hik-project.uz:
Hikvision loyihaviy uskunalari — bu yirik va texnik jihatdan murakkab xavfsizlik tizimlarini amalga oshirish uchun ishlab chiqilgan maxsus mahsulot liniyasidir. Standart assortimentdan farqli o'laroq, loyihaviy seriya unumdorlik, masshtablanuvchanlik va ishonchlilikka yuqori talablar qo'yiladigan obyektlar uchun mo'ljallangan: sanoat korxonalari, aeroportlar, savdo markazlari, bank muassasalari va shahar infratuzilmasi. Toshkentda Hikvision loyihaviy uskunalarini SAT Solutions rasmiy hamkoridan sotib olish mumkin, u ushbu liniya bilan butun O'zbekiston bo'ylab kompleks loyihalar doirasida ishlaydi.

Loyihaviy uskunaning asosiy xususiyati — kengaytirilgan texnik xarakteristikalar: 96 va 128 kanalli videoregistratorlar, davlat raqamlarini avtomatik tanish uchun ANPR kameralar, tezkor aylanuvchi PTZ kameralar, operator markazlari uchun maxsus kompyuterlar va LCD monitorlar, shuningdek sanoat sinfidagi kirishni boshqarish (SKUD) kontrollerlari. Bularning barchasi Hikvision dasturiy platformasi orqali yagona tizimga birlashtiriladi va yuqori yuklamalar sharoitida sutkalik ekspluatatsiyaga mo'ljallangan.

Loyihaviy uskunani tanlash obyektni oldindan tekshirishni, texnik topshiriq tuzishni va tizimning o'tkazuvchanlik qobiliyatini hisoblashni talab qiladi. Loyihalash bosqichidagi xatolar yetarli bo'lmagan unumdorlikka yoki komponentlarning mos kelmasligiga olib kelishi mumkin, shuning uchun bunday yechimlar uchun butun liniyani biladigan va tizimni aniq vazifalarga moslab masshtablashni uddalaydigan tajribali integrator bilan ishlash ayniqsa muhim.

## Qanday tanlash kerak

- Kanallar soni va yuklama: yirik obyektlar uchun 96–128 IP-kanalni qo'llab-quvvatlaydigan DS-96xxx yoki DS-96128NI seriyali videoregistratorlardan foydalaning. Tizimni kengaytirish ehtimolini hisobga olib, kameralar sonini 20–30% zaxira bilan hisoblang.
- Videoanalitikaga talablar: agar obyekt transport kirishini nazorat qilishni ko'zda tutsa, IDS-2CD7A va IDS-2CD7A26G0 seriyali ANPR kameralarni tanlang. Umumiy videokuzatuv uchun bazaviy analitikaga ega standart IP-kameralar yetarli.
- Ruxsat va obyektiv diapazoni: DS-2CD5AC5G0 va DS-2CD3641G2 loyihaviy kameralari 2.8–12 mm yoki 2.7–13.5 mm diapazonli variofokal obyektivlarga ega bo'lib, bu ko'rish burchagini aniq kuzatuv zonasiga moslab sozlash imkonini beradi.
- Dinamik kuzatuv uchun PTZ kameralar: DS-2DF8C835MHS seriyali modellar optik yaqinlashtirish va joylashuvni masofadan boshqarishni ta'minlaydi — perimetrlar, avtoturargohlar va katta ochiq maydonlar uchun zarur.
- Tarmoq infratuzilmasi: masshtabli tizimlarda PoE marshrutizatorlar va kommutatorlarni to'g'ri tanlash muhim. DS-3WG210GP-SI modellari bitta kabel orqali quvvat va ma'lumot uzatishni ta'minlab, montaj xarajatlarini kamaytiradi.
- SKUD va integratsiya: agar loyiha kirishni nazorat qilishni o'z ichiga olsa, DS-K2604T seriyali kontrollerlarning allaqachon o'rnatilgan o'quvchilar va dasturiy ta'minot bilan mosligiga ishonch hosil qiling.
- Operator ish joyi: dispetcherlik markazlari uchun 24/7 rejimida videooqimlar bilan ishlashga optimallashtirilgan DS-D5AC9C5 maxsus kompyuterlari va DS-D2055LU monitorlarini tanlang.

## Qo'llanilish sohalari

- Sanoat korxonalari va zavodlar: perimetr nazorati, sexlarda videokuzatuv, KPPdagi SKUD va xodimlarning kirishini real vaqtda boshqarish.
- Aeroportlar, vokzallar va transport tugunlari: transport oqimlarini nazorat qilish uchun ANPR tizimlari, o'tirish zonalarini kuzatish uchun PTZ kameralar, dispetcherlik tizimlari bilan integratsiya.
- Savdo markazlari va biznes majmualari: ko'p kanalli NVR tizimlari, tashrif buyuruvchilarni hisoblash uchun videoanalitika, xizmat zonalari va server xonalariga kirishni nazorat qilish.
- Banklar, moliya muassasalari va ma'lumotlarni qayta ishlash markazlari (DPI): yozuvning ishonchliligi, zaxiralash va ruxsatsiz kirishdan himoyaga yuqori talablar, videokuzatuv va SKUD tizimlarining integratsiyasi.
- Aqlli shaharlar va shahar infratuzilmasi: Hikvision loyihaviy uskunalari O'zbekistonda jamoat joylari, yo'llar va muhim infratuzilma obyektlarini videokuzatuv qilish bo'yicha davlat loyihalarida qo'llaniladi.
- Tibbiyot muassasalari va ta'lim majmualari: yopiq zonalarga kirishni nazorat qilish, avtoturargohlar va hududda videokuzatuv, yagona operator markazidan markazlashtirilgan boshqaruv.

## Katalogdagi brendlar va modellar

- Hikvision — ushbu bo'limdagi yagona brend, va bu qonuniy: Hikvision loyihaviy liniyasi barcha komponentlar birgalikda ishlash uchun ishlab chiqilgan tugallangan ekotizimni ifodalaydi. Bu tizimni masshtablashda moslik muammolarini oldini olish imkonini beradi.
- DS-96xxx va DS-96128NI seriyali videoregistratorlar — yuzlab kameralarga ega obyektlar uchun flagman NVR yechimlari bo'lib, yuqori bitreytlarni va videoarxiv bo'yicha intellektual qidiruv texnologiyalarini qo'llab-quvvatlaydi.
- IDS-2CD7A46G0 va IDS-2CD7A26G0 seriyali ANPR kameralar — 8–32 mm variofokal obyektivli davlat raqamlarini avtomatik tanish uchun maxsus qurilmalar bo'lib, kirish guruhlari va avtoturargohlarda ishlashga optimallashtirilgan.
- DS-2DF8C835MHS PTZ kameralar — kengaytirilgan videoanalitika funksiyalariga ega yuqori tezlikdagi aylanuvchi qurilmalar bo'lib, katta ochiq maydonlarni kuzatish uchun mo'ljallangan.
- DS-K2604T kirish kontrollerlari va tegishli SKUD uskunalari — markazlashtirilgan boshqaruvga ega ko'p zonali kirishni nazorat qilish tizimlarini qurish uchun komponent bazasi.

## FAQ

Q: Hikvision loyihaviy va standart uskunalari o'rtasida qanday farq bor?
A: Loyihaviy liniya yuqori yuklamalarga ega obyektlarga mo'ljallangan: ko'proq kanallar, kengaytirilgan videoanalitika, ishonchlilikka yuqori talablar va 24/7 rejimida xizmat muddati. Standart uskuna oddiy videokuzatuv vazifalariga ega kichik obyektlar uchun mos.

Q: Hikvision loyihaviy uskunasi qancha turadi va hisob-kitobni qanday olish mumkin?
A: Narx kanallar soniga, kameralar turiga va qo'shimcha uskunalar hajmiga bog'liq. SAT Solutions saytida so'rov qoldiring yoki menejerlarimiz bilan bog'laning — obyektingizning texnik topshirig'i asosida tijorat taklifini tayyorlaymiz.

Q: Hikvision loyihaviy uskunasini boshqa ishlab chiqaruvchilarning tizimlari bilan integratsiya qilish mumkinmi?
A: Ha, aksariyat qurilmalar ONVIF va RTSP protokollarini qo'llab-quvvatlaydi, bu ularni uchinchi tomon ishlab chiquvchilarining videoboshqaruv platformalari bilan integratsiya qilish imkonini beradi. Biroq, videoanalitikaning to'liq funksionalligi uchun Hikvision dasturiy ta'minotidan foydalanish tavsiya etiladi.

Q: Hikvision loyihaviy uskunasiga qanday kafolat beriladi?
A: Aksariyat pozitsiyalarga ishlab chiqaruvchining rasmiy kafolati 3 yilni tashkil etadi. SAT Solutions vakolatli hamkor sifatida zavod nuqsoni bo'lganda kafolatli xizmat ko'rsatish va uskunani almashtirishni ta'minlaydi.

Q: Loyihani bosqichma-bosqich amalga oshirish va kelajakda tizimni kengaytirish mumkinmi?
A: Ha, Hikvision loyihaviy liniyasi dastlab masshtablanuvchanlikni hisobga olib ishlab chiqilgan. Videoregistratorlar yangi kameralar qo'shishni qo'llab-quvvatlaydi, SKUD kontrollerlari qo'shimcha modullar hisobiga kengayadi. Biz tizimni kelajakdagi o'sish uchun zaxira bilan loyihalashtiramiz.
hik-project.en:
Hikvision project-grade equipment is a specialized product line developed for implementing large and technically complex security systems. Unlike the standard range, the project series is designed for facilities with elevated requirements for performance, scalability and reliability: industrial enterprises, airports, shopping malls, banking institutions and urban infrastructure. You can buy Hikvision project-grade equipment in Tashkent from the official partner SAT Solutions, which works with this line as part of turnkey projects across Uzbekistan.

The key feature of project-grade equipment is its enhanced technical specifications: video recorders with 96 and 128 channels, ANPR cameras for automatic license plate recognition, high-speed PTZ cameras, specialized computers and LCD monitors for operator centers, as well as industrial-class ACS controllers. All this equipment is integrated into a single system via the Hikvision software platform and is designed for round-the-clock operation under high load.

Choosing project-grade equipment requires a preliminary site survey, drafting of technical specifications and calculation of the system's throughput. Mistakes at the design stage can lead to insufficient performance or component incompatibility, so for such solutions it is especially important to work with an experienced integrator who is familiar with the entire line and knows how to scale the system to specific tasks.

## How to choose

- Number of channels and load: for large facilities use DS-96xxx or DS-96128NI series video recorders supporting 96-128 IP channels. Calculate the number of cameras with a 20-30% reserve for possible system expansion.
- Video analytics requirements: if the facility involves vehicle entry control, choose ANPR cameras of the IDS-2CD7A and IDS-2CD7A26G0 series. For general video surveillance, standard IP cameras with basic analytics are sufficient.
- Resolution and lens range: project cameras DS-2CD5AC5G0 and DS-2CD3641G2 have varifocal lenses with a range of 2.8-12 mm or 2.7-13.5 mm, which allows the field of view to be precisely adjusted to a specific surveillance zone.
- PTZ cameras for dynamic surveillance: models of the DS-2DF8C835MHS series provide optical zoom and remote positioning control - essential for perimeters, parking lots and large open areas.
- Network infrastructure: in large-scale systems it is important to correctly select PoE routers and switches. The DS-3WG210GP-SI models provide power and data transmission over a single cable, reducing installation costs.
- ACS and integration: if the project includes access control, make sure the DS-K2604T series controllers are compatible with already installed readers and software.
- Operator workstation: for control centers choose specialized DS-D5AC9C5 computers and DS-D2055LU monitors optimized for working with video streams in 24/7 mode.

## Applications

- Industrial enterprises and factories: perimeter control, video surveillance in workshops, ACS at checkpoints and real-time employee access management.
- Airports, railway stations and transport hubs: ANPR systems for traffic flow control, PTZ cameras for monitoring boarding areas, integration with dispatch systems.
- Shopping malls and business complexes: multi-channel NVR systems, video analytics for visitor counting, access control to service areas and server rooms.
- Banks, financial institutions and data centers: elevated requirements for recording reliability, redundancy and protection against unauthorized access, integration of video surveillance and ACS systems.
- Smart cities and urban infrastructure: Hikvision project-grade equipment is used in government projects for video surveillance of public spaces, roads and critical infrastructure facilities in Uzbekistan.
- Medical institutions and educational complexes: access control to restricted areas, video surveillance in parking lots and grounds, centralized management from a single operator center.

## Brands and models in the catalog

- Hikvision is the only brand in this section, and this is natural: the Hikvision project line is a complete ecosystem in which all components are developed to work together. This helps avoid compatibility problems when scaling the system.
- DS-96xxx and DS-96128NI series video recorders are flagship NVR solutions for facilities with hundreds of cameras, supporting high bitrates and intelligent video archive search technologies.
- ANPR cameras of the IDS-2CD7A46G0 and IDS-2CD7A26G0 series are specialized devices for automatic license plate recognition with an 8-32 mm varifocal lens, optimized for operation at entry groups and parking lots.
- DS-2DF8C835MHS PTZ cameras are high-speed pan-tilt devices with advanced video analytics functions, designed for surveillance of large open spaces.
- DS-K2604T access controllers and associated ACS equipment form the component base for building multi-zone access control systems with centralized management.

## FAQ

Q: What is the difference between project-grade and standard Hikvision equipment?
A: The project line is designed for facilities with elevated loads: more channels, advanced video analytics, higher reliability requirements and a service life in 24/7 mode. Standard equipment is suitable for small facilities with typical video surveillance tasks.

Q: How much does Hikvision project-grade equipment cost and how can I get a quote?
A: The cost depends on the number of channels, the type of cameras and the volume of additional equipment. Submit a request on the SAT Solutions website or contact our managers - we will prepare a commercial proposal based on the technical specifications of your facility.

Q: Can Hikvision project-grade equipment be integrated with systems from other manufacturers?
A: Yes, most devices support ONVIF and RTSP protocols, which allows them to be integrated with third-party video management platforms. However, for full video analytics functionality, it is recommended to use Hikvision software.

Q: What warranty applies to Hikvision project-grade equipment?
A: The official manufacturer's warranty on most items is 3 years. As an authorized partner, SAT Solutions provides warranty service and equipment replacement in case of a manufacturing defect.

Q: Is phased project implementation and future system expansion possible?
A: Yes, the Hikvision project line is designed from the outset with scalability in mind. Video recorders support adding new cameras, and ACS controllers are expanded with additional modules. We design the system with a reserve for future growth.

ruijie-switches.uz:
Kommutatorlar — obyektdagi har qanday tuzilgan kabel tarmog'ining asosidir: aynan ular ish stansiyalari, serverlar, IP-kameralar, kirish nuqtalari va boshqa faol uskunalarni yagona boshqariladigan tizimga birlashtiradi. To'g'ri tanlangan kommutatorsiz hatto eng qimmat oxirgi uskuna ham beqaror ishlaydi: to'qnashuvlar yuzaga keladi, o'tkazuvchanlik qobiliyati pasayadi, paketlar yo'qoladi. Toshkentda aniq loyiha uchun professional tanlov bilan kommutator sotib olish — butun IT-infratuzilma uchun ishonchli poydevor qo'yish demakdir.

SAT Solutions katalogida turli sinfdagi Ruijie kommutatorlari taqdim etilgan: kichik ofislar va texnik xonalar uchun boshqarilmaydigan, VLAN va QoS qo'llab-quvvatlashiga ega korporativ tarmoqlar uchun boshqariladigan L2 va L2+, shuningdek apparat darajasida marshrutlash imkoniyatiga ega quvvatli L3 kommutatorlar. Liniya mis portli Gigabit Ethernet qurilmalarni ham, optik magistrallarni ulash uchun SFP-slotli modellarni ham qamrab oladi. Videokuzatuv va IP-telefoniya tizimlari uchun PoE qo'llab-quvvatlashiga ega versiyalar dolzarb — ular ulangan qurilmalarni alohida quvvat bloklarisiz to'g'ridan-to'g'ri o'ralgan juftlik kabeli orqali quvvatlantiradi.

Aniq modelni tanlash obyekt masshtabiga, boshqarilishga talablarga, portlar soniga va PoE quvvatlantirish zaruratiga bog'liq. O'zbekistonda boshqariladigan kommutatorlarga talab biznes IP-videokuzatuvga va markazlashtirilgan tarmoq boshqaruviga o'tishi bilan o'sib bormoqda: apparat VLAN qo'llab-quvvatlashiga ega bitta model kameralar, ofis kompyuterlari va mehmon Wi-Fi trafigini aniq ajratish imkonini beradi.

## Qanday tanlash kerak

- Boshqarilish sinfi: boshqarilmaydigan kommutator segmentatsiyaga talabsiz oddiy tarmoqlar uchun mos; boshqariladigan L2 VLAN, STP va portlar monitoringi ustidan nazorat beradi; L2+ statik marshrutlashni qo'shadi; L3 apparat darajasida to'liq marshrutlashni ta'minlaydi va ko'p segmentli korporativ tarmoqlar uchun zarur.

- Portlar soni va turi: ulanadigan qurilmalar sonini o'sish uchun 20-30% zaxira bilan hisoblang. Optik aplinklar uchun SFP-portlar kerakligini hisobga oling — bu ayniqsa binolar yoki qavatlar orasidagi katta masofalarda muhim.

- PoE qo'llab-quvvatlash: agar kommutatorga IP-kameralar, kirish nuqtalari yoki IP-telefonlar ulansa, PoE yoki PoE+ modellarni tanlang. PoE umumiy quvvat byudjetiga e'tibor bering — u barcha ulangan qurilmalar iste'molini qoplashi kerak.

- O'tkazuvchanlik qobiliyati va unumdorlik: bir nechta yuqori ruxsatli oqimga ega videokuzatuv uchun bloklanmaydigan kommutatsiya matritsasi muhim. E'lon qilingan o'tkazuvchanlik qobiliyati portlar soni va ularning tezligiga mos kelishiga ishonch hosil qiling.

- Steklash va zaxiralashni qo'llab-quvvatlash: muhim obyektlarda uzilishlarga chidamlilik muhim — Ruijie kommutatorlarining bir qismi halqasimon topologiyalar va kanallarni zaxiralash protokollarini qo'llab-quvvatlaydi.

- Montaj: stol usti modellar kichik ofislar uchun mos, rack-o'rnatiladigan (1U, 2U) — server shkaflari va texnik xonalar uchun. Shkaf chuqurligi va shamollatishning mavjudligini aniqlashtiring.

- Mavjud infratuzilma bilan moslik: kommutator obyektda qo'llaniladigan boshqaruv protokollari va standartlarini qo'llab-quvvatlashi kerak. Ruijie IEEE standartlariga mos va SNMP, LLDP, LACP standart protokollarini qo'llab-quvvatlaydi.

## Qo'llanilish sohalari

- Ofis va biznes markazlari: trafikni bo'limlar bo'yicha segmentlash bilan korporativ lokal tarmoq qurish, PoE orqali IP-telefoniya va simsiz kirish nuqtalarini qo'llab-quvvatlash.

- Videokuzatuv obyektlari: IP-kameralarni izolyatsiyalangan VLANga birlashtirish, kameralarni PoE orqali quvvatlantirish, videooqimlarni kafolatlangan polosa bilan NVR va saqlash serverlariga uzatish.

- Ishlab chiqarish korxonalari va omborlar: sanoat ekspluatatsiyasi sharoitlari uchun kengaytirilgan harorat diapazoni va shovqinlardan himoyaga ega ishonchli boshqariladigan kommutatorlar.

- O'quv muassasalari va davlat idoralari: o'qituvchilar, talabalar va ma'muriy xodimlar uchun kirishni ajratish bilan himoyalangan tarmoqlar qurish.

- Mehmonxonalar va savdo obyektlari: mehmon Wi-Fi'ni xizmat tarmog'idan alohida boshqarish, kirishni nazorat qilish tizimlari va kassa uskunalari bilan integratsiya.

- Provayder va magistral yechimlar: Ruijie M6000 va RG-NBS6002 seriyali L3 kommutatorlari SFP/SFP+ optik interfeyslarni qo'llab-quvvatlash bilan yuqori yuklamali tugunlarga mo'ljallangan.

## Katalogdagi brendlar va modellar

- Ruijie Networks — 20 yildan ortiq tarixga ega, korporativ va provayder tarmoq yechimlariga ixtisoslashgan xitoy vendori. Uskuna xalqaro standartlar bo'yicha sertifikatlangan va butun dunyo bo'ylab bank sektorida, ta'limda va davlat tuzilmalarida faol qo'llaniladi.

- RG-ES seriyasi (boshqarilmaydigan): RG-ES116G-L va RG-ES118S-LP modellari — Gigabit Ethernet portli, kichik ofislar va texnik xonalar uchun mo'ljallangan ixcham boshqarilmaydigan kommutatorlar. -LP va -P qo'shimchali versiyalar IP-kameralar va kirish nuqtalarini quvvatlantirish uchun PoEni qo'llab-quvvatlaydi.

- RG-ES seriyasi (boshqariladigan L2): RG-ES206GS-P, RG-ES209GC-P, RG-ES210GS-P, RG-ES224GC-V2 modellari — VLAN, QoS va monitoring qo'llab-quvvatlashiga ega boshqariladigan kommutatorlar. -P qo'shimchasi PoE qo'llab-quvvatlashini ko'rsatadi, bu ularni IP-videokuzatuv uchun qulay qiladi.

- RG-NBS3100/3200 seriyasi (L2+): optik aplinklar uchun SFP portli va kengaytirilgan L2+ funksiyalarini qo'llab-quvvatlaydigan modellar. RG-NBS3100-24GT4SFP-P-V2 va RG-NBS3200-24GT4XS zaxiralash va segmentatsiyaga talablar bilan o'rta masshtabli korporativ tarmoqlarga yo'naltirilgan.

- RG-NBS6002 va M6000 seriyasi (L3): apparat marshrutlashiga va yuqori tezlikdagi SFP+ interfeyslar qo'llab-quvvatlashiga ega flagman kommutatorlar. Yirik korporativ yoki provayder tarmoqlaridagi agregatsiya tugunlari uchun mo'ljallangan.

## FAQ

Q: Boshqariladigan kommutator boshqarilmaydigandan nimasi bilan yaxshiroq va ortiqcha to'lashga arziydimi?
A: Boshqarilmaydigan kommutator «yoqib qo'ydik va unutdik» tamoyili bo'yicha ishlaydi — sozlamalarsiz va trafikni nazorat qilish imkoniyatisiz. Boshqariladigan VLAN yaratish, trafik ustuvorligini (QoS) belgilash, portlarni monitoring qilish va tarmoq segmentlarini izolyatsiya qilish imkonini beradi. IP-kameralar, IP-telefoniya yoki bir nechta bo'limga ega obyektlar uchun boshqariladigan kommutator tarmoq bilan bog'liq birinchi jiddiy muammoda o'zini oqlaydi.

Q: Ruijie kommutatori qancha turadi va narx nimaga bog'liq?
A: Narx qurilma sinfi, portlar soni, PoE qo'llab-quvvatlash va boshqarilish darajasi bilan belgilanadi. Boshlang'ich darajadagi boshqarilmaydigan modellar arzon narxda mavjud, boshqariladigan SFP-portli L3 kommutatorlar esa sezilarli darajada qimmatroq. Loyihangiz uchun aniq narxni hisoblash uchun SAT Solutions menejerlariga murojaat qiling — biz optimal narx/funksionallik nisbatini tanlaymiz.

Q: Ruijie kommutatorlarini boshqa brendlar uskunasi bilan birga ishlatish mumkinmi?
A: Ha, Ruijie IEEE 802.1Q (VLAN), 802.3af/at (PoE), LACP, STP va SNMP standart protokollarini amalga oshiradi, bu Cisco, Huawei, TP-Link va boshqa ishlab chiqaruvchilar uskunasi bilan moslikni ta'minlaydi. Gibrid tarmoqlar qurishda mutaxassislarimiz aniq modellarning mosligini oldindan tekshiradilar.

Q: Kommutatorni montaj qilish kerakmi yoki mustaqil o'rnatish mumkinmi?
A: Kichik boshqarilmaydigan kommutatorni mustaqil o'rnatish mumkin — u sozlashni talab qilmaydi. Boshqariladigan L2/L3 kommutatorlar professional konfiguratsiyani talab qiladi: VLAN yoki STP noto'g'ri sozlamalari halqalar va tarmoq uzilishiga olib kelishi mumkin. Montaj va sozlashni mutaxassislarga ishonib topshirishni tavsiya qilamiz, ayniqsa foydalanuvchanlikka yuqori talablar bilan obyektlarda.

Q: Kommutatorlarga kafolat bormi va unga nimalar kiradi?
A: Ruijie uskunasi ishlab chiqaruvchining rasmiy kafolati bilan yetkazib beriladi. SAT Solutions qo'shimcha ravishda servis qo'llab-quvvatlashni ta'minlaydi: diagnostika, kafolat davrida nosoz qurilmalarni almashtirish va kafolatdan keyingi xizmat. Aniq model uchun kafolat shartlarini menejerlarimizdan aniqlashtiring.
ruijie-switches.en:
Switches are the foundation of any structured cabling network at a facility: they are what unites workstations, servers, IP cameras, access points and other active equipment into a single managed system. Without a properly selected switch, even the most expensive terminal equipment works unstably: collisions occur, throughput drops, packets are lost. To buy a switch in Tashkent with professional selection for a specific project means laying a reliable foundation for the entire IT infrastructure.

The SAT Solutions catalog features Ruijie switches of various classes: unmanaged for small offices and utility rooms, managed L2 and L2+ for corporate networks with VLAN and QoS support, as well as powerful L3 switches with hardware-level routing capability. The line covers both devices with copper Gigabit Ethernet ports and models with SFP slots for connecting optical trunks. For video surveillance and IP telephony systems, PoE-enabled versions are relevant - they power connected devices directly through the twisted-pair cable without separate power supplies.

The choice of a specific model depends on the scale of the facility, manageability requirements, the number of ports and the need for PoE power. In Uzbekistan, demand for managed switches is growing as businesses transition to IP video surveillance and centralized network management: a single model with hardware VLAN support makes it possible to clearly separate the traffic of cameras, office PCs and guest Wi-Fi.

## How to choose

- Management class: an unmanaged switch is suitable for simple networks without segmentation requirements; a managed L2 switch gives control over VLAN, STP and port monitoring; L2+ adds static routing; L3 provides full hardware-level routing and is needed for multi-segment corporate networks.

- Number and type of ports: calculate the number of connected devices with a 20-30% reserve for growth. Consider whether SFP ports are needed for optical uplinks - this is especially important over long distances between buildings or floors.

- PoE support: if IP cameras, access points or IP phones connect to the switch, choose models with PoE or PoE+. Pay attention to the total PoE power budget - it must cover the consumption of all connected devices.

- Throughput and performance: for video surveillance with several high-resolution streams, a non-blocking switching matrix is critical. Make sure the declared throughput matches the number of ports and their speeds.

- Stacking and redundancy support: on critical facilities, fault tolerance is important - some Ruijie switches support ring topologies and link redundancy protocols.

- Installation: desktop models are suitable for small offices, rack-mountable models (1U, 2U) are for server cabinets and utility rooms. Check the cabinet depth and the availability of ventilation.

- Compatibility with existing infrastructure: the switch must support the same management protocols and standards used at the facility. Ruijie is compatible with IEEE standards and supports the standard SNMP, LLDP and LACP protocols.

## Applications

- Offices and business centers: building a corporate local area network with traffic segmentation by department, support for IP telephony and wireless access points via PoE.

- Video surveillance facilities: uniting IP cameras into an isolated VLAN, powering cameras via PoE, transmitting video streams to NVRs and storage servers with guaranteed bandwidth.

- Manufacturing enterprises and warehouses: reliable managed switches with an extended temperature range and interference protection for industrial operating conditions.

- Educational institutions and government agencies: building secure networks with access differentiation for teachers, students and administrative staff.

- Hotels and retail facilities: managing guest Wi-Fi separately from the service network, integration with access control systems and POS equipment.

- Provider and backbone solutions: L3 switches of the Ruijie M6000 series and RG-NBS6002 are designed for high-load nodes with support for SFP/SFP+ optical interfaces.

## Brands and models in the catalog

- Ruijie Networks is a Chinese vendor with over 20 years of history, specializing in corporate and provider network solutions. The equipment is certified to international standards and is actively used in the banking sector, education and government structures worldwide.

- RG-ES series (unmanaged): the RG-ES116G-L and RG-ES118S-LP models are compact unmanaged switches with Gigabit Ethernet ports, designed for small offices and utility rooms. Versions with the -LP and -P suffixes support PoE for powering IP cameras and access points.

- RG-ES series (managed L2): the RG-ES206GS-P, RG-ES209GC-P, RG-ES210GS-P and RG-ES224GC-V2 models are managed switches with VLAN, QoS and monitoring support. The -P suffix indicates PoE support, which makes them convenient for IP video surveillance.

- RG-NBS3100/3200 series (L2+): models with SFP ports for optical uplinks and support for advanced L2+ features. The RG-NBS3100-24GT4SFP-P-V2 and RG-NBS3200-24GT4XS are aimed at medium-scale corporate networks with redundancy and segmentation requirements.

- RG-NBS6002 and M6000 series (L3): flagship switches with hardware routing and support for high-speed SFP+ interfaces. Designed for aggregation nodes in large corporate or provider networks.

## FAQ

Q: How is a managed switch better than an unmanaged one, and is it worth paying extra?
A: An unmanaged switch works on a "plug and forget" principle - no configuration and no ability to control traffic. A managed switch allows you to create VLANs, assign traffic priorities (QoS), monitor ports and isolate network segments. For facilities with IP cameras, IP telephony or several departments, a managed switch pays for itself at the first serious network problem.

Q: How much does a Ruijie switch cost and what determines the price?
A: The price is determined by the device class, the number of ports, PoE support and the management level. Entry-level unmanaged models are available at a low price, while managed L3 switches with SFP ports are significantly more expensive. For an accurate cost calculation for your project, contact SAT Solutions managers - we will find the optimal price/functionality ratio.

Q: Can Ruijie switches be used together with equipment from other brands?
A: Yes, Ruijie implements the standard IEEE 802.1Q (VLAN), 802.3af/at (PoE), LACP, STP and SNMP protocols, which ensures compatibility with equipment from Cisco, Huawei, TP-Link and other manufacturers. When building hybrid networks, our specialists check the compatibility of specific models in advance.

Q: Does a switch require professional installation or can it be installed independently?
A: A small unmanaged switch can be installed independently - it requires no configuration. Managed L2/L3 switches require professional configuration: incorrect VLAN or STP settings can lead to loops and network failure. We recommend entrusting installation and configuration to specialists, especially at facilities with high availability requirements.

Q: Is there a warranty on the switches and what does it cover?
A: Ruijie equipment comes with an official manufacturer's warranty. SAT Solutions additionally provides service support: diagnostics, replacement of faulty devices during the warranty period and post-warranty service. Check the warranty terms for a specific model with our managers.

Wi-Fi kirish nuqtalari — bu qurilmalarni lokal tarmoq yoki internetga simsiz ulanishni ta'minlaydigan tarmoq uskunasidir. Maishiy routerlardan farqli o'laroq, professional kirish nuqtalari doimiy yuklama, boshqariladigan infratuzilma va yirik simsiz tarmoqlar tarkibida ishlashga mo'ljallangan. Aynan bunday uskuna sanoat obyektlarida, ofislarda, savdo markazlarida, mehmonxonalarda va aloqa barqarorligi hamda markazlashtirilgan boshqaruv muhim bo'lgan videokuzatuv obyektlarida qo'llaniladi.

SAT Solutions katalogida Hikvision Wi-Fi kirish nuqtalari taqdim etilgan — bu ishlab chiqaruvchi asosan videokuzatuv tizimlari bilan mashhur, biroq o'zining NVR, IP-kameralari va xavfsizlik tizimlari bilan integratsiyaga yo'naltirilgan tarmoq uskunasini ham chiqaradi. Toshkentda kafolat bilan va aniq obyekt uchun professional tanlov bilan Wi-Fi kirish nuqtalarini sotib olishni SAT Solutions'da amalga oshirish mumkin: biz butun O'zbekiston bo'ylab ishlaymiz va simsiz infratuzilmani noldan qurishga yordam beramiz.

Uskunani tanlash bir necha omilga bog'liq: qamrov zonasi maydoni, bir vaqtdagi ulanishlar soni, tashqi yoki ichki antennalarning mavjudligi, Wi-Fi standarti va tarmoq vazifalari. Katalogdagi modellarning bir qismi — Omni turidagi ichki shift kirish nuqtalari (DS-3WAP seriyasi), bir qismi — yog'ingarchilikdan himoyalangan va har tomonlama yo'naltirilgan antennali ko'cha nuqtalari (DS-3WF02C seriyasi). Shuningdek katalogda Wi-Fi NVR (DS-7102NI-S1/W, DS-7104NI-S1/W) va simli internetsiz obyektlar uchun DS-3WR4G3N 4G marshrutizatori bor.

## Qanday tanlash kerak

- Wi-Fi standarti: DS-3WAP seriyali modellar yuqori tezlik va zich tarmoqni ta'minlaydigan dolzarb standartlarni qo'llab-quvvatlaydi. 2,4 GHz va 5 GHz diapazonlarini qo'llab-quvvatlashni aniqlashtiring — ikki diapazonli nuqtalar ko'p sonli qurilmalarni uddalaydi.
- Joylashtirish zonasi (indoor/outdoor): ko'cha uchun namlik va changdan himoyaga ega nuqtalar kerak (IP66 va undan yuqori sinf), masalan DS-3WF02C-5AC/O seriyasi. Ichki xonalarni DS-3WAP shift modellari qamrab oladi.
- Bir vaqtdagi mijozlar soni: ombor yoki ko'p sonli xodimlarga ega ofisda MU-MIMO texnologiyasini qo'llab-quvvatlaydigan va ulanishlar cheklovi yuqori bo'lgan nuqtalar kerak.
- Quvvatlantirish: aksariyat professional kirish nuqtalari PoE (802.3af/at) texnologiyasi bo'yicha quvvatlanadi, bu alohida elektr o'tkazish zaruratini bartaraf etadi va montajni soddalashtiradi.
- Videokuzatuv bilan integratsiya: agar obyektda Hikvision uskunasi allaqachon o'rnatilgan yoki rejalashtirilgan bo'lsa, Wi-Fi NVR (DS-7102NI-S1/W) alohida serversiz simsiz kameralardan yozib olishni tashkil qilish imkonini beradi.
- Uzoqlik va antenna turi: binolar orasida simsiz ko'prik tashkil qilish uchun DS-3WF02-5AC/D seriyasi (Wi-Fi ko'prik) mos. To'g'ri ko'rinishda uzoqligi bir necha yuz metrgacha.
- 4G zaxiralashning mavjudligi: agar obyekt barqaror simli internetga ega bo'lmasa, LTEni qo'llab-quvvatlaydigan DS-3WR4G3N marshrutizatori uyali tarmoq orqali aloqani ta'minlaydi.

## Qo'llanilish sohalari

- Ofis va ma'muriy binolar: xodimlar, IP-telefoniya va videokuzatuv tizimlari uchun yagona infratuzilmada uzluksiz Wi-Fi ta'minlash.
- Ishlab chiqarish va ombor obyektlari: minimal nuqtalar soni bilan katta maydonlarni qamrab olish, sanoat shovqinlariga chidamlilik, ma'lumot yig'ish terminallari bilan integratsiya.
- Mehmonxonalar, savdo markazlari va HoReCa obyektlari: ko'p sonli mehmon ulanishlariga ega zich tarmoq, mehmon VLANlarini yaratish imkoniyati.
- Ko'cha perimetrlari va avtoturargohlar: DS-3WF02C-5AC/O seriyali ko'cha kirish nuqtalari ochiq zonalarni qamrab oladi, Wi-Fi ko'priklar esa korpuslarni kabel o'tkazmasdan ulaydi.
- Simli internetsiz obyektlar (vaqtinchalik maydonchalar, uzoq omborlar): Hikvision DS-3WR4G3N 4G marshrutizatori LTE orqali tarmoqqa chiqishni tashkil qiladi.
- Simsiz kameralarga ega videokuzatuv tizimlari: Hikvision Wi-Fi NVR kabel o'tkazish imkonsiz yoki maqsadga muvofiq bo'lmagan joyda simsiz kameralardan videoni yozib olish va saqlash imkonini beradi.

## Katalogdagi brendlar va modellar

- Hikvision (DS-3WAP seriyali kirish nuqtalari): DS-3WAP521-SI, DS-3WAP522-SI, DS-3WAP621E-SI, DS-3WAP622G-SI ichki shift modellari — ofis va savdo obyektlari uchun mo'ljallangan, kontroller orqali markazlashtirilgan boshqaruvni qo'llab-quvvatlaydi.
- Hikvision (DS-3WF02C seriyali ko'cha nuqtalari): tashqi montaj uchun har tomonlama yo'naltirilgan antennali DS-3WF02C-5N/O va DS-3WF02C-5AC/O modellari, yog'ingarchilik va harorat o'zgarishlaridan himoya.
- Hikvision (DS-3WF02 Wi-Fi ko'priklari): to'g'ri ko'rinish masofasida kabel o'tkazmasdan binolar orasida simsiz oraliqlarni tashkil qilish uchun DS-3WF02-5AC/D modeli.
- Hikvision (Wi-Fi NVR): simsiz IP-kameralardan yozib olish uchun o'rnatilgan Wi-Fi modulli DS-7102NI-S1/W va DS-7104NI-S1/W videoregistratorlari — kichik obyektlar uchun qulay yechim.
- Hikvision (DS-3WR4G3N 4G marshrutizatori): simli internetsiz obyektlar uchun LTE-router, yevropa va MDH chastotalarini qo'llab-quvvatlash, aloqani zaxiralash.

## FAQ

Q: Toshkentda Hikvision Wi-Fi kirish nuqtasi qancha turadi?
A: Narx modelga, ijroga (indoor/outdoor) va funksionallikka bog'liq. Kerakli modelni menejerlarimizdan aniqlashtiring — biz byudjet bo'yicha optimal variantni tanlaymiz va tijorat taklifini tayyorlaymiz.

Q: Hikvision Wi-Fi kirish nuqtalarini kontrollersiz ishlatish mumkinmi?
A: Ha, DS-3WAP seriyali aksariyat modellar avtonom rejimni ham, kontroller orqali boshqaruvni ham qo'llab-quvvatlaydi. Kichik obyektlar uchun avtonom sozlash yetarli; yirik installatsiyalar uchun kontrollerli boshqaruvni tavsiya qilamiz.

Q: Ko'cha kirish nuqtalari O'zbekistonda yil davomida ekspluatatsiya uchun mosmi?
A: DS-3WF02C-5AC/O seriyasi keng harorat diapazonida ishlashga mo'ljallangan va changdan hamda namlikdan himoyaga ega, bu issiq yozgi davrda ham, qishda ham ekspluatatsiya sharoitlariga mos keladi.

Q: Ikki bino orasida kabel o'tkazmasdan Wi-Fi'ni qanday tashkil qilish mumkin?
A: Buning uchun Hikvision DS-3WF02-5AC/D Wi-Fi ko'prigi ishlatiladi. Obyektlar orasida to'g'ri ko'rinish bo'lsa, u bir necha yuz metr masofada barqaror simsiz oraliqni ta'minlaydi.

Q: Tarmoqni sozlash montaj narxiga kiradimi?
A: Ha, SAT Solutions ishlarning to'liq siklini bajaradi: uskunani montaj qilishdan tortib SSID, VLAN, mehmon Wi-Fi'ni sozlash va qamrovni tekshirishgacha. Ishlar narxi tijorat taklifini tayyorlashda smetaga kiritiladi.
hik-wifi.en:
Wi-Fi access points are network equipment that provides wireless connection of devices to a local network or the internet. Unlike consumer routers, professional access points are designed for constant load, a managed infrastructure and operation as part of large wireless networks. It is precisely this kind of equipment that is used at industrial facilities, in offices, shopping malls, hotels and at video surveillance facilities, where connection stability and centralized management are important.

The SAT Solutions catalog features Hikvision Wi-Fi access points - a manufacturer known primarily for video surveillance systems, but which also produces network equipment focused on integration with its own NVRs, IP cameras and security systems. You can buy Wi-Fi access points in Tashkent with a warranty and professional selection for a specific facility at SAT Solutions: we work throughout Uzbekistan and help build wireless infrastructure from scratch.

The choice of equipment depends on several factors: the size of the coverage area, the number of simultaneous connections, the presence of external or internal antennas, the Wi-Fi standard and the network's tasks. Some models in the catalog are indoor ceiling access points of the Omni type (DS-3WAP series), some are outdoor points with weather protection and omnidirectional antennas (DS-3WF02C series). The catalog also includes Wi-Fi NVRs (DS-7102NI-S1/W, DS-7104NI-S1/W) and the DS-3WR4G3N 4G router for facilities without wired internet.

## How to choose

- Wi-Fi standard: models of the DS-3WAP series support current standards that provide high speed and a dense network. Check support for the 2.4 GHz and 5 GHz bands - dual-band points handle a large number of devices.
- Deployment area (indoor/outdoor): outdoor use requires points with protection against moisture and dust (IP66 class and above), for example the DS-3WF02C-5AC/O series. Indoor spaces are covered by DS-3WAP ceiling models.
- Number of simultaneous clients: a warehouse or an office with a large number of employees requires points supporting MU-MIMO technology and a high connection limit.
- Power: most professional access points are powered by PoE technology (802.3af/at), which eliminates separate electrical wiring and simplifies installation.
- Integration with video surveillance: if Hikvision equipment is already installed or planned at the facility, a Wi-Fi NVR (DS-7102NI-S1/W) makes it possible to record from wireless cameras without a separate server.
- Range and antenna type: to organize a wireless bridge between buildings, the DS-3WF02-5AC/D series (Wi-Fi bridge) is suitable. Range up to several hundred meters with line of sight.
- 4G backup availability: if the facility does not have stable wired internet, the DS-3WR4G3N router with LTE support provides connectivity via a cellular network.

## Applications

- Office and administrative buildings: providing uninterrupted Wi-Fi for employees, IP telephony and video surveillance systems on a single infrastructure.
- Manufacturing and warehouse facilities: covering large areas with a minimal number of points, resistance to industrial interference, integration with data collection terminals.
- Hotels, shopping malls and HoReCa facilities: a dense network with a large number of guest connections, the ability to create guest VLANs.
- Outdoor perimeters and parking lots: outdoor access points of the DS-3WF02C-5AC/O series cover open areas, and Wi-Fi bridges connect buildings without cable laying.
- Facilities without wired internet (temporary sites, remote warehouses): the Hikvision DS-3WR4G3N 4G router provides network access via LTE.
- Video surveillance systems with wireless cameras: the Hikvision Wi-Fi NVR makes it possible to record and store video from wireless cameras where cabling is impossible or impractical.

## Brands and models in the catalog

- Hikvision (DS-3WAP series access points): indoor ceiling models DS-3WAP521-SI, DS-3WAP522-SI, DS-3WAP621E-SI, DS-3WAP622G-SI - designed for office and retail facilities, supporting centralized management via a controller.
- Hikvision (DS-3WF02C series outdoor points): the DS-3WF02C-5N/O and DS-3WF02C-5AC/O models with omnidirectional antennas for outdoor installation, with protection against precipitation and temperature fluctuations.
- Hikvision (DS-3WF02 Wi-Fi bridges): the DS-3WF02-5AC/D model for organizing wireless spans between buildings without cable laying over line-of-sight distances.
- Hikvision (Wi-Fi NVR): the DS-7102NI-S1/W and DS-7104NI-S1/W video recorders with a built-in Wi-Fi module for recording from wireless IP cameras - a convenient solution for small facilities.
- Hikvision (DS-3WR4G3N 4G router): an LTE router for facilities without wired internet, supporting European and CIS frequencies, connection backup.

## FAQ

Q: How much does a Hikvision Wi-Fi access point cost in Tashkent?
A: The cost depends on the model, the design (indoor/outdoor) and the functionality. Check the required model with our managers - we will find the optimal option within your budget and prepare a commercial proposal.

Q: Can Hikvision Wi-Fi access points be used without a controller?
A: Yes, most models of the DS-3WAP series support both standalone mode and management via a controller. For small facilities, standalone configuration is sufficient; for large installations, we recommend controller-based management.

Q: Are outdoor access points suitable for year-round operation in Uzbekistan?
A: The DS-3WF02C-5AC/O series is designed to operate in a wide temperature range and has protection against dust and moisture, which corresponds to operating conditions both during the hot summer period and in winter.

Q: How can Wi-Fi be organized between two buildings without cable laying?
A: For this, the Hikvision DS-3WF02-5AC/D Wi-Fi bridge is used. With line of sight between the facilities, it provides a stable wireless span of several hundred meters.

Q: Is network configuration included in the installation cost?
A: Yes, SAT Solutions performs the full work cycle: from equipment installation to configuring SSID, VLAN, guest Wi-Fi and coverage verification. The cost of the work is included in the estimate when preparing the commercial proposal.

hilook-nvr.uz:
IP-videoregistratorlar (NVR) — bu IP-kameralar asosidagi har qanday zamonaviy videokuzatuv tizimining markaziy elementidir. Analog signal bilan ishlagan eskirgan DVR registratorlaridan farqli o'laroq, NVR to'g'ridan-to'g'ri tarmoq kameralaridan raqamli oqimni standart Ethernet-infratuzilma orqali qabul qiladi, qayta ishlaydi va yozadi. Bu har qanday obyektda — kichik ofisdan tortib tarmoqlangan ishlab chiqarish korxonasigacha — masshtablanadigan, moslashuvchan va yuqori sifatli tizimlar qurish imkonini beradi. Toshkentda aniq loyiha uchun professional tanlov bilan IP-videoregistratorni SAT Solutions'da sotib olish mumkin.

NVR tanlovi ulanadigan kameralar soni, talab qilinadigan yozuv ruxsati, arxiv hajmi va funksionallik bilan belgilanadi. Registratorlar 4, 8, 16, 32 va undan ko'p kanalli bo'ladi; modellarning bir qismi o'rnatilgan PoE-portlar bilan jihozlangan, bu kameralarni quvvatlantirish uchun alohida kommutator zaruratini bartaraf etadi. Kameralar ruxsati qanchalik yuqori bo'lsa va arxivni qancha uzoq saqlash kerak bo'lsa, disklar sig'imini to'g'ri hisoblash shunchalik muhim. O'zbekistonda NVR eng turli masshtab va turdagi obyektlarda qo'llaniladi — va barcha hollarda registratorni malakali tanlash tizimning qanchalik ishonchli va ekspluatatsiyada qulay bo'lishini hal qiladi.

Zamonaviy IP-videoregistratorlar allaqachon shunchaki saqlash qurilmalari bo'lishdan to'xtadi. Ular videooqimni real vaqtda tahlil qiladi, harakatni aniqlashni, yuzlarni tanishni va perimetr algoritmlarini qo'llab-quvvatlaydi, bulut xizmatlari va mobil ilovalar bilan integratsiyalashadi. Xavfsizlik tizimini qurishda tanlangan kameralar bilan protokol, o'tkazuvchanlik qobiliyati va videoanalitika bo'yicha mos keladigan NVRni tanlash muhim.

## Qanday tanlash kerak

- Kanallar soni: joriy kameralar soniga qo'shimcha 20-30% kengaytirish zaxirasiga yo'naling. 4, 8, 16 kanalli registratorlar kichik va o'rta obyektning aksariyat vazifalarini qoplaydi; yirik obyektlar uchun 32 kanal va undan yuqori yechimlar mos keladi.
- O'rnatilgan PoE-portlarning mavjudligi: PoE'li modellar kameralarni alohida kommutatorsiz to'g'ridan-to'g'ri ulash imkonini beradi, bu montajni soddalashtiradi va server shkafidagi uskunalar sonini kamaytiradi.
- Maksimal kiruvchi o'tkazuvchanlik qobiliyati: barcha kameralardan umumiy oqim registratorning o'tkazuvchanlik qobiliyatidan oshmasligi kerak. 4K-kameralar va ko'p sonli kanallar bilan bu parametr muhim ahamiyat kasb etadi.
- Qattiq disklar uchun bo'linmalar soni: modelga qarab bittadan sakkiztagacha HDD. Disklar qancha ko'p bo'lsa, arxiv shuncha uzoq yoki RAID ishlatilganda ishonchlilik shuncha yuqori.
- Qo'llab-quvvatlanadigan protokollar va moslik: aksariyat NVR kameralar bilan ONVIF orqali ishlaydi, biroq kengaytirilgan funksiyalar — videoanalitika, ikki tomonlama audioaloqa, aqlli aniqlash — ko'pincha faqat bir xil ishlab chiqaruvchi kameralaridan foydalanilganda mavjud.
- Yozuv va dekodlash ruxsati: registrator kameralaringiz ruxsatini (2 MP, 4 MP, 8 MP va undan yuqori) nafaqat yozishda, balki bir nechta oqimni bir vaqtda ijro etishda ham qo'llab-quvvatlashiga ishonch hosil qiling.
- Videoanalitikaning mavjudligi: harakatni aniqlash, chiziqni kesib o'tish, zonaga bostirib kirish, yuzlarni tanish — obyekt qanchalik murakkab bo'lsa, registratorning o'rnatilgan intellekti shunchalik muhim.

## Qo'llanilish sohalari

- Ofis va biznes markazlari: kirish guruhlari, muzokara zonalari, server xonalari nazorati; kirishni nazorat qilish tizimi bilan integratsiya.
- Savdo obyektlari va omborlar: savdo zali, kassa tugunlari, yuklash doklarini kuzatish; hodisalarni tahlil qilishda arxivni ko'rish imkoniyati.
- Ishlab chiqarish korxonalari: texnologik jarayonlarni monitoring qilish, perimetr nazorati, ish joylarida mehnat muhofazasi normalariga rioya qilish.
- Turar-joy majmualari va xususiy uylar: kirish guruhlari, avtoturargohlar, uy oldi hududini kuzatish; egasining mobil ilova orqali masofadan kirishi.
- O'quv muassasalari va davlat idoralari: perimetr muhofazasi, davomatni nazorat qilish, kampus hududida xavfsizlikni ta'minlash.
- Transport infratuzilmasi obyektlari va yoqilg'i quyish shoxobchalari: vaqt, zona yoki hodisa bo'yicha tez qidiruv imkoniyati bilan sutkalik yozuv.

## Katalogdagi brendlar va modellar

- HiLook: narx va imkoniyatlarning optimal nisbatiga ega loyihalar uchun Hikvision'ning NVR liniyasi. Katalogda 4, 8, 16, 32 va 64 kanalli MH va H seriyali registratorlar taqdim etilgan — kichik obyektlar uchun ixcham yechimlardan tortib yirik installatsiyalar uchun ko'p kanalli tizimlargacha. MH-K seriyali modellar yuqori ruxsatni qo'llab-quvvatlash va o'rnatilgan PoE-portlar bilan ajralib turadi, MH-C va H-D seriyali modellar esa moslashuvchanroq tarmoq integratsiyasiga yo'naltirilgan.
- HiLook'ning keng model qatori boshlang'ich darajadagi 4 kanalli tizimlardan (HL-NVR-104MH) yuqori yozuv zichligini talab qiladigan masshtabli obyektlar uchun 64 kanalli yechimlargacha (HL-NVR-464MH-K) vazifalarni qamrab oladi.
- Katalogdagi barcha registratorlar kengaytirilgan rejimda HiLook va Hikvision IP-kameralari bilan, shuningdek ONVIF protokoli bo'yicha uchinchi tomon ishlab chiqaruvchilari uskunasi bilan mos keladi.

## FAQ

Q: NVR va DVR o'rtasida qanday farq bor?
A: DVR analog kameralar bilan ishlaydi va signalni qurilma ichida raqamlashtiradi. NVR lokal tarmoq orqali IP-kameralardan allaqachon tayyor raqamli oqimni qabul qiladi, bu yuqoriroq tasvir sifatini, kameralarni joylashtirishda moslashuvchanlikni va intellektual funksiyalardan foydalanish imkoniyatini beradi.

Q: IP-videoregistrator qancha turadi va narx nimaga bog'liq?

Q: Qaysi kameralar HiLook NVR bilan mos keladi?

Q: Arxiv uchun qattiq disk hajmini qanday hisoblash mumkin?
A: Zarur hajm kameralar soni, yozuv ruxsati, kadrlar chastotasi va arxiv chuqurligiga bog'liq. SAT Solutions mutaxassislari hisob-kitobni bepul bajaradilar — obyektingiz parametrlarini xabar qilish yetarli.

Q: Yozuvni telefondan masofadan ko'rish mumkinmi?
A: Ha, barcha zamonaviy HiLook NVR mobil ilovalar orqali masofadan ko'rishni qo'llab-quvvatlaydi. Registratorni internetga ulash va kirishni sozlash yetarli — SAT Solutions mutaxassislari dastlabki konfiguratsiyada yordam beradilar.
hilook-nvr.en:
IP video recorders (NVRs) are the central element of any modern video surveillance system based on IP cameras. Unlike outdated DVR recorders that worked with an analog signal, an NVR receives, processes and records the digital stream directly from network cameras over standard Ethernet infrastructure. This makes it possible to build scalable, flexible and high-quality systems at any facility - from a small office to a sprawling manufacturing enterprise. You can buy an IP video recorder in Tashkent with professional selection for a specific project at SAT Solutions.

The choice of NVR is determined by the number of connected cameras, the required recording resolution, the archive volume and the functionality. Recorders come in 4, 8, 16, 32 and more channels; some models are equipped with built-in PoE ports, which eliminates the need for a separate switch to power the cameras. The higher the camera resolution and the longer the archive needs to be stored, the more important it is to correctly calculate the disk capacity. In Uzbekistan, NVRs are used at facilities of the most varied scales and types - and in all cases, competent selection of the recorder determines how reliable and convenient the system will be to operate.

Modern IP video recorders have long ceased to be merely storage devices. They analyze the video stream in real time, support motion detection, face recognition and perimeter algorithms, and integrate with cloud services and mobile applications. When building a security system, it is important to select an NVR compatible with the chosen cameras in terms of protocol, throughput and video analytics.

## How to choose

- Number of channels: base it on the current number of cameras plus a 20-30% reserve for expansion. Recorders with 4, 8, 16 channels cover most tasks of small and medium facilities; for large facilities, solutions with 32 channels and above are suitable.
- Availability of built-in PoE ports: models with PoE make it possible to connect cameras directly, without a separate switch, which simplifies installation and reduces the amount of equipment in the server cabinet.
- Maximum incoming throughput: the total stream from all cameras must not exceed the recorder's throughput. With 4K cameras and a large number of channels, this parameter becomes critical.
- Number of hard drive bays: from one to eight HDDs depending on the model. The more drives, the longer the archive or the higher the reliability when using RAID.
- Supported protocols and compatibility: most NVRs work with cameras via ONVIF, however, advanced functions - video analytics, two-way audio, smart detection - are more often available only when using cameras from the same manufacturer.
- Recording and decoding resolution: make sure the recorder supports your cameras' resolution (2 MP, 4 MP, 8 MP and above) not only for recording, but also for simultaneous playback of several streams.
- Availability of video analytics: motion detection, line crossing, zone intrusion, face recognition - the more complex the facility, the more important the recorder's built-in intelligence.

## Applications

- Offices and business centers: monitoring of entrance groups, meeting areas, server rooms; integration with the access control system.
- Retail facilities and warehouses: surveillance of the sales floor, checkout areas, loading docks; the ability to review the archive when investigating incidents.
- Manufacturing enterprises: monitoring of technological processes, perimeter control, compliance with occupational safety standards at workstations.
- Residential complexes and private houses: surveillance of entrance groups, parking lots, adjacent grounds; remote access for the owner via a mobile application.
- Educational institutions and government agencies: perimeter security, attendance control, ensuring safety across the campus grounds.
- Transport infrastructure facilities and gas stations: round-the-clock recording with the ability to quickly search by time, zone or event.

## Brands and models in the catalog

- HiLook: Hikvision's NVR line for projects with an optimal ratio of price and capabilities. The catalog features recorders of the MH and H series with 4, 8, 16, 32 and 64 channels - from compact solutions for small facilities to multi-channel systems for large installations. The MH-K series models feature high-resolution support and built-in PoE ports, while the MH-C and H-D series models are oriented toward more flexible network integration.
- The wide HiLook model range covers tasks from entry-level 4-channel systems (HL-NVR-104MH) to 64-channel solutions (HL-NVR-464MH-K) for large-scale facilities requiring high recording density.
- All recorders in the catalog are compatible with HiLook and Hikvision IP cameras in extended mode, as well as with third-party equipment via the ONVIF protocol.

## FAQ

Q: What is the difference between an NVR and a DVR?
A: A DVR works with analog cameras and digitizes the signal inside the device. An NVR receives an already-ready digital stream from IP cameras over a local network, which gives higher image quality, flexibility in camera placement and the ability to use intelligent functions.

Q: How much does an IP video recorder cost and what determines the price?
A: The price is determined by the number of channels, the availability of PoE ports, the supported resolution, the number of HDD bays and the set of analytics functions. Request a commercial proposal from SAT Solutions managers - we will find an option to suit your budget and tasks.

Q: Which cameras are compatible with HiLook NVRs?
A: HiLook recorders work with full functionality with HiLook and Hikvision cameras. For equipment from other manufacturers, the ONVIF standard is supported, however some advanced functions may be unavailable.

Q: How to calculate the hard drive capacity for the archive?
A: The required volume depends on the number of cameras, recording resolution, frame rate and archive depth. SAT Solutions specialists will perform the calculation free of charge - just tell us the parameters of your facility.

Q: Can I view the recording remotely from a phone?
A: Yes, all modern HiLook NVRs support remote viewing via mobile applications. You just need to connect the recorder to the internet and configure access - SAT Solutions specialists will help with the initial configuration.

Wi-Fi kirish nuqtalari — bu foydalanuvchilar, qurilmalar va xavfsizlik tizimlarini korporativ tarmoq va internetga simsiz ulanishni ta'minlaydigan professional tarmoq uskunasidir. Maishiy routerlardan farqli o'laroq, professional kirish nuqtalari sutkalik ishlash, ko'p sonli bir vaqtdagi ulanishlarga xizmat ko'rsatish va markazlashtirilgan kontrollerlar yoki bulut platformalari orqali boshqarilishga mo'ljallangan. Toshkent va butun O'zbekistondagi kompaniyalar, ofislar, savdo markazlari, mehmonxonalar va ishlab chiqarish obyektlari maishiy yechimlar yuklamani uddalay olmay qolganda bunday uskunaga o'tadilar.

Wi-Fi kirish nuqtasini tanlash nafaqat signal quvvati, balki butun simsiz tarmoq arxitekturasi bilan belgilanadi: foydalanuvchilar soni, xona turi, ko'cha zonalarining mavjudligi, xavfsizlikka talablar va nuqtalar orasidagi rouming. To'g'ri tanlangan va malakali montaj qilingan tizim o'lik zonalarsiz barqaror qamrov, yuklamaning teng taqsimlanishi va obyekt o'sganda oddiy masshtablanishni ta'minlaydi. Toshkentda professional montaj va sozlash bilan Wi-Fi kirish nuqtalarini SAT Solutions orqali sotib olish mumkin — O'zbekistonda turli masshtabdagi obyektlar uchun tarmoqlar loyihalash tajribasiga ega integrator.

Aniq modelni tanlashdan oldin tarmoq topologiyasini aniqlash muhim: qancha nuqta kerak bo'ladi, ular qanday quvvatlanadi (PoE yoki alohida quvvat), korpusning ko'cha himoyasi kerakmi va markazlashtirilgan boshqaruv qanday amalga oshiriladi. Bu savollarga javoblar ham komplektatsiyaga, ham yechimning yakuniy narxiga sezilarli ta'sir ko'rsatadi.

## Qanday tanlash kerak

- Wi-Fi standarti: dolzarb kirish nuqtalari Wi-Fi 5 (802.11ac) yoki Wi-Fi 6/6E (802.11ax) ni qo'llab-quvvatlaydi. Wi-Fi 6 yuqoriroq o'tkazuvchanlik qobiliyatini, ko'p sonli qurilmalarga ega zich muhitlarda yaxshiroq ishlashni va mijozlarning kamaytirilgan energiya iste'molini ta'minlaydi. Yangi loyihalar uchun aynan Wi-Fi 6 ni tanlash tavsiya etiladi.

- Chastota diapazonlari: ikki diapazonli nuqtalar (2.4 GHz + 5 GHz) aksariyat obyektlar uchun mos. Qo'shimcha 6 GHz diapazonli uch diapazonli modellar yuqori yuklamali muhitlar uchun kattaroq o'tkazuvchanlik qobiliyati zaxirasini beradi.

- Bir vaqtdagi mijozlar soni: ishlab chiqaruvchilar maksimal ulanishlar sonini ko'rsatadi, biroq real qulay sig'im odatda pastroq. Ofislar va mehmonxonalar uchun bir vaqtda ko'plab qurilmalarga xizmat ko'rsatish imkonini beradigan MU-MIMO va OFDMA texnologiyalarini qo'llab-quvvatlaydigan nuqtalarni tanlash muhim.

- Korpus ijrosi: xonalar uchun standart shift yoki devor (rozetka) nuqtalari mos. Ko'cha hududlari, avtoturargohlar, ombor hovlilari va og'ir sharoitli obyektlar uchun IP65 va undan yuqori himoya darajasiga ega himoyalangan korpusdagi uskuna zarur.

- Quvvatlantirish: aksariyat kirish nuqtalari Ethernet-kabel orqali PoE texnologiyasi bo'yicha quvvatlanadi, bu alohida quvvat liniyalarini o'tkazish zaruratini bartaraf etadi. Kommutator tegishli PoE yoki PoE+ standartini qo'llab-quvvatlashiga ishonch hosil qilish kerak.

- Boshqaruv: professional kirish nuqtalari kontroller — apparat, dasturiy yoki bulut boshqaruvi ostida ishlaydi. Bu SSID, rouming, xavfsizlik siyosatlarini markazlashtirilgan sozlash va barcha nuqtalar holatini yagona interfeysdan monitoring qilish imkonini beradi.

- O'tkazuvchanlik qobiliyati va kanallarni agregatsiya qilish: tezlikka yuqori talablar bilan obyektlar uchun kommutatorga ulanish darajasida tor joy yaratmaslik uchun 2.5 Gbit/s ko'tariluvchi aplink yoki portlarni agregatsiya qilishni qo'llab-quvvatlashga e'tibor berish kerak.

## Qo'llanilish sohalari

- Ofis va biznes markazlari: xodimlar, muzokara zallari va kirishni ajratish bilan mehmon tarmog'i uchun ishonchli korporativ Wi-Fi ta'minlash.

- Mehmonxonalar va apart-majmualar: ko'p sonli bir vaqtdagi mehmonlarni qo'llab-quvvatlash va mijozga o'tkazuvchanlik qobiliyatini boshqarish imkoniyati bilan xonalar, xollar, restoranlar va konferens-zallarni qamrab olish.

- Savdo markazlari va chakana do'konlar: xaridorlar uchun Wi-Fi, raqamli narx yorliqlari tizimlari, kassa uskunasi va videokuzatuvni yagona simsiz infratuzilma orqali.

- Ishlab chiqarish korxonalari va omborlar: katta ochiq maydonlarni qamrab olish, ma'lumot yig'ish terminallari, simsiz skanerlar va sanoat qurilmalarini ulash.

- Ta'lim muassasalari: kontent va xavfsizlik siyosatlarini boshqarish bilan auditoriyalar, kutubxonalar, aktzallar va kampus hududi uchun Wi-Fi.

- Ko'cha va ochiq hududlar: avtoturargohlar, korxona hududlari, stadionlar, maydonlar — qamrov zonasini kengaytirish uchun himoyalangan ko'cha kirish nuqtalaridan foydalanish.

## Katalogdagi brendlar va modellar

- TP-Link Omada: katalogda EAP seriyali kirish nuqtalarining keng assortimenti taqdim etilgan — SMB va o'rta biznes segmentidagi eng mashhur professional yechimlardan biri. Liniya xonalar uchun shift modellarini, mehmonxonalar va muzokara xonalari uchun devor (rozetka) nuqtalarini, shuningdek Wi-Fi 6 qo'llab-quvvatlashiga ega himoyalangan korpusdagi ko'cha modellarini o'z ichiga oladi.

- TP-Link ko'cha kirish nuqtalari: EAP Outdoor seriyali modellar ochiq hududlarda joylashtirishga mo'ljallangan. Ular atmosfera ta'siriga chidaydi va avtoturargohlar, hovlilar va korxona hududlarida barqaror qamrovni ta'minlaydi.

- TP-Link devor (rozetka) nuqtalari: standart rozetka formatidagi ixcham modellar televizorlar va telefonlarni ulash uchun simli portlar bilan sezilmas montaj talab qiladigan mehmonxona xonalari va muzokara xonalari uchun ideal mos keladi.

- TP-Link Omada VPN-marshrutizatorlari: katalogda maydonchalarni VPN orqali xavfsiz birlashtirishni va kirish nuqtalari bilan birgalikda yagona Omada ekotizimida trafikni boshqarishni ta'minlaydigan ER seriyali marshrutizatorlar ham mavjud.

- Aksessuarlar va montaj komplektlari: uskunani rack-montaj qilish uchun kontrollerlar va boshqa uskunalarni standart 19 dyuymli shkaflarda joylashtirish imkonini beradigan maxsus kronshteynlar ko'zda tutilgan.

## FAQ

Q: 500 kv. m maydonli ofis uchun qancha kirish nuqtasi kerak?
A: Hammasi rejalashtirish, to'siqlar materiallari va foydalanuvchilar soniga bog'liq. O'rtacha bitta shift kirish nuqtasi ofis xonasida 50-150 kv. m ni qamrab oladi. Aniq hisob-kitob uchun obyektning radiochastota tekshiruvini o'tkazish tavsiya etiladi.

Q: Ko'cha kirish nuqtasini bino fasadiga o'rnatish mumkinmi?
A: Ha, himoyalangan korpusdagi ko'cha modellari maxsus fasadlarga, machtalarga va kronshteynlarga montaj qilish uchun ishlab chiqilgan. Ular harorat o'zgarishlari, yog'ingarchilik va ultrabinafsha nurlanishga chidaydi. Quvvat ichki kommutatordan PoE kabeli orqali beriladi.

Q: Bir tarmoqdagi bir nechta kirish nuqtasini qanday boshqarish mumkin?
A: Professional Omada kirish nuqtalari yagona kontroller — apparat, dasturiy (serverda) yoki bulut orqali boshqariladi. Kontroller barcha nuqtalarni markazlashtirilgan sozlash, tarmoq holatini kuzatish va zarurat bo'lganda o'zgarishlarni barcha qurilmalarga bir vaqtda qo'llash imkonini beradi.

Q: TP-Link Wi-Fi kirish nuqtalariga qanday kafolat beriladi?
A: Ishlab chiqaruvchi uskunaga rasmiy kafolat beradi. SAT Solutions vakolatli yetkazib beruvchi sifatida kafolatli xizmat ko'rsatishni ta'minlaydi va zarurat bo'lganda kafolat muddati davomida uskunani almashtirishga yordam beradi.

Q: Omada kirish nuqtalari boshqa ishlab chiqaruvchilar uskunasi bilan mos keladimi?
A: TP-Link Omada kirish nuqtalari Omada kommutatorlari va marshrutizatorlari bilan birgalikda o'zining boshqariladigan ekotizimida ishlaydi. Uchinchi tomon kommutatorlariga ulanish uchun standart PoEni qo'llab-quvvatlash yetarli — boshqaruv bunda Omada kontrolleri orqali olib boriladi.
tplink-wifi.en:
Wi-Fi access points are professional network equipment that provides wireless connection of users, devices and security systems to a corporate network and the internet. Unlike consumer routers, professional access points are designed for round-the-clock operation, servicing a large number of simultaneous connections and management via centralized controllers or cloud platforms. Companies, offices, shopping malls, hotels and manufacturing facilities in Tashkent and throughout Uzbekistan switch to such equipment when consumer solutions can no longer handle the load.

The choice of a Wi-Fi access point is determined not only by signal strength, but by the architecture of the entire wireless network: the number of users, the type of premises, the presence of outdoor zones, security requirements and roaming between points. A properly selected and competently installed system provides stable coverage without dead zones, even load distribution and easy scaling as the facility grows. You can buy Wi-Fi access points in Tashkent with professional installation and configuration through SAT Solutions - an integrator with experience designing networks for facilities of various scales in Uzbekistan.

Before choosing a specific model, it is important to determine the network topology: how many points will be needed, how they will be powered (PoE or separate power), whether an outdoor-protected housing is required, and how centralized management will be carried out. The answers to these questions significantly affect both the configuration and the final cost of the solution.

## How to choose

- Wi-Fi standard: current access points support Wi-Fi 5 (802.11ac) or Wi-Fi 6/6E (802.11ax). Wi-Fi 6 provides higher throughput, better operation in dense environments with numerous devices and reduced client power consumption. For new projects, it is recommended to choose Wi-Fi 6.

- Frequency bands: dual-band points (2.4 GHz + 5 GHz) are suitable for most facilities. Tri-band models with an additional 6 GHz band provide a larger throughput reserve for high-load environments.

- Number of simultaneous clients: manufacturers indicate the maximum number of connections, but the real comfortable capacity is usually lower. For offices and hotels, it is important to choose points supporting MU-MIMO and OFDMA - technologies that allow serving many devices in parallel.

- Housing design: standard ceiling or wall-mounted (wall-plate) points are suitable for indoor spaces. For outdoor areas, parking lots, warehouse yards and facilities with harsh conditions, equipment in a protected housing with an IP65 rating and above is required.

- Power: most access points are powered by PoE technology over an Ethernet cable, which eliminates the need to lay separate power lines. You need to make sure the switch supports the corresponding PoE or PoE+ standard.

- Management: professional access points operate under the control of a controller - hardware, software or cloud-based. This makes it possible to centrally configure SSID, roaming, security policies and monitor the status of all points from a single interface.

- Throughput and link aggregation: for facilities with high speed requirements, it is worth paying attention to support for a 2.5 Gbit/s uplink or port aggregation, so as not to create a bottleneck at the level of the connection to the switch.

## Applications

- Offices and business centers: providing reliable corporate Wi-Fi for employees, meeting rooms and a guest network with access differentiation.

- Hotels and apartment complexes: coverage of rooms, lobbies, restaurants and conference halls with support for a large number of simultaneous guests and the ability to manage per-client throughput.

- Shopping malls and retail stores: Wi-Fi for shoppers, electronic shelf label systems, POS equipment and video surveillance over a single wireless infrastructure.

- Manufacturing enterprises and warehouses: coverage of large open areas, connection of data collection terminals, wireless scanners and industrial devices.

- Educational institutions: Wi-Fi for classrooms, libraries, assembly halls and the campus grounds with content management and security policies.

- Outdoor and open areas: parking lots, enterprise grounds, stadiums, squares - using protected outdoor access points to extend the coverage area.

## Brands and models in the catalog

- TP-Link Omada: the catalog features a wide range of EAP series access points - one of the most popular professional solutions in the SMB and mid-market segment. The line includes ceiling models for indoor spaces, wall-mounted (wall-plate) points for hotels and meeting rooms, as well as outdoor models in protected housings with Wi-Fi 6 support.

- TP-Link outdoor access points: models of the EAP Outdoor series are designed for deployment in open areas. They withstand atmospheric influences and provide stable coverage in parking lots, courtyards and enterprise grounds.

- TP-Link wall-mounted (wall-plate) points: compact models in a standard wall-plate format are ideal for hotel rooms and meeting rooms where discreet installation with wired ports for connecting TVs and phones is required.

- TP-Link Omada VPN routers: the catalog also includes ER series routers, which provide secure connection of sites via VPN and traffic management within a single Omada ecosystem together with the access points.

- Accessories and mounting kits: special brackets are provided for rack mounting of equipment, allowing controllers and other equipment to be placed in standard 19-inch cabinets.

## FAQ

Q: How many access points are needed for a 500 sq. m office?
A: It all depends on the layout, the materials of the partitions and the number of users. On average, one ceiling access point covers 50-150 sq. m in an office space. For an accurate calculation, it is recommended to conduct a radio frequency survey of the facility.

Q: Can an outdoor access point be installed on a building facade?
A: Yes, outdoor models in protected housings are specifically designed for installation on facades, masts and brackets. They withstand temperature fluctuations, precipitation and ultraviolet radiation. Power is supplied over a PoE cable from an indoor switch.

Q: How to manage several access points in one network?
A: Professional Omada access points are managed via a single controller - hardware, software (on a server) or cloud-based. The controller makes it possible to centrally configure all points, monitor the network status and, if necessary, apply changes to all devices simultaneously.

Q: What warranty applies to TP-Link Wi-Fi access points?
A: The manufacturer provides an official warranty on the equipment. As an authorized supplier, SAT Solutions provides warranty service and, if necessary, helps with equipment replacement during the warranty period.

Q: Are Omada access points compatible with equipment from other manufacturers?
A: TP-Link Omada access points operate in their own managed ecosystem together with Omada switches and routers. To connect to third-party switches, support for standard PoE is sufficient - management is still carried out via the Omada controller.
