Videokuzatuv tizimlari uchun qattiq disklar — bu kameralardan videooqimlarni uzluksiz sutkalik yozib olish uchun yaratilgan maxsus saqlash qurilmalaridir. Oddiy kompyuter HDDlaridan farqli o'laroq, bunday disklar 24/7 rejimiga mo'ljallangan va unumdorlik pasayishisiz katta hajmdagi ma'lumotlarni doimiy yozishga optimallashtirilgan. Toshkentda videokuzatuv uchun qattiq disk sotib olishni SAT Solutions katalogida amalga oshirish mumkin — biz har qanday masshtabdagi registratorlar uchun mo'ljallangan 2 dan 12 TB gacha sig'imli saqlash qurilmalarini yetkazib beramiz.

Xavfsizlik tizimi uchun to'g'ri HDD tanlash videoarxivni saqlash ishonchliligiga bevosita ta'sir qiladi. Noto'g'ri tanlangan saqlash qurilmasi — maxsus disk o'rniga ofis diski — videoyozuv yuklamasi ostida bir necha oy ichida ishdan chiqadi. Aynan shuning uchun videoregistratorlar uchun bunday yuklamaga maxsus moslashtirilgan disklar ishlatiladi: ular doimiy yozishga mo'ljallangan, kengaytirilgan resursga ega va ko'plab kanallardan bir vaqtda yozishni qo'llab-quvvatlaydi. Quvvat uzilishlari tez-tez uchraydigan O'zbekistondagi obyektlar uchun saqlash qurilmasining to'satdan o'chishlarga chidamliligi ham muhim.

Arxiv chuqurligi — videokuzatuv tizimini loyihalashda asosiy parametr. 16 ta yuqori ruxsatli kameradan yozuvlarni 30 kun saqlash uchun bir necha terabayt joy kerak bo'ladi. Disk sig'imini to'g'ri hisoblash kameralar soni, ruxsat, kadrlar chastotasi va yozuv doimiy yoki harakat detektori bo'yicha olib borilishiga bog'liq. SAT Solutions mutaxassislari aniq obyekt va byudjet uchun optimal hajmni hisoblashga yordam beradilar.

## Qanday tanlash kerak

- Saqlash qurilmasi sig'imi: kanallar soni, kameralar ruxsati va talab qilinadigan arxiv chuqurligidan kelib chiqib hisoblanadi. Kichik tizimlar uchun (4-8 kamera, 14 kun) 2-4 TB yetarli, 32+ kameralar va 30 kunlik arxivga ega yirik obyektlar uchun 8 dan 12 TB gacha disklar yoki bir nechta saqlash qurilmasi kerak.

- 24/7 ish rejimi: videokuzatuv tizimlari uchun majburiy talab. Uzluksiz ishlashga mo'ljallanmagan disklar qizib ketadi va tez ishdan chiqadi. Ishlab chiqaruvchidan «for surveillance» yoki shunga o'xshash belgini qidiring.

- Registrator bilan moslik: aksariyat zamonaviy DVR va NVR standart SATA-disklarni qabul qiladi, biroq ba'zi registratorlarda bitta saqlash qurilmasining maksimal sig'imi bo'yicha cheklovlar bor. Sotib olishdan oldin registratoringiz modeli uchun mos HDDlar ro'yxatini aniqlashtiring.

- Yozuv tezligi: yuqori ruxsatli kameralarga ega ko'p kanalli tizimlar uchun diskning o'tkazuvchanlik qobiliyati muhim. Videokuzatuv uchun disklar ketma-ket yozishga optimallashtirilgan, bu uzluksiz videooqim uchun ideal mos keladi.

- Tebranishga chidamlilik: sanoat uskunasiga ega yoki bitta korpusda ko'p sonli diskka ega obyektlarda qo'shni saqlash qurilmalari orasidagi tebranish shovqinlaridan himoya muhim.

- Ish harorati: yozda texnik xonalardagi harorat normadan oshishi mumkin bo'lgan O'zbekiston sharoitida kengaytirilgan harorat diapazoni va samarali termik rejimga ega disklar afzal.

- Kafolat muddati va ishlab chiqaruvchi obro'si: muhim infratuzilma uchun kamida ikki yillik rasmiy kafolatga ega mashhur brendlar saqlash qurilmalarini tanlang.

## Qo'llanilish sohalari

- Ofis va ma'muriy binolar: 8-32 kanalli registratorlar, 14-30 kunlik arxivni saqlash, 4-8 TB sig'imli disklar.

- Savdo obyektlari va savdo markazlari: ko'p sonli kamera, ko'pincha analitika bilan, yuqori sig'imli saqlash qurilmalarini talab qiladi — registratorga 6 dan 12 TB gacha.

- Ishlab chiqarish korxonalari va omborlar: sutkalik videokuzatuv, uzilishsiz yozuv, tebranish va changlanish sharoitida saqlash qurilmalari ishonchliligiga yuqori talablar.

- Turar-joy majmualari va ko'p kvartirali uylar: avtoturargohlar, kirish guruhlari va perimetrdagi ko'p sonli kameralarga ega tizimlar, arxivni uzoq muddat saqlash.

- Banklar, yoqilg'i quyish shoxobchalari, muhim infratuzilma obyektlari: ishonchlilik va arxiv chuqurligiga maksimal talablar, ko'pincha RAID-massivlar bilan zaxiralash ishlatiladi.

- Transport infratuzilmasi: O'zbekistonning vokzallari, avtobus parklari va transport tugunlarida sutkalik yozuv bilan videokuzatuv.

## Katalogdagi brendlar va modellar

- Seagate SkyHawk: videokuzatuv uchun disklarning eng mashhur liniyalaridan biri. Katalogda 2, 6, 8 va 10 TB sig'imli modellar taqdim etilgan. Disklar ko'p kanalli yozishga optimallashtirilgan va 24/7 ish rejimiga mo'ljallangan, bu ularni professional xavfsizlik tizimlari uchun ishonchli tanlovga aylantiradi.

- Western Digital Purple (WD PURX seriyasi): Western Digital'ning videokuzatuv uchun maxsus saqlash qurilmalari. Katalogda 3, 6 va 10 TB modellar bor. Purple seriyasi ko'plab kameralarga ega tizimlar yuklamasi uchun ishlab chiqilgan va kadrlarni yo'qotishni minimallashtirish uchun AllFrame texnologiyasini qo'llab-quvvatlaydi.

- DS-seriyali videokuzatuv uchun maxsus HDDlar: professional videoregistratorlar bilan mos deb yetkazib beriladigan saqlash qurilmalari. 2 dan 12 TB gacha hajmlar taqdim etilgan, bu har qanday masshtabdagi tizim uchun — kichik ofisdan yirik sanoat obyektigacha — saqlash qurilmasini tanlash imkonini beradi.

- Sig'imlar diapazoni: katalog 2 dan 12 TB gacha saqlash qurilmalarini qamrab oladi, bu har qanday murakkablikdagi videokuzatuv tizimlarini — kichik do'kondagi 4 kanalli registratordan yirik korxonaning 64 kanalli xavfsizlik serverigacha — jihozlash imkonini beradi.

## FAQ

Q: Videoregistratorda oddiy kompyuter qattiq diskini ishlatish mumkinmi?
A: Texnik jihatdan — ha, lekin bu asossiz xavf. Oddiy disklar 24/7 rejimiga va doimiy ketma-ket yozishga mo'ljallanmagan: ular qizib ketadi, tezroq eskiradi va bir necha oy ichida ishdan chiqishi mumkin. Videokuzatuv tizimlari uchun faqat maxsus saqlash qurilmalaridan foydalaning.

Q: 30 kun yozuv bilan 8 ta kamera uchun qanday qattiq disk hajmi kerak?
A: Ruxsat va yozuv rejimiga bog'liq. 2 MP ruxsatli 8 ta kamera uchun doimiy yozishda taxminan 4-6 TB kerak bo'ladi. Harakat detektori bo'yicha yozishda hajmni ikki barobar kamaytirish mumkin. Aniq hisob-kitobni SAT Solutions mutaxassislari bepul bajaradilar.

Q: Bitta videoregistratorga qancha qattiq disk o'rnatish mumkin?
A: Bu registrator modeliga bog'liq. Byudjet qurilmalari HDD uchun 1-2 bo'linmaga ega, professional videoyozuv serverlari — 8 va undan ko'p. Bir nechta diskka ega registratorlar ko'pincha ma'lumotlarni zaxiralash uchun RAIDni qo'llab-quvvatlaydi.

Q: Videokuzatuv uchun qattiq disklar qancha muddat xizmat qiladi?
A: To'g'ri tanlangan va normal ekspluatatsiya sharoitida maxsus disklar 3-5 yil va undan ko'p xizmat qiladi. Qizib ketish, kuchlanish sakrashlari va saqlash qurilmalarini maqsadga muvofiq ishlatmaslikda xizmat muddati qisqaradi. Registratorlar uchun UPS ishlatishni tavsiya qilamiz.

Q: Toshkentda kafolat bilan videokuzatuv uchun qattiq disk sotib olish mumkinmi?
A: Ha, SAT Solutions katalogidagi barcha saqlash qurilmalari kafolat bilan yetkazib beriladi. Biz ishonchli yetkazib beruvchilar bilan ishlaymiz va belgilangan muddat davomida kafolatli xizmat ko'rsatamiz. Zarurat bo'lganda ishdan chiqqan diskni tezkor almashtiramiz.
prochee-hdd.en:
Hard drives for video surveillance systems are specialized storage devices created for continuous round-the-clock recording of video streams from cameras. Unlike ordinary computer HDDs, such drives are designed for 24/7 mode and optimized for the constant recording of large volumes of data without performance degradation. You can buy a hard drive for video surveillance in Tashkent in the SAT Solutions catalog - we supply drives with a capacity from 2 to 12 TB, designed for recorders of any scale.

Choosing the right HDD for a security system directly affects the reliability of video archive storage. An incorrectly selected drive - an office drive instead of a specialized one - will fail within a few months under the load of video recording. That is precisely why drives specially adapted for such a load are used for video recorders: they are designed for constant recording, have an increased resource and support simultaneous recording from multiple channels. For facilities in Uzbekistan, where power outages are more frequent, the drive's resistance to sudden shutdowns is also important.

Archive depth is a key parameter when designing a video surveillance system. To store 30 days of recordings from 16 high-resolution cameras, several terabytes of space will be required. The correct calculation of disk capacity depends on the number of cameras, resolution, frame rate and whether recording is continuous or triggered by a motion detector. SAT Solutions specialists help calculate the optimal volume for a specific facility and budget.

## How to choose

- Drive capacity: calculated based on the number of channels, camera resolution and the required archive depth. For small systems (4-8 cameras, 14 days) 2-4 TB is sufficient; for large facilities with 32+ cameras and a 30-day archive, drives from 8 to 12 TB or several drives are needed.

- 24/7 operating mode: a mandatory requirement for video surveillance systems. Drives not intended for continuous operation overheat and quickly fail. Look for a "for surveillance" marking or an equivalent one from the manufacturer.

- Compatibility with the recorder: most modern DVRs and NVRs accept standard SATA drives, however some recorders have limitations on the maximum capacity of a single drive. Before purchasing, check the list of compatible HDDs for your recorder model.

- Recording speed: for multi-channel systems with high-resolution cameras, the drive's throughput is important. Video surveillance drives are optimized for sequential recording, which is ideal for a continuous video stream.

- Vibration resistance: at facilities with industrial equipment or a large number of drives in one housing, protection against vibration interference between neighboring drives is important.

- Operating temperature: in the conditions of Uzbekistan, where in summer the temperature in utility rooms can exceed the norm, drives with an extended temperature range and an efficient thermal mode are preferable.

- Warranty period and manufacturer's reputation: for critical infrastructure, choose drives from well-known brands with an official warranty of at least two years.

## Applications

- Office and administrative buildings: recorders with 8-32 channels, storing an archive for 14-30 days, drives with a capacity of 4-8 TB.

- Retail facilities and shopping malls: a large number of cameras, often with analytics, require high-capacity drives - from 6 to 12 TB per recorder.

- Manufacturing enterprises and warehouses: round-the-clock video surveillance, recording without gaps, elevated reliability requirements for drives in conditions of vibration and dust.

- Residential complexes and apartment buildings: systems with a large number of cameras in parking lots, entrance groups and the perimeter, long-term archive storage.

- Banks, gas stations, critical infrastructure facilities: maximum requirements for reliability and archive depth, redundancy with RAID arrays is often used.

- Transport infrastructure: video surveillance at railway stations, bus depots and transport hubs of Uzbekistan with round-the-clock recording.

## Brands and models in the catalog

- Seagate SkyHawk: one of the most well-known lines of video surveillance drives. The catalog features models with a capacity of 2, 6, 8 and 10 TB. The drives are optimized for multi-channel recording and designed for 24/7 operating mode, which makes them a reliable choice for professional security systems.

- Western Digital Purple (WD PURX series): specialized video surveillance drives from Western Digital. The catalog includes 3, 6 and 10 TB models. The Purple series is designed for the load of systems with multiple cameras and supports AllFrame technology to minimize frame loss.

- Specialized DS-series HDDs for video surveillance: drives supplied as compatible with professional video recorders. Capacities from 2 to 12 TB are available, which makes it possible to select a drive for a system of any scale - from a small office to a large industrial facility.

- Capacity range: the catalog covers drives from 2 to 12 TB, which makes it possible to equip video surveillance systems of any complexity - from a 4-channel recorder in a small shop to a 64-channel security server of a large enterprise.

## FAQ

Q: Can an ordinary computer hard drive be used in a video recorder?
A: Technically - yes, but it is an unjustified risk. Ordinary drives are not designed for 24/7 mode and constant sequential recording: they overheat, wear out faster and can fail within a few months. For video surveillance systems, use only specialized drives.

Q: What hard drive capacity is needed for 8 cameras recording for 30 days?
A: It depends on the resolution and recording mode. For 8 cameras with a resolution of 2 MP with continuous recording, approximately 4-6 TB will be required. With recording triggered by a motion detector, the volume can be halved. SAT Solutions specialists will make an accurate calculation free of charge.

Q: How many hard drives can be installed in one video recorder?
A: This depends on the recorder model. Budget devices have 1-2 HDD bays, professional video recording servers - up to 8 and more. Recorders with several drives often support RAID for data redundancy.

Q: How long do video surveillance hard drives last?
A: With correct selection and normal operating conditions, specialized drives last 3-5 years and more. The service life is shortened by overheating, voltage surges and using drives for the wrong purpose. We recommend using a UPS for recorders.

Q: Can I buy a hard drive for video surveillance in Tashkent with a warranty?
A: Yes, all drives in the SAT Solutions catalog are supplied with a warranty. We work with trusted suppliers and provide warranty service for the established period. If necessary, we promptly replace a failed drive.

poe-switches.uz:
PoE-kommutatorlar — bu oddiy kommutator va o'ralgan juftlik orqali quvvat manbai funksiyalarini o'zida birlashtirgan tarmoq qurilmalaridir. Power over Ethernet standarti bitta Cat5e/Cat6 kabeli orqali ma'lumotlar bilan birga elektr quvvatini uzatish imkonini beradi, bu videokuzatuv, kirishni nazorat qilish va simsiz kirish nuqtalari tizimlari montajini tubdan soddalashtiradi. Buning tufayli har bir kamera yoki kirish nuqtasiga alohida quvvat liniyalarini tortish zarurati yo'qoladi — bitta kabel yetarli. Toshkentda PoE-kommutatorlarni SAT Solutions katalogidan sotib olishingiz mumkin: bu yerda har qanday masshtabdagi obyektlar uchun modellar taqdim etilgan.

PoE-kommutatorning asosiy afzalligi — infratuzilmada tejash. Sakkizta kamerali kichik ofis yoki do'kon uchun 60-65 Vt umumiy quvvat byudjetiga ega sakkiz portli stol usti kommutator yetarli. O'zbekistondagi savdo markazlari, ishlab chiqarishlar va turar-joy majmualari uchun VLAN qo'llab-quvvatlashiga, ulangan qurilmalar holatini monitoring qilish funksiyasiga va kengaytirilgan quvvat byudjetiga — 240 Vt va undan yuqorigacha — ega 16-24 portli boshqariladigan qurilmalar kerak bo'ladi. Xavfsizlik tizimini loyihalash bosqichida kommutatorni to'g'ri tanlash pulni tejaydi va keyingi kengaytirishda quvvat yuklamasi bilan bog'liq muammolarni bartaraf etadi.

PoE-kommutatorni tanlash bir necha parametrni tushunishni talab qiladi: portlar soni, PoE sinfi, umumiy quvvat byudjeti, aplinklarning mavjudligi va boshqarish imkoniyati. SAT Solutions katalogida kichik savdo nuqtalaridan yirik sanoat obyektlarigacha bo'lgan vazifalar uchun 22 ta model taqdim etilgan. Barcha qurilmalar IP-kameralar va boshqa uskunalar bilan moslik tekshiruvidan o'tadi — bu kommutator rasman PoEni qo'llab-quvvatlasa-da, aniq kameralar brendi bilan kelishmaydigan holatni bartaraf etadi.

## Qanday tanlash kerak

- PoE portlari soni: kichik tizimlar uchun 4-8 port yetarli, o'rta obyektlar uchun — 16-24 port. Kelajakdagi kengaytirish uchun kamida 20% zaxirani hisobga oling.
- Umumiy quvvat byudjeti: barcha ulanadigan qurilmalar iste'molini qo'shing (tipik IP-kamera — 8-15 Vt, PTZ-kamera — 25 Vt gacha, kirish nuqtasi — 12-20 Vt) va 20-30% zaxira bilan kommutatorni tanlang.
- PoE standarti: bazaviy IEEE 802.3af har bir portga 15,4 Vt gacha ta'minlaydi, PoE+ (802.3at) — 30 Vt gacha, PoE++ (802.3bt) — 60 va undan ortiq Vt. Zamonaviy ko'p megapiksel kameralar va Wi-Fi 6 kirish nuqtalari uchun PoE+ tavsiya etiladi.
- Boshqarilishi: boshqarilmaydigan kommutatorlar arzonroq va oddiyroq, boshqariladigan — VLAN, QoS, portlar monitoringi, qurilmalarni masofadan qayta yuklashni qo'llab-quvvatlaydi. Professional xavfsizlik tizimlari uchun boshqariladigan modellar afzal.
- Portlar tezligi: gigabitli aplinklarga (Uplink) ega kommutatorlar ko'p sonli yuqori ruxsatli kameralar bo'lganda trafikning normal agregatsiyasini ta'minlaydi. Tizim o'sganda aplink tor joy bo'lib qolmasligiga ishonch hosil qiling.
- Kuchlanishdan oshib ketishdan himoya: barqaror bo'lmagan elektr ta'minotiga ega O'zbekistondagi obyektlar uchun portlarning o'rnatilgan chaqmoqdan himoyasi muhim — bu ham kommutator, ham ulangan kameralar xizmat muddatini uzaytiradi.
- Form-faktor va montaj: stol usti modellar kichik server shkaflari va yashirin joylar uchun mos, rack-o'rnatiladigan (1U, 2U) — 19 dyuymli stoykalarga ega texnik xonalar uchun.

## Qo'llanilish sohalari

- Videokuzatuv tizimlari: rozetkalarga qulay kirish imkoni bo'lmagan obyektlarda IP-kameralarni ulash — avtoturargohlar, perimetr, omborlar, ishlab chiqarish sexlari.
- Ofis va biznes markazlari: yagona kabel xo'jaligi bilan IP-telefoniya, Wi-Fi kirish nuqtalari va kirishni nazorat qilish tizimlari uchun tarmoq tashkil qilish.
- Savdo obyektlari: videokuzatuvni minimal qurilish ishlari bilan tez joylashtirish muhim bo'lgan do'konlar, savdo markazlari va bozorlar.
- Turar-joy majmualari va mehmonxonalar: videokuzatuv kameralari, domofonlar va qavatlar hamda jamoat zonalaridagi Wi-Fi kirish nuqtalari orasida aloqani ta'minlash.
- Ishlab chiqarish korxonalari va omborlar: O'zbekiston ishlab chiqarishlarida tez-tez uchraydigan changlanish va kuchlanish o'zgarishlari sharoitida kameralarni barqaror quvvatlantirish.
- O'quv muassasalari va davlat idoralari: yagona administratsiya nuqtasi bilan videokuzatuv va kirishni nazorat qilish infratuzilmasini markazlashtirilgan boshqarish.

## Katalogdagi brendlar va modellar

- Dahua — ushbu kategoriyadagi asosiy brend. Kompaniya PoE-kommutatorlarning keng liniyasini chiqaradi: 4-8 portli va 36-65 Vt byudjetli ixcham boshqarilmaydigan PFS va S seriyali qurilmalardan tortib 8-24 portli va 240 Vt gacha quvvat byudjetiga ega CS4010 va CS4218 seriyali boshqariladigan kommutatorlargacha.
- PFS seriyasi (masalan, PFS3005, PFS3008, PFS3010, PFS3218) — kichik va o'rta videokuzatuv tizimlari uchun boshqarilmaydigan plug-and-play kommutatorlar. Sozlashsiz tez joylashtirish uchun mos.
- CS4xxx seriyasi (CS4010, CS4218, CS4226) — VLAN, portlar monitoringi va kengaytirilgan PoE-byudjet qo'llab-quvvatlashiga ega boshqariladigan L2-kommutatorlar. Moslashuvchan tarmoq administratsiyasi talab qilinadigan professional installatsiyalar uchun mo'ljallangan.
- S seriyasi (S3006, S3010) — cheklangan kameralar soniga ega kichik obyektlar uchun boshlang'ich darajadagi byudjet boshqarilmaydigan kommutatorlar.
- Dahua'ning barcha taqdim etilgan modellari ushbu brend IP-kameralari bilan birgalikda ishlashga optimallashtirilgan, bu joylashtirishni soddalashtiradi va moslik muammolarini bartaraf etadi.

## FAQ

Q: Boshqariladigan PoE-kommutator boshqarilmaydigandan nimasi bilan farq qiladi?
A: Boshqarilmaydigan plug-and-play tamoyili bo'yicha ishlaydi — yoqib qo'ydik va unutdik, sozlash talab qilinmaydi. Boshqariladigan VLAN yaratish, trafik ustuvorligini (QoS) belgilash, osilgan kameralarni masofadan qayta yuklash va har bir port holatini monitoring qilish imkonini beradi. Jiddiy xavfsizlik tizimlari uchun boshqariladigan variant tavsiya etiladi.

Q: PoE-kommutator quvvati IK-yoritgichli va PTZ kameralarni quvvatlantirish uchun yetarlimi?
A: Kuchli IK-yoritgichli kameralar 15-25 Vt iste'mol qiladi, PTZ-kameralar — 25-30 Vt gacha. PoE+ (802.3at, portga 30 Vt gacha) qo'llab-quvvatlashiga va zaxira bilan umumiy byudjetga ega kommutatorni tanlang. Zarurat bo'lganda mutaxassislarimiz aniq hisob-kitobni bajaradilar.

Q: Dahua PoE-kommutatorlari boshqa brendlar kameralari bilan mos keladimi?
A: Ha, barcha kommutatorlar IEEE 802.3af/at standartlarini qo'llab-quvvatlaydi va ushbu standartlarga mos har qanday PoE-uskuna — Hikvision, Uniview, Reolink va boshqa kameralar bilan mos keladi. Dahua'ning firmaviy optimallashtirishi faqat bir xil brend kameralari bilan juftlikda ishlatilganda qo'shimcha afzalliklar beradi.

Q: PoE-kommutator uchun alohida uzluksiz quvvat manbai kerakmi?
A: Muhim obyektlar uchun — ha. Kommutator UPSga ulanadi va elektr uzilganda kameralar bir necha soat davomida ishlashda davom etadi. Biz kommutator bilan komplektda kerakli sig'imli UPSni tanlaymiz va yetkazib beramiz.

Q: PoE-kommutator va videokuzatuv tarmog'ini kalit taslim montaj qilish qancha turadi?
A: Narx kameralar soni, masofalar, o'tkazish murakkabligi va obyekt turiga bog'liq. Menejerlarimizdan tijorat taklifini so'rang — hisob-kitob bepul, muhandisning Toshkentda obyektni ko'rish uchun chiqishi ham bepul.
poe-switches.en:
PoE switches are network devices that combine the functions of an ordinary switch and a power source over twisted pair. The Power over Ethernet standard makes it possible to transmit power along with data over a single Cat5e/Cat6 cable, which fundamentally simplifies the installation of video surveillance, access control and wireless access point systems. Thanks to this, the need to run separate power lines to each camera or access point disappears - a single cable is enough. You can buy PoE switches in Tashkent in the SAT Solutions catalog: here you will find models for facilities of any scale.

The key advantage of a PoE switch is savings on infrastructure. For a small office or shop with eight cameras, a desktop eight-port switch with a total power budget of 60-65 W is sufficient. For shopping malls, manufacturing facilities and residential complexes in Uzbekistan, managed devices with 16-24 ports, VLAN support, a function for monitoring the status of connected devices and an extended power budget - up to 240 W and above - will be required. Correct selection of a switch at the security system design stage saves money and eliminates power overload problems during subsequent expansion.

Choosing a PoE switch requires an understanding of several parameters: the number of ports, the PoE class, the total power budget, the availability of uplinks and management capability. The SAT Solutions catalog features 22 models for tasks ranging from small retail outlets to large industrial facilities. All devices undergo compatibility testing with IP cameras and other equipment - this eliminates the situation where a switch formally supports PoE but is not compatible with a specific camera brand.

## How to choose

- Number of PoE ports: for small systems, 4-8 ports are sufficient; for medium facilities - 16-24 ports. Allow for a reserve of at least 20% for future expansion.
- Total power budget: add up the consumption of all connected devices (a typical IP camera - 8-15 W, a PTZ camera - up to 25 W, an access point - 12-20 W) and choose a switch with a 20-30% reserve on top.
- PoE standard: the basic IEEE 802.3af provides up to 15.4 W per port, PoE+ (802.3at) - up to 30 W, PoE++ (802.3bt) - up to 60 W and more. For modern multi-megapixel cameras and Wi-Fi 6 access points, PoE+ is recommended.
- Manageability: unmanaged switches are cheaper and simpler, managed ones support VLAN, QoS, port monitoring, remote device reboot. For professional security systems, managed models are preferable.
- Port speed: switches with gigabit uplinks provide normal traffic aggregation with a large number of high-resolution cameras. Make sure the uplink does not become a bottleneck as the system grows.
- Overvoltage protection: for facilities in Uzbekistan with unstable power supply, built-in port surge protection is important - this extends the service life of both the switch and the connected cameras.
- Form factor and installation: desktop models are suitable for small server cabinets and hidden niches, rack-mountable ones (1U, 2U) - for utility rooms with 19-inch racks.

## Applications

- Video surveillance systems: connecting IP cameras at facilities without convenient access to power outlets - parking lots, perimeter, warehouses, production workshops.
- Offices and business centers: organizing a network for IP telephony, Wi-Fi access points and access control systems with a single cabling infrastructure.
- Retail facilities: shops, shopping malls and markets, where it is important to quickly deploy video surveillance with minimal construction work.
- Residential complexes and hotels: providing communication between video surveillance cameras, intercoms and Wi-Fi access points on floors and in public areas.
- Manufacturing enterprises and warehouses: stable camera power in conditions of dust and voltage fluctuations, common at production facilities in Uzbekistan.
- Educational institutions and government agencies: centralized management of video surveillance and access control infrastructure with a single administration point.

## Brands and models in the catalog

- Dahua is the main brand in this category. The company produces a wide line of PoE switches: from compact unmanaged devices of the PFS and S series with 4-8 ports and a budget of 36-65 W to managed switches of the CS4010 and CS4218 series with 8-24 ports and a power budget up to 240 W.
- The PFS series (for example, PFS3005, PFS3008, PFS3010, PFS3218) - unmanaged plug-and-play switches for small and medium video surveillance systems. Suitable for quick deployment without configuration.
- The CS4xxx series (CS4010, CS4218, CS4226) - managed L2 switches with VLAN support, port monitoring and an extended PoE budget. Designed for professional installations where flexible network administration is required.
- The S series (S3006, S3010) - budget entry-level unmanaged switches for small facilities with a limited number of cameras.
- All Dahua models presented are optimized to work together with IP cameras of this brand, which simplifies deployment and eliminates compatibility problems.

## FAQ

Q: How does a managed PoE switch differ from an unmanaged one?
A: An unmanaged one works on a plug-and-play principle - plug it in and forget it, no configuration is required. A managed one allows you to create VLANs, assign traffic priorities (QoS), remotely reboot frozen cameras and monitor the status of each port. For serious security systems, the managed option is recommended.

Q: Will a PoE switch have enough power to power cameras with IR illumination and PTZ?
A: Cameras with powerful IR illumination consume 15-25 W, PTZ cameras - up to 25-30 W. Choose a switch with PoE+ support (802.3at, up to 30 W per port) and a total budget with a reserve. If necessary, our specialists will perform an accurate calculation.

Q: Are Dahua PoE switches compatible with cameras from other brands?
A: Yes, all switches support the IEEE 802.3af/at standards and are compatible with any PoE equipment that conforms to these standards - Hikvision, Uniview, Reolink and other cameras. Dahua's proprietary optimization provides additional advantages only when used in pairs with cameras of the same brand.

Q: Is a separate uninterruptible power supply needed for a PoE switch?
A: For critically important facilities - yes. The switch is connected to a UPS, and when the power is cut off, the cameras continue to work for several hours. We will select and supply a UPS of the required capacity together with the switch.

Q: How much does turnkey installation of a PoE switch and video surveillance network cost?
A: The cost depends on the number of cameras, distances, complexity of cable laying and the type of facility. Request a commercial proposal from our managers - the calculation is free, and an engineer's visit to inspect the facility in Tashkent is also free.

Har bir element optik signal uzatish traktida qat'iy belgilangan funksiyani bajaradi, va hatto bitta mos kelmaydigan komponentni almashtirish signal darajasini yo'qotishga yoki liniyaning to'liq uzilishiga olib kelishi mumkin. O'zbekiston uchun uskuna tanlash obyektlarning masshtab bo'yicha farq qilishi bilan murakkablashadi: kichik ofislardan tortib yirik sanoat korxonalari va davlat idoralarigacha.

Buyurtma shakllantirishda asosiy parametr — tola turi (bir modali SM yoki ko'p modali MM) va konnektor turi (LC, SC, FC, MPO). Bu parametrlardagi xato komponentni yaroqsiz qiladi. Shuning uchun xarid qilishdan oldin loyihaviy hujjatlar yoki hech bo'lmaganda amaldagi liniya spetsifikatsiyasiga ega bo'lish muhim. SAT Solutions katalogida 242 ta pozitsiya taqdim etilgan, bu aksariyat tipik va nostandart konfiguratsiyalar uchun aksessuarlarning to'liq to'plamini tanlash imkonini beradi.

## Qanday tanlash kerak

- Tola turi: bir modali (SM, 9/125 mkm) uzoq masofalarda va magistral liniyalarda ishlatiladi; ko'p modali (MM, 50/125 yoki 62,5/125 mkm) — binolar ichida va bir necha yuz metrgacha bo'lgan qisqa uchastkalarda. Ularni chalkashtirib bo'lmaydi: uskuna shunchaki ishlamaydi.

- Konnektor turi: LC Duplex — faol uskuna (kommutatorlar, transiverlar) uchun standart; SC — telekommunikatsiya tugunlarida va passiv optik tarmoqlarda keng tarqalgan; FC — o'lchov texnikasida va ba'zi sanoat tizimlarida ishlatiladi; MPO — 8, 12 yoki 24 toladan iborat tutamlar bilan yuqori zichlikdagi server installatsiyalari uchun.

- Uch tomonini yotqizish turi: UPC (Ultra Physical Contact) qaytish yo'qotishlarini 50 dB dan yomon bo'lmagan darajada beradi va aksariyat qo'llanishlar uchun mos; APC (Angled Physical Contact) 8 gradusli burchakli yotqizish bilan 60 dB dan ortiq qaytish yo'qotishlarini ta'minlaydi va passiv optik PON tarmoqlarida (GPON/EPON) majburiy.

- Shnur uzunligi: 1-3 metrli patchkordlar stoyka yoki shkaf ichidagi tarqatish uchun ishlatiladi; 10-30 metrli shnurlar — sektsiyalararo ulanishlar yoki vaqtinchalik liniyalar uchun. Ortiqcha uzunlik minimal egilish radiusidan oshib ketish xavfi bilan halqalar hosil qiladi.

- Optik kross (ШКОС) konstruksiyasi: 19 dyuymli stoykalar uchun rack-ga o'rnatiladigan krosslar tanlanadi. Ortiqcha sig'im uchun ortiqcha to'lamaslik yoki keyinroq korpus qo'shib olmaslik uchun sig'imni (portlar sonini) va adapter plankalari turini oldindan aniqlash muhim.

- Sifat va kiritish yo'qotishlari: professional komponentlar konnektorga so'nishi 0,3 dB dan oshmagan va sinfga muvofiq qaytish yo'qotishlariga ega. Arzon izdellarda tejash liniya degradatsiyasiga aylanadi, bu ayniqsa 10G/40G-tarmoqlarda muhim.

- Plankalar va krosslar bilan moslik: adapter plankalari kross korpusiga o'rnatish o'lchami va adapter turi bo'yicha mos kelishi kerak. Buyurtma berishda moslikni aniqlashtiring, ayniqsa krossni bosqichma-bosqich to'ldirishni rejalashtirsangiz.

## Qo'llanilish sohalari

- Korporativ tarmoqlar va ma'lumotlar markazlari: gorizontal va magistral kabel quyi tizimlari, server xonalaridagi patch-panellar, qavat kommutatorlaridagi faol uskunani ulash.

- Uzun obyektlardagi videokuzatuv tizimlari: o'ralgan juftlik uchun erishib bo'lmaydigan masofalarda binolar, sanoat korxonalari korpuslari va perimetr kameralari orasida videosignalni optika orqali uzatish.

- Telekommunikatsiya tugunlari va operator tarmoqlari: tolali-optik kabellarni kiritish, krosslarda tarqatish, aloqa operatorlari va internet-provayderlar ofislarida transport uskunasini ulash.

- Davlat va ta'lim muassasalari: mis infratuzilma masofa yoki elektromagnit moslik talablari bilan cheklangan joyda yuqori o'tkazuvchanlik qobiliyatiga ega himoyalangan ichki tarmoqlar qurish.

- Sanoat obyektlari va ishlab chiqarishlar: optika kuch uskunasidan keladigan elektromagnit shovqinlarga sezgir emas, shuning uchun O'zbekistondagi zavodlar, podstansiyalar va neft-gaz obyektlari uchun afzal yechim hisoblanadi.

- Mehmonxonalar, savdo markazlari va turar-joy majmualari: optik magistral pardozlash bosqichida qo'yiladigan yangi qurilishda tuzilgan kabel tizimlarini qurish.

## Katalogdagi brendlar va modellar

- Pixietech: katalogning ushbu bo'limidagi asosiy brend. Liniya bir modali ijrodagi 1 dan 30 metrgacha uzunlikdagi LC/UPC, SC/APC va SC/UPC patchkordlarni, FC/UPC-FC/UPC SM montaj shnurlarini, ko'p tolali ulanishlar uchun yuqori zichlikdagi MPO-MPO patchkordlarni (12 tola, OM4, 20 m), shuningdek to'liq jihozlangan holatda 8 ta LC Duplex portli 19 dyuymli ijrodagi optik krosslarni o'z ichiga oladi.

- Pixietech adapterlari va plankalari: krosslar uchun SC-SC SM optik adapterlari va SC hamda LC Duplex portlariga mos R seriyali optik taqsimlash ramkalari (ODF) uchun adapter plankalari. Plankalar korpusni almashtirmasdan kross sig'imini oshirish imkonini beradi.

- Montaj tugunlari va aksessuarlar: katalogda kabellar va shnurlarni mahkamlash uchun mahkamlash tugunlari (PXT-UKN-01) taqdim etilgan, bu ayniqsa kabel kanallarida o'tkazish va stoykalarga montaj qilishda muhim.

- 242 ta pozitsiyadan iborat assortiment har qanday loyiha uchun — kichik ofisdan ko'p qavatli ma'muriy binogacha — kerakli konnektor turi, yotqizish, uzunlik va konstruktivni tanlashni ta'minlaydi.

## FAQ

Q: SC/UPC va SC/APC patchkordlar nimasi bilan farq qiladi — ularni aralashtirish mumkinmi?
A: UPC va APC — konnektor uchini yotqizishning turli turlari. Jismoniy jihatdan SC razyomlari bir xil, biroq APC burchakli qiyalikka va yashil korpusga ega. Ularni aralashtirib bo'lmaydi: UPCni APC-adapter bilan ulash ulkan signal yo'qotishlarini beradi. GPON-tarmoqlar bilan ishlashda faqat APCdan foydalaning.

Q: Kommutatordagi SFP-transiverni ulash uchun qanday patchkordni tanlash kerak?
A: Aksariyat SFP-transiverlar LC Duplex konnektoridan foydalanadi. Tola turi (SM yoki MM) transiver turiga bog'liq: bir modali SFP faqat bir modali kabel bilan, ko'p modali — ko'p modali bilan ishlaydi. Patchkordga buyurtma berishdan oldin transiver belgisini aniqlashtiring.

Q: Toshkentda optik kross va uni montaj qilish qancha turadi?
A: Narx sig'im (portlar soni), adapterlar turi va komplektlikka bog'liq. 19 dyuymli ijrodagi 8 ta LC Duplex portli to'liq jihozlangan kross — stoykaga montaj qilish uchun tayyor yechim. Montaj va payvandlashni o'z ichiga olgan to'liq narxni hisoblash uchun SAT Solutions menejerlaridan tijorat taklifini so'rang.

Q: Yangi server installatsiyalari uchun OM4 ko'p modali patchkordlarni ishlatish mumkinmi?
A: OM4 (50/125 mkm) 150 metrgacha masofalarda 40G va 100G tezliklarni qo'llab-quvvatlaydi va ma'lumotlar markazlari uchun dolzarb standart hisoblanadi. MPO-konnektorlar (12 toladan iborat tutamlar) bilan ulanishlar uchun OM4 past so'nish va keng o'tkazish polosasi tufayli afzal.

Q: Optikani yetkazib berish va montaj qilishni Toshkentdan tashqarida bajaramizmi?
A: Ha, SAT Solutions butun O'zbekiston bo'ylab ishlaydi. Yetkazib berish transport kompaniyalari yoki o'z transporti orqali amalga oshiriladi, montaj brigadalari viloyatlarga chiqadi. Shartlar va muddatlarni ariza rasmiylashtirishda aniqlashtiring.
pxt-fiber.en:
Optics and accessories are a category of passive network equipment without which it is impossible to build modern fiber-optic infrastructure. It includes patch cords, mounting cords, adapters, optical cross-connects and auxiliary mounting units. It is precisely these components that provide the physical connection of fiber-optic lines: from backbone cables to the terminal switching equipment. Buying optics and accessories in Tashkent today is easier than a few years ago - the market is saturated, however, the correct selection of components still requires engineering expertise.

The category covers a wide range of products: single-mode and multimode patch cords with LC, SC, FC and MPO connectors, adapters for cross-connect panels, optical cabinets (ShKOS) in a 19-inch design, adapter strips and mounting fixtures. Each element performs a strictly defined function in the optical signal transmission path, and the replacement of even a single incompatible component can lead to a loss of signal level or a complete break in the line. The choice of equipment for Uzbekistan is complicated by the fact that facilities differ in scale: from small offices to large industrial enterprises and government agencies.

The key parameter when forming an order is the fiber type (single-mode SM or multimode MM) and the connector type (LC, SC, FC, MPO). An error in these parameters makes the component unusable. Therefore, before purchasing, it is important to have design documentation or at least the specification of the existing line. The SAT Solutions catalog features 242 items, which makes it possible to select a complete set of accessories for most standard and non-standard configurations.

## How to choose

- Fiber type: single-mode (SM, 9/125 microns) is used over long distances and in backbone lines; multimode (MM, 50/125 or 62.5/125 microns) - inside buildings and on short sections up to several hundred meters. They cannot be mixed up: the equipment simply will not work.

- Connector type: LC Duplex - the standard for active equipment (switches, transceivers); SC - common in telecommunication nodes and passive optical networks; FC - used in measuring equipment and some industrial systems; MPO - for high-density server installations with bundles of 8, 12 or 24 fibers.

- End-face polishing type: UPC (Ultra Physical Contact) gives return loss no worse than 50 dB and is suitable for most applications; APC (Angled Physical Contact) with an 8-degree angled polish provides return loss over 60 dB and is mandatory in passive optical networks PON (GPON/EPON).

- Cord length: patch cords 1-3 meters long are used for wiring inside a rack or cabinet; cords 10-30 meters - for inter-section connections or temporary lines. Excess length creates loops with the risk of exceeding the minimum bend radius.

- Optical cross-connect (ShKOS) design: rack-mountable cross-connects are chosen for 19-inch racks. It is important to determine the capacity (number of ports) and the type of adapter strips in advance, so as not to overpay for excess capacity or have to purchase a housing later.

- Quality and insertion loss: professional components have an attenuation per connector of no more than 0.3 dB and return loss in accordance with the class. Saving on cheap products results in line degradation, which is especially critical in 10G/40G networks.

- Compatibility with strips and cross-connects: adapter strips must match the cross-connect housing in terms of mounting size and adapter type. Check compatibility when ordering, especially if you plan to equip the cross-connect in stages.

## Applications

- Corporate networks and data centers: horizontal and backbone cabling subsystems, patch panels in server rooms, connection of active equipment on floor switches.

- Video surveillance systems at extended facilities: transmission of the video signal over optics between buildings, structures of industrial enterprises and perimeter cameras over distances inaccessible to twisted pair.

- Telecommunication nodes and operator networks: input of fiber-optic cables, wiring on cross-connects, connection of transport equipment in the offices of communication operators and internet providers.

- Government and educational institutions: building secure internal networks with high throughput, where copper infrastructure is limited by distance or electromagnetic compatibility requirements.

- Industrial facilities and production plants: optics are insensitive to electromagnetic interference from power equipment, so they are the preferred solution for factories, substations and oil-and-gas facilities in Uzbekistan.

- Hotels, shopping malls and residential complexes: building structured cabling systems during new construction, where the optical backbone is laid at the finishing stage.

## Brands and models in the catalog

- Pixietech: the main brand in this section of the catalog. The line includes LC/UPC, SC/APC and SC/UPC patch cords in single-mode design from 1 to 30 meters long, FC/UPC-FC/UPC SM mounting cords, high-density MPO-MPO patch cords for multi-fiber connections (12 fibers, OM4, 20 m), as well as 19-inch optical cross-connects for 8 LC Duplex ports in a fully assembled form.

- Pixietech adapters and strips: SC-SC SM optical adapters for cross-connects and adapter strips for optical distribution frames (ODF) of the R series, compatible with SC and LC Duplex ports. The strips make it possible to increase the cross-connect capacity without replacing the housing.

- Mounting units and accessories: the catalog features mounting units (PXT-UKN-01) for fixing cables and cords, which is especially important when laying in cable ducts and mounting in racks.

- The range of 242 items ensures the choice of the required connector type, polishing, length and design for any project - from a small office to a multi-story administrative building.

## FAQ

Q: How do SC/UPC and SC/APC patch cords differ - can they be mixed?
A: UPC and APC are different types of connector end-face polishing. The SC connectors are physically identical, but APC has an angled bevel and a green housing. They cannot be mixed: connecting UPC with an APC adapter will result in huge signal loss. When working with GPON networks, use exclusively APC.

Q: Which patch cord should I choose for connecting an SFP transceiver in a switch?
A: Most SFP transceivers use an LC Duplex connector. The fiber type (SM or MM) depends on the transceiver type: single-mode SFPs work only with single-mode cable, multimode ones - with multimode. Check the transceiver marking before ordering a patch cord.

Q: How much does an optical cross-connect and its installation cost in Tashkent?
A: The cost depends on the capacity (number of ports), the type of adapters and the completeness. A fully assembled cross-connect for 8 LC Duplex ports in a 19-inch design is a ready-made solution for rack mounting. For a calculation of the full cost including installation and splicing, request a commercial proposal from SAT Solutions managers.

Q: Can multimode OM4 patch cords be used for new server installations?
A: OM4 (50/125 microns) supports 40G and 100G speeds over distances up to 150 meters and is the current standard for data centers. For connections with MPO connectors (bundles of 12 fibers), OM4 is preferable thanks to its low attenuation and wide bandwidth.

Q: Do you carry out the supply and installation of optics outside Tashkent?
A: Yes, SAT Solutions works throughout Uzbekistan. Delivery is carried out by transport companies or our own transport, and installation crews travel to the regions. Check the terms and deadlines when placing an order.

Terminallar va o'quvchilar — bu har qanday kirishni nazorat qilish va boshqarish tizimining (SKUD) asosiy elementi. Aynan shu qurilmalar oldingi chiziqda turadi: ular insonni identifikatsiya qiladi va uni o'tkazish yoki o'tkazmaslik haqida qaror qabul qiladi. Modelga qarab terminal kontaktsiz kartalarni o'qiy oladi, yuzni taniy oladi, barmoq izini skanerlaydi, QR-kodni o'qiy oladi yoki bir vaqtning o'zida bir nechta tekshirish usullarini birlashtiradi. Toshkentda kirish terminallari va o'quvchilarini SAT Solutions katalogida sotib olish mumkin — bu yerda ishonchli jahon ishlab chiqaruvchilaridan 58 ta pozitsiya taqdim etilgan.

Aniq modelni tanlash obyektning xavfsizlik darajasi, o'tkazuvchanlik qobiliyati, ekspluatatsiya sharoitlari va loyiha byudjeti bilan belgilanadi. Kam odam oqimi bo'lgan ofis kirishi uchun ixcham karta o'quvchisi yetarli. Zavod, bank yoki maxsus rejimli obyekt o'tkazgichi uchun yuzni tanish va tiriklikni nazorat qilish funksiyasiga ega, yorqin quyoshda yoki sovuqda ishlashga qodir ko'p faktorli terminal kerak. O'zbekistonda, keng iqlim sharoitlari diapazoni va obyektlar xilma-xilligini hisobga olgan holda, uskunani to'g'ri tanlash ayniqsa muhim.

Zamonaviy kirish terminallari allaqachon oddiy «karta — qulf» doirasidan chiqib ketgan. Flagman modellar kirishda tana haroratini o'lchashi, niqobsiz odamlarni aniqlashi, hodisalar jurnalini bulutda yuritishi va videokuzatuv tizimlari, turniketlar hamda ish vaqtini hisoblash dasturlari bilan integratsiyalashishi mumkin. SAT Solutions muhandislari uskunani aniq vazifa uchun tanlashda yordam beradi — kichik ofisdan tortib butun O'zbekiston bo'ylab tarqalgan obyektlar tarmog'igacha.

## Qanday tanlash kerak

- Identifikatsiya usuli. Obyektga qaysi tekshirish usuli mos kelishini aniqlang: EM/Mifare karta, barmoq izi, yuzni tanish, PIN-kod yoki ularning kombinatsiyasi. Ko'p faktorli identifikatsiya xavfsizlikni oshiradi, lekin qurilma narxini ko'taradi.

- O'tkazuvchanlik qobiliyati. Katta odam oqimi bo'lgan obyektlar uchun (soatiga 200 kishidan ortiq) tanish tezligi muhim — zamonaviy terminallar yuzni bir soniyadan kam vaqtda identifikatsiya qiladi. Cho'qqi yuklamani oldindan hisoblang.

- Ekspluatatsiya sharoitlari. Ko'chadagi terminallar IP65 bo'yicha himoya va kengaytirilgan harorat diapazonini talab qiladi. Ichki xonalar uchun bu talablar yumshoqroq, ammo namlik va changni ham hisobga oling.

- Infratuzilma bilan integratsiya. Terminal ishlatilayotgan SKUD kontrolleri, dasturiy ta'minot va zarur bo'lganda turniketlar yoki shlagbaumlar bilan mos kelishiga ishonch hosil qiling.

- Ma'lumotlar bazasi sig'imi. Yirik obyektlar uchun terminal qancha yuz yoki kartani lokal saqlashi muhim — bu server bilan aloqa uzilganda hal qiluvchi ahamiyatga ega.

- Qo'shimcha funksiyalar. Ba'zi modellar harorat o'lchash, niqoblarni tanish, mehmon kirishi uchun QR-kodlar, videokuzatuv tizimlari bilan integratsiyani qo'llab-quvvatlaydi. Bu imkoniyatlar obyektingizga kerakligini baholang.

- Form-faktor va o'rnatish. Terminallar devorga, tayanchga, turniketga o'rnatiladigan turlarda bo'ladi. To'g'ri form-faktor o'rnatishni soddalashtiradi va foydalanuvchi tajribasini yaxshilaydi.

## Qo'llanilish sohalari

- Ofis binolari va biznes-markazlar: binoga, qavatlarga va alohida xonalarga kirishni nazorat qilish, xodimlarning ish vaqtini hisoblash.

- Ishlab chiqarish korxonalari va omborlar: kirish zonalarini ajratish, maxsus rejimli uchastkalarga o'tishni nazorat qilish, xodimlarni hisoblash tizimi bilan integratsiya.

- Banklar, davlat muassasalari va xavfsizlikka yuqori talablar qo'yiladigan obyektlar: ko'p faktorli identifikatsiya, hodisalarning batafsil jurnalini yuritish, qo'riqlash signalizatsiyasi bilan integratsiya.

- Maktablar, universitetlar va tibbiyot muassasalari: o'quvchilar va xodimlarning kirishini nazorat qilish, jumladan harorat o'lchash va niqob rejimini nazorat qilish funksiyasi bilan.

- Turar-joy majmualari va mehmonxonalar: kirish eshigi, avtoturargoh, jamoat zonalariga o'rnatiladigan terminallar; QR-kod yoki mobil ilova orqali mehmonlar kirishini boshqarish.

- Sport obyektlari va savdo markazlari: tashrif buyuruvchilar oqimini nazorat qilish uchun turniket terminallari, kassa tizimlari va sodiqlik tizimlari bilan integratsiya.

## Katalogdagi brendlar va modellar

- Hikvision — ushbu kategoriyada taqdim etilgan asosiy va yagona ishlab chiqaruvchi, xavfsizlik tizimlari sohasidagi jahon yetakchisi. Hikvision terminallari liniyasi vazifalarning butun diapazonini qamrab oladi: byudjetli DS-K1T804 seriyali karta o'quvchilaridan tortib yuz va barmoq izini tanish funksiyasiga ega DS-K1T671 va DS-K1T342 seriyali flagman biometrik terminallargacha.

- DS-K1TA70MI seriyali terminallar tana haroratini o'lchash va niqob rejimini nazorat qilishni qo'llab-quvvatlaydi — bu tibbiyot muassasalari, o'quv yurtlari va katta odam oqimi bo'lgan o'tkazgichlar uchun dolzarb yechim.

- DS-K5671 seriyali turniket terminallari maxsus shlagbaumlar va turniket tizimlari bilan integratsiya uchun ishlab chiqilgan bo'lib, nazorat-o'tkazish punktlarida ishonchli nazoratni ta'minlaydi.

- DS-K4H250S va DS-K4H258S seriyali magnit qulflar terminallarni kompleks SKUD yechimi tarkibida to'ldiradi, eshiklar va darvozalarni jismoniy yopishni ta'minlaydi.

- DS-KAB673 seriyali periferik modullar terminallarning imkoniyatlarini kengaytiradi, tizimlarni qo'shimcha o'quvchilar va aksessuarlar bilan moslashuvchan tarzda sozlash imkonini beradi.

## FAQ

Q: Toshkentda kirish terminallari qancha turadi?
A: Narx funksionallikka bog'liq: oddiy karta o'quvchilari yuzni tanuvchi biometrik terminallardan ancha arzonga tushadi. Aniq narx loyiha hajmini hisobga olgan holda individual hisoblanadi — SAT Solutions mutaxassislaridan tijorat taklifini so'rang.

Q: Hikvision terminallarini allaqachon mavjud kirish tizimi bilan integratsiya qilish mumkinmi?
A: Aksariyat hollarda ha, agar SKUD kontrolleri standart Wiegand yoki OSDP protokollarini qo'llab-quvvatlasa. Aniq javob uchun o'rnatilgan kontroller va dasturiy ta'minot modelini bilish kerak.

Q: Yuzni tanuvchi terminallar kam yoritilganda ishlaydimi?
A: Zamonaviy Hikvision terminallari infraqizil yoritish bilan jihozlangan va yomon yoritilgan sharoitlarda ishlaydi. Ko'chadagi modelni tanlashda to'g'ridan-to'g'ri quyosh nurlaridan himoyani va ishchi harorat diapazonini ham hisobga oling.

Q: Terminallarni o'rnatgandan keyin xizmat ko'rsatish kerakmi?
A: Yillik texnik xizmat ko'rsatish tavsiya etiladi: ulanishlarni tekshirish, dasturiy ta'minotni yangilash, biometrik modellarda optikani tozalash va funksiyalarni sinash. SAT Solutions servis xizmati shartnomalarini taklif qiladi.

Q: Kirish terminalini qanchalik tez o'rnatish mumkin?
A: Tayyor infratuzilmaga bitta terminalni o'rnatish bir necha soat davom etadi. Obyektda kompleks tizimni o'rnatish muddatlari kirish nuqtalari soni va integratsiya murakkabligiga bog'liq — odatda bir ish kunidan tortib yirik obyektlar uchun bir necha haftagacha.
hik-access-terminals.en:
Terminals and readers are the key element of any access control system (ACS). It is precisely these devices that operate on the front line: they identify a person and decide whether to grant entry or not. Depending on the model, a terminal can read contactless cards, recognize faces, scan fingerprints, read QR codes, or combine several verification methods at once. You can buy access terminals and readers in Tashkent in the SAT Solutions catalog — here you will find 58 items from trusted global manufacturers.

The choice of a specific model is determined by the site's security level, throughput, operating conditions, and project budget. For an office entrance with a small flow of people, a compact card reader is sufficient. For a factory checkpoint, a bank, or a restricted-access facility, you need a multi-factor terminal with face recognition and liveness detection, capable of operating in bright sunlight or freezing cold. In Uzbekistan, given the wide range of climatic conditions and the diversity of sites, choosing the right equipment is especially important.

Modern access terminals have long moved beyond the simple "card — lock" concept. Flagship models can measure body temperature at the entrance, detect people without masks, keep an event log in the cloud, and integrate with video surveillance systems, turnstiles, and time-and-attendance software. SAT Solutions engineers help select equipment for a specific task — from a small office to a distributed network of sites across Uzbekistan.

## How to choose

- Identification method. Determine which verification method suits the site: EM/Mifare card, fingerprint, face recognition, PIN code, or a combination of these. Multi-factor identification increases security but raises the cost of the device.

- Throughput. For sites with a large flow of people (more than 200 people per hour), recognition speed is important — modern terminals identify a face in less than a second. Calculate peak load in advance.

- Operating conditions. Outdoor terminals require IP65 protection and an extended temperature range. For indoor spaces these requirements are milder, but humidity and dust should also be taken into account.

- Integration with infrastructure. Make sure the terminal is compatible with the ACS controller in use, the software, and, if necessary, with turnstiles or barriers.

- Database capacity. For large sites it is important how many faces or cards the terminal stores locally — this is critical if the connection to the server is lost.

- Additional features. Some models support temperature measurement, mask detection, QR codes for guest access, and integration with video surveillance systems. Assess whether your site needs these capabilities.

- Form factor and mounting. Terminals come in wall-mounted, stand-mounted, and turnstile-mounted versions. The right form factor simplifies installation and improves the user experience.

## Applications

- Office buildings and business centers: control of entry to the building, to floors, and to individual rooms, plus employee time-and-attendance tracking.

- Manufacturing enterprises and warehouses: access-zone segregation, control of entry to restricted areas, integration with the personnel management system.

ruijie-wifi.en:
Wi-Fi access points are the foundation of any modern wireless network in an enterprise, office, hotel, shopping center, or industrial site. Unlike consumer routers, professional access points are designed to handle dozens and hundreds of client devices simultaneously without degradation of speed and connection stability. You can buy Wi-Fi access points in Tashkent and throughout Uzbekistan in the SAT Solutions catalog — we supply equipment tailored to a specific project, not "at random."

Choosing an access point starts with analyzing the site: coverage area, the material of walls and ceilings, the expected number of simultaneous connections, the required throughput, and the availability of cable power (PoE). Open spaces require omnidirectional or sector outdoor models with protection from moisture and dust; offices need ceiling- or wall-mounted devices with support for centralized management. Modern Wi-Fi 6 and Wi-Fi 7 standards provide fundamentally different efficiency in dense environments compared to previous generations: OFDMA and MU-MIMO technologies allow serving more devices simultaneously and reducing latency in a busy network.

Professional access points are managed through a controller — hardware or cloud-based — which allows configuring roaming, load balancing, security policies, and monitoring from a single interface. This is especially important for sites with a large number of access points: hotels, business centers, industrial sites. The SAT Solutions catalog offers 18 models for various deployment scenarios — from compact office solutions to rugged outdoor devices.

## How to choose

- Wi-Fi standard: for new projects, models supporting Wi-Fi 6 (802.11ax) or Wi-Fi 7 are recommended — they provide higher throughput, lower latency, and better performance with a large number of client devices compared to Wi-Fi 5.
- Mounting type and form factor: ceiling access points suit offices and retail floors, wall-mounted ones — for corridors and meeting rooms, outdoor (OD models) — for parking lots, warehouses, and open areas with IP65 protection or higher.
- PoE support: most professional access points are powered over an Ethernet cable (PoE or PoE+), which eliminates the need for separate power and simplifies installation; check the PoE class and power consumption.
- Number of bands and antennas: dual-band models operate simultaneously on 2.4 GHz and 5 GHz; tri-band ones add a second 5 GHz channel or a 6 GHz band to offload the network at sites with very high device density.
- Centralized management: check whether the model supports a hardware or cloud controller from the same manufacturer — this is critical for building a single managed network of several access points with seamless roaming.
- Maximum number of clients: manufacturers specify the recommended number of simultaneous connections; for conference halls, classrooms, or retail floors, choose models with a margin for this parameter.
- Throughput and port aggregation: at sites with high speed requirements, pay attention to the availability of a 2.5G port or channel aggregation for connection to a switch.

## Applications

- Offices and business centers: providing stable Wi-Fi for employees, guest access, and corporate services with rights segregation via VLAN and SSID.
- Hotels and hospitality facilities: seamless roaming across floors and zones, guest network management, integration with authorization systems.
- Shopping centers and retail: coverage of large retail floors, support for POS terminals and video analytics systems, guest Wi-Fi with an authorization portal.
- Manufacturing enterprises and warehouses: outdoor and industrial access points for operation in harsh conditions — temperature fluctuations, dust, large spans.
- Educational institutions: a dense wireless network for classrooms with simultaneous connection of a large number of devices, access policy management.
- Open areas and campuses: outdoor access points for parking lots, stadiums, university and industrial areas with protection from weather effects.

## Brands and models in the catalog

- Ruijie Networks — all 18 items in the catalog are represented by equipment from this manufacturer, which specializes in enterprise network solutions. The RG-RAP lineup covers a wide range of scenarios: from compact office to powerful outdoor access points.
- Models of the RG-RAP1200 and RG-RAP2200 series — access points of previous generations for office and wall mounting, well proven in medium-scale projects.
- The RG-RAP series with Wi-Fi 6/7 support: models RG-RAP2260, RG-RAP2266, RG-RAP62, RG-RAP72Pro, and others — up-to-date solutions for high-load environments with support for the latest wireless standards.
- Outdoor models RG-RAP62-OD and RG-RAP52-OD — access points in a rugged design for outdoor operation, suitable for parking lots, warehouse areas, and open campuses.
- RG-RAP6202(G) — a multi-band access point for sites with heightened requirements for throughput and the number of simultaneous connections.

## FAQ

Q: How many access points do I need for my office?
A: It depends on the area, layout, and number of users. As a rough guide, one modern access point confidently serves 30-50 simultaneous client devices and covers 100-300 sq. m depending on the wall material. An exact calculation is done during network design — contact our engineers.

Q: How is a Wi-Fi 6 access point better than Wi-Fi 5?
A: Wi-Fi 6 (802.11ax) provides higher throughput and, most importantly, works more efficiently with a large number of simultaneous connections thanks to OFDMA and BSS Coloring technologies. In an office or retail floor with dozens of devices, the difference is noticeable: lower latency, higher connection stability.

Q: Do Ruijie access points need a separate controller?
A: For small installations (2-5 access points), standalone management is possible. For enterprise sites, a Ruijie Cloud hardware or cloud controller is recommended — it provides centralized configuration, seamless roaming, and monitoring. We will help select the optimal management option for your project.

Q: Can access points be installed outdoors?
A: Yes, the catalog includes outdoor OD-series models in a rugged enclosure. They are designed for operation under temperature fluctuations and moisture exposure. For outdoor installation, proper cable routing and grounding are also important — our specialists will perform the installation according to all requirements.

Q: What is the warranty on access points and what does it include?
A: Ruijie equipment comes with the official manufacturer's warranty. SAT Solutions processes warranty documents upon delivery and provides service support: diagnostics, replacement of faulty equipment, and technical support throughout the warranty period.

Shu sababli uskunani to'g'ri tanlash va kirish nuqtalarini joylashtirish professional yondashuvni talab qiladi.

- Aniqlik. Katalogda 2 MP (1080p) va 4 MP aniqlikdagi modellar taqdim etilgan. Yuzlarni identifikatsiya qilish va kirishdagi raqamlarni o'qish uchun kamida 2 MP kerak; perimetrni kuzatish uchun Full HD yetarli. Aniqlik qanchalik yuqori bo'lsa, kanalga va saqlash joyiga talablar shunchalik yuqori bo'ladi.

- Tashqi muhitdan himoya. Ko'chada o'rnatish uchun IP67 dan kam bo'lmagan himoya klassi kerak. Tanlangan model O'zbekistonga xos yuqori yozgi haroratlarda ishlashga mo'ljallanganligiga ishonch hosil qiling.

- Quvvat. Aksariyat Wi-Fi kameralar 12V adapteridan yoki PoE orqali quvvatlanadi. 4G kameralar ko'pincha akkumulyator bilan jihozlangan yoki quyosh panellarini qo'llab-quvvatlaydi — bu elektr tarmog'i yo'q joylar uchun dolzarb.

- Ekotizim va saqlash. Tayyor Hikvision Wi-Fi to'plamlari birgalikda ishlashga sozlangan kameralar va videoregistratorni o'z ichiga oladi. Yakka kameralar uchun oldindan aniqlab olish muhim: microSD kartaga, NAS ga yoki bulutga yozib olish.

## Qo'llanilish sohalari

- Xususiy uy-joylar va kottejlar. Wi-Fi yoki 4G li simsiz kameralar kabel orqali doimiy internet yo'q shahar tashqarisidagi uylar uchun idealdir. Mobil ilova orqali masofadan ko'rish istalgan vaqtda mavjud.

- Kichik va o'rta biznes: do'konlar, ofislar, kafelar. Tayyor Hikvision Wi-Fi to'plamlari kabel o'rnatuvchilarni jalb qilmasdan videokuzatuv tizimini tez joylashtirish imkonini beradi, bu o'rnatish narxi va muddatlarini kamaytiradi.

- Bog' shirkatlari va dala hovli kooperativlari. Internet o'tkazilmagan mavsumiy yashash obyektlarida akkumulyator yoki quyosh panelli 4G kamera butun yil davomida qo'riqlash monitoringini ta'minlaydi.

- Madaniy meros obyektlari va ijaraga olingan xonalar. Devorlarni teshish va kabel yotqizish mumkin bo'lmagan joyda simsiz kameralar interyerga zarar yetkazmasdan vazifani hal qiladi.
