A: Wi-Fi kamera router orqali lokal simsiz tarmoqqa ulanadi va obyektda statsionar internet mavjudligini talab qiladi. 4G kamera SIM-karta orqali uyali tarmoqda ishlaydi — uni umuman kabelli internet yo'q joyda o'rnatish mumkin. Tanlov obyekt infratuzilmasiga bog'liq.

Q: Toshkentda simsiz kameralarni o'rnatish qancha turadi?
A: Narx kameralar soni, ularning turi (Wi-Fi yoki 4G), qo'shimcha kirish nuqtalarini o'rnatish zarurati va montaj ishlari murakkabligiga bog'liq. Obyekt parametrlarini SAT Solutions menejeridan aniqlab oling — biz sizning sharoitlaringiz uchun hisob-kitob tayyorlaymiz.

Q: Wi-Fi kameralar uchun SIM-karta kerakmi?
A: Yo'q, Wi-Fi kameralar routeringizning simsiz tarmog'i orqali ishlaydi. SIM-karta faqat 4G kameralar uchun kerak. 4G kameralar uchun mobil trafik xarajatlari tanlangan tarif va video siqish sifatiga bog'liq.

Q: Simsiz kameralardagi tasvirni smartfon orqali ko'rish mumkinmi?
A: Ha, barcha Hikvision kameralari Hik-Connect mobil ilovasi orqali masofadan kirishni qo'llab-quvvatlaydi. Sozlashdan keyin siz kameralardagi to'g'ridan-to'g'ri translatsiya va yozuvlarni dunyoning istalgan nuqtasida ko'rasiz — telefonda internet ulanishi yetarli.

Q: Simsiz kameralar allaqachon o'rnatilgan simli videokuzatuv tizimi bilan mos keladimi?
A: Odatda Hikvision IP-kameralari (jumladan simsizlari) o'sha ishlab chiqaruvchining NVR videoregistratorlari va ONVIF protokoli bo'yicha mos qurilmalar bilan ishlaydi. Aniq moslikni sotib olishdan oldin mutaxassisdan aniqlab olish yaxshiroq.
hik-wireless-cameras.en:
Wireless surveillance cameras are a solution for sites where cable routing is impossible, difficult, or economically impractical. Unlike wired systems, such equipment transmits the video signal over Wi-Fi or through a 4G/LTE cellular network, which opens up possibilities for surveillance at temporary construction sites, country properties, warehouses without cabling infrastructure, and in spaces with limited access to wiring. You can buy wireless cameras in Tashkent in the SAT Solutions catalog — here we have gathered proven models from leading manufacturers.

The choice of a wireless camera depends on the connection type, operating conditions, and required resolution. Wi-Fi models are suitable for spaces with stable router coverage. Cameras with a 4G module work where there is no fixed internet: in open areas, at country houses, in the field, at construction sites, and in zones without fiber optics. It is important to understand that wireless video transmission is not only about installation convenience but also about certain trade-offs: signal stability depends on the quality of radio coverage, and in a multi-apartment environment interference is possible. Therefore, proper equipment selection and access-point placement require a professional approach.

The SAT Solutions catalog offers 27 models of wireless cameras: cylindrical (bullet), dome, and rotating PTZ cameras, as well as ready-made Wi-Fi surveillance kits. The range covers solutions both for private homes in Tashkent and for commercial and industrial sites throughout Uzbekistan.

## How to choose

- Connection type: Wi-Fi or 4G. Wi-Fi cameras work within the coverage of a home or corporate network. 4G cameras require a SIM card and a data plan, but work anywhere in the country with mobile coverage. For remote sites outside the city, 4G is the only realistic option.

- Form factor: cylindrical, dome, or rotating. Cylindrical (bullet) cameras are aimed at a single point, are clearly visible, and serve as a visible deterrent. Dome cameras are less noticeable and vandal-resistant. Rotating PTZ cameras allow remote control of direction and zoom, covering a large area.

- Resolution. The catalog offers models with 2 MP (1080p) and 4 MP resolution. To identify faces and read license plates at an entrance, a minimum of 2 MP is needed; for perimeter overview, Full HD is sufficient. The higher the resolution, the greater the requirements for the channel and storage.

- Night vision and illumination. Hikvision cameras of the ColorVu series feature color night recording thanks to additional white-light illumination. Standard IR models produce a black-and-white image in the dark. For entrance groups and parking lots, color night recording is preferable.

- Protection from the environment. For outdoor installation, a protection class of at least IP67 is required. Make sure the chosen model is rated for operation at the high summer temperatures typical of Uzbekistan.

- Power. Most Wi-Fi cameras are powered by a 12V adapter or via PoE. 4G cameras are often equipped with a battery or support solar panels — this is relevant for places without a power grid.

- Ecosystem and storage. Ready-made Hikvision Wi-Fi kits include cameras and a recorder configured to work together. For individual cameras, it is important to decide in advance: recording to a microSD card, to a NAS, or to the cloud.

## Applications

- Private homes and cottages. Wireless cameras with Wi-Fi or 4G are ideal for country houses that lack permanent cable internet. Remote viewing via a mobile app is available at any time.

- Construction sites and temporary facilities. Where cabling infrastructure has not yet been laid or its installation is impractical, 4G cameras provide prompt monitoring of work progress and equipment safety.

- Warehouses, parking lots, and industrial areas. Rotating 4G PTZ cameras cover large open spaces without the need to run cable lines over significant distances.

- Small and medium businesses: shops, offices, cafes. Ready-made Hikvision Wi-Fi kits allow quick deployment of a surveillance system without involving cable installers, which reduces the cost and installation time.

- Garden associations and dacha cooperatives. At sites with seasonal occupancy where internet is not available, a 4G camera with a battery or solar panel provides year-round security monitoring.

- Cultural heritage sites and rented premises. Where drilling walls and running cables is not allowed, wireless cameras solve the task without damaging the interior.

## Brands and models in the catalog

- Hikvision — the only manufacturer represented in this category, and this reflects the real state of affairs: Hikvision holds leading positions in the IP surveillance market in Uzbekistan and worldwide. The brand offers a full range of wireless solutions — from budget home cameras to professional enterprise-grade systems.

- The DS-2CV1 series — compact Wi-Fi cameras in cylindrical and dome designs with 2 and 4 MP resolution, built-in color night recording (ColorVu), and support for memory card recording. The optimal choice for small sites and home use.

- The DS-2CV2 series — dome Wi-Fi cameras with increased resistance to external effects, designed for office and retail spaces.

- Rotating 4G PTZ cameras of the DS-2DE2C series — mini-PTZ with SIM card support, remote pan and tilt control. Used for perimeter and open-area protection without fixed internet.

- Ready-made Wi-Fi kits of the NKS series — the kit includes cameras and a network video recorder, pre-paired with each other. This is the fastest way to deploy a multi-camera surveillance system: connection takes minimal time, and the configuration is already set up at the factory.

## FAQ

Q: How does a Wi-Fi camera differ from a 4G camera?
A: A Wi-Fi camera connects to a local wireless network through a router and requires the presence of fixed internet at the site. A 4G camera works through a cellular network via a SIM card — it can be installed where there is no cable internet at all. The choice depends on the site's infrastructure.

Q: How much does installing wireless cameras cost in Tashkent?
A: The cost depends on the number of cameras, their type (Wi-Fi or 4G), the need to install additional access points, and the complexity of the installation work. Provide the site parameters to a SAT Solutions manager — we will prepare a calculation for your conditions.

Q: Do Wi-Fi cameras need a SIM card?
A: No, Wi-Fi cameras work through your router's wireless network. A SIM card is only needed for 4G cameras. Mobile data costs for 4G cameras depend on the chosen plan and the quality of video compression.

Q: Can I view the image from wireless cameras via smartphone?
A: Yes, all Hikvision cameras support remote access through the Hik-Connect mobile app. After setup, you can see the live stream and recordings from the cameras anywhere in the world — all you need is an internet connection on your phone.

Q: Are wireless cameras compatible with an already installed wired surveillance system?
A: As a rule, Hikvision IP cameras (including wireless ones) work with NVR recorders from the same manufacturer and with compatible devices via the ONVIF protocol. It is best to check specific compatibility with a specialist before purchase.

hilook-ip-cameras.uz:
IP-kameralar — har qanday zamonaviy videokuzatuv tizimining asosi. Analog salaflaridan farqli o'laroq, ular signalni Ethernet tarmog'i orqali uzatadi, yuqori tasvir aniqligini, moslashuvchan masshtablanishni va istalgan qurilmadan translatsiyaga masofadan kirishni ta'minlaydi. Bugungi kunda Toshkentda IP-kameralarni eng turli vazifalar uchun sotib olish mumkin: kichik ofisni qo'riqlashdan tortib O'zbekistonning istalgan mintaqasidagi yirik sanoat obyektida tarqalgan kuzatuv tizimini qurishgacha.

IP-kamerani tanlash faqat narx bilan emas, balki texnik parametrlar majmuasi bilan belgilanadi: matritsa aniqligi, korpus konstruksiyasi, infraqizil yoki rangli tungi yoritish mavjudligi, PoE orqali quvvatlashni qo'llab-quvvatlash va tashqi ta'sirlardan himoya darajasi. HiLook liniyasi — Hikvision dan arzon segment — aksariyat tipik so'rovlarni qoplaydi: ko'cha perimetri uchun silindrik modellar, interyer zonalari uchun gumbazlilar, tunda rangli tasvir uchun ColorVu li variantlar. To'g'ri tanlangan kamera almashtirmasdan yillar davomida ishlaydi va tez-tez xizmat ko'rsatishni talab qilmaydi.

SAT Solutions katalogida turli o'lchamdagi va turli funksiyalar to'plamiga ega HiLook IP-kameralari taqdim etilgan. Barcha modellar ONVIF standarti bilan mos keladi va ham firma registratorlari, ham uchinchi tomon ishlab chiqaruvchilarining universal NVR lari bilan integratsiyalashadi. Sotib olishdan oldin ekspluatatsiya sharoitlari, talab qilinadigan aniqlik va ulanish sxemasini aniq belgilash muhim — bu ortiqcha xarajatlardan qochish va barqaror ishlaydigan tizimni olish imkonini beradi.

## Qanday tanlash kerak

- Matritsa aniqligi. Yuzlarni identifikatsiya qilish va davlat raqamlarini o'qish uchun kamida 4 MP kerak; kichik hududlarda umumiy kuzatuv uchun 2 MP yetarli. Katalogdagi HiLook modellari 2 dan 8 MP gacha diapazonda taqdim etilgan.
- Korpus konstruksiyasi. HL-IPC-B* silindrik kameralari ko'chada yo'naltirilgan kuzatuv uchun optimal; HL-IPC-T* gumbazlilari interyerga yaxshiroq mos keladi va buzg'unchilar tomonidan qiyinroq buriladi.
- Tungi yoritish. LU qo'shimchali modellar an'anaviy IR-yoritishdan foydalanadi (qorong'ida qora-oq tasvir); ColorVu (LUC, LUF) li kameralar minimal yoritishda ham rangli tasvir beradi — bu obyektlarni identifikatsiya qilish uchun hal qiluvchi ahamiyatga ega.
- Quvvat. PoE (802.3af/at) ni qo'llab-quvvatlash alohida quvvat kabelidan xalos qiladi: kommutatorgacha bitta Cat5e/Cat6 kabel yetarli. Katalogdagi barcha dolzarb HiLook modellari PoE ni qo'llab-quvvatlaydi.
- IP himoya darajasi. Ko'cha uchun kamida IP67 kerak; nam xonalar uchun — IP66. Ochiq osmon ostida yoki ishlab chiqarish zonalarida o'rnatiladigan kameralar uchun ushbu parametrni aniqlab oling.
- Fokus masofasi va ko'rish burchagi. 2.8 mm belgilangan obyektiv keng burchak beradi (taxminan 100°) va koridorlar hamda kichik xonalar uchun mos keladi; uzoq masofalarni kuzatish uchun variofokal obyektivli yoki katta fokus masofasi bo'lgan kameralar kerak.
- Registrator bilan moslik. Tanlangan kamera ONVIF protokolini qo'llab-quvvatlashi yoki mavjud NVR bilan bevosita integratsiyalashishiga ishonch hosil qiling. HiLook Hikvision registratorlari va aksariyat uchinchi tomon tizimlari bilan to'liq mos keladi.

## Qo'llanilish sohalari

- Ofislar va biznes-markazlar. Resepshen zonalari, muzokara xonalari va koridorlardagi gumbazli kameralar diskret kuzatuv va xodimlar kirishini nazorat qilishni ta'minlaydi.
- Chakana savdo. Toshkentdagi do'konlar, savdo markazlari va omborlar IP-kameralardan kassa zonalarini nazorat qilish, o'g'irliklarga qarshi kurashish va xaridorlar trafigini tahlil qilish uchun foydalanadi.
- Sanoat korxonalari va omborlar. Yuqori aniqlik va ishonchli korpus himoyasiga ega silindrik modellar O'zbekistonning murakkab sharoitlarida perimetr, texnika kirishi va ishlab chiqarish jarayonlarini nazorat qiladi.
- Turar-joy majmualari va xususiy uylar. Kirish guruhlari, avtoturargohlar va uy oldi hududini kuzatish; domofonlar va kirishni nazorat qilish tizimlari bilan integratsiya.
- Ta'lim muassasalari. Maktablar va universitetlar o'quvchilar xavfsizligini ta'minlash uchun o'quv binolari, oshxonalar va hududda kameralar o'rnatadi.
- Kritik infratuzilma obyektlari. Podstansiyalar, server xonalari, banklar — uzluksiz yozib olish va hodisalarga tez reaksiya talab qilinadigan joylar.

## Katalogdagi brendlar va modellar

- HiLook (HL-IPC-B seriyali silindrik kameralar). HL-IPC-B120HA-LU, HL-IPC-B140HA-LUC, HL-IPC-B160HAP-LUF/SL va HL-IPC-B180HA-LU ko'cha modellari keng aniqlik tanlovini (2-8 MP) va yoritish turlarini taklif qiladi — standart IR dan tortib rangli tungi ko'rish uchun ColorVu texnologiyasigacha.
- HiLook (HL-IPC-T seriyali gumbazli kameralar). HL-IPC-T220HA-LUC, HL-IPC-T240HA-LUC, HL-IPC-T240HA-LUF/SL va HL-IPC-T241H-UC modellari xonalarda va soyabon ostida o'rnatishga mo'ljallangan; ixcham korpus ortiqcha e'tiborni jalb qilmaydi.
- HiLook (HL-IPC-C seriyali ixcham kameralar). HL-IPC-C320(C) va HL-IPC-C340(C) modellari ixchamlik va o'rnatish soddaligi muhim bo'lgan kichik obyektlar uchun yetarli aniqlikni saqlagan holda mos keladi.
- Yagona Hikvision / HiLook ekotizimi. Katalogdagi barcha kameralar Hikvision registratorlari va dasturiy ta'minoti bilan mos keladi, bu tayyor tizimlarni masshtablashni soddalashtiradi va xizmat ko'rsatish narxini kamaytiradi.

## FAQ

Q: Ofis uchun qanday aniqlikdagi IP-kamerani tanlash kerak?
A: Ofisda umumiy kuzatuv uchun 2-4 MP yetarli. Agar kirishdagi yuzlarni aniq identifikatsiya qilish yoki hujjatlarni o'qish kerak bo'lsa, 4 MP va undan yuqorini tanlang. HiLook T24x seriyali kameralari bunday vazifalar uchun sifat va narxning optimal nisbatini taklif qiladi.

Q: HiLook IP-kameralari internetsiz ishlaydimi?
A: Ha, registratorga lokal yozib olish uchun internet kerak emas. Tarmoqqa ulanish faqat mobil ilova yoki brauzer orqali masofadan ko'rish uchun kerak bo'ladi — bu holda router yoki Hik-Connect bulutli xizmati orqali kirish sozlanadi.

Q: Qaysi biri yaxshiroq — silindrik yoki gumbazli kamera?
A: Silindrik kameralar aniq bir yo'nalishda tashqi kuzatuv uchun yaxshiroq mos keladi (kirish, perimetr), gumbazlilar — ko'rinmaslik va keng ko'rish burchagi muhim bo'lgan xonalar uchun. Tanlov o'rnatish joyi va kuzatuv vazifasiga bog'liq.

Q: O'rnatish uskuna narxiga kiradimi?
A: Yo'q, o'rnatish alohida hisoblanadi va kameralar soni, obyekt turi hamda kabel yotqizish murakkabligiga bog'liq. SAT Solutions obyektni tekshirgandan keyin batafsil smeta taqdim etadi.

Q: Kameralarni allaqachon ishlayotgan tizimga qo'shish mumkinmi?
A: Ha, registrator va kommutatorda bo'sh portlar mavjud bo'lishi sharti bilan. HiLook kameralari ONVIF standartini qo'llab-quvvatlaydi, shuning uchun aksariyat mavjud videokuzatuv tizimlari bilan mos keladi. Mutaxassislarimiz moslikni tekshiradi va integratsiyada yordam beradi.
hilook-ip-cameras.en:
IP cameras are the foundation of any modern video surveillance system. Unlike their analog predecessors, they transmit the signal over an Ethernet network, providing high image resolution, flexible scalability, and remote access to the stream from any device. You can buy IP cameras in Tashkent today for a wide variety of tasks: from securing a small office to building a distributed surveillance system at a large industrial site in any region of Uzbekistan.

The choice of an IP camera is determined not only by price but by a combination of technical parameters: sensor resolution, enclosure design, the presence of infrared or color night illumination, PoE power support, and the degree of protection from external effects. The HiLook lineup — the affordable segment from Hikvision — covers most typical needs: cylindrical models for the outdoor perimeter, dome models for interior areas, and ColorVu variants for color imaging at night. A properly chosen camera works for years without replacement and does not require frequent maintenance.

The SAT Solutions catalog offers HiLook IP cameras of various sizes and with different feature sets. All models are compatible with the ONVIF standard and integrate both with proprietary recorders and with universal NVRs from third-party manufacturers. Before purchasing, it is important to clearly define the operating conditions, the required resolution, and the connection scheme — this will help avoid excessive costs and get a stably working system.

## How to choose

- Sensor resolution. To identify faces and read license plates, at least 4 MP is needed; for general surveillance of small areas, 2 MP is sufficient. HiLook models in the catalog range from 2 to 8 MP.
- Enclosure design. Cylindrical HL-IPC-B* cameras are optimal for directional outdoor surveillance; dome HL-IPC-T* cameras fit better into interiors and are harder for intruders to reposition.
- Night illumination. Models with the LU suffix use traditional IR illumination (black-and-white image in the dark); cameras with ColorVu (LUC, LUF) produce a color image even in minimal lighting — this is critical for identifying objects.
- Power. PoE support (802.3af/at) eliminates a separate power cable: a single Cat5e/Cat6 cable to the switch is enough. All current HiLook models in the catalog support PoE.
- IP protection degree. For outdoors, at least IP67 is needed; for humid spaces — IP66. Check this parameter for cameras mounted outdoors or in industrial zones.
- Focal length and field of view. A fixed 2.8 mm lens gives a wide angle (about 100°) and suits corridors and small rooms; for long-distance surveillance, cameras with a varifocal lens or a longer focal length are needed.
- Recorder compatibility. Make sure the chosen camera supports the ONVIF protocol or integrates directly with the existing NVR. HiLook is fully compatible with Hikvision recorders and most third-party systems.

## Applications

- Offices and business centers. Dome cameras in reception areas, meeting rooms, and corridors provide discreet surveillance and staff access control.
- Retail. Shops, shopping centers, and warehouses in Tashkent use IP cameras to monitor checkout areas, counter theft, and analyze customer traffic.
- Industrial enterprises and warehouses. High-resolution cylindrical models with a rugged enclosure monitor the perimeter, equipment entry, and production processes in the harsh conditions of Uzbekistan.
- Residential complexes and private homes. Surveillance of entrance groups, parking lots, and the surrounding area; integration with intercoms and access control systems.
- Educational institutions. Schools and universities install cameras in academic buildings, cafeterias, and on the grounds to ensure the safety of students.
- Critical infrastructure sites. Substations, server rooms, banks — where continuous recording and rapid response to incidents are required.

## Brands and models in the catalog

- HiLook (cylindrical cameras of the HL-IPC-B series). Outdoor models HL-IPC-B120HA-LU, HL-IPC-B140HA-LUC, HL-IPC-B160HAP-LUF/SL, and HL-IPC-B180HA-LU offer a wide choice of resolutions (2-8 MP) and illumination types — from standard IR to ColorVu technology for color night vision.
- HiLook (dome cameras of the HL-IPC-T series). Models HL-IPC-T220HA-LUC, HL-IPC-T240HA-LUC, HL-IPC-T240HA-LUF/SL, and HL-IPC-T241H-UC are designed for installation indoors and under canopies; the compact enclosure does not attract unnecessary attention.
- HiLook (compact cameras of the HL-IPC-C series). Models HL-IPC-C320(C) and HL-IPC-C340(C) suit small sites where compactness and ease of installation are important while maintaining sufficient resolution.
- A unified Hikvision / HiLook ecosystem. All catalog cameras are compatible with Hikvision recorders and software, which simplifies the scaling of ready-made systems and reduces maintenance costs.

## FAQ

Q: What IP camera resolution should I choose for an office?
A: For general surveillance in an office, 2-4 MP is sufficient. If you need to clearly identify faces at the entrance or read documents, choose 4 MP and above. HiLook cameras of the T24x series offer the optimal balance of quality and price for such tasks.

Q: Do HiLook IP cameras work without internet?
A: Yes, internet is not needed for local recording to a recorder. A network connection is only required for remote viewing via a mobile app or browser — in this case, access is configured through a router or the Hik-Connect cloud service.

Q: Which is better — a cylindrical or a dome camera?
A: Cylindrical cameras are better suited for outdoor surveillance in a specific direction (entrance, perimeter), dome ones — for indoor spaces where discreetness and a wide field of view are important. The choice depends on the installation location and the surveillance task.

Q: Is installation included in the equipment cost?
A: No, installation is calculated separately and depends on the number of cameras, the type of site, and the complexity of cable routing. SAT Solutions provides a detailed estimate after surveying the site.

Q: Can cameras be added to an already working system?
A: Yes, provided there are free ports on the recorder and switch. HiLook cameras support the ONVIF standard, so they are compatible with most existing surveillance systems. Our specialists will check compatibility and help with integration.

Kommutatorlar — har qanday zamonaviy tarmoq infratuzilmasining asosi. Aynan shu qurilmalar kompyuterlar, IP-kameralar, kirish nuqtalari, IP-telefonlar va boshqa tarmoq uskunalarini yagona ishchi tarmoqqa birlashtiradi. To'g'ri tanlangan kommutatorsiz hatto eng qimmat xavfsizlik yoki avtomatlashtirish uskunasi ham to'liq kuchida ishlamaydi. Bugungi kunda Toshkentda kommutator sotib olish qiyin emas, ammo aniq vazifa uchun mos modelni tanlash — bu allaqachon ekspertiza masalasi.

SAT Solutions katalogida turli seriya va klassdagi 50 dan ortiq TP-Link kommutatorlari mavjud: kichik ofis uchun oddiy boshqarilmaydigan kommutatorlardan tortib yirik videokuzatuv tizimlari va korporativ tarmoqlar uchun PoE++ ni qo'llab-quvvatlaydigan L2+ darajasidagi boshqariladigan qurilmalargacha. Assortimentda shuningdek turli standart interfeyslarga ega uskunani yagona infratuzilmaga integratsiya qilish imkonini beradigan mediakonverterlar taqdim etilgan. Bu katalogni tizim integratorlari, IT-mutaxassislar va O'zbekistondagi buyurtmachilar uchun universal resurs qiladi.

Kommutatorni to'g'ri tanlash faqat portlar soni bilan belgilanmaydi. Ulanadigan qurilmalar turini, tarmoq orqali quvvatlash talablarini, trafikni boshqarish zaruratini va keyingi masshtablash potensialini hisobga olish muhim. Ushbu parametrlarni tushunish va byudjet hamda vazifa uchun optimal yechimni tanlash — aynan shuning uchun SAT Solutions kompaniyasi mavjud.

## Qanday tanlash kerak

- Portlar soni va turi. Hozir va istiqbolda zaxira bilan qancha qurilma ulash kerakligini aniqlang. Fast Ethernet (100 Mbit/s) va Gigabit Ethernet (1000 Mbit/s) portlar nisbatiga e'tibor bering — yuqori aniqlikdagi IP-videokuzatuv va korporativ vazifalar uchun gigabit portlar afzalroq.

- PoE qo'llab-quvvatlash. Agar tarmoqda IP-kameralar, Wi-Fi kirish nuqtalari yoki IP-telefonlar ishlaydigan bo'lsa, Power over Ethernet ni qo'llab-quvvatlaydigan kommutatorni tanlang. PoE quvvatining umumiy byudjetiga e'tibor bering: ko'p kamerali loyihalar uchun yuqori byudjetli modellar kerak — masalan, PoE++ ni qo'llab-quvvatlaydigan DS yoki SX3206HPP seriyali kommutatorlar.

- Boshqariluvchanlik. Boshqarilmaydigan kommutatorlar (TL-SF1016D, TL-SG1008D) maxsus talablarsiz kichik tarmoqlar uchun mos keladi. Boshqariladigan va qisman boshqariladigan modellar (TL-SG105E, SG3428, L2+ seriyali SX3206HPP) VLAN sozlash, trafikni nazorat qilish, QoS ustuvorligini belgilash va monitoringni ta'minlaydi — ular korporativ va obyektli inshootlarda zarur.

- Kommutatsiya tezligi va o'tkazuvchanlik qobiliyati. Yuqori yuklamalarda — ko'p oqimli video, zaxira nusxalash, VoIP — nafaqat port tezligi, balki kommutatsiya matritsasi unumdorligi ham muhim. Ko'p portli modellar uchun ushbu parametrni aniqlab oling.

- Form-faktor va o'rnatish. Kommutatorlar stol usti va rack-ijroda (19") chiqariladi. Server shkaflari va telekommunikatsiya tayanchlari uchun rack-modellarni tanlang. Stol usti variantlari kichik ofislar va olis nuqtalar uchun qulay.

- Optika uchun mediakonverterlar. Agar obyekt signalni 100 metrdan ortiq masofaga uzatishni talab qilsa, mediakonverterlar ishlatiladi — MC220L yoki MC112CS kabi — optik tola orqali ulanish uchun. Bu yirik hududlar uchun hal qiluvchi ahamiyatga ega: zavodlar, kampuslar, savdo markazlari.

- Kafolat va ishlab chiqaruvchi qo'llab-quvvatlashi. Uskuna rasmiy kafolat bilan yetkazib berilishi va O'zbekiston hududida texnik yordam mavjudligiga ishonch hosil qiling.

## Qo'llanilish sohalari

- Videokuzatuv tizimlari. PoE-kommutatorlar IP-kameralarni alohida quvvat kabelisiz quvvatlash va ulash uchun ishlatiladi — bu istalgan masshtabdagi obyektlarda o'rnatishni soddalashtiradi va inshoot narxini kamaytiradi.

- Ofis va korporativ tarmoqlar. Boshqariladigan kommutatorlar biznes-markazlar, banklar, davlat muassasalarida ma'lumot uzatish, IP-telefoniya va Wi-Fi uchun ishonchli infratuzilmani shakllantiradi.

- Sanoat va ishlab chiqarish obyektlari. Kommutatorlar zavodlar, ombor majmualari va tarqalgan infratuzilmaga ega obyektlarda texnologik tarmoqlar qurish uchun qo'llaniladi.

- O'quv yurtlari va tibbiyot muassasalari. Maktablar, universitetlar, klinikalar axborot tizimlari, videokuzatuv va kirishni nazorat qilish uchun ishonchli va boshqariladigan tarmoqlarga muhtoj.

- Mehmonxonalar va savdo obyektlari. Mehmonxonalar va savdo-o'yin-kulgi markazlari uchun mehmon va xizmat trafigini ajratish uchun VLAN ni qo'llab-quvvatlaydigan barqaror tarmoq ishi muhim.

- Turar-joy majmualari va aqlli uy. PoE ni qo'llab-quvvatlaydigan kommutatorlar ko'p xonadonli uylar va kottej posyolkalarida videokuzatuv, domofoniya va kirishni nazorat qilish tizimlarining ishlashini ta'minlaydi.

## Katalogdagi brendlar va modellar

- TP-Link — SAT Solutions katalogining ushbu kategoriyasida yagona va to'liq taqdim etilgan brend. TP-Link tarmoq uskunasi yetkazib berish hajmi bo'yicha jahon yetakchilari qatoriga kiradi, keng mahsulot liniyasi va obyektli inshootlar uchun optimal narx-sifat nisbati bilan ajralib turadi.

- DS seriyasi — videokuzatuv tizimlari talablarini hisobga olgan holda ishlab chiqilgan maxsus PoE-kommutatorlar (DS105GP, DS106P, DS1018GMP): oshirilgan quvvat byudjeti, kengaytirilgan ishchi harorat diapazoni, veb-interfeys orqali qulay boshqaruv.

- SG va SF seriyasi — turli sig'imdagi ofis va korporativ tarmoqlar uchun kommutatorlar. TL-SG105E va TL-SG1008D modellari gigabit yechimlarning arzon segmentini ifodalaydi, TL-SF1016D va TL-SF1048 esa tejamli loyihalar uchun sinalgan Fast Ethernet kommutatorlari.

- SX3206HPP — PoE++ (802.3bt) ni qo'llab-quvvatlaydigan L2+ darajasidagi boshqariladigan kommutator, talabchan qurilmalar bilan yuqori yuklamali tarmoqlar uchun mo'ljallangan: PTZ-kameralar, Wi-Fi 6 kirish nuqtalari, sanoat terminallari.

- MC220L va MC112CS mediakonverterlari — mis buralgan juftlik asosidagi tarmoqqa optik tolali kanallarni integratsiya qilish uchun yechimlar. Uzun kommunikatsiyali obyektlarda tarqalgan videokuzatuv va ma'lumot uzatish tarmoqlarini qurishda ishlatiladi.

## FAQ

Q: Boshqariladigan kommutator boshqarilmaydiganidan nimasi bilan farq qiladi?
A: Boshqarilmaydigan kommutator sozlashsiz «qutidan chiqib» ishlaydi — u shunchaki qurilmalarni tarmoqqa ulaydi. Boshqariladigani VLAN, trafik ustuvorligini (QoS), portlar monitoringini va boshqa parametrlarni sozlash imkonini beradi, bu xavfsizlik va unumdorlik talablariga ega murakkab tarmoqlar uchun zarur.

Q: Menga nechta PoE port va qanday quvvatda kerak?
A: PoE portlar soni ulanadigan qurilmalar soniga (kameralar, kirish nuqtalari, telefonlar) mos kelishi kerak. Port quvvati: standart PoE (802.3af) — 15,4 W gacha, PoE+ (802.3at) — 30 W gacha, PoE++ (802.3bt) — 60–90 W gacha. Kommutatorning umumiy quvvat byudjeti barcha ulangan qurilmalarni bir vaqtning o'zida qoplashi kerak.

Q: Yangi optika yotqizish o'rniga mediakonverter ishlatish mumkinmi?
A: Mediakonverter allaqachon mavjud optik tolali liniyani RJ-45 interfeysli uskunaga ulash imkonini beradi va aksincha. Bu yangi uskunani amaldagi infratuzilmaga kabelni qayta yotqizmasdan integratsiya qilishda qulay.

Q: TP-Link kommutatorlariga qanday kafolat beriladi?
A: SAT Solutions yetkazib beradigan aksariyat TP-Link kommutatorlariga ishlab chiqaruvchining rasmiy kafolati amal qiladi. Kafolat muddati aniq modelga bog'liq — buyurtmani rasmiylashtirishda aniqlab oling. Bundan tashqari, SAT Solutions loyihani bajarish davrida o'zining servis yordamini ko'rsatadi.

Q: Uskuna yetkazib berish bilan birga tarmoqni «kalit topshirish» tamoyilida o'rnatishni buyurtma qilish mumkinmi?
A: Ha, SAT Solutions to'liq ish siklini bajaradi: loyihalash, uskuna yetkazib berish, o'rnatish, sozlash va obyektni topshirish. Bu uskunani alohida sotib olib, uchinchi tomon o'rnatuvchilarni jalb qilishdan qulayroq va tejamliroq.
tplink-switches.en:
Switches are the foundation of any modern network infrastructure. It is precisely these devices that unite computers, IP cameras, access points, IP phones, and other network equipment into a single working network. Without a properly chosen switch, even the most expensive security or automation equipment will not perform to its full potential. Buying a switch in Tashkent today is not difficult, but choosing the right model for a specific task is already a matter of expertise.

The SAT Solutions catalog includes more than 50 models of TP-Link switches of various series and classes: from simple unmanaged switches for a small office to managed L2+ devices with PoE++ support for large-scale surveillance systems and corporate networks. The range also includes media converters, allowing equipment with interfaces of various standards to be integrated into a single infrastructure. This makes the catalog a universal resource for system integrators, IT specialists, and customers in Uzbekistan.

The right choice of switch is determined not only by the number of ports. It is important to consider the type of devices that will be connected, the requirements for power over the network, the need for traffic management, and the further potential for scaling. Understanding these parameters and selecting the optimal solution for a budget and task — this is exactly why the SAT Solutions company exists.

## How to choose

- Number and type of ports. Determine how many devices need to be connected now and with a margin for the future. Pay attention to the ratio of Fast Ethernet (100 Mbit/s) and Gigabit Ethernet (1000 Mbit/s) ports — for high-definition IP surveillance and corporate tasks, gigabit ports are preferable.

- PoE support. If IP cameras, Wi-Fi access points, or IP phones will operate on the network, choose a switch with Power over Ethernet support. Pay attention to the total PoE power budget: for projects with a large number of cameras, models with a high budget are needed — for example, DS-series switches or the SX3206HPP with PoE++ support.

- Manageability. Unmanaged switches (TL-SF1016D, TL-SG1008D) suit small networks without special requirements. Managed and partially managed models (TL-SG105E, SG3428, SX3206HPP of the L2+ series) provide VLAN configuration, traffic control, QoS prioritization, and monitoring — they are necessary in corporate and site installations.

- Switching speed and throughput. Under high loads — multi-stream video, backup, VoIP — not only port speed matters but also the performance of the switching fabric. Check this parameter for multi-port models.

- Form factor and mounting. Switches come in desktop and rack designs (19"). For server cabinets and telecommunication racks, choose rack models. Desktop versions are convenient for small offices and remote locations.

- Media converters for optics. If the site requires signal transmission over a distance exceeding 100 meters, media converters are used — such as the MC220L or MC112CS — for connection over fiber optics. This is critical for large territories: factories, campuses, shopping centers.

- Warranty and manufacturer support. Make sure the equipment comes with an official warranty and that technical support is available in Uzbekistan.

## Applications

- Video surveillance systems. PoE switches are used to power and connect IP cameras without a separate power cable — this simplifies installation and reduces the installation cost at sites of any scale.

- Office and corporate networks. Managed switches form reliable infrastructure for data transmission, IP telephony, and Wi-Fi in business centers, banks, and government institutions.

- Industrial and manufacturing sites. Switches are used to build technological networks at factories, warehouse complexes, and sites with distributed infrastructure.

- Educational institutions and medical facilities. Schools, universities, and clinics need reliable and managed networks for the operation of information systems, video surveillance, and access control.

- Hotels and retail facilities. For hotels and shopping-and-entertainment centers, stable network operation with VLAN support for separating guest and service traffic is critical.

- Residential complexes and smart home. Switches with PoE support ensure the operation of surveillance, intercom, and access control systems in apartment buildings and cottage settlements.

## Brands and models in the catalog

- TP-Link — the only and fully represented brand in this catalog category at SAT Solutions. TP-Link is among the world leaders in network equipment shipment volume, distinguished by a wide product lineup and an optimal price-to-quality ratio for site installations.

- The DS series — specialized PoE switches (DS105GP, DS106P, DS1018GMP) developed with the requirements of surveillance systems in mind: increased power budget, extended operating temperature range, convenient management via a web interface.

- The SG and SF series — switches for office and corporate networks of various capacities. The TL-SG105E and TL-SG1008D models represent the affordable segment of gigabit solutions, while the TL-SF1016D and TL-SF1048 are proven Fast Ethernet switches for economical projects.

- SX3206HPP — a managed L2+ switch with PoE++ (802.3bt) support, designed for high-load networks with demanding devices: PTZ cameras, Wi-Fi 6 access points, industrial terminals.

- Media converters MC220L and MC112CS — solutions for integrating fiber-optic channels into a network based on copper twisted pair. Used in building distributed surveillance and data transmission networks at sites with extended communications.

## FAQ

Q: How does a managed switch differ from an unmanaged one?
A: An unmanaged switch works out of the box without configuration — it simply connects devices into a network. A managed one allows configuring VLANs, traffic prioritization (QoS), port monitoring, and other parameters, which is necessary for complex networks with security and performance requirements.

Q: How many PoE ports do I need and at what power?
A: The number of PoE ports should match the number of connected devices (cameras, access points, phones). Port power: PoE standard (802.3af) — up to 15.4 W, PoE+ (802.3at) — up to 30 W, PoE++ (802.3bt) — up to 60–90 W. The switch's total power budget must cover all connected devices simultaneously.

Q: Can a media converter be used instead of laying new optics?
A: A media converter allows connecting an already existing fiber-optic line to equipment with an RJ-45 interface, and vice versa. This is convenient when integrating new equipment into an existing infrastructure without re-laying cable.

Q: What is the warranty on TP-Link switches?
A: Most TP-Link switches supplied by SAT Solutions are covered by the official manufacturer's warranty. The warranty period depends on the specific model — check when placing an order. In addition, SAT Solutions provides its own service support for the duration of the project.

Q: Can turnkey network installation be ordered together with the equipment supply?
A: Yes, SAT Solutions performs the full cycle of work: design, equipment supply, installation, configuration, and site handover. This is more convenient and economical than purchasing equipment separately and hiring third-party installers.

Xavfsizlik tizimlari va past kuchlanishli tarmoqlar uchun kabellar — har qanday muhandislik infratuzilmasining asosi. To'g'ri tanlangan kabelsiz na videokuzatuv kamerasi, na yong'in izvestchisi, na kirishni nazorat qilish tizimi barqaror ishlamaydi. SAT Solutions katalogida turli tur va kesimdagi kabellar taqdim etilgan: signal, buralgan juftlik, olovga chidamli, elektr — Toshkentda va butun O'zbekiston bo'ylab istalgan masshtabdagi obyektlarda past kuchlanishli va kuchli liniyalarni o'rnatish uchun zarur bo'lgan hamma narsa.

Kabelni tanlash tizim turi, trassa uzunligi, yotqizish sharoitlari va yong'in xavfsizligi talablari bilan belgilanadi. Qo'riqlash signalizatsiyasi tizimlari uchun КСПВ va КСВППЭТросс turidagi signal kabellari mos keladi, strukturalashtirilgan kabel tarmoqlari uchun — 5e kategoriyali buralgan juftlik, uskunani quvvatlash uchun — kerakli kesimdagi ПВС va ПУГНП simlar. FRLS va нг(А) markali olovga chidamli kabellar evakuatsiya yo'llarida va kabel liniyasi yong'inda ishlashini saqlashi kerak bo'lgan joylarda majburiy. Toshkentda kerakli tur va kesimdagi kabelni obyektga yetkazib berish bilan sotib olish imkonini bizning doimiy assortimentga ega katalogimiz beradi.

Past kuchlanishli tizimlarni professional o'rnatish kabel trassasini aniq hisoblashsiz mumkin emas. SAT Solutions tajribali muhandislari kabel turi va markasini loyiha yechimi, muhit sharoitlari va me'yoriy talablardan kelib chiqib tanlaydi. Bunday yondashuv qayta ishlashlarni istisno qiladi va tizimning butun ekspluatatsiya muddati davomida uzoq umr ko'rishini kafolatlaydi.

## Qanday tanlash kerak

- Tizim turi: qo'riqlash va yong'in signalizatsiyasi uchun signal kabellari ishlatiladi (КСПВ, КСВВЭнг, КПСнг-FRLS), videokuzatuv uchun — koaksial kabel yoki buralgan juftlik, lokal tarmoqlar uchun — 5e va undan yuqori kategoriyali buralgan juftlik, elektr ta'minoti uchun — ПВС yoki ПУГНП kuchli simlar.
- Tomir kesimi: uzun trassalarda ruxsat etilgan tok va kuchlanish pasayishini belgilaydi. Signal zanjirlari uchun odatda 0,4–0,8 mm yetarli, 12/24 V quvvat uchun — 0,75 mm² dan, 220 V kuchli liniyalar uchun — 1,5 dan 2,5 mm² va undan ortiq.
- Tomirlar soni: ulanish sxemasiga bog'liq. Ikki tomirli kabellar oddiy shleyflar uchun ishlatiladi, to'rt tomirli va ko'p tomirlilar — RS-485 interfeyslari, manzilli tizimlar, quvvat va signalni birgalikda yotqizish uchun.
- Ekranlash: ekranlangan kabellar (ФТП, markalashda Э) elektromagnit xalaqitlardan himoya qiladi — ishlab chiqarish obyektlarida va kuchli liniyalar yonida muhim.
- Yong'in xavfsizligi klassi: evakuatsiya yo'llarida va ПУЭ talablariga ega zonalarda нг(А), FRLS indekslariga ega yoki ularning kombinatsiyasidagi kabellar zarur — ular yonishni tarqatmaydi va minimal tutun ajratadi.
- Yotqizish sharoitlari: tashqi yotqizish va grunt uchun tros yoki bron bilan kabellar kerak (КСВППЭТросс), ichki uchun — standart ijrolar.
- Trassa uzunligi: uzun liniyalarda kuchlanish pasayishi kritik — kesimni to'g'ri hisoblash olis qurilmalar quvvatidagi uzilishlardan qochish imkonini beradi.

## Qo'llanilish sohalari

- Turar-joy va tijorat obyektlari: kvartiralar, ofis markazlari, savdo majmualari — qo'riqlash signalizatsiyasi, domofonlar, videokuzatuv va lokal tarmoqlarni o'rnatish.
- Sanoat korxonalari va omborlar: kirishni nazorat qilish tizimlari, yong'in avtomatikasi, perimetr bo'ylab va ishlab chiqarish zonalari ichida IP-videokuzatuv.
- Ta'lim va sog'liqni saqlash obyektlari: maktablar, universitetlar, kasalxonalar — kabel liniyalari yong'in xavfsizligiga talablar ayniqsa qat'iy bo'lgan joylar.
- Mehmonxonalar va otellar: xavfsizlik tizimlari, telefoniya, IPTV va xonalar bo'yicha kirishni boshqarish uchun kabel infratuzilmasi.
- Davlat va maxsus rejimli obyektlar: ma'muriy binolar, banklar, KPP — kabel trassalari ishonchliligi va olovga chidamliligiga oshirilgan talablar bilan.
- Tashqi inshootlar va perimetr: ochiq hududlar, panjaralar, avtoturargohlarda videokuzatuv — tros ijrosidagi kabellarni qo'llash bilan.

## Katalogdagi brendlar va modellar

- Assortimentda «Boshqa uskunalar» umumiy guruhi ostida mahalliy va rossiya ishlab chiqarishidagi kabellar taqdim etilgan — ГОСТ ga mos keladigan va butun O'zbekiston bo'ylab real loyihalarda qo'llaniladigan sinalgan markalar.
- КСПВ 2х0,4 va КСВППЭТросс 4х2х0,52 signal kabellari — qo'riqlash signalizatsiyasi, harakat datchiklari va perimetr himoyasini ochiq uchastkalarda trosda yotqizish bilan o'rnatish uchun.
- КСВВЭнг 4х0,8 aloqa kabellari va ФТП hamda ЮТП ijrodagi КСВППЭ 4х2х0,52 buralgan juftligi — strukturalashtirilgan kabel tarmoqlari, IP-videokuzatuv va binolar ichida ma'lumot uzatish uchun.
- КПСнг(А)-FRLS 1х2х0,5 olovga chidamli kabeli — yong'in me'yorlari talablariga muvofiq evakuatsiya yo'llari bo'ylab yotqiziladigan manzilli yong'in tizimlari va shleyflar uchun.
- ПВС 2х0,75, ПВС 3х2,5 va ПУГНП 2х2,5 elektr simlari — obyektlarda uskuna, rozetka guruhlari va taqsimlash qutilariga quvvat ulash uchun.

## FAQ

Q: ФТП kabeli ЮТП dan nimasi bilan farq qiladi?
A: ФТП — bu tashqi elektromagnit xalaqitlardan himoya qiluvchi umumiy folgalangan ekranli buralgan juftlik. ЮТП — ekranlanmagan buralgan juftlik, xalaqitlar minimal bo'lgan joyda ishlatiladi. Sanoat obyektlari va kuchli uskunali zonalar uchun ФТП tavsiya etiladi.

Q: Yong'in signalizatsiyasi uchun qanday kabel kerak?
A: Evakuatsiya yo'llaridagi yong'in signalizatsiyasi uchun нг(А)-FRLS indeksli kabellar qo'llaniladi — ular tutamda yonishni tarqatmaydi va cheklangan miqdorda tutun ajratadi. Bu talab yong'in xavfsizligi me'yorlarida bevosita ko'rsatilgan.

Q: Buralgan juftlikni analog videokuzatuv uchun ishlatish mumkinmi?
A: Ha, passiv yoki faol qabul qiluvchi-uzatuvchilarni (balun) qo'llash bilan buralgan juftlik analog video signalni 300–500 m gacha masofalarga uzatish uchun ishlatiladi. IP-videokuzatuv uchun 5e kategoriyali buralgan juftlik standart hisoblanadi.

Q: Kameralarni quvvatlash uchun qanday kabel kesimi kerakligini qanday hisoblash mumkin?
A: Kesim yuklamaning umumiy toki va trassa uzunligidan kelib chiqib tanlanadi, toki kuchlanish pasayishi ruxsat etilganidan oshmasin. Muhandislarimiz loyiha yoki tijorat taklifini tayyorlashda hisob-kitobni bepul bajaradi.

Q: Kabelni O'zbekiston mintaqalariga yetkazib berasizmi?
A: Ha, SAT Solutions O'zbekistonning istalgan nuqtasidagi obyektlarga yetkazib berishni tashkil qiladi. Yetkazib berish muddatlari va shartlari buyurtmani rasmiylashtirishda kelishiladi.
prochee-cable.en:
Cables for security systems and low-current networks are the foundation of any engineering infrastructure. Without a properly chosen cable, neither a surveillance camera, nor a fire detector, nor an access control system will work stably. The SAT Solutions catalog offers cables of various types and cross-sections: signal, twisted pair, fire-resistant, electrical — everything needed for installing low-current and power lines at sites of any scale in Tashkent and throughout Uzbekistan.

The choice of cable is determined by the type of system, the route length, the installation conditions, and fire safety requirements. For security alarm systems, signal cables of the KSPV and KSVPPETross types are suitable, for structured cabling networks — category 5e twisted pair, for equipment power — PVS and PUGNP wires of the required cross-section. Fire-resistant cables of the FRLS and ng(A) grades are mandatory on evacuation routes and in places where the cable line must remain functional during a fire. Our catalog with a constant range in stock allows you to buy cable of the required type and cross-section in Tashkent with delivery to the site.

Professional installation of low-current systems is impossible without an accurate calculation of the cable route. Experienced SAT Solutions engineers select the type and grade of cable based on the design solution, environmental conditions, and regulatory requirements. This approach eliminates rework and guarantees the durability of the system throughout its entire service life.

## How to choose

- System type: for security and fire alarms, signal cables are used (KSPV, KSVVEng, KPSng-FRLS), for surveillance — coaxial cable or twisted pair, for local networks — category 5e twisted pair and higher, for power supply — PVS or PUGNP power wires.
- Conductor cross-section: determines the permissible current and voltage drop on long routes. For signal circuits, 0.4–0.8 mm is usually sufficient, for 12/24 V power — from 0.75 mm², for 220 V power lines — from 1.5 to 2.5 mm² and more.
- Number of conductors: depends on the connection scheme. Two-conductor cables are used for simple loops, four-conductor and multi-conductor ones — for RS-485 interfaces, addressable systems, and combined routing of power and signal.
- Shielding: shielded cables (FTP, E in the marking) protect against electromagnetic interference — important at industrial sites and near power lines.
- Fire safety class: on evacuation routes and in zones with PUE requirements, cables with the ng(A), FRLS indices, or a combination of them are needed — they do not spread flame and emit minimal smoke.
- Installation conditions: for outdoor installation and in soil, cables with a support wire or armor are needed (KSVPPETross), for indoor use — standard designs.
- Route length: on long lines, voltage drop is critical — a correct cross-section calculation avoids power failures of remote devices.

## Applications

- Residential and commercial sites: apartments, office centers, shopping complexes — installation of security alarms, intercoms, video surveillance, and local networks.
- Industrial enterprises and warehouses: access control systems, fire automation, IP video surveillance along the perimeter and inside production zones.
- Educational and healthcare facilities: schools, universities, hospitals — where the fire-safety requirements for cable lines are especially strict.
- Hotels: cabling infrastructure for security, telephony, IPTV, and room-based access management systems.
- Government and restricted-access sites: administrative buildings, banks, checkpoints — with heightened requirements for the reliability and fire resistance of cable routes.
- Outdoor installations and perimeter: video surveillance in open areas, fences, parking lots — using support-wire cables.

## Brands and models in the catalog

- The range includes cables of domestic and Russian manufacture under the general "Other equipment" group — proven grades compliant with GOST and used in real projects throughout Uzbekistan.
- Signal cables KSPV 2x0.4 and KSVPPETross 4x2x0.52 — for installing security alarms, motion sensors, and perimeter protection with support-wire routing in open areas.
- Communication cables KSVVEng 4x0.8 and twisted pair KSVPPE 4x2x0.52 in FTP and UTP designs — for structured cabling networks, IP video surveillance, and data transmission inside buildings.
- Fire-resistant cable KPSng(A)-FRLS 1x2x0.5 — for addressable fire systems and loops laid along evacuation routes in accordance with fire code requirements.
- Electrical wires PVS 2x0.75, PVS 3x2.5, and PUGNP 2x2.5 — for connecting power to equipment, socket groups, and distribution boxes at sites.

## FAQ

Q: How does FTP cable differ from UTP?
A: FTP is twisted pair with a common foil shield protecting against external electromagnetic interference. UTP is unshielded twisted pair, used where interference is minimal. For industrial sites and zones with power equipment, FTP is recommended.

Q: What cable is needed for fire alarms?
A: For fire alarms on evacuation routes, cables with the ng(A)-FRLS index are used — they do not spread flame in a bundle and emit a limited amount of smoke. This requirement is explicitly stated in fire safety codes.

Q: Can twisted pair be used for analog video surveillance?
A: Yes, with the use of passive or active transceivers (baluns), twisted pair is used to transmit an analog video signal over distances of up to 300–500 m. For IP video surveillance, category 5e twisted pair is the standard.

Q: How do I calculate what cable cross-section is needed to power cameras?
A: The cross-section is chosen based on the total load current and the route length, so that the voltage drop does not exceed the permissible level. Our engineers perform the calculation free of charge when preparing a project or commercial proposal.

Q: Do you deliver cable to the regions of Uzbekistan?
A: Yes, SAT Solutions arranges delivery to sites anywhere in Uzbekistan. Delivery terms and conditions are agreed upon when placing the order.

Simsiz izvestchilar himoyalangan radiochastotalarda ishlaydi, xab bilan ikki tomonlama aloqani qo'llab-quvvatlaydi va aloqa uzilishi yoki bostirish urinishi haqida signal beradi. Tizim masshtablanadi: bitta DS-PWA96 xabiga 96 tagacha periferik qurilma ulanadi, radioretranslyatorlar esa katta obyektlarda qamrov zonasini kengaytirish imkonini beradi.

Aniq konfiguratsiyani tanlash obyekt maydoni, qo'riqlash zonalari soni, videokuzatuv va uy avtomatlashtirilishi bilan integratsiya talablariga bog'liq. Har bir turdagi datchiklar sonini to'g'ri hisoblash, zaxira quvvatni ta'minlash va xabardor qilish usulini belgilash muhim — Hik-Connect mobil ilovasi, SMS yoki qo'ng'iroq orqali. SAT Solutions mutaxassislari konsultatsiya bosqichida optimal to'plamni tanlashda yordam beradi.

## Qanday tanlash kerak

- Obyekt turi va masshtabi: kichik kvartira uchun xab va bir nechta datchikli asosiy to'plam yetarli; ofis, kottej yoki kichik ombor uchun ko'p sonli zonalar va olis xonalarni qoplash uchun retranslyatorlar bilan kengaytirilgan konfiguratsiya kerak bo'ladi.
- Xab sig'imi: DS-PWA96 modeli 96 tagacha qurilmani qo'llab-quvvatlaydi; loyihalashda joriy zonalar sonidan kamida 20% zaxira qoldiring — bu qo'riqlanadigan hududni kengaytirishda uskunani almashtirmasdan datchiklar qo'shish imkonini beradi.
- Izvestchilar to'plami: standart to'plam ochilish (magnitokontaktli), harakat (PIR yoki PIR+mikroto'lqin ikki texnologiyali), oyna sinishi va tutun datchiklarini o'z ichiga oladi. Suv quvurli yoki yerto'lali xonalar uchun toshqin datchiklarini qo'shish mantiqan to'g'ri.
- Yuqori sezuvchanlikdagi zonalar: uy hayvonlari bo'lgan xonalarda hayvonlarga immunitet funksiyasiga ega harakat izvestchilarini tanlang — masalan, faol IR detektorli DS-PDC10AM-EG2. Bu noto'g'ri trevogalar sonini kamaytiradi.
- Radioqamrov: o'rnatishdan oldin har bir o'rnatish nuqtasidagi signal darajasini tekshiring. Agar signal ruxsat etilganidan zaifroq bo'lsa, xab va chekka datchiklar orasiga DS-PR1-WB radioretranslyatori o'rnatiladi, u signalni shifrlashni yo'qotmasdan retranslyatsiya qiladi.
- Xabardor qilish va integratsiya: AX PRO Hik-Connect ilovasi orqali push-bildirishnomalarni, Hikvision IP-kameralari bilan integratsiyani (trevoga bo'yicha yozib olish), shuningdek CID protokoli bo'yicha markaziy monitoring pultiga ulanishni qo'llab-quvvatlaydi. Reaksiya guruhi chiqishi bilan qo'riqlash kerakligini oldindan aniqlab oling.
- Zaxira quvvat: xab o'rnatilgan akkumulyatorga ega, periferik qurilmalar almashtiriladigan batareykalarda ishlaydi. Tanlangan datchiklarning quvvat elementlari xizmat muddatini tekshiring — aksariyat AX PRO qurilmalarida u shtat so'rov chastotasida bir necha yilni tashkil qiladi.

## Qo'llanilish sohalari

- Turar-joy obyektlari: kvartiralar, xususiy uylar va kottejlar, u yerda pardozni kabellar uchun o'yish bilan buzish istalmagan. Tez o'rnatish va smartfondan boshqarish AX PRO ni xavfsizlikni mustaqil nazorat qilish uchun qulay yechim qiladi.
- Ofislar va biznes-markazlar: ishchi zonalar, server va muzokara xonalarini qo'riqlashni yoqish/o'chirish vaqti bo'yicha ajratish bilan qo'riqlash. Bir nechta bo'limlarni qo'llab-quvvatlash bir binodagi turli ijarachilar qo'riqlashini mustaqil boshqarish imkonini beradi.
- Savdo nuqtalari va kichik do'konlar: kapital ta'mirsiz tez joylashtirish, ish vaqtidan tashqari ruxsatsiz kirishdan himoya, egasining smartfoniga trevoga avtomatik yuborilishi bilan.
- Ombor va ishlab chiqarish xonalari: harakat datchiklari yordamida perimetrni nazorat qilish, kirish guruhlari va qimmatliklarni saqlash zonalarini qo'riqlash, trevoga bo'yicha yozib olish uchun videoregistratorlar bilan integratsiya.
- Vaqtinchalik joylashtirish obyektlari: qurilish maydonlari, vaqtinchalik ofislar, ko'rgazma pavilonlari — simsiz arxitektura tizimni uskunaga zarar yetkazmasdan demontaj qilish va ko'chirish imkonini beradi.
- Ta'lim va tibbiyot muassasalari: ish vaqtidan tashqari kirishdan himoya, uskunali kabinetlarni nazorat qilish, xodimlar uchun trevoga tugmalari.

## Katalogdagi brendlar va modellar

- Hikvision AX PRO — ushbu kategoriyada to'liq hajmda taqdim etilgan yagona savdo markasi. Liniya 96 zonalik DS-PWA96 xabini, simsiz datchiklar va periferik qurilmalarning butun spektrini o'z ichiga oladi.
- Harakat datchiklari: DS-PDC10AM-EG2 (standart PIR) va noto'g'ri ishga tushishlarning yo'qligiga yuqori talab qo'yiladigan xonalar uchun PIR+mikroto'lqin ikki texnologiyali DS-PDD12P-EG2.
- Magnitokontaktli datchiklar: eshik va oynalar uchun DS-PDMC-EG2, surma konstruksiyalar uchun DS-PDMCS-EG2 — har ikki variant ham radiokanal va xab bilan ikki tomonlama aloqaga ega.
- Maxsus izvestchilar: DS-PDBG8 — oyna sinishi izvestchisi; DS-PDSMK-S — tutun izvestchisi; DS-PDWL-E — toshqin datchigi. Barcha qurilmalar bir ekotizimdan va yagona Hik-Connect interfeysi orqali boshqariladi.
- Periferiya va aksessuarlar: DS-PS1-E sirenasi, DS-PDEBP1-EG2 trevoga tugmasi, DS-PR1-WB radioretranslyatori, izvestchilar uchun mahkamlash kronshteynlari — professional o'rnatish uchun zarur bo'lgan hamma narsa.

## FAQ

Q: AX PRO qo'riqlash signalizatsiyasi to'plami qancha turadi?
A: Narx datchiklar soni va tanlangan qurilmalarga bog'liq. Kvartira uchun asosiy to'plam (xab, 3-4 ochilish datchigi va 1-2 harakat datchigi) ofis yoki uy uchun kengaytirilgan konfiguratsiyadan ancha arzonga tushadi. SAT Solutions menejerlaridan hisob-kitob so'rang — biz byudjetingizga optimal tarkibni tanlaymiz.

Q: Professional o'rnatish kerakmi yoki mustaqil o'rnatish mumkinmi?
A: AX PRO tizimini mustaqil o'rnatish mumkin — datchiklar ikki tomonlama skotch yoki o'zi burg'ilaydigan vintlarga mahkamlanadi, sozlash mobil ilova orqali bajariladi. Shunga qaramay, professional o'rnatish tijorat obyektlari uchun tavsiya etiladi: u datchiklarni to'g'ri joylashtirishni, zonalarni to'g'ri sozlashni va ishlab chiqaruvchi kafolatini saqlashni kafolatlaydi.

Q: Simsiz datchiklarda batareykalar qancha ishlaydi?
A: Aksariyat AX PRO datchiklari standart so'rov chastotasida bir necha yil avtonom ishlashga mo'ljallangan. Tizim har bir qurilmaning zaryad darajasini nazorat qiladi va Hik-Connect ilovasi orqali almashtirish zarurati haqida oldindan xabar beradi.

Q: AX PRO Hikvision videokuzatuv kameralari bilan mos keladimi?
A: Ha, Hikvision IP-kameralari mavjud bo'lsa, tizim istalgan datchik ishga tushganda yozib olishni avtomatik ishga tushirishi yoki suratni yuborishi mumkin. Integratsiya Hik-Connect platformasi yoki lokal videoregistrator orqali sozlanadi — qo'shimcha shlyuz va dasturiy ta'minotsiz.

Q: Internet yoki elektr o'chirilganda tizim ishlaydimi?
A: AX PRO xabi o'rnatilgan zaxira quvvat akkumulyatori bilan jihozlangan, shuning uchun elektr tarmog'ining qisqa muddatli o'chishi tizim ishini buzmaydi. Internet o'chirilganda qo'riqlash lokal ishlashda davom etadi: datchiklar trevogani qayd qiladi, sirena ishga tushadi, bildirishnomalar esa aloqa tiklanganda yetkaziladi.
hik-axpro.en:
Hikvision AX PRO wireless alarm is a new-generation wireless security system from Hikvision, developed specifically for sites where cable routing is difficult or impractical. The system unites a central control panel, motion sensors, door and window opening sensors, smoke and water detectors, sirens, and panic buttons into a single radio-channel network with an encrypted communication protocol. You can buy AX PRO equipment in Tashkent and throughout Uzbekistan in the SAT Solutions catalog — we supply the full range of original devices and take on turnkey design and installation.

Unlike wired analogs, AX PRO does not require wall chasing and cable routing, which significantly reduces installation time and cost. Wireless detectors operate on protected radio frequencies, support two-way communication with the hub, and signal a loss of connection or a jamming attempt. The system scales: up to 96 peripheral devices connect to a single DS-PWA96 hub, and radio repeaters allow extending the coverage area at large sites.

The choice of a specific configuration depends on the site's area, the number of security zones, the requirements for integration with video surveillance and home automation. It is important to correctly calculate the number of sensors of each type, provide for backup power, and determine the notification method — via the Hik-Connect mobile app, SMS, or a call. SAT Solutions specialists will help select the optimal kit as early as the consultation stage.

## How to choose

- Type and scale of the site: for a small apartment, a basic kit with a hub and several sensors is sufficient; for an office, cottage, or small warehouse, an expanded configuration with a large number of zones and repeaters to cover remote rooms will be needed.
- Hub capacity: the DS-PWA96 model supports up to 96 devices; when designing, allow a margin of at least 20% over the current number of zones — this will allow adding sensors when expanding the protected area without replacing equipment.
- Set of detectors: a standard kit includes opening (magnetic contact), motion (PIR or dual-technology PIR+microwave), glass-break, and smoke detectors. For spaces with plumbing or for basements, it makes sense to add flood detectors.
- High-sensitivity zones: in spaces with pets, choose motion detectors with a pet-immunity function — for example, the DS-PDC10AM-EG2 with an active IR detector. This will reduce the number of false alarms.
- Radio coverage: before installation, check the signal level at each installation point. If the signal is weaker than permissible, a DS-PR1-WB radio repeater is installed between the hub and the outermost sensors, retransmitting the signal without loss of encryption.
- Notification and integration: AX PRO supports push notifications via the Hik-Connect app, integration with Hikvision IP cameras (recording on alarm), as well as connection to a central monitoring station via the CID protocol. Clarify in advance whether security with a response team dispatch is needed.
- Backup power: the hub has a built-in battery, peripheral devices run on replaceable batteries. Check the battery life of the chosen sensors — for most AX PRO devices it is several years at a standard polling frequency.

## Applications

- Residential sites: apartments, private houses, and cottages where it is undesirable to disturb the finish with cable chasing. Quick installation and smartphone control make AX PRO a convenient solution for self-monitoring of security.
- Offices and business centers: protection of work areas, server rooms, and meeting rooms with time-based arming/disarming segregation. Support for multiple partitions allows independent management of the security of different tenants in one building.
- Retail outlets and small shops: quick deployment without major renovation, protection against unauthorized entry during off-hours with automatic alarm dispatch to the owner's smartphone.
- Warehouse and industrial premises: perimeter control using motion sensors, protection of entrance groups and valuables storage zones, integration with video recorders for recording on alarm.
- Temporary-deployment sites: construction sites, temporary offices, exhibition pavilions — the wireless architecture allows dismantling and relocating the system without damaging the equipment.
- Educational institutions and medical facilities: protection against entry during off-hours, monitoring of rooms with equipment, panic buttons for staff.

## Brands and models in the catalog

- Hikvision AX PRO — the only trademark in this category, represented in full. The lineup includes the DS-PWA96 hub with a capacity of 96 zones, the full range of wireless sensors, and peripheral devices.
- Motion sensors: DS-PDC10AM-EG2 (standard PIR) and DS-PDD12P-EG2 with dual PIR+microwave technology for spaces with high requirements for the absence of false triggers.
- Magnetic contact sensors: DS-PDMC-EG2 for doors and windows, DS-PDMCS-EG2 for sliding structures — both variants with a radio channel and two-way communication with the hub.
- Specialized detectors: DS-PDBG8 — a glass-break detector; DS-PDSMK-S — a smoke detector; DS-PDWL-E — a flood sensor. All devices are from a single ecosystem and are managed through the unified Hik-Connect interface.
- Peripherals and accessories: DS-PS1-E siren, DS-PDEBP1-EG2 panic button, DS-PR1-WB radio repeater, mounting brackets for detectors — everything needed for professional installation.

## FAQ

Q: How much does an AX PRO security alarm kit cost?
A: The cost depends on the number of sensors and the chosen devices. A basic kit for an apartment (hub, 3-4 opening sensors, and 1-2 motion sensors) will cost significantly less than an expanded configuration for an office or house. Request a calculation from SAT Solutions managers — we will select the optimal composition for your budget.

Q: Is professional installation needed or can it be installed independently?
A: The AX PRO system can be installed independently — sensors are attached with double-sided tape or self-tapping screws, and configuration is done through the mobile app. Nevertheless, professional installation is recommended for commercial sites: it guarantees correct sensor placement, proper zone configuration, and preservation of the manufacturer's warranty.

Q: How long do the batteries in wireless sensors last?
A: Most AX PRO sensors are designed for several years of autonomous operation at a standard polling frequency. The system monitors the charge level of each device and notifies in advance of the need for replacement via the Hik-Connect app.

Q: Is AX PRO compatible with Hikvision surveillance cameras?
A: Yes, if Hikvision IP cameras are present, the system can automatically start recording or send a snapshot when any sensor is triggered. The integration is configured through the Hik-Connect platform or a local video recorder — without additional gateways and software.

Q: Does the system work when the internet or power is off?
A: The AX PRO hub is equipped with a built-in backup battery, so a short-term power outage does not disrupt the system's operation. When the internet is off, security continues to function locally: sensors register the alarm, the siren goes off, and notifications will be delivered when the connection is restored.

pxt-pon.uz:
PON-uskuna — bugungi kunda turar-joy majmualarida, biznes-markazlarda, sanoat obyektlari va aloqa operatorlarining telekommunikatsiya tarmoqlarida yuqori tezlikdagi keng polosali internetga kirishni tashkil qilish uchun ishlatiladigan zamonaviy passiv optik tarmoqlarning (Passive Optical Network) asosi. Klassik faol tarmoqlardan farqli o'laroq, PON-infratuzilma oraliq tugunlarda quvvatsiz passiv optik ajratgichlarda quriladi, bu ekspluatatsiya xarajatlarini kamaytiradi va ishonchlilikni oshiradi. Toshkentda PON-uskunani professional konsultatsiya va keyingi o'rnatish bilan sotib olish imkonini SAT Solutions kompaniyasi beradi.

PON-tarmoqning ishlash tamoyili «OLT — ONU» juftligida quriladi. OLT (Optical Line Terminal) — operatorning serverida yoki tugun shkafida o'rnatiladigan markaziy tugun. ONU (Optical Network Unit) — oxirgi foydalanuvchi tomonidagi abonent terminali. Ular orasiga passiv splitterli bir modali optik tolali kabel daraxti yotqiziladi. EPON va GPON texnologiyalari ma'lumot uzatish standartini belgilaydi: GPON pastga tushuvchi oqimda 2,5 Gbit/s gacha nazariy tezlikni ta'minlaydi va O'zbekiston operatorlari orasida ko'proq tarqalgan standart hisoblanadi. Uskunani tanlashda OLT va ONU ning standart bo'yicha mosligini, SFP-modullarning quvvat klassini va tarmoq masshtablanuvchanligiga bo'lgan talablarni hisobga olish muhim.

PON-uskunani to'g'ri tanlash obyektning tarmoq topologiyasini ham, abonent bazasi o'sishi istiqbollarini ham tushunishni talab qiladi. OLT portlari soni, splitterlar ajralish koeffitsienti, SFP-modullarning optik quvvat klassi — bularning barchasi bevosita qamrov zonasi, signal sifati va infratuzilma narxiga ta'sir qiladi. SAT Solutions aniq obyekt va byudjet uchun optimal konfiguratsiyani hisoblashda yordam beradi.

## Qanday tanlash kerak

- Tarmoq standarti: EPON yoki GPON. GPON katta tezlikni ta'minlaydi va aksariyat zamonaviy uskuna tomonidan qo'llab-quvvatlanadi. EPON allaqachon mavjud infratuzilma bilan integratsiyada dolzarb. OLT va ONU bir standart bo'yicha ishlashiga ishonch hosil qiling.
- OLT portlari soni. Kichik obyektlar uchun (turar-joy binosi, ofis binosi) 4 portli konsentrator yetarli. Minglab abonentli yirik loyihalar 8, 16 va undan ortiq GPON/EPON portli hamda gorizontal masshtablash imkoniyatiga ega OLT ni talab qiladi.
- SFP-modullarning optik quvvat klassi. C+, C++, C+++ va PX20+++ klassli modullar optik liniya byudjeti bo'yicha farq qiladi — klass qanchalik yuqori bo'lsa, masofa va ajralish koeffitsienti shunchalik katta. Tanlov trassa uzunligi va portdagi abonentlar soniga bog'liq.
- ONU funksionalligi. Abonent terminallari oddiy (1-2 Ethernet port) yoki ko'p funksiyali bo'lishi mumkin — Wi-Fi 5G, bir nechta GE-portlar, VoIP ni qo'llab-quvvatlash bilan. Turar-joy sektori uchun o'rnatilgan Wi-Fi routerli ONU afzalroq.
- Moslik va boshqariluvchanlik. OLT OAM/OMCI orqali markazlashtirilgan boshqaruvni qo'llab-quvvatlashiga, shuningdek aralash infratuzilma rejalashtirilgan bo'lsa, boshqa ishlab chiqaruvchilarning ONU si bilan mosligiga ishonch hosil qiling.
- Quvvatni zaxiralash. Kritik muhim obyektlar uchun OLT zaxira quvvat bloklariga (ikki AC yoki DC) ega bo'lishi kerak. Bu bir manba ishdan chiqqanda ishning uzluksizligini ta'minlaydi.
- Masshtablanuvchanlik. Shassini almashtirmasdan portlarni oshirishga imkon beradigan platformani tanlang — bu tarmoqni kengaytirishda xarajatlarni kamaytiradi.

## Qo'llanilish sohalari

- Turar-joy ko'p xonadonli uylar va turar-joy majmualari: har bir kvartiraga yagona optik magistral bilan kvartiralarni internet va IPTV ga ulash uchun FTTH (Fiber To The Home) tarmog'ini tashkil qilish.
- Biznes-markazlar va ofis binolari: ijarachilarga markazlashtirilgan boshqaruv va polosani moslashuvchan ajratish bilan yuqori tezlikdagi korporativ internet taqdim etish.
- O'zbekiston aloqa operatorlari va internet-provayderlari: ixcham faol uskunada ko'p sonli ulanishlar bilan magistral va abonent kirish tarmoqlarini qurish.
- Mehmonxonalar, otellar va apart-majmualar: qavat tugunlaridagi uskunaga minimal ekspluatatsiya xarajatlari bilan ishonchli mehmon Wi-Fi va ichki tarmoqni tashkil qilish.
- Sanoat korxonalari va texnoparklar: korpuslar va bo'linmalarni yuqori o'tkazuvchanlik qobiliyati va xalaqitga bardoshlilikka ega yagona optik tarmoqqa birlashtirish.
- Aqlli shaharlar va infratuzilma obyektlari: videokuzatuv, kirishni nazorat qilish va IoT-datchiklar tizimlarini markazlashtirilgan boshqaruvga ega yagona optik magistral orqali ulash.

## Katalogdagi brendlar va modellar

- Pixietech — SAT Solutions katalogining ushbu kategoriyasidagi asosiy brend. Liniya ham 4 va 8 portli EPON va GPON konfiguratsiyalaridagi V1600 seriyali OLT-konsentratorlarni, ham turli klassdagi ONU abonent terminallarini qamrab oladi — bazaviy bir portlilardan tortib Wi-Fi 5G va ikkita GE-portli ko'p funksiyalilargacha.
- Pixietech V1600 seriyali OLT-konsentratorlari: V1600D4 (4 EPON port), V1600D8 (8 EPON port) va V1600G0 (4 GPON port) modellari kichik turar-joy binolaridan tortib o'rta ko'p xonadonli majmualargacha bo'lgan obyektlar uchun mos.
- OLT uchun Pixietech SFP-modullari: aniq tarmoq topologiyasi uchun optik liniya byudjetini moslashuvchan sozlash uchun turli quvvat klasslaridagi modullar taqdim etilgan — C++, C+++, C++++ va PX20+++.
- Katalogdagi ONU-terminallar XPON standartini (EPON va GPON da universal ishlash) qo'llab-quvvatlaydigan, o'rnatilgan Wi-Fi 5G va bir nechta GE-portli modellarni qamrab oladi — turar-joy va tijorat sektorida oxirgi abonentlarni ulash uchun optimal tanlov.
- C-DATA uskunasi (jumladan SFP-modullar to'plamidagi 8 GPON portli OLT FD1608S-B2) yuqori abonent zichligiga ega operator tarmoqlari uchun tayyor yechimlarni taklif qiladi.

## FAQ

Q: EPON va GPON o'rtasidagi farq nima va yangi obyekt uchun nimani tanlash kerak?
A: EPON IEEE 802.3ah standarti bo'yicha 1 Gbit/s gacha tezlikda ishlaydi, GPON — ITU-T G.984 bo'yicha pastga tushuvchi oqimda 2,5 Gbit/s gacha tezlikda. Yangi loyihalar uchun GPON unumdorroq va istiqbolli standart sifatida tavsiya etiladi. EPON allaqachon joylashtirilgan infratuzilma bilan integratsiya zarurati bo'lganda oqlanadi.

Q: Bitta OLT portiga nechta abonent ulash mumkin?
A: Standart bo'yicha bitta GPON/EPON port splitter ajralish koeffitsienti va SFP-modul klassiga qarab 32 yoki 64 tagacha abonentga xizmat ko'rsatadi. Hisoblashda har bir ONU da yetarli signal darajasini ta'minlash uchun real yuklama va optik liniya byudjetini hisobga olish kerak.

Q: Bir ishlab chiqaruvchining ONU sini boshqasining OLT si bilan ishlatish mumkinmi?
A: Moslik OMCI protokoli amalga oshirilishi va aniq modellarga bog'liq. Kafolatlangan moslik bir vendorning OLT va ONU sidan foydalanganda ta'minlanadi. Aralash konfiguratsiyalar uchun oldindan sinash yoki hujjatlashtirilgan o'zaro ishlash imkoniyatiga ega uskunani tanlash tavsiya etiladi.

Q: O'z tarmog'im uchun kerakli SFP-modul klassini qanday aniqlash mumkin?
A: Modul klassi optik liniya byudjetidan kelib chiqib tanlanadi: trassa uzunligi, splitterlar va ulagichlardagi umumiy yo'qotishlar. SAT Solutions mutaxassislari optik byudjet hisob-kitobini bajaradi va tarmog'ingiz parametrlariga kerakli klassdagi modulni tanlaydi — C++ dan PX20+++ gacha.

Q: PON-uskunaga qanday kafolat shartlari?
A: SAT Solutions yetkazib beradigan barcha uskunaga ishlab chiqaruvchining rasmiy kafolati amal qiladi. Kafolat muddati aniq pozitsiyalar bo'yicha aniqlanadi. Kompaniya shuningdek kafolatdan keyingi xizmat ko'rsatish va ishdan chiqqan komponentlarni Toshkentdagi o'z servis markazi orqali operativ almashtirishni taklif qiladi.
pxt-pon.en:
PON equipment is the foundation of modern passive optical networks (Passive Optical Network), which today are used to organize high-speed broadband internet access in residential complexes, business centers, industrial sites, and telecommunication networks of communication operators. Unlike classic active networks, PON infrastructure is built on passive optical splitters without power at intermediate nodes, which reduces operating costs and increases reliability. The SAT Solutions company allows you to buy PON equipment in Tashkent with professional consultation and subsequent installation.

The operating principle of a PON network is built on the "OLT — ONU" pair. The OLT (Optical Line Terminal) is the central node, installed in the server room or the operator's node cabinet. The ONU (Optical Network Unit) is the subscriber terminal on the end-user side. Between them, a single-mode fiber-optic cable tree with passive splitters is laid. The EPON and GPON technologies define the data transmission standard: GPON provides a theoretical downstream speed of up to 2.5 Gbit/s and is the more common standard among Uzbekistan's operators. When choosing equipment, it is important to consider the compatibility of the OLT and ONU by standard, the power class of the SFP modules, and the network scalability requirements.

Proper selection of PON equipment requires an understanding of both the site's network topology and the prospects for growth of the subscriber base. The number of OLT ports, the splitter branching ratio, the optical power class of the SFP modules — all this directly affects the coverage area, signal quality, and infrastructure cost. SAT Solutions helps calculate the optimal configuration for a specific site and budget.

## How to choose

- Network standard: EPON or GPON. GPON provides higher speed and is supported by most modern equipment. EPON is relevant when integrating with an already existing infrastructure. Make sure the OLT and ONU operate by the same standard.
- Number of OLT ports. For small sites (a residential building, an office building), a 4-port concentrator is sufficient. Large projects with thousands of subscribers require an OLT with 8, 16, or more GPON/EPON ports and the ability to scale horizontally.
- Optical power class of the SFP modules. Modules of the C+, C++, C+++, and PX20+++ classes differ in the optical-link budget — the higher the class, the greater the distance and branching ratio. The choice depends on the route length and the number of subscribers per port.
- ONU functionality. Subscriber terminals can be simple (1-2 Ethernet ports) or multifunctional — with Wi-Fi 5G, several GE ports, VoIP support. For the residential sector, ONUs with a built-in Wi-Fi router are preferable.
- Compatibility and manageability. Make sure the OLT supports centralized management via OAM/OMCI, as well as being compatible with ONUs from other manufacturers if a mixed infrastructure is planned.
- Power redundancy. For critically important sites, the OLT should have redundant power supplies (dual AC or DC). This ensures continuity of operation in the event of a single-source failure.
- Scalability. Choose a platform that allows increasing the number of ports without replacing the chassis — this reduces costs when expanding the network.

## Applications

- Residential apartment buildings and residential complexes: organizing an FTTH (Fiber To The Home) network to connect apartments to the internet and IPTV with a single optical trunk to each apartment.
- Business centers and office buildings: providing high-speed corporate internet to tenants with centralized management and flexible bandwidth allocation.
- Communication operators and internet providers of Uzbekistan: building backbone and subscriber access networks with a large number of connections on compact active equipment.
- Hotels and apart-complexes: organizing reliable guest Wi-Fi and an internal network with minimal operating costs for equipment in floor nodes.
- Industrial enterprises and technology parks: uniting buildings and departments into a single optical network with high throughput and noise immunity.
- Smart cities and infrastructure sites: connecting video surveillance, access control, and IoT sensor systems through a single optical backbone with centralized management.

## Brands and models in the catalog

- Pixietech — the primary brand in this catalog category at SAT Solutions. The lineup covers both V1600-series OLT concentrators in EPON and GPON configurations with 4 and 8 ports, and ONU subscriber terminals of various classes — from basic single-port to multifunctional ones with Wi-Fi 5G and two GE ports.
- Pixietech V1600-series OLT concentrators: models V1600D4 (4 EPON ports), V1600D8 (8 EPON ports), and V1600G0 (4 GPON ports) suit sites from small residential buildings to medium apartment complexes.
- Pixietech SFP modules for OLT: modules of various power classes are available — C++, C+++, C++++, and PX20+++ — for flexible configuration of the optical-link budget for a specific network topology.
- The ONU terminals in the catalog cover models with XPON standard support (universal operation in EPON and GPON), built-in Wi-Fi 5G, and several GE ports — the optimal choice for connecting end subscribers in the residential and commercial sector.
- C-DATA equipment (including the OLT FD1608S-B2 with 8 GPON ports bundled with SFP modules) offers ready-made solutions for operator networks with a high density of subscribers.

## FAQ

Q: What is the difference between EPON and GPON and which to choose for a new site?
A: EPON operates by the IEEE 802.3ah standard at speeds up to 1 Gbit/s, GPON — by ITU-T G.984 at speeds up to 2.5 Gbit/s downstream. For new projects, GPON is recommended as the more productive and forward-looking standard. EPON is justified when integration with an already deployed infrastructure is needed.

Q: How many subscribers can be connected to a single OLT port?
A: Standardly, one GPON/EPON port serves up to 32 or 64 subscribers depending on the splitter branching ratio and the SFP module class. When calculating, it is necessary to take into account the actual load and the optical-link budget to ensure a sufficient signal level at each ONU.

Q: Can an ONU from one manufacturer be used with an OLT from another?
A: Compatibility depends on the OMCI protocol implementation and the specific models. Guaranteed compatibility is ensured when using an OLT and ONU from the same vendor. For mixed configurations, preliminary testing or the choice of equipment with documented interoperability is recommended.

Q: How do I determine the required SFP module class for my network?
A: The module class is chosen based on the optical-link budget: the total losses over the route length, in the splitters, and in the connectors. SAT Solutions specialists will calculate the optical budget and select a module of the required class — from C++ to PX20+++ — for your network's parameters.

Q: What are the warranty terms on PON equipment?
A: All equipment supplied by SAT Solutions is covered by the official manufacturer's warranty. The warranty period is clarified for specific items. The company also offers post-warranty service and prompt replacement of failed components through its own service center in Tashkent.
