Ishonchsiz elektromagnit qulf normativ yukni ko'tara olmaydi va xavfsizlikka tahdidga aylanadi. Yomon tanlangan UTM elektr uzilishi paytida uskunani ta'minotsiz qoldiradi. Shuning uchun O'zbekistonda aksessuarlar tanlashga kameralar yoki kontrollerlar tanlashi kabi mas'uliyat bilan yondashish kerak.

SAT Solutions katalogida ushbu toifada 300 dan ortiq pozitsiya taqdim etilgan — oddiy plastik xomutlar va kabel klipsalaridan tortib 6 va 12 unit hajmli FINEN server shkaflari, 10 A zaryad tokiga ega UTM, metall chiqish tugmalari va 280 kg ushlab turish kuchiga ega elektromagnit qulflargacha. Bunday assortiment har qanday masshtabdagi obyektlarni — kichik ofisdan tortib yirik logistika markazigacha komplektlash imkonini beradi.

## Qanday tanlash kerak

- Kronshteyn turi va yuki. Shift va devor kameralari uchun tegishli og'irlik ruxsati va chiqishga ega kronshteynlar kerak. Ko'cha modellari korroziyaga qarshi materiallardan tayyorlangan va shamol yukini ko'tara oladigan bo'lishi kerak.

- Elektromagnit qulfning ushlab turish kuchi. Turar-joy eshiklari uchun 180–280 kg yetarli. Ishlab chiqarish obyektlaridagi evakuatsiya va kirish guruhlari uchun 500 kg va undan yuqori qulflar kerak. Shovqinsiz modellar ofislar va mehmonxonalar uchun afzalroq.

- Server shkafining sig'imi va form-faktori. Unitlar soni o'rnatiladigan qurilmalar soni bilan belgilanadi. Shkaf chuqurligi (450 yoki 600 mm) faol uskunaning — kommutatorlar, NVR, patch-panellarning o'lchamiga moslashtiriladi.

- UTM quvvati va avtonomligi. Uzluksiz ta'minot manbai tarmoq uzilganda ulangan uskuna ishlashini kamida 30–60 daqiqa ta'minlashi kerak. Zaryad toki va akkumulyator sig'imi umumiy yukka moslashtiriladi.

- Kabel o'tkazish turi. Kabellarni bejirim tortish uchun kabel diametri bo'yicha klipsalar va xomutlarni tanlang. Plastik xomutlar ichki ishlar uchun mos; ko'cha va agressiv muhitlar uchun zanglamaydigan yoki issiqlikka chidamli variantlar kerak.

- Chiqish tugmasining KKBT kontrolleri bilan mosligi. EXIT tugmalari kontakt turi (normal ochiq/normal yopiq), montaj usuli (ustma-ust, o'rnatiladigan, S86 standartida) va korpus materiali bo'yicha farqlanadi. Sizning kirishni nazorat qilish tizimingiz bilan mosligiga ishonch hosil qiling.

- 4G-zaxiralash mavjudligi. Agar asosiy aloqa kanali beqaror bo'lsa, 4G-modem (masalan, CPE-seriyasi) videokuzatuvni masofaviy monitoring qilish va tizimlarni boshqarish uchun zaxira kanalni ta'minlaydi.

## Qo'llanilish sohalari

- Ofis va ma'muriy binolar. Kameralar uchun kronshteynlar, NVR va kommutatorlarni joylashtirish uchun server shkaflari, kirish guruhlaridagi elektromagnit qulflar, muzokara xonalari va koridorlardagi chiqish tugmalari.

- Savdo obyektlari. Chakana do'konlar va savdo markazlari kupolli kameralar uchun shift kronshteynlaridan, uskunani himoya qilish uchun ixcham UTM lardan va yashirin yo'l tortish uchun kabel menejmentidan foydalanadi.

- Sanoat korxonalari va omborlar. Bu yerda kuchaytirilgan ko'cha kronshteynlari, darvozalar va sanoat eshiklari uchun kuchli elektromagnit qulflar, katta sig'imli server shkaflari va kengaytirilgan avtonom ish vaqtiga ega UTM talab qilinadi.

- Turar-joy majmualari va ko'p kvartirali uylar. Podyezd eshiklaridagi chiqish tugmalari va elektromagnit qulflar, fasadlardagi kameralar uchun kronshteynlar, texnik xonalarda kabel xo'jaligini tashkil etish uchun klipsalar va xomutlar.

- Banklar, davlat muassasalari va xavfsizlikka yuqori talablarga ega obyektlar. Kuchaytirilgan ushlab turish kuchiga ega sertifikatlangan qulflar, zaxiralangan ta'minot, yopiq lotoklar va shkaflarda bejirim kabel o'tkazish.

- Uzoq maydonlardagi obyektlar. Barqaror simli internet bo'lmagan joylarda 4G-modem-routerlar videokuzatuv tizimi bilan aloqani va uskunaga masofaviy kirishni ta'minlaydi.

## Katalogdagi brendlar va modellar

- FINEN. Katalogda ushbu ishlab chiqaruvchining 600x600 va 600x450 mm o'lchamli 6U va 12U form-faktorlaridagi server shkaflari taqdim etilgan. Shkaflar faol tarmoq uskunasi, NVR va kommutatorlarni server xonalari va texnik nishalarda montaj qilish uchun ishlatiladi.

- Brendsiz elektromagnit qulflar (OEM-yetkazib berishlar). Montaj burchagiga ega 280 kg ushlab turish kuchiga ega qulflar — ofislar, turar-joy majmualari va ishlab chiqarish obyektlarida kirishni nazorat qilish uchun standart yechim. Shovqinsiz modellar vakolatxona zonalari uchun mos.

- EXIT seriyasidagi chiqish tugmalari. Katalogda S86 standartidagi katta o'lchamli ustma-ust metall tugmalar ham, ixcham EXIT-PM9D modellari ham mavjud. Ularning barchasi standart KKBT tizimlariga integratsiyalashadi va qo'riqlashni yechmasdan qo'riqlanadigan zonadan to'g'ri chiqishni ta'minlaydi.

- 4G-CPE (903 seriyasi). Obyektlarda zaxira yoki asosiy aloqa kanalini tashkil etish uchun modem-routerlar. O'zbekiston hududlaridagi uzoq videokuzatuv nuqtalari va beqaror simli internetli obyektlar uchun dolzarb.

- Kabel mahkamlagichlari va xomutlar. Plastik xomutlar 5x300 va kabel klipsalari 16 mm — montajchilar uchun sarf materiallar bo'lib, kabel yo'llarini bejirim va uzoq muddatli tortishni ta'minlaydi.

## FAQ

Q: Faqat alohida aksessuarlarni — masalan, kronshteynlar yoki xomutlarni — montajsiz sotib olish mumkinmi?
A: Ha, SAT Solutions aksessuarlar va sarf materiallarni chakana va ulgurji sotadi. Siz katalogdan istalgan pozitsiyani montaj ishlarini buyurtma qilmasdan sotib olishingiz mumkin.

Q: Ofis eshigi uchun qaysi elektromagnit qulfni tanlash kerak?
A: Standart ichki yoki kirish ofis eshigi uchun 180–280 kg qulf yetarli. Agar eshik tashqariga ochilsa yoki kamdan-kam ishlatilsa, shovqinsiz modelni ko'rib chiqing — u ishga tushganda akustik noqulaylik yaratmaydi.

Q: Kuchlanish stabilizatori bo'lsa, videoregistrator uchun UTM kerakmi?
A: Stabilizator kuchlanish o'zgarishlaridan himoya qiladi, biroq elektr to'liq uzilganda ta'minot bermaydi. UTM tarmoq uzilganda, ayniqsa beqaror elektr ta'minotli obyektlarda, videoyozuvni saqlash va NVR ni to'g'ri yakunlash uchun zarur.

Q: FINEN server shkaflari ko'chada yoki isitilmaydigan xonada o'rnatish uchun mos keladimi?
A: Katalogdagi FINEN shkaflari normal iqlim sharoitiga ega xonalarda o'rnatish uchun mo'ljallangan. Ko'cha va isitilmaydigan zonalar uchun tegishli IP himoya darajasiga va ichida iqlim uskunasiga ega shkaflar kerak — vazifangizni menejerdan aniqlashtiring.

Q: O'zbekiston bo'ylab aksessuarlar qanchalik tez yetkazib beriladi?
A: Toshkentdagi omborda mavjud pozitsiyalar 1–2 ish kuni ichida jo'natiladi. Hududlarga yetkazib berish muddatlari buyurtma rasmiylashtirishda aniqlashtiriladi. Yirik partiyalar va nostandart pozitsiyalar buyurtma bo'yicha yetkazib berilishi mumkin.
prochee-accessories.en:
Brackets and accessories are a broad category of mounting and auxiliary equipment without which it is impossible to implement any security, video surveillance, access control or structured cabling system. This includes brackets for cameras and network recorders, electromagnetic locks, exit buttons, server cabinets, uninterruptible power supplies, cable clips, ties, 4G modems and dozens of other items. All of this is the infrastructure "backbone" on which the operation of the main equipment rests. You can buy brackets and accessories in Tashkent at a reasonable price and with a quality guarantee from the integrator SAT Solutions.

The choice of accessories seems a secondary task, but in practice the reliability of the entire system directly depends on the quality of the fasteners, power supply and switching. A cheap bracket under an outdoor camera develops play over time and shifts the field of view. An unreliable electromagnetic lock does not withstand the standard load and becomes a security threat. A poorly selected UPS leaves the equipment without power at the moment of a power outage. Therefore, the choice of accessories in Uzbekistan should be approached just as responsibly as the choice of cameras or controllers.

The SAT Solutions catalog presents more than 300 items in this category — from simple plastic ties and cable clips to FINEN server cabinets of 6 and 12 units, UPSs with a charge current of 10 A, metal exit buttons and electromagnetic locks with 280 kg of holding force. Such an assortment makes it possible to equip sites of any scale — from a small office to a large logistics center.

## How to choose

- Bracket type and load. Ceiling and wall cameras require brackets with the appropriate weight rating and reach. Outdoor models must be made of anti-corrosion materials and withstand wind loads.

- Holding force of the electromagnetic lock. For residential doors, 180-280 kg is sufficient. For evacuation and entrance groups at industrial sites, locks of 500 kg and higher are needed. Silent models are preferable for offices and hotels.

- Capacity and form factor of the server cabinet. The number of units is determined by the number of installed devices. The cabinet depth (450 or 600 mm) is selected to match the size of the active equipment — switches, NVRs, patch panels.

- UPS power and autonomy. The uninterruptible power supply must ensure the operation of connected equipment for at least 30-60 minutes during a power outage. The charge current and battery capacity are selected to match the total load.

- Cable routing type. For neat cable laying, choose clips and ties by cable diameter. Plastic ties are suitable for indoor work; for outdoors and aggressive environments, stainless or heat-resistant options are needed.

- Compatibility of the exit button with the ACS controller. EXIT buttons differ by contact type (normally open/normally closed), mounting method (surface-mounted, flush-mounted, in the S86 standard) and enclosure material. Make sure of compatibility with your access control system.

- Presence of 4G redundancy. If the main communication channel is unstable, a 4G modem (for example, the CPE series) will provide a backup channel for remote monitoring of video surveillance and system control.

## Applications

- Office and administrative buildings. Camera brackets, server cabinets for housing NVRs and switches, electromagnetic locks on entrance groups, exit buttons in meeting rooms and corridors.

- Retail facilities. Retail stores and shopping centers use ceiling brackets for dome cameras, compact UPSs to protect equipment and cable management for concealed run routing.

- Industrial enterprises and warehouses. Here, reinforced outdoor brackets, powerful electromagnetic locks for gates and industrial doors, high-capacity server cabinets and UPSs with extended autonomous operation time are in demand.

- Residential complexes and multi-apartment houses. Exit buttons and electromagnetic locks on entrance doors, brackets for cameras on facades, clips and ties for organizing cable management in technical rooms.

- Banks, government institutions and sites with high security requirements. Certified locks with elevated holding force, redundant power, neat cable routing in enclosed trays and cabinets.

- Sites at remote locations. Where there is no stable wired internet, 4G modem-routers provide communication with the video surveillance system and remote access to the equipment.

## Brands and models in the catalog

- FINEN. The catalog presents server cabinets from this manufacturer in the 6U and 12U form factors with dimensions of 600x600 and 600x450 mm. The cabinets are used for mounting active network equipment, NVRs and switches in server rooms and technical niches.

- Unbranded electromagnetic locks (OEM supplies). Locks with 280 kg of holding force and a mounting bracket — a standard solution for access control in offices, residential complexes and at industrial sites. Silent models are suitable for representative zones.

- EXIT series exit buttons. The catalog includes both large surface-mounted metal buttons in the S86 standard and compact EXIT-PM9D models. All of them integrate into standard ACS systems and ensure correct exit from a protected zone without disarming.

- 4G-CPE (903 series). Modem-routers for organizing a backup or main communication channel at sites. Relevant for remote video surveillance points and sites with unstable wired internet in the regions of Uzbekistan.

- Cable fasteners and ties. 5x300 plastic ties and 16 mm cable clips — consumables for installers, ensuring neat and durable laying of cable runs.

## FAQ

Q: Can I buy only individual accessories — for example, brackets or ties — without installation?
A: Yes, SAT Solutions sells accessories and consumables both retail and wholesale. You can purchase any item from the catalog without ordering installation work.

Q: Which electromagnetic lock should I choose for an office door?
A: For a standard interior or office entrance door, a lock of 180-280 kg is sufficient. If the door opens outward or is used rarely, consider a silent model — it does not create acoustic discomfort when triggered.

Q: Is a UPS needed for a video recorder if there is a voltage stabilizer?
A: A stabilizer protects against voltage fluctuations but does not provide power during a complete outage. A UPS is necessary to preserve the video recording and correctly shut down the NVR during a power outage, especially at sites with unstable power supply.

Q: Are FINEN server cabinets suitable for outdoor installation or in an unheated room?
A: The FINEN cabinets from the catalog are intended for installation in rooms with normal climatic conditions. For outdoors and unheated zones, cabinets with an appropriate IP protection rating and climate equipment inside are needed — clarify your task with a manager.

Q: How quickly are accessories delivered across Uzbekistan?
A: Items in stock at the Tashkent warehouse are shipped within 1-2 business days. For delivery to the regions, the timeframes are clarified when placing the order. Large batches and non-standard items may be supplied to order.

Aynan shu qurilmalar bostirib kirish, tutunlanish, harakat yoki vaziyat o'zgarishi faktini qayd etadi va nazorat paneliga signal uzatadi. Malakali tanlangan va to'g'ri o'rnatilgan izvergichlarsiz hatto eng zamonaviy qabul-nazorat asbobi ham foydasiz bo'lib qoladi. SAT Solutions katalogida har qanday masshtabdagi obyektlar — kichik ofisdan tortib sanoat korxonasigacha — uchun detektorlarning keng assortimenti taqdim etilgan. Qo'riqlash signalizatsiyasi detektorlari va datchiklarini Toshkentda ishlab chiqaruvchi kafolati va professional montaj bilan bevosita bizdan sotib olish mumkin.

To'g'ri izvergichni tanlash ko'p omillarga bog'liq: qo'riqlanadigan obyekt turi, uning rejalashtirilishi, iqlim sharoitlari, aniqlash zonalariga qo'yiladigan talablar va ma'lumotlarni uzatish usuli. 868 MGts chastotasidagi simsiz tizimlar bugungi kunda ayniqsa talabga ega: ular kabellarni tortishni talab qilmaydi, tez montaj qilinadi va oson masshtablanadi. Aynan shuning uchun ushbu toifadagi assortimentning katta qismi — yagona ekotizimda ishlaydigan va markaziy asbob bilan himoyalangan radiokanal orqali ma'lumot almashadigan simsiz qurilmalar. O'zbekistonda bunday yechimlar yangi qurilishlar uchun ham, kabel tortish texnik jihatdan qiyin yoki qimmatga tushadigan obyektlar uchun ham dolzarb.

Toifa nafaqat passiv infraqizil harakat datchiklarini (PIR), balki kombinatsiyalangan qurilmalarni, akustik izvergichlarni, ochilishni aniqlash datchiklarini, shuningdek unga hamroh uskunani ham qamrab oladi: sirenalar, qabul-nazorat asboblari va simsiz klaviaturalar. Bu bir ishlab chiqaruvchining komponentlarini tanlab va ularning o'zaro mosligini kafolatlab, yagona katalogdan to'liq qonli qo'riqlash tizimini komplektlash imkonini beradi.

## Qanday tanlash kerak

- Izvergich turi: passiv infraqizil (PIR) issiq obyektlarning harakatiga reaksiya beradi; mikroto'lqinli kanalga ega kombinatsiyalangan PIR yolg'on ishga tushishlar sonini kamaytiradi; akustik — oyna sinishi tovushiga; magnitokontaktli — eshik va derazalarning ochilishiga. Turni muayyan aniqlash zonasiga qarab tanlang.
- Simli yoki simsiz ijro: 868 MGts chastotasidagi simsiz datchiklar kabel infratuzilmasi bo'lmaganda va allaqachon pardozi bajarilgan obyektlarda qulay; simlilar barqarorroq aloqani ta'minlaydi va batareyalarga bog'liq emas.
- Aniqlash masofasi va burchagi: kichik xonalar uchun standart 90–110 gradus burchak va 12 metrgacha masofa yetarli; cho'zilgan zonalar va perimetr uchun koridor nasadkalari yoki «parda» tipidagi obyektivlar qo'llaniladi.
- Xalaqitlardan himoya darajasi: antisabotaj funksiyasi (tamper himoya), radioxalaqitlarga va uy hayvonlaridan yolg'on ishga tushishlarga chidamlilik — tijorat obyektlari uchun juda muhim parametrlar.
- Markaziy asbob bilan moslik: datchiklar va izvergichlar qabul-nazorat uskunasi bilan yagona tizimda ishlashi kerak. Bir ekotizim doirasida bir brend qurilmalaridan foydalanish integratsiya xavflarini minimallashtiradi.
- Ekspluatatsiya sharoitlari: ko'chada o'rnatish uchun IP54 va undan yuqori reytingga ega, shuningdek harorat o'zgarishlariga chidamli datchiklar kerak. Ichki qurilmalar himoya bo'yicha kamroq qattiq talablarga ega bo'lishi mumkin.
- Tizimda GSM yoki Wi-Fi moduli mavjudligi: bir qator zamonaviy to'plamlar alohida uskunasiz smartfonga bildirishnomalar va masofaviy monitoringni qo'llab-quvvatlaydi — bu kichik biznes va shaxsiy uy-joylar uchun qulay.

## Qo'llanilish sohalari

- Turar-joy uylari va kvartiralar: perimetrni himoya qilish, kirish guruhlarini qo'riqlash, devorlarni teshmasdan simsiz datchiklar yordamida asosiy zonalarda harakatni nazorat qilish.
- Ofislar va biznes-markazlar: xonalar bo'yicha qo'riqlashni zonalashtirish, qo'riqlashga qo'yish va yechish huquqlarini chegaralash, kirishni nazorat qilish tizimi bilan integratsiya.
- Savdo obyektlari (do'konlar, omborlar, supermarketlar): ishlamaydigan vaqtda ishonchli qo'riqlash, kassalar va qimmatliklarni saqlash zonalarini himoya qilish, katta ochiq maydonlarni monitoring qilish.
- Sanoat korxonalari va ishlab chiqarishlar: xalaqitlarga, changga va harorat o'zgarishlariga yuqori chidamlilikka ega datchiklar; perimetr va turli ish rejimlariga ega ichki zonalarni qo'riqlash.
- Ta'lim va sog'liqni saqlash obyektlari: maktablar, klinikalar, tibbiyot markazlari — tunda qo'riqlash, server va ma'muriy zonalarni himoya qilish, ruxsatsiz kirishda tez javob berish.
- Banklar va moliya muassasalari: bir necha tur izvergichlardan foydalangan holda maksimal himoya darajasi, aloqa kanallarini dublyaj qilish, markazlashtirilgan kuzatuv pulti bilan integratsiya.

## Katalogdagi brendlar va modellar

- Dahua: ushbu toifada taqdim etilgan yagona brend qo'riqlash signalizatsiyasining simsiz komponentlarining to'liq assortimentini ta'minlaydi. 868 MGts chastotasidagi qurilmalar seriyasi — bu yopiq, yaxshi integratsiyalashgan ekotizim: izvergichlar, qabul-nazorat asboblari, sirenalar va klaviaturalar yagona muhitda ishlaydi.
- DHI-ARD va DHI-HY seriyasidagi izvergichlar va datchiklar: simsiz PIR-izvergichlar, kombinatsiyalangan PIR-kameralar, tutunlanish datchiklari va kontaktli izvergichlar — barchasi Dahua markaziy panellari bilan birgalikda ishlashga mo'ljallangan.
- Dahua ARC va ARM seriyasidagi qabul-nazorat asboblari: ko'p sonli simsiz zonalarni qo'llab-quvvatlaydi, o'rnatilgan kommunikatorga ega va tizimni mobil ilova orqali boshqarish imkonini beradi. ARM7011, ARM7012 va ARC3800H modellari turli masshtabdagi obyektlarga yo'naltirilgan.
- Dahua ARA13 va ARA14 seriyasidagi simsiz sirenalar: ko'cha va ichki ijro, yuqori tovush quvvati, tamper himoya va o'rnatilgan akkumulyatordan uzoq muddatli ish resursi.
- Dahua DHI-ARD2251E-W2 simsiz PIR-kamerasi: qo'riqlash izvergichi va videokameraning funksiyalarini birlashtiradi, bu trevoganing vizual tasdig'ini olish va yolg'on chiqishlar sonini kamaytirish imkonini beradi.

## FAQ

Q: Toshkentda qo'riqlash signalizatsiyasi datchiklari qancha turadi?
A: Narx qurilma turiga, brendga va funksionallikka bog'liq. Dahua simsiz PIR-izvergichlari o'rta narx segmentiga tegishli bo'lib, ishonchlilikni arzon narx bilan uyg'unlashtiradi. Sizning obyektingiz uchun tizim narxini aniq hisoblash uchun mutaxassislarimizdan tijorat taklifini so'rang.

Q: Simsiz datchiklarni mustaqil ravishda o'rnatish mumkinmi?
A: Texnik jihatdan ba'zi qurilmalar mustaqil sozlashga ruxsat beradi, biroq professional montaj tizimning to'g'ri ishlashi, aniqlash zonalarini to'g'ri joylashtirish va obyektni qo'riqlashga yuridik ahamiyatga ega tarzda topshirish uchun majburiy. Mustaqil o'rnatish, shuningdek, kafolat yo'qotilishiga olib kelishi mumkin.

Q: Simsiz datchiklarda batareyalarni qanchalik tez-tez almashtirish kerak?
A: Zamonaviy Dahua simsiz izvergichlari energiya tejamkor modullar bilan jihozlangan va batareya zaryadi pastligini oldindan xabar beradi. O'rtacha batareyalar foydalanish jadalligi va ekspluatatsiya sharoitlariga qarab bir yildan bir necha yilgacha xizmat qiladi.

Q: Dahua datchiklari boshqa signalizatsiya tizimlari bilan mos keladimi?
A: Dahua 868 MGts seriyasidagi simsiz qurilmalar Dahua qabul-nazorat asboblari bilan o'z ekotizimi doirasida ishlashga mo'ljallangan. Uchinchi tomon markaziy panellari bilan integratsiya moslikni qo'shimcha tekshirishni talab qiladi — mutaxassislarimiz sizning holatingiz uchun optimal yechimni tanlashda yordam beradi.

Q: Datchiklar elektr uzilganda ishlaydimi?
A: Simsiz izvergichlar o'rnatilgan batareyalardan ishlaydi va elektr tarmog'iga bog'liq emas. Qabul-nazorat asboblari, odatda, asosiy ta'minot uzilganda tizim ishlashini batareya sig'imi bilan belgilanadigan muddatga ta'minlaydigan zaxira akkumulyator bilan jihozlangan.
detectors.en:
Detectors and sensors are the foundation of any security alarm system. It is precisely these devices that register the fact of intrusion, smoke, motion or a change in the situation and transmit a signal to the control panel. Without competently selected and correctly installed detectors, even the most modern control panel will turn out to be useless. The SAT Solutions catalog presents a wide range of detectors for sites of any scale — from a small office to an industrial enterprise. You can buy security alarm detectors and sensors in Tashkent directly from us with a manufacturer's warranty and professional installation.

The choice of the right detector depends on many factors: the type of protected site, its layout, climatic conditions, requirements for detection zones and the method of data transmission. Wireless systems on the 868 MHz frequency are especially in demand today: they do not require laying cables, are mounted quickly and easily scale. That is exactly why most of the assortment in this category consists of wireless devices that operate in a single ecosystem and exchange data with the central device over a secure radio channel. In Uzbekistan, such solutions are relevant both for new buildings and for sites where laying cable is technically difficult or costly.

The category covers not only passive infrared motion detectors (PIR), but also combined devices, acoustic detectors, tamper sensors, as well as accompanying equipment: sirens, control panels and wireless keypads. This makes it possible to assemble a full-fledged security system from a single catalog, choosing components from a single manufacturer and guaranteeing their compatibility with each other.

## How to choose

- Detector type: passive infrared (PIR) responds to the movement of thermal objects; combined PIR with a microwave channel reduces the number of false alarms; acoustic — to the sound of breaking glass; magnetic-contact — to the opening of doors and windows. Choose the type to match a specific detection zone.
- Wired or wireless version: wireless sensors on the 868 MHz frequency are convenient in the absence of cable infrastructure and at sites with already completed finishing; wired ones provide more stable communication and do not depend on batteries.
- Detection range and angle: for small rooms, a standard angle of 90-110 degrees and a range of up to 12 meters is sufficient; corridor lenses or "curtain"-type lenses are used for elongated zones and the perimeter.
- Degree of protection against interference: anti-sabotage function (tamper protection), resistance to radio interference and to false alarms from pets — critically important parameters for commercial sites.
- Compatibility with the central device: sensors and detectors must operate in a single system with the control equipment. Using devices of one brand within a single ecosystem minimizes integration risks.
- Operating conditions: for outdoor installation, sensors with an IP54 rating and higher are needed, as well as ones resistant to temperature fluctuations. Indoor devices may have less strict protection requirements.
- Presence of a GSM or Wi-Fi module in the system: a number of modern kits support smartphone notifications and remote monitoring without separate equipment — this is convenient for small business and private households.

## Applications

- Residential houses and apartments: perimeter protection, security of entrance groups, control of movement in key zones using wireless sensors without drilling walls.
- Offices and business centers: zoning of security by rooms, delineation of rights to arm and disarm, integration with the access control system.
- Retail facilities (stores, warehouses, supermarkets): reliable security during off-hours, protection of cash registers and valuables storage zones, monitoring of large open spaces.
- Industrial enterprises and production facilities: sensors with high resistance to interference, dust and temperature fluctuations; protection of the perimeter and internal zones with various operating modes.
- Educational and healthcare facilities: schools, clinics, medical centers — nighttime security, protection of server rooms and administrative zones, rapid response to unauthorized access.
- Banks and financial institutions: maximum level of protection using several types of detectors, redundancy of communication channels, integration with a centralized monitoring console.

## Brands and models in the catalog

- Dahua: the only brand presented in this category, providing a full assortment of wireless security alarm components. The series of devices on the 868 MHz frequency is a closed, well-integrated ecosystem: detectors, control panels, sirens and keypads operate in a single environment.
- DHI-ARD and DHI-HY series detectors and sensors: wireless PIR detectors, combined PIR cameras, smoke detectors and contact detectors — all designed for joint operation with Dahua central panels.
- Dahua ARC and ARM series control panels: support a large number of wireless zones, have a built-in communicator and make it possible to manage the system via a mobile app. The ARM7011, ARM7012 and ARC3800H models are oriented toward sites of various scales.
- Dahua ARA13 and ARA14 series wireless sirens: outdoor and indoor versions, high sound power, tamper protection and long operating life from the built-in battery.
- Dahua DHI-ARD2251E-W2 wireless PIR camera: combines the functions of a security detector and a video camera, which makes it possible to obtain visual confirmation of an alarm and reduce the number of false dispatches.

## FAQ

Q: How much do security alarm sensors cost in Tashkent?
A: The cost depends on the type of device, the brand and the functionality. Dahua wireless PIR detectors belong to the mid-price segment and combine reliability with an affordable price. For an exact calculation of the system cost for your site, request a commercial offer from our specialists.

Q: Can wireless sensors be installed independently?
A: Technically, some devices allow independent configuration, however professional installation is mandatory for correct system operation, correct placement of detection zones and a legally valid handover of the site under protection. Independent installation may also entail loss of warranty.

Q: How often do batteries in wireless sensors need to be changed?
A: Modern Dahua wireless detectors are equipped with energy-efficient modules and signal a low battery charge in advance. On average, batteries last from one to several years depending on the intensity of use and operating conditions.

Q: Are Dahua sensors compatible with other alarm systems?
A: Dahua 868 MHz series wireless devices are designed to operate within their own ecosystem with Dahua control panels. Integration with third-party central panels requires additional compatibility verification — our specialists will help select the optimal solution for your case.

Q: Do the sensors work during a power outage?
A: Wireless detectors run on built-in batteries and do not depend on the mains. Control panels, as a rule, are equipped with a backup battery that ensures system operation during an outage of the main power for a period determined by the battery capacity.

Telekommunikatsiya shkaflari — har qanday tuzilgan kabel tizimi va server infratuzilmasining asosi. Ularda faol va passiv tarmoq uskunasi joylashtiriladi: kommutatorlar, patch-panellar, marshrutizatorlar, serverlar, elektr ta'minoti va zaxira ta'minot tizimlari. To'g'ri tanlangan shkaf uskunani changdan va mexanik shikastlanishlardan himoya qiladi, texnik xizmat ko'rsatish uchun qulay kirishni ta'minlaydi va kabel xo'jaligida tartib yaratadi. Telekommunikatsiya shkaflarini Toshkentda professional tanlov va montaj bilan SAT Solutions da sotib olish mumkin.

Shkaf tanlash ko'plab omillarga bog'liq: obyekt turi, uskuna soni, ventilyatsiya va xavfsizlikka qo'yiladigan talablar, mavjud maydon. O'zbekiston bozorida kichik ofislar uchun ixcham devorga o'rnatiladigan yechimlar ham, server xonalari va aloqa tugunlari uchun to'liq o'lchamli poldagi shkaflar ham talabga ega. Nafaqat shkafning o'z o'lchamlarini, balki unga aksessuarlarni ham hisobga olish muhim: kabel organayzerlari, javonlar, tiqinlar, kabel yo'lini boshqarish tizimlari — bularning barchasi ekspluatatsiya qulayligi va infratuzilma masshtablanishiga bevosita ta'sir qiladi.

SAT Solutions katalogi telekommunikatsiya shkaflari va hamroh aksessuarlarning 100 dan ortiq pozitsiyasini o'z ichiga oladi. Bu yerda turli balandlikdagi poldagi shkaflar — ixcham 22U dan tortib professional 42U gacha, kichik xonalarda montaj qilish uchun devorga o'rnatiladigan modellar, shuningdek kabel organayzerlari, kuchaytirilgan turdagi statsionar javonlar va tiqinlar taqdim etilgan. Assortiment kichik kompaniyalarning ham, yirik korporativ buyurtmachilar va telekommunikatsiya operatorlarining ham ehtiyojlarini qamrab oladi.

## Qanday tanlash kerak

- Shkaf balandligi unitlarda (U). Standart birlik — 1U 44,45 mm ga teng. Kichik ofis uchun 9-12U shkaf yetarli, server xonasi uchun 22-42U modellari optimal. Har doim kelajakdagi kengaytirish uchun kamida 20-30% zaxira qo'ying.

- Montaj turi: poldagi yoki devorga o'rnatiladigan. Devorga o'rnatiladigan shkaflar joyni tejaydi va koridorlar, kichik ofislar yoki texnik xonalarda montaj qilish uchun mos. Poldagi shkaflar ajratilgan server xonalari va aloqa tugunlarida o'rnatiladi, ular katta yukga mo'ljallangan va ko'proq uskunani sig'diradi.

- Chuqurlik va kenglik bo'yicha o'lchamlar. Standart kenglik — 600 yoki 800 mm, chuqurlik — 600 dan 1200 mm gacha. Chuqurlik o'rnatiladigan uskuna uzunligidan kelib chiqib tanlanadi: serverlar va UTM kamida 900-1000 mm chuqurlikni talab qiladi, passiv uskunani ixchamroq modellarda joylashtirish mumkin.

- Eshik va yon devorlar turi. Perforatsiyalangan eshiklar havoning tabiiy sirkulyatsiyasini ta'minlaydi — bu majburiy sovutishga ega faol uskuna uchun muhim. Shisha eshiklar uskuna holatining vizual indikatsiyasi kerak bo'lgan joyda qo'llaniladi. Yopiq metall eshiklar ruxsatsiz kirishdan yaxshiroq himoya beradi.

- Yuk ko'tarish qobiliyati. Shkafga ruxsat etilgan maksimal yukni aniqlashtiring: byudjetli modellar 600-800 kg ni ko'taradi, professionallar — 1000 kg dan ortiq. Serverlar va og'ir UTM uskunasini joylashtirishda bu parametr juda muhim.

- Aksessuarlar bilan komplektlash. Javonlarga (statsionar yoki chiqariladigan), kabel organayzerlariga (gorizontal va vertikal), ishlatilmaydigan unitlar uchun tiqinlarga, elektr ta'minotini tashkil etish tizimlariga ehtiyojni oldindan o'ylab qo'ying. Bu elementlarning barchasi yakuniy xizmat ko'rsatish qulayligiga ta'sir qiladi.

- Ventilyatsiya tizimi va iqlim nazorati. Uskuna zich o'rnatilgan server shkaflari uchun ko'pincha qo'shimcha ventilyator bloklari yoki aniq konditsionerlar talab qilinadi. Uskunaning issiqlik ajratishini aniqlashtiring va issiqlikni chiqarishni oldindan rejalashtiring.

Devorga o'rnatiladigan shkaflar to'g'ridan-to'g'ri muzokara xonalari yoki texnik nishalarda montaj qilinadi.

- Server xonalari va ma'lumotlar markazlari. 42U poldagi shkaflar — server xonalari uchun standart. Bu yerda yagona stoykada serverlar, ma'lumotlarni saqlash tizimlari, tarmoq uskunasi va zaxira ta'minot bloklari joylashtiriladi.

- Ishlab chiqarish korxonalari va omborlar. Sanoat obyektlarida shkaflar tarmoq infratuzilmasini tashkil etish, avtomatlashtirilgan tizimlarni boshqarish va videokuzatuv hamda kirishni nazorat qilish uskunasini joylashtirish uchun qo'llaniladi.

- Ta'lim muassasalari va tibbiyot tashkilotlari. Maktablar, universitetlar va kasalxonalar telekommunikatsiya shkaflari asosida o'z tuzilgan kabel tizimini quradi, tarmoq uskunasini ishonchli va xavfsiz saqlashni ta'minlaydi.

- Telekommunikatsiya tugunlari va provayderlar. O'zbekistondagi aloqa operatorlari kirish tugunlarini tashkil etish, optik krosslar va faol uskunani turar-joy va tijorat binolarida joylashtirish uchun professional poldagi shkaflardan foydalanadi.

- Xavfsizlik tizimlari va past kuchlanishli tizimlar. Shkaflar yirik obyektlarda videokuzatuv serverlari, KKBT kontrollerlari, yong'in signalizatsiyasi uskunasi va xabar berish tizimlarini montaj qilish uchun baza sifatida qo'llaniladi.

## Katalogdagi brendlar va modellar

- Pixietech — ushbu toifadagi asosiy brend. Ishlab chiqaruvchi kenglik (600 va 800 mm) va chuqurlik (600, 800, 1000 va 1200 mm) bo'yicha turli konfiguratsiyalarga ega 22U, 27U va 42U balandlikdagi poldagi shkaflarning keng liniyasini taklif qiladi. Eshiklar perforatsiyalangan ijroda ham, maksimal havo almashinuvi uchun ikki qavatli perforatsiyalangan variantda ham chiqariladi.

- Pixietech aksessuarlari montajchining barcha asosiy ehtiyojlarini qamrab oladi: turli chuqurlikdagi shkaflar uchun oddiy va kuchaytirilgan ijrodagi statsionar javonlar, 95x70 mm kanallarga ega 47U balandlikdagi vertikal kabel organayzerlar, patch-kordlarni bejirim yotqizish uchun halqalarga ega gorizontal organayzerlar.

- Standart 19-dyuymli profil uchun 1U tiqinlari — har qanday stoykaning majburiy elementi. Ular bo'sh unitlarni yopadi, shkaf ichida havoning tartibsiz harakatini istisno qiladi va uskunaning qizib ketish xavfini kamaytiradi.

- Kuchaytirilgan statsionar javonlar og'ir uskunani o'rnatishga mo'ljallangan: faol kommutatorlar, uzluksiz ta'minot manbalari, mediakonverterlar. 800 mm kenglikdagi shkaflar uchun 800, 1000 va 1200 mm chuqurlikda chiqariladi.

## FAQ

Q: 20-30 ish o'rniga ega kichik ofis uchun qaysi shkafni tanlash kerak?
A: Bunday o'lchamdagi ofis uchun odatda 12-18U balandlikdagi devorga o'rnatiladigan yoki kichik poldagi shkaf yetarli. Unda kommutator, patch-panel, Wi-Fi kirish nuqtasi va zarur bo'lsa kichik UTM joylashtiriladi. 450-600 mm chuqurlik aksariyat vazifalarni qamrab oladi.

Q: Telekommunikatsiya shkafini montajsiz, faqat uskunani sotib olish mumkinmi?
A: Ha, SAT Solutions shkaflar va aksessuarlarni alohida sotadi. Siz kerakli pozitsiyalarni Toshkentdagi ombordan sotib olib, montajni o'z kuchingiz bilan yoki uchinchi tomon mutaxassislarini jalb qilib bajarishingiz mumkin. Menejerlar komplektlashni tanlashda yordam beradi.

Q: 600 mm va 1000 mm chuqurlikdagi shkaflar o'rtasidagi farq nima?
A: 600 mm chuqurlik passiv uskuna — patch-panellar, kross-ulanishlar, kichik kommutatorlar uchun mos. Serverlar, jiddiy kommutatorlar va UTM ni montaj qilish uchun kamida 900-1000 mm chuqurlik talab qilinadi: uskuna sayoz shkafga jismonan sig'maydi.

Q: Server xonasida poldagi shkafni montaj qilish uchun maxsus ruxsat kerakmi?
A: Ajratilgan xonada telekommunikatsiya shkafini o'rnatish maxsus ruxsatlarni talab qilmaydi, biroq server xonasi elektr ta'minoti, yerga ulash va yong'in xavfsizligi normalariga mos kelishi kerak. SAT Solutions zarur bo'lsa talablar bo'yicha maslahat beradi va xonani tayyorlashda yordam beradi.

Q: Pixietech shkaflari va aksessuarlariga kafolat beriladimi?
A: Barcha Pixietech uskunasiga ishlab chiqaruvchi kafolati taalluqli. Muddat va shartlarni buyurtma rasmiylashtirishda SAT Solutions menejerlaridan aniqlashtiring. Kafolatli holatlar O'zbekiston hududidagi rasmiy yetkazib beruvchi sifatida SAT Solutions orqali ko'rib chiqiladi.

Telecommunication cabinets are the foundation of any structured cabling system and server infrastructure. They house active and passive network equipment: switches, patch panels, routers, servers, power and backup power systems. A correctly selected cabinet protects the equipment from dust and mechanical damage, provides convenient access for technical maintenance and creates order in the cable management. You can buy telecommunication cabinets in Tashkent with professional selection and installation at SAT Solutions.

The choice of a cabinet depends on many factors: the type of site, the amount of equipment, the requirements for ventilation and security, the available space. Both compact wall-mounted solutions for small offices and full-size floor-standing cabinets for server rooms and communication nodes are in demand on the Uzbekistan market. It is important to take into account not only the dimensions of the cabinet itself, but also its accessories: cable organizers, shelves, blanking panels, cable-run management systems — all this directly affects the ease of operation and scalability of the infrastructure.

The SAT Solutions catalog includes more than 100 items of telecommunication cabinets and accompanying accessories. Here are presented floor-standing cabinets of various heights — from compact 22U to professional 42U, wall-mounted models for installation in small rooms, as well as cable organizers, reinforced-type fixed shelves and blanking panels. The assortment covers the needs of both small companies and large corporate customers and telecommunication operators.

## How to choose

- Cabinet height in units (U). The standard unit — 1U equals 44.45 mm. For a small office, a cabinet of 9-12U is sufficient, for a server room, 22-42U models are optimal. Always allow a margin of at least 20-30% for future expansion.

- Mounting type: floor-standing or wall-mounted. Wall-mounted cabinets save space and are suitable for installation in corridors, small offices or technical rooms. Floor-standing cabinets are installed in dedicated server rooms and communication nodes; they are designed for a large load and accommodate more equipment.

- Depth and width dimensions. The standard width is 600 or 800 mm, the depth is from 600 to 1200 mm. The depth is chosen based on the length of the installed equipment: servers and UPSs require a depth of at least 900-1000 mm, passive equipment can be housed in more compact models.

- Door and side-wall type. Perforated doors provide natural air circulation — this is important for active equipment with forced cooling. Glass doors are used where visual indication of the equipment state is needed. Solid metal doors provide better protection against unauthorized access.

- Load capacity. Verify the maximum permissible load on the cabinet: budget models withstand 600-800 kg, professional ones — over 1000 kg. When housing servers and heavy UPS equipment, this parameter is critically important.

- Accessory configuration. Think in advance about the need for shelves (fixed or sliding), cable organizers (horizontal and vertical), blanking panels for unused units, power organization systems. All these elements affect the final ease of maintenance.

- Ventilation system and climate control. For server cabinets with dense equipment installation, additional fan units or precision air conditioners are often required. Verify the heat dissipation of the equipment and plan heat removal in advance.

## Applications

- Corporate offices and business centers. In office spaces, telecommunication cabinets are used to house switches, patch panels, Wi-Fi access points and telephony systems. Wall-mounted cabinets are mounted directly in meeting rooms or technical niches.

- Server rooms and data centers. Floor-standing 42U cabinets are the standard for server rooms. Here, in a single rack, servers, data storage systems, network equipment and backup power units are housed.

- Industrial enterprises and warehouses. At industrial sites, cabinets are used to organize network infrastructure, manage automated systems and house video surveillance and access control equipment.

- Educational institutions and medical organizations. Schools, universities and hospitals build their own SCS based on telecommunication cabinets, ensuring reliable and secure storage of network equipment.

- Telecommunication nodes and providers. Communication operators in Uzbekistan use professional floor-standing cabinets to organize access nodes, house optical cross-connects and active equipment in residential and commercial buildings.

- Security systems and low-current systems. Cabinets are used as a base for mounting video surveillance servers, ACS controllers, fire alarm equipment and notification systems at large sites.

## Brands and models in the catalog

- Pixietech — the main brand in this category. The manufacturer offers a wide lineup of floor-standing cabinets 22U, 27U and 42U high with various configurations in width (600 and 800 mm) and depth (600, 800, 1000 and 1200 mm). Doors are produced both in a perforated version and in a double-perforated variant for maximum air exchange.

- Pixietech accessories cover all the basic needs of an installer: fixed shelves of ordinary and reinforced design for cabinets of various depths, vertical cable organizers 47U high with 95x70 mm channels, horizontal organizers with rings for neat laying of patch cords.

- 1U blanking panels for the standard 19-inch profile — a mandatory element of any rack. They close free units, excluding disorganized airflow inside the cabinet and reducing the risk of equipment overheating.

- Reinforced fixed shelves are designed for installing heavy equipment: active switches, uninterruptible power supplies, media converters. They are produced for cabinets 800 mm wide with depths of 800, 1000 and 1200 mm.

## FAQ

Q: Which cabinet should I choose for a small office of 20-30 workstations?
A: For an office of this size, a wall-mounted or small floor-standing cabinet 12-18U high is usually sufficient. It houses a switch, a patch panel, a Wi-Fi access point and, if necessary, a small UPS. A depth of 450-600 mm covers most tasks.

Q: Can I buy a telecommunication cabinet without installation, just the equipment?
A: Yes, SAT Solutions sells cabinets and accessories separately. You can purchase the required items from the Tashkent warehouse and perform the installation on your own or by engaging third-party specialists. Managers will help select the configuration.

Q: What is the difference between cabinets with a depth of 600 mm and 1000 mm?
A: A depth of 600 mm is suitable for passive equipment — patch panels, cross-connects, small switches. For mounting servers, serious switches and UPSs, a depth of at least 900-1000 mm is required: the equipment physically does not fit in a shallow cabinet.

Q: Is special permission needed to install a floor-standing cabinet in a server room?
A: Installation of a telecommunication cabinet in a dedicated room does not require special permissions, however the server room must comply with standards for power supply, grounding and fire safety. SAT Solutions will, if necessary, advise on the requirements and help prepare the room.

Q: Is there a warranty on Pixietech cabinets and accessories?
A: All Pixietech equipment is covered by the manufacturer's warranty. Check the term and conditions with SAT Solutions managers when placing an order. Warranty cases are processed through SAT Solutions as the official supplier in Uzbekistan.

Kirish terminallari — bu xodimlar va tashrif buyuruvchilarning kirishini boshqarish uchun kirish guruhlarida, o'tkazgichlarda va nazorat nuqtalarida o'rnatiladigan intellektual identifikatsiya qurilmalaridir. Oddiy karta o'quvchilardan farqli o'laroq, zamonaviy terminallar bir korpusda bir nechta tekshirish usulini birlashtiradi: yuzni aniqlash, barmoq izlarini skanerlash va RFID-kartalarni o'qish. Aynan shunday ko'p biometrik jihozlar bugungi kunda O'zbekistondagi korxonalar, ofis markazlari, banklar va davlat muassasalarida kirishni nazorat qilish va boshqarish tizimlarining asosini tashkil etadi.

Toshkentda kirish terminalini sotib olish — bu real sharoitlarda ishlaydigan jihozni tanlash demakdir: chang, o'zgaruvchan yoritish, tig'iz soatlardagi odam oqimi, mavjud infratuzilma bilan integratsiya zarurati. Noto'g'ri tanlangan terminal o'tkazgichda navbatlar hosil qiladi, noto'g'ri rad etishlarni keltirib chiqaradi va doimiy xizmat ko'rsatishni talab qiladi. Aksincha, to'g'ri tanlov ish vaqtini avtomatik hisobga olish, kartalarni uzatishni istisno qilish va obyekt xavfsizligining umumiy darajasini oshirish imkonini beradi.

SAT Solutions katalogi ZKTeco kirish terminallarining 20 ta modelini o'z ichiga oladi — ixcham bir biometrik yechimlardan tortib yuz, barmoq izi va RFID-ni bir vaqtda aniqlaydigan ko'p funksiyali komplekslargacha. Imkoniyatlar bo'yicha keng tarqoqlik bitta o'tkazgichli kichik ofis uchun ham, o'nlab nazorat nuqtalari va minglab xodimlari bo'lgan yirik ishlab chiqarish majmuasi uchun ham jihoz tanlash imkonini beradi.

## Qanday tanlash kerak

- Identifikatsiya usuli: bitta omil (masalan, faqat yuz yoki faqat karta) yetarlimi yoki obyekt ko'p omilli autentifikatsiyani talab qiladimi — buni aniqlang. Xavfsizlikka yuqori talablar qo'yiladigan zonalar uchun yuz, barmoq izi va kartani birgalikda tekshiradigan ko'p biometrik terminallarni tanlang.

- Aniqlash tezligi va o'tkazish qobiliyati: yuqori odam oqimiga ega o'tkazgichlar uchun identifikatsiya tezligi hal qiluvchi ahamiyatga ega — bir odamga soniyaning ulushidan 1-2 soniyagacha. Terminal bazada qancha yuzni saqlay olishini va katta bazada tekshirish qanday tezlikda amalga oshishini aniqlang.

- Ekspluatatsiya sharoitlari: ko'chada yoki yarim ochiq o'rnatish himoyalangan korpus (IP-sinf), harorat o'zgarishlariga chidamlilik va turli yoritishda, jumladan to'g'ridan-to'g'ri quyosh nurlari yoki qorong'ulikda ishlashni talab qiladi.

- CHUB (kirishni nazorat qilish tizimi) bilan integratsiya: terminal sizning kirishni boshqarish dasturiy ta'minotingiz bilan mos keladigan protokollarni qo'llab-quvvatlashi kerak — Wiegand, OSDP, TCP/IP. Ayniqsa tizim allaqachon qisman joriy etilgan bo'lsa, sotib olishdan oldin mosligini tekshiring.

- Ish vaqtini hisobga olish: agar terminal faqat o'tishni nazorat qilish uchun emas, balki tabel hisobi uchun ham kerak bo'lsa, u tegishli funksionalni qo'llab-quvvatlashiga yoki korxonaning HR-tizimi bilan integratsiyalashishiga ishonch hosil qiling.

- Foydalanuvchilar bazasi hajmi: terminal xotirada saqlashi mumkin bo'lgan xodimlar soni turli modellarda farq qiladi. Kompaniyaning o'sishini hisobga olib, joriy foydalanuvchilar sonidan 20-30% zaxira qo'ying.

- Antipassbek va qo'shimcha xavfsizlik funksiyalari: rejimli obyektlar uchun antipassbek funksiyasini qo'llab-quvvatlash (chiqmasdan qayta o'tishni taqiqlash), eshik qulfini boshqarish, buzish paytida signalizatsiya va yuzni aniqlashda fotosuratdan himoya muhim ahamiyatga ega.

## Qo'llanilish sohalari

- Sanoat korxonalari va ishlab chiqarish: ish smenalari uchun o'tkazish rejimini tashkil etish, avtomatlashtirilgan tabel hisobi, cheklangan kirishli sexlar va omborlarga kirishni nazorat qilish.

- Ofis markazlari va biznes-parklar: ijarachilar va tashrif buyuruvchilarning kirishini boshqarish, zonalarni ruxsat darajalari bo'yicha ajratish, videokuzatuv tizimi va qo'riqlash signalizatsiyasi bilan integratsiya.

- Banklar, moliyaviy va davlat muassasalari: server xonalari, saqlash joylari va cheklangan kirishli zonalarni har bir o'tishni majburiy ro'yxatga olish bilan ko'p darajali himoyasini ta'minlash.

- O'quv yurtlari va tibbiyot muassasalari: talabalar, o'qituvchilar yoki xodimlarning kirishini nazorat qilish, turli toifadagi xodimlar uchun turli darajadagi ruxsatni tashkil etish.

- Mehmonxonalar, savdo va ko'ngilochar obyektlar: obyektning mijozlar qismidan ajratilgan xizmat zonalari, omborlar va texnik xonalarga kirishni boshqarish.

- Turar-joy majmualari va yopiq hududlar: jismoniy kalitlarga ehtiyoj bo'lmasdan, yuz yoki karta bo'yicha identifikatsiya bilan aholining kirishi va o'tishini tashkil etish.

## Katalogdagi brendlar va modellar

- ZKTeco SenseFace seriyasi (2A, 3B, 4A, 4B, 7A, 7B): yuzni aniqlash va RFID-ni birlashtiradigan ko'p biometrik terminallar liniyasi, ba'zi modellar esa qo'shimcha ravishda barmoq izi skaneri bilan jihozlangan. Seriya keng doiradagi vazifalarni qamrab oladi — oddiy ofis o'tkazgichidan tortib xavfsizlikka oshirilgan talablar qo'yiladigan obyektlargacha.

- ZKTeco SpeedFace-V5L va SpeedFace-V3L: yuzni yuqori tezlikda aniqlashga urg'u berilgan, intensiv odam oqimi bo'lgan obyektlar uchun mo'ljallangan terminallar. Aniqlash masofadan, qurilmaga yaqin to'xtash zaruratisiz amalga oshadi.

- ZKTeco EFace10: yuzni aniqlash uchun terminal bo'lib, kartasiz ishonchli va tezkor identifikatsiya talab qilinadigan obyektlarga yo'naltirilgan.

- ZKTeco SC800: standart korporativ CHUB vazifalari uchun kirish terminali bo'lib, keng tarqalgan integratsiya protokollarini qo'llab-quvvatlaydi.

- ZKTeco terminal komplektlari: terminal va montaj uchun tegishli elementlarni o'z ichiga olgan tayyor "kalit ostida" yechimlar bo'lib, tizimni joriy etishni soddalashtiradi.

## FAQ

Q: Ko'p biometrik terminal oddiy karta o'quvchidan nimasi bilan farq qiladi?
A: Karta o'quvchi faqat boshqa odamga uzatilishi yoki yo'qotilishi mumkin bo'lgan kartani tekshiradi. Ko'p biometrik terminal shaxsni biometrik ma'lumotlar — yuz yoki barmoq izi — bo'yicha karta bilan birgalikda yoki mustaqil ravishda tekshiradi, bu esa kirishni uzatish imkoniyatini istisno qiladi va identifikatsiya ishonchliligini oshiradi.

Q: ZKTeco terminallari yuzda niqob bilan ishlaydimi?
A: SenseFace va SpeedFace seriyasining dolzarb modellari odamni niqobda maqbul aniqlik darajasini saqlagan holda identifikatsiya qilish imkonini beradigan algoritmlar bilan jihozlangan. Aniq xususiyatlar modelga bog'liq — tanlashda mutaxassislarimizdan aniqlashtirishni tavsiya qilamiz.

Q: Terminalni allaqachon o'rnatilgan o'tkazish rejimi tizimi bilan integratsiyalash mumkinmi?
A: ZKTeco terminallarining aksariyati standart Wiegand va OSDP protokollarini, shuningdek TCP/IP-ulanishni qo'llab-quvvatlaydi, bu esa aksariyat mashhur CHUB platformalari bilan moslikni ta'minlaydi. Integratsiya aniqligi muayyan dasturiy ta'minotga bog'liq — muhandislarimiz loyiha boshlanishidan oldin moslik tekshiruvini o'tkazadi.

Q: Kirish terminallariga qanday kafolat beriladi va buzilganda nima bo'ladi?
A: SAT Solutions tomonidan yetkazib beriladigan ZKTeco jihozlariga ishlab chiqaruvchi kafolati amal qiladi. Kafolat muddatida nosozlik yuzaga kelganda kompaniya qurilmani almashtirish yoki ta'mirlashni ta'minlaydi, muhim vaziyatlarda esa texnik mutaxassisning tezkor chiqishini tashkil etadi.

Q: Bitta terminal qancha foydalanuvchini saqlashi mumkin?
A: Foydalanuvchilar bazasi sig'imi model va biometriya turiga bog'liq — yuzlar uchun odatda bir necha mingdan o'nlab minggacha shablon. Muayyan obyekt uchun terminal tanlashda biz xodimlar sonining o'sishiga zaxira qo'yishni tavsiya qilamiz.
zkteco-terminals.en:
Access terminals are intelligent identification devices installed at entrance groups, checkpoints and control points to manage the access of employees and visitors. Unlike simple card readers, modern terminals combine several verification methods in a single housing: facial recognition, fingerprint scanning and RFID card reading. It is precisely this multi-biometric equipment that today forms the basis of access control and management systems at enterprises, office centers, banks and government institutions in Uzbekistan.

Buying an access terminal in Tashkent means choosing equipment that will work in real conditions: dust, variable lighting, a flow of people during peak hours, and the need to integrate with existing infrastructure. An incorrectly selected terminal creates queues at the checkpoint, generates false rejections and requires constant maintenance. A well-considered choice, on the contrary, makes it possible to automate working-time tracking, eliminate card sharing and raise the overall security level of the facility.

The SAT Solutions catalog includes 20 models of ZKTeco access terminals — from compact single-biometric solutions to multifunctional complexes with simultaneous recognition of face, fingerprint and RFID. This range of capabilities makes it possible to select equipment both for a small office with a single checkpoint and for a large industrial complex with dozens of control points and thousands of employees.

## How to choose

- Identification method: determine whether a single factor is sufficient (for example, face only or card only) or whether the facility requires multi-factor authentication. For zones with high security requirements, choose multi-biometric terminals with combined verification of face, fingerprint and card.

- Recognition speed and throughput: for checkpoints with a high flow of people, identification speed is critical — from a fraction of a second to 1-2 seconds per person. Clarify how many faces the terminal can store in its database and at what speed verification occurs with a large database.

- Operating conditions: outdoor or semi-open installation requires a protected housing (IP class), resistance to temperature fluctuations and operation under various lighting conditions, including direct sunlight or darkness.

- Integration with ACS: the terminal must support protocols compatible with your access management software — Wiegand, OSDP, TCP/IP. Check compatibility before purchase, especially if the system is already partially deployed.

- Working-time tracking: if the terminal is needed not only for passage control but also for timekeeping, make sure it supports the corresponding functionality or integrates with the enterprise's HR system.

- User database size: the number of employees a terminal can store in memory varies across models. Allow a reserve of 20-30% over the current number of users to account for company growth.

- Anti-passback and additional security functions: for restricted-access facilities, support for the anti-passback function (prohibiting repeated entry without exit), door-lock control, tamper alarm and anti-spoofing protection during facial recognition is important.

## Applications

- Industrial enterprises and manufacturing: organizing access control for work shifts, automated timekeeping, controlling entry into workshops and warehouses with restricted access.

- Office centers and business parks: managing access for tenants and visitors, dividing zones by clearance levels, integration with video surveillance and security alarm systems.

- Banks, financial and government institutions: providing multi-level protection of server rooms, vaults and restricted-access zones with mandatory logging of every passage.

- Educational institutions and medical facilities: controlling the entry of students, teachers or staff, organizing different clearance levels for various categories of employees.

- Hotels, retail and entertainment facilities: managing access to service zones, warehouses and technical premises separated from the customer-facing part of the facility.

- Residential complexes and gated communities: organizing entry and passage of residents with identification by face or card, without the need for physical keys.

## Brands and models in the catalog

- ZKTeco SenseFace series (2A, 3B, 4A, 4B, 7A, 7B): a line of multi-biometric terminals combining facial recognition and RFID, with some models additionally featuring a fingerprint scanner. The series covers a wide range of tasks — from a basic office checkpoint to facilities with elevated security requirements.

- ZKTeco SpeedFace-V5L and SpeedFace-V3L: terminals with an emphasis on high-speed facial recognition, designed for facilities with an intensive flow of people. Recognition happens at a distance, without the need to stop right up against the device.

- ZKTeco EFace10: a facial-recognition terminal oriented toward facilities that require reliable and fast identification without cards.

- ZKTeco SC800: an access terminal for standard corporate ACS tasks, supporting common integration protocols.

- ZKTeco terminal kits: turnkey ready-made solutions that include the terminal and accompanying mounting elements, which simplifies system deployment.

## FAQ

Q: How does a multi-biometric terminal differ from an ordinary card reader?
A: A card reader checks only the card, which can be handed to another person or lost. A multi-biometric terminal verifies identity by biometric data — face or fingerprint — in combination with a card or on its own, which eliminates the possibility of transferring access and increases the reliability of identification.

Q: Do ZKTeco terminals work with masks on the face?
A: Current SenseFace and SpeedFace series models are equipped with algorithms that make it possible to identify a person wearing a mask while maintaining an acceptable level of accuracy. Specific characteristics depend on the model — we recommend checking with our specialists when making a selection.

Q: Can a terminal be integrated with an already installed access-control system?
A: Most ZKTeco terminals support the standard Wiegand and OSDP protocols as well as TCP/IP connectivity, which ensures compatibility with most popular ACS platforms. The precision of integration depends on the specific software — our engineers will perform a compatibility check before the project begins.

Q: What is the warranty on access terminals and what happens in case of a breakdown?
A: ZKTeco equipment supplied by SAT Solutions is covered by the manufacturer's warranty. If a malfunction occurs during the warranty period, the company provides replacement or repair of the device, and in critical situations — a prompt visit by a technical specialist.

Q: How many users can a single terminal store?
A: The user database capacity depends on the model and the type of biometrics — for faces it is usually from several thousand to tens of thousands of templates. When selecting a terminal for a specific facility, we recommend allowing a reserve for growth in the number of employees.

hik-hd-cameras.uz:
HD-kameralar (Turbo HD) — bu HD-TVI (High Definition Transport Video Interface) texnologiyasi bo'yicha ishlaydigan yuqori aniqlikdagi analog videokuzatuv kameralaridir. Klassik CVBS formatidagi analog kameralardan farqli o'laroq, ular tasvirni oddiy koaksial kabel orqali 1 dan 8 megapiksele qadar aniqlikda, mavjud infratuzilmani almashtirmasdan uzatadi. Aynan shu sababli Turbo HD eski analog videokuzatuv tizimlarini modernizatsiya qilishda talabgir yechim bo'lib qolmoqda: yangi kabel tarmog'ini o'tkazish shart emas, tasvir sifati esa tubdan oshadi.

Bugungi kunda Toshkentda HD-kameralar sotib olish bir necha yil oldingiga qaraganda ancha oson: O'zbekiston bozori takliflar bilan to'yingan, ammo vazifani tushunmasdan o'nlab seriya va modifikatsiyalarni farqlash qiyin. Turbo HD-kameralar ikki asosiy konstruktivda ishlab chiqariladi — ko'chada yoki koridorlarda yo'naltirilgan kuzatuv uchun silindrik (bullet) va xonalar hamda kozirek ostida shift o'rnatish uchun kupolli (dome). Alohida nishani ColorVu modellari egallaydi, ular yaxshilangan matritsa va oq yoritma hisobiga deyarli to'liq qorong'ulikda rangli tasvirni ta'minlaydi, shuningdek yorug'lik oqimini bir tekis taqsimlaydigan va kadr markazida yorib yuborishni istisno qiladigan aqlli infraqizil yoritmali EXIR-kameralar ham bor.

Tanlashda faqat megapikselga emas, balki obyektiv turini, tungi ko'rish masofasini, korpus himoya sinfini va allaqachon o'rnatilgan videoregistrator bilan moslikni ham baholash muhim. SAT Solutions katalogida Hikvision DS-2CE1x, DS-2CE7x, DS-2CE10x, DS-2CE16x seriyalarining 2,8 mm va boshqa fokus masofalariga ega qat'iy obyektivli modellari taqdim etilgan, bu esa kamerani muayyan ko'rish burchagi va masofaga moslab tanlash imkonini beradi.

## Qanday tanlash kerak

- Matritsa aniqligi. Aksariyat vazifalar uchun 2 MP (FullHD 1080p) yetarli, ammo agar yuzlarni aniqlash yoki masofadan avtomobil raqamlarini o'qish kerak bo'lsa, 5 MP va undan yuqorini ko'rib chiqish lozim. DS-2CE76H0T seriyasi kameralari Turbo HD-registratorlar bilan moslikni saqlagan holda 5 MP ni ta'minlaydi.
- Konstruktiv. Silindrik kameralar devor va ustunlarga o'rnatiladi, ko'cha uchun yaxshi mos keladi. Kupolli kameralar shift uchun bo'lib, ularni qo'lda buzish yoki qayta yo'naltirish qiyinroq, shuning uchun ular jamoat joylarida afzaldir.
- Yoritma turi. EXIR-yoritma kechasi 40-60 m gacha masofada bir tekis qora-oq tasvirni ta'minlaydi. Oq yoritmali ColorVu sutkalik rangli tasvir beradi, ammo qo'shimcha yoritish manbaini hosil qiladi. Tanlov kechasi rangga bo'lgan talablarga va atrofdagilarning ko'rinadigan yorug'likka munosabatiga bog'liq.
- Ko'rish burchagi va fokus masofasi. 2,8 mm obyektiv xonalarni kuzatish uchun keng ko'rish burchagini (taxminan 100-105°) beradi. 3,6 mm obyektiv burchakni toraytiradi, identifikatsiya masofasini oshiradi. Ko'chalar va perimetrlar uchun ko'pincha 6 mm va undan uzunroq obyektivlar kerak.
- Korpus himoya darajasi. Ko'cha uchun IP67 dan past bo'lmagan himoya sinfi majburiy (to'liq changdan himoya, suv oqimiga chidamlilik). Vandalizm zonalari uchun — IK10 (zarbaga chidamli) korpus.
- Registrator bilan moslik. Turbo HD-kameralar HD-TVI-registratorlar bilan ishlaydi. Sotib olishdan oldin DVR kerakli aniqlik va protokolni qo'llab-quvvatlashiga ishonch hosil qiling. Hikvision DS-2CE seriyasi kameralari Hikvision iDS/iDS2/iDS7 registratorlari bilan to'liq mos keladi.
- Ishchi harorat diapazoni. O'zbekiston sharoitida yozda havo +40°C va undan yuqori qiziydi, shuning uchun ko'cha obyektlari uchun kameraning +60°C va undan yuqorigacha bo'lgan ishchi harorat diapazoni muhim.

## Qo'llanilish sohalari

- Savdo obyektlari va ofislar. Savdo zallari, kassalar va muzokara xonalaridagi kupolli HD-kameralar interyerga minimal aralashuv bilan xodimlar va tashrif buyuruvchilarni nazorat qilishni ta'minlaydi.
- Perimetr va avtoturargohlar. Uzoq yoritmali silindrik EXIR-kameralar to'siqlarga, kirish darvozalariga va ombor hamda ishlab chiqarish korxonalarining avtoturargoh zonalariga o'rnatiladi.
- Ko'p kvartirali turar-joy binolari. HD-TVI asosidagi tizimlar eski koaksial kabeldan foydalanish imkonini beradi, bu esa domofon va qo'riqlash tizimlarini modernizatsiya qilishda montaj narxini sezilarli darajada kamaytiradi.
- Ta'lim va sog'liqni saqlash obyektlari. Toshkent va O'zbekiston hududlaridagi maktablar, bolalar bog'chalari va tibbiyot muassasalari koridorlar, kirish guruhlari va ichki hovlilarni nazorat qilish uchun kupolli kameralar bilan jihozlanadi.
- Sanoat korxonalari. Murakkab yoritish sharoitlarida kuzatuv talab qilinadigan sexlar, omborlar, texnologik zonalar uchun portlashga chidamli yoki vandalizmga qarshi ijrodagi kameralar.
- Xususiy uy-joylar va kottejlar. ColorVu-kameralar tashqi yorug'lik manbalarisiz kechasi rangli tasvir olish imkonini beradi — xususiy sektorda videokuzatuv uchun talabgir yechim.

## Katalogdagi brendlar va modellar

- Hikvision — jahon videokuzatuv bozorining yetakchisi bo'lib, uning Turbo HD-kameralari SAT Solutions katalogining asosini tashkil etadi. Assortimentda 2 dan 5 MP gacha matritsali DS-2CE10, DS-2CE11, DS-2CE12, DS-2CE16, DS-2CE17, DS-2CE72, DS-2CE76 seriyalari silindrik va kupolli ijroda taqdim etilgan.
- EXIR modellari. DS-2CE16D0T, DS-2CE76D0T va DS-2CE11H0T seriyasi Hikvision firmasining EXIR-yoritmasi bilan jihozlangan — bu reflektorli infraqizil diodlar massivi bo'lib, nuqtaviy manbani taqlid qiladi va yaqin zonani ortiqcha yoritmasdan bir tekis konus yoritmani shakllantiradi.
- ColorVu. DS-2CE12DF3T-F va DS-2CE72DF3T-F kameralari yuqori yorug'lik sezuvchanligiga ega matritsa va o'rnatilgan oq projektordan foydalanib, sutkalik to'liq rangli rejimda ishlaydi. Qorong'i vaqtda rangli aniqlash muhim bo'lgan obyektlar uchun mos.
- Boshlang'ich darajadagi HD-TVI modellari. DS-2CE10DF0T va DS-2CE16D0T-IRP seriyasi kameralari byudjetli inshootlar uchun mo'ljallangan bo'lib, obyektni kabel infratuzilmasini almashtirmasdan tez va arzon HD-aniqlikka o'tkazish kerak bo'lgan joylar uchundir.

## FAQ

Q: Turbo HD-kameralarni eski analog registratorga ulash mumkinmi?
A: Yo'q, HD-TVI-signal CVBS standartidagi registratorlar bilan mos kelmaydi. HD-TVI-ni qo'llab-quvvatlaydigan DVR yoki gibrid videoregistrator kerak. Bunda koaksial kabelning o'zini, qoida tariqasida, almashtirish shart emas.

Q: Toshkentda HD-kameralar asosidagi videokuzatuv tizimini o'rnatish qancha turadi?
A: Narx kameralar soni, kabel yo'llarining uzunligi, obyekt turi va montaj ishlari zaruratiga bog'liq. SAT Solutions obyektni tekshirgach yoki uning rejasini o'rgangach tijorat taklifini tayyorlaydi — hisob-kitob uchun menejer bilan bog'laning.

Q: Hikvision EXIR-kameralarining tungi ko'rish masofasi qancha?
A: Modelga qarab IK-yoritma masofasi 20 dan 60 metrgacha bo'ladi. Aniq qiymat har bir kameraning katalogdagi xususiyatlarida ko'rsatilgan. Tanlashda tuman yoki kuchli yomg'ir sharoitida real masofa kamroq bo'lishi mumkinligini hisobga oling.

Q: ColorVu-kameralar IK-yoritmali oddiy HD-kameralardan nimasi bilan farq qiladi?
A: ColorVu-kameralar oshirilgan yorug'lik sezuvchanligiga ega matritsa va oq (ko'rinadigan) yoritmadan foydalanadi, buning hisobiga kechasi tasvir rangli bo'lib qoladi. Oddiy IK-kameralar qorong'uda qora-oq rejimga o'tadi. ColorVu tungi vaqtda kiyim yoki avtomobillar rangini farqlash muhim bo'lgan joylarda afzaldir.

Q: Hikvision kameralariga qancha kafolat muddati beriladi?
A: SAT Solutions tomonidan rasmiy kanallar orqali yetkazib beriladigan Hikvision jihozlariga ishlab chiqaruvchi kafolati amal qiladi. Aniq shartlarni buyurtma rasmiylashtirishda menejerdan aniqlang; kompaniya bajarilgan montaj ishlariga ham kafolat xizmatini ta'minlaydi.
hik-hd-cameras.en:
HD cameras (Turbo HD) are high-resolution analog video surveillance cameras operating on HD-TVI (High Definition Transport Video Interface) technology. Unlike classic analog cameras of the CVBS format, they transmit an image with a resolution from 1 to 8 megapixels over an ordinary coaxial cable without replacing the existing infrastructure. This is precisely why Turbo HD remains an in-demand solution when modernizing old analog video surveillance systems: there is no need to lay a new cable network, while the picture quality improves dramatically.

Buying HD cameras in Tashkent today is significantly easier than a few years ago: the Uzbekistan market is saturated with offers, yet it is difficult to make sense of dozens of series and modifications without understanding the task. Turbo HD cameras are produced in two main form factors — bullet cameras for directional surveillance outdoors or in corridors, and dome cameras for ceiling installation indoors and under canopies. A separate niche is occupied by ColorVu models, which provide a color image in near-total darkness thanks to an improved sensor and white illumination, as well as EXIR cameras with smart infrared illumination that evenly distributes the light flux and eliminates overexposure at the center of the frame.

When choosing, it is important to focus not only on megapixels but also to evaluate the lens type, night-vision range, housing protection class and compatibility with the already installed video recorder. The SAT Solutions catalog features Hikvision models of the DS-2CE1x, DS-2CE7x, DS-2CE10x, DS-2CE16x series with fixed 2.8 mm lenses and other focal lengths, which makes it possible to select a camera for a specific viewing angle and range.

## How to choose

- Sensor resolution. For most tasks 2 MP (FullHD 1080p) is sufficient, but if you need to recognize faces or read license plates at a distance, it is worth considering 5 MP and above. Cameras of the DS-2CE76H0T series provide 5 MP while maintaining compatibility with Turbo HD recorders.
- Form factor. Bullet cameras are mounted on walls and poles and are well suited for outdoor use. Dome cameras are for ceilings; they are harder to damage or redirect by hand, so they are preferable in public places.
- Illumination type. EXIR illumination provides an even black-and-white image at night at a range of up to 40-60 m. ColorVu with white illumination gives a color picture around the clock but creates an additional light source. The choice depends on the requirements for color at night and the reaction of those nearby to visible light.
- Viewing angle and focal length. A 2.8 mm lens gives a wide viewing angle (about 100-105°) for monitoring indoor spaces. A 3.6 mm lens narrows the angle, increasing the identification range. For streets and perimeters, lenses of 6 mm and longer are often needed.
- Housing protection rating. For outdoor use, a protection class of at least IP67 is mandatory (full dust protection, resistance to a water jet). For areas prone to vandalism — a housing with IK10 (impact-resistant).
- Compatibility with the recorder. Turbo HD cameras work with HD-TVI recorders. Before purchase, make sure the DVR supports the required resolution and protocol. Hikvision DS-2CE series cameras are fully compatible with Hikvision iDS/iDS2/iDS7 recorders.
- Operating temperature range. In Uzbekistan the air warms up to +40°C and above in summer, so for outdoor facilities a camera operating temperature range up to +60°C and above is important.

## Applications

- Retail facilities and offices. Dome HD cameras in sales areas, at checkouts and in meeting rooms provide oversight of staff and visitors with minimal interference in the interior.
- Perimeter and parking lots. Bullet EXIR cameras with long-range illumination are installed on fences, entrance gates and parking zones of warehouse and industrial enterprises.
- Multi-apartment residential buildings. Systems based on HD-TVI make it possible to use old coaxial cable, which substantially reduces installation cost when modernizing intercom and security systems.
- Educational and healthcare facilities. Schools, kindergartens and medical institutions in Tashkent and the regions of Uzbekistan are equipped with dome cameras to monitor corridors, entrance groups and inner courtyards.
- Industrial enterprises. Cameras in explosion-proof or vandal-proof designs for workshops, warehouses and process zones where monitoring is required under difficult lighting conditions.
- Private households and cottages. ColorVu cameras make it possible to obtain a color image at night without external light sources — an in-demand solution for video surveillance in the private sector.

## Brands and models in the catalog

- Hikvision — the world leader in the video surveillance market, whose Turbo HD cameras form the basis of the SAT Solutions catalog. The range includes the DS-2CE10, DS-2CE11, DS-2CE12, DS-2CE16, DS-2CE17, DS-2CE72, DS-2CE76 series with sensors from 2 to 5 MP in bullet and dome designs.
- EXIR models. The DS-2CE16D0T, DS-2CE76D0T and DS-2CE11H0T series are equipped with proprietary Hikvision EXIR illumination — an array of infrared diodes with reflectors that imitate a point source and form an even illumination cone without overexposing the near zone.
- ColorVu. The DS-2CE12DF3T-F and DS-2CE72DF3T-F cameras operate in full-color mode around the clock, using a highly light-sensitive sensor and a built-in white floodlight. They are suitable for facilities where color recognition at night is critical.
- Entry-level HD-TVI models. The DS-2CE10DF0T and DS-2CE16D0T-IRP series cameras are designed for budget installations where a facility needs to be switched to HD resolution quickly and inexpensively without replacing the cable infrastructure.

## FAQ

Q: Can Turbo HD cameras be connected to an old analog recorder?
A: No, the HD-TVI signal is incompatible with CVBS-standard recorders. A DVR or hybrid video recorder with HD-TVI support is required. At the same time, the coaxial cable itself, as a rule, does not need to be replaced.

Q: How much does installing a video surveillance system based on HD cameras cost in Tashkent?
A: The cost depends on the number of cameras, the length of the cable runs, the type of facility and the need for installation work. SAT Solutions will prepare a commercial offer after surveying the facility or studying its plan — contact a manager for a calculation.

Q: What is the night-vision range of Hikvision EXIR cameras?
A: Depending on the model, the IR illumination range is from 20 to 60 meters. The specific value is indicated in the specifications of each camera in the catalog. When choosing, keep in mind that the actual range may be shorter in fog or heavy rain.

Q: How do ColorVu cameras differ from ordinary HD cameras with IR illumination?
A: ColorVu cameras use a sensor with increased light sensitivity and white (visible) illumination, thanks to which the image remains in color at night. Ordinary IR cameras switch to black-and-white mode in the dark. ColorVu is preferable where it is important to distinguish the color of clothing or vehicles at night.

Q: What is the warranty period for Hikvision cameras?
A: Hikvision equipment supplied by SAT Solutions through official channels is covered by the manufacturer's warranty. Check the exact terms with a manager when placing an order; the company also provides a warranty service for the installation work performed.
