Domofoniya — bu turar-joy binolari, ofis markazlari, sanoat obyektlari va tashkil etilgan o'tkazish rejimiga ega boshqa har qanday binolar uchun kirishni nazorat qilish va xavfsizlikning asosiy quyi tizimlaridan biridir. Domofoniya tizimlari eshik ochishdan oldin tashrif buyuruvchini identifikatsiya qilish, muzokaralarni videoga yozish, elektromagnit va elektromexanik qulflarni masofadan boshqarish, zamonaviy IP-yechimlarda esa mobil ilovalar va qo'riqlash tizimlari bilan integratsiyalashish imkonini beradi. Bugungi kunda Toshkentda domofon jihozlarini keng assortimentda sotib olish mumkin: xususiy uy uchun oddiy analog komplektlardan tortib boshqaruv serveriga ega ko'p kvartirali IP-tizimlargacha.

O'zbekistonda domofoniyani tanlash obyekt turi va vazifa ko'lami bilan belgilanadi. Xususiy kottej yoki kichik ofis uchun bir yoki bir necha trubkani qo'llab-quvvatlaydigan "chaqiruv paneli plyus ichki stansiya" komplekti yetarli. Ko'p kvartirali turar-joy majmualari, biznes-markazlar va sanoat korxonalari uchun boshqaruv serveri, o'nlab va yuzlab abonentlarni qo'llab-quvvatlash, CHUB va qo'riqlash signalizatsiyasi bilan integratsiyaga ega to'laqonli IP-domofoniya talab qilinadi. SAT Solutions katalogida domofon jihozlarining 50 dan ortiq pozitsiyasi taqdim etilgan — tayyor komplektlardan tortib alohida komponentlargacha: chaqiruv panellari, ichki stansiyalar, kirish kontrollerlari va qo'shimcha modullar.

Domofon tizimini loyihalashtirishda arxitekturani oldindan aniqlash muhim: analog yoki IP, kirish guruhlari va abonentlar soni, boshqa tizimlar bilan integratsiya zarurati. Noto'g'ri tanlangan tizim kabel infratuzilmasini qayta ishlashga qo'shimcha xarajatlarni keltirib chiqaradi, shuning uchun boshlang'ich bosqichda professional maslahat va to'g'ri texnik topshiriq vaqt va pulni tejaydi.

## Qanday tanlash kerak

- Tizim turi (analog yoki IP). Analog tizimlar montajda soddaroq va arzonroq, bitta kirish nuqtali kichik obyektlar uchun mos. IP-domofoniya istalgan sonli abonentga masshtablanadi, smartfon orqali masofaviy kirishni va boshqa xavfsizlik tizimlari bilan chuqur integratsiyani qo'llab-quvvatlaydi.
- Abonentlar va kirish nuqtalari soni. Bitta eshik va bir necha trubka uchun bazaviy komplekt yetarli. Bir necha kirishga ega ko'p kvartirali uy yoki ofis markazi uchun kontroller va server dasturiy ta'minotiga ega manzilli tizim kerak.
- Chaqiruv panelida videokamera mavjudligi. Videopanel tashrif buyuruvchini vizual identifikatsiya qilish, NVR ga yozish va arxivni ko'rish imkonini beradi. Tungi vaqtda ishlash uchun keng burchakli obyektiv va IK-yoritmali panellarni tanlang.
- Qulfni boshqarish usuli. Tizimlar elektromagnit, elektromexanik qulflar va elektroshpingaletlarni boshqarishi mumkin. Obyektdagi qulf turini aniqlang va tanlangan domofon bilan mosligiga ishonch hosil qiling.
- Mobil ilova bilan integratsiya. Zamonaviy IP-domofonlar chaqiruvni qabul qilish va eshikni smartfondan ochish imkonini beradi — masofaviy boshqaruv va egasi uydan tashqarida bo'lgan holatlar uchun dolzarb.
- Kartalar va kirish o'quvchilarini qo'llab-quvvatlash. Agar obyektda allaqachon Mifare, Wiegand yoki boshqa standartlardagi kartalarga asoslangan CHUB ishlatilsa, chaqiruv paneli o'rnatilgan yoki ulanadigan o'quvchini qo'llab-quvvatlashiga ishonch hosil qiling.
- Chaqiruv panelining iqlimiy ijrosi. Ko'chada o'rnatish uchun IP65 dan past bo'lmagan himoya darajasi, vandalizmga qarshi korpus mavjudligi va past haroratlarda ishlash qobiliyati muhim — ayniqsa qattiq qishki iqlimga ega O'zbekiston hududlaridagi obyektlar uchun dolzarb.

## Qo'llanilish sohalari

- Turar-joy ko'p kvartirali binolar va turar-joy majmualari: kirishlarga kirishni tashkil etish, tashrif buyuruvchilarni nazorat qilish, konsyerj bilan aloqa, aholining eshikni masofadan ochishi.
- Xususiy uylar va kottej posyolkalari: kirish darvozalari va kalitkalarni videonazorat qilish, shlagbaumni boshqarish, qo'riqlash signalizatsiyasi bilan integratsiya.
- Ofis va biznes-markazlar: o'tkazish rejimini tashkil etish uchun ko'p abonentli domofoniya, CHUB va ish vaqtini hisobga olish tizimlari bilan integratsiya.
- Sanoat korxonalari va omborlar: KPP da kirishni nazorat qilish, transport va xodimlarni identifikatsiya qilish, bir nechta kirish nuqtasini yagona markazdan boshqarish.
- O'quv va tibbiyot muassasalari: zonalar o'rtasida kirishni ajratish, bemorlar va tashrif buyuruvchilarning kirishini nazorat qilish, muzokaralar videoyozuvlarini arxivlash.
- Savdo markazlari va mehmonxonalar: domofoniyani mehmonxona yoki savdo markazini boshqarish tizimi bilan integratsiyalash, xizmat zonalariga kirishni tashkil etish.

## Katalogdagi brendlar va modellar

- Hikvision — ushbu toifadagi asosiy va keng taqdim etilgan brend. Hikvision DS-K domofoniya liniyasi barcha yechim sinflarini qamrab oladi: xususiy sektorda tez joriy etish uchun DS-KIS seriyasi tayyor komplektlari, ko'p kvartirali va tijorat obyektlari uchun DS-KH va DS-KD seriyalari IP-videodomofonlari, shuningdek karta o'quvchilari va videoyozuvni qo'llab-quvvatlaydigan DS-KV chaqiruv panellari. Modellar kamera aniqligi, form-faktori, qo'llab-quvvatlanadigan protokollar va integratsiya imkoniyatlari bilan farqlanadi.
- DS-KIS seriyasi komplektlari tizimni "quti ichidan" tayyor holda joriy etish imkonini beradi — tarkibiga chaqiruv paneli, ichki stansiya va zarur aksessuarlar kiradi. Bu masshtablash talab qilinmaydigan xususiy uylar va kichik ofislar uchun optimal tanlov.
- DS-KH8350 va DS-KH9310 seriyalari ichki stansiyalari yuqori aniqlikdagi sensorli ekranlar bilan jihozlangan, Wi-Fi ga ulanishni, Hik-Connect mobil ilovalari bilan integratsiyani va ko'p abonentli konfiguratsiyalarni qo'llab-quvvatlaydi — zamonaviy turar-joy majmualari va ofislar uchun mos.
- DS-KV9503 chaqiruv panellari himoyaga yuqori talablar qo'yiladigan tijorat obyektlari uchun mo'ljallangan: vandalizmga qarshi korpus, o'rnatilgan karta o'quvchisi, keng ko'rish burchakli videokamera va bir nechta chaqiruv tugmasini qo'llab-quvvatlash.

## FAQ

Q: Ko'p kvartirali uy uchun qaysi domofoniya turini tanlash kerak — analog yoki IP?
A: 20 va undan ortiq kvartirali ko'p kvartirali uylar uchun IP-domofoniya tavsiya etiladi: u oson masshtablanadi, smartfon orqali masofaviy kirishni qo'llab-quvvatlaydi va boshqa xavfsizlik tizimlari bilan integratsiyalashadi. Analog tizimlar faqat cheklangan byudjetli kichik obyektlar uchun oqlanadi.

Q: Domofonni mavjud videokuzatuv tizimiga ulash mumkinmi?
A: Ha, zamonaviy Hikvision IP-domofonlari videoregistratorlar va videokuzatuvni boshqarish dasturiy ta'minoti bilan integratsiyani qo'llab-quvvatlaydi. Chaqiruv panelidan videooqimni NVR ga yozib olish va kameralar bilan yagona interfeysda ko'rish mumkin.

Q: Toshkentda domofon tizimini montaj qilish qancha turadi?
A: Montaj narxi obyekt turi, kirish nuqtalari soni, kabel yo'llarining uzunligi va tanlangan jihozga bog'liq. Aniq hisob-kitob olish uchun obyektni tekshirish kerak — bepul maslahat va mutaxassisning chiqishi uchun SAT Solutions menejerlari bilan bog'laning.

Q: IP-domofon internetsiz ishlaydimi?
A: Bazaviy funksiyalar — chaqiruv, muzokaralar va eshikni ochish — internetga chiqmasdan lokal tarmoqda ishlaydi. Hik-Connect ilovasi orqali smartfondan masofaviy kirish uchun internet ulanishi yoki VPN sozlamalari talab qilinadi.

Q: Domofon jihozlariga qanday kafolat beriladi?
A: Rasmiy kanallar orqali yetkazib beriladigan Hikvision jihozlariga ishlab chiqaruvchi kafolati beriladi. SAT Solutions qo'shimcha ravishda montaj va ishga tushirish-sozlash ishlari sifatini kafolatlaydi. Aniq shartlarni kompaniya menejerlaridan aniqlang.
hik-intercoms.en:
Intercom systems are one of the key subsystems of access control and security for residential buildings, office centers, industrial facilities and any other buildings with organized access control. Intercom systems make it possible to identify a visitor before opening the door, record video of conversations, remotely control electromagnetic and electromechanical locks, and in modern IP solutions — integrate with mobile applications and security systems. Buying intercom equipment in Tashkent today is possible across a wide range: from simple analog kits for a private house to multi-apartment IP systems with a management server.

The choice of intercom system in Uzbekistan is determined by the type of facility and the scale of the task. For a private cottage or a small office, a "call panel plus indoor station" kit supporting one or several handsets is sufficient. For multi-apartment residential complexes, business centers and industrial enterprises, a full-fledged IP intercom system with a management server, support for dozens and hundreds of subscribers, and integration with ACS and security alarms is required. The SAT Solutions catalog features more than 50 intercom equipment items — from ready-made kits to individual components: call panels, indoor stations, access controllers and additional modules.

When designing an intercom system, it is important to determine the architecture in advance: analog or IP, the number of entrance groups and subscribers, the need for integration with other systems. An incorrectly selected system entails additional costs for reworking the cable infrastructure, so professional consultation and a well-drafted technical specification at the start save time and money.

## How to choose

- System type (analog or IP). Analog systems are simpler to install and cheaper, suitable for small facilities with a single entry point. IP intercom scales to any number of subscribers, supports remote access via smartphone and deep integration with other security systems.
- Number of subscribers and entry points. For one door and several handsets, a basic kit is sufficient. For a multi-apartment building or an office center with several entrances, an addressable system with a controller and server software is needed.
- Presence of a video camera in the call panel. A video panel makes it possible to identify a visitor visually, record to an NVR and review the archive. Choose panels with a wide-angle lens and IR illumination for nighttime operation.
- Lock control method. Systems can control electromagnetic and electromechanical locks and electric strikes. Clarify the type of lock at the facility and make sure it is compatible with the chosen intercom.
- Integration with a mobile application. Modern IP intercoms make it possible to receive a call and open the door from a smartphone — relevant for remote control and situations when the owner is away from home.
- Support for cards and access readers. If the facility already uses an ACS based on Mifare, Wiegand or other standard cards, make sure the call panel supports a built-in or connectable reader.
- Climatic design of the call panel. For outdoor installation, a protection rating of at least IP65, the presence of a vandal-proof housing and operability at low temperatures are important — especially relevant for facilities in regions of Uzbekistan with a harsh winter climate.

## Applications

- Multi-apartment residential buildings and residential complexes: organizing entry into stairwells, controlling visitors, communication with a concierge, remote door opening by residents.
- Private houses and cottage settlements: video monitoring of entrance gates and wickets, barrier control, integration with security alarms.
- Office and business centers: multi-subscriber intercom for organizing access control, integration with ACS and working-time tracking systems.
- Industrial enterprises and warehouses: access control at checkpoints, identification of vehicles and personnel, control of several entry points from a single center.
- Educational and medical institutions: differentiation of access between zones, control of the entry of patients and visitors, archiving of conversation recordings.
- Shopping centers and hotels: integration of intercom with the hotel or mall management system, organizing access to service zones.

## Brands and models in the catalog

- Hikvision — the main and widely represented brand in this category. The Hikvision DS-K intercom line covers all classes of solutions: ready-made DS-KIS series kits for rapid deployment in the private sector, DS-KH and DS-KD series IP video intercoms for multi-apartment and commercial facilities, as well as DS-KV call panels with support for card readers and video recording. The models differ in camera resolution, form factor, supported protocols and integration capabilities.
- DS-KIS series kits make it possible to deploy a ready-made system "out of the box" — the set includes a call panel, an indoor station and the necessary accessories. This is the optimal choice for private houses and small offices where scaling is not required.
- Indoor stations of the DS-KH8350 and DS-KH9310 series are equipped with high-resolution touch screens, support Wi-Fi connectivity, integration with Hik-Connect mobile applications and multi-subscriber configurations — suitable for modern residential complexes and offices.
- DS-KV9503 call panels are designed for commercial facilities with high security requirements: a vandal-proof housing, a built-in card reader, a video camera with a wide viewing angle and support for several call buttons.

## FAQ

Q: Which type of intercom to choose for a multi-apartment building — analog or IP?
A: For multi-apartment buildings with 20 or more apartments, an IP intercom is recommended: it scales easily, supports remote access via smartphone and integrates with other security systems. Analog systems are justified only for small facilities with a limited budget.

Q: Can an intercom be connected to an existing video surveillance system?
A: Yes, modern Hikvision IP intercoms support integration with video recorders and video surveillance management software. The video stream from the call panel can be recorded to an NVR and viewed in a single interface together with the cameras.

Q: How much does installing an intercom system cost in Tashkent?
A: The installation cost depends on the type of facility, the number of entry points, the length of the cable runs and the chosen equipment. To obtain an accurate calculation, a facility survey is required — contact SAT Solutions managers for a free consultation and a specialist's visit.

Q: Does an IP intercom work without the internet?
A: The basic functions — calling, conversation and door opening — work on the local network without internet access. For remote access from a smartphone via the Hik-Connect application, an internet connection or VPN setup is required.

Q: What warranty is provided for intercom equipment?
A: Hikvision equipment supplied through official channels is covered by the manufacturer's warranty. SAT Solutions additionally guarantees the quality of installation and commissioning work. Check the exact terms with the company's managers.

Yong'in xabar bergichlari — bu yong'in belgilarini: tutun, issiqlik, ochiq alanga yoki evakuatsiya vaqtidagi qo'lda bosishni aniqlaydigan avtomatik yong'in signalizatsiyasining birlamchi qurilmalaridir. Aynan xabar bergichning o'z vaqtida ishga tushishiga tizim odamlarni qanchalik tez ogohlantirishi va markaziy pultga signal uzatishi bog'liq. Ishlab chiqaruvchi kafolati va professional montaj bilan Toshkentda yong'in xabar bergichlarini sotib olishni SAT Solutions kompaniyasi taklif qiladi — O'zbekistonda xavfsizlik tizimlari uchun jihozlarning rasmiy yetkazib beruvchisi.

Zamonaviy yong'in xabar bergichlari bir necha asosiy turga bo'linadi. Dudli optik-elektron xabar bergichlar nazorat zonasida tutun zarralari paydo bo'lishiga reaksiya bildiradi — bu ofislar, turar-joy va savdo xonalari uchun eng keng tarqalgan tur. Issiqlik xabar bergichlari harorat chegarasidan oshib ketishini yoki haroratning keskin o'zgarishini qayd etadi, bu esa ayniqsa oshxonalar, qozonxonalar va tutun oddiy rejimda mavjud bo'lishi mumkin bo'lgan ishlab chiqarish sexlari uchun dolzarb. Qo'lda ishlatiladigan yong'in xabar bergichlari evakuatsiya yo'llari bo'ylab o'rnatiladi va odamlarga yong'inni aniqlaganda trevogani qo'lda ishga tushirish imkonini beradi. Manzilli va manzilli-analog modellar tizimga shunchaki trevoga faktini emas, balki ishga tushgan qurilmaning aniq manzilini ham uzatadi, bu esa yirik obyektlar uchun juda muhim.

Yong'in signalizatsiyasi loyihasini shakllantirishda xabar bergichlar turlarini to'g'ri birlashtirish, tizim topologiyasiga qarab manzilli yoki manzilsiz versiyalarni tanlash, shuningdek qo'llaniladigan boshqaruv qurilmasi bilan moslikni hisobga olish muhim. SAT Solutions mutaxassislari O'zbekiston Respublikasining yong'in xavfsizligi normativlariga muvofiq muayyan obyekt uchun jihozlarning optimal tarkibini tanlashga yordam beradi.

## Qanday tanlash kerak

- Aniqlash turi: dudli xabar bergichlar aksariyat xonalar uchun mos, issiqlik xabar bergichlari — yuqori changli yoki oddiy rejimda ochiq olov mavjud zonalar uchun, qo'lda ishlatiladiganlar esa evakuatsiya chiqishlari va zinapoyalar yonida majburiy tartibda joylashtiriladi.
- Manzillilik: manzilli va manzilli-analog xabar bergichlar tizimga ishga tushish joyini aniq belgilash va yong'inni nosozlikdan farqlash imkonini beradi. Ko'p xonali obyektlar uchun bu tubdan muhim.
- Boshqaruv qurilmasi bilan moslik: har bir xabar bergich muayyan kontroller liniyalari bilan ishlashga mo'ljallangan. Sotib olishdan oldin xabar bergich ishlatilayotgan ППКОП tomonidan qo'llab-quvvatlanishiga ishonch hosil qilish kerak.
- Xonaning maydoni va balandligi: normativlar xabar bergichlar sonini va turini nazorat zonasi maydoni va shift balandligidan kelib chiqib belgilaydi. Baland ishlab chiqarish xonalari uchun kengaytirilgan qamrov zonasiga ega modellar tanlanadi.
- Yong'in xavfsizligi sertifikati mavjudligi: O'zbekistonda sertifikatsiyadan o'tgan jihozlar qo'llanilishga ruxsat etiladi. Katalogimizdagi barcha qurilmalar zarur hujjatlarga ega.
- Ijro va himoya sinfi: nam xonalar, omborlar yoki ko'cha soyabonlari uchun korpusning tegishli chang-namlikdan himoyalanish darajasiga ega modellar kerak.
- Indikator va ovozli signalizatsiya mavjudligi: o'rnatilgan sirenali avtonom dudli xabar bergichlar markazlashtirilgan tizim yo'q joylarda — kichik ijaraga olingan ofislar, dala hovlilar, yordamchi xonalarda ishlatiladi.

## Qo'llanilish sohalari

- Ma'muriy va ofis binolari: yong'in xabar bergichlari erta aniqlash va xodimlarni tez evakuatsiya qilishni ta'minlash uchun har bir kabinet, koridor, server va texnik xonaga o'rnatiladi.
- Savdo markazlari va do'konlar: odamlar va tovar boyliklarining yuqori konsentratsiyasi ishonchli erta aniqlash tizimini talab qiladi; manzilli dudli va issiqlik xabar bergichlar bu yerda ajralmasdir.
- Ishlab chiqarish korxonalari va omborlar: issiqlik va dudli xabar bergichlar kombinatsiyasi turli muhit sharoitlariga ega zonalarni nazorat qilishni ta'minlaydi; qo'lda ishlatiladigan xabar bergichlar barcha avariya chiqishlari yonida joylashtiriladi.
- Turar-joy majmualari va mehmonxonalar: avtonom va manzilli dudli xabar bergichlar mehmonxona nomerlari, apartamentlar va umumiy zonalarni himoya qiladi, yong'in nazorati talablariga rioya qilishga yordam beradi.
- Tibbiyot muassasalari va maktablar: ishonchlilikka alohida talablar qo'yiladigan obyektlar bo'lib, bu yerda nol soxta trevoga va real yong'in paytida kafolatlangan ogohlantirish muhim.
- Madaniy va tarixiy meros obyektlari: yuqori sezuvchanlikka ega manzilli-analog tizimlar yong'inni eng erta bosqichda aniqlash imkonini beradi, qaytarilmas zarar xavfini kamaytiradi.

## Katalogdagi brendlar va modellar

- Рубеж — yong'in avtomatikasi jihozlarining yetakchi rossiyalik ishlab chiqaruvchisi bo'lib, SAT Solutions katalogida manzilli va manzilli-analog qurilmalarning keng liniyasi bilan taqdim etilgan. Рубеж mahsulotlari sertifikatsiyalangan va MDH bo'ylab, jumladan O'zbekistonda obyektlarda faol qo'llaniladi.
- Рубеж ИП 212 seriyasidagi dudli optik-elektron xabar bergichlar (ИП 212-45, ИП 212-141, ИП 212-187, ИП 212-64 modellari) keng sharoit diapazonida tutunni aniqlashni ta'minlaydi. ИП 212-64-R3 seriyasidagi manzilli-analog variantlar zamonaviy boshqaruv qurilmalarining manzilli shleyflari tarkibida ishlashga yo'naltirilgan.
- Рубеж ИП 101-29-PR seriyasidagi issiqlik yong'in xabar bergichlari manzilli tizimlarda ishlash uchun versiyalarda taqdim etilgan va shleyfni o'chirmasdan qulay montaj va almashtirish uchun bazaviy asoslar bilan komplektlanadi.
- Рубеж ИПР 513 seriyasidagi qo'lda ishlatiladigan yong'in xabar bergichlari manzilli va manzilsiz ijroda ishlab chiqariladi. Manzilli ИПР 513-11-А va ИПР 513-11ИКЗ-А-R3 modellari operator pultida trevogani qo'lda ishga tushirish nuqtasini tezkor aniqlash imkonini beradi.
- Рубеж ИП 212-142 avtonom dudli xabar bergichi o'rnatilgan ovozli sirena bilan jihozlangan va markazlashtirilgan tizimga ulanmasdan ishlaydi, bu esa uni yong'in avtomatikasi bo'lmagan xonalar uchun universal yechimga aylantiradi.

## FAQ

Q: Toshkentda Рубеж yong'in xabar bergichlari qancha turadi?

Q: Bitta tizimda manzilli va manzilsiz xabar bergichlarni aralashtirish mumkinmi?
A: Yo'q, manzilli va manzilsiz xabar bergichlar turli protokollar bo'yicha ishlaydi va bitta shleyfda mos kelmaydi. Xabar bergichlar turi qo'llaniladigan yong'in qabul-nazorat qurilmasi turi bilan belgilanadi.

Q: Oshxona yoki qozonxona uchun qaysi turdagi xabar bergichni tanlash kerak?
A: Tutun yoki bug' normal mavjud bo'lgan xonalarda issiqlik xabar bergichi tavsiya etiladi — u tutun zarralariga emas, balki haroratga reaksiya bildiradi, bu esa soxta ishga tushishlarni istisno qiladi. Mutaxassislarimiz xona parametrlari bo'yicha mos modelni tanlaydi.

Q: O'zbekistonda yong'in signalizatsiyasini montaj qilish uchun litsenziya kerakmi?
A: Ha, yong'in avtomatikasi tizimlarini montaj qilishni tegishli ruxsatga ega tashkilot bajarishi kerak. SAT Solutions zarur hujjatlarga ega va bajarilgan ishlar sifati uchun javobgardir.

Q: Xabar bergichlar va montaj ishlariga qanday kafolat beriladi?
A: Рубеж jihozlariga ishlab chiqaruvchi kafolati amal qiladi. Montaj ishlariga SAT Solutions o'z kafolatini beradi; batafsil shartlarni shartnoma tuzishda menejerdan aniqlang.

Fire detectors are the primary devices of automatic fire alarm systems that detect signs of a fire: smoke, heat, an open flame, or a manual press during evacuation. It is precisely the timely triggering of the detector that determines how quickly the system will alert people and transmit a signal to the central console. SAT Solutions — the official supplier of security-systems equipment in Uzbekistan — offers to buy fire detectors in Tashkent with a manufacturer's warranty and professional installation.

Modern fire detectors are divided into several main types. Optical-electronic smoke detectors respond to the appearance of smoke particles in the monitored zone — this is the most common type for offices, residential and retail premises. Heat detectors register exceeding a temperature threshold or a sharp temperature change, which is especially relevant for kitchens, boiler rooms and production workshops where smoke may be present under normal conditions. Manual fire detectors are mounted along evacuation routes and allow people to manually trigger an alarm upon discovering a fire. Addressable and addressable-analog models transmit to the system not just the fact of an alarm but the exact address of the triggered device, which is critically important for large facilities.

When forming a fire alarm design, it is important to correctly combine detector types, choose addressable or non-addressable versions depending on the system topology, and take into account compatibility with the control panel used. SAT Solutions specialists help select the optimal set of equipment for a specific facility in accordance with the fire safety regulations of the Republic of Uzbekistan.

## How to choose

- Detection type: smoke detectors are suitable for most premises, heat detectors — for zones with high dust content or the presence of open fire under normal conditions, and manual detectors are placed at evacuation exits and stairwells on a mandatory basis.
- Addressability: addressable and addressable-analog detectors allow the system to precisely determine the location of triggering and distinguish a fire from a malfunction. For facilities with a large number of premises, this is fundamentally important.
- Compatibility with the control panel: each detector is designed to work with specific controller lines. Before procurement, you must make sure the detector is supported by the fire control-and-receiving panel in use.
- Area and height of the premises: regulations determine the number and type of detectors based on the area of the monitored zone and the ceiling height. For tall production premises, models with an enlarged coverage zone are chosen.
- Presence of a fire safety certificate: in Uzbekistan, equipment that has passed certification is approved for use. All devices in our catalog have the necessary documentation.
- Design and protection class: for damp premises, warehouses or outdoor canopies, models with an appropriate degree of dust and moisture protection of the housing are needed.
- Presence of an indicator and sound alarm: standalone smoke detectors with a built-in siren are used where there is no centralized system — in small rented offices, dachas, and utility rooms.

## Applications

- Administrative and office buildings: fire detectors are mounted in every office, corridor, server room and technical room to ensure early detection and rapid evacuation of personnel.
- Shopping centers and stores: the high concentration of people and merchandise values requires a reliable early-detection system; addressable smoke and heat detectors are indispensable here.
- Production enterprises and warehouses: a combination of heat and smoke detectors provides control over zones with various environmental conditions; manual detectors are placed at all emergency exits.
- Residential complexes and hotels: standalone and addressable smoke detectors protect hotel rooms, apartments and common areas, helping to comply with fire-supervision requirements.
- Medical institutions and schools: facilities with special reliability requirements, where zero false alarms and guaranteed alerting in the event of a real fire are critical.
- Cultural and historical heritage sites: addressable-analog systems with high sensitivity make it possible to detect a fire at the earliest stage, reducing the risk of irreversible damage.

## Brands and models in the catalog

- Rubezh — a leading Russian manufacturer of fire automation equipment, represented in the SAT Solutions catalog by a wide line of addressable and addressable-analog devices. Rubezh products are certified and actively used at facilities throughout the CIS, including Uzbekistan.
- Rubezh optical-electronic smoke detectors of the IP 212 series (models IP 212-45, IP 212-141, IP 212-187, IP 212-64) provide smoke detection across a wide range of conditions. The addressable-analog variants of the IP 212-64-R3 series are oriented toward operation within the addressable loops of modern control panels.
- Rubezh heat fire detectors of the IP 101-29-PR series come in versions for operation in addressable systems and are supplied with base mounts for convenient installation and replacement without disconnecting the loop.
- Rubezh manual fire detectors of the IPR 513 series are produced in addressable and non-addressable versions. The addressable models IPR 513-11-A and IPR 513-11IKZ-A-R3 make it possible to promptly determine the point of manual alarm initiation on the operator's console.
- The Rubezh IP 212-142 standalone smoke detector is equipped with a built-in sound siren and operates without connection to a centralized system, which makes it a universal solution for premises without fire automation.

## FAQ

Q: How much do Rubezh fire detectors cost in Tashkent?
A: The price depends on the type and design of the device — standalone and non-addressable models are cheaper, addressable-analog ones are more expensive. Current prices are indicated in the SAT Solutions catalog; to calculate the cost of a set for your facility, contact a manager.

Q: Can addressable and non-addressable detectors be mixed in a single system?
A: No, addressable and non-addressable detectors operate on different protocols and are incompatible in a single loop. The type of detectors is determined by the type of fire receiving-and-control panel used.

Q: Which type of detector to choose for a kitchen or boiler room?
A: In premises with a normal presence of smoke or steam, a heat detector is recommended — it responds to temperature rather than to smoke particles, which eliminates false triggers. Our specialists will select a suitable model according to the parameters of the premises.

Q: Is a license required for installing fire alarms in Uzbekistan?
A: Yes, the installation of fire automation systems must be performed by an organization that has the appropriate permit. SAT Solutions has the necessary documents and bears responsibility for the quality of the work performed.

Q: What is the warranty on detectors and installation work?
A: Rubezh equipment is covered by the manufacturer's warranty. SAT Solutions provides its own warranty on installation work; check the detailed terms with a manager when concluding a contract.

Qurilmalar va modullar — bu har qanday qo'riqlash-yong'in signalizatsiyasi va kompleks xavfsizlik tizimining markaziy bo'g'inidir. Ushbu toifaga aloqa liniyalari kontrollerlari, boshqaruv bloklari, nazorat va indikatsiya bloklari, signal-ishga tushirish bloklari, manzil dasturchilari va interfeys o'zgartirgichlari kiradi — ya'ni datchiklar, ijro etuvchi qurilmalar va dasturiy ta'minotning yagona tizimda muvofiqlashtirilgan ishini ta'minlaydigan hamma narsa. To'g'ri tanlangan qurilmalar va modullarsiz hatto eng zamonaviy xabar bergichlar va ogohlantirgichlar ham o'z funksiyalarini ishonchli va avtomatik rejimda bajara olmaydi.

Xavfsizlik tizimlari uchun Toshkentda qurilmalar va modullar sotib olish — muayyan obyekt arxitekturasini tushunishni talab qiladigan vazifa. Kichik ofis va yirik savdo markazi, sanoat korxonasi va turar-joy majmuasi kontrollerlar unumdorligiga, ulanadigan shleyflar soniga, ma'lumot almashish protokollariga va rezervlashtirish darajasiga turli talablar qo'yadi. Aynan shu sababli jihozlarni tanlash narx bo'yicha emas, balki loyihalashdan boshlanishi kerak. SAT Solutions katalogida istalgan ko'lamdagi obyektlar uchun qurilmalar va modullar taqdim etilgan — kichik savdo nuqtalaridan tortib O'zbekiston bo'ylab yirik ishlab chiqarish va ma'muriy binolargacha.

Zamonaviy tizimlar tobora ko'proq manzilli protokollar asosida quriladi, bu yerda har bir qurilma va datchik tarmoqda noyob identifikatorga ega. Bu trevoga manbaini aniq lokalizatsiya qilish, soxta ishga tushishlarni minimallashtirish va diagnostikani sezilarli darajada soddalashtirish imkonini beradi. Aloqa liniyalari kontrollerlari, boshqaruv bloklari va interfeys o'zgartirgichlari obyektning "asab tizimini" tashkil etadi — favqulodda vaziyatga reaksiya tezligi ularning sifatiga bevosita bog'liq.

## Qanday tanlash kerak

- Tizim topologiyasi va protokol: tizim manzilli yoki chegaraviy tamoyilda qurilishini aniqlang. Manzilli kontrollerlar (masalan, С2000 seriyasi) ikki simli liniya bo'ylab yuzlab qurilmalarni har birini aniq identifikatsiya qilish bilan ulash imkonini beradi.
- Kontroller sig'imi: hozir va kengaytirish istiqbolida ulanishi kerak bo'lgan manzilli qurilmalar sonini baholang. Aloqa liniyalari kontrollerlari qo'llab-quvvatlanadigan manzillar soni bo'yicha farqlanadi — bu yirik obyektlar uchun kalit parametr.
- Markaziy qurilma bilan moslik: boshqaruv, indikatsiya va signal-ishga tushirish modullari yagona ekotizimda ishlashi kerak. Mos kelmaydigan liniyalarni aralashtirish integratsiya va boshqaruv bilan bog'liq muammolarga olib keladi.
- Aloqa interfeyslari: dispetcher kompyuteriga yoki monitoring tizimiga ulanish uchun qo'llab-quvvatlanadigan interfeyslar muhim — RS-485, USB, Ethernet. Interfeys o'zgartirgichlari jihozlarni ARM va dasturiy ta'minot bilan integratsiyalash imkonini beradi.
- Ta'minot va rezervlashtirish: ishchi kuchlanishni (12/24 V yoki 220 V) va o'rnatilgan rezerv ta'minot mavjudligini aniqlang. 220 V ijrodagi signal-ishga tushirish bloklari quvvatli ijro etuvchi qurilmalarni boshqarish uchun mos.
- Ekspluatatsiya sharoitlari: sanoat obyektlari yoki ko'cha shchitlari uchun ishchi harorat diapazoni va korpus himoya darajasi muhim.
- Dasturlash va sozlash: konfiguratsiya qulayligini baholang — ba'zi qurilmalar alohida manzil dasturchisini talab qiladi, boshqalari kompyuterdan USB orqali dasturiy ta'minot yordamida sozlanadi.

- Turar-joy majmualari va mehmonxonalar: navbatchi xodimlar oldidagi nazorat va indikatsiya bloklarida holatni aks ettirish bilan ko'plab zonalarni markazlashtirilgan monitoring.

- Болид yordamchi qurilmalari: С2000-АПА manzil dasturchisi manzilli xabar bergichlar va modullarni sozlashni soddalashtiradi, interfeys o'zgartirgichlari (USB-RS485 va С2000-USB) esa jihozlarning dispetcher kompyuteri yoki monitoring tizimi bilan aloqasini ta'minlaydi.

## FAQ

Devices and modules are the central link of any security and fire alarm system and integrated security. This category includes communication-line controllers, control units, monitoring and indication units, signal-and-trigger units, address programmers and interface converters — that is, everything that ensures the coordinated operation of sensors, actuators and software in a single system. Without well-selected devices and modules, even the most modern detectors and annunciators cannot perform their functions reliably and in automatic mode.

Buying devices and modules in Tashkent for security systems is a task that requires an understanding of the architecture of the specific facility. A small office and a large shopping center, an industrial enterprise and a residential complex place different requirements on controller performance, the number of connected loops, data-exchange protocols and the degree of redundancy. That is precisely why equipment selection should begin with design, not with a choice by price. The SAT Solutions catalog features devices and modules for facilities of any scale — from small retail outlets to large industrial and administrative buildings throughout Uzbekistan.

Modern systems are increasingly built on addressable protocols, where each device and sensor has a unique identifier in the network. This makes it possible to precisely localize the source of an alarm, minimize false triggers and significantly simplify diagnostics. Communication-line controllers, control units and interface converters form the "nervous system" of a facility — and the speed of response to an abnormal situation directly depends on their quality.

## How to choose

- System topology and protocol: determine whether the system is built on an addressable or threshold principle. Addressable controllers (for example, the S2000 series) make it possible to connect hundreds of devices over a two-wire line with precise identification of each.
- Controller capacity: assess the number of addressable devices that need to be connected now and in the perspective of expansion. Communication-line controllers differ in the number of supported addresses — this is a key parameter for large facilities.
- Compatibility with the central device: control, indication and signal-and-trigger modules must operate within a single ecosystem. Mixing incompatible lines leads to problems with integration and management.
- Communication interfaces: for connection to the dispatcher's computer or a monitoring system, the supported interfaces are important — RS-485, USB, Ethernet. Interface converters make it possible to integrate equipment with an operator workstation and software.
- Power and redundancy: clarify the operating voltage (12/24 V or 220 V) and the presence of built-in backup power. Signal-and-trigger units in the 220 V version are suitable for controlling powerful actuators.
- Operating conditions: for industrial facilities or outdoor cabinets, the operating temperature range and the housing protection rating are important.
- Programming and configuration: assess the convenience of configuration — some devices require a separate address programmer, others are configured via software from a computer over USB.

## Applications

- Administrative and office buildings: integration of fire alarms, access control and alerting into a single management system through controllers and indication units.
- Shopping centers and hypermarkets: addressable systems with a large number of devices, where the precision of determining the alarm zone is critically important for evacuation.
- Industrial enterprises and warehouses: management of process operations, fire suppression and smoke removal through signal-and-trigger units with 220 V support.
- Residential complexes and hotels: centralized monitoring of many zones with the display of status on monitoring and indication units for the duty staff.
- Critical infrastructure facilities: banks, server rooms, government institutions — where high reliability and a detailed event log with transmission to the security console are required.

## Brands and models in the catalog

- Bolid (Russia): the main represented manufacturer in this category. The company specializes in integrated security systems and produces a wide line of compatible devices.
- The S2000 series: the S2000-KDL communication-line controllers ensure the operation of the addressable network, the S2000-SP4 control units (in 24 V and 220 V versions) control actuators, and the S2000-BKI monitoring and indication units display the system status to the operator.
- Bolid auxiliary devices: the S2000-APA address programmer simplifies the configuration of addressable detectors and modules, and the interface converters (USB-RS485 and S2000-USB) provide communication between the equipment and the dispatcher's computer or a monitoring system.
- Ecosystem approach: all Bolid devices and modules are designed for joint operation within a single integrated system, which simplifies the design and subsequent maintenance of the facility.

## FAQ

Q: Can devices and modules be bought without installation, only the equipment?
A: Yes, SAT Solutions supplies equipment both for third-party installation organizations and for the customer's own technical services. At the same time, the company's specialists are ready to advise on the selection of compatible components.

Q: Are Bolid devices compatible with equipment from other manufacturers?
A: S2000 series devices support the RS-485 protocol and can be integrated with a number of third-party systems through interface converters. However, for full addressable operation it is recommended to use devices within a single ecosystem — this guarantees the correct interaction of all components.

Q: How many addressable devices can be connected to a single communication-line controller?
A: The capacity depends on the specific controller model. Before choosing, you need to determine the total number of planned addressable devices with a reserve for expansion — SAT Solutions specialists will help select the optimal option for your facility.

Q: What is the warranty on devices and modules?
A: The warranty period is determined by the manufacturer and, as a rule, ranges from 12 to 36 months depending on the model. SAT Solutions provides warranty support throughout the entire warranty period and ensures the replacement of faulty equipment.

Q: Is special software required to configure Bolid devices?
A: Yes, the configuration of most S2000 series devices is performed using the manufacturer's proprietary software. To connect to a computer, USB-RS485 or S2000-USB interface converters, included in the SAT Solutions catalog, are used.

Ogohlantirish tizimlari — bu har qanday binoning xavfsizligining infratuzilmaviy asosidir: ular ovozli xabarlar va trevoga signallarini bir necha soniyada uzatib, uyushtirilgan evakuatsiyani va xodimlar hamda tashrif buyuruvchilarni tezkor xabardor qilishni ta'minlaydi. SAT Solutions katalogida translyatsion va avariya ogohlantirish tizimlarini qurish uchun jihozlar taqdim etilgan: turli quvvatdagi devor va shift dinamiklari, ovoz kuchaytirgichlar, mikrofonlar va yordamchi texnika. Bularning barchasi ofisdagi oddiy fon musiqasini ham, yirik sanoat yoki savdo obyektidagi ko'p zonali favqulodda ogohlantirish tizimini ham amalga oshirish imkonini beradi.

O'zbekistonda ogohlantirish tizimlariga talab barqaror o'sib bormoqda: qurilish normalari va yong'in xavfsizligi talablari jamoat va ishlab chiqarish binolarini trevoga signallarini translyatsiya qilish tizimlari bilan jihozlashni majbur qiladi. Toshkentda sifat kafolati va professional montaj bilan ogohlantirish uchun jihoz sotib olishni SAT Solutions da amalga oshirish mumkin — bu kompaniya butun mamlakat bo'ylab obyektlar bilan ishlaydi va kompleks jihozlashda boy tajribaga ega. Katalogda quvvatlar va form-faktorlarning keng diapazonini qamrab oluvchi 24 pozitsiyadagi yechimlar taqdim etilgan.

Jihozlarni tanlashda akustik yukni to'g'ri hisoblash muhim: kuchaytirgichning yetarli bo'lmagan quvvati nutqning yomon tushunarliligiga, ortiqchasi esa keraksiz xarajatlar va dinamiklarning shikastlanish xavfiga olib keladi. Komplektni to'g'ri tanlash — dinamiklar, kuchaytirgich, mikrofon, kabel yo'li — tizim real ekspluatatsiya sharoitlarida qanchalik ishonchli va sifatli ishlashini belgilaydi.

## Qanday tanlash kerak

- Dinamiklar quvvati va soni: har bir dinamikning quvvati (3 Vt, 10 Vt, 20 Vt, 40 Vt) va ularning soni kuchaytirgichga tushadigan umumiy yukni belgilaydi. To'g'ri komplektni tanlash uchun xonalar maydoni va balandligini, fon shovqini darajasini va talab qilinadigan tovush bosimi darajasini hisoblash kerak.
- Dinamik turi — devor yoki shift: devor dinamiklari (masalan, 10 Vt ZT-507 yoki 40 Vt MC-640) koridorlar, zinapoyalar va xonalar perimetri uchun mos; shift dinamiklari (MC-17, DS-QAE0203G1E-V) osma shiftli savdo zallari, ofislar va auditoriyalar uchun optimal.
- Kuchaytirgich quvvati: kuchaytirgich barcha ulangan dinamiklarning umumiy quvvatini kamida 20-30% zaxira bilan qoplashi kerak. Katalogda 45 Vt (MC-40A) dan 350 Vt gacha bo'lgan modellar taqdim etilgan, bu esa istalgan ko'lamdagi — kichik ofisdan savdo markazigacha — tizimlarni qurish imkonini beradi.
- Zonalar soni: yirik obyektlar uchun turli xabarlarni bino turli qismlariga bir vaqtda translyatsiya qilish imkonini beradigan ko'p zonali tizim kerak. Qancha mustaqil zona kerak bo'lishini oldindan aniqlang.
- Tovush sifati va nutq tushunarliligi: favqulodda ogohlantirish tizimlari uchun faqat baland ovoz emas, balki nutq signalining tushunarliligi muhim. Tegishli akustik xususiyatlarga ega jihozlarni tanlang.
- Mikrofon va signal manbalari: tezkor e'lon uchun stol usti yoki statsionar mikrofon (masalan, COOMA), qo'shimcha manbalarni (CD/MP3, yong'in paneli, telefon) ulash imkoniyati.
- Ishonchlilik va ekspluatatsiya sharoitlari: sanoat va ko'cha zonalari uchun chang va namlikka chidamli himoya korpuslariga ega dinamiklar kerak. Turar-joy va ofis xonalari uchun standart modellar mos.

## Qo'llanilish sohalari

- Savdo markazlari va supermarketlar: savdo zallari va avtoturargohlarda fon musiqasi, reklama e'lonlari va avariya ogohlantirishi.
- Ofis va biznes-markazlar: xodimlarni xabardor qilish, muzokaralarni translyatsiya qilish, yong'in yoki evakuatsiya paytida ogohlantirish.
- Ishlab chiqarish korxonalari va omborlar: shovqinli sexlarda ogohlantirish oshirilgan quvvatli dinamiklar va chiqish signali zaxirali kuchaytirgichlarni talab qiladi.
- O'quv yurtlari va tibbiyot muassasalari: maktablar, universitetlar, kasalxonalar — ko'p xonalarga bir vaqtda ovozli xabarlarni aniq translyatsiya qilish zarur bo'lgan joylar.
- Mehmonxonalar va ko'ngilochar majmualar: fon ovoz berish, mehmonlar uchun axborot e'lonlari va avariya ogohlantirish tizimlari.
- Transport infratuzilmasi va jamoat maydonlari: vokzallar, aeroportlar, savdo ko'chalari — yuqori o'tuvchanlik va tovush bosimi darajasiga oshirilgan talablar qo'yiladigan obyektlar.

## Katalogdagi brendlar va modellar

- Devor dinamiklari: katalogda 3-6 Vt (ZT-515) dan 40 Vt (MC-640) gacha quvvatdagi modellar taqdim etilgan bo'lib, koridorlar, zinapoyalar va ochiq zonalarda o'rnatishga mo'ljallangan. Ixcham ZT-507 (10 Vt) modellari past fon shovqini darajasiga ega kichik xonalar uchun mos.
- Shift dinamiklari: MC-17 seriyasi (20-30 Vt, Premium, ramkasiz) va DS-QAE0203G1E-V modellari Armstrong turidagi osma shiftlarga montaj qilish uchun mo'ljallangan. Shuningdek, girlyanda ulash sxemalari uchun 3-6 Vt quvvatdagi tejamkor shift modellari mavjud.
- DD80 stol usti dinamigi (35 Vt): dispetcher punktlari, muzokara xonalari va yuqori sifatli ijro talab qilinadigan kichik zallar uchun yirik pol yoki stol usti akustikasi.
- Quvvat kuchaytirgichlari: liniya kichik obyektlar uchun MC-40A (45 Vt) modellari va yirik ko'p zonali tizimlar uchun 250-350 Vt kuchaytirgichlarni qamrab oladi. Bu yechimni istalgan obyektga masshtablash imkonini beradi.
- COOMA mikrofoni: operatorning tezkor ovozli e'lonlari uchun stol usti mikrofoni bo'lib, katalogda taqdim etilgan kuchaytirgichlar bilan mos keladi.

## FAQ

Q: Kalit ostidagi ogohlantirish tizimi qancha turadi?
A: Narx obyekt maydoni, zonalar soni, talab qilinadigan quvvat va kabel yo'lining murakkabligiga bog'liq. Kichik ofis uchun bu bir necha yuz dollar bo'lishi mumkin, savdo markazi uchun — ancha ko'p. SAT Solutions mutaxassislaridan hisob-kitob so'rang — bu bepul.

Q: Ogohlantirish tizimini yong'in nazorati bilan kelishish kerakmi?
A: Ha, O'zbekistonda yong'in paytidagi avariya ogohlantirish tizimlari davlat yong'in nazorati organlari bilan kelishilishi lozim. SAT Solutions zarur loyiha hujjatlarini tayyorlashga yordam beradi.

Q: Ogohlantirish tizimini yong'in signalizatsiyasi bilan integratsiyalash mumkinmi?
A: Ha, bu standart amaliyot: yong'in paneli ishga tushganda tizim avtomatik ravishda trevoga signali va evakuatsiya bo'yicha ovozli ko'rsatmalar translyatsiyasiga o'tadi. Bunday integratsiya tizimni ishlab chiqish bosqichida loyihalashtiriladi.

Q: 500 kv. m ofis uchun qaysi kuchaytirgichni tanlash kerak?
A: Bunday obyekt uchun, qoida tariqasida, 45-100 Vt quvvatdagi kuchaytirgich va 10-20 Vt li 10-15 shift dinamigi yetarli. Aniq hisob-kitob rejalashtirish, shift balandligi va shovqin darajasiga bog'liq — SAT Solutions mutaxassisi obyektni ko'rgach tanlov tuzadi.

Q: Jihozlarga qanday kafolat beriladi?
A: Jihozlarga kafolat muddati, qoida tariqasida, ishlab chiqaruvchiga qarab 12 oy va undan ortiq bo'ladi. Montaj ishlariga SAT Solutions ham kafolat beradi. Shartlarni buyurtma rasmiylashtirishda aniqlang.

Public address and alerting systems are the infrastructure foundation of any building's security: they transmit voice messages and alarm signals in a matter of seconds, ensuring organized evacuation and prompt informing of staff and visitors. The SAT Solutions catalog features equipment for building broadcast and emergency alerting systems: wall and ceiling speakers of various power, sound amplifiers, microphones and auxiliary equipment. All of this makes it possible to implement both simple background music in an office and a multi-zone emergency alerting system at a large industrial or retail facility.

Demand for alerting systems in Uzbekistan is steadily growing: building codes and fire safety requirements make it mandatory to equip public and industrial buildings with alarm-signal broadcast systems. You can buy alerting equipment in Tashkent with a quality warranty and professional installation at SAT Solutions — a company that works with facilities throughout the country and has extensive experience in comprehensive equipping. The catalog features solutions across 24 items, covering a wide range of power ratings and form factors.

When choosing equipment, it is important to correctly calculate the acoustic load: insufficient amplifier power will lead to poor speech intelligibility, while excessive power leads to unnecessary costs and the risk of damaging the speakers. A well-considered selection of the set — speakers, amplifier, microphone, cable run — determines how reliably and with what quality the system will operate under real operating conditions.

## How to choose

- Power and number of speakers: the power of each speaker (3 W, 10 W, 20 W, 40 W) and their number determine the total load on the amplifier. It is necessary to calculate the area and height of the premises, the background noise level and the required sound pressure level in order to choose the correct set.
- Speaker type — wall or ceiling: wall speakers (for example, 10 W ZT-507 or 40 W MC-640) are suitable for corridors, stairwells and the perimeter of premises; ceiling speakers (MC-17, DS-QAE0203G1E-V) are optimal for sales areas, offices and auditoriums with suspended ceilings.
- Amplifier power: the amplifier must cover the total power of all connected speakers with a reserve of at least 20-30%. The catalog features models from 45 W (MC-40A) to 350 W, which makes it possible to build systems of any scale — from a small office to a shopping center.
- Number of zones: for large facilities a multi-zone system is needed, allowing different messages to be broadcast to different parts of the building simultaneously. Clarify in advance how many independent zones will be required.
- Sound quality and speech intelligibility: for emergency alerting systems the intelligibility of the speech signal is critical, not just loudness. Choose equipment with the appropriate acoustic characteristics.
- Microphone and signal sources: a desktop or fixed microphone (for example, COOMA) for prompt announcements, and the ability to connect additional sources (CD/MP3, fire panel, telephone).
- Reliability and operating conditions: for industrial and outdoor zones, speakers with protective housings resistant to dust and moisture are needed. For residential and office premises, standard models are suitable.

## Applications

- Shopping centers and supermarkets: background music, advertising announcements and emergency alerting in sales areas and parking lots.
- Office and business centers: informing employees, broadcasting announcements, alerting in the event of a fire or evacuation.
- Production enterprises and warehouses: alerting in noisy workshops requires higher-power speakers and amplifiers with an output-signal reserve.
- Educational institutions and medical facilities: schools, universities, hospitals — where clear broadcasting of voice messages to many rooms simultaneously is necessary.
- Hotels and entertainment complexes: background sound, informational announcements for guests and emergency alerting systems.
- Transport infrastructure and public spaces: railway stations, airports, shopping streets — facilities with high foot traffic and elevated requirements for sound pressure level.

## Brands and models in the catalog

- Wall speakers: the catalog features models with power from 3-6 W (ZT-515) to 40 W (MC-640), designed for installation in corridors, stairwells and open zones. Compact ZT-507 (10 W) models are suitable for small premises with a low background noise level.
- Ceiling speakers: models of the MC-17 series (20-30 W, Premium, frameless) and DS-QAE0203G1E-V are intended for installation in Armstrong-type suspended ceilings. Economical ceiling models with a power of 3-6 W for daisy-chain connection schemes are also available.
- DD80 desktop speaker (35 W): large floor-standing or desktop acoustics for dispatch points, meeting rooms and small halls where high playback quality is required.
- Power amplifiers: the line covers models from MC-40A (45 W) for small facilities to 250-350 W amplifiers for large multi-zone systems. This makes it possible to scale the solution to any facility.
- COOMA microphone: a desktop microphone for prompt voice announcements by the operator, compatible with the amplifiers featured in the catalog.

## FAQ

Q: How much does a turnkey alerting system cost?
A: The cost depends on the area of the facility, the number of zones, the required power and the complexity of the cable run. For a small office it may be several hundred dollars, for a shopping center — significantly more. Request a calculation from SAT Solutions specialists — it is free.

Q: Is coordination of the alerting system with fire supervision required?
A: Yes, in Uzbekistan emergency fire-alerting systems are subject to coordination with the state fire supervision authorities. SAT Solutions helps prepare the necessary design documentation.

Q: Can the alerting system be integrated with a fire alarm?
A: Yes, this is standard practice: when the fire panel triggers, the system automatically switches to broadcasting an alarm signal and voice evacuation instructions. Such integration is designed at the stage of system development.

Q: Which amplifier to choose for an office of 500 sq. m?
A: For such a facility, as a rule, an amplifier with a power of 45-100 W and 10-15 ceiling speakers of 10-20 W each is sufficient. The exact calculation depends on the layout, ceiling height and noise level — a SAT Solutions specialist will compile a selection after inspecting the facility.

Q: What is the warranty on the equipment?
A: The warranty period for the equipment is, as a rule, 12 months and more depending on the manufacturer. SAT Solutions also provides a warranty on installation work. Check the terms when placing an order.

Marshrutizatorlar — kichik ofis, savdo nuqtasi, ombor yoki turar-joy majmuasi bo'ladimi, har qanday zamonaviy tarmoqning kalit elementidir. Aynan shu qurilma internet-trafikni qurilmalar o'rtasida taqsimlaydi, simsiz qamrovni tashkil etadi va ulanish ustuvorliklarini boshqaradi. SAT Solutions katalogida Mercusys marshrutizatorlari taqdim etilgan — bu brend ortida TP-Link ning ko'p yillik muhandislik maktabi turadi. Toshkentda oqilona narxda marshrutizator sotib olish va shu bilan birga rasmiy kafolatli ishonchli tarmoq jihozini olishni aynan shu yerda amalga oshirish mumkin.

Marshrutizatorni tanlash bir necha omilga bog'liq: obyekt maydoni, bir vaqtdagi foydalanuvchilar soni, simli internet mavjudligi yoki 4G mobil tarmoq orqali ishlash zarurati. 50-70 kv. m gacha bo'lgan kichik xonalar uchun Wi-Fi 5 yoki Wi-Fi 6 ni qo'llab-quvvatlaydigan ixcham model yetarli. Yirik ofislar, do'konlar yoki ishlab chiqarish uchastkalari uchun bir nechta diapazon va yuqori o'tkazish qobiliyatiga ega qurilmalar kerak — masalan, uch diapazonli Wi-Fi 7 marshrutizatorlari. Alohida segment — o'rnatilgan modemga ega 4G-marshrutizatorlar: ular barqaror simli ulanish bo'lmagan yoki rezerv aloqa kanali kerak bo'lgan joylarda ajralmasdir.

Katalogimizda taqdim etilgan Mercusys liniyasida barcha dolzarb standartlar qamrab olingan: arzon ikki diapazonli modellardan tortib Wi-Fi 7 ni qo'llab-quvvatlash va kanallar agregatsiyasiga ega flagman qurilmalargacha. Bunday xilma-xillik istalgan byudjet va istalgan infratuzilma uchun jihoz tanlash imkonini beradi. SAT Solutions marshrutizatorlarni butun O'zbekiston bo'ylab yetkazib beradi va tarmoqlarni kalit ostida montaj qilishni o'z zimmasiga oladi.

## Qanday tanlash kerak

- Diapazonlar: ikki diapazonli modellar (2,4 + 5 GGts) aksariyat vazifalarni yopadi; uch diapazonli (2,4 + 5 + 6 GGts, Mercusys MR47BE dagidek) maksimal o'tkazish qobiliyati va xalaqitlarni minimallashtirish uchun kerak.
- Internetga ulanish turi: agar binoda kabel provayder bo'lsa — WAN-portli standart marshrutizator yetarli; agar barqaror "o'ralgan juftlik" bo'lmasa yoki rezerv kerak bo'lsa — SIM-karta uchun slotli 4G-marshrutizatorni tanlang (Mercusys MT110, MB115-4G).
- Qamrov zonasi: xona maydoni va devor materialini baholang. Temir-beton perekritiyali obyektlar uchun quvvatli model yoki qo'shimcha kirish nuqtalari kerak bo'ladi.
- Portlar tezligi: gigabit internet uchun Gigabit LAN/WAN portli marshrutizatorlar kerak — sotib olishdan oldin xususiyatlarni tekshiring.
- Bir vaqtdagi ulanishlar soni: 20+ xodimli ofislarda yoki ko'p sonli IoT-qurilmalar va videokuzatuv kameralariga ega obyektlarda MU-MIMO va OFDMA ni qo'llab-quvvatlaydigan modellarni tanlang.

## Qo'llanilish sohalari

- Ofislar va biznes-markazlar: ishchi stansiyalar, IP-telefoniya va videokuzatuv tizimlari uchun barqaror internetni ta'minlash.
- Savdo obyektlari: kassa terminallari, POS-tizimlar va xaridorlarning mehmon kirishi uchun Wi-Fi ni tashkil etish.
- Ishlab chiqarish va ombor xonalari: katta maydonlarni qamrab olish, shtrix-kod skanerlari va sanoat kontrollerlarini ulash.
- Turar-joy majmualari va xususiy uylar: uy va mehmon qurilmalari uchun alohida tarmoqli yuqori tezlikli uy interneti.
- Uzoq obyektlar va qurilish maydonchalari: kabel internet bo'lmagan joylarda asosiy yoki rezerv kanal sifatida 4G-marshrutizatorlar.
- Xavfsizlik tizimlari: IP-videokuzatuv, kirishni nazorat qilish va qo'riqlash signalizatsiyasi infratuzilmasining bir qismi sifatida marshrutizatorlar.

## Katalogdagi brendlar va modellar

- Mercusys — TP-Link ning sho'ba brendi bo'lib, arzon, ammo texnologik jihatdan dolzarb tarmoq jihozlariga yo'naltirilgan. Qurilmalar ona kompaniyaning flagman mahsulotlari bilan bir xil ishlab chiqarish va sinov bazasidan o'tadi.
- Wi-Fi 6 liniyasi MR60X, MR1500X, MR50G va MR80X modellarini o'z ichiga oladi — ular 2,4 va 5 GGts diapazonlarida yuqori tezlikni ta'minlaydi va o'rtacha zichlikdagi ko'p vazifali tarmoqlar bilan yaxshi ishlaydi.
- Wi-Fi 7 ikki diapazonli MR25BE va uch diapazonli MR47BE modellari, shuningdek MR62X bilan taqdim etilgan — tezlikka maksimal talablar va minimal javob vaqtiga ega obyektlar uchun.

## FAQ

Q: Wi-Fi 6 Wi-Fi 7 dan nimasi bilan farq qiladi va ortiqcha to'lash arziydimi?
A: Wi-Fi 6 Wi-Fi 5 ga nisbatan tezlik va samaradorlikning sezilarli o'sishini beradi va aksariyat obyektlar ehtiyojlarini qoplaydi. Wi-Fi 7 juda yuqori qurilma zichligiga ega tarmoqlar, 4K/8K striming va minimal javob vaqti uchun dolzarb — masalan, ko'p sonli yuqori aniqlikdagi kameralar bo'lgan obyektlar uchun. Standart ofis yoki do'kon uchun Wi-Fi 6 yetarli bo'ladi.

Q: 4G-marshrutizator asosiy internet manbai sifatida mos keladimi?
A: Ha, agar qamrov zonasida barqaror 4G-signal bo'lsa. Mercusys MT110 va MB115-4G modellari O'zbekistonning istalgan operatorlarining SIM-kartalarini qo'llab-quvvatlaydi va ofis ishi, videokuzatuv va IP-telefoniya uchun yetarli tezlikni ta'minlaydi. Muhim obyektlar uchun asosiy simli ulanishda 4G ni rezerv kanal sifatida ishlatishni tavsiya qilamiz.

Q: Mercusys marshrutizatorlariga qanday kafolat beriladi?

Q: Mercusys marshrutizatorini mustaqil sozlash mumkinmi?
A: Bazaviy sozlash Mercusys mobil ilovasi orqali mavjud va maxsus bilim talab qilmaydi. Korporativ ssenariylar uchun — VLAN, VPN sozlamalari, trafikni ustuvorlashtirish va xavfsizlik tizimlari bilan integratsiya — SAT Solutions muhandislarini jalb qilishni tavsiya qilamiz.

Q: Marshrutizatorlarni Toshkentdan tashqaridagi O'zbekiston hududlariga yetkazib berish mumkinmi?

mercusys-routers.en:
Routers are a key element of any modern network, whether it is a small office, a retail outlet, a warehouse or a residential complex. It is precisely this device that distributes internet traffic between devices, organizes wireless coverage and manages connection priorities. The SAT Solutions catalog features Mercusys routers — a brand backed by the many years of engineering expertise of TP-Link. You can buy a router in Tashkent at a reasonable price and, at the same time, get reliable network equipment with an official warranty right here.

The choice of router depends on several factors: the area of the facility, the number of simultaneous users, the presence of wired internet or the need to operate over a 4G mobile network. For small premises up to 50-70 sq. m, a compact model with Wi-Fi 5 or Wi-Fi 6 support is sufficient. For large offices, stores or production areas, devices with multiple bands and high throughput are needed — for example, tri-band Wi-Fi 7 routers. A separate segment is 4G routers with a built-in modem: they are indispensable where there is no stable wired connection or a backup communication channel is needed.

The Mercusys line featured in our catalog covers all current standards: from affordable dual-band models to flagship devices with Wi-Fi 7 support and channel aggregation. Such variety makes it possible to select equipment for any budget and any infrastructure. SAT Solutions supplies routers throughout Uzbekistan and undertakes turnkey network installation.

## How to choose

- Wi-Fi standard: Wi-Fi 5 (802.11ac) is suitable for basic tasks and small premises; Wi-Fi 6 (802.11ax) gives higher speed and copes better with a dense number of devices; Wi-Fi 7 is relevant for facilities with high load and high-resolution video surveillance.
- Bands: dual-band models (2.4 + 5 GHz) cover most tasks; tri-band models (2.4 + 5 + 6 GHz, as in the Mercusys MR47BE) are needed for maximum throughput and minimizing interference.
- Type of internet connection: if there is a cable provider in the building — a standard router with a WAN port is sufficient; if there is no stable twisted pair or a backup is needed — choose a 4G router with a slot for a SIM card (Mercusys MT110, MB115-4G).
- Coverage area: assess the area of the premises and the material of the walls. For facilities with reinforced-concrete floors, either a powerful model or additional access points will be required.
- Port speed: for gigabit internet, routers with Gigabit LAN/WAN ports are needed — check the specifications before purchase.
- Number of simultaneous connections: in offices with 20+ employees or at facilities with a large number of IoT devices and video surveillance cameras, choose models with MU-MIMO and OFDMA support.
- Management and security: the presence of a mobile application for configuration, parental control, a guest network and a VPN client are important criteria for corporate and facility installations.

## Applications

- Offices and business centers: providing stable internet for workstations, IP telephony and video surveillance systems.
- Retail facilities: organizing Wi-Fi for checkout terminals, POS systems and guest access for customers.
- Production and warehouse premises: covering large areas, connecting barcode scanners and industrial controllers.
- Residential complexes and private houses: high-speed home internet with separate networks for home and guest devices.
- Remote facilities and construction sites: 4G routers as the main or backup channel where there is no cable internet.
- Security systems: routers as part of the infrastructure for IP video surveillance, access control and security alarms.

## Brands and models in the catalog

- Mercusys — a subsidiary brand of TP-Link, oriented toward affordable but technologically current network equipment. The devices go through the same production and testing base as the flagship products of the parent company.
- The Wi-Fi 6 line includes the MR60X, MR1500X, MR50G and MR80X models — they provide high speed in the 2.4 and 5 GHz bands and cope well with multitasking networks of medium density.
- Wi-Fi 7 is represented by the dual-band MR25BE and tri-band MR47BE models, as well as the MR62X — for facilities with maximum requirements for speed and minimal response time.
- The MT110 and MB115-4G 4G routers make it possible to organize internet over a mobile network — they are especially in demand during facility construction, at field events and in areas with weak cable infrastructure.
- The entire line is managed through the Mercusys application, which simplifies initial setup and ongoing administration without involving a system administrator.

## FAQ

Q: How does Wi-Fi 6 differ from Wi-Fi 7 and is it worth overpaying?
A: Wi-Fi 6 gives a substantial increase in speed and efficiency compared to Wi-Fi 5 and covers the needs of most facilities. Wi-Fi 7 is relevant for networks with a very high density of devices, 4K/8K streaming and minimal response time — for example, for facilities with a large number of high-resolution cameras. For a standard office or store, Wi-Fi 6 will be sufficient.

Q: Is a 4G router suitable as the main source of internet?
A: Yes, if there is a stable 4G signal in the coverage zone. The Mercusys MT110 and MB115-4G models support SIM cards of any Uzbekistan operators and provide speed sufficient for office work, video surveillance and IP telephony. For critically important facilities, we recommend using 4G as a backup channel alongside a main wired connection.

Q: What is the warranty on Mercusys routers?
A: The official manufacturer's warranty is 1 year. SAT Solutions additionally provides warranty support and takes on interaction with the supplier in the event of warranty cases.

Q: Can a Mercusys router be configured independently?
A: Basic configuration is available through the Mercusys mobile application and does not require special knowledge. For corporate scenarios — configuring VLAN, VPN, traffic prioritization and integration with security systems — we recommend involving SAT Solutions engineers.

Q: Is delivery of routers to regions of Uzbekistan outside Tashkent possible?
A: Yes, SAT Solutions supplies equipment throughout Uzbekistan. Installation work is also performed in the regions — check the timelines and terms when placing an order.
