HDCVI-kameralar — bu HD-signalni koaksial kabel orqali uzatadigan yuqori aniqlikdagi analog videokameralardir. HDCVI (High Definition Composite Video Interface) texnologiyasi Dahua Technology kompaniyasi tomonidan ishlab chiqilgan va mavjud kabel infratuzilmasini almashtirmasdan 2-5 Mpiks darajasidagi tasvir sifatini olish imkonini beradi. Bu HDCVI ni eskirgan analog videokuzatuv tizimlarini modernizatsiya qilish uchun optimal yechimga aylantiradi: eski koaksial qoladi, tasvir sifati esa zamonaviy darajaga oshadi. Ishlab chiqaruvchi kafolati bilan Toshkentda arzon narxda HDCVI-kameralar sotib olishni SAT Solutions katalogi orqali amalga oshirish mumkin.

HDCVI formatining IP-videokuzatuv oldidagi asosiy afzalligi — infratuzilmaning past narxi va xizmat ko'rsatish soddaligi. PoE ni qo'llab-quvvatlaydigan kommutator talab qilinmaydi, ijro paytida kechikishlar yo'q, HDCVI videoregistrator o'xshash sig'imdagi NVR dan arzonroq turadi. Bunda zamonaviy HDCVI-kameralar audio uzatishni, PTZ boshqaruvni va hatto telemetriya ma'lumotlarini bir xil koaksial kabel orqali uzatishni qo'llab-quvvatlaydi. O'zbekistonda tayyor kabel razvodkasiga ega obyektlar — ofis markazlari, savdo xonalari, ishlab chiqarish binolari — uchun HDCVI ko'pincha IP ga to'liq o'tishdan ko'ra iqtisodiy jihatdan foydaliroq bo'lib chiqadi.

HDCVI-kamerani tanlash bir necha omilga bog'liq: aniqlik, form-faktor (silindrik yoki kupolli), IK-yoritma masofasi, o'rnatilgan mikrofon mavjudligi va nazorat zonasi yoritish turi. SAT Solutions katalogida ichki xonalar uchun ixcham kupolli modellar ham, ko'chada montaj qilish uchun himoyalangan silindrik kameralar ham taqdim etilgan. Ikkala tur ham O'zbekistonda tipik videonazorat vazifalari uchun mos — perimetrni qo'riqlash, kirish guruhlarini nazorat qilish, omborlar va avtoturargohlarda kuzatuv.

## Qanday tanlash kerak

- Aniqlik: tasvirning minimal ruxsat etilgan sifatini aniqlang. Xonada yuzlarni identifikatsiya qilish uchun 2 Mpiks (1080p) yetarli, keng zonalarni qamrab olish yoki avtomobil raqamlarini o'qish uchun 5 Mpiks tanlagan ma'qul.
- Form-faktor: HAC-HDW kupolli kameralarni qo'lda burish qiyinroq va vizual jihatdan neytralroq — interyerlar uchun mos; HAC-HFW silindrik kameralarni uzoq obyektlarga yo'naltirish osonroq va ko'proq tashqarida ishlatiladi.
- Yoritma: ko'rinmas IK-yoritma (klassik variant) yoki oq nurli to'liq rangli Full-color yoritma (-LED suffiksli modellar) kerakligini aniqlang. To'liq rangli kameralar kechasi rangli tasvir beradi, ammo kuzatuv zonasini biroz yoritadi.
- Ko'rish masofasi: koridorlar va tor o'tishlar uchun 20-30 m IK yetarli; ochiq hududlar va perimetr uchun yoritma masofasi 50 m dan bo'lgan kameralarni tanlang.
- O'rnatilgan mikrofon: bir qator modellar (artikulda -A suffiksi) mikrofon bilan jihozlangan — bu alohida kabel o'tkazmasdan audioyozuv olib borish imkonini beradi.
- Himoya darajasi: ko'cha uchun IP67 dan past bo'lmagan korpus kerak, xonalar uchun IP54 yetarli. Ishchi harorat diapazoniga e'tibor bering — O'zbekiston hududlarida yozda havo +45 °C gacha qiziydi.
- Registrator bilan moslik: Dahua HDCVI-kameralari bir xil markadagi XVR registratorlar bilan to'g'ri ishlaydi. Sotib olishdan oldin DVR/XVR ingiz kerakli aniqlikni qo'llab-quvvatlashini mutaxassisdan aniqlang.

## Qo'llanilish sohalari

- Ofislar va biznes-markazlar: kirish guruhlari, koridorlar, muzokara xonalari va server xonalarini arxiv yozuvi bilan nazorat qilish.
- Savdo obyektlari: do'konlar, bozorlar, savdo markazlari — savdo zali, kassa zonalari va omborni kuzatish.
- Ishlab chiqarish va omborlar: texnologik zonalar, o'tkazgichlar, yuklash doklarini nazorat qilish; kirishni nazorat qilish tizimi bilan integratsiya.
- Turar-joy majmualari va xususiy uylar: perimetrni qo'riqlash, videodomofoniya, kirish va o'tish joyidagi voqealarni yozib olish.
- Ma'muriy binolar va o'quv yurtlari: maktablar, universitetlar, davlat muassasalari — hudud va ichki zonalarni arxivni saqlash bilan monitoring qilish.
- Avtoturargohlar va AYoQSH: ochiq hududlarni umumiy videonazorat qilish va avtomobil raqamlarini qayd etish uchun silindrik ko'cha kameralari.

## Katalogdagi brendlar va modellar

- Dahua Technology — ushbu toifada taqdim etilgan barcha kameralar shu brendga tegishli bo'lib, u dunyoda HDCVI formatining asoschisi va yetakchi ishlab chiqaruvchisidir. Dahua videokuzatuv yetkazib berish hajmi bo'yicha yetakchi o'rinlarni egallaydi va liniyani muntazam yangilab turadi.
- HAC-HFW seriyasidagi silindrik kameralar: HAC-HFW1200CLP-IL-A, HAC-HFW1209CLP-LED, HAC-HFW1500CP, HAC-HFW1200RLP-IL-T modellari — yoritma variantlarining xilma-xilligi (IK, ikki tomonlama IL yoritma, Full-color LED) 2 va 5 Mpiks aniqlikda.
- HAC-HDW seriyasidagi kupolli kameralar: HAC-HDW1209TLQP-A-LED, HAC-HDW1509TLQP-A-LED, HAC-HDW1200CLQP-IL-A, HAC-HDW1500TRQP modellari — ixcham vandalizmga qarshi korpus, bir qator ijrolarda o'rnatilgan mikrofon, Full-color va ikki tomonlama yoritmani qo'llab-quvvatlash.
- Maxsus ijrolar: HAC-ME1500BP-L kamerasi ME mobil seriyasiga tegishli — transportda yoki oshirilgan tebranish sharoitlarida o'rnatish uchun mo'ljallangan.

## FAQ

Q: HDCVI-kamerani oddiy analog DVR registratorga ulash mumkinmi?
A: Standart analog DVR HDCVI ning HD-signalini qo'llab-quvvatlamaydi — XVR yoki HDCVI DVR formatidagi registrator kerak bo'ladi. Dahua ning aksariyat zamonaviy XVR lari HDCVI, analog va IP-kameralarni bir vaqtda ulashni qo'llab-quvvatlaydi.

Q: HDCVI-signalni koaksial kabel orqali qancha masofaga uzatish mumkin?
A: RG59 kabeli orqali 1080p aniqlikdagi HDCVI signali 500 m gacha masofaga, 720p rejimida esa 800 m gacha uzatiladi. Taqqoslash uchun, klassik analog signal allaqachon 200-300 m dan keyin buziladi.

Q: Toshkentda HDCVI-kameralarni o'rnatish qancha turadi?
A: Montaj narxi kameralar soni, kabel yo'llarining uzunligi, obyekt murakkabligi va shtroblash zaruratiga bog'liq. SAT Solutions menejerlaridan hisob-kitob so'rang — ular obyektni ko'rgach yoki rejasini o'rgangach tijorat taklifini tayyorlaydi.

Q: Dahua HDCVI-kameralariga kafolat bormi?
A: SAT Solutions tomonidan rasmiy kanallar orqali yetkazib beriladigan Dahua jihozlariga ishlab chiqaruvchi kafolati amal qiladi. Kafolat muddati modelga qarab buyurtma rasmiylashtirishda aniqlanadi.

Q: HDCVI-kameralarni allaqachon o'rnatilgan IP-kameralar bilan birlashtirish mumkinmi?
A: Ha, zamonaviy gibrid XVR registratordan foydalanganda bitta tizimga HDCVI ni ham, IP-kameralarni ham ulash mumkin. Bu tizimni bosqichma-bosqich kengaytirish, katta masofa yoki tarmoq integratsiyasi talab qilinadigan joylarga IP-qurilmalar qo'shish imkonini beradi.
hdcvi-cameras.en:
HDCVI cameras are high-resolution analog video cameras that transmit an HD signal over coaxial cable. HDCVI (High Definition Composite Video Interface) technology was developed by Dahua Technology and makes it possible to obtain image quality at the 2-5 MP level without replacing the existing cable infrastructure. This makes HDCVI an optimal solution for modernizing outdated analog video surveillance systems: the old coaxial cable remains, while the picture quality rises to a modern level. You can buy HDCVI cameras in Tashkent at an affordable price with a manufacturer's warranty through the SAT Solutions catalog.

The key advantage of the HDCVI format over IP video surveillance is the low cost of infrastructure and ease of maintenance. A PoE-capable switch is not required, there are no delays during playback, and an HDCVI video recorder costs less than an NVR of comparable capacity. At the same time, modern HDCVI cameras support the transmission of audio, PTZ control and even telemetry data over the same coaxial cable. For facilities with ready cable wiring in Uzbekistan — office centers, retail premises, production buildings — HDCVI often turns out to be more economically advantageous than a full transition to IP.

The choice of an HDCVI camera depends on several factors: resolution, form factor (bullet or dome), IR illumination range, the presence of a built-in microphone and the type of lighting of the monitored zone. The SAT Solutions catalog features both compact dome models for indoor premises and protected bullet cameras for outdoor installation. Both types are suitable for typical video-monitoring tasks in Uzbekistan — perimeter protection, control of entrance groups, surveillance in warehouses and parking lots.

## How to choose

- Resolution: determine the minimum acceptable picture quality. For identifying faces indoors, 2 MP (1080p) is sufficient; for covering wide zones or reading license plates, it is better to choose 5 MP.
- Form factor: HAC-HDW dome cameras are harder to redirect by hand and are visually more neutral — suitable for interiors; HAC-HFW bullet cameras are easier to aim at distant objects and are more often used outdoors.
- Illumination: clarify whether invisible IR illumination (the classic option) or full-color white-light illumination (models with the -LED suffix) is needed. Full-color cameras give a color image at night but slightly illuminate the surveillance zone.
- Viewing range: for corridors and narrow passages, 20-30 m of IR is sufficient; for open areas and perimeters, choose cameras with an illumination range of 50 m and above.
- Built-in microphone: a number of models (the -A suffix in the part number) are equipped with a microphone — this makes it possible to record audio without laying a separate cable.
- Protection rating: for outdoor use, a housing of at least IP67 is required; for indoor use IP54 is sufficient. Pay attention to the operating temperature range — in the regions of Uzbekistan the air warms up to +45 °C in summer.
- Compatibility with the recorder: Dahua HDCVI cameras work correctly with XVR recorders of the same brand. Before purchase, check with a specialist whether your DVR/XVR supports the required resolution.

## Applications

- Offices and business centers: control of entrance groups, corridors, meeting rooms and server rooms with archive recording.
- Retail facilities: stores, markets, shopping centers — surveillance of the sales area, checkout zones and warehouse.
- Production and warehouses: control of process zones, checkpoints, loading docks; integration with an access control system.
- Residential complexes and private houses: perimeter protection, video intercom, recording of events at the entrance gate and doorway.
- Administrative buildings and educational institutions: schools, universities, government institutions — monitoring the territory and internal zones with archive storage.
- Parking lots and gas stations: bullet outdoor cameras for capturing license plates and general video monitoring of open areas.

## Brands and models in the catalog

- Dahua Technology — all cameras featured in this category belong to this brand, which is the originator and leading manufacturer of the HDCVI format in the world. Dahua holds a leading position in video surveillance supply volume and regularly updates its line.
- HAC-HFW series bullet cameras: the HAC-HFW1200CLP-IL-A, HAC-HFW1209CLP-LED, HAC-HFW1500CP, HAC-HFW1200RLP-IL-T models — a variety of illumination options (IR, dual IL illumination, Full-color LED) in resolutions of 2 and 5 MP.
- HAC-HDW series dome cameras: the HAC-HDW1209TLQP-A-LED, HAC-HDW1509TLQP-A-LED, HAC-HDW1200CLQP-IL-A, HAC-HDW1500TRQP models — a compact vandal-proof housing, a built-in microphone in a number of versions, support for Full-color and dual illumination.
- Specialized designs: the HAC-ME1500BP-L camera belongs to the mobile ME series — designed for installation in vehicles or under conditions of increased vibration.

## FAQ

Q: Can an HDCVI camera be connected to an ordinary analog DVR recorder?
A: A standard analog DVR does not support the HDCVI HD signal — an XVR or HDCVI DVR recorder is required. Most modern Dahua XVRs support the simultaneous connection of HDCVI, analog and IP cameras.

Q: What distance can an HDCVI signal be transmitted over coaxial cable?
A: Over RG59 cable, an HDCVI signal at 1080p resolution is transmitted over a distance of up to 500 m, and in 720p mode — up to 800 m. For comparison, a classic analog signal degrades already after 200-300 m.

Q: How much does installing HDCVI cameras cost in Tashkent?
A: The installation cost depends on the number of cameras, the length of the cable runs, the complexity of the facility and the need for wall chasing. Request a calculation from SAT Solutions managers — they will prepare a commercial offer after inspecting the facility or studying the layout.

Q: Is there a warranty on Dahua HDCVI cameras?
A: Dahua equipment supplied by SAT Solutions through official channels is covered by the manufacturer's warranty. The warranty period is clarified when placing an order depending on the model.

Q: Can HDCVI cameras be combined with already installed IP cameras?
A: Yes, when using a modern hybrid XVR recorder, both HDCVI and IP cameras can be connected to a single system. This makes it possible to expand the system gradually, adding IP devices where greater range or network integration is required.

zkteco-turnstiles.uz:
Turniketlar — bu qo'riqlanadigan hududga kirishni cheklaydigan hamda odamlarning bir yoki ikki yo'nalishli harakatini ta'minlaydigan mexanik yoki elektromexanik o'tish nazorati qurilmalaridir. Xavfsizlik tizimlarida ular alohida o'rin egallaydi: turniket bir vaqtning o'zida fizik to'siq va ish vaqtini hisobga olish terminali vazifasini bajaradi, biometrik o'quvchilar yoki kirish kartalari bilan integratsiya qilinganda esa to'laqonli o'tish nazorati punktiga aylanadi. Bugungi kunda Toshkentda turniket sotib olish ma'muriy binolardan tortib sanoat korxonalarigacha bo'lgan eng turli obyektlar uchun talab qilinmoqda.

Turniket turini tanlash obyekt xususiyati va odamlar oqimining zichligiga bog'liq. Uchta aylanuvchi to'siqli tripod-turniketlar o'rtacha trafikli o'tish joylari uchun mos keladi, ular ixcham va tejamli. Shishali portal-turniketlar salmoqliroq ko'rinadi, kengroq oqimlarni o'tkazadi va ko'proq biznes-markazlarda, banklarda hamda mehmonxonalarda uchraydi. Estetikaga talab yuqori va o'tkazuvchanlik qobiliyati katta bo'lgan obyektlar uchun to'liq bo'yli yoki ochiladigan tizimlar optimal hisoblanadi. O'zbekistonda zamonaviy turniketlarga bo'lgan talab korporativ infratuzilma va xavfsizlik standartlarining rivojlanishi bilan birga o'sib bormoqda.

Tanlashda turniket avtonom ishlaydimi yoki yagona kirishni nazorat qilish va boshqarish tizimi (SKUD) tarkibida ishlaydimi, buni oldindan aniqlash muhim. Bunga aloqa interfeyslarini tanlash, integratsiya protokollari va qo'shimcha o'quvchilar zarurligi bog'liq. SAT Solutions Toshkentda va butun O'zbekiston bo'ylab buyurtmachining aniq talablariga mos turniketlarni tanlash va o'rnatishda yordam beradi.

## Qanday tanlash kerak

- Konstruksiya turi: tripod (uchta to'siq) o'rtacha trafikda o'tishning bazaviy himoyasini ta'minlaydi; shishali portal keng o'tish joyi, yaxshiroq tashqi ko'rinish va qo'l yuki bilan o'tish imkonini beradi; to'liq bo'yli turniket o'tish joyini butunlay yopadi va maksimal nazorat kerak bo'lgan joylarda ishlatiladi.
- O'tkazuvchanlik qobiliyati: standart tripodlarda u daqiqasiga 20 dan 40 kishigacha, portallarda esa yuqoriroq. Cho'qqi soatlarda oqimi katta bo'lgan obyektlar (stadionlar, vokzallar, zavod o'tish joylari) uchun o'tkazuvchanlik qobiliyati — kritik parametr.
- SKUD bilan integratsiya: turniket kerakli protokollarni (Wiegand, RS-485, TCP/IP) qo'llab-quvvatlashiga hamda o'rnatilgan karta o'quvchilar, biometrik terminallar yoki ish vaqtini hisobga olish tizimi bilan mosligiga ishonch hosil qiling.
- Material va bajarilishi: ko'chada o'rnatish yoki nam xonalar uchun tegishli IP himoya sinfiga ega zanglamaydigan po'latdan yasalgan korpus zarur. Ofislar uchun standart metall korpus yoki shishali seksiyalar yetarli.
- Favqulodda ochilish rejimi: quvvat o'chganda yoki yong'in signalizatsiyasi ishga tushganda turniket avtomatik ravishda ochilishi kerak. Fail-safe yoki fail-secure funksiyasining mavjudligini va uning yong'in xavfsizligi talablariga mosligini tekshiring.
- Identifikatsiya usuli: RFID-kartalar, QR-kodlar, biometriya (barmoq izi, yuzni tanish) yoki ularning kombinatsiyasi. ZKTeco o'rnatilgan biometrik o'quvchilarga ega turniketlarni taklif qiladi, bu joriy etishni soddalashtiradi.
- Ishonchlilik va resurs: privod uchun e'lon qilingan resursga (ishga tushish sikllari soniga) va O'zbekistonda avtorizatsiyalangan servis xizmatining mavjudligiga e'tibor bering.

## Qo'llanilish sohalari

- Ofis va biznes-markazlar: xodimlar va tashrif buyuruvchilarning o'tishini nazorat qilish, ish vaqtini hisobga olish tizimi va videokuzatuv bilan integratsiya.
- Sanoat korxonalari va zavod o'tish joylari: kirish zonalarini ajratish, xodimlarning kelish-ketishini hisobga olish, maxsus rejimli uchastkalarga kirishni cheklash.
- O'quv muassasalari va davlat idoralari: talabalar va xodimlar oqimini boshqarish, davomatni qayd etish, perimetrni himoya qilish.
- Savdo markazlari va ko'ngilochar obyektlar: pullik kirishni tashkil etish, kirish va chiqishni ajratish, kassa tizimlari bilan integratsiya.
- Sport inshootlari va stadionlar: muxlislarni chiptalar yoki kartalar bo'yicha o'tkazish, minbarlar to'lganligini nazorat qilish.
- Tibbiyot muassasalari va mehmonxonalar: begona shaxslarning kirishini cheklash, xodimlar uchun himoyalangan zonalar yaratish.

## Katalogdagi brendlar va modellar

- ZKTeco — kirishni nazorat qilish va biometrik identifikatsiya uskunalarining yetakchi jahon ishlab chiqaruvchisi. SAT Solutions katalogida ushbu brendning turniketlari keng assortimenti taqdim etilgan: o'rtacha trafikli o'tish joylari uchun klassik tripodlardan tortib vakillik darajasidagi shishali portallargacha.
- ZKTeco tripod-turniketlari ishonchli mexanika, ixcham o'lchamlar va o'rnatish soddaligini birlashtiradi. Ular o'quvchilarni ulash uchun standart interfeyslarni qo'llab-quvvatlaydi va mavjud SKUD tizimiga integratsiya qilish uchun mos keladi.
- ZKTeco shishali turniketlari (shaffof tavaqali seriyalar) tashqi ko'rinish muhim bo'lgan joylarda — ofis lobbilarida, banklarda, mehmonxonalarda ishlatiladi. Konstruksiya keng o'tish joyi va privodning bir tekis ishlashini ta'minlaydi.
- ZKTeco portal-turniketlari — dizayn va xavfsizlikka talab yuqori bo'lgan obyektlar uchun yechimlar. Modulli arxitektura seksiyalarni birlashtirish va o'tish joyi kengligini aniq obyektga moslashtirish imkonini beradi.

## FAQ

Q: Ofis binosi uchun qaysi turdagi turniketni tanlash kerak?
A: Zamonaviy ofis lobbisi uchun shishali portallar optimal — ular interyerga uyg'un tarzda mos keladi va xodimlar o'tishi uchun keng o'tish joyini ta'minlaydi. Tripod-turniketlar yordamchi kirishlar yoki cheklangan byudjetli obyektlar uchun mos keladi.

Q: Turniketni allaqachon o'rnatilgan kirishni nazorat qilish tizimi bilan integratsiya qilish mumkinmi?
A: Ha, ZKTeco turniketlarining aksariyati Wiegand va RS-485 interfeyslarini qo'llab-quvvatlaydi, bu ko'p tarqalgan SKUD tizimlari bilan moslikni ta'minlaydi. Xarid qilishdan oldin mutaxassislarimizdan sizning aniq tizimingiz bilan moslikni aniqlashtirish tavsiya etiladi.

Q: Elektr o'chganda turniket bilan nima bo'ladi?
A: Professional turniketlar favqulodda ochilish funksiyasi bilan jihozlangan: quvvat yo'qolganda yoki yong'in signalizatsiyasi ishga tushganda to'siqlar yoki tavaqalar avtomatik ochilib, evakuatsiya uchun o'tish joyini bo'shatadi. Bu talab aksariyat obyektlar uchun majburiy hisoblanadi.

Q: Toshkentda turniket o'rnatish qancha turadi?
A: O'rnatish narxi turniketlarning turi va soniga, kabel o'tkazish murakkabligiga hamda qo'shni tizimlar bilan integratsiya zarurligiga bog'liq. SAT Solutions menejerlaridan tijorat taklifini so'rang — hisob-kitob obyektni ko'zdan kechirgandan so'ng individual tarzda amalga oshiriladi.

Q: ZKTeco turniketlariga kafolat qanday?
A: ZKTeco uskunalariga ishlab chiqaruvchining standart kafolati beriladi. SAT Solutions shuningdek o'rnatilgan tizimlarga kafolatli xizmat ko'rsatishni ta'minlaydi va tuzilgan shartnoma doirasida servis murojaatlariga tezkor javob beradi.
zkteco-turnstiles.en:
Turnstiles are mechanical or electromechanical passage-control devices that restrict access to a protected area and provide one-way or two-way movement of people. They occupy a special place in security systems: a turnstile simultaneously acts as a physical barrier and a time-and-attendance terminal, and when integrated with biometric readers or access cards it becomes a full-fledged access control point. Buying turnstiles in Tashkent is in high demand today for a wide variety of sites, from administrative buildings to industrial enterprises.

The choice of turnstile type is determined by the nature of the site and the intensity of the flow of people. Tripod turnstiles with three rotating arms are suitable for passageways with medium traffic; they are compact and economical. Glass portal turnstiles look more representative, pass wider flows, and are more often found in business centers, banks, and hotels. For sites with aesthetic requirements and high throughput, full-height or swing systems are optimal. In Uzbekistan, demand for modern turnstiles is growing along with the development of corporate infrastructure and security standards.

When choosing, it is important to determine in advance whether the turnstile will operate autonomously or as part of a unified access control system (ACS). This determines the choice of communication interfaces, integration protocols, and the need for additional readers. SAT Solutions helps select and install turnstiles according to a specific customer's requirements in Tashkent and throughout Uzbekistan.

## How to choose

- Design type: a tripod (three arms) provides basic passage protection at moderate traffic; a glass portal gives a wide opening, better appearance, and the ability to pass with hand luggage; a full-height turnstile completely blocks the passage and is used where maximum control is required.
- Throughput: standard tripods handle from 20 to 40 people per minute, portals handle more. For sites with peak-hour flow (stadiums, railway stations, factory checkpoints), throughput is a critical parameter.
- Integration with ACS: make sure the turnstile supports the required protocols (Wiegand, RS-485, TCP/IP) and is compatible with the installed card readers, biometric terminals, or time-and-attendance system.
- Material and design: outdoor installation or damp premises require a stainless steel housing with an appropriate IP protection rating. For offices, a standard metal housing or glass sections is sufficient.
- Emergency opening mode: when power is cut off or a fire alarm is triggered, the turnstile must automatically unlock. Check for a fail-safe or fail-secure function and its compliance with fire safety requirements.
- Identification method: RFID cards, QR codes, biometrics (fingerprint, facial recognition), or a combination of them. ZKTeco offers turnstiles with built-in biometric readers, which simplifies deployment.
- Reliability and service life: pay attention to the stated drive service life (number of actuation cycles) and the availability of authorized service support in Uzbekistan.

## Applications

- Offices and business centers: control of employee and visitor passage, integration with the time-and-attendance system and video surveillance.
- Industrial enterprises and factory checkpoints: delimitation of access zones, recording of personnel arrival and departure, restriction of access to restricted areas.
- Educational institutions and government agencies: managing flows of students and staff, recording attendance, protecting the perimeter.
- Shopping centers and entertainment venues: organizing paid access, separating entry and exit, integration with point-of-sale systems.
- Sports facilities and stadiums: admitting fans by tickets or cards, controlling stand occupancy.
- Medical facilities and hotels: restricting access for unauthorized persons, creating protected zones for staff.

## Brands and models in the catalog

- ZKTeco is a leading global manufacturer of access control and biometric identification equipment. The SAT Solutions catalog offers a wide range of turnstiles from this brand: from classic tripods for passageways with moderate traffic to executive-class glass portals.
- ZKTeco tripod turnstiles combine reliable mechanics, compact dimensions, and ease of installation. They support standard reader connection interfaces and are suitable for integration into an existing ACS.
- ZKTeco glass turnstiles (series with transparent leaves) are used where appearance matters, in office lobbies, banks, hotels. The design provides a wide opening and smooth drive operation.
- ZKTeco portal turnstiles are solutions for sites with increased design and security requirements. The modular architecture allows sections to be combined and the passage width to be adapted to a specific site.

## FAQ

Q: What type of turnstile should I choose for an office building?
A: For a modern office lobby, glass portals are optimal, they blend organically into the interior and provide a wide opening for staff to pass through. Tripod turnstiles are suitable for auxiliary entrances or sites with a limited budget.

Q: Can a turnstile be integrated with an already installed access control system?
A: Yes, most ZKTeco turnstiles support the Wiegand and RS-485 interfaces, which ensures compatibility with most common ACS. Before purchasing, we recommend checking compatibility with your specific system with our specialists.

Q: What happens to the turnstile during a power outage?
A: Professional turnstiles are equipped with an emergency opening function: when power is lost or the fire alarm is triggered, the arms or leaves automatically unlock, freeing the passage for evacuation. This is a mandatory requirement for most sites.

Q: How much does turnstile installation cost in Tashkent?
A: The cost of installation depends on the type and number of turnstiles, the complexity of the cable routing, and the need for integration with adjacent systems. Request a commercial proposal from SAT Solutions managers, the calculation is made individually after a site survey.

Q: What is the warranty on ZKTeco turnstiles?
A: ZKTeco equipment comes with the standard manufacturer's warranty. SAT Solutions also provides warranty service for installed systems and responds promptly to service requests within the terms of the concluded contract.

hik-nvr.uz:
IP-videoregistratorlar (NVR) — IP-kameralarga asoslangan har qanday zamonaviy videokuzatuv tizimining asosiy elementi. Eskirgan analog DVR'lardan farqli o'laroq, NVR faqat tarmoq kameralari bilan ishlaydi: videooqimni TCP/IP protokoli orqali qabul qiladi, uni qattiq disklarga yozadi, masofaviy kirish va intellektual tahlilni ta'minlaydi. Bugungi kunda Toshkentda IP-videoregistrator sotib olish arxivni oylar davomida saqlaydigan va istalgan vaqtda kerakli kameradan yozuvni olish imkonini beradigan ishonchli qurilmani tanlashni anglatadi.

NVR tanlash tizim arxitekturasini tushunishdan boshlanadi: hozir qancha kamera ulash rejalashtirilgan va kelajakda qancha kerak bo'lishi mumkin, kameralarning ruxsati qanday, o'rnatilgan analitika kerakmi. Zamonaviy IP-videoregistratorlar 4 dan 64 kanal va undan ko'proqni qo'llab-quvvatlaydi, videoni 4K gacha bo'lgan ruxsatda yozadi, ba'zi modellarda esa o'rnatilgan PoE-kommutator mavjud — bu kameralarni to'g'ridan-to'g'ri registratordan, alohida uskunasiz quvvatlantirish imkonini beradi. O'zbekistonda bunday yechimlar kichik savdo obyektlarida ham, yirik sanoat korxonalari va turar-joy majmualarida ham talab qilinadi.

IP-videoregistratorlarning analog tizimlar oldidagi asosiy afzalligi — masshtablanuvchanlik va tasvir sifati. NVR fizik koaksial kabellar bilan cheklanmagan: kameralar mavjud tarmoq infratuzilmasi yoki simsiz kirish nuqtalari orqali ulanadi. Yozib olish, qayta ijro etish va monitoring har qanday qurilmadan — smartfon, planshet yoki kompyuterdan mavjud. Aynan shuning uchun IP-videokuzatuvga o'tish Toshkent va O'zbekiston hududlaridagi aksariyat loyihalar uchun standartga aylandi.

## Qanday tanlash kerak

- Kanallar soni: kengaytirish zaxirasi bilan tizimdagi IP-kameralar sonini aniqlang. Eng ommabop registratorlar 4, 8, 16, 32 va 64 kanalli. Joriy ehtiyojdan 25-50% zaxira bilan qurilma olish yaxshiroq.
- PoE portlarining mavjudligi va soni: o'rnatilgan PoE (Power over Ethernet) o'rnatishni soddalashtiradi — kameralar video uzatadigan kabel orqali quvvat oladi. Bu tarmoqlangan elektr tarmog'i bo'lmagan obyektlar uchun kritik.
- Qo'llab-quvvatlanadigan ruxsat va o'tkazuvchanlik qobiliyati: NVR ishlatiladigan kameralarning ruxsatini (2 MP, 4 MP, 8 MP/4K) qo'llab-quvvatlashiga va uning o'tkazuvchanlik qobiliyati barcha kanallarni sifat pasaymasdan bir vaqtda yozish uchun yetarli ekanligiga ishonch hosil qiling.
- HDD uchun uyalar soni va qo'llab-quvvatlanadigan hajm: arxivni uzoq muddat saqlash uchun katta hajmdagi bir necha diskni o'rnatish imkoniyati muhim. 30 kun va undan ortiq saqlash talabi bo'lgan obyektlar uchun 2-4 va undan ortiq disk uyasiga ega registratorlar kerak.
- O'rnatilgan videoanalitika: bir qator modellar yuzlarni aniqlash, davlat raqamlarini tanish, odamlarni sanash, perimetral himoyani qo'llab-quvvatlaydi. Agar bu funksiyalar kerak bo'lsa, apparatli AI-analitika tezlatgichiga ega NVR tanlang.
- Chiqarish va boshqaruv interfeyslari: HDMI va VGA chiqishlarining mavjudligi, sichqonchani qo'llab-quvvatlash, masofaviy ko'rish uchun mobil ilovalar bilan moslik.
- Kameralar bilan moslik: aralash o'rnatishlarda NVR turli ishlab chiqaruvchilarning kameralari bilan ishlash uchun ONVIF protokolini qo'llab-quvvatlashiga ishonch hosil qiling.

## Qo'llanilish sohalari

- Savdo va riteyl: do'konlar, savdo markazlari, omborlar — xaridorlar trafikini tahlil qilish imkoniyati bilan kassa zonalari, avtoturargohlar va tovar maydonlarini nazorat qilish.
- Ofis va biznes-markazlar: kirish guruhlarida, muzokara xonalarida, serverxonalar va cheklangan kirish zonalarida videokuzatuv, SKUD bilan integratsiya.
- Ishlab chiqarish korxonalari va sanoat obyektlari: ishlab chiqarish liniyalari, perimetr, kirish guruhlari, ombor zonalarini yuqori ruxsatli yozuv va uzoq muddatli arxiv bilan monitoring qilish.
- Turar-joy majmualari va ko'p qavatli uylar: hovli hududida, yo'laklarda, avtoturargohlarda videokuzatuv; domofon tizimlari bilan integratsiya.
- Davlat va ijtimoiy obyektlar: maktablar, kasalxonalar, ma'muriy binolar — markazlashtirilgan monitoring va reglament bo'yicha uzoq muddatli yozuvlarni saqlash tizimlari.
- Transport infratuzilmasi: avtovokzallar, aeroportlar, to'xtash joylari — davlat raqamlarini tanish va turargoh maydonini boshqarishni qo'llab-quvvatlaydigan NVR.

## Katalogdagi brendlar va modellar

- Hikvision: SAT Solutions katalogida DS-7600NI, DS-7700NI, DS-7100NI va DS-76xxNXI seriyali IP-videoregistratorlar taqdim etilgan. Bu uskuna vazifalarning butun spektrini qamrab oladi — kichik obyektlar uchun ixcham 4-kanalli qurilmalardan tortib 4K va o'rnatilgan analitikani qo'llab-quvvatlaydigan 64-kanalli registratorlargacha. NXI seriyasi registrator darajasida odamlar va avtomobillarni aniqlaydigan Acusense texnologiyasini qo'llab-quvvatlashi bilan ajralib turadi, bu yolg'on signallar sonini keskin kamaytiradi.
- PoE bilan liniyalar: katalogdagi bir qator Hikvision modellari o'rnatilgan PoE-portlar bilan jihozlangan, bu ularni qo'shimcha quvvat kommutatorlarisiz o'rnatish uchun ayniqsa qulay qiladi.
- Q seriyasi va K seriyasi modellari: analitika funksiyalari to'plami va unumdorlik darajasi bilan farqlanadi. Q seriyasi byudjetli o'rnatishlarga, K seriyasi esa ishonchlilik va funksionallikka kengaytirilgan talablar qo'yiladigan professional loyihalarga mo'ljallangan.

## FAQ

Q: Toshkentda IP-videoregistrator qancha turadi?
A: Narx kanallar soniga, PoE mavjudligiga, qo'llab-quvvatlanadigan ruxsatga va analitika funksiyalari to'plamiga bog'liq. Hikvision'ning bazaviy 4-8 kanalli modellari o'rtacha narxda mavjud, analitikali professional ko'p kanalli NVR'lar sezilarli darajada qimmatroq. Dolzarb narxlarni SAT Solutions menejerlaridan aniqlashtiring — narx joriy yetkazib berishlar va kursga bog'liq.

Q: NVR'ga boshqa ishlab chiqaruvchilarning kameralarini ulash mumkinmi?
A: Ha, zamonaviy IP-videoregistratorlarning aksariyati ONVIF protokolini qo'llab-quvvatlaydi, bu turli brendlarning kameralari bilan moslikni ta'minlaydi. Shunga qaramay, analitika va intellektual qidiruvning kengaytirilgan funksiyalari, qoida tariqasida, faqat o'sha ishlab chiqaruvchining kameralari bilan ishlaydi.

Q: Qancha qattiq disk va qanday hajmda kerak?
A: Zarur hajm kameralar soniga, yozuv ruxsatiga, kadr chastotasiga va talab qilinadigan arxiv chuqurligiga bog'liq. Harakatni aniqlash rejimida yozuv va 30 kunlik arxiv bilan 4 MP li 8 kameradan iborat tizim uchun odatda 4-6 TB yetarli. SAT Solutions mutaxassislari sizning parametrlaringiz uchun aniq saqlash hajmini hisoblab beradi.

Q: Toshkentda NVR o'rnatish va sozlashni kim bajaradi?
A: O'rnatish va ishga tushirishni SAT Solutions'ning sertifikatlangan mutaxassislari bajaradi. Ish narxiga registratorni o'rnatish, kameralarni ulash, yozuv va masofaviy kirishni sozlash, xodimlarni o'qitish kiradi.

Q: Videoregistratorni kirishni nazorat qilish yoki signalizatsiya tizimiga ulash mumkinmi?
A: Ha, zamonaviy NVR'lar signal kirish va chiqishlarini, shuningdek dasturiy interfeyslar orqali SKUD va qo'riqlash panellari bilan integratsiyani qo'llab-quvvatlaydi. Bu markazlashtirilgan boshqaruv va hodisalarga avtomatik javob berish bilan yagona xavfsizlik tizimlarini qurish imkonini beradi.
hik-nvr.en:
IP video recorders (NVRs) are the core element of any modern video surveillance system based on IP cameras. Unlike outdated analog DVRs, an NVR works exclusively with network cameras: it receives the video stream over the TCP/IP protocol, records it to hard drives, and provides remote access and intelligent analysis. Buying an IP video recorder in Tashkent today means choosing a reliable device that will store an archive for months and give you the ability to retrieve footage from any camera at any moment.

Choosing an NVR begins with understanding the system architecture: how many cameras are planned for connection now and how many may be needed in the future, what resolution the cameras are, and whether built-in analytics are required. Modern IP video recorders support from 4 to 64 channels and more, record video at resolutions up to 4K, and some models have a built-in PoE switch, which allows cameras to be powered directly from the recorder without separate equipment. In Uzbekistan, such solutions are in demand both at small retail sites and at large industrial enterprises and residential complexes.

The key advantage of IP video recorders over analog systems is scalability and image quality. An NVR is not limited by physical coaxial cables: cameras connect through the existing network infrastructure or wireless access points. Recording, playback, and monitoring are available from any device, a smartphone, tablet, or computer. That is exactly why the transition to IP video surveillance has become the standard for most projects in Tashkent and the regions of Uzbekistan.

## How to choose

- Number of channels: determine the number of IP cameras in the system with a margin for expansion. The most popular recorders are for 4, 8, 16, 32, and 64 channels. It is better to take a device with a reserve of 25-50% over the current need.
- Presence and number of PoE ports: built-in PoE (Power over Ethernet) simplifies installation, cameras receive power over the same cable through which they transmit video. This is critical for sites without an extensive electrical network.
- Supported resolution and bandwidth: make sure the NVR supports the resolution of the cameras used (2 MP, 4 MP, 8 MP/4K) and that its bandwidth is sufficient for simultaneous recording of all channels without loss of quality.
- Number of HDD bays and supported capacity: for long-term archive storage, it is important to be able to install several high-capacity disks. For sites requiring 30 days of storage or more, recorders with 2-4 or more disk slots are needed.
- Built-in video analytics: a number of models support face detection, license plate recognition, people counting, and perimeter protection. If these functions are needed, choose an NVR with hardware-accelerated AI analytics.
- Output and control interfaces: presence of HDMI and VGA outputs, mouse support, compatibility with mobile applications for remote viewing.
- Camera compatibility: for mixed installations, make sure the NVR supports the ONVIF protocol for working with cameras from different manufacturers.

## Applications

- Trade and retail: shops, shopping centers, warehouses, control of checkout areas, parking lots, and merchandise areas with the ability to analyze customer traffic.
- Offices and business centers: video surveillance at entrance groups, in meeting rooms, server rooms, and restricted-access zones with integration into ACS.
- Manufacturing enterprises and industrial sites: monitoring of production lines, the perimeter, entrance groups, and warehouse zones with high-resolution recording and a long archive.
- Residential complexes and apartment buildings: video surveillance in the adjacent territory, in entrance halls, and in parking lots; integration with intercom systems.
- Government and social facilities: schools, hospitals, administrative buildings, systems with centralized monitoring and long-term storage of recordings according to regulations.
- Transport infrastructure: bus stations, airports, parking lots, NVRs with support for license plate recognition and parking space management.

## Brands and models in the catalog

- Hikvision: the SAT Solutions catalog offers IP video recorders of the DS-7600NI, DS-7700NI, DS-7100NI, and DS-76xxNXI series. This equipment covers the entire range of tasks, from compact 4-channel devices for small sites to 64-channel recorders with 4K support and built-in analytics. The NXI series is distinguished by support for AcuSense technology with detection of people and vehicles at the recorder level, which sharply reduces the number of false alarms.
- PoE lines: a number of Hikvision models in the catalog are equipped with built-in PoE ports, which makes them especially convenient for installation without additional power switches.
- Q-series and K-series models: they differ in the set of analytics functions and the level of performance. The Q series is aimed at budget installations, the K series at professional projects with advanced requirements for reliability and functionality.

## FAQ

Q: How much does an IP video recorder cost in Tashkent?
A: The price depends on the number of channels, the presence of PoE, the supported resolution, and the set of analytics functions. Basic 4-8 channel Hikvision models are available at a moderate price, professional multi-channel NVRs with analytics cost significantly more. Check current prices with SAT Solutions managers, the cost depends on current supplies and the exchange rate.

Q: Can cameras from other manufacturers be connected to the NVR?
A: Yes, most modern IP video recorders support the ONVIF protocol, which ensures compatibility with cameras of different brands. Nevertheless, advanced analytics functions and intelligent search, as a rule, work only with cameras from the same manufacturer.

Q: How many hard drives are needed and of what capacity?
A: The required capacity depends on the number of cameras, recording resolution, frame rate, and required archive depth. For a system of 8 cameras of 4 MP with motion-detection recording and a 30-day archive, 4-6 TB is usually sufficient. SAT Solutions specialists will calculate the exact storage capacity for your parameters.

Q: Who performs NVR installation and configuration in Tashkent?
A: Installation and commissioning are performed by certified SAT Solutions specialists. The cost of the work includes recorder installation, camera connection, configuration of recording and remote access, and staff briefing.

Q: Is it possible to connect a video recorder to an access control or alarm system?
A: Yes, modern NVRs support alarm inputs and outputs, as well as integration with ACS and security panels through software interfaces. This makes it possible to build unified security systems with centralized management and automatic response to events.

Kommutatorlar — bu birorta zamonaviy videokuzatuv, kirishni nazorat qilish yoki tuzilmalangan kabel tarmog'i tizimini qurishning iloji bo'lmaydigan tarmoq uskunasi. Aynan kommutator IP-kameralarni, NVR-registratorlarni, o'quvchilarni va boshqa qurilmalarni yagona lokal tarmoqqa birlashtirib, ular o'rtasida ma'lumot uzatishni ta'minlaydi. Xavfsizlik tizimlarida PoE-kommutatorlar alohida rol o'ynaydi — ular nafaqat ma'lumot uzatadi, balki ulangan qurilmalarni xuddi shu o'ralgan juftlik kabeli orqali quvvatlantiradi, bu o'rnatishni sezilarli darajada soddalashtiradi va kabel infratuzilmasiga xarajatlarni kamaytiradi.

Agar siz videokuzatuv obyekti uchun Toshkentda kommutator sotib olishni rejalashtirayotgan bo'lsangiz, model tanlash to'g'ridan-to'g'ri loyiha ko'lami va tarmoqqa qo'yiladigan talablarga bog'liqligini tushunish muhim. Kichik ofis yoki do'kon uchun 4-8 portli boshqarilmaydigan PoE-kommutator yetarli. Yirik obyektlar — savdo markazlari, ishlab chiqarish korxonalari, turar-joy majmualari — VLAN, trafik monitoringi va zaxiralashni qo'llab-quvvatlaydigan boshqariladigan kommutatorlarni talab qiladi. To'g'ri tanlangan kommutator butun xavfsizlik tizimining osilishlar va videooqim yo'qotishlarisiz barqaror ishlashini kafolatlaydi.

SAT Solutions katalogida O'zbekistonda xavfsizlik tizimlarining tarmoq infratuzilmasini qurish uchun 46 model kommutator taqdim etilgan. Uskuna vazifalarning butun spektrini qamrab oladi: kichik obyektlar uchun oddiy boshqarilmaydigan PoE-yechimlardan tortib ishonchlilik va unumdorlikka yuqori talablar qo'yiladigan taqsimlangan tarmoqlar uchun ko'p portli boshqariladigan kommutatorlargacha.

## Qanday tanlash kerak

- PoE portlari soni: tarmoq orqali qancha qurilmani quvvatlantirish kerakligini aniqlang. Kameralar, Wi-Fi kirish nuqtalari, IP-telefonlar, SKUD o'quvchilari — bularning barchasi PoE orqali quvvat sarflaydi. Tizimni kengaytirish imkoniyati uchun 20-30% port zaxirasi bilan kommutator tanlang.

- Umumiy PoE quvvati: ko'pincha e'tibordan chetda qoladigan kalit parametr. Portlar yetarli bo'lsa ham, PoE byudjeti past kommutator barcha ulangan qurilmalarni to'liq yukda bir vaqtda quvvatlantira olmaydi. Barcha qurilmalarning umumiy iste'molini hisoblang va quvvat zaxirasiga ega modelni tanlang.

- Boshqariladigan yoki boshqarilmaydigan: boshqarilmaydigan kommutatorlar sozlashda soddaroq va arzonroq, kichik bir xil tarmoqlar uchun mos keladi. Boshqariladigan kommutatorlar VLAN sozlash, trafikni prioritetlash (QoS), portlar holatini masofadan nazorat qilish imkonini beradi — yirik va taqsimlangan obyektlar uchun almashtirib bo'lmaydigan.

- Portlar tezligi: standart ruxsatli aksariyat IP-kameralar uchun 10/100 Mbit/s portlar yetarli. Yuqori ruxsatli 4K kameralar va yuqori bitreytli PTZ-kameralar gigabitli portlarni talab qiladi. Magistral tarmoqqa ulanish uchun uplink-portlarni ham hisobga oling.

- PoE standarti: PoE (portga 15,4 Vt), PoE+ (30 Vt) va Hi-PoE (60 Vt) standartlari mavjud. PTZ-kameralar, isitgichli ko'cha kameralari, Wi-Fi 6 kirish nuqtalari PoE+ yoki Hi-PoE ni talab qiladi. Kommutator sizning qurilmalaringiz uchun kerakli standartni qo'llab-quvvatlashiga ishonch hosil qiling.

- Korpus va foydalanish sharoitlari: server shkaflariga o'rnatish uchun rack-mount bajarilishini tanlang. Ko'chada o'rnatish yoki og'ir sharoitlar uchun kengaytirilgan harorat diapazoniga ega himoyalangan korpusdagi modellar zarur.

- Videokuzatuv tizimi bilan moslik: kameralar va registratorlar bilan bir xil ishlab chiqaruvchining kommutatorlari ko'pincha kengaytirilgan integratsiya funksiyalarini — qurilmalarni avtomatik aniqlash, masofaviy monitoring va NVR interfeysi orqali portlarni qayta yuklashni qo'llab-quvvatlaydi.

## Qo'llanilish sohalari

- Videokuzatuv tizimlari: kommutatorlar IP-kameralarni NVR-registratorlar va videoanalitika serverlariga ulash uchun tarmoq infratuzilmasi asosi bo'lib xizmat qiladi. Sanoat korxonalari, ombor majmualari, avtoturargohlar va tarmoqlangan kabel tarmog'iga ega hududlarda qo'llaniladi.

- Ofis va biznes-markazlar: videokuzatuv, kirishni nazorat qilish, IP-telefoniya va korporativ IT-infratuzilma tizimlarini yagona tarmoqqa birlashtirish. Boshqariladigan kommutatorlar xavfsizlik va korporativ ma'lumotlar trafigini VLAN orqali ajratish imkonini beradi.

- Savdo obyektlari: supermarketlar, savdo markazlari va do'konlar savdo zallari, omborlar, kassa zonalari va perimetrni qamrab oluvchi o'nlab va yuzlab kamerali videokuzatuv tarmoqlarini qurish uchun kommutatorlardan foydalanadi.

- Turar-joy majmualari va ko'p qavatli uylar: kommutatorlar domofon tizimlari, yo'laklar va hovli hududidagi IP-videokuzatuv, kirish joylari va liftlardagi kirishni nazorat qilish tizimlarining ishlashini ta'minlaydi.

- Kritik infratuzilma obyektlari: banklar, davlat idoralari, tibbiyot tashkilotlari va ta'lim muassasalari, bu yerda zaxiralash va monitoring imkoniyati bilan ishonchli va boshqariladigan tarmoq infratuzilmasi talab qilinadi.

- Mehmonxonalar va ko'ngilochar obyektlar: restoranlar, mehmonxonalar, sport majmualari — turli zonalarda ko'p sonli kameraga ega obyektlar, bu yerda tarmoq barqarorligi va markazlashtirilgan boshqaruv qulayligi kritik.

## Katalogdagi brendlar va modellar

- Hikvision: katalogda ushbu ishlab chiqaruvchining PoE-kommutatorlarining keng liniyasi taqdim etilgan — kichik o'rnatishlar uchun ixcham boshqarilmaydigan DS-3E0 seriyali modellardan tortib kengaytirilgan tarmoq funksiyalariga ega DS-3E1 va DS-3T seriyali ko'p portli boshqariladigan kommutatorlargacha. EI seriyali modellar veb-interfeys orqali boshqarish va Hikvision platformasi bilan integratsiyani qo'llab-quvvatlaydi, bu yirik loyihalarda ekspluatatsiyani soddalashtiradi.

- Hikvision'ning DS-3E0 va DS-3T seriyali boshqarilmaydigan PoE-kommutatorlari: tarmoqni nozik sozlash talab qilinmaydigan obyektlar uchun optimal tanlov. Ishga tushirish soddaligi, yuqori ishonchlilik va Hi-PoE ni qo'llab-quvvatlash ularni ko'cha videokuzatuvini o'rnatishda talab qilinadigan qiladi.

- SI seriyali boshqariladigan PoE-kommutatorlari: kengaytirilgan marshrutlash protokollari, SNMP-monitoring va moslashuvchan VLAN sozlashni qo'llab-quvvatlovchi yuqori darajali modellar. Videokuzatuv tarmog'i korxonaning umumiy IT-infratuzilmasiga integratsiya qilingan yirik obyektlarda qo'llaniladi.

- Hi-PoE standartini qo'llab-quvvatlaydigan modellar: katalogdagi bir qator kommutatorlar portga 60 Vt gacha quvvat berishni ta'minlaydi, bu isitgichli zamonaviy PTZ-kameralar, o'zbek iqlimi sharoitidagi ko'cha kameralari va yuqori energiya iste'moliga ega ko'p funksiyali qurilmalar uchun zarur.

## FAQ

Q: Boshqariladigan kommutator boshqarilmaydiganidan nimasi bilan farq qiladi?
A: Boshqarilmaydigan kommutator ulanishdan so'ng darhol, hech qanday sozlashsiz ishlaydi va bir turdagi qurilmalarga ega oddiy tarmoqlar uchun mos keladi. Boshqariladigan kommutator VLAN, trafik prioritetlarini sozlash, portlar holatini kuzatish va qurilmani masofadan boshqarish imkonini beradi — bu yirik obyektlar va xavfsizlik hamda ishonchlilikka yuqori talablar qo'yiladigan tarmoqlar uchun zarur.

Q: PoE-kommutator uchun alohida quvvat manbai kerakmi?
A: PoE-kommutator oddiy 220V tarmoqqa ulanadi va mustaqil ravishda ulangan qurilmalarga portlar orqali quvvat taqsimlaydi. Kameralar yoki kirish nuqtalari uchun alohida quvvat manbai kerak emas — bu PoE-texnologiyaning asosiy afzalliklaridan biri bo'lib, o'rnatishni sezilarli darajada soddalashtiradi.

Q: Kommutatordan kameragacha signalni qanday masofaga uzatish mumkin?
A: Ethernet standarti o'ralgan juftlik segmenti uzunligini 100 metr bilan cheklaydi. Bir qator Hikvision kommutatorlari Long Range PoE rejimini qo'llab-quvvatlaydi, bu tezlik pasayishi hisobiga uzatish masofasini 250-300 metrgacha oshirish imkonini beradi — bu katta hududli obyektlar uchun foydali.

Q: Hikvision kommutatorlarini boshqa ishlab chiqaruvchilarning kameralari bilan ishlatish mumkinmi?
A: Ha, Hikvision kommutatorlari standart Ethernet va PoE protokollarini qo'llab-quvvatlaydi, shuning uchun har qanday ishlab chiqaruvchilarning uskunasi bilan mos keladi. Kengaytirilgan integratsiya funksiyalari — masalan, avtomatik aniqlash va portni masofadan qayta yuklash — Hikvision uskunasi bilan birga ishlatilganda mavjud.

Q: Kommutatorlarga kafolat qanday va unga nima kiradi?
A: SAT Solutions tomonidan yetkazib beriladigan Hikvision uskunasiga ishlab chiqaruvchining rasmiy kafolati tarqaladi. Qurilma ishlab chiqarish nuqsoni sababli ishdan chiqqan taqdirda kompaniya uskunani almashtirish yoki ta'mirlashni ta'minlaydi. Kafolat shartlari va muddatlarini buyurtma rasmiylashtirishda menejerlardan aniqlashtirish mumkin.
hik-switches.en:
Switches are network equipment without which it is impossible to build any modern video surveillance, access control, or structured cabling system. It is the switch that unites IP cameras, NVR recorders, readers, and other devices into a single local network, ensuring data transmission between them. In security systems, PoE switches play a special role, they not only transmit data but also power the connected devices over the same twisted-pair cable, which significantly simplifies installation and reduces the cost of cabling infrastructure.

If you plan to buy a switch in Tashkent for a video surveillance site, it is important to understand that the choice of model directly depends on the scale of the project and the network requirements. For a small office or shop, an unmanaged PoE switch with 4-8 ports is sufficient. Large sites, shopping centers, manufacturing enterprises, residential complexes, require managed switches with VLAN support, traffic monitoring, and redundancy. A correctly selected switch guarantees stable operation of the entire security system without freezes or video stream loss.

The SAT Solutions catalog offers 46 switch models for building the network infrastructure of security systems in Uzbekistan. The equipment covers the entire range of tasks: from simple unmanaged PoE solutions for small sites to multi-port managed switches for distributed networks with high requirements for reliability and performance.

## How to choose

- Number of PoE ports: determine how many devices need to be powered over the network. Cameras, Wi-Fi access points, IP phones, ACS readers, all of these consume power via PoE. Choose a switch with a port reserve of 20-30% for possible system expansion.

- Total PoE power: a key parameter that is often overlooked. Even if there are enough ports, a switch with a low PoE budget will not be able to power all connected devices simultaneously at full load. Calculate the total consumption of all devices and choose a model with a power reserve.

- Managed or unmanaged: unmanaged switches are simpler to set up and cheaper, suitable for small homogeneous networks. Managed ones allow you to configure VLANs, prioritize traffic (QoS), and monitor the state of ports remotely, indispensable for large and distributed sites.

- Port speed: for most standard-resolution IP cameras, 10/100 Mbit/s ports are sufficient. High-resolution 4K cameras and PTZ cameras with a high bitrate require gigabit ports. Also take into account the uplink ports for connecting to the backbone network.

- PoE standard: there are the PoE (15.4 W per port), PoE+ (30 W), and Hi-PoE (60 W) standards. PTZ cameras, outdoor cameras with heating, and Wi-Fi 6 access points require PoE+ or Hi-PoE. Make sure the switch supports the required standard for your devices.

- Housing and operating conditions: for installation in server cabinets, choose a rack-mount design. For outdoor installation or harsh conditions, models in protected housings with an extended temperature range are needed.

- Compatibility with the video surveillance system: switches from the same manufacturer as the cameras and recorders often support advanced integration functions, automatic device discovery, remote monitoring, and port reboot through the NVR interface.

## Applications

- Video surveillance systems: switches serve as the basis of the network infrastructure for connecting IP cameras to NVR recorders and video analytics servers. They are used at industrial enterprises, warehouse complexes, parking lots, and territories with extensive cabling networks.

- Offices and business centers: uniting video surveillance, access control, IP telephony, and corporate IT infrastructure systems into a single network. Managed switches allow security traffic and corporate data to be separated via VLANs.

- Retail sites: supermarkets, shopping centers, and shops use switches to build video surveillance networks with tens and hundreds of cameras covering sales floors, warehouses, checkout areas, and the perimeter.

- Residential complexes and apartment buildings: switches ensure the operation of intercom systems, IP video surveillance in entrance halls and the adjacent territory, and access control systems at entrances and in elevators.

- Critical infrastructure facilities: banks, government agencies, medical organizations, and educational institutions where reliable and managed network infrastructure with redundancy and monitoring capabilities is required.

- Hotels and entertainment venues: restaurants, hotels, sports complexes, sites with a large number of cameras in different zones, where network stability and the convenience of centralized management are critical.

## Brands and models in the catalog

- Hikvision: the catalog offers a wide line of PoE switches from this manufacturer, from compact unmanaged models of the DS-3E0 series for small installations to multi-port managed switches of the DS-3E1 and DS-3T series with advanced network functions. Models of the EI series support management through a web interface and integration with the Hikvision platform, which simplifies operation in large projects.

- Hikvision unmanaged PoE switches of the DS-3E0 and DS-3T series: the optimal choice for sites where fine network tuning is not required. Ease of commissioning, high reliability, and Hi-PoE support make them in demand for installing outdoor video surveillance.

- Managed PoE switches of the SI series: senior models with support for advanced routing protocols, SNMP monitoring, and flexible VLAN configuration. Used at large sites where the video surveillance network is integrated into the enterprise's overall IT infrastructure.

- Models with Hi-PoE standard support: a number of switches in the catalog provide up to 60 W of power per port, which is necessary for modern PTZ cameras with heating, outdoor cameras in the Uzbek climate, and multifunctional devices with high power consumption.

## FAQ

Q: What is the difference between a managed and an unmanaged switch?
A: An unmanaged switch works immediately after connection without any configuration and is suitable for simple networks with the same type of devices. A managed switch allows you to configure VLANs, traffic priorities, monitor the state of ports, and manage the device remotely, this is necessary for large sites and networks with high security and reliability requirements.

Q: Does a PoE switch need a separate power supply?
A: A PoE switch connects to a regular 220V network and independently distributes power over the ports to the connected devices. A separate power supply for cameras or access points is not needed, this is one of the main advantages of PoE technology, significantly simplifying installation.

Q: Over what distance can a signal be transmitted from the switch to the camera?
A: The Ethernet standard limits the length of a twisted-pair segment to 100 meters. A number of Hikvision switches support Long Range PoE mode, which allows the transmission range to be increased to 250-300 meters at a reduced speed, this is useful for sites with a large territory.

Q: Can Hikvision switches be used with cameras from other manufacturers?
A: Yes, Hikvision switches support standard Ethernet and PoE protocols, so they are compatible with equipment from any manufacturer. Advanced integration functions, such as auto-discovery and remote port reboot, are available when used together with Hikvision equipment.

Q: What is the warranty on switches and what does it include?
A: Hikvision equipment supplied by SAT Solutions is covered by the official manufacturer's warranty. In the event of a device failure due to a manufacturing defect, the company provides replacement or repair of the equipment. You can clarify the warranty terms and periods with the managers when placing an order.

Bu uskuna maishiy ma'noda "sarflanadigan" emas — har bir element aniq texnik funksiyani bajaradi va butun tizimning ishonchliligiga ta'sir qiladi.

Toshkentda Рубеж yordamchi uskunasini sotib olish avvalo loyihachilar, o'rnatish tashkilotlari va amaldagi yoki loyihalashtirilayotgan yong'in signalizatsiyasiga ega obyektlarning texnik xizmatlari orasida talab qilinadi. Adresli metkalar, indikatsiya va boshqaruv bloklari, ikkilamchi quvvat manbalari, shleyf izolyatorlari va programmatorlar — bu qurilmalarning barchasi adresli-analog tizimning to'g'ri ishlashi vazifalarini hal qiladi, shleyfdagi qurilmalarni identifikatsiya qilishdan tortib uzluksiz elektr ta'minoti va qisqa tutashuvni lokalizatsiya qilishgacha. O'zbekistonda bunday uskunaga bo'lgan talab an'anaviy porogli tizimlardan adreslilariga o'tayotgan obyektlar soni bilan birga o'sib bormoqda.

Aniq pozitsiyalarni tanlashda protokol versiyasini va platforma reviziyasini hisobga olish muhim: R3 liniyasidagi qurilmalar Рубеж R3 protokoli doirasida ishlaydi va qo'shimcha shlyuzlarsiz oldingi reviziyalar bilan mos kelmaydi. Xarid qilishdan oldin obyektda konfiguratsiya konfliktlarini istisno qilish uchun qo'llaniladigan kontrollerlar va asboblarni ishlab chiqaruvchining mos uskunalar ro'yxati bilan solishtirish tavsiya etiladi.

## Qanday tanlash kerak

- Protokol versiyasi bilan moslik. Qo'shimcha uskuna (metkalar, izolyatorlar, quvvat manbalari) sizning tizimingiz reviziyasiga — R3 yoki oldingiga mos kelishiga ishonch hosil qiling. Shlyuzlarsiz versiyalarni aralashtirish shleyfni so'rovda xatoliklarga olib keladi.

- Talab qilinadigan quvvat toki. Рубеж ИВЭПР ikkilamchi quvvat manbalari turli yuk toklari (2 A, 3,5 A, 5 A) bilan chiqariladi. Ulangan adresli qurilmalarning umumiy iste'molidan kamida 20% zaxira bilan model tanlang.

- Zaxira akkumulyatorining sig'imi. "2x7" yoki "2x17" konfiguratsiyasi (raqam — har bir AKB ning amper-soatlari) tarmoq o'chganda navbatchilik rejimidagi ish vaqtini belgilaydi. Qo'riqlash uzluksizligiga talab qo'yiladigan obyektlar uchun kattaroq sig'imli bajarilishni tanlang.

- Adreslar soni va shleyf topologiyasi. ИЗ-1-R3 shleyf izolyatorlari KZ ni lokalizatsiya qilish uchun halqasimon liniyaga o'rnatiladi: har 32 adresli qurilmaga bitta izolyator — tipik tavsiya. Loyihalash bosqichida izolyatorlarga bo'lgan ehtiyojni hisoblang.

- Adresli metka turi. АМ (adresli metka) noadresli qurilmalar yoki konstruksiyalarga adres berish uchun ishlatiladi; АМП (adresli yong'in metkasi) qo'shimcha yong'inga qarshi indikatsiyaga ega izvestitel'larni identifikatsiya qilish uchun mo'ljallangan. Xarid qilishdan oldin vazifasini aniqlashtiring.

- Programmator zarurligi. ПКУ-1-R3 qurilmasi qurilma adreslarini tizimdan tashqarida dastlabki dasturlash uchun kerak — o'rnatishdan oldin guruhli konfiguratsiyada qulay. Agar o'rnatuvchining tarkibida programmator bo'lsa, alohida xarid qilish kerak emas.

- Tutunni chiqarishni boshqarish tugmalari. УДП 513-11-R3 — tutunni chiqarish tizimini qo'lda ishga tushirishning adresli tugmasi. U adresli shleyfga ulanadi va tizimda alohida qurilma sifatida ko'rsatiladi; rang va yozuv (masalan, "ПУСК ДЫМОУДАЛЕНИЯ") loyiha va normativlar talablariga ko'ra tanlanadi.

## Qo'llanilish sohalari

- Ma'muriy va ofis binolari. Toshkent va O'zbekistonning yirik shaharlaridagi biznes-markazlarda yong'in signalizatsiyasi tizimlari, qoida tariqasida, adresli platformada quriladi; Рубеж yordamchi qurilmalari ularning ishlashini ta'minlaydi.

- Savdo va ko'ngilochar obyektlar. Katta maydon, tarmoqlangan shleyf topologiyasi va tutunni chiqarish talablari adresli metkalar va boshqaruv tugmalarini loyihaning ajralmas qismiga aylantiradi.

- Ishlab chiqarish korxonalari va omborlar. Sanoat obyektlaridagi cho'zilgan halqasimon shleyflar yakka qisqa tutashuvlardan himoyalanish uchun izolyatorlarni majburiy o'rnatishni talab qiladi.

- Mehmonxonalar va turar-joy majmualari. Odamlar doimiy bo'ladigan obyektlar uchun yong'in xavfsizligi normativlari adresli asboblarni zaxiralangan elektr ta'minoti bilan ta'minlashni nazarda tutadi — aynan shu maqsad uchun ИВЭПР manbalari mo'ljallangan.

- Sog'liqni saqlash va ta'lim obyektlari. Zamonaviy normalar bo'yicha loyihalashtirilayotgan kasalxonalar, klinikalar va o'quv muassasalari yong'in signalizatsiyasi tizimlarini tutunni chiqarish va ogohlantirish boshqaruvi bilan integratsiya qilishni talab qiladi.

## Katalogdagi brendlar va modellar

- Рубеж — katalogning ushbu bo'limidagi yagona ishlab chiqaruvchi, adresli-analog uskunaning keng liniyasiga ega rossiyalik brend. Mahsulot sertifikatlangan va Mustaqil Davlatlar Hamdo'stligi obyektlarida, jumladan O'zbekistonda keng qo'llaniladi.

- АМ-1-R3 va АМ-4-R3 adresli metkalari o'z adresli interfeysiga ega bo'lmagan qurilmalarni har bir nuqtani individual identifikatsiya qilib adresli shleyfga ulash imkonini beradi.

- АМП-4 va АМП-4-R3 adresli yong'in metkalari qo'shimcha ravishda ishga tushishning yorug'lik indikatsiyasini bevosita o'rnatilgan joyda ta'minlaydi, bu obyektni aylanib chiqishda qulay.

- ИВЭПР 12/2, 12/3,5 va 12/5 ikkilamchi quvvat manbalari AKB sig'imi bo'yicha turli bajarilishlarda shleyfning adresli qurilmalari uchun har qanday topologiya varianti bo'yicha 12 V zaxiralangan quvvatni ta'minlaydi.

- ИЗ-1-R3 izolyatori va ПКУ-1-R3 programmatori — servis qurilmalari bo'lib, mos ravishda halqasimon shleyfni himoya qilish va ishga tushirish bosqichida adreslarni dastlabki dasturlash uchun zarur.

## FAQ

Q: Рубеж R3 uskunasi R3 indeksisiz eski Рубеж asboblari bilan mos keladimi?
A: Umumiy holatda R3 qurilmalari faqat R3 protokoli doirasida ishlaydi va maxsus shlyuzlar yoki konvertorlarsiz oldingi reviziyalar bilan mos kelmaydi. Xarid qilishdan oldin muhandisimizdan amaldagi boshqaruv asbobingiz qaysi protokoldan foydalanishini aniqlashtiring.

Q: Obyektga qancha shleyf izolyatori kerak?
A: Ishlab chiqaruvchining standart tavsiyasi — halqasimon shleyfdagi har 32 adresli qurilmaga bitta ИЗ-1-R3 izolyator. Aniq son loyihalashda liniya topologiyasi va tizim yashovchanligiga talablarni hisobga olib belgilanadi.

Q: Butun tizimni almashtirmasdan ИВЭПР quvvat manbaini o'rnatish mumkinmi?
A: Ha, ikkilamchi quvvat manbalari qo'shimcha qurilmalarni quvvatlantirish yoki eskirgan quvvat bloklarini almashtirish uchun mavjud adresli tizimga qo'shilishi mumkin. Interfeys va chiqish parametrlarining amaldagi uskuna bilan mosligiga ishonch hosil qilish muhim.

Q: Obyektda bitta qurilmani almashtirishda ПКУ-1-R3 programmatori kerakmi?
A: Agar qurilma allaqachon dasturlashtirilgan bo'lsa va siz uni bir xil adresli identik qurilmaga almashtirsangiz, programmator kerak emas — adresni boshqaruv asbobi orqali belgilash mumkin. ПКУ-1-R3 o'rnatishdan oldin yangi qurilmalarni ommaviy dasturlashda qulay.

Q: Рубеж uskunasini Toshkentga yetkazib berish muddati qancha?
A: Omborda mavjud pozitsiyalar 1-3 ish kuni ichida jo'natiladi. Buyurtma bo'yicha pozitsiyalar muddatlarini menejerdan aniqlashtiring — ular yetkazib beruvchidagi joriy mavjudlik va logistikaga bog'liq.
rubezh-misc.en:
Addressable fire alarm systems are becoming increasingly complex and multi-component, and that is exactly why the section of auxiliary and additional equipment occupies an important place in design. The SAT Solutions catalog offers components and peripheral devices of the Rubezh brand, which ensure the operability, diagnostics, and control of the addressable loops of fire automatics. This equipment is not "consumable" in the everyday sense, each element performs a specific technical function and affects the reliability of the entire system as a whole.

Buying Rubezh auxiliary equipment in Tashkent is in demand primarily among designers, installation organizations, and technical services of sites with an operating or planned fire alarm system. Addressable labels, indication and control units, secondary power supplies, loop isolators, and programmers, all of these devices solve the tasks of correct operation of an addressable-analog system, from identifying devices on the loop to uninterrupted power supply and localization of a short circuit. In Uzbekistan, demand for such equipment is growing along with the number of sites transitioning from traditional threshold systems to addressable ones.

When selecting specific items, it is important to take into account the protocol version and the platform revision: devices of the R3 line operate within the Rubezh R3 protocol and are incompatible with earlier revisions without additional gateways. Before purchasing, it is recommended to check the controllers and devices used against the manufacturer's list of compatible equipment, in order to rule out configuration conflicts on site.

## How to choose

- Compatibility with the protocol version. Make sure the additional equipment (labels, isolators, power supplies) matches the revision of your system, R3 or earlier. Mixing versions without gateways leads to loop polling errors.

- Required supply current. Rubezh IVEPR secondary power supplies are produced with different load currents (2 A, 3.5 A, 5 A). Choose a model based on the total consumption of the connected addressable devices with a margin of at least 20%.

- Backup battery capacity. The "2x7" or "2x17" configuration (the number is the ampere-hours of each battery) determines the operating time in standby mode when the mains is disconnected. For sites with continuity-of-protection requirements, choose a version with greater capacity.

- Number of addresses and loop topology. IZ-1-R3 loop isolators are installed in the ring line to localize a short circuit: one isolator for every 32 addressable devices is a typical recommendation. Calculate the need for isolators at the design stage.

- Type of addressable label. AM (addressable label) is used to assign an address to non-addressable devices or structures; AMP (addressable fire label) is intended for identifying detectors with additional fire indication. Clarify the purpose before purchasing.

- Need for a programmer. The PKU-1-R3 device is required for the initial programming of device addresses outside the system, convenient for group configuration before installation. If the installer's team has a programmer, a separate purchase is not needed.

- Smoke-removal control buttons. The UDP 513-11-R3 is an addressable manual-start button for the smoke removal system. It connects to the addressable loop and is displayed in the system as a separate device; the color and inscription (for example, "SMOKE REMOVAL START") are chosen according to the requirements of the project and regulations.

## Applications

- Administrative and office buildings. Fire alarm systems in business centers of Tashkent and large cities of Uzbekistan are, as a rule, built on an addressable platform; Rubezh auxiliary devices ensure their operation.

- Retail and entertainment venues. Large area, branched loop topology, and smoke-removal requirements make addressable labels and control buttons an integral part of the project.

- Manufacturing enterprises and warehouses. Extended ring loops at industrial sites require the mandatory installation of isolators to protect against single short circuits.

- Hotels and residential complexes. Fire safety regulations for sites with a constant presence of people provide for redundant power supply of addressable devices, this is exactly what IVEPR sources are intended for.

- Healthcare and education facilities. Hospitals, clinics, and educational institutions designed according to modern standards require the integration of fire alarm systems with smoke-removal control and notification.

## Brands and models in the catalog

- Rubezh is the only manufacturer in this section of the catalog, a Russian brand with a wide line of addressable-analog equipment. The products are certified and widely used at sites in the CIS, including Uzbekistan.

- AM-1-R3 and AM-4-R3 addressable labels allow devices without their own addressable interface to be connected to the addressable loop, with individual identification of each point.

- AMP-4 and AMP-4-R3 addressable fire labels additionally provide light indication of activation directly at the installation location, which is convenient when patrolling the site.

- IVEPR 12/2, 12/3.5, and 12/5 secondary power supplies in various battery-capacity versions provide redundant 12 V power for addressable loop devices in any topology option.

- The IZ-1-R3 isolator and the PKU-1-R3 programmer are service devices, needed respectively for protecting the ring loop and for the initial programming of addresses at the commissioning stage.

## FAQ

Q: Is Rubezh R3 equipment compatible with old Rubezh devices without the R3 index?
A: In general, R3 devices work only within the R3 protocol and are incompatible with earlier revisions without special gateways or converters. Before purchasing, check with our engineer which protocol your current control device uses.

Q: How many loop isolators are needed for a site?
A: The manufacturer's standard recommendation is one IZ-1-R3 isolator for every 32 addressable devices in a ring loop. The exact number is determined during design, taking into account the line topology and the system's survivability requirements.

Q: Can an IVEPR power supply be installed without replacing the entire system?
A: Yes, secondary power supplies can be added to an existing addressable system to power additional devices or replace outdated power units. It is important to make sure the interface and output parameters are compatible with the existing equipment.

Q: Is a PKU-1-R3 programmer needed when replacing one device at a site?
A: If the device has already been programmed and you are replacing it with an identical one with the same address, a programmer is not required, the address can be set through the control device. The PKU-1-R3 is convenient for mass programming of new devices before installation.

Q: What is the delivery time for Rubezh equipment to Tashkent?
A: Items in stock are shipped within 1-3 business days. Clarify the terms for made-to-order items with the manager, they depend on the current availability at the supplier and logistics.
