Wi-Fi kameralar — bu kabel yo'llarini o'tkazmasdan videokuzatuvni tashkil etishning zamonaviy usuli. Simli ulanishga ega an'anaviy IP-kameralardan farqli o'laroq, bunday qurilmalar videooqimni simsiz tarmoq orqali uzatadi, bu o'rnatishni ancha soddaroq va tezroq qiladi. Bugungi kunda Toshkentda Wi-Fi kamera sotib olishni eng turli vazifalar uchun amalga oshirish mumkin: uy va kvartirani qo'riqlash, ofisni kuzatish, kichik ishlab chiqarish yoki savdo nuqtasini nazorat qilish. Asosiy afzalligi — o'rnatish moslashuvchanligi: kamerani kabel yetmaydigan joyga joylashtirish yoki zarurat tug'ilganda tezda ko'chirish mumkin.

Zamonaviy Wi-Fi kameralar oddiy veb-kameralardan ancha uzoqlashib ketgan. Katalogda motorli privodga ega aylanuvchi PTZ modellari, ikki zonani bir vaqtda ko'rish uchun ikki obyektivli kameralar, avtonom ishlash uchun quyosh panellaridan quvvatlanadigan yechimlar va 4G ni qo'llab-quvvatlaydigan modellar taqdim etilgan — oxirgilari umuman uydagi Wi-Fi tarmoq mavjudligiga bog'liq emas. Matritsa ruxsati, ko'rish burchagi, tungi ko'rish, ikki tomonlama audioaloqasi, xotira kartasida yoki bulutda lokal saqlash — bularning barchasi aniq modelni tanlashga ta'sir qiladi. O'zbekistonda Wi-Fi kameralar aynan jiddiy qurilish ishlarisiz videokuzatuvni joriy etish imkonini bergani uchun katta talabga ega.

Wi-Fi kameralarni tanlashda foydalanish sharoitlarini xolisona baholash muhim: obyekt turi, o'rnatish zonasida barqaror Wi-Fi signalining mavjudligi, ish rejimi (faqat kunduzimi yoki sutka bo'yicha), yozib olish va arxivni saqlash zarurligi. Bu savollarga javoblarga byudjet ham, zarur funksiyalar to'plami ham bog'liq. SAT Solutions mutaxassislari ortiqcha narsa uchun ortiqcha to'lamaslik va o'rnatishdan so'ng imkoniyatlar yetishmasligiga duch kelmaslik uchun aniq vazifaga mos uskunani tanlashda yordam beradi.

## Qanday tanlash kerak

- Kamera turi: aylanuvchi yoki qo'zg'almas. Aylanuvchi PTZ-kameralar katta maydonni qamrab olish va ilova orqali masofadan boshqarish imkonini beradi, qo'zg'almaslari — soddaroq va arzonroq, aniq nuqtani nazorat qilish uchun mos.
- Matritsa ruxsati. Uy foydalanishi uchun Full HD (1080p) yetarli, yirik obyektlar uchun yoki raqamlar va yuzlarni o'qish muhim bo'lganda — 2K va undan yuqorini tanlang.
- Tungi ko'rish masofasi va sifati. Aksariyat kameralar infraqizil yoritishdan foydalanadi, ilg'or modellar — Starlight-sensorlarga asoslangan rangli tungi ko'rishdan. IK-yoritishning marketing emas, real masofasini aniqlashtiring.
- Videoyozuvlarni saqlash. Ba'zi modellar microSD-kartaga yozadi, boshqalari bulutli saqlash yoki NAS ni qo'llab-quvvatlaydi. Jiddiy arxiv uchun ONVIF ni qo'llab-quvvatlaydigan lokal videoregistrator yoki NAS kerak.
- Wi-Fi ulanishining barqarorligi. Kamera simsiz kanal qanchalik barqaror bo'lsa, shunchalik yaxshi ishlaydi. Agar qamrov zaif bo'lsa, 4G-kameralarni yoki kabel o'tkazishni ko'rib chiqing.
- Tashqi muhitdan himoya. Ko'chada o'rnatish uchun IP65 va undan yuqori himoya sinfi, O'zbekistonga xos harorat diapazoniga chidamlilik majburiy — qishda kuchli sovuqdan tortib yozda soyada +50°C gacha.
- Ekotizim va boshqaruv. Qulay mobil ilova, aqlli uy bilan integratsiya imkoniyati, ovozli assistentlarni qo'llab-quvvatlash — bu omillar kundalik foydalanish qulayligiga ta'sir qiladi.

## Qo'llanilish sohalari

- Turar-joy obyektlari: kvartiralar, xususiy uylar, bog'lar. Wi-Fi kameralar ta'mirsiz oson o'rnatiladi va istalgan smartfondan real vaqt rejimida masofaviy nazoratni ta'minlaydi.
- Kichik va o'rta biznes: ofislar, do'konlar, kafelar, dorixonalar. Kameralar murakkab infratuzilmasiz kassa zonasi, ombor, kirish va savdo zalini nazorat qilishga yordam beradi.
- Kichik maydonli ishlab chiqarish va omborlar, bu yerda xodimlar va mol-mulk saqlanishini nazorat qilish muhim, kabel o'tkazish esa maqsadga muvofiq emas.
- Avtonom obyektlar: bog' uchastkalari, qurilish maydonchalari, vaqtinchalik obyektlar — ayniqsa elektr tarmog'isiz quvvatlanish uchun 4G-modul va quyosh paneli bilan birgalikda.
- Ta'lim muassasalari: bolalar bog'chalari, o'quv sinflari, maktab yo'laklari — bolalar va xodimlar xavfsizligini nazorat qilish uchun.

## Katalogdagi brendlar va modellar

- Tapo — TP-Link'ning iste'molchi brendi bo'lib, rivojlangan ekotizimga ega arzon va qulay Wi-Fi kameralarga ixtisoslashgan. Tapo ilovasi barcha qurilmalarni yagona muhitda boshqarish, harakatni aniqlash zonalarini sozlash va push-bildirishnomalar olish imkonini beradi.
- Tapo aylanuvchi kameralar liniyasi (TC40, TC70, C211, C210, C202) turli narx segmentlarini qamrab oladi va gorizontal tekislikda 360° panoramalash, ikki tomonlama audioaloqasi hamda xotira kartasiga yoki Tapo Care bulutiga yozib olishni taklif qiladi.
- Ko'cha bajarilishidagi C seriyali modellar (C520WS, C460) xonadan tashqarida foydalanishga mo'ljallangan bo'lib, chang va namlikdan tegishli himoya darajasiga, shuningdek kuchliroq IK-yoritishga ega.
- Tapo C246D ikki obyektivli kamerasi — bitta o'rnatish nuqtasidan ikki yo'nalishni bir vaqtda nazorat qilish uchun nostandart yechim bo'lib, obyektdagi qurilmalarning umumiy sonini kamaytiradi.
- 4G-modul va quyosh paneli bilan Tapo C615G KIT to'plami — elektrsiz va Wi-Fi'siz obyektlar uchun avtonom yechim: dala, qurilish maydonchasi, shahar tashqarisidagi uchastka.

## FAQ

Q: Wi-Fi kamerani internetsiz ulash mumkinmi?
A: Ha, aksariyat modellar lokal tarmoqda ishlaydi va internetga chiqishsiz ham videoni xotira kartasiga yozadi. Bu holda mobil ilova orqali masofaviy ko'rish mavjud bo'lmaydi.

Q: Kameraning normal ishlashi uchun qanday internet kerak?
A: Real vaqt rejimida videoni ko'rish uchun kameraga 2 Mbit/s dan barqaror ulanish yetarli. Bulutga yozish va bildirishnomalarni olish uchun tezlik emas, balki kanal barqarorligi muhim.

Q: Toshkentda Wi-Fi kameralarni o'rnatish qancha turadi?
A: Narx kameralar soniga, obyekt murakkabligiga va Wi-Fi qamrovini kuchaytirish bo'yicha zarur ishlarga bog'liq. Aniq narxni mutaxassis chiqib, smeta tuzgandan so'ng bilish mumkin — bu bepul.

Q: Tapo kameralari boshqa videokuzatuv tizimlari bilan mos keladimi?
A: Ba'zi modellar ONVIF protokolini qo'llab-quvvatlaydi, bu ularni uchinchi tomon ishlab chiqaruvchilarining videoregistratorlari va VMS-tizimlari bilan integratsiya qilish imkonini beradi. Bu nuqtani sotib olishdan oldin aniq model bo'yicha aniqlashtirish kerak.

Q: Wi-Fi kameralar va o'rnatish ishlariga kafolat bormi?
A: Uskunaga ishlab chiqaruvchining rasmiy kafolati amal qiladi. O'rnatish ishlariga SAT Solutions o'z kafolatini beradi — shartlar shartnoma tuzishda muhokama qilinadi.
tapo-cameras.en:
Wi-Fi cameras are a modern way to set up video surveillance without laying cable runs. Unlike traditional IP cameras with a wired connection, such devices transmit the video stream over a wireless network, which makes installation significantly simpler and faster. Buying Wi-Fi cameras in Tashkent today is possible for a wide variety of tasks: protecting a home and apartment, monitoring an office, controlling a small production facility or retail outlet. The main advantage is installation flexibility: a camera can be placed where a cable cannot reach, or quickly moved when necessary.

Modern Wi-Fi cameras have come a long way from simple webcams. The catalog offers PTZ rotating models with a motorized drive, dual-lens cameras with simultaneous viewing of two zones, solutions powered by solar panels for autonomous operation, and models with 4G support, the latter do not depend on the presence of a home Wi-Fi network at all. Sensor resolution, viewing angle, night vision, two-way audio, local storage on a memory card or in the cloud, all of this affects the choice of a specific model. In Uzbekistan, Wi-Fi cameras are in high demand precisely because they allow video surveillance to be deployed without serious construction work.

When choosing Wi-Fi cameras, it is important to soberly assess the operating conditions: the type of site, the presence of a stable Wi-Fi signal in the installation zone, the operating mode (daytime only or around the clock), and the need for recording and archive storage. The answers to these questions determine both the budget and the set of required functions. SAT Solutions specialists will help select equipment for a specific task, so as not to overpay for unnecessary features and not to face a lack of capabilities after installation.

## How to choose

- Camera type: pan-tilt or fixed. PTZ pan-tilt cameras allow a large area to be covered and to be controlled remotely through an app, fixed ones are simpler and cheaper, suitable for monitoring a specific point.
- Sensor resolution. For home use, Full HD (1080p) is sufficient; for large sites or when it is important to read plates and faces, choose 2K and higher.
- Range and quality of night vision. Most cameras use infrared illumination, more advanced models use color night vision based on Starlight sensors. Clarify the real range of the IR illumination, not the marketing figure.
- Storage of video recordings. Some models write to a microSD card, others support cloud storage or NAS. For a serious archive, a local video recorder or a NAS with ONVIF support is needed.
- Stability of the Wi-Fi connection. A camera works only as well as the wireless channel is stable. If coverage is weak, consider 4G cameras or laying a cable.
- Protection from the external environment. For outdoor installation, an IP65 protection rating or higher is mandatory, along with resistance to the temperature range characteristic of Uzbekistan, from severe frost in winter to +50°C in the shade in summer.
- Ecosystem and management. A convenient mobile app, the ability to integrate with a smart home, support for voice assistants, these factors affect the daily comfort of use.

## Applications

- Residential sites: apartments, private houses, country houses. Wi-Fi cameras are easily installed without renovation and provide remote real-time control from any smartphone.
- Small and medium business: offices, shops, cafes, pharmacies. Cameras help control the checkout area, warehouse, entrance, and sales floor without complex infrastructure.
- Manufacturing and small warehouses, where control over personnel and the safety of property is important, and laying a cable is impractical.
- Autonomous sites: country plots, construction sites, temporary facilities, especially in combination with a 4G module and a solar panel for power without a mains network.
- Educational institutions: kindergartens, classrooms, school corridors, for monitoring the safety of children and staff.

## Brands and models in the catalog

- Tapo is a consumer brand from TP-Link, specializing in affordable and convenient Wi-Fi cameras with a well-developed ecosystem. The Tapo app allows you to manage all devices in a single environment, configure motion-detection zones, and receive push notifications.
- The line of Tapo pan-tilt cameras (TC40, TC70, C211, C210, C202) covers different price segments and offers 360° horizontal panning, two-way audio, and recording to a memory card or the Tapo Care cloud.
- Models of the C series with outdoor design (C520WS, C460) are designed for operation outdoors and have an appropriate degree of protection from dust and moisture, as well as more powerful IR illumination.
- The Tapo C246D dual-lens camera is a non-standard solution for simultaneous monitoring of two directions from a single installation point, which reduces the total number of devices at the site.
- The Tapo C615G KIT with a 4G module and a solar panel is an autonomous solution for sites without electricity and without Wi-Fi: a field, a construction site, a country plot.

## FAQ

Q: Can a Wi-Fi camera be connected without internet?
A: Yes, most models work on a local network and record video to a memory card even without internet access. Remote viewing through the mobile app will be unavailable in this case.

Q: What kind of internet is needed for the camera to work properly?
A: For real-time video viewing, a stable connection of 2 Mbit/s per camera is sufficient. For cloud recording and receiving notifications, it is not so much the speed that matters as the stability of the channel.

Q: How much does Wi-Fi camera installation cost in Tashkent?
A: The cost depends on the number of cameras, the complexity of the site, and the necessary work to strengthen Wi-Fi coverage. The exact price can be determined after a specialist visit and drawing up an estimate, this is free.

Q: Are Tapo cameras compatible with other video surveillance systems?
A: Some models support the ONVIF protocol, which allows them to be integrated with video recorders and VMS systems from third-party manufacturers. This point should be clarified for a specific model before purchase.

Q: Is there a warranty on Wi-Fi cameras and installation work?
A: The equipment is covered by the official manufacturer's warranty. For installation work, SAT Solutions provides its own warranty, the terms are discussed when concluding the contract.

prochee-optics.uz:
Optika va HDMI — bu videokuzatuv tizimlarida, multimedia o'rnatishlarida, tuzilmalangan kabel tarmoqlarida va korporativ ma'lumot uzatish tarmoqlarida kichik va katta masofalarga videosignal hamda ma'lumot uzatishni ta'minlaydigan kabel-kommutatsiya uskunasi toifasi. SAT Solutions katalogida optotolali liniyalar uchun SFP-modullar, optik patchkordlar va adapterlar, 4K HDMI-kabellar va HDMI-splitterlar taqdim etilgan. Bularning barchasi — birorta zamonaviy xavfsizlik yoki multimedia infratuzilmasi qurilmaydigan bazaviy komponentlar.

O'zbekistonda optika va HDMI-uskunaga bo'lgan talab HD va 4K tasvirni yo'qotishlarsiz uzatish talab qilinadigan IP-videotizimlar, savdo markazlari, mehmonxonalar, ofis binolari va ishlab chiqarish korxonalari soni o'sishi bilan birga barqaror o'sib bormoqda. Optotola bugungi kunda masofalar 100 metrdan oshadigan yoki to'liq shovqinga chidamlilik zarur bo'lgan joylarda almashtirib bo'lmaydi. HDMI-yechimlar konferens-zallar, dispetcherlik, videodevorlar va o'quv auditoriyalari uchun dolzarb. Toshkentda vazifaga professional tanlov bilan optik komponentlar va HDMI-uskunani sotib olishni SAT Solutions'dan amalga oshirish mumkin.

Kabellar, modullar va adapterlarni to'g'ri tanlash signal uzatish masofasiga, allaqachon o'rnatilgan aktiv uskunaning razyom turiga, talab qilinadigan video ruxsatiga va o'tkazish sharoitlariga bog'liq. Komponentlarni tanlash bosqichidagi xato signal yo'qolishiga, tasvir degradatsiyasiga yoki kommutatorlar va videoregistratorlar bilan to'liq mos kelmaslikka olib keladi — shuning uchun butun traktni yaxlit hisobga olish muhim.

## Qanday tanlash kerak

- Uzatish masofasi. SFP-modullar masofa bo'yicha bo'linadi: 3 km gacha (SC3km), 20 km gacha (SC20km, LC20km) va undan ortiq. 30 va 60 metrli HDMI-kabellar bino ichidagi vazifalarni kuchaytirgichlarsiz hal qiladi, biroq 15-20 metrdan ortiq uzunliklarda 4K-chastotani qo'llab-quvvatlashiga ishonch hosil qilish kerak.

- Razyom turi va moslik. Optik tizimlar UPC va APC variantlarida LC va SC razyomlaridan foydalanadi. Patchkordlar va adapterlar kommutatorlar, mediakonverterlar va aktiv uskuna portlariga mos kelishiga ishonch hosil qiling. SC/APC va SC/UPC ni chalkashtirish mumkin emas — razyomlar fizik jihatdan mos, lekin birgalikda ishlash yuqori so'nishni beradi.

- Tola turi. Bir modli tola (SM) 2 km va undan yuqori masofalarda ishlatiladi, ko'p modli (MM) — bino ichidagi qisqa liniyalar uchun. SFP-modul liniya kabeli turiga mos kelishi kerak.

- HDMI ruxsati va o'tkazish polosasi. Videodevorlarga, operatorlar monitorlariga yoki proektorlarga 4K-kontent chiqarish uchun HDMI 2.0 ni qo'llab-quvvatlaydigan va o'tkazuvchanlik qobiliyati 18 Gbit/s dan kam bo'lmagan kabellar va splitterlar kerak. Spetsifikatsiyani menejerdan aniqlashtiring.

- Splitter chiqishlari soni. 1x4 HDMI-splitter bitta manbani sifat yo'qotishisiz to'rtta ekranga tarqatadi. Ko'p sonli monitorli dispetcherlik uchun kaskadlash yoki matritsali kommutator talab qilinishi mumkin.

- Bajarilish sifati va ekranlash. Sanoat obyektlari va ko'cha shkaflari uchun egilish va tebranishga chidamli armaturali qobiqli himoyalangan patchkordlar muhim. Doimiy o'tkazish uchun HDMI-kabellar zich ekranlashga ega bo'lishi kerak.

- Aktiv uskuna bilan moslik. SFP-modullar aniq kommutator yoki mediakonverter tomonidan qo'llab-quvvatlanishi kerak. Mos modullar ro'yxatini buyurtmadan oldin vendor hujjatlarida yoki SAT Solutions mutaxassisidan aniqlashtiring.

## Qo'llanilish sohalari

- IP-videokuzatuv tizimlari. IP-kameralardan videoregistratorlar va saqlash serverlariga optotolali liniyalar orqali oqim uzatish — katta hududlar uchun standart ssenariy: sanoat zonalari, aeroportlar, universitet kampuslari.

- Konferens-zallar va muzokara xonalari. HDMI-kabellar va splitterlar prezentatsiyalar va videokonferensiyalarni bitta manbadan bir necha ekran yoki proektorga ruxsatni pasaytirmasdan chiqarishni ta'minlaydi.

- Dispetcherlik va monitoring markazlari. Videodevorlar va operatorlarning ko'p monitorli ish joylari ishonchli HDMI-distributsiya va serverxona hamda boshqaruv posti o'rtasida o'nlab metr masofada optik aloqani talab qiladi.

- Ofis va biznes-markazlarning tuzilmalangan kabel tarmoqlari. Optik patchkordlar telekommunikatsiya shkaflaridagi kommutatorlarni ulaydi; turli masofali SFP-modullar tarmoqni kengaytirishda moslashuvchanlikni ta'minlaydi.

- Mehmonxonalar va savdo obyektlari. HDMI-uskuna raqamli lavhalar, axborot ekranlari, reklama kontentini translyatsiya qilish va mehmon qavatlarida IPTV tizimlari uchun ishlatiladi.

- O'quv muassasalari va akt zallari. Optik liniyalar va HDMI-trakt ma'ruza kontenti va videoyozuvlarni markaziy serverdan bir vaqtning o'zida bir necha auditoriyaga uzatish imkonini beradi.

## Katalogdagi brendlar va modellar

- Joriy katalogda boshqa uskunaning umumiy markasi ostidagi uskuna taqdim etilgan — bu buyurtma bo'yicha yetkazib beriladigan yoki kichik seriyali, IEEE va TIA/EIA standartlariga mos keluvchi mos ishlab chiqaruvchilar mahsulotlari.

- LC20km va SC20km SFP-modullari 20 kilometrgacha masofadagi bir modli optotolali liniyalar uchun mo'ljallangan. SFP SC3km moduli 3 km gacha masofalarga hisoblangan bo'lib, ko'pincha binolar ichida yoki kichik hududlarda qo'llaniladi.

- SC-SC, SC/APC-SC/APC va LC-LC patchkordlari server shkaflarida kommutatsiya uchun 1 va 10 metr uzunlikda chiqariladi. SC-LC va LC-LC adapterlari turli razyom turlariga ega uskunani ulash imkonini beradi.

- 4K ni qo'llab-quvvatlaydigan 30 va 60 metrli HDMI-kabellar bino ichidagi aksariyat o'rnatishlar ehtiyojini kuchaytirgichlar yoki HDMI optik uzatgichlarisiz qoplaydi.

- 4K 1x4 HDMI-splitter signalni to'rtta displeyga bir vaqtda dastlabki ruxsatni saqlagan holda tarqatishni ta'minlaydi, bu uni shourumlar, dispetcherlik va konferens-zallar uchun talab qilinadigan yechim qiladi.

## FAQ

Q: SC/UPC patchkord SC/APC dan nimasi bilan farq qiladi?
A: Farq konnektor uchi geometriyasida: APC (burchakli sayqallash) -60 dB va undan yuqori darajada teskari yo'qotishlarni ta'minlaydi, bu PON-tizimlar va uzun liniyalar uchun kritik. UPC aksariyat lokal tarmoqlar va qisqa yo'llar uchun yetarli. Razyomlar fizik jihatdan almashtirib bo'lmaydi, shuning uchun sayqallash turini uskunadagi portlar turi bilan muvofiqlashtirish kerak.

Q: HDMI-kabel 4K ni signal degradatsiyasisiz qanday masofaga uzatadi?
A: Passiv HDMI-kabellar 4K 60 Gts ruxsatida 15-20 metrgacha masofalarda barqaror ishlaydi. Katalogdagi 30 va 60 metrli kabellar kuchaytirilgan xususiyatlarga ega va shu masofalarga hisoblangan, biroq tanlashda traktning ikkala uchida ham HDMI 2.0 qo'llab-quvvatlanishiga ishonch hosil qilish muhim.

Q: SFP-modulni aniq kommutator bilan muvofiqlashtirish kerakmi?
A: Ha, kommutator ishlab chiqaruvchilarining aksariyati mos SFP-modullar ro'yxatini e'lon qiladi. Sertifikatlanmagan moduldan foydalanish portni bloklash yoki nobarqaror ishlashga olib kelishi mumkin. SAT Solutions menejerlari sizning aktiv uskunangiz uchun mos modulni tanlashda yordam beradi.

Q: Toshkentda optik komponentlarni yetkazib berish va yetkazib berish muddatlari qanday tashkil etilgan?
A: Omborda mavjud pozitsiyalar Toshkent bo'ylab buyurtma kuni yoki keyingi ish kuni yetkaziladi. Buyurtma bo'yicha pozitsiyalar muddatlarini menejerdan aniqlashtiring — odatda bu spetsifikatsiyaga qarab 5-14 ish kuni.

Q: Optotolani payvandlash va o'lchash xizmatlarini ko'rsatasizmi?
A: Ha, SAT Solutions optik tolalarni payvandlash, optik reflektometr (OTDR) bilan o'lchash va so'nish testini bayonnoma berish bilan bajaradi. Bu xizmat o'rnatish ishlari tarkibiga kiradi yoki so'rov bo'yicha alohida ko'rsatiladi.
prochee-optics.en:
Optics and HDMI is a category of cabling and switching equipment that ensures the transmission of video signals and data over short and long distances in video surveillance systems, multimedia installations, structured cabling networks, and corporate data transmission networks. The SAT Solutions catalog offers SFP modules for fiber-optic lines, optical patch cords and adapters, 4K HDMI cables, and HDMI splitters. All of these are basic components without which no modern security or multimedia infrastructure is built.

Demand for optics and HDMI equipment in Uzbekistan is steadily growing along with the increase in the number of IP video systems, shopping centers, hotels, office buildings, and manufacturing enterprises where transmission of HD and 4K images without loss is required. Fiber optics today is indispensable where distances exceed 100 meters or where full immunity to interference is necessary. HDMI solutions are relevant for conference halls, control rooms, video walls, and lecture halls. Buying optical components and HDMI equipment in Tashkent with professional selection for the task is possible at SAT Solutions.

The correct choice of cables, modules, and adapters depends on the signal transmission distance, the type of connectors on the already installed active equipment, the required video resolution, and the installation conditions. An error at the component selection stage leads to signal loss, image degradation, or complete incompatibility with switches and video recorders, therefore it is important to consider the entire signal path as a whole.

## How to choose

- Transmission distance. SFP modules are divided by range: up to 3 km (SC3km), up to 20 km (SC20km, LC20km), and more. HDMI cables of 30 and 60 meters solve tasks within a building without amplifiers, but for lengths over 15-20 meters you should make sure 4K frequency is supported.

- Connector type and compatibility. Optical systems use LC and SC connectors in UPC and APC versions. Make sure the patch cords and adapters match the ports of the switches, media converters, and active equipment. SC/APC and SC/UPC must not be confused, the connectors are physically compatible, but working them together produces high attenuation.

- Fiber type. Single-mode fiber (SM) is used at distances of 2 km and above, multimode (MM) for short lines within a building. The SFP module must match the type of the line cable.

- HDMI resolution and bandwidth. To output 4K content to video walls, operator monitors, or projectors, cables and splitters with HDMI 2.0 support and a bandwidth of at least 18 Gbit/s are needed. Clarify the specification with the manager.

- Number of splitter outputs. A 1x4 HDMI splitter distributes one source to four screens without loss of quality. For control rooms with a large number of monitors, cascading or a matrix switch may be required.

- Build quality and shielding. For industrial sites and outdoor cabinets, protected patch cords with an armored sheath, resistant to bending and vibration, are important. HDMI cables for permanent installation must have dense shielding.

- Compatibility with active equipment. SFP modules must be supported by the specific switch or media converter. Clarify the list of compatible modules in the vendor's documentation or with a SAT Solutions specialist before ordering.

## Applications

- IP video surveillance systems. Transmitting the stream from IP cameras to video recorders and storage servers over fiber-optic lines is a standard scenario for large territories: industrial zones, airports, university campuses.

- Conference halls and meeting rooms. HDMI cables and splitters ensure the output of presentations and video conferences to several screens or projectors from a single source without a decrease in resolution.

- Control rooms and monitoring centers. Video walls and multi-monitor operator workstations require reliable HDMI distribution and optical communication between the server room and the control post at a distance of tens of meters.

- Structured cabling networks of offices and business centers. Optical patch cords connect switches in telecommunications cabinets; SFP modules of different ranges provide flexibility when expanding the network.

- Hotels and retail sites. HDMI equipment is used for digital signage, information screens, broadcasting advertising content, and IPTV systems on guest floors.

- Educational institutions and assembly halls. Optical lines and the HDMI path make it possible to transmit lecture content and video recordings from a central server to several auditoriums at once.

## Brands and models in the catalog

- The current catalog offers equipment under the general label of miscellaneous equipment, these are made-to-order or small-batch products from compatible manufacturers that comply with IEEE and TIA/EIA standards.

- LC20km and SC20km SFP modules are designed for single-mode fiber-optic lines with a range of up to 20 kilometers. The SFP SC3km module is designed for distances up to 3 km and is often used inside buildings or on small territories.

- SC-SC, SC/APC-SC/APC, and LC-LC patch cords are produced in lengths of 1 and 10 meters for switching in server cabinets. SC-LC and LC-LC adapters make it possible to join equipment with different types of connectors.

- HDMI cables of 30 and 60 meters with 4K support cover the needs of most installations within a building without the use of amplifiers or optical HDMI extenders.

- The 4K 1x4 HDMI splitter provides signal distribution to four displays simultaneously while preserving the original resolution, which makes it an in-demand solution for showrooms, control rooms, and conference halls.

## FAQ

Q: What is the difference between an SC/UPC and an SC/APC patch cord?
A: The difference is in the geometry of the connector end face: APC (angled polish) provides a return loss of -60 dB and better, which is critical for PON systems and long lines. UPC is sufficient for most local networks and short runs. Physically, the connectors are not interchangeable, so the polish type must be matched with the type of ports on the equipment.

Q: Over what distance does an HDMI cable transmit 4K without signal degradation?
A: Passive HDMI cables work stably at distances up to 15-20 meters at 4K 60 Hz resolution. The 30 and 60 meter cables from the catalog have enhanced characteristics and are designed for these distances, however, when choosing, it is important to make sure HDMI 2.0 is supported at both ends of the path.

Q: Does an SFP module need to be matched with a specific switch?
A: Yes, most switch manufacturers publish a list of compatible SFP modules. Using an uncertified module may cause the port to be blocked or unstable operation. SAT Solutions managers will help select a compatible module for your active equipment.

Q: How are delivery and lead times for optical components organized in Tashkent?
A: Items in stock are delivered within Tashkent on the day of the order or the next business day. For made-to-order items, clarify the terms with the manager, this is usually 5-14 business days depending on the specification.

Q: Do you provide fiber-optic splicing and measurement services?
A: Yes, SAT Solutions performs fiber-optic splicing, measurements with an optical reflectometer (OTDR), and attenuation testing with the issuance of a report. This service is included in the scope of installation work or is provided separately upon request.

SAT Solutions katalogida Avigilon brendining silindrik va korpusli kameralari taqdim etilgan — professional darajadagi, O'zbekistondagi tasvir sifati va ishlash ishonchliligiga o'rtachadan yuqori talablar qo'yiladigan o'rta va yirik obyektlarga mo'ljallangan. H5A, H6A, H6X, Alta A5 va Unity liniyalari matritsa ruxsati, o'rnatilgan videoanalitika algoritmlari to'plami va videokuzatuvni boshqarish dasturiy ta'minoti bilan integratsiya imkoniyatlari bilan farqlanadi.

Aniq obyekt uchun silindrik kamera tanlashda bir qator parametrlarni hisobga olish zarur: sahna turi, kuzatuv obyektigacha bo'lgan masofa, yoritilganlik sharoitlari, saqlash va allaqachon mavjud tizim bilan integratsiya talablari. ## Qanday tanlash kerak

- Matritsa ruxsati. Ruxsat qanchalik yuqori bo'lsa (2 dan 8 MP va undan yuqori), tasvir shunchalik batafsil va bitta kamera bilan kattaroq uchastkani qoplash mumkin. Yuzlarni yoki davlat raqamlarini identifikatsiya qilish uchun to'g'ri tanlangan fokus masofasi bilan kamida 4-5 MP kerak.

- Fokus masofasi va qamrov zonasi. Qo'zg'almas obyektiv nishonagacha bo'lgan masofa ma'lum bo'lgan standart sahnalar uchun mos; varifokal yoki motorli obyektiv o'rnatishda moslashuvchanlik beradi va o'rnatishdan so'ng ko'rish burchagini sozlash imkonini beradi.

- Infraqizil yoritish. IK-yoritish masofasi tungi vaqtdagi real aniqlash masofasiga mos kelishi kerak. Ishlab chiqaruvchi e'lon qilgan qiymatlar odatda ideal sharoitlar uchun ko'rsatiladi — 20-30% zaxira qoldiring.

- Korpus himoyasi. Ko'chada o'rnatish uchun IP66 va undan yuqori himoya sinfi majburiy, agressiv muhitlarda (qirg'oq zonalari, sanoat obyektlari) — IK10 va korroziyadan himoya. Xonalar uchun IP54 yetarli.

- O'rnatilgan analitika. Zamonaviy Avigilon kameralari harakatni aniqlash, obyektlarni tanish, tasniflash (odam, transport vositasi), avtomatik kuzatishni qo'llab-quvvatlaydi. Bortda analitikaning mavjudligi serverga yukni kamaytiradi va tizim reaksiyasini tezlashtiradi.

- VMS bilan moslik. Kamerani tanlashdan oldin u sizning videokuzatuvni boshqarish tizimingiz tomonidan qo'llab-quvvatlanishiga ishonch hosil qiling. Avigilon Avigilon Control Center (ACC) platformasi bilan to'liq integratsiyalashadi, shuningdek boshqa VMS bilan ishlash uchun ONVIF protokolini qo'llab-quvvatlaydi.

- Quvvatlanish va tarmoq. Aksariyat IP-kameralar PoE standarti (802.3af/at) bo'yicha quvvatlanadi, bu kabel o'tkazishni soddalashtiradi. 100 m dan ortiq cho'zilgan yo'llar uchun PoE-uzatgichlar yoki alohida quvvat ishlatiladi.

## Qo'llanilish sohalari
