- Savdo markazlari va riteyl. Kameralar videofiksatsiya va noqonuniy harakatlarni jilovlash uchun kirish guruhlari ustiga, avtoturargohlarda va kassa operatsiyalari zonalarida o'rnatiladi.

- Ofis binolari va biznes-markazlar. Yo'laklar, zinapoyalar, resepshn zonalari va serverxonalarni yuqori tasvir ruxsati bilan monitoring qilish.

- Sanoat obyektlari va omborlar. Kuchaytirilgan himoyaga ega zarbaga chidamli korpusdagi kameralar sexlarda, ishlab chiqarish maydonchalarida va moddiy boyliklarni saqlash zonalarida ishlatiladi.

- O'quv muassasalari va davlat idoralari. Maktablar, universitetlar, ma'muriy binolar — ishonchlilik, tasvir sifati va kirishni nazorat qilish tizimi bilan integratsiya imkoniyati birgalikda talab qilinadigan obyektlar.

- Ochiq shahar hududlari. Bog'lar, ko'chalar, maydonlar — keng qamrov zonasi, harorat o'zgarishlariga chidamlilik va vandalizmga qarshi himoya muhim bo'lgan ssenariylar.

## Katalogdagi brendlar va modellar

- Avigilon ushbu toifada flagman brend hisoblanadi. Kompaniya Motorola Solutions guruhiga kiradi va sun'iy intellektga asoslangan rivojlangan analitikaga ega intellektual videokuzatuv tizimlariga ixtisoslashgan.

- H5A Bullet seriyasi — yuqori ruxsatli va o'rnatilgan Self-Learning Video Analytics algoritmlariga ega professional kameralar. O'rta va yirik ko'lamli obyektlar uchun mo'ljallangan.

- H6A Bullet va H6X Bullet seriyasi — yaxshilangan matritsa, kengaytirilgan dinamik diapazon va ikkinchi avlod analitikasini qo'llab-quvvatlaydigan keyingi avlod. H6X tasvirni batafsillashtirishning kengaytirilgan imkoniyatlari bilan farqlanadi.

- Avigilon Alta A5 Bullet — bulutli integratsiyaga, soddalashtirilgan ishga tushirishga va gibrid yechimlar uchun Avigilon Alta platformasini qo'llab-quvvatlashga ega zamonaviy liniya.

- Unity Bullet — Unity seriyali kameralar markazlashtirilgan boshqaruvga ega yirik taqsimlangan videokuzatuv tizimlariga unifikatsiya va integratsiya soddaligiga yo'naltirilgan.

## FAQ

Q: Silindrik kamera gumbazlidan nimasi bilan farq qiladi?
A: Silindrik (bullet) kamera yo'naltirilgan konstruksiyaga ega va o'q bo'ylab katta masofalarga kuzatish uchun yaxshiroq mos keladi. Gumbazli kamera yashirinroq va vandalizmga chidamliroq. Tanlov vazifa va o'rnatish joyiga bog'liq.

Q: Yuz yoki avtomobil raqamini identifikatsiya qilish uchun qanday kamera ruxsati yetarli?
A: Yuzlarni tanish uchun qiziqish zonasida 3-4 metrdan kengroq bo'lmagan qamrovni ta'minlaydigan to'g'ri tanlangan fokus masofasi bilan kamida 4 MP tavsiya etiladi. Davlat raqamlarini o'qish uchun nafaqat matritsa, balki obyektiv, o'rnatish burchagi va yoritish ham kritik.

Q: Avigilon kameralari boshqa videokuzatuv tizimlari bilan (faqat ACC bilan emas) ishlaydimi?
A: Ha, Avigilon kameralari ONVIF protokolini qo'llab-quvvatlaydi, bu ularni aksariyat zamonaviy VMS-platformalarga ulash imkonini beradi. Biroq analitikaning to'liq funksionali faqat o'z Avigilon Control Center platformasi bilan ishlatilganda mavjud.

Q: Avigilon kameralarini Toshkentda rasmiy kafolat bilan sotib olish mumkinmi?
A: SAT Solutions Avigilon uskunasini tegishli hujjatlar va kafolat majburiyatlari bilan rasmiy kanallar orqali yetkazib beradi. Bizning mutaxassislarimiz tomonidan o'rnatilganda kafolat o'rnatish ishlariga ham tarqaladi.

Q: Bitta silindrik kamerani o'rnatish qancha turadi?
A: O'rnatish narxi obyekt turiga, o'rnatish balandligiga, kabel yo'li uzunligiga va yondosh ishlar hajmiga bog'liq. Aniq hisob-kitob olish uchun mutaxassisning chiqishi yoki obyekt rejasini taqdim etish zarur — bepul konsultatsiya uchun biz bilan bog'laning.
avigilon-bullet.en:
Bullet and box video surveillance cameras are one of the most in-demand classes of equipment for perimeter protection, entrance control, monitoring of open areas, and long corridors. The characteristic elongated shape of the housing is not accidental: it allows a lens with an extended focal length to be accommodated and provides a high detection range even in poor lighting conditions. Buying bullet video surveillance cameras in Tashkent today is easy, the question is to select a model that really matches the site's task.

The SAT Solutions catalog offers bullet and box cameras of the Avigilon brand, professional-grade, aimed at medium and large sites in Uzbekistan where the requirements for image quality and operating reliability are above average. The model range covers both budget lines for typical tasks and advanced systems with onboard analytics. The H5A, H6A, H6X, Alta A5, and Unity lines differ in sensor resolution, the set of built-in video analytics algorithms, and integration capabilities with video management software.

When choosing a bullet camera for a specific site, it is necessary to take into account a whole range of parameters: the type of scene, the distance to the object of observation, the lighting conditions, and the requirements for storage and integration with the existing system. That is exactly why at SAT Solutions we recommend starting not with the choice of a model but with a technical survey of the site and the development of a project, this saves money and eliminates errors during installation.

## How to choose

- Sensor resolution. The higher the resolution (from 2 to 8 MP and above), the more detailed the image and the larger the area that can be covered by a single camera. For identifying faces or license plates, at least 4-5 MP with a correctly selected focal length is needed.

- Focal length and coverage zone. A fixed lens is suitable for standard scenes with a known distance to the target; a varifocal or motorized lens gives flexibility during installation and allows the viewing angle to be adjusted after mounting.

- Infrared illumination. The range of the IR illumination must correspond to the real detection distance at night. Manufacturer-stated values are usually given for ideal conditions, allow for a margin of 20-30%.

- Housing protection. For outdoor installation, an IP66 protection rating or higher is mandatory; in aggressive environments (coastal zones, industrial sites), IK10 and corrosion protection are needed. For indoor premises, IP54 is sufficient.

- Built-in analytics. Modern Avigilon cameras support motion detection, object recognition, classification (person, vehicle), and automatic tracking. Onboard analytics reduce the load on the server and speed up the system's response.

- Compatibility with VMS. Before choosing a camera, make sure it is supported by your video management system. Avigilon fully integrates with the Avigilon Control Center (ACC) platform, and also supports the ONVIF protocol for working with other VMS.

- Power and network. Most IP cameras are powered via the PoE standard (802.3af/at), which simplifies cable laying. For extended runs over 100 m, PoE extenders or a separate power supply are used.

## Applications

- Perimeter protection and entrance groups. Bullet cameras with a long-focus lens make it possible to monitor checkpoints, gates, and fences of industrial and warehouse enterprises at a distance of 30-100 meters and more.

- Shopping centers and retail. Cameras are installed above entrance groups, in parking lots, and in checkout operation zones for video recording and deterrence of unlawful actions.

- Office buildings and business centers. Monitoring of corridors, stairwells, reception zones, and server rooms with high image resolution.

- Industrial sites and warehouses. Cameras in impact-resistant housings with reinforced protection are used in workshops, at production sites, and in zones for storing material assets.

- Educational institutions and government agencies. Schools, universities, administrative buildings, sites where a combination of reliability, image quality, and the ability to integrate with an access control system is required.

- Open urban areas. Parks, streets, squares, scenarios where a wide coverage zone, resistance to temperature fluctuations, and vandal protection are important.

## Brands and models in the catalog

- Avigilon is the flagship brand in this category. The company is part of the Motorola Solutions group and specializes in intelligent video surveillance systems with advanced analytics based on artificial intelligence.

- The H5A Bullet series comprises professional cameras with high resolution and built-in Self-Learning Video Analytics algorithms. Designed for medium and large-scale sites.

- The H6A Bullet and H6X Bullet series are the next generation with an improved sensor, an expanded dynamic range, and support for second-generation analytics. The H6X is distinguished by expanded image-detailing capabilities.

- The Avigilon Alta A5 Bullet is a modern line with cloud integration, simplified commissioning, and support for the Avigilon Alta platform for hybrid solutions.

- The Unity Bullet, cameras of the Unity series are aimed at unification and ease of integration into large distributed video surveillance systems with centralized management.

## FAQ

Q: How does a bullet camera differ from a dome camera?
A: A bullet camera has a directional design and is better suited for observation over long distances along an axis. A dome camera is more discreet and more resistant to vandalism. The choice depends on the task and the installation location.

Q: What camera resolution is sufficient for identifying a face or a car's license plate?
A: For facial recognition, at least 4 MP is recommended with a correctly chosen focal length that ensures coverage no wider than 3-4 meters in the zone of interest. For reading license plates, not only the sensor is critical, but also the lens, the installation angle, and the lighting.

Q: Do Avigilon cameras work with other video surveillance systems (not only with ACC)?
A: Yes, Avigilon cameras support the ONVIF protocol, which allows them to be connected to most modern VMS platforms. The full analytics functionality, however, is available only when used with the native Avigilon Control Center platform.

Q: Can Avigilon cameras be bought in Tashkent with an official warranty?
A: SAT Solutions supplies Avigilon equipment through official channels with the corresponding documentation and warranty obligations. When installed by our specialists, the warranty also extends to the installation work.

Q: How much does the installation of one bullet camera cost?
A: The cost of installation depends on the type of site, the installation height, the length of the cable run, and the volume of related work. To obtain an exact calculation, a specialist visit or provision of the site layout is required, contact us for a free consultation.

nvr.uz:
Tarmoq videoregistratorlari (NVR) — har qanday zamonaviy IP-videokuzatuv tizimining markaziy bo'g'ini. Analog DVR-qurilmalardan farqli o'laroq, tarmoq videoregistratori allaqachon raqamlangan videooqimni bevosita IP-kameralardan lokal tarmoq yoki internet orqali qabul qiladi, qayta ishlaydi va saqlaydi. Bunday yondashuv tubdan yuqoriroq tasvir sifatini, tizimni masshtablashda moslashuvchanlikni va qo'shimcha uskunasiz masofaviy kirishni beradi. Agar siz Toshkentda yoki O'zbekistonning boshqa shahrida tarmoq videoregistratorini sotib olishni rejalashtirayotgan bo'lsangiz, tizim yillar davomida almashtirishsiz xizmat qilishi uchun qurilmaning kalit xususiyatlarini oldindan tushunib olish muhim.

SAT Solutions katalogi yetakchi jahon ishlab chiqaruvchisi Dahua'ning 29 model tarmoq videoregistratorini o'z ichiga oladi — kichik obyektlar uchun ixcham 4-kanalli qurilmalardan tortib sun'iy intellektni qo'llab-quvvatlaydigan professional 128-kanalli korporativ sinf yechimlarigacha bo'lgan liniyalar. Barcha qurilmalar O'zbekiston bozoriga rasmiy yetkazib beriladi, zarur hujjatlarga ega va real obyekt sharoitida sutkalik ekspluatatsiyaga moslashtirilgan.

NVR tanlash butun videokuzatuv tizimining konfiguratsiyasi bilan belgilanadi: kameralar soni va ruxsati, arxiv chuqurligiga talablar, analitika funksiyalarining mavjudligi va masofaviy kirish ssenariylari. Registratorni tanlash bosqichidagi xato tizim unumdorligida tor joylarga yoki ortiqcha xarajatlarga olib keladi, shuning uchun bu yerda savodli loyihalash kritik.

## Qanday tanlash kerak

- Kanallar soni: hozirgi IP-kameralar soni va kengaytirish zaxirasi bilan belgilanadi. Standart liniyalar 4, 8, 16, 32, 64 va 128 kanalni qamrab oladi. Bir yildan so'ng kameralar qo'shishda registratorni almashtirishdan ko'ra, kichik zaxira bilan qurilma olish yaxshiroq.
- Maksimal kiruvchi ruxsat va o'tkazuvchanlik qobiliyati: parametr Mbit/s (soniyasiga megabit) da ko'rsatiladi va registrator kadr yo'qotishlarisiz bir vaqtda qancha yuqori ruxsatli oqimni qayta ishlashga qodirligini belgilaydi. 4K-kameralar uchun o'tkazuvchanlik qobiliyatiga talablar 2 MP dan sezilarli darajada yuqori.
- Qattiq disklarni qo'llab-quvvatlash: HDD uyalari soni va bitta diskning maksimal hajmini baholang. Arxivni uzoq muddat saqlash uchun (uzluksiz yozuvda 30 kundan) har biri 8-20 TB hajmli qattiq disklar uchun 4 va undan ortiq uyali qurilmalar kerak.
- O'rnatilgan PoE-kommutator: o'rnatilgan PoE'ga ega modellar kameralarni tashqi kommutatorsiz to'g'ridan-to'g'ri registratorga ulash imkonini beradi, bu o'rnatishni soddalashtiradi va kichik tizimlar narxini kamaytiradi.
- Videoanalitika funksiyalari: Dahua'ning EI va XI seriyali zamonaviy NVR'lari yuzlarni aniqlash, perimetral analitika, avtomobil raqamlarini tanish va boshqa AI algoritmlarini serversiz bevosita bortda qo'llab-quvvatlaydi.
- Chiqarish interfeyslari va masofaviy kirish: lokal monitor uchun HDMI va VGA mavjudligi, arxivni ko'rish va istalgan qurilmadan onlayn-translyatsiya uchun mobil ilovalar va veb-interfeysni qo'llab-quvvatlash.
- Quvvat zaxiralash va ishonchlilik: kritik obyektlar uchun RAID-massivlarni qo'llab-quvvatlash yoki UPS ga ulanish, shuningdek qurilmaning e'lon qilingan nosozliksiz ishlash muddati muhim.

## Qo'llanilish sohalari

- Savdo va ofis obyektlari: do'konlar, savdo markazlari, biznes-markazlar, bu yerda perimetr, kassalar, ombor zonalari va kirish guruhlarini uzoq muddatli arxiv saqlash bilan nazorat qilish talab qilinadi.
- Ishlab chiqarish korxonalari va omborlar: texnologik jarayonlarni videofiksatsiya qilish, KPP da kirishni nazorat qilish, yuqori kanallar soni bilan yuklash-tushirish zonalarini monitoring qilish.
- Turar-joy majmualari va mehmonxonalar: ko'p qavatli uylar, apart-majmualar va mehmonxonalarda videoni markazlashtirilgan saqlash va qo'riqlash uchun kirish huquqlarini ajratish bilan videokuzatuv tizimlari.
- Ta'lim va sog'liqni saqlash obyektlari: maktablar, universitetlar, kasalxonalar va klinikalar, bu yerda ishonchli arxivlash va hodisalar bo'yicha tezkor qidiruv imkoniyati talab qilinadi.
- Banklar, moliya muassasalari va davlat obyektlari: tasvir sifatiga, saqlash ishonchliligiga va kirishni nazorat qilish hamda signalizatsiya tizimlari bilan integratsiyaga yuqori talablar.
- Transport infratuzilmasi: avtoturargohlar, YMK, transport tugunlari va yo'llar, bu yerda davlat raqamlari analitikasi va 24/7 rejimida ko'p kanalli yozuv qo'llaniladi.

## Katalogdagi brendlar va modellar

- Dahua — videokuzatuv tizimlarini ishlab chiqarishda jahon yetakchisi, katalogda eng keng taqdim etilgan. Kompaniya har qanday ko'lam uchun NVR chiqaradi: kichik o'rnatishlar uchun byudjetli NVR1 va NVR2 seriyalaridan tortib sun'iy intellekt va yuqori kanallar soni bilan professional NVR4, NVR5 va NVR616 seriyalarigacha.
- Dahua NVR2 seriyasi (masalan, DHI-NVR2104-4KS3, DHI-NVR2108-S3, DHI-NVR2116-S3) — 4K ruxsatini qo'llab-quvvatlash va bazaviy harakat analitikasi bilan o'rta o'lchamli obyektlar uchun arzon narxdagi optimal yechimlar.
- Dahua NVR4 seriyasi (DHI-NVR4104-4KS2/L, DHI-NVR4108-4KS2/L, DHI-NVR4232-EI, DHI-NVR4432-EI) — EI intellektual algoritmlarini qo'llab-quvvatlaydigan yuqori unumdorlikdagi registratorlar: yuzlarni aniqlash, perimetral analitika, hodisalar bo'yicha aniq qidiruv.
- Dahua NVR5 va NVR616 seriyasi (DHI-NVR5464-EI2, DHI-NVR616H-128-XI) — 128 kanalgacha qo'llab-quvvatlash, neyrotarmoqlarga asoslangan chuqur videoanalitika va katta hajmli nosozliklarga chidamli arxivlar qurish imkoniyati bilan korporativ sinf professional qurilmalar.

## FAQ

Q: Tarmoq videoregistratori (NVR) analogli (DVR) dan nimasi bilan farq qiladi?
A: NVR IP-kameralar bilan ishlaydi va allaqachon siqilgan raqamli videooqimni lokal tarmoq orqali oladi, DVR esa koaksial kabeldan analog signalni raqamlaydi. NVR sezilarli darajada yuqoriroq ruxsatni, kameralarni joylashtirishda moslashuvchanlikni va yangi kabellarni o'tkazmasdan tizimni masshtablash qulayligini ta'minlaydi.

Q: 30 kunlik arxivni saqlash uchun qancha qattiq disk kerak?
A: Hajm kameralar soniga, ularning ruxsatiga, kadr chastotasiga va yozuv rejimiga (uzluksiz yoki harakat bo'yicha) bog'liq. Taxminan: 4 Mbit/s bitreyt bilan 24/7 uzluksiz yozuvda bitta 4 MP kamera oyiga taxminan 1,3 TB talab qiladi. SAT Solutions mutaxassislari sizning konfiguratsiyangiz uchun aniq saqlash hajmini hisoblab beradi.

Q: Arxivni smartfon yoki planshetdan ko'rish mumkinmi?
A: Ha, barcha Dahua registratorlari DMSS mobil ilovasini (iOS va Android uchun) qo'llab-quvvatlaydi, bu jonli efir va arxivni ko'rish, hodisalar haqida push-bildirishnomalar olish va internet ulanishi mavjud bo'lganda istalgan mobil qurilmadan tizim sozlamalarini boshqarish imkonini beradi.

Q: Tarmoq videoregistratorlariga qanday kafolat beriladi?
A: SAT Solutions orqali rasmiy yetkazib beriladigan Dahua uskunasiga ishlab chiqaruvchining kafolati tarqaladi. Kafolat muddati qurilma seriyasiga qarab sotib olishda aniqlashtiriladi. Kafolatli xizmat ko'rsatish uskunani chet elga jo'natish zaruratisiz O'zbekiston hududida bajariladi.

Q: Dahua registratorlari boshqa ishlab chiqaruvchilarning kameralari bilan mos keladimi?
A: Dahua registratorlari ONVIF protokolini qo'llab-quvvatlaydi, bu uchinchi tomon ishlab chiqaruvchilarining aksariyat IP-kameralari bilan bazaviy moslikni ta'minlaydi. Biroq intellektual analitikaning to'liq funksionali (EI, XI seriyalari) faqat yagona ekotizimga integratsiyalangan Dahua kameralaridan foydalanilganda mavjud.
nvr.en:
Network video recorders (NVRs) are the central link of any modern IP video surveillance system. Unlike analog DVR devices, a network video recorder receives, processes, and stores an already digitized video stream directly from IP cameras over a local network or the internet. This approach provides fundamentally higher image quality, flexibility in scaling the system, and remote access without additional equipment. If you plan to buy a network video recorder in Tashkent or another city of Uzbekistan, it is important to understand the key characteristics of the device in advance, so that the system serves for years without replacement.

The SAT Solutions catalog includes 29 network video recorder models from the leading global manufacturer Dahua, lines from compact 4-channel devices for small sites to professional 128-channel enterprise-class solutions with support for artificial intelligence. All devices are officially supplied to the Uzbekistan market, have the necessary documentation, and are adapted for around-the-clock operation in real-site conditions.

The choice of NVR is determined by the configuration of the entire video surveillance system: the number and resolution of cameras, the requirements for archive depth, the presence of analytics functions, and remote access scenarios. An error at the recorder selection stage leads to bottlenecks in system performance or excessive costs, so competent design is critical here.

## How to choose

- Number of channels: determined by the number of IP cameras now and with a margin for expansion. Standard lines cover 4, 8, 16, 32, 64, and 128 channels. It is better to take a device with a small reserve than to change the recorder when adding cameras a year later.
- Maximum incoming resolution and bandwidth: the parameter is specified in Mbit/s (megabits per second) and determines how many high-resolution streams the recorder is able to process simultaneously without frame loss. For 4K cameras, the bandwidth requirements are significantly higher than for 2 MP.
- Hard drive support: assess the number of HDD bays and the maximum capacity of a single disk. For long-term archive storage (from 30 days of continuous recording), devices with 4 or more bays for hard drives of 8-20 TB each are needed.
- Built-in PoE switch: models with a built-in PoE allow cameras to be connected directly to the recorder without an external switch, which simplifies installation and reduces the cost of small systems.
- Video analytics functions: modern NVRs of the EI and XI series from Dahua support face detection, perimeter analytics, license plate recognition, and other AI algorithms directly onboard without a server.
- Output interfaces and remote access: presence of HDMI and VGA for a local monitor, support for mobile apps and a web interface for viewing the archive and live streaming from any device.
- Power redundancy and reliability: for critical sites, support for RAID arrays or connection to a UPS is important, as well as the device's stated mean time to failure.

## Applications

- Retail and office sites: shops, shopping centers, business centers where control of the perimeter, checkouts, warehouse zones, and entrance groups with long-term archive storage is required.
- Manufacturing enterprises and warehouses: video recording of technological processes, access control at checkpoints, monitoring of loading and unloading zones with a high number of channels.
- Residential complexes and hotels: video surveillance systems in apartment buildings, apartment complexes, and hotels with centralized video storage and delimitation of access rights for security.
- Education and healthcare facilities: schools, universities, hospitals, and clinics where reliable archiving and the ability to quickly search by events are required.
- Banks, financial institutions, and government facilities: high requirements for image quality, storage reliability, and integration with access control and alarm systems.
- Transport infrastructure: parking lots, gas stations, transport hubs, and roads where license plate analytics and multi-channel 24/7 recording are used.

## Brands and models in the catalog

- Dahua is a global leader in the production of video surveillance systems, represented most widely in the catalog. The company produces NVRs for any scale: from budget NVR1 and NVR2 series for small installations to professional NVR4, NVR5, and NVR616 series with support for artificial intelligence and a high number of channels.
- The Dahua NVR2 series (for example, DHI-NVR2104-4KS3, DHI-NVR2108-S3, DHI-NVR2116-S3) are optimal solutions for medium-sized sites with support for 4K resolution and basic motion analytics at an affordable price.
- The Dahua NVR4 series (DHI-NVR4104-4KS2/L, DHI-NVR4108-4KS2/L, DHI-NVR4232-EI, DHI-NVR4432-EI) are recorders of increased performance with support for intelligent EI algorithms: face detection, perimeter analytics, precise search by events.
- The Dahua NVR5 and NVR616 series (DHI-NVR5464-EI2, DHI-NVR616H-128-XI) are professional enterprise-class devices with support for up to 128 channels, deep neural-network-based video analytics, and the ability to build fault-tolerant archives of large volume.

## FAQ

Q: How does a network video recorder (NVR) differ from an analog one (DVR)?
A: An NVR works with IP cameras and receives an already compressed digital video stream over the local network, whereas a DVR digitizes an analog signal from a coaxial cable. An NVR provides significantly higher resolution, flexibility in camera placement, and ease of scaling the system without laying new cables.

Q: How many hard drives are needed to store a 30-day archive?
A: The capacity depends on the number of cameras, their resolution, the frame rate, and the recording mode (continuous or motion-based). Approximately: one 4 MP camera with continuous 24/7 recording at a bitrate of 4 Mbit/s will require about 1.3 TB per month. SAT Solutions specialists will calculate the exact storage capacity for your configuration.

Q: Can the archive be viewed from a smartphone or tablet?
A: Yes, all Dahua recorders support the DMSS mobile app (for iOS and Android), which allows you to watch the live stream and the archive, receive push notifications about events, and manage system settings from any mobile device with an internet connection.

Q: What warranty is provided for network video recorders?
A: Dahua equipment officially supplied through SAT Solutions is covered by the manufacturer's warranty. The warranty period is clarified at the time of purchase depending on the device series. Warranty service is performed within the territory of Uzbekistan without the need to send equipment abroad.

Q: Are Dahua recorders compatible with cameras from other manufacturers?
A: Dahua recorders support the ONVIF protocol, which ensures basic compatibility with most third-party IP cameras. However, the full functionality of intelligent analytics (EI, XI series) is available only when using Dahua cameras integrated into a single ecosystem.

ubiquiti-wifi.uz:
Wi-Fi kirish nuqtalari — bu qurilmalarni har bir ish joyi yoki zonaga kabel tortmasdan tarmoqqa barqaror va tez ulanishini ta'minlaydigan professional simsiz uskuna. Maishiy routerlardan farqli o'laroq, professional kirish nuqtalari yuqori ulanish zichligiga, uzluksiz kunu-tun ishlashga va markazlashtirilgan boshqaruvga mo'ljallangan. Bunday uskuna ofislarda, savdo markazlarida, mehmonxonalarda, ishlab chiqarish korxonalarida va o'quv muassasalarida — ishonchli korporativ Wi-Fi talab qilinadigan hamma joyda qo'llaniladi.

Toshkentdagi va butun O'zbekiston bo'ylab joylashgan obyektlar uchun to'g'ri kirish nuqtasini tanlash muhim: issiq iqlim, changlilik va ayrim obyektlarning uzoqligi uskunaning ishonchliligi va himoyasiga yuqori talablar qo'yadi. Bundan tashqari, katalogda «nuqta — nuqta» va «nuqta — ko'p nuqta» turdagi simsiz kanallarni tashkil etish uchun Wi-Fi ko'priklari taqdim etilgan, bu binolarni ulashda yoki optik tolani tortmasdan ma'lumotlarni katta masofalarga uzatishda dolzarbdir. O'zbekistonda korporativ ehtiyojlar uchun kafolat va servis bilan Wi-Fi kirish nuqtalarini sotib olish — SAT Solutions har kuni ishlaydigan vazifa.

Aniq qurilmani tanlash qamrov maydoniga, bir vaqtning o'zida foydalanuvchilar soniga, ekspluatatsiya sharoitlariga va boshqaruvchanlik talablariga bog'liq. Ofis uchun ichki kirish nuqtalari va tashqi zonalar uchun ko'cha modellari konstruksiyasi, ishchi haroratlar diapazoni va korpus himoya darajasi bo'yicha sezilarli farq qiladi. Yirik obyektlar uchun «o'lik zonalar» va nuqtalar orasidagi interferensiyani istisno qilish maqsadida radio qamrovni oldindan loyihalash muhim.

## Qanday tanlash kerak

- O'rnatish turi (ichki yoki ko'cha): xonalar uchun shift va devor kirish nuqtalari mos keladi, ko'cha va texnik zonalar uchun keng ishchi haroratlar diapazoniga mo'ljallangan, changdan, namlikdan va ultrabinafsha nurdan himoyalangan modellar kerak.
- Wi-Fi standarti: zamonaviy nuqtalar Wi-Fi 6 (802.11ax) yoki Wi-Fi 7 ni qo'llab-quvvatlaydi, ular Wi-Fi 5 (802.11ac) bilan solishtirganda ancha yuqori o'tkazuvchanlik va ko'p sonli mijozlar bilan samarali ishlashni ta'minlaydi.
- Bir vaqtning o'zida mijozlar soni: zich muhit — konferens-zallar, auditoriyalar, savdo maydonlari uchun — OFDMA va MU-MIMO texnologiyalariga ega, o'nlab va yuzlab qurilmalarni tezlik pasayishisiz xizmat qila oladigan nuqtalar kerak.
- Qamrov radiusi va masofasi: katta open-space yoki ko'cha uchun antennalar kuchaytirish koeffitsienti yuqori bo'lgan modellar mos keladi; to'siqli xonalar uchun uzatgich quvvati va qabul qiluvchi sezgirligi muhim.
- Quvvat ta'minoti: aksariyat korporativ nuqtalar Ethernet kabeli orqali quvvat oladi (PoE/PoE+), bu montajni soddalashtiradi va kommutator orqali quvvatni markazlashtirilgan boshqarishga imkon beradi.
- Markazlashtirilgan boshqaruv: yirik tarmoqlarda kirish nuqtalari yagona kontroller — apparat yoki bulutli — ostida birlashtiriladi. Bu xavfsizlik siyosatlarini sozlashni, yuklamani monitoring qilishni va barcha qurilmalarda dasturiy ta'minotni bir vaqtda yangilashni soddalashtiradi.
- PtP/PtMP uchun Wi-Fi ko'priklari: agar vazifa ikki binoni ulash yoki simsiz backhaul tashkil etish bo'lsa, tor yo'nalish diagrammasiga va minimal xalaqitlar uchun 5 GGs chastotasini qo'llab-quvvatlaydigan yo'naltirilgan ko'priklar tanlanadi.

## Qo'llanilish sohalari

- Ofislar va biznes-markazlar: ish joylari, muzokara xonalari, resepshn zonalarini qamrab olish; kirish huquqlarini chegaralash bilan mehmon va korporativ SSID ni ta'minlash.
- Mehmonxonalar va mehmondo'stlik obyektlari: nomerlarda, lobbi, restoranlar va konferens-zallarda ishonchli Wi-Fi; mehmonlar bir vaqtda ulanganda yuqori mijoz zichligi.
- Omborlar, ishlab chiqarishlar va logistika majmualari: metall konstruksiyalarga ega katta maydonlarni qamrab olish; Wi-Fi terminallarni, shtrix-kod skanerlarini va ombor boshqaruv tizimlarini qo'llab-quvvatlash.
- O'quv muassasalari va idoralar: auditoriyalar va umumiy zonalarni keng qamrab olish; markazlashtirilgan kontent filtratsiyasi va siyosatlarni boshqarish.
- Sanoat va ko'cha obyektlari: korxona binolari orasida simsiz kanallarni tashkil etish, Wi-Fi orqali videokuzatuv, perimetr va avtoturargohlarni qamrab olish.
- Savdo markazlari va chakana tarmoqlar: qatnov tahlili, marketing portallari va mehmon kirishi imkoniyati bilan yagona boshqariladigan Wi-Fi tarmoq.

## Katalogdagi brendlar va modellar

- Ubiquiti UniFi — ichki o'rnatish uchun professional kirish nuqtalari liniyasi. U6 va U7 seriyali modellar mos ravishda Wi-Fi 6 va Wi-Fi 7 ni qo'llab-quvvatlaydi, ko'p sonli mijozli korporativ tarmoqlar uchun mo'ljallangan. U6 LR, U6 PRO, U7 PRO, U7 LR variantlari qamrov masofasi va o'tkazuvchanligi bilan farq qiladi.
- Ubiquiti UAP AC PRO — MU-MIMO va ikki diapazonni qo'llab-quvvatlaydigan, ofis va mehmonxona loyihalarida o'zini yaxshi ko'rsatgan, vaqt sinovidan o'tgan Wi-Fi 5 standartidagi kirish nuqtasi.
- Ubiquiti NanoStation va LiteBeam — bir necha yuz metrdan bir necha kilometrgacha bo'lgan masofalarga simsiz kanallarni tashkil etish uchun ko'cha yo'naltirilgan kirish nuqtalari va Wi-Fi ko'priklari. LITEBEAM 5AC GEN2 va POWERBEAM 5AC GEN2 5 GGs diapazonida PtP va PtMP kanallarini qurish uchun ishlatiladi.
- Ubiquiti UniFi Cloud Key Gen2 Plus — butun UniFi tarmog'ini markazlashtirilgan boshqarish uchun apparat kontroller. Kirish nuqtalari, kommutatorlar va shlyuzlarni boshqarishni yagona veb-interfeys va bulutli kirish bilan birlashtiradi.

## FAQ

Q: Professional kirish nuqtasi oddiy uy routeridan nimasi bilan farq qiladi?
A: Professional kirish nuqtalari bir vaqtning o'zida o'nlab va yuzlab mijozlarga xizmat ko'rsatishga mo'ljallangan, 24/7 rejimda ishlaydi va markazlashtirilgan boshqariladi. Uy routerlari yuqori ulanish zichligini uddalay olmaydi va korporativ xavfsizlik funksiyalarini — tarmoqlarni ajratish, 802.1X autentifikatsiya va trafikni batafsil monitoring qilishni qo'llab-quvvatlamaydi.

Q: Mening obyektim uchun nechta kirish nuqtasi kerak?
A: Soni maydonga, planirovkaga, devor materiallariga va foydalanuvchilar soniga bog'liq. Aniq hisoblash uchun radio tekshiruvi yoki qamrovning issiqlik xaritasini o'tkazish kerak — SAT Solutions mutaxassislari buni montaj boshlanishidan oldin bajaradi.

Q: Faqat uskunani montajsiz sotib olish mumkinmi?
A: Ha, biz uskunani alohida yetkazib beramiz. Biroq korporativ obyektlar uchun montaj va sozlashni sertifikatlangan mutaxassislarga buyurtma qilishni tavsiya qilamiz: noto'g'ri konfiguratsiya tarmoq unumdorligini pasaytiradi va xavfsizlik xatarlarini yaratadi.

Q: Ubiquiti uskunasiga kafolat qanday?
A: Kafolat muddati aniq modelga bog'liq va ishlab chiqaruvchi tomonidan belgilanadi. SAT Solutions uskunani rasmiy kafolat bilan yetkazib beradi va zavod nuqsoni bo'lgan taqdirda kafolatli almashtirishni ta'minlaydi.

Q: Ubiquiti Wi-Fi ko'priklari O'zbekiston sharoitida katta masofalarda ishlaydimi?
A: PowerBeam va LiteBeam seriyali yo'naltirilgan ko'priklar 5 GGs diapazonida to'g'ridan-to'g'ri ko'rinishda bir necha kilometr masofada barqaror kanalni ta'minlashga qodir. E'lon qilingan xususiyatlarga erishish uchun antennalarni to'g'ri yo'naltirish va Frenel zonasida to'siqlar yo'qligi muhim — bu parametrlar loyihalashda hisobga olinadi.
ubiquiti-wifi.en:
Wi-Fi access points are professional wireless equipment that provides a stable, fast connection for devices to the network without running a cable to each workstation or zone. Unlike consumer routers, professional access points are designed for high connection density, continuous around-the-clock operation and centralized management. Such equipment is used in offices, shopping centers, hotels, manufacturing plants and educational institutions — wherever reliable corporate Wi-Fi is required.

For sites in Tashkent and across Uzbekistan, choosing the right access point is critical: the hot climate, dust and the remoteness of individual sites place heightened demands on the reliability and protection of equipment. In addition, the catalog features Wi-Fi bridges for building point-to-point and point-to-multipoint wireless links, which is relevant when connecting buildings or transmitting data over significant distances without laying fiber-optic cable. Buying Wi-Fi access points for corporate needs in Uzbekistan with warranty and service is a task SAT Solutions handles every day.

The choice of a specific device depends on the coverage area, the number of simultaneous users, the operating conditions and manageability requirements. Indoor access points for the office and outdoor models for external zones differ noticeably in design, operating temperature range and enclosure protection rating. For large sites it is important to plan radio coverage in advance to eliminate dead zones and interference between access points.

## How to choose

- Installation type (indoor or outdoor): ceiling- and wall-mounted access points are suitable for indoor spaces, while for the outdoors and technical zones you need models protected against dust, moisture and ultraviolet and rated for a wide operating temperature range.
- Wi-Fi standard: modern access points support Wi-Fi 6 (802.11ax) or Wi-Fi 7, which provide significantly higher throughput and efficient operation with a large number of clients compared to Wi-Fi 5 (802.11ac).
- Number of simultaneous clients: for dense environments — conference halls, lecture rooms, retail floors — you need access points with OFDMA and MU-MIMO technologies, capable of serving dozens and hundreds of devices without speed degradation.
- Coverage radius and range: models with high antenna gain are suitable for large open-space areas or the outdoors; for spaces with partitions, transmitter power and receiver sensitivity are important.
- Power: most corporate access points are powered over the Ethernet cable (PoE/PoE+), which simplifies installation and allows power to be managed centrally through the switch.
- Centralized management: in large networks, access points are combined under a single controller — hardware or cloud-based. This simplifies configuring security policies, monitoring load and updating firmware on all devices at once.
- Wi-Fi bridges for PtP/PtMP: if the task is to connect two buildings or organize a wireless backhaul, choose directional bridges with a narrow antenna radiation pattern and support for the 5 GHz band for minimal interference.

## Applications

- Offices and business centers: coverage of workspaces, meeting rooms and reception areas; providing guest and corporate SSIDs with differentiated access rights.
- Hotels and hospitality facilities: reliable Wi-Fi in rooms, lobbies, restaurants and conference halls; high client density with guests connecting simultaneously.
- Warehouses, manufacturing and logistics complexes: coverage of large areas with metal structures; support for Wi-Fi terminals, barcode scanners and warehouse management systems.
- Educational institutions and public establishments: broad coverage of lecture halls and common areas; centralized content filtering and policy management.
- Industrial and outdoor sites: building wireless links between plant buildings, video surveillance over Wi-Fi, coverage of perimeters and parking lots.
- Shopping centers and retail chains: a single managed Wi-Fi network with the ability to analyze foot traffic, run marketing portals and provide guest access.

## Brands and models in the catalog

- Ubiquiti UniFi — a line of professional access points for indoor installation. The U6 and U7 series models support Wi-Fi 6 and Wi-Fi 7 respectively and are designed for corporate networks with a large number of clients. The U6 LR, U6 PRO, U7 PRO and U7 LR variants differ in coverage range and throughput.
- Ubiquiti UAP AC PRO — a time-proven Wi-Fi 5 access point with MU-MIMO support and two bands, well established in office and hotel projects.
- Ubiquiti NanoStation and LiteBeam — outdoor directional access points and Wi-Fi bridges for building wireless links over distances from several hundred meters to several kilometers. LITEBEAM 5AC GEN2 and POWERBEAM 5AC GEN2 are used to build PtP and PtMP links in the 5 GHz band.
- Ubiquiti UniFi Cloud Key Gen2 Plus — a hardware controller for centralized management of the entire UniFi network. It combines management of access points, switches and gateways with a single web interface and cloud access.

## FAQ

Q: How does a professional access point differ from an ordinary home router?
A: Professional access points are designed to serve dozens and hundreds of clients simultaneously, operate 24/7 and are managed centrally. Home routers cannot cope with high connection density and do not support corporate security features — network segmentation, 802.1X authentication and detailed traffic monitoring.

Q: How many access points do I need for my site?
A: The number depends on the area, layout, wall materials and the number of users. For an accurate calculation, a radio survey or coverage heat map is required — SAT Solutions specialists perform this before installation begins.

Q: Can I buy only the equipment without installation?
A: Yes, we supply equipment separately. However, for corporate sites we recommend ordering installation and configuration from certified specialists: incorrect configuration reduces network performance and creates security risks.

Q: What is the warranty on Ubiquiti equipment?
A: The warranty period depends on the specific model and is set by the manufacturer. SAT Solutions supplies equipment with an official warranty and provides warranty replacement in case of a manufacturing defect.

Q: Do Ubiquiti Wi-Fi bridges work over long distances under Uzbekistan conditions?
A: Directional bridges of the PowerBeam and LiteBeam series in the 5 GHz band can provide a stable link over a distance of several kilometers with line of sight. To achieve the stated characteristics, correct antenna alignment and the absence of obstacles in the Fresnel zone are important — these parameters are taken into account during design.

hik-ip-cameras.uz:
IP-kameralar — har qanday zamonaviy videokuzatuv tizimining asosi. Analog yechimlardan farqli o'laroq, tarmoq kameralari tasvirni standart IP-infratuzilma orqali raqamli formatda uzatadi, bu yuqori aniqlik, moslashuvchan masshtablanuvchanlik va istalgan qurilmadan masofaviy kirish imkonini beradi. Toshkentda IP-kameralarni bugun har qanday miqyosdagi obyektlar uchun — kichik ofisdan tortib butun O'zbekiston bo'ylab tarmoqlangan filiallar tarmog'igacha — sotib olish mumkin.

SAT Solutions katalogida turli konstruktiv ijrolarda 149 dan ortiq IP-kamera modeli taqdim etilgan: gumbazli, silindrik va kub shaklidagi. Har bir shakl-faktor o'z vazifalarini hal qiladi: gumbazli kameralarni payqash qiyinroq va vandal uchun burish qiyinroq, silindriklari koridorlar va perimetr uchun yaxshi mos keladi, kublilari ichki o'rnatish va yuzni tanish tizimlariga integratsiya uchun qulay. Korpus turini to'g'ri tanlash — samarali videokuzatuv tizimiga birinchi qadam.

IP-kamerani tanlash bir nechta asosiy parametrlar bilan belgilanadi: matritsa aniqligi, obyektiv turi va xususiyatlari, infraqizil yoritishning mavjudligi va masofasi, korpus himoya darajasi, analitikani qo'llab-quvvatlash va quvvat ta'minoti usuli. Uskunani tanlash bosqichidagi xato yoki ortiqcha xarajatlarga, yoki yozuv sifatining yetarli emasligiga olib keladi. SAT Solutions mutaxassislari aniq obyekt va byudjetga optimal konfiguratsiyani tanlashda yordam beradi.

## Qanday tanlash kerak

- Matritsa aniqligi. Yuzlarni identifikatsiya qilish yoki avtomobil raqamlarini o'qish uchun kamida 4 MP kerak; xonalarni umumiy ko'rish uchun 2 MP yetarli. Yuqoriroq aniqlik saqlash uchun ko'proq joy va tarmoq o'tkazuvchanligini talab qiladi.
- Obyektiv va ko'rish burchagi. 2,8 mm fiksatsiyalangan obyektiv keng qamrovni beradi — kichik xonalar uchun mos. Variofokal obyektiv (masalan, 2,8–12 mm) montajdan keyin burchakni sozlash imkonini beradi — ko'cha va uzun koridorlar uchun qulay.
- Infraqizil yoritish. IQ-yoritish masofasiga e'tibor bering: avtoturargohlar va perimetr uchun 40–50 m dan kerak, ofis koridori uchun 15–20 m yetarli. Bir qism modellar rangli yoritish bilan jihozlangan (ColorVu, ColorHunter) — ular kechasi ham rangli tasvir beradi.
- Korpus himoya darajasi. Tashqi o'rnatish uchun minimal IP66 klassi kerak (chang va namlikdan himoya). Antivandal ijro IK10 jamoat joylari va kirish guruhlari uchun dolzarb.
- Quvvat ta'minoti. PoE (Power over Ethernet) montajni soddalashtiradi — bitta kabel ham ma'lumotni, ham quvvatni olib boradi. Standartni aniqlang: PoE (802.3af, 15,4 Vtgacha) yoki PoE+ (802.3at, 30 Vtgacha) — bunga kommutator bilan moslik bog'liq.
- O'rnatilgan analitika. Zamonaviy kameralar harakatni aniqlash, chiziqni kesib o'tish, tashrif buyuruvchilarni sanash, yuzlar va raqamlarni tanishni qo'llab-quvvatlaydi. Bortdagi analitika mavjudligi serverga yuklamani kamaytiradi.
- Videoregistrator bilan moslik. Kamera sizning NVR bilan ONVIF protokoli bo'yicha yoki ishlab chiqaruvchining yagona ekotizimi doirasida ishlashiga ishonch hosil qiling — bu barcha funksiyalarni to'g'ri uzatishni kafolatlaydi.

## Qo'llanilish sohalari

- Ofislar va biznes-markazlar. Kirish guruhlari, muzokara xonalari, serverlar va umumiy zonalarni nazorat qilish; kirishni boshqarish tizimi bilan integratsiya.
- Savdo obyektlari. Savdo zali, kassa zonasi va omborni kuzatish; xaridorlar trafigi tahlili va tashrif buyuruvchilarni sanash.
- Ishlab chiqarish korxonalari va omborlar. Texnologik liniyalar, perimetr, yuklash-tushirish zonalarini monitoring qilish; texnika xavfsizligiga rioya qilishni nazorat qilish.
- Turar-joy majmualari va xususiy obyektlar. Videodomofon, perimetr qo'riqlashi, parking; mobil telefondan masofaviy ko'rish.
- Davlat va ta'lim muassasalari. Kirishlar, rekreatsiyalar, atrofdagi hududni nazorat qilish; shaharning markazlashtirilgan xavfsizlik tizimlari bilan integratsiya.
- Transport infratuzilmasi obyektlari. Kirishlar, to'xtash joylari, perronlarni kuzatish; avtomobillarning davlat raqamlarini tanish.

## Katalogdagi brendlar va modellar

- Hikvision — SAT Solutions katalogida keng taqdim etilgan videokuzatuv bozorining jahon lideri. Liniya DS-2CD seriyali gumbazli modellarni (masalan, DS-2CD2543G2-IS, DS-2CD1143G2-LIU), DS-2CD2T va DS-2CD1 seriyali silindrik modellarni, shuningdek DS-2CD2443G2 va DS-2CD2463G2 seriyali kub kameralarni o'z ichiga oladi. Modellar AcuSense, ColorVu va Deep Learning texnologiyalarini qo'llab-quvvatlash bilan 2 dan 8 MP gacha aniqliklar diapazonini qamrab oladi.
- AcuSense seriyasi (Hikvision) noto'g'ri signallarni intellektual filtratsiya qilishi bilan ajralib turadi: kamera odamlar va transport vositalarini ajratadi, hayvonlarga, barglar yoki ob-havo xalaqitlariga reaksiya bermaydi. Bu qo'riqlash operatorlariga yuklamani sezilarli darajada kamaytiradi.
- Ikki svetodiodli yoritishli modellar (artikullarda LI, LIUF suffiksi) bir vaqtning o'zida infraqizil va oq yoritishni ta'minlaydi, vazifaga qarab oq-qora va to'liq rangli tungi rejimlar orasida almashishga imkon beradi.
- Variofokal modellar (artikulda Z suffiksi yoki diapazon, masalan 2,8–12 mm) montajdan keyin ko'rish maydonini aniq sozlash imkonini beradi — ayniqsa nostandart geometriyali yoki katta oraliqli obyektlarda qadrli.

## FAQ

Q: Ofis uchun qanday aniqlikdagi IP-kamerani tanlash kerak?
A: Umumiy kuzatuv va kirishni nazorat qilish uchun 4 MP yetarli. Agar yuzlarni aniq identifikatsiya qilish yoki mayda tafsilotlarni (hujjatlar, pul banknotalari) o'qish talab qilinsa, 6 dan 8 MP gacha bo'lgan modellarni ko'rib chiqish kerak.

Q: Hikvision IP-kameralarini boshqa brendning allaqachon mavjud registratoriga ulash mumkinmi?
A: Aksariyat zamonaviy IP-kameralar ONVIF protokolini qo'llab-quvvatlaydi, bu turli ishlab chiqaruvchilarning registratorlari bilan asosiy moslikni ta'minlaydi. Biroq kengaytirilgan funksional (intellektual analitika, ikki tomonlama audioaloqa, maxsus yozuv rejimlari) faqat bitta ekotizim doirasida to'g'ri ishlaydi. Sotib olishdan oldin SAT Solutions mutaxassislaridan moslikni aniqlang.

Q: IP-kameralar internetsiz ishlaydimi?
A: Ha. NVR ga lokal yozuv uchun internet kerak emas — lokal tarmoq yetarli. Internet ulanishi faqat mobil qurilmadan yoki boshqa tarmoqdan masofaviy ko'rish uchun talab qilinadi.

Q: SAT Solutions'da IP-kameralarga kafolat qanday?
A: Rasmiy distribyutorlar orqali yetkazib beriladigan Hikvision uskunasiga ishlab chiqaruvchi kafolati beriladi. Aniq muddatlar modelga bog'liq va buyurtma rasmiylashtirishda aniqlanadi. SAT Solutions shuningdek shartnoma bo'yicha kengaytirilgan servis xizmatini taklif qiladi.

Q: Toshkentda IP-videokuzatuv tizimini montaj qilish qancha turadi?
A: Montaj narxi kameralar soniga, obyektning murakkabligiga, kabel yo'llari uzunligiga va qo'shimcha ishlarga (shtroblash, kabelni maskalash) bog'liq. SAT Solutions mutaxassislaridan bepul hisob-kitob so'rang — ular obyektga chiqib, smeta tuzadilar.
hik-ip-cameras.en:
IP cameras are the foundation of any modern video surveillance system. Unlike analog solutions, network cameras transmit the image in digital format over standard IP infrastructure, which enables high resolution, flexible scalability and remote access from any device. Buying IP cameras in Tashkent today is possible for sites of any scale — from a small office to an extensive network of branches across Uzbekistan.

The SAT Solutions catalog features more than 149 IP camera models in various form factors: dome, bullet and cube. Each form factor solves its own tasks: dome cameras are harder to notice and harder for a vandal to reposition, bullet cameras are well suited to corridors and perimeters, and cube cameras are convenient for indoor installation and integration into face recognition systems. Choosing the right enclosure type is the first step toward an effective video surveillance system.

The choice of an IP camera is determined by several key parameters: sensor resolution, lens type and characteristics, the presence and range of infrared illumination, enclosure protection rating, analytics support and power method. A mistake at the equipment selection stage results in either excessive costs or insufficient recording quality. SAT Solutions specialists help select the optimal configuration for a specific site and budget.

## How to choose

- Sensor resolution. At least 4 MP is needed for identifying faces or reading license plates; 2 MP is sufficient for a general overview of premises. Higher resolution requires more storage space and network bandwidth.
- Lens and field of view. A fixed 2.8 mm lens provides wide coverage — suitable for small spaces. A varifocal lens (for example, 2.8–12 mm) allows the angle to be adjusted after installation — convenient for the outdoors and long corridors.
- Infrared illumination. Pay attention to the IR illumination range: for parking lots and perimeters you need 40–50 m or more, while for an office corridor 15–20 m is enough. Some models are equipped with color illumination (ColorVu, ColorHunter) — they provide a color image even at night.
- Enclosure protection rating. For outdoor installation, an IP66 class (dust and moisture protection) is the minimum required. An IK10 vandal-resistant design is relevant for public spaces and entrance areas.
- Power. PoE (Power over Ethernet) simplifies installation — a single cable carries both data and power. Check the standard: PoE (802.3af, up to 15.4 W) or PoE+ (802.3at, up to 30 W) — this determines compatibility with the switch.
- Built-in analytics. Modern cameras support motion detection, line crossing, visitor counting, face and plate recognition. Onboard analytics reduces the load on the server.
- Compatibility with the recorder. Make sure the camera works with your NVR via the ONVIF protocol or within the manufacturer's single ecosystem — this guarantees correct transmission of all functions.

## Applications

- Offices and business centers. Monitoring entrance areas, meeting rooms, server rooms and common areas; integration with the access control system.
- Retail facilities. Surveillance of the sales floor, checkout area and warehouse; customer traffic analytics and visitor counting.
- Manufacturing plants and warehouses. Monitoring production lines, the perimeter and loading/unloading areas; monitoring compliance with safety rules.
- Residential complexes and private sites. Video intercom, perimeter security, parking; remote viewing from a mobile phone.
- Government and educational institutions. Monitoring entrances, common areas and the adjacent territory; integration with the city's centralized security systems.
- Transport infrastructure facilities. Surveillance of entrances, parking lots and platforms; recognition of vehicle license plates.

## Brands and models in the catalog

- Hikvision — a world leader in the video surveillance market, widely represented in the SAT Solutions catalog. The lineup includes dome models of the DS-2CD series (for example, DS-2CD2543G2-IS, DS-2CD1143G2-LIU), bullet cameras of the DS-2CD2T and DS-2CD1 series, as well as cube cameras of the DS-2CD2443G2 and DS-2CD2463G2 series. The models cover a resolution range from 2 to 8 MP with support for AcuSense, ColorVu and Deep Learning technologies.
- The AcuSense series (Hikvision) stands out for its intelligent false alarm filtering: the camera distinguishes between people and vehicles, not reacting to animals, leaves or weather interference. This significantly reduces the load on security operators.
- Models with dual-LED illumination (suffix LI, LIUF in the part numbers) provide both infrared and white illumination simultaneously, allowing switching between black-and-white and full-color night modes depending on the task.
- Varifocal models (suffix Z or a range in the part number, for example 2.8–12 mm) make it possible to precisely adjust the field of view after installation — especially valuable at sites with non-standard geometry or large spans.

## FAQ

Q: What IP camera resolution should I choose for an office?
A: For general surveillance and entrance monitoring, 4 MP is sufficient. If clear face identification or reading small details (documents, banknotes) is required, models from 6 to 8 MP are worth considering.

Q: Can Hikvision IP cameras be connected to an existing recorder of another brand?
A: Most modern IP cameras support the ONVIF protocol, which provides basic compatibility with recorders from different manufacturers. However, advanced functionality (intelligent analytics, two-way audio, special recording modes) works correctly only within a single ecosystem. Before purchasing, check compatibility with SAT Solutions specialists.

Q: Do IP cameras work without the internet?
A: Yes. The internet is not needed for local recording to an NVR — a local network is sufficient. An internet connection is required only for remote viewing from a mobile device or another network.

Q: What is the warranty on IP cameras at SAT Solutions?
A: Hikvision equipment supplied through official distributors comes with a manufacturer's warranty. Exact terms depend on the model and are clarified when placing an order. SAT Solutions also offers extended service maintenance under contract.

Q: How much does installing an IP video surveillance system in Tashkent cost?
A: The installation cost depends on the number of cameras, the complexity of the site, the length of cable runs and additional work (channeling, cable concealment). Request a free estimate from SAT Solutions specialists — they will visit the site and prepare a quote.

Turniketlar — bu odamlarning kirish-chiqish nazorat punktlari orqali bir yoki ikki yo'nalishli o'tishini tashkil etish uchun mo'ljallangan kirishni nazorat qilish va boshqarish tizimlari. Ular kirish zonalarini chegaralash, tashrif buyuruvchilar yoki xodimlarni hisobga olish, qo'riqlanadigan hududga ruxsatsiz kirishni istisno qilish zarur bo'lgan joylarda qo'llaniladi. Toshkentda turniket sotib olishni bugun keng assortimentda amalga oshirish mumkin: kichik ofislar uchun ixcham tripodlardan tortib biznes-markazlar va transport tugunlari uchun to'liq bo'yli shisha panjarali tizimlargacha.

Turniketni tanlash obyekt klassiga, odamlar oqimi zichligiga, xavfsizlik talablariga va boshqa tizimlar bilan integratsiyaga bog'liq. Zamonaviy turniketlar karta o'qigichlari, biometrik terminallar, SKUD-kontrollerlar va videokuzatuv tizimlari bilan bog'liq holda ishlaydi. SAT Solutions katalogida Hikvision turniketlarining 27 modeli taqdim etilgan — arzon shisha modellardan tortib yuzni tanish o'rnatilgan terminallariga ega premium yechimlargacha. Uskuna O'zbekistonga rasmiy ravishda, to'liq texnik qo'llab-quvvatlash va ishlab chiqaruvchi kafolati bilan yetkazib beriladi.

To'g'ri tanlangan va o'rnatilgan turniket bir vaqtning o'zida bir necha vazifani hal qiladi: jadval va rollar bo'yicha kirishni nazorat qiladi, xodimlarning kelish va ketish vaqtini qayd etadi, qo'riqchiga yuklamani kamaytiradi va «dumli» o'tishning oldini oladi. Turniketlarni montaj qilish va sozlash SKUD dasturiy ta'minoti bilan integratsiya tajribasini talab qiladi, shuning uchun o'z muhandislik xizmatiga ega yetkazib beruvchini tanlash juda muhim.

## Qanday tanlash kerak

- Mexanizm turi: tripodlar (uch shtangali) mo''tadil oqimli ofislar uchun mos keladi, shisha panjarali (flap-baryer) — vakillik kirish guruhlari va savdo markazlari uchun, ochilib-yopiladigan baryerlar — yirik gabaritli yuk bilan o'tish yoki nogiron tashrif buyuruvchilar uchun.
- Balandlik va himoya darajasi: past shisha turniketlar estetika beradi, lekin sakrab o'tishni to'smaydi; to'liq bo'yli konstruksiyalar fizik to'siqni ta'minlaydi va xavfsizlikka yuqori talablar qo'yiladigan obyektlarda qo'llaniladi.
- O'rnatilgan terminal yoki tashqi o'qigich: Hikvision DS-K3B631TX turidagi o'rnatilgan terminalli modellar turniket va karta yoki biometriya o'qigichini bitta korpusda birlashtiradi, montajni soddalashtiradi va kabel yo'llari sonini kamaytiradi.
- Ijro: ko'cha yoki namlik yuqori xonalar uchun IP65 va undan yuqori himoyali uskuna kerak (masalan, ko'cha seriyali Hikvision DS-K3B501SX/601SX-Dp65); standart ofis modellari IP40-54 klassiga mo'ljallangan.
- O'tkazuvchanlik: yuqori yuklamali KPP uchun (metro, vokzallar, yirik korxonalar) panjarani ochish tezligi muhim — daqiqasiga 30 dan 60 va undan ortiq o'tishgacha.
- SKUD bilan moslik: turniket bir xil protokollarni (Wiegand, RS-485, TCP/IP) qo'llab-quvvatlashi va allaqachon ishlatilayotgan yoki rejalashtirilayotgan kirishni boshqarish dasturiy kompleksi bilan integratsiyalashishiga ishonch hosil qiling.
- Chap va o'ng ijro: ko'p modellar ko'zguli konfiguratsiyalarda (L/R) va juft komplektlarda chiqariladi, bu aniq planirovka ostida o'tishni loyihalashda hisobga olish muhim.

## Qo'llanilish sohalari

- Ofis markazlari va biznes-parklar: xodimlar va tashrif buyuruvchilar uchun zonalarni chegaralash, ish vaqtini hisobga olish, ijarachilar kirish tizimi bilan integratsiya.
- Sanoat korxonalari va zavodlar: rejimli hududlarga o'tishni nazorat qilish, ishlab chiqarish sexlarini chegaralash, kirish rejimi buzilishlarini qayd etish.
- Transport infratuzilmasi va jamoat muassasalari: stadionlar, sport majmualari, o'quv muassasalari, tibbiyot markazlari — boshqariladigan bir yo'nalishli oqim talab qilinadigan hamma joyda.
- Savdo markazlari va riteyl: nazorat qilinadigan nuqtalar orqali savdo zonalaridan chiqishni tashkil etish, o'g'irlikdan yo'qotishlarni kamaytirish.
- Davlat muassasalari va idoralar: qat'iy kirish rejimi, karta va biometriya bo'yicha verifikatsiya, barcha o'tish hodisalarini jurnallashtirish.
- Turar-joy majmualari va premium-klass apartamentlar: lobbidagi nafis shisha flap-baryerlar xavfsizlikni ta'minlaydi va obyekt maqomini ta'kidlaydi.

## Katalogdagi brendlar va modellar

- Hikvision — ushbu kategoriyada taqdim etilgan yagona brend, va bu tasodifiy emas: kompaniya xavfsizlik sohasidagi jahon uchligiga kiradi va yagona platforma ostida SKUD, videokuzatuv va biometriyaning tugallangan ekotizimini taklif qiladi.
- DS-K3B501SX / DS-K3B601SX seriyasi — o'rta klassdagi shisha panjarali turniketlar, xonalar va ko'cha (IP65) uchun variantlarda, chap va o'ng ijroda, tashqi karta o'qigichlarini qo'llab-quvvatlash bilan mavjud.
- DS-K3B801BX seriyasi (Premium) — vakillik kirish guruhlari va intensiv oqimga mo'ljallangan, ulkan shisha panjarali premium klassdagi turniketlar.
- DS-K3B220LX / DS-K3B411TMX — dizayn va yuklamaga mo''tadil talablarga ega ofislar uchun arzon va o'rta shisha turniketlar.
- DS-K3G501X / DS-K3G501CX (tripod) — cheklangan byudjetli yoki nostandart planirovka vazifalariga ega tashkilotlar uchun klassik va premium tripodlar.
- DS-K3B631TX — SKUD-o'qigich va o'tish funksiyalarini yagona qurilmada birlashtiruvchi, o'rnatilgan terminalli turniket; kirishda uskuna miqdorini minimallashtirishni istaydigan obyektlar uchun mos.
- DS-K3B211LX — keng o'tishni tashkil etish uchun ochilib-yopiladigan baryer: nogiron shaxslar kirishini, aravachalar yoki velosipedlarni olib o'tishni ta'minlash uchun panjarali turniketlar bilan birgalikda ishlatiladi.

## FAQ

Q: Toshkentda turniket va montaj qancha turadi?
A: Narx turi va modeliga bog'liq: arzon tripodlar va boshlang'ich darajadagi shisha turniketlar o'rnatilgan terminalli premium seriyalardan sezilarli darajada arzon narxlarda mavjud. Montaj o'tish nuqtalari soniga, kabel ishlari hajmiga va mavjud tizim bilan integratsiya zaruriyatiga qarab individual hisoblanadi. SAT Solutions menejerlaridan tijorat taklifini so'rang — hisob-kitob bepul.

Q: Turniketni boshqa ishlab chiqaruvchining allaqachon o'rnatilgan SKUD'i bilan integratsiya qilish mumkinmi?
A: Hikvision turniketlari standart Wiegand interfeyslarini va quruq kontaktni qo'llab-quvvatlaydi, bu ularni uchinchi tomon ishlab chiqaruvchilarning aksariyat SKUD-kontrollerlariga ulash imkonini beradi. Firma HikCentral dasturiy ta'minoti bilan to'liq integratsiya uchun mos Hikvision kontrollerlaridan foydalanish tavsiya etiladi. Sotib olishdan oldin muhandislarimizdan moslikni aniqlang.

Q: Shisha turniketlarga qo'shimcha ravishda ochilib-yopiladigan baryer kerakmi?
A: Muhit imkoniyatlari me'yorlari va yong'in xavfsizligi talablari bo'yicha har bir turniket liniyasida nogiron odamlar va shoshilinch evakuatsiya uchun keng o'tish bo'lishi kerak. Hikvision DS-K3B211LX ochilib-yopiladigan baryeri o'sha SKUD bilan boshqariladi va qo'riqchi tomonidan masofadan yoki yong'in signalizatsiyasida avtomatik ravishda ochiladi.

Q: Hikvision turniketlari ko'cha o'rnatishga mos keladimi?
A: Ha, DS-K3B501SX/601SX seriyasining bir qator modellari IP65 ijroda chiqariladi, bu chang va atmosfera yog'inlaridan himoyani ta'minlaydi. Issiq yozi bo'lgan O'zbekiston uchun ishchi harorat diapazoni va korpus materialini ham hisobga olish muhim — aniq model xususiyatlarini mutaxassislardan aniqlang.

Q: Turniketlarga kafolat qanday va kafolatli ta'mirlashni kim o'tkazadi?
A: Hikvision uskunasiga kafolat muddati odatda modelga qarab 12-24 oyni tashkil etadi. SAT Solutions rasmiy hamkor sifatida O'zbekiston hududida kafolatli xizmatni amalga oshiradi: muhandis chiqishi, diagnostika va nosoz komponentlarni almashtirish kafolat davri mobaynida buyurtmachi uchun qo'shimcha xarajatlarsiz.
hik-turnstiles.en:
Turnstiles are access control and management systems designed to organize one-way or two-way passage of people through checkpoints. They are used where it is necessary to delimit access zones, keep records of visitors or employees, and prevent unauthorized entry into a protected area. Buying a turnstile in Tashkent today is possible in a wide range: from compact tripods for small offices to full-height glass flap-barrier systems for business centers and transport hubs.

The choice of a turnstile depends on the class of the site, the intensity of the flow of people, security requirements and integration with other systems. Modern turnstiles work in conjunction with card readers, biometric terminals, ACS controllers and video surveillance systems. The SAT Solutions catalog features 27 models of Hikvision turnstiles — from budget glass ones to premium solutions with built-in face recognition terminals. The equipment is supplied to Uzbekistan officially, with full technical support and a manufacturer's warranty.

A properly selected and installed turnstile solves several tasks at once: it controls access by schedule and roles, records employees' arrival and departure times, reduces the load on security and prevents tailgating. Installation and configuration of turnstiles require experience in integration with ACS software, so choosing a supplier with its own engineering service is critically important.

## How to choose

- Mechanism type: tripods (three-arm) are suitable for offices with moderate flow, glass flap barriers — for representative entrance areas and shopping centers, swing barriers — for passage with large cargo or for people with reduced mobility.
- Height and level of protection: low glass turnstiles offer aesthetics but do not block jumping over; full-height structures provide a physical barrier and are used at sites with high security requirements.
- Built-in terminal or external reader: models like the Hikvision DS-K3B631TX with a built-in terminal combine the turnstile and card or biometric reader in a single housing, simplifying installation and reducing the number of cable runs.
- Enclosure rating: for the outdoors or spaces with high humidity, equipment with IP65 protection or higher is required (for example, the Hikvision DS-K3B501SX/601SX-Dp65 outdoor series); standard office models are rated for IP40-54 class.
- Throughput: for high-load checkpoints (metro, railway stations, large enterprises), the speed of the barrier opening is important — from 30 to 60 and more passages per minute.
- ACS compatibility: make sure the turnstile supports the same protocols (Wiegand, RS-485, TCP/IP) and integrates with the access control software already in use or planned.
- Left- and right-hand configuration: many models are produced in mirror configurations (L/R) and paired kits, which is important to consider when designing a passage for a specific layout.

## Applications

- Office centers and business parks: delimiting zones for employees and visitors, working-time tracking, integration with tenants' access system.
- Industrial enterprises and factories: controlling passage into restricted areas, delimiting production shops, recording access-regime violations.
- Transport infrastructure and public institutions: stadiums, sports complexes, educational institutions, medical centers — wherever a managed one-way flow is required.
- Shopping centers and retail: organizing exit from retail zones through controlled points, reducing losses from theft.
- Government institutions and agencies: strict access regime, verification by card and biometrics, logging of all passage events.
- Residential complexes and premium apartments: elegant glass flap barriers in the lobby provide security and emphasize the site's status.

## Brands and models in the catalog

- Hikvision — the only brand represented in this category, and this is no coincidence: the company is among the world's top three in the security field and offers a complete ecosystem of ACS, video surveillance and biometrics under a single platform.
- The DS-K3B501SX / DS-K3B601SX series — mid-range glass flap-barrier turnstiles, available in indoor and outdoor (IP65) variants, in left- and right-hand configurations, with support for external card readers.
- The DS-K3B801BX series (Premium) — premium-class turnstiles with massive glass flaps, designed for representative entrance areas and heavy flow.
- DS-K3B220LX / DS-K3B411TMX — budget and mid-range glass turnstiles for offices with moderate design and load requirements.
- DS-K3G501X / DS-K3G501CX (tripod) — classic and premium tripods for organizations with a limited budget or non-standard layout tasks.
- DS-K3B631TX — a turnstile with a built-in terminal, combining ACS reader and passage functions in a single device; suitable for sites that want to minimize the amount of equipment at the entrance.
- DS-K3B211LX — a swing barrier for organizing a wide passage: used together with flap-barrier turnstiles to provide access for people with reduced mobility, or the passage of carts or bicycles.

## FAQ

Q: How much does a turnstile and installation cost in Tashkent?
A: The cost depends on the type and model: budget tripods and entry-level glass turnstiles are available at prices significantly lower than premium series with built-in terminals. Installation is calculated individually depending on the number of passage points, the volume of cabling work and the need for integration with an existing system. Request a commercial proposal from SAT Solutions managers — the calculation is free.

Q: Can a turnstile be integrated with an already installed ACS from another manufacturer?
A: Hikvision turnstiles support standard Wiegand interfaces and dry contact, which allows connecting them to most third-party ACS controllers. For full integration with proprietary HikCentral software, it is recommended to use compatible Hikvision controllers. Check compatibility with our engineers before purchasing.

Q: Is a swing barrier needed in addition to glass turnstiles?
A: According to accessibility standards and fire safety requirements, each turnstile line must have a wide passage for people with reduced mobility and emergency evacuation. The Hikvision DS-K3B211LX swing barrier is managed by the same ACS and opens remotely by security or automatically in case of a fire alarm.

Q: Are Hikvision turnstiles suitable for outdoor installation?
A: Yes, a number of models of the DS-K3B501SX/601SX series are produced in an IP65 version, which provides protection against dust and precipitation. For Uzbekistan with its hot summer, it is also important to consider the operating temperature range and enclosure material — check the characteristics of the specific model with specialists.

Q: What is the warranty on turnstiles and who performs warranty repairs?
A: The warranty period on Hikvision equipment is, as a rule, 12–24 months depending on the model. SAT Solutions, as an official partner, provides warranty service in Uzbekistan: an engineer visit, diagnostics and replacement of faulty components at no additional cost to the customer during the warranty period.

avigilon-domes.uz:
Gumbazli videokuzatuv kameralari — har qanday miqyosdagi obyektlarni qo'riqlash uchun eng talab qilinadigan uskuna turlaridan biri. Ularning yarim shar shaklidagi ixcham korpusi ortiqcha e'tiborni tortmasdan interer va eksteryerga organik ravishda mos keladi, keng ko'rish burchagi esa minimal o'rnatish nuqtalari bilan katta maydonlarni qamrab olish imkonini beradi. Toshkentda gumbazli kameralarni bugun keng assortimentda sotib olish mumkin — arzon analog yechimlardan tortib bortda analitikaga ega korporativ klassdagi professional IP-kameralargacha.

Bu uskuna turi xonalarda, kirish guruhlarida, savdo zallarida, ofislarda, koridorlarda va binolar perimetrida kuzatuv uchun mos keladi. Gumbazli kameralar polikarbonat yoki aksilyaltiroq shishadan yasalgan himoya gumbazlari tufayli yoritishga va vandalizmga chidamli. Zamonaviy modellar infraqizil yoritish, motorlashtirilgan zum, tungi ko'rish funksiyalari va yuzlarni tanish, harakatni aniqlash va xatti-harakatlar tahlili uchun o'rnatilgan sun'iy intellekt bilan jihozlanadi. Bularning barchasi gumbazli kameralarni O'zbekistondagi xavfsizlik tizimlari uchun universal yechimga aylantiradi.

Gumbazli kamerani tanlashda bir nechta omillarni hisobga olish muhim: ekspluatatsiya sharoitlari (ko'cha yoki xona), talab qilinadigan aniqlik, tungi ko'rish va qo'shimcha analitika zaruriyati. Bozorda ham umumiy foydalanish kameralari, ham chakana savdo, transport tugunlari, banklar va kritik infratuzilma obyektlari uchun ixtisoslashgan yechimlar taqdim etilgan. Real vazifalarni hisobga olgan holda uskunani puxta tanlash optimal byudjetda maksimal qamrovni olish imkonini beradi.

## Qanday tanlash kerak

- Aniqlik va tasvir sifati. Kichik xonalar uchun 2-4 MP yetarli, yuqori qatnovli yoki yuzlarni tanish zarur bo'lgan zonalar uchun 5-8 MP va undan yuqori tavsiya etiladi. Avigilon'ning H6A va H6X seriyali modellari keng qamrash burchagida ham shaxsni identifikatsiya qilish uchun yetarli detallashtirishni ta'minlaydi.

- O'rnatish turi va montaj joyi. Shiftga montaj — aksariyat obyektlar uchun standart, lekin burchak zonalari va ko'cha perimetri uchun ixtisoslashgan kronshteynlar va yuqori himoya darajali korpuslar kerak bo'ladi. Sotib olishdan oldin IP klassini aniqlang.

- Tungi ko'rish va yoritish. IQ-yoritish ishtirokchilar uchun sezilmasdan ishlaydi, lekin cheklangan radiusga ega. Qorong'i ochiq maydonlar uchun qo'shimcha oq yoritishli yoki Starlight rejimini qo'llab-quvvatlaydigan kameralar afzal.

- O'rnatilgan analitika. Agar yuzlarni tanish, odamlarni sanash, tashlab ketilgan predmetlarni aniqlash yoki perimetr buzilishi talab qilinsa — bortda analitikaga ega kameralarni tanlang. Bu serverga yuklamani kamaytiradi va tizim reaksiyasini tezlashtiradi.

- VMS va bulutli platformalar bilan moslik. Tanlangan kameralar foydalanilayotgan video boshqaruv dasturiy ta'minotini qo'llab-quvvatlashiga ishonch hosil qiling. Avigilon'ning Alta Dome seriyalari ham lokal VMS bilan integratsiyani, ham bulutli videokuzatuvni nativ qo'llab-quvvatlashni taklif qiladi.

- Korpus himoya darajasi. Ko'cha montaji uchun IP66 dan kam bo'lmagan himoya klassi kerak. IK10 klassidagi vandaldan himoyalangan korpuslar jamoat joylari, transport tugunlari va avtoturargohlar uchun dolzarb.

- Tizim masshtablanuvchanligi. Kengaytirishni rejalashtirganda, bir ekotizimdagi kameralarni afzal ko'ring: bu boshqaruvni soddalashtiradi va uzoq muddatli istiqbolda xizmat ko'rsatish narxini kamaytiradi.

## Qo'llanilish sohalari

- Savdo va biznes-markazlar. Gumbazli kameralar savdo zallari, kassa zonalari, kirish guruhlari va avtoturargohlarni nazorat qiladi, o'g'irliklarning oldini olishga va hodisalarni qayd etishga yordam beradi.

- Ofislar va ma'muriy binolar. Voqealarni masofaviy ko'rish va arxivlash imkoniyati bilan resepshn, muzokara xonalari, koridorlar va serverlar xonalarini kuzatish.

- Ishlab chiqarish obyektlari va omborlar. Texnologik zonalar, hududga kirish va ombor xonalarini nazorat qilish; kirishni nazorat qilish va qo'riqlash signalizatsiyasi tizimlari bilan integratsiya.

- Banklar va moliyaviy muassasalar. Mijozlarga xizmat ko'rsatish zonalarida, bankomatlar va omborxonalarda 30 kundan chuqurlikdagi majburiy videoarxiv bilan yuqori aniqlikdagi videokuzatuv.

- O'quv muassasalari va tibbiyot muassasalari. Real vaqt rejimida trafik tahlili va favqulodda vaziyatlarni aniqlash imkoniyati bilan kirishlar, koridorlar va perimetrni nazorat qilish.

- Mehmonxonalar va mehmondo'stlik obyektlari. Lobbi, lift xollari va qavatlardagi bemalol gumbazli kameralar interer estetikasini buzmasdan mehmonlar xavfsizligini ta'minlaydi.

## Katalogdagi brendlar va modellar

- Avigilon — Motorola Solutions guruhiga kiruvchi professional videokuzatuv tizimlarining amerikalik ishlab chiqaruvchisi. Uskuna korporativ va davlat sektoriga yo'naltirilgan, yuqori tasvir sifati va rivojlangan videoanalitika bilan ajralib turadi.

- H6A va H6X Dome seriyasi. 32 MP gacha aniqlikka, Avigilon Appearance Search analitikasini qo'llab-quvvatlashga va Avigilon Control Center platformasi bilan integratsiyaga ega flagman modellar. Identifikatsiyaga yuqori talablar qo'yiladigan obyektlarda qo'llaniladi.

- Alta Dome seriyasi (Alta A5 va bulutli modellar bilan). Avigilon Alta platformasi orqali bulutli boshqaruvni nativ qo'llab-quvvatlaydigan zamonaviy liniya. Taqsimlangan obyektlar va lokal serverlarsiz bulutli xizmat modelini afzal ko'radigan buyurtmachilar uchun mos.

- H5A Dome va H6 Mini Dome seriyasi. Ofis va tijorat muhiti uchun ixcham yechimlar: kichik korpusda yuqori aniqlik, PoE ni qo'llab-quvvatlash, standart o'rnatish qutisiga oddiy montaj.

- Unity Dome. Ortiqcha analitikasiz ishonchli videoyozuv talab qilinadigan obyektlar uchun boshlang'ich korporativ darajadagi yechim, standart integratsiya protokollarini qo'llab-quvvatlash bilan.

## FAQ

Q: Yorug'lik yomon xonalar uchun qaysi Avigilon gumbazli kameralari yaxshiroq mos keladi?
A: Kam yoritilgan zonalar uchun past yoritish rejimi va IQ-yoritishga ega modellar tavsiya etiladi, masalan LightCatcher funksiyasiga ega H6A Dome seriyali kameralar. Ular qo'shimcha yorug'lik manbalarisiz minimal yoritishda sifatli rangli tasvirni ta'minlaydi.

Q: Avigilon gumbazli kameralarini uchinchi tomon videoregistratoriga ulash mumkinmi?
A: Bir qism modellar ONVIF standartini qo'llab-quvvatlaydi, biroq analitika va integratsiyaning to'liq funksionali faqat Avigilon Control Center yoki Alta platformalari kabi mos VMS'lardan foydalanganda mavjud. Sotib olishdan oldin SAT Solutions mutaxassislaridan moslikni aniqlashni tavsiya qilamiz.

Q: Toshkentda gumbazli kamerani montaj qilish qancha turadi?
A: Montaj narxi obyekt turiga, kabel yo'lining murakkabligiga va o'rnatish nuqtalari soniga bog'liq. Aniq smetani olish uchun SAT Solutions saytida ariza qoldiring — obyektni tekshirish uchun mutaxassis chiqishi bepul.

Q: Avigilon gumbazli kameralariga kafolat muddati qanday?
A: Ishlab chiqaruvchi Avigilon uskunasiga seriyaga qarab 1 dan 3 yilgacha kafolat beradi. SAT Solutions butun kafolat davri mobaynida nosoz uskunani almashtirish bilan kafolatli xizmatni ta'minlaydi.

Q: Gumbazli kameralar O'zbekistonning issiq iqlim sharoitida ko'cha o'rnatishga mos keladimi?
A: Ha, tashqi o'rnatish uchun modellar keng harorat diapazonida ekspluatatsiyaga mo'ljallangan va IP66 yoki IP67 himoya klassli korpus bilan jihozlangan. Montajdan oldin tanlangan model tashqi qo'llash uchun sertifikatlanganligi va mintaqaning ishchi haroratlariga mos kelishiga ishonch hosil qilish muhim.
avigilon-domes.en:
Dome video surveillance cameras are one of the most sought-after types of equipment for protecting sites of any scale. Their compact hemisphere-shaped housing fits organically into interiors and exteriors without drawing undue attention, while a wide field of view makes it possible to cover large areas with a minimal number of installation points. Buying dome cameras in Tashkent today is possible in a wide range — from budget analog solutions to professional corporate-class IP cameras with onboard analytics.

This type of equipment is suitable for surveillance indoors, at entrance areas, on sales floors, in offices, corridors and along building perimeters. Dome cameras are resistant to glare and vandalism thanks to protective domes made of polycarbonate or anti-glare glass. Modern models are equipped with infrared illumination, motorized zoom, night vision functions and built-in artificial intelligence for face recognition, motion detection and behavior analysis. All this makes dome cameras a universal solution for security systems in Uzbekistan.

When choosing a dome camera, it is important to consider several factors: operating conditions (outdoors or indoors), the required resolution, the need for night vision and additional analytics. The market offers both general-purpose cameras and specialized solutions for retail, transport hubs, banks and critical infrastructure facilities. A well-considered selection of equipment tailored to real tasks makes it possible to achieve maximum coverage at an optimal budget.

## How to choose

- Resolution and image quality. For small spaces 2-4 MP is sufficient, while for high-traffic zones or where face recognition is needed, 5-8 MP and higher is recommended. Avigilon's H6A and H6X series models provide detail sufficient for identifying a person even at a wide capture angle.

- Installation type and mounting location. Ceiling mounting is the standard for most sites, but corner zones and outdoor perimeters will require specialized brackets and housings with a higher protection rating. Check the IP class before purchasing.

- Night vision and illumination. IR illumination works invisibly for those present but has a limited range. For dark open spaces, cameras with additional white illumination or Starlight mode support are preferable.

- Built-in analytics. If face recognition, people counting, abandoned object detection or perimeter breach detection is required — choose cameras with onboard analytics. This reduces the load on the server and speeds up the system's response.

- Compatibility with VMS and cloud platforms. Make sure the chosen cameras support the video management software in use. Avigilon's Alta Dome series offers both integration with on-premises VMS and native support for cloud video surveillance.

- Enclosure protection rating. For outdoor mounting, a protection class of at least IP66 is required. IK10 vandal-resistant housings are relevant for public places, transport hubs and parking lots.

- System scalability. When planning expansion, give preference to cameras of a single ecosystem: this simplifies management and reduces maintenance costs in the long term.

## Applications

- Shopping and business centers. Dome cameras monitor sales floors, checkout areas, entrance areas and parking lots, helping to prevent theft and record incidents.

- Offices and administrative buildings. Surveillance of reception, meeting rooms, corridors and server rooms with the ability to view remotely and archive events.

- Industrial sites and warehouses. Monitoring of technological zones, the entrance to the territory and storage areas; integration with access control systems and burglar alarms.

- Banks and financial institutions. High-resolution video surveillance in customer service areas, ATMs and vaults, with a mandatory video archive of at least 30 days' depth.

- Educational institutions and medical facilities. Monitoring of entrances, corridors and the perimeter with the ability to analyze traffic and detect abnormal situations in real time.

- Hotels and hospitality facilities. Unobtrusive dome cameras in lobbies, elevator halls and on floors ensure guest safety without disrupting the aesthetics of the interior.

## Brands and models in the catalog
