Kommutatorlar — bu tarmoq uskunasini yagona lokal tarmoqqa birlashtiradigan va trafikni ulangan tugunlar o'rtasida taqsimlaydigan qurilmalar: videokuzatuv kameralari, Wi-Fi kirish nuqtalari, IP-telefonlar, serverlar va ishchi stansiyalar. Kommutatorsiz na bitta zamonaviy xavfsizlik tizimini, na ofis tarmog'ini qurish mumkin — aynan u qurilmalar o'rtasida ma'lumotlar qanchalik barqaror va tez uzatilishini belgilaydi. Toshkentda kommutatorlarni aniq ob'ekt va byudjet ostida boshqariladigan va boshqarilmaydigan modellar, shuningdek IP-kameralar va kirish nuqtalarini o'ralgan juftlik orqali ta'minlash uchun PoE ni qo'llab-quvvatlaydigan qurilmalar to'plangan SAT Solutions katalogi orqali sotib olish mumkin.

Alohida rolni PoE-kommutatorlar (Power over Ethernet) o'ynaydi — ular ulangan qurilmalarga ta'minotni to'g'ridan-to'g'ri tarmoq kabeli orqali, alohida ta'minot bloklari va har bir kamera yonidagi rozetkalarsiz beradi. Bu videokuzatuv va Wi-Fi tizimlarini montaj qilishni keskin osonlashtiradi: bitta UTP kabeli ham ma'lumotlarni, ham elektr ta'minotini olib boradi, bu esa o'tkazish xarajatlarini va nosozlik nuqtalari sonini kamaytiradi. O'nlab kamerali ob'ektlar uchun yetarli quvvat byudjetiga ega to'g'ri tanlangan PoE-kommutator butun tizimning ishonchli ishlashining asosi.

O'zbekiston sharoitida kommutatorni tanlash har doim nafaqat portlar soni bilan, balki yuk va haroratga chidamlilik bilan ham bog'liq. Server va apparat xonalari yozda qiziydi, viloyatlarda esa kuchlanish sakrashlari ko'p uchraydi, shuning uchun uskunani tanlashda elektronika sifati, portlarni himoya qilish va PoE quvvat zaxirasi muhim. SAT Solutions katalogi mahalliy sharoitlarda — Toshkent va viloyatlarning ofislarida, savdo va ishlab chiqarish ob'ektlarida — barqaror ishlaydigan texnikaga yo'naltirilgan.

## Qanday tanlash kerak

- **PoE qo'llab-quvvatlash va quvvat byudjeti:** agar kommutator kameralar yoki kirish nuqtalarini ta'minlasa, PoE ning vattdagi umumiy byudjetini va portga quvvatni tekshiring. IK-yoritgichli va aylanuvchi mexanizmli kamera qo'zg'almasidan ko'proq iste'mol qiladi — umumiy quvvat barcha qurilmalarga bir vaqtning o'zida yetishi kerak.
- **Portlar tezligi:** asosiy vazifalar uchun 100 Mbit/s (Fast Ethernet) yetarli, lekin serverlar, NVR, ko'p megapikselli kameralar oqimlari va magistral liniyalar uchun gigabitli modellarni tanlang — masalan, KANIHAD 1006GB yoki 1010GB yoxud gigabitli GNT-G1618FG.
- **Boshqarish imkoniyati:** boshqarilmaydigan kommutatorlar "qutidan" ishlaydi va oddiy tarmoqlar uchun mos. Boshqariladiganlari VLAN, trafik ustuvorliklari (QoS) va segmentatsiyani sozlash imkonini beradi — bu videokuzatuv va ofis tarmog'i bitta infratuzilmani bo'lishganda muhim.
- **Aplink va magistral:** qavatlar va binolar o'rtasidagi aloqa uchun gigabitli yoki optik (SFP) aplinklar mavjudligiga e'tibor bering. Optika mis liniyaning 100 metrlik uzunlik cheklovini olib tashlaydi va taqsimlangan ob'ektlar uchun muhim.

- **Himoya va ishonchlilik:** portlarni ortiqcha kuchlanish va momaqaldiroq induksiyalaridan himoya qilish mavjudligi ayniqsa ko'chadagi kameralar va beqaror tarmoq sharoitidagi korpuslar o'rtasidagi liniyalar uchun muhim.

- **Maxsus ob'ektlar va perimetr:** portlarni himoya qilish va optik aplinklarga ega kommutatorlar perimetr kameralarini yagona tizimga bog'laydigan banklar, rejimli hududlar va uzoq maydonlar.

## Katalogdagi brendlar va modellar

- **KANIHAD 1006/1010 seriyali PoE-kommutatorlar:** KANIHAD 1006GB, 1006MB, 1010GB va 1010MB modellari — videokuzatuv va Wi-Fi tizimlari uchun turli portlar soni va PoE ta'minotiga ega liniya. GB versiyalari — gigabitli, MB — Fast Ethernet tezligida.

- **KANIHAD POE1-2:** kichik tugunlar va tarmoqni bir nechta qurilmaga lokal kengaytirish uchun ixcham PoE-kommutator.
- **KANIHAD GNT-G1618FG:** magistral vazifalar va tezlikka talabchan qurilmalarni — serverlar, NVR va ko'p megapikselli kameralar oqimlarini — ulash uchun gigabitli kommutator.

## FAQ

Q: PoE va oddiy kommutator o'rtasida qanday farq bor?
A: PoE-kommutator ulangan qurilmalarga ta'minotni to'g'ridan-to'g'ri tarmoq kabeli orqali beradi, oddiysi esa faqat ma'lumotlarni uzatadi. Bu IP-kameralar va Wi-Fi kirish nuqtalarini har bir qurilma yonidagi alohida ta'minot bloklari va rozetkalarsiz ta'minlash imkonini beradi. Toshkentdagi videokuzatuv tizimlari uchun bu montajni sezilarli darajada osonlashtiradi va arzonlashtiradi.

Q: Bitta kommutatorga nechta kamera ulash mumkin?
A: Bu PoE-portlar soniga va qurilmaning umumiy quvvat byudjetiga bog'liq. Barcha kameralarning bir vaqtdagi iste'moli mavjud PoE byudjetidan oshmasligi muhim. SAT Solutions mutaxassislari yukni hisoblashda va ob'ektingiz uchun kerakli zaxira bilan modelni tanlashda yordam beradi.

Q: Nima uchun gigabitli kommutator videokuzatuv uchun yaxshiroq?
A: Ko'p megapikselli kameralar va videoregistratorlar katta ma'lumot oqimini hosil qiladi, 100 Mbit/s tezlikda esa magistral tor joyga aylanishi mumkin. KANIHAD 1006GB, 1010GB yoki GNT-G1618FG kabi gigabitli modellar o'tkazish qobiliyati bo'yicha zaxira ta'minlaydi. Bu ayniqsa magistral liniyalar va NVR ni ulash uchun muhim.

Q: Ofis uchun boshqariladigan kommutator kerakmi?
A: Oddiy tarmoq uchun ulanganidan keyin darhol ishlaydigan boshqarilmaydigan model yetarli. Boshqariladigan kommutator VLAN orqali tarmoqlarni ajratish, trafik ustuvorliklarini o'rnatish yoki videokuzatuv va ofis tarmog'ini bitta infratuzilmada birlashtirish kerak bo'lganda zarur. SAT Solutions biznesingiz vazifalari uchun optimal variantni maslahat beradi.

Q: Uskuna O'zbekiston jaziramasi sharoitida barqaror ishlaydimi?

kanihad-switches.en:
Switches are devices that unite network equipment into a single local network and distribute traffic between connected nodes: video surveillance cameras, Wi-Fi access points, IP phones, servers and workstations. Without a switch it is impossible to build any modern security or office network — it is precisely the switch that determines how stably and quickly data is transmitted between devices. You can buy switches in Tashkent for a specific facility and budget through the SAT Solutions catalog, which brings together managed and unmanaged models, as well as devices with PoE support for powering IP cameras and access points over twisted pair.

A special role is played by PoE switches (Power over Ethernet) — they supply power to connected devices directly over the network cable, without separate power supplies and outlets next to each camera. This dramatically simplifies the installation of video surveillance and Wi-Fi systems: a single UTP cable carries both data and power, which reduces the cost of cabling and the number of points of failure. For facilities with dozens of cameras, a properly selected PoE switch with a sufficient power budget is the foundation of reliable operation of the entire system.

In the conditions of Uzbekistan, the choice of a switch is always connected not only with the number of ports but also with resistance to load and temperature. Server and equipment rooms heat up in summer, and in the regions voltage surges are common, so when selecting equipment the quality of electronics, port protection and a PoE power margin are important. The SAT Solutions catalog is oriented toward equipment that operates stably in local realities — in offices, at retail and production facilities in Tashkent and the regions.

## How to choose

- **Number and type of ports:** determine how many devices need to be connected and allow a margin for expansion. For video surveillance and Wi-Fi, count ports for cameras and access points plus at least one uplink for communication with the router or the network core.
- **PoE support and power budget:** if the switch powers cameras or access points, check the total PoE budget in watts and the power per port. A camera with IR illumination and a pan mechanism consumes more than a fixed one — the total power must be enough for all devices simultaneously.
- **Port speed:** for basic tasks 100 Mbit/s (Fast Ethernet) is sufficient, but for servers, NVRs, multi-megapixel camera streams and backbone lines choose gigabit models — for example, KANIHAD 1006GB or 1010GB or the gigabit GNT-G1618FG.
- **Manageability:** unmanaged switches work "out of the box" and are suitable for simple networks. Managed ones make it possible to configure VLAN, traffic priorities (QoS) and segmentation — this is critical when video surveillance and the office network share one infrastructure.
- **Uplink and backbone:** pay attention to the presence of gigabit or optical (SFP) uplinks for communication between floors and buildings. Optics removes the 100-meter limit on copper line length and is important for distributed facilities.
- **Enclosure and cooling:** for rack mounting choose a rack design, for small nodes — desktop models. Passive cooling is quieter, but at high load and heat a heat-dissipation margin is needed.
- **Protection and reliability:** the presence of port protection against surges and lightning-induced spikes is especially important for outdoor cameras and lines between buildings under unstable mains conditions.

## Applications

- **Offices and business centers:** uniting workstations, IP telephony, printers and Wi-Fi access points into a single structured network.
- **Retail facilities:** stores, supermarkets and shopping malls, where switches serve cash register nodes, video surveillance and the access control system.
- **Production and warehouses:** connecting cameras, sensors and equipment in workshops and logistics complexes with large distances between nodes.
- **Residential complexes and new buildings:** power and communication for intercoms, cameras in yards and entrances, access points in common areas over PoE.
- **Government institutions and education:** schools, clinics, administrative buildings, where network segmentation and scalability to hundreds of ports are required.
- **Special facilities and perimeter:** banks, restricted-access territories and remote sites, where switches with port protection and optical uplinks connect perimeter cameras into a single system.

## Brands and models in the catalog

- **KANIHAD PoE switches, 1006/1010 series:** the KANIHAD 1006GB, 1006MB, 1010GB and 1010MB models — a lineup with a different number of ports and PoE power for video surveillance and Wi-Fi systems. GB versions are gigabit, MB versions operate at Fast Ethernet speed.
- **KANIHAD GNT-P4813F6:** a PoE switch for connecting cameras and access points with power over twisted pair — a solution for medium-scale facilities.
- **KANIHAD POE1-2:** a compact PoE switch for small nodes and local network expansion for several devices.
- **KANIHAD GNT-G1618FG:** a gigabit switch for backbone tasks and connecting speed-demanding devices — servers, NVRs and multi-megapixel camera streams.

## FAQ

Q: What is the difference between a PoE and an ordinary switch?
A: A PoE switch supplies power to connected devices directly over the network cable, whereas an ordinary one transmits only data. This makes it possible to power IP cameras and Wi-Fi access points without separate power supplies and outlets next to each device. For video surveillance systems in Tashkent this noticeably simplifies and reduces the cost of installation.

Q: How many cameras can be connected to a single switch?
A: This depends on the number of PoE ports and the device's total power budget. It is important that the consumption of all cameras simultaneously does not exceed the available PoE budget. SAT Solutions specialists will help calculate the load and select a model with the necessary margin for your facility.

Q: Why is a gigabit switch better for video surveillance?
A: Multi-megapixel cameras and video recorders generate a large data stream, and at a speed of 100 Mbit/s the backbone can become a bottleneck. Gigabit models such as KANIHAD 1006GB, 1010GB or GNT-G1618FG provide a throughput margin. This is especially important for backbone lines and connecting an NVR.

Q: Is a managed switch needed for an office?
A: For a simple network an unmanaged model is sufficient, which works immediately after connection. A managed switch is needed when networks must be separated via VLAN, traffic priorities must be set, or video surveillance and the office network must be combined on one infrastructure. SAT Solutions will advise the optimal option for your business tasks.

Q: Will the equipment operate stably in the conditions of Uzbekistan's heat?
A: With proper selection and installation — yes. We take the thermal load into account, ensure ventilation of server rooms and, if necessary, incorporate port protection against surges. This reduces risks during summer temperatures and unstable power in the regions of Uzbekistan.

Wi-Fi kirish nuqtalari — bu simsiz qamrov zonasini yaratadigan va noutbuklar, smartfonlar, IP-kameralar, kassa terminallari va boshqa qurilmalarni simli infratuzilmaga ulaydigan faol tarmoq uskunasi. Maishiy routerlardan farqli o'laroq, professional kirish nuqtalari o'nlab va yuzlab mijozlarning bir vaqtdagi ishlashiga mo'ljallangan, butun ish kuni davomida yukni barqaror ushlab turadi va yagona boshqariladigan tarmoqqa integratsiyalashadi. Toshkentda Wi-Fi kirish nuqtalarini aniq ob'ekt ostida — kichik ofisdan filiallari bo'lgan taqsimlangan korxonagacha — ichki va tashqi stsenariylar uchun MikroTik uskunasi to'plangan SAT Solutions katalogi orqali sotib olish mumkin.

Simsiz tarmoq allaqachon ikkinchi darajali xizmat bo'lishdan to'xtadi: unda kirishni nazorat qilish tizimi, videokuzatuv, ombor logistikasi, mehmon Wi-Fi va korporativ ilovalar ishlaydi. To'g'ri tanlangan kirish nuqtasi cho'qqi yuk soatlarida ulanish barqaror bo'lishini, tarmoq xodimlarning qavatlar o'rtasidagi rouminglariga bardosh berishini va ruxsat etilmagan joylarda "o'lik zonalar" paydo bo'lmasligini belgilaydi. Shuning uchun uskuna tanlash — bu quti sotib olish emas, balki loyihaviy vazifa: maydonni, foydalanuvchilar zichligini, devor materiallarini va trafik xarakterini hisobga olish kerak.

O'zbekiston sharoitida bunga mahalliy o'ziga xoslik va iqlim qo'shiladi. Ko'chadagi va yarim ko'chadagi kirish nuqtalari +45 °C gacha yozgi jaziramaga, changga va harorat o'zgarishlariga bardosh berishi kerak, ichkilari esa — Toshkent va viloyat markazlarining biznes-markazlari va savdo majmualarining zich radioefir sharoitida ishlashi kerak. SAT Solutions MikroTik modellarini uskuna faqat pasport raqamlariga emas, balki ob'ektdagi haqiqiy ekspluatatsiya sharoitlariga mos keladigan qilib tanlaydi va rasmiy ravishda kafolat bilan yetkazadi.

## Qanday tanlash kerak

- **Chastota diapazonlari:** ikki diapazonli nuqtalar (2,4 va 5 GHz) moslashuvchanlik beradi — 2,4 GHz masofa va moslik uchun, 5 GHz tezlik va efirni bo'shatish uchun. Taqdim etilgan MikroTik modellarining ko'pchiligi ikkala diapazonda ishlaydi.
- **Joylashtirish turi:** ichki shift nuqtalari (cAP seriyasi) ofislar va xonalar uchun mos, himoyalangan korpusli ijro (wAP seriyasi, masalan RBwAPG-5HacD2HnD) ko'cha, perimetr va isitilmaydigan zonalarga mo'ljallangan.
- **PoE ta'minoti:** PoE ni qo'llab-quvvatlaydigan nuqtalar montajni osonlashtiradi — ta'minot va ma'lumotlar bitta kabel orqali boradi, shift yonida rozetka kerak emas. Bu o'rnatishni tezlashtiradi va o'tkazish xarajatlarini kamaytiradi.
- **Foydalanuvchilar zichligi va maydon:** katta maydonlar va gavjum zonalar uchun bitta kuchli nuqta emas, balki uzluksiz rouming bilan bir nechta nuqtani rejalashtiring — bir tekis qamrov "uzoqqa otish"dan muhimroq.
- **Markazlashtirilgan boshqaruv:** MikroTik uskunasi RouterOS va CAPsMAN kontrolleri bilan birgalikda ishlaydi, bu barcha nuqtalarni yagona konsoldan boshqarish, sozlamalar va yangilanishlarni sinxronlashtirish imkonini beradi.
- **Antenna konfiguratsiyasi:** kuchaytirish va yo'nalganlik diagrammasini hisobga oling — XL seriyali modellar (masalan RBcAPGi-5acD2nD-XL) katta zonani kamroq qurilma soni bilan qamrab olish kerak bo'lgan joyda kengaytirilgan qamrov beradi.

## Qo'llanilish sohalari

- **Ofislar va biznes-markazlar:** korporativ va mehmon Wi-Fi, kabinetlar va qavatlar o'rtasida uzluksiz rouming, xodimlar va tashrif buyuruvchilar uchun tarmoqlarni ajratish.
- **Savdo va HoReCa:** do'konlar, savdo markazlari, kafe va restoranlar — tashrif buyuruvchilar yuqori zichligidagi zallarda barqaror qamrov va kassa uskunasining ishlashi.
- **Ishlab chiqarish va omborlar:** sexlar va ombor zonalarini qamrab olish, ma'lumot yig'ish terminallarini ulash, real vaqtda logistika va hisobni qo'llab-quvvatlash.
- **Turar-joy majmualari va apart-mehmonxonalar:** hollar, parkinglar va umumiy zonalardagi Wi-Fi, domofoniya va turar-joy majmuasi xavfsizlik tizimlarini ulash.

- **Maxsus ob'ektlar va perimetr:** korxonalar hududi, KPP, avtoturargohlar va uzoq maydonlar uchun og'ir iqlim sharoitlarida ishlaydigan ko'cha nuqtalari.

## FAQ

SAT Solutions radiorejalashtirishni o'tkazadi va ob'ektingiz uchun nuqtalar sonini hamda joylashuvini aniq hisoblaydi.

Q: Ko'chadagi kirish nuqtasi O'zbekiston jaziramasiga bardosh beradimi?

A: Ha, himoyalangan korpusdagi modellar, masalan MikroTik wAP ac (RBwAPG-5HacD2HnD), xona tashqarisida ekspluatatsiyaga mo'ljallangan va yuqori yozgi haroratlar, chang va o'zgarishlarga bardosh beradi. Biz ob'ektda joylashtirishning aniq sharoitlariga qarab ko'cha ijrosini tanlaymiz.

Q: Barcha kirish nuqtalarini markazlashgan holda boshqarish mumkinmi?

A: Ha, MikroTik uskunasi RouterOS ostida ishlaydi va barcha nuqtalarni yagona konsoldan sozlash, yangilash va nazorat qilish imkonini beruvchi CAPsMAN kontrollerini qo'llab-quvvatlaydi. Bu ayniqsa filiallari bo'lgan taqsimlangan tarmoqlar uchun qulay. SAT Solutions sozlashni bajaradi va tarmoqni boshqariladigan holatda topshiradi.

Q: SAT Solutions faqat Toshkentda emas, viloyatlarda ham montaj qiladimi?

A: Ha, biz simsiz tarmoqlarni yetkazib berish, montaj va ishga tushirishni O'zbekiston bo'ylab, jumladan viloyat markazlari va uzoq maydonlarda bajaramiz. Ishlar hajmi loyiha bosqichida kelishiladi. Ob'ektingizni muhokama qilish uchun menejerlar bilan bog'laning.
mikrotik-wifi.en:
Wi-Fi access points are active network equipment that creates a wireless coverage zone and connects laptops, smartphones, IP cameras, POS terminals and other devices to the wired infrastructure. Unlike consumer routers, professional access points are designed for the simultaneous operation of dozens and hundreds of clients, stably hold the load throughout the entire working day and integrate into a single managed network. You can buy Wi-Fi access points in Tashkent for a specific facility — from a small office to a distributed enterprise with branches — through the SAT Solutions catalog, which brings together MikroTik equipment for indoor and outdoor scenarios.

The wireless network has long ceased to be a secondary service: the access control system, video surveillance, warehouse logistics, guest Wi-Fi and corporate applications all run on it. A properly selected access point determines whether the connection will be stable during peak load hours, whether the network will withstand the roaming of employees between floors, and whether "dead zones" will appear where they are unacceptable. Therefore the choice of equipment is not the purchase of a box, but a design task: it is necessary to take into account the area, user density, wall materials and the nature of the traffic.

In the conditions of Uzbekistan, local specifics and climate are added to this. Outdoor and semi-outdoor access points must withstand summer heat of up to +45 °C, dust and temperature fluctuations, while indoor ones must operate in the dense radio environment of the business centers and shopping complexes of Tashkent and regional centers. SAT Solutions selects MikroTik models so that the equipment matches the actual operating conditions at the facility, and not only the datasheet figures, and it is supplied officially with a warranty.

## How to choose

- **Wi-Fi standard:** determine whether Wi-Fi 5 (802.11ac) is sufficient for current tasks or whether a margin for the future is needed. The catalog features both CAP AC models and the more productive CAP AX with support for the new standard for high client density.
- **Frequency bands:** dual-band points (2.4 and 5 GHz) provide flexibility — 2.4 GHz for range and compatibility, 5 GHz for speed and offloading the airwaves. Most of the featured MikroTik models operate in both bands.
- **Placement type:** indoor ceiling points (the cAP series) are suitable for offices and rooms, while the design with a protected enclosure (the wAP series, for example RBwAPG-5HacD2HnD) is intended for outdoors, the perimeter and unheated zones.
- **PoE power:** points with PoE support simplify installation — power and data go over a single cable, and no outlet is needed at the ceiling. This speeds up installation and reduces cabling costs.
- **User density and area:** for large areas and crowded zones plan several points with seamless roaming, rather than one powerful one — even coverage is more important than "long range".
- **Centralized management:** MikroTik equipment works in conjunction with RouterOS and the CAPsMAN controller, which makes it possible to manage all points from a single console, synchronize settings and updates.
- **Antenna configuration:** take into account the gain and radiation pattern — XL series models (for example RBcAPGi-5acD2nD-XL) provide extended coverage where it is necessary to cover a large zone with fewer devices.

## Applications

- **Offices and business centers:** corporate and guest Wi-Fi, seamless roaming between rooms and floors, separation of networks for employees and visitors.
- **Trade and HoReCa:** stores, shopping centers, cafes and restaurants — stable coverage in halls with high visitor density and operation of cash register equipment.
- **Production and warehouses:** coverage of workshops and warehouse zones, connection of data collection terminals, support of logistics and real-time accounting.
- **Residential complexes and apart-hotels:** Wi-Fi in lobbies, parking lots and common areas, connection of door-entry systems and residential complex security systems.
- **Government institutions and education:** schools, universities, clinics and administrative buildings, where a managed and segmented network is required for a large number of users.
- **Special facilities and perimeter:** outdoor points for enterprise territories, checkpoints, parking lots and remote sites, operating in harsh climatic conditions.

## Brands and models in the catalog

- **MikroTik cAP ac (RBcAPGi-5acD2nD):** an indoor dual-band access point with Wi-Fi 5 support, optimal for offices and rooms with ceiling mounting and PoE.
- **MikroTik cAP AX (RBCAPGI-5ACD2ND, CAP AX):** a model with support for the new Wi-Fi standard for high-client-density scenarios and increased throughput.
- **MikroTik cAP XL ac (RBcAPGi-5acD2nD-XL):** a version with a reinforced antenna path for an extended coverage zone, when it is necessary to cover a large area with fewer points.
- **MikroTik wAP ac (RBwAPG-5HacD2HnD):** a dual-band point in a protected enclosure for outdoor and semi-outdoor placement, the perimeter and unheated rooms.
- **Unified RouterOS / CAPsMAN ecosystem:** all MikroTik models are managed centrally, which simplifies the deployment and maintenance of a distributed wireless network.

## FAQ

Q: How does a professional MikroTik access point differ from a home router?

A: An access point is designed for the simultaneous operation of many clients and continuous load, supports centralized management via CAPsMAN and PoE power. A home router cannot handle such tasks and quickly loses stability. For offices and commercial facilities in Tashkent we recommend precisely professional equipment.

Q: How many access points are needed for an office or a floor?

A: This depends on the area, the density of employees, the wall materials and the nature of the traffic. One powerful point will not replace a well-arranged network of several devices with seamless roaming. SAT Solutions carries out radio planning and precisely calculates the number and location of points for your facility.

Q: Will an outdoor access point withstand the heat of Uzbekistan?

A: Yes, models in a protected enclosure, for example MikroTik wAP ac (RBwAPG-5HacD2HnD), are designed for operation outdoors and withstand high summer temperatures, dust and fluctuations. We select the outdoor design for the specific placement conditions at the facility.

Q: Can all access points be managed centrally?

A: Yes, MikroTik equipment runs under RouterOS and supports the CAPsMAN controller, which makes it possible to configure, update and control all points from a single console. This is especially convenient for distributed networks with branches. SAT Solutions performs the setup and hands over the network in a managed form.

Q: Does SAT Solutions do installation in the regions, and not only in Tashkent?

A: Yes, we carry out the supply, installation and commissioning of wireless networks throughout Uzbekistan, including regional centers and remote sites. The scope of work is agreed at the project stage. Contact the managers to discuss your facility.

witek-optical.uz:
Optik kommutatorlar — bu mis va optik infratuzilma afzalliklarini birlashtiradigan tarmoq uskunasi: bunday qurilmalarga ham oddiy o'ralgan juftlik RJ-45 liniyalari, ham magistral optik tola kanallari SFP-portlar yoki o'rnatilgan optik interfeyslar orqali ulanadi. Optika tufayli signal mis uchun mavjud bo'lmagan masofalarga tezlik yo'qolmasdan va elektromagnit shovqinlarga sezgirliksiz uzatiladi — aynan shuning uchun bunday kommutatorlar taqsimlangan videokuzatuv, kirishni boshqarish tizimi va korporativ tarmoqlarni qurishda asosiy bo'g'inga aylandi. Toshkentda optik kommutatorlarni ob'ektning aniq topologiyasiga tanlash va rasmiy kafolat bilan SAT Solutions katalogi orqali sotib olish mumkin.

Optik kommutatorning asosiy vazifasi — mis kabel endi ishlamaydigan joyda tarmoqning uzoq tugunlarini yagona tizimga bog'lash. Standart o'ralgan juftlikli Ethernet segmenti taxminan yuz metr bilan cheklangan, haqiqiy ob'ektlarda esa kameralar, kirish nuqtalari va uzoq shkaflar tarmoq yadrosidan ko'pincha yuzlab metr va hatto kilometr masofada joylashadi. Optik liniya bu cheklovni olib tashlaydi, bir qator modellardagi PoE funksiyasi esa oxirgi qurilmalarga — IP-kameralar, domofonlar, Wi-Fi nuqtalari — bir kabel orqali, alohida quvvat liniyalarini o'tkazmasdan bir vaqtning o'zida ma'lumot va ta'minot uzatish imkonini beradi.

O'zbekiston sharoitida optika ayniqsa hududiy uzun ob'ektlarda qadrli: ishlab chiqarish maydonlari, logistika majmualari, turar-joy kvartallari va qo'riqlanadigan perimetrlarda, bu yerda binolar o'rtasidagi masofalar katta, elektromagnit muhit esa murakkab. Optik tola kuch uskunasidan va momaqaldiroq razryadlaridan induksiyaga chalinmaydi, to'g'ri loyihalashtirilgan optik magistral esa o'nlab yillar xizmat qiladi. SAT Solutions kommutatorlarni kerakli masofa, portlar soni va PoE byudjetiga qarab tanlashga, tarmoqni loyihalashtirishga va uni Toshkent hamda viloyatlarda kalit topshirish sharti bilan topshirishga yordam beradi.

## Qanday tanlash kerak

- **Optik portlar turi va soni:** tugunga qancha optik liniya kirishi va qanday turdagi ulagichlar ishlatilishini (SC, LC, o'rnatilgan qabul-uzatgich) aniqlang. Masalan, 1A1B indeksli Wi-Tek WK-PCES seriyasi to'g'ri/teskari turdagi bir tolali liniyalarga, WK-CES314-4A4B esa — bir nechta optik kanalga birdaniga mo'ljallangan.
- **Mis portlar soni:** har bir tugun uchun oxirgi qurilmalar — kameralar, kirish nuqtalari, ish o'rinlari sonini hisoblang. 6, 10 yoki 14 portli model tarmoqni rivojlantirish uchun 15-20% zaxira bilan tanlanadi.
- **PoE qo'llab-quvvatlash va byudjet:** agar kommutator IP-kameralar yoki Wi-Fi nuqtalarini ta'minlasa, standartni (PoE/PoE+) va umumiy quvvatni tekshiring. Byudjet faqat bo'sh turishda emas, balki cho'qqi yukda barcha qurilmalarga yetishi muhim.
- **Optik liniya masofasi:** bir rejimli tola ostida trassa uzunligi, payvandlar va krosslar sonini hisobga olgan holda optik byudjet bo'yicha zaxira qo'ying. Turli masofalar uchun tegishli qabul-uzatgichlar tanlanadi.
- **Boshqarish imkoniyati:** oddiy perimetrlar uchun boshqarilmaydigan modellar yetarli, trafikni segmentlash, VLAN va videooqimlarni ustuvorlashtirish uchun esa boshqariladigan kommutator kerak. Buni loyiha bosqichida aniqlab oling.
- **Ekspluatatsiya sharoitlari:** isitilmaydigan shkaflarda, ko'chada yoki sexlarda joylashtirishda harorat ish diapazonini hisobga oling — O'zbekistonda uskuna yozda ekstremal qiymatlargacha qiziydi, shuning uchun shkaf ventilyatsiyasi va issiqlik zaxirasi muhim.
- **Liniya himoyasi va momaqaldiroqdan himoya:** tashqi trassalarda va binolararo liniyalarda ortiqcha kuchlanishdan himoya qilish qurilmalarini nazarda tuting, toki bitta momaqaldiroq razryadi uskuna zanjirini ishdan chiqarmasin.

## Qo'llanilish sohalari

- **Katta hududlardagi videokuzatuv tizimlari:** kameralar server xonasidan yuzlab metr masofada joylashgan zavodlar, omborlar, avtoturargohlar va qo'riqlanadigan perimetrlar.
- **Turar-joy majmualari va mahallalar:** uylar, kirish yo'llari va markaziy tugun o'rtasidagi aloqa, domofonlar va kameralarni PoE orqali ta'minlash.
- **Savdo va biznes-markazlar:** qavatlar va korpuslarni yagona tarmoqqa birlashtirish, kassalar, kameralar va Wi-Fi kirish nuqtalarini ulash.
- **Ishlab chiqarish korxonalari:** dastgohlar va kuch uskunasidan kuchli elektromagnit shovqinlar sharoitida ishonchli aloqa.
- **Davlat muassasalari va ta'lim ob'ektlari:** korpuslar bo'yicha taqsimlangan infratuzilmaga ega maktablar, kasalxonalar, ma'muriy binolar.
- **Maxsus ob'ektlar va infratuzilma:** energetika, transport tugunlari, uzoq qo'riqlash postlari va katta masofali perimetr tizimlari.

## Katalogdagi brendlar va modellar

- **Wi-Tek WK-PCES306-1A1B-H** — bir tolali optik liniyaga ega ixcham PoE optik kommutator, uzoq tugunlarda kichik kamera guruhlarini ulash uchun qulay.
- **Wi-Tek WK-PCES310-1A1B-H** — yanada to'yingan videokuzatuv tugunlari va kirish nuqtalari uchun ko'paytirilgan mis portlar soniga ega PoE optik kommutator.
- **Wi-Tek WK-CES314-4A4B** — bir nechta optik kanalga (4A4B format) ega CES seriyali optik kommutator, yirik taqsimlangan tarmoqlarda liniyalarni agregatsiya qilish uchun mos.
- **Wi-Tek PCES va CES seriyalari** umuman optik magistrallar, mis portlar va PoE bo'yicha ta'minot uyg'unligi talab qilinadigan videokuzatuv va tarmoq tizimlarini qurishga yo'naltirilgan.

## FAQ

Q: Optik kommutator oddiysidan nimasi bilan farq qiladi?
A: Optik kommutatorda standart mis RJ-45 portlaridan tashqari optik tolani ulash uchun optik interfeyslar bor. Bu ma'lumotni tezlik yo'qolmasdan va shovqinlarga sezgirliksiz kilometrlarga uzatish imkonini beradi — buni oddiy mis kommutator ta'minlay olmaydi. O'zbekistondagi katta ob'ektlarda optikasiz uzoq tugunlarni bog'lash deyarli mumkin emas.

Q: Optik kommutatorda PoE kerakmi?
A: PoE agar kommutator oxirgi qurilmalarni — IP-kameralar, Wi-Fi nuqtalari, domofonlar — ma'lumotlar bilan bitta kabel orqali ta'minlasa kerak. Bu alohida quvvat liniyalarini o'tkazishdan xalos qiladi va montajni osonlashtiradi. SAT Solutions katalogida PoE ni qo'llab-quvvatlaydigan Wi-Tek modellari bor, bizning muhandislarimiz zarur quvvat byudjetini hisoblashda yordam beradi.

Q: Optika bo'yicha signalni qancha masofaga uzatish mumkin?
A: Masofa tola turiga, qabul-uzatgichga va liniyaning optik byudjetiga bog'liq — amaliyotda bu yuzlab metrdan o'nlab kilometrgacha. Loyihalashda biz zaxira qo'yish uchun trassa uzunligi, payvandlar va krosslar sonini hisobga olamiz. SAT Solutions mutaxassislari ob'ektingizning aniq masofasi ostida uskuna tanlaydi.

Q: Bunday kommutatorlar O'zbekistonning jazirama iqlimi uchun mos keladimi?
A: Ha, lekin ko'cha va isitilmaydigan shkaflarga joylashtirishda harorat ish diapazonini hisobga olish va ventilyatsiyani ta'minlash muhim, chunki yozda uskuna ekstremal qiymatlargacha qizishi mumkin. Biz kerakli issiqlik zaxirasiga ega modellarni tanlaymiz va shkaflarni sovutishni hisobga olib loyihalashtiramiz. Bu ayniqsa Toshkent va janubiy viloyatlardagi ob'ektlar uchun dolzarb.

Q: Siz tarmoqni kalit topshirish sharti bilan loyihalashtirib, montaj qila olasizmi?
A: Ha, SAT Solutions to'liq siklni bajaradi — ob'ektni tekshirish va loyihalashdan optika o'tkazish, tolani payvandlash, kommutatorlarni sozlash va tizimni topshirishgacha. Biz O'zbekiston bo'ylab ishlaymiz va kafolatli hamda servis kuzatuvini o'z zimmamizga olamiz. Ariza qoldirish kifoya, menejer mutaxassisning chiqishini kelishadi.
witek-optical.en:
Optical switches are network equipment that combines the advantages of copper and optical infrastructure: both ordinary twisted-pair RJ45 lines and backbone fiber-optic channels via SFP ports or built-in optical interfaces connect to such devices. Thanks to optics, the signal is transmitted over distances inaccessible to copper, without loss of speed and without sensitivity to electromagnetic interference — which is precisely why such switches have become a basic link in building distributed video surveillance systems, ACS and corporate networks. You can buy optical switches in Tashkent with selection for the specific facility topology and an official warranty through the SAT Solutions catalog.

The main task of an optical switch is to link remote network nodes into a single system where copper cable no longer works. A standard twisted-pair Ethernet segment is limited to about a hundred meters, while at real facilities cameras, access points and remote cabinets are often located hundreds of meters and even kilometers from the network core. An optical line removes this limitation, and the PoE function on a number of models makes it possible to simultaneously transmit data and power to end devices — IP cameras, intercoms, Wi-Fi points — over a single cable, without laying separate power lines.

For the conditions of Uzbekistan, optics is especially valuable at geographically extended facilities: production sites, logistics complexes, residential neighborhoods and guarded perimeters, where the distances between buildings are large and the electromagnetic environment is complex. Optical fiber is not subject to pickup from power equipment and lightning discharges, and a properly designed optical backbone lasts for decades. SAT Solutions helps select switches for the required range, number of ports and PoE budget, design the network and hand it over turnkey in Tashkent and the regions.

## How to choose

- **Type and number of optical ports:** determine how many optical lines enter the node and what type of connectors are used (SC, LC, built-in transceiver). For example, the Wi-Tek WK-PCES series with the 1A1B index is designed for single-fiber forward/reverse lines, while the WK-CES314-4A4B is designed for several optical channels at once.
- **Number of copper ports:** for each node count the number of end devices — cameras, access points, workstations. A 6-, 10- or 14-port model is chosen with a 15-20% margin for network growth.
- **PoE support and budget:** if the switch powers IP cameras or Wi-Fi points, check the standard (PoE/PoE+) and the total power. It is important that the budget is enough for all devices under peak load, and not only at idle.
- **Optical line range:** for single-mode fiber allow a margin in the optical budget taking into account the length of the route, the number of splices and patch panels. Appropriate transceivers are selected for different distances.
- **Manageability:** for simple perimeters unmanaged models are sufficient, while for traffic segmentation, VLAN and prioritization of video streams a managed switch is needed. Decide on this at the design stage.
- **Operating conditions:** when placing in unheated cabinets, outdoors or in workshops, take into account the operating temperature range — in Uzbekistan the equipment heats up to extreme values in summer, so cabinet ventilation and a thermal margin are important.
- **Line protection and lightning protection:** on outdoor routes and inter-building lines provide for surge protection devices, so that a single lightning discharge does not disable a chain of equipment.

## Applications

- **Video surveillance systems over large areas:** factories, warehouses, parking lots and guarded perimeters, where cameras are hundreds of meters from the server room.
- **Residential complexes and neighborhoods:** communication between houses, entrances and the central node, powering intercoms and cameras over PoE.
- **Retail and business centers:** uniting floors and buildings into a single network, connecting cash registers, cameras and Wi-Fi access points.
- **Production enterprises:** reliable communication under conditions of strong electromagnetic interference from machine tools and power equipment.
- **Government institutions and educational facilities:** schools, hospitals, administrative buildings with infrastructure distributed across buildings.
- **Special facilities and infrastructure:** energy, transport hubs, remote guard posts and perimeter systems with large distances.

## Brands and models in the catalog

- **Wi-Tek WK-PCES306-1A1B-H** — a compact PoE optical switch with a single-fiber optical line, convenient for connecting small groups of cameras at remote nodes.
- **Wi-Tek WK-PCES310-1A1B-H** — a PoE optical switch with an increased number of copper ports for more saturated video surveillance nodes and access points.
- **Wi-Tek WK-CES314-4A4B** — a CES series optical switch with several optical channels (4A4B format), suitable for aggregating lines in large distributed networks.
- **The Wi-Tek PCES and CES series** are generally oriented toward building video surveillance systems and networks that require a combination of optical backbones, copper ports and PoE power.

## FAQ

Q: How does an optical switch differ from an ordinary one?
A: In addition to standard copper RJ45 ports, an optical switch has optical interfaces for connecting fiber optics. This makes it possible to transmit data over kilometers without loss of speed and without sensitivity to interference — something an ordinary copper switch cannot provide. At large facilities in Uzbekistan it is practically impossible to link remote nodes without optics.

Q: Is PoE needed on an optical switch?
A: PoE is needed if the switch powers end devices — IP cameras, Wi-Fi points, intercoms — over a single cable with data. This eliminates the laying of separate power lines and simplifies installation. The SAT Solutions catalog features Wi-Tek models with PoE support, and our engineers will help calculate the required power budget.

Q: Over what distance can a signal be transmitted over optics?
A: The range depends on the type of fiber, the transceiver and the optical budget of the line — in practice this is from hundreds of meters to tens of kilometers. When designing, we take into account the length of the route, the number of splices and patch panels to allow a margin. SAT Solutions specialists select equipment for the specific distance of your facility.

Q: Are such switches suitable for the hot climate of Uzbekistan?
A: Yes, but when placing them in outdoor and unheated cabinets it is important to take into account the operating temperature range and to ensure ventilation, since in summer the equipment can heat up to extreme values. We select models with the necessary thermal margin and design cabinets taking cooling into account. This is especially relevant for facilities in Tashkent and the southern regions.

Q: Can you design and install the network turnkey?
A: Yes, SAT Solutions performs a full cycle — from facility survey and design to laying optics, splicing fiber, configuring switches and handing over the system. We work throughout Uzbekistan and take on warranty and service support. Simply submit a request, and a manager will arrange a specialist visit.
