Tarmoq kameralari — zamonaviy videokuzatuv tizimlarining asosi. Analog yechimlardan farqli o'laroq, IP-kameralar videooqimni lokal tarmoq yoki internet orqali raqamli formatda uzatadi, bu esa yuqori aniqlik, masshtablashning moslashuvchanligini va istalgan qurilmadan masofadan kirish imkonini ta'minlaydi. Bugungi kunda Toshkentda tarmoq kameralarini sotib olish qiyin emas, biroq muayyan obyektga model to'g'ri tanlash ekspert bilimini talab qiladi: aniqlik, obyektiv turi, yoritilganlik sharoitlari, masofa va yozib olish formatini hisobga olish kerak.

SAT Solutions katalogi ishonchli ishlab chiqaruvchilarning 52 ta tarmoq kamerasi modelini o'z ichiga oladi. Bu yerda oddiy qo'riqlash vazifalari uchun byudjetli silindrik va gumbazli kameralar, shuningdek motorli zum, o'rnatilgan sun'iy intellekt tahlili, 4G qo'llab-quvvatlashi va kengaytirilgan qo'llanilish stsenariylariga ega professional modellar taqdim etilgan. Bunday xilma-xillik kichik ofis uchun ham, yirik ishlab chiqarish majmuasi uchun ham optimal yechim tanlash imkonini beradi.

Muayyan modelni tanlash bir necha omilga bog'liq: nazorat zonasi maydoni, yoritilganlik darajasi, tasvir sifatiga qo'yiladigan talablar, tungi kuzatuv zarurati va mavjud IT-infratuzilma bilan integratsiya. SAT Solutions mutaxassislari butun O'zbekiston bo'ylab mijozlarga videokuzatuv tizimini malakali loyihalashda va keraksiz funksiyalar uchun ortiqcha to'lovsiz real vazifalarni yopadigan uskunani tanlashda yordam beradi.

## Qanday tanlash kerak

- Matritsa aniqligi: perimetrni umumiy kuzatish uchun 2 MP yetarli, yuzlarni aniqlash yoki davlat raqamlarini o'qish uchun 4 dan 8 MP gacha kerak. Aniqlik qanchalik yuqori bo'lsa, tarmoq va saqlash omboriga yuk shunchalik ko'p bo'ladi.
- Korpus turi: silindrik kameralar ochiq ko'chalar va uzun koridorlar uchun ko'proq mos keladi, gumbazli kameralar — keng ko'rish burchagi va shiftga sezdirmasdan o'rnatiladigan xonalar uchun. Korpus foydalanish sharoitlariga (IP himoya klassi) mos bo'lishi kerak.
- Obyektiv va ko'rish burchagi: fiksatsiyalangan obyektiv oddiyroq va arzonroq, motorli varifokal (masalan, 2,7–13,5 mm yoki kengroq diapazonli) kameraga ko'tarilmasdan ko'rish burchagi va fokusni masofadan sozlash imkonini beradi.
- Tungi ko'rish: aksariyat zamonaviy IP-kameralar IQ-yorug'lik bilan jihozlangan. E'lon qilingan masofa va obyekt yaqinlashganda yoritib yuborishning oldini oladigan aqlli yoritish texnologiyasi mavjudligiga e'tibor bering.
- Intellektual funksiyalar: modellarning bir qismi bortda videotahlilni qo'llab-quvvatlaydi — harakatni aniqlash, yuzlarni tanib olish, odamlarni sanash, perimetr bo'yicha trevoga. Bu videoregistratorga yukni kamaytiradi va hodisalarga reaktsiyani tezlashtiradi.
- Ulanish usuli: aksariyat kameralar PoE quvvatlanishi bilan Ethernet kabeli orqali ulanadi, biroq kabel infratuzilmasi yo'q obyektlar uchun 4G-tarmoqni qo'llab-quvvatlaydigan modellar dolzarb — ular SIM-karta bilan avtonom ishlaydi.
- Videoregistrator bilan moslik: tanlangan kameralar ONVIF protokolini qo'llab-quvvatlashiga yoki sizning NVR bilan bevosita mos kelishiga ishonch hosil qiling. Bu yagona boshqaruv tizimi va videotahlilning to'g'ri ishlashi uchun muhim.

## Qo'llanilish sohalari

- Ofislar va biznes-markazlar: kirish guruhlari, koridorlar, muzokara xonalari, server xonalari va avtoturargohlarni nazorat qilish. Gumbazli IP-kameralar interyerga sezdirmasdan mos tushadi va xonalarni to'liq qamrab oladi.
- Savdo obyektlari: supermarketlar, savdo markazlari va do'konlar tarmoq kameralaridan o'g'irliklarni oldini olish, kassa zonalarini nazorat qilish va xaridorlar oqimini tahlil qilish uchun foydalanadi.
- Ishlab chiqarish korxonalari va omborlar: ishlab chiqarishdagi videokuzatuv perimetrni qo'riqlash, texnologik jarayonlarni nazorat qilish va sexlarda xavfsizlik texnikasiga rioya etilishi vazifalarini hal qiladi.
- Turar-joy majmualari va xususiy uylar: kirish, avtoturargoh, uy oldi hududi va podyezdlarni qo'riqlash. 4G-modulli kameralar simsiz tarmoqsiz shahar tashqarisidagi obyektlar uchun qulay.
- Davlat va ijtimoiy obyektlar: maktablar, kasalxonalar, ma'muriy binolar — xavfsizlikni ta'minlash va sodir bo'layotgan voqealarni keyingi hodisalarni tekshirish uchun hujjatlashtirish talab qilinadigan har qanday joy.
- Transport infratuzilmasi: yo'llar, avtoturargohlar, qo'riqlanadigan hududlarga kirish joylari — yuqori aniqlik va keng dinamik diapazonli kameralar transport vositalarini kunning istalgan vaqtida qayd etadi.

## Katalogdagi brendlar va modellar

- Dahua — ushbu toifadagi asosiy va eng keng taqdim etilgan brend. IPC-HFW va IPC-HDW liniyalari butun vazifalar spektrini qamrab oladi: oddiy qo'riqlash uchun HFW1230 seriyali byudjetli 2 MP kameralardan tortib motorli obyektiv, Smart Dual Light va kengaytirilgan videotahlil algoritmlariga ega HFW5442 seriyali professional 8 MP modellargacha.
- Dahua IPC-HFW seriyali silindrik modellari devor yoki kronshteynga o'rnatish uchun mo'ljallangan. ZS va ZHE indeksli modellar varifokal motorli obyektiv bilan jihozlangan, bu balandlikda montaj qilingandan keyin ko'rish burchagini sozlashni osonlashtiradi.
- IPC-HDW seriyali gumbazli modellar shiftga yoki sirtga o'rnatiladi. Ixcham korpus, vandalga qarshi himoya va keng ko'rish burchagi ularni ko'p tashrif buyuruvchi xonalar uchun afzal tanlovga aylantiradi.
- 4G qo'llab-quvvatlashiga ega modellar (IPC-HFW3441DG-AS-4G seriyasi) kabel ulanishisiz obyektlar uchun mo'ljallangan: qurilish maydonchalari, vaqtinchalik qo'riqlash postlari, O'zbekistondagi uzoq obyektlar.
- Dahua PTS seriyali panoramik va multisensorli IP-kameralar bitta qurilma bilan katta maydonni qamrab oladi, nazorat zonasini yo'qotmasdan o'rnatish nuqtalari sonini kamaytiradi.

## FAQ

Q: Ofis yoki do'kon uchun qaysi aniqlikni tanlash kerak?
A: Aksariyat tijorat obyektlari uchun 4 MP yetarli — bu tasvir detallashuvi va tarmoqqa yuk o'rtasidagi yaxshi muvozanat. Agar yuzlarni aniqlash yoki mayda tafsilotlarni o'qish kerak bo'lsa, 8 MP ni tanlang.

Q: Tarmoq kameralari kabelsiz ishlashi mumkinmi?
A: Ha, bir qator modellar SIM-karta orqali 4G ulanishini qo'llab-quvvatlaydi. Bu qurilish maydonchalari, vaqtinchalik obyektlar yoki kabel yotqizish maqsadga muvofiq bo'lmagan shahar tashqarisidagi hududlar uchun qulay.

Q: Tarmoq IP-kameralari turli videoregistratorlar bilan qanday mos keladi?
A: Katalogdagi barcha IP-kameralar ochiq ONVIF protokolini qo'llab-quvvatlaydi, bu esa aksariyat NVR bilan asosiy moslikni ta'minlaydi. Kengaytirilgan funksiyalar — videotahlil, trevoga — uchun bir ishlab chiqaruvchining kameralari va registratorlaridan foydalanish tavsiya etiladi.

Q: Kameralar tunda qo'shimcha yoritishsiz ishlaydimi?
A: Aksariyat modellar past yoritilganlikda avtomatik faollashadigan o'rnatilgan IQ-yorug'lik bilan jihozlangan. Yoritish masofasi modelga bog'liq. Bir qator kameralar tunda rangli tasvir olish uchun ko'rinadigan oq yoritishga ega Smart Dual Light texnologiyasini qo'llab-quvvatlaydi.

Q: Uskuna va montajga kafolat berasizmi?
A: Ha, yetkazib beriladigan uskunaga ishlab chiqaruvchining zavod kafolati amal qiladi. Bajarilgan montaj va ishga tushirish-sozlash ishlariga SAT Solutions o'z kafolatini beradi. Barcha shartlar shartnomada qayd etiladi.
network-cameras.en:
Network cameras are the foundation of modern video surveillance systems. Unlike analog solutions, IP cameras transmit the video stream over a local network or the internet in digital format, which delivers high resolution, flexible scalability, and remote access from any device. Buying network cameras in Tashkent today is straightforward, but selecting the right model for a specific site requires expert knowledge: you need to account for resolution, lens type, lighting conditions, range, and recording format.

The SAT Solutions catalog includes 52 network camera models from proven manufacturers. It features both budget bullet and dome cameras for typical security tasks and professional models with motorized zoom, built-in AI analytics, 4G support, and advanced use scenarios. This variety makes it possible to choose the optimal solution for both a small office and a large industrial complex.

The choice of a specific model depends on several factors: the size of the monitored area, the lighting level, image quality requirements, the need for night vision, and integration with existing IT infrastructure. SAT Solutions specialists help clients across Uzbekistan properly design a video surveillance system and select equipment that addresses real needs without overpaying for unused features.

## How to choose

- Sensor resolution: 2 MP is sufficient for general perimeter monitoring, while 4 to 8 MP is needed for face identification or reading license plates. The higher the resolution, the greater the load on the network and storage.
- Housing type: bullet cameras are better suited for open streets and long corridors, while dome cameras work best in rooms with a wide viewing angle and discreet ceiling mounting. The housing must match the operating conditions (IP protection rating).
- Lens and viewing angle: a fixed lens is simpler and cheaper, while a motorized varifocal lens (for example, with a range of 2.7-13.5 mm or wider) allows you to adjust the viewing angle and focus remotely without accessing the camera.
- Night vision: most modern IP cameras are equipped with IR illumination. Pay attention to the stated range and the presence of smart illumination technology, which prevents overexposure when an object approaches.
- Intelligent functions: some models support onboard video analytics — motion detection, face recognition, people counting, and perimeter alarms. This reduces the load on the recorder and speeds up response to events.
- Connection method: most cameras connect via Ethernet cable with PoE power, but for sites without cable infrastructure, models with 4G support are relevant — they operate autonomously with a SIM card.
- Recorder compatibility: make sure the selected cameras support the ONVIF protocol or are directly compatible with your NVR. This is important for a unified management system and correct operation of video analytics.

## Applications

- Offices and business centers: monitoring entrance groups, corridors, meeting rooms, server rooms, and parking areas. Dome IP cameras blend discreetly into the interior and provide full coverage of the premises.
- Retail sites: supermarkets, shopping centers, and stores use network cameras to prevent theft, monitor checkout areas, and analyze customer flow.
- Industrial enterprises and warehouses: video surveillance at production sites addresses perimeter security, monitoring of technological processes, and compliance with safety regulations in workshops.
- Residential complexes and private homes: securing entrances, parking, the adjacent territory, and hallways. Cameras with a 4G module are convenient for suburban sites without a wired network.
- Government and social facilities: schools, hospitals, administrative buildings — anywhere security must be ensured and events documented for subsequent incident investigation.
- Transport infrastructure: roads, parking lots, entrances to secured areas — high-resolution cameras with a wide dynamic range capture vehicles at any time of day.

## Brands and models in the catalog

- Dahua — the main and most widely represented brand in this category. The IPC-HFW and IPC-HDW lines cover the full range of tasks: from budget 2 MP HFW1230 series cameras for typical security to professional 8 MP HFW5442 series models with a motorized lens, Smart Dual Light, and advanced video analytics algorithms.
- Dahua bullet models in the IPC-HFW series are designed for wall or bracket mounting. Models with the ZS and ZHE index are equipped with a varifocal motorized lens, which simplifies adjusting the viewing angle after mounting at height.
- Dome models in the IPC-HDW series are mounted on the ceiling or surface. A compact housing, vandal resistance, and a wide viewing angle make them the preferred choice for rooms with a large number of visitors.
- Models with 4G support (the IPC-HFW3441DG-AS-4G series) are designed for sites without a cable connection: construction sites, temporary security posts, and remote facilities in Uzbekistan.
- Dahua panoramic and multi-sensor IP cameras in the PTS series provide coverage of a large area with a single device, reducing the number of installation points without loss of the controlled zone.

## FAQ

Q: What resolution should I choose for an office or store?
A: For most commercial sites, 4 MP is sufficient — this is a good balance between image detail and network load. If you need face identification or reading fine details, choose 8 MP.

Q: Can network cameras work without a cable?
A: Yes, a number of models support connection via 4G with a SIM card. This is convenient for construction sites, temporary facilities, or suburban areas where laying a cable is impractical.

Q: How compatible are network IP cameras with different recorders?
A: All IP cameras in the catalog support the open ONVIF protocol, which provides basic compatibility with most NVRs. For advanced functions — video analytics, alarms — it is recommended to use cameras and recorders from the same manufacturer.

Q: Do the cameras work at night without additional lighting?
A: Most models are equipped with built-in IR illumination that activates automatically in low light. The illumination range depends on the model. A number of cameras support Smart Dual Light technology with visible white illumination to obtain a color image at night.

Q: Do you provide a warranty on equipment and installation?
A: Yes, the supplied equipment is covered by the manufacturer's factory warranty. SAT Solutions provides its own warranty on the installation and commissioning work performed. All terms are recorded in the contract.

mikrotik-accessories.uz:
MikroTik aksessuarlari — bu yordamchi uskuna bo'lib, ularsiz tarmoq infratuzilmasining to'liq ishlashi mumkin emas. Gap quvvat bloklari, PoE injektor va splitterlari, montaj modullari, kabel organayzerlari va boshqa komponentlar haqida bormoqda, ular asosiy tarmoq uskunasining to'g'ri o'rnatilishi, quvvatlanishi va himoyasini ta'minlaydi. Toshkentda MikroTik aksessuarlarini sotib olish — bu ayni shu ishlab chiqaruvchining mahsulot liniyasiga mo'ljallangan kafolatlangan mos keladigan buyumlarni olishdir.

Aksessuarlarni malakali tanlash butun tarmoq ishonchliligiga bevosita ta'sir qiladi. Nomos keladigan quvvat bloki yoki sifatsiz PoE-injektor tarmoq qurilmasining o'zi soz bo'lsa ham marshrutizator yoki kirish nuqtasini ishdan chiqarishi mumkin. Shu sababli O'zbekistonda obyektlarni loyihalashda SAT Solutions mutaxassislari doimo faqat asosiy faol uskunani emas, balki yordamchi elementlarning to'liq to'plamini hisobga oladi.

SAT Solutions katalogidagi MikroTik aksessuarlari assortimenti turli stsenariylar uchun pozitsiyalarni qamrab oladi: ixcham ofis inshootlaridan tortib chiqarilgan kirish nuqtalari va ko'cha radiomostlariga ega taqsimlangan obyektlargacha. Muayyan buyumni tanlash asosiy qurilma turi, quvvatlanish sxemasi va montaj sharoitlariga bog'liq — aynan shu sababli aksessuarlarni alohida emas, uskuna bilan komplektda tanlash muhim.

## Qanday tanlash kerak

- Asosiy qurilma bilan moslik. Har bir MikroTik aksessuari muayyan modellar yoki seriyalarga mo'ljallangan. Masalan, PoE injektor muayyan qurilmaning kirish kuchlanishi va quvvatlanish standartiga (passive PoE, 802.3af/at) mos bo'lishi kerak. Sotib olishdan oldin hujjatlar bilan solishtiring.
- Quvvat bloki yoki PoE-injektorning quvvati. "Port boshiga vatt" parametri qurilmaning real iste'molini 20-30% zaxira bilan qoplashi kerak. Ko'cha kirish nuqtalari va radiomostlar uchun quvvatlanish talablari stol usti routerlariga qaraganda yuqoriroq.
- Konstruktiv turi. Ba'zi aksessuarlar stol usti foydalanish uchun, boshqalari — stoykaga yoki DIN-reykaga o'rnatish uchun mo'ljallangan. Muayyan obyekt uchun form-faktorni aniqlang.
- Qizib ketish va ortiqcha yukdan himoya. Ko'cha va sanoat obyektlari uchun kuchlanish sakrashlari va qizib ketishdan himoyaga ega buyumlarni tanlash muhim, ayniqsa yozgi yuqori haroratli o'zbek iqlimi sharoitida.
- Kabel uzunligi va turi. PoE-uzaytirgichlar va konverterlardan foydalanganda kabel segmentining maksimal uzunligini hisobga oling — passiv PoE uchun u, qoida tariqasida, standart Ethernetga qaraganda pastroq.
- Originallik va yetkazib berish manbai. Kontrafakt yoki original bo'lmagan aksessuarlar qimmatbaho tarmoq uskunasini shikastlashi mumkin. Faqat mahsulotga tasdiqlangan hujjatlarga ega vakolatli yetkazib beruvchilardan sotib oling.
- Portlar soni va konfiguratsiyasi. Agar bir necha qurilmani quvvatlantirish kerak bo'lsa, alohida injektorlar to'plami o'rniga ko'pportli PoE-injektorlar yoki PoE bilan kommutatorlarni ko'rib chiqing.

## Qo'llanilish sohalari

- Ofis tarmoqlari. Aksessuarlar biznes-markazlar, ofislar va muzokara xonalarida marshrutizatorlar, kommutatorlar va kirish nuqtalarini montaj qilishda foydalaniladi — to'g'ri quvvatlanish va kabel tarqatishini tashkil etish uchun.
- Ko'cha radiotarmoqlari va kirish nuqtalari. LHG va shunga o'xshash seriyali qurilmalar kommutatsiya tugunidan sezilarli masofalarda ishlashga mo'ljallangan maxsus PoE-injektorlarni talab qiladi.
- Mehmonxonalar, savdo markazlari va jamoat maskanlari. Ko'p sonli kirish nuqtalariga ega tarmoqlangan Wi-Fi-infratuzilma har bir tugunning ishonchli quvvatlanishini talab qiladi — to'g'ri tanlangan aksessuarlarsiz barqaror ishlash mumkin emas.
- Ishlab chiqarish va ombor obyektlari. Kuchaygan elektromagnit shovqinlar va beqaror quvvatlanish sharoitida himoya funksiyalariga ega aksessuarlar uskunaning uzoq muddat xizmat qilishini ta'minlaydi.
- Telekommunikatsiya tugunlari va provayder obyektlari. Montaj modullari, kabel organayzerlari va maxsus quvvat bloklari server va apparat xonalarini professional rasmiylashtirish uchun zarur.

## Katalogdagi brendlar va modellar

- MikroTik — ushbu toifada taqdim etilgan yagona brend, bu qonuniy: aksessuarlar aynan shu ishlab chiqaruvchining uskunasi bilan foydalanish uchun mo'ljallangan. MikroTik o'z mahsulotiga to'liq mos keladigan yordamchi qurilmalarning shaxsiy liniyasini ishlab chiqaradi.
- Katalogda 48POW va GPEN11 seriyali PoE injektorlari taqdim etilgan, ular kirish nuqtalari va ko'cha qurilmalarini alohida quvvat liniyalarini yotqizmasdan Ethernet kabeli orqali quvvatlantirish uchun mo'ljallangan.
- RBGPOE-CON-HP modeli — PoE quvvat konverteri bo'lib, u bir infratuzilma doirasida turli PoE standartlariga ega uskunani ulash imkonini beradi.
- MT48-480095-11DG quvvat bloki stoyka va stol usti uskunasi uchun barqaror kuchlanishni ta'minlaydigan MikroTik rasmiy quvvat manbalari seriyasiga kiradi.
- QMP-LHG aksessuari LHG seriyali qurilmalar — taqsimlangan tarmoqlarda keng qo'llaniladigan ko'cha yo'naltirilgan antennalar va radiomostlarni montaj qilish uchun maxsus ishlab chiqilgan.

## FAQ

Q: Original MikroTik aksessuarlari o'rniga uchinchi tomon quvvat bloklaridan foydalanish mumkinmi?
A: Agar quvvatlanish parametrlari mos kelsa, texnik jihatdan mumkin, biroq original bo'lmagan aksessuarlardan foydalanish beqaror ishlashga yoki uskunaning shikastlanishiga olib kelishi mumkin. Bunday holda qurilmaga kafolat ishlab chiqaruvchi tomonidan bekor qilinishi mumkin.

Q: MikroTik kirish nuqtamga qaysi PoE-injektor mos kelishini qanday aniqlash mumkin?
A: Kirish nuqtasi spetsifikatsiyasida talab qilinadigan kuchlanishni (odatda 24 V passive PoE yoki 48 V 802.3af/at standarti) va maksimal tok iste'molini aniqlash kerak. Shundan so'ng mos parametrlarga ega injektor tanlanadi. SAT Solutions mutaxassislari mos aksessuarni tanlashda yordam beradi.

Q: Toshkentda MikroTik aksessuarlari qancha turadi va narx nimaga bog'liq?
A: Narx aksessuar turi, uning quvvati va funksionalligiga bog'liq. Boshlang'ich darajali PoE-injektorlar arzon narxda mavjud, maxsus montaj to'plamlari va ko'pportli yechimlar qimmatroq turadi. Dolzarb narxlarni SAT Solutions menejerlaridan aniqlang.

Q: Aksessuarlar montaji tarmoq inshootining narxiga kiradimi?
A: Qoida tariqasida, butun uskuna majmuasining montaji — yordamchi aksessuarlar bilan birga — ishlarning umumiy narxiga kiritiladi. Smeta tuzishda bu alohida kelishib olinadi.

Q: SAT Solutions MikroTik aksessuarlarini O'zbekiston bo'ylab yetkazib beradimi?
A: Ha, kompaniya uskunani O'zbekiston hududlariga yetkazib berishni tashkil etadi. Yetkazib berish muddatlari va shartlari hajm va yetkazib berish manziliga qarab buyurtma rasmiylashtirishda muhokama qilinadi.
mikrotik-accessories.en:
MikroTik accessories are the auxiliary equipment without which a network infrastructure cannot fully function. This includes power supplies, PoE injectors and splitters, mounting modules, cable organizers, and other components that ensure the correct installation, powering, and protection of the main network equipment. Buying MikroTik accessories in Tashkent means getting guaranteed compatible products designed specifically for this manufacturer's product line.

Proper selection of accessories directly affects the reliability of the entire network. An unsuitable power supply or a low-quality PoE injector can disable a router or access point even if the network device itself is functional. That is why, when designing sites in Uzbekistan, SAT Solutions specialists always account for the complete set of auxiliary elements, not just the main active equipment.

The range of MikroTik accessories in the SAT Solutions catalog covers items for various scenarios: from compact office installations to distributed sites with remote access points and outdoor radio bridges. The choice of a specific product depends on the type of main device, the power scheme, and the installation conditions — which is exactly why it is important to select accessories together with the equipment rather than separately.

## How to choose

- Compatibility with the main device. Each MikroTik accessory is designed for specific models or series. For example, a PoE injector must match the input voltage and power standard (passive PoE, 802.3af/at) of the specific device. Check the documentation before purchasing.
- Power of the power supply or PoE injector. The "watts per port" parameter should cover the actual consumption of the device with a 20-30% reserve. Outdoor access points and radio bridges have higher power requirements than desktop routers.
- Form factor type. Some accessories are intended for desktop use, others for rack or DIN-rail mounting. Clarify the form factor for the specific site.
- Protection against overheating and overload. For outdoor and industrial sites, it is important to choose products with protection against voltage surges and overheating, especially in the Uzbek climate with high summer temperatures.
- Cable length and type. When using PoE extenders and converters, consider the maximum cable segment length — for passive PoE it is usually shorter than for standard Ethernet.
- Authenticity and source of supply. Counterfeit or non-original accessories can damage expensive network equipment. Buy only from authorized suppliers with confirmed product documentation.
- Number of ports and configuration. If you need to power several devices, consider multi-port PoE injectors or switches with PoE instead of a set of single injectors.

## Applications

- Office networks. Accessories are used when installing routers, switches, and access points in business centers, offices, and meeting rooms — for correct powering and cable routing.
- Outdoor radio networks and access points. Devices such as the LHG and similar series require specialized PoE injectors designed to operate at significant distances from the switching node.
- Hotels, shopping centers, and public spaces. An extensive Wi-Fi infrastructure with a large number of access points requires reliable powering of each node — stable operation is impossible without properly selected accessories.
- Industrial and warehouse sites. In conditions of increased electromagnetic interference and unstable power, accessories with protective functions ensure a long service life of the equipment.
- Telecommunication nodes and provider sites. Mounting modules, cable organizers, and specialized power supplies are necessary for professional arrangement of server and equipment rooms.

## Brands and models in the catalog

- MikroTik — the only brand represented in this category, which is logical: the accessories are intended for use specifically with this manufacturer's equipment. MikroTik produces its own line of auxiliary devices that are fully compatible with its products.
- The catalog features PoE injectors in the 48POW and GPEN11 series, designed to power access points and outdoor devices via Ethernet cable without laying separate power lines.
- The RBGPOE-CON-HP model is a PoE power converter that allows connecting equipment with various PoE standards within a single infrastructure.
- The MT48-480095-11DG power supply is part of MikroTik's line of official power sources that provide stable voltage for rack and desktop equipment.
- The QMP-LHG accessory is designed specifically for mounting devices in the LHG series — outdoor directional antennas and radio bridges widely used in distributed networks.

## FAQ

Q: Can third-party power supplies be used instead of original MikroTik accessories?
A: It is technically possible if the power parameters match, however, using non-original accessories can lead to unstable operation or damage to the equipment. The device warranty in this case may be voided by the manufacturer.

Q: How do I determine which PoE injector fits my MikroTik access point?
A: You need to check in the access point specification the required voltage (usually 24 V passive PoE or 48 V 802.3af/at standard) and the maximum current consumption. Then an injector with the corresponding parameters is selected. SAT Solutions specialists will help you choose a compatible accessory.

Q: How much do MikroTik accessories cost in Tashkent and what determines the price?
A: The cost depends on the type of accessory, its power, and functionality. Entry-level PoE injectors are available at a low price, while specialized mounting kits and multi-port solutions cost more. Check current prices with SAT Solutions managers.

Q: Is accessory installation included in the cost of network installation?
A: As a rule, the installation of the entire equipment complex — including auxiliary accessories — is included in the overall cost of the work. This is specified separately when preparing the estimate.

Q: Does SAT Solutions deliver MikroTik accessories across Uzbekistan?
A: Yes, the company arranges the supply of equipment to the regions of Uzbekistan. Delivery times and conditions are discussed when placing the order, depending on the volume and delivery address.

bolid-sirens.uz:
Ovozli xabar beruvchilar (opoveshchateli) — bu yong'in va qo'riqlash signalizatsiyasi tizimlari tarkibida odamlarga trevoga signalini: ovoz, yorug'lik yoki ularning ikkalasi kombinatsiyasi bilan yetkazadigan qurilmalardir. Aynan xabar beruvchi datchik ishga tushishini odam uchun tushunarli ogohlantirishga aylantiradi, xonani tark etishga, xavfga e'tibor qaratishga yoki reaktsiya chaqirishga majbur qiladi. Toshkentda muayyan obyektga tanlash, qabul-nazorat qurilmasi bilan moslikni tekshirish va rasmiy kafolat bilan xabar beruvchilarni sotib olish SAT Solutions katalogi orqali mumkin — biz butun O'zbekiston bo'ylab xavfsizlik tizimlari komponentlarini yetkazib beramiz va montaj qilamiz.

Yong'in signalizatsiyasi va yong'in haqida xabar berish (СОУЭ) tizimlarida xabar beruvchilar — majburiy element bo'lib, ularsiz obyektni nazorat organlari tomonidan qabul qilish mumkin emas. Ular ovozli (sirenalar, revunlar), yorug'lik (miltillovchi tablolar, strob-lampalar), yorug'lik-ovozli va nutqli xabar beruvchilarga bo'linadi. Amalda bir obyektda bir vaqtning o'zida bir necha tur qo'llaniladi: sirena shovqinli sexda e'tiborni tortadi, "Chiqish" yorug'lik tablosi odamlarni evakuatsiya yo'llariga yo'naltiradi, nutqli xabar beruvchi esa odamlar ommaviy to'planadigan joylarda tushunarli ovozli ko'rsatmalarni translatsiya qiladi.

O'zbekiston sharoitida xabar beruvchilarni tanlashga pragmatik yondashiladi. Obyektlar har xil bo'ladi — konditsionerli salqin ofislardan tortib ochiq maydonchalar va isitilmaydigan omborlargacha, u yerda yozda harorat +45 °C gacha ko'tariladi, chang va harorat farqlari esa oddiy hol. Shu sababli nafaqat ovoz balandligi va yorqinlik, balki ish harorati diapazoni, korpus himoya darajasi va changlanishga chidamlilik ham muhim. Elektr ta'minoti ishonchliligi alohida ahamiyatga ega: xabar beruvchi tarmoq o'chganda ham qurilmaning zaxira akkumulyatoridan quvvatlanib ishlashi kerak. To'g'ri tanlangan va malakali montaj qilingan xabar beruvchi yolg'on rad javoblarisiz yillar davomida ishlaydi va o'zining asosiy funksiyasini muhim vaqtda — odamlar reaktsiyasi tezligiga xavfsizlik va mol-mulk saqlanishi bog'liq bo'lgan paytda barqaror bajaradi.

## Qanday tanlash kerak

- **Xabar berish turi:** obyektga nima kerakligini aniqlang — faqat ovoz (kichik xona uchun sirena), yorug'lik (ovoz eshitilmaydigan shovqinli ishlab chiqarishlar uchun), yorug'lik-ovozli kombinatsiyalangan variant yoki odamlar ommaviy to'planadigan joylar uchun to'liq nutqli xabar berish.
- **Ovoz bosimi darajasi:** ovoz balandligi dB da o'lchanadi; ofis uchun o'rtacha qiymat yetarli, yuqori fon shovqinli sex uchun esa ish shovqinini normalangan masofada bosadigan kuchli revun kerak.
- **Quvvatlanish kuchlanishi:** aksariyat xabar beruvchilar 12 V yoki 24 V doimiy tokka mo'ljallangan; parametr qabul-nazorat qurilmasi chiqishi va zaxira akkumulyator hisobiga mos bo'lishi kerak.
- **Ulanish usuli va liniya nazorati:** tizim uzilish yoki qisqa tutashuvni trevoga onigacha qayd etishi uchun qurilma xabar berish shleyfi sozligini nazorat qilishni qo'llab-quvvatlashini aniqlang.
- **Himoya darajasi (IP) va harorat diapazoni:** ko'cha, omborlar va texnik xonalar uchun chang va namlikdan himoyaga ega hamda mahalliy iqlimga mos tasdiqlangan ish harorati diapazoniga ega korpusni tanlang.
- **Yorug'lik signalining rangi va sezilarliligi:** yong'in tizimlari uchun an'anaviy ravishda qizil korpus va qizil yorug'lik qo'llaniladi; signalning kunduzgi yoritishda va ko'rish burchaklarida ajralib turishi muhim.
- **Tizim bilan moslik:** xabar beruvchi muayyan ППКОП yoki adresli tizim bilan to'g'ri ishlashi kerak — bu ishga tushirish-sozlash va obyektni qabul qilishda muammolarni istisno qiladi.

## Qo'llanilish sohalari

- Ofis va ma'muriy binolar, biznes-markazlar — koridorlarda, qavatlarda va evakuatsiya yo'llarida ovozli va yorug'lik-ovozli xabar berish.
- Savdo obyektlari: do'konlar, supermarketlar, savdo markazlari — nutqli xabar berish va odamlar oqimini chiqish joylariga yo'naltirish talab qilinadigan joylar.
- Ishlab chiqarish sexlari va omborlar — uskuna shovqinini bosadigan va changli xonalarda ko'rinadigan kuchli sirenalar va yorug'lik qurilmalari.
- Turar-joy majmualari va ko'p kvartirali uylar — podyezdlarda, texnik qavatlarda va avtoturargohlarda xabar berish.
- Davlat muassasalari, maktablar, poliklinikalar, mehmonxonalar — СОУЭ normalariga ayniqsa qat'iy talablar qo'yiladigan odamlar ommaviy to'planadigan obyektlar.
- Maxsus va rejimli obyektlar, banklar, server va texnik xonalar — xabar beruvchi qo'riqlash signalizatsiyasi va reaktsiya bilan integratsiyalashadigan joylar.

## Katalogdagi brendlar va modellar

- **Болид** — integratsiyalangan xavfsizlik tizimlarining rossiyalik ishlab chiqaruvchisi bo'lib, uning uskunasi O'zbekiston obyektlarida keng qo'llaniladi va С2000 liniyasi qurilmalari bilan yaxshi ulanadi.
- **Sirena Болид С2000-ОПЗ (qizil)** — yong'in va qo'riqlash signalizatsiyasi tarkibida trevoga signalini berish uchun mo'ljallangan xarakterli qizil korpusli ovozli xabar beruvchi.
- Болид ning **С2000** seriyasi — qabul-nazorat qurilmalaridan tortib xabar beruvchilar va interfeys modullarigacha yagona tizimni yig'ish imkonini beruvchi qurilmalar va periferiya ekotizimi.
- SAT Solutions katalogida xabar beruvchilar assortimenti so'rov bo'yicha kengaytiriladi — muayyan loyiha uchun kerakli tur, quvvat va ijrodagi modellarni, jumladan Болид liniyasining hamroh uskunasini tanlaymiz.

## FAQ

Q: Ovozli xabar beruvchi yorug'lik-ovozlidan nimasi bilan farq qiladi?
A: Ovozli faqat akustik signal (sirena, revun) beradi, yorug'lik-ovozli esa qo'shimcha miltillovchi yorug'lik signalini beradi. Ikkinchi variant ovoz eshitilmaydigan joylarda — shovqinli sexlarda yoki eshitish qobiliyati buzilgan odamlar uchun kerak. O'zbekistondagi aksariyat obyektlarda SAT Solutions mutaxassislari xabar beruvchi turlarini zonalar bo'yicha kombinatsiya qiladi.

Q: Katalogdagi xabar beruvchilarning quvvatlanish kuchlanishi qanday?
A: Ko'pincha bu 12 V yoki 24 V doimiy tok, quvvat zaxira akkumulyatorli qabul-nazorat qurilmasidan olinadi. Aniq qiymat model va tizim sxemasiga bog'liq. Buyurtma qilishda biz xabar beruvchining sizning uskunangiz bilan mosligini tekshiramiz.

Q: Болид xabar beruvchisi ko'chada yoki isitilmagan omborda o'rnatishga mos keladimi?
A: Bu muayyan modelga, uning himoya darajasi (IP) va e'lon qilingan harorat diapazoniga bog'liq. Ko'cha va isitilmaydigan xonalar uchun o'zbek iqlimi sharoitida biz chang, namlik va +45 °C gacha issiqqa mo'ljallangan ijroni tanlaymiz. SAT Solutions menejerlari mos variantni tanlashda yordam beradi.

Q: Bitta xabar beruvchini yoki faqat komplekt bilan sotib olish mumkinmi?
A: Ham alohida qurilmani, ham butun tizim uchun komplektni sotib olish mumkin. Agar ishdan chiqqan qurilmani almashtirayotgan bo'lsangiz, biz mos modelni yetkazamiz; agar tizimni noldan qurayotgan bo'lsangiz — Toshkentda yoki hududda obyekt uchun uskunaning to'liq to'plamini hisoblab beramiz.

Q: SAT Solutions xabar beruvchilarni o'rnatadimi yoki faqat sotadimi?
A: Biz to'liq siklni bajaramiz: yetkazib berish, loyihalash, montaj, ishga tushirish-sozlash va butun O'zbekiston bo'ylab servis. Faqat uskunani katalog orqali buyurtma qilish yoki bizga o'rnatish va amaldagi signalizatsiya tizimi bilan integratsiyani ishonib topshirish mumkin.
bolid-sirens.en:
Sirens are devices that, as part of fire and security alarm systems, convey an alarm signal to people through sound, light, or a combination of both. It is the siren that turns a sensor activation into a warning understandable to a person, prompting them to leave the premises, pay attention to a threat, or call for a response. You can buy sirens in Tashkent with selection for a specific site, verification of compatibility with the control panel, and an official warranty through the SAT Solutions catalog — we supply and install security system components across Uzbekistan.

In fire alarm and fire warning systems (WES), sirens are a mandatory element without which acceptance of a site by supervisory authorities is impossible. They are divided into sound (sirens, horns), light (flashing signs, strobe lamps), audio-visual, and voice types. In practice, several types are used at a single site at once: a siren attracts attention in a noisy workshop, an "Exit" light sign directs people to evacuation routes, and a voice siren broadcasts clear voice instructions in places with mass gatherings of people.

For the conditions of Uzbekistan, the choice of sirens is approached pragmatically. Sites vary — from cool air-conditioned offices to open areas and unheated warehouses where the temperature rises to +45 °C in summer, and dust and fluctuations are commonplace. Therefore, not only volume and brightness matter, but also the operating temperature range, the degree of housing protection, and resistance to dust. The reliability of the power supply is of separate importance: a siren must activate even when the mains is disconnected, powered by the control panel's backup battery. A properly selected and skillfully installed siren works for years without false failures and steadily performs its main function at the critical moment — when the safety and preservation of property depend on the speed of people's reaction.

## How to choose

- **Notification type:** determine what the site needs — sound only (a siren for a small room), light (for noisy industries where sound is not heard), a combined audio-visual option, or full-fledged voice notification for places with mass gatherings of people.
- **Sound pressure level:** volume is measured in dB; a moderate value is sufficient for an office, while a workshop with high background noise needs a powerful horn that overrides the working hum at the standardized distance.
- **Supply voltage:** most sirens are rated for 12 V or 24 V DC; this parameter must match the output of the control panel and the calculation of the backup battery.
- **Connection method and line monitoring:** clarify whether the device supports monitoring of the notification loop integrity, so that the system detects a break or short circuit before the moment of alarm.
- **Protection rating (IP) and temperature range:** for streets, warehouses, and technical rooms, choose a housing with protection against dust and moisture and a confirmed operating temperature range for the local climate.
- **Color and visibility of the light signal:** for fire systems, a red housing and red glow are traditionally used; the signal's distinguishability in daylight and viewing angles is important.
- **Compatibility with the system:** the siren must work correctly with the specific control panel or addressable system — this eliminates problems during commissioning and site acceptance.

## Applications

- Office and administrative buildings, business centers — sound and audio-visual notification in corridors, on floors, and along evacuation routes.
- Retail sites: stores, supermarkets, shopping centers — where voice notification and directing people flows to exits are required.
- Production workshops and warehouses — powerful sirens and light devices that override equipment noise and are visible in dusty rooms.
- Residential complexes and apartment buildings — notification in entrances, on technical floors, and in parking areas.
- Government institutions, schools, clinics, hotels — sites with mass gatherings of people, where WES standards are especially strict.
- Special and restricted facilities, banks, server rooms, and technical rooms — where the siren is integrated with the security alarm and response.

## Brands and models in the catalog

- **Bolid** — a Russian manufacturer of integrated security systems whose equipment is widely used at sites in Uzbekistan and pairs well with the S2000 line of devices.
- **Bolid S2000-OPZ siren (red)** — a sound siren with a distinctive red housing, designed to deliver an alarm signal as part of a fire and security alarm.
- The **S2000** series from Bolid is an ecosystem of devices and peripherals that allows assembling a unified system: from control panels to sirens and interface modules.
- In the SAT Solutions catalog, the range of sirens is expanded on request — for a specific project, we select models of the required type, power, and design, including related Bolid line equipment.

## FAQ

Q: What is the difference between a sound siren and an audio-visual one?
A: A sound siren delivers only an acoustic signal (siren, horn), while an audio-visual one additionally provides a flashing light signal. The second option is needed where the sound may not be heard — in noisy workshops or for people with hearing impairments. At most sites in Uzbekistan, SAT Solutions specialists combine types of sirens by zone.

Q: What supply voltage do the sirens in the catalog have?
A: Most often it is 12 V or 24 V DC, with power taken from the control panel with a backup battery. The exact value depends on the model and the system scheme. When ordering, we verify the siren's compatibility with your equipment.

Q: Is a Bolid siren suitable for installation outdoors or in an unheated warehouse?
A: This depends on the specific model, its protection rating (IP), and the stated temperature range. For outdoor and unheated rooms in the Uzbek climate, we select a design rated for dust, moisture, and heat up to +45 °C. SAT Solutions managers will help you choose a suitable option.

Q: Can I buy a single siren or only as a set?
A: You can purchase either an individual device or a set for the entire system. If you are replacing a failed device, we will supply a compatible model; if you are building a system from scratch, we will calculate the complete set of equipment for the site in Tashkent or the region.

Q: Does SAT Solutions install sirens, or only sell them?
A: We perform the full cycle: supply, design, installation, commissioning, and service across Uzbekistan. You can order only the equipment through the catalog or entrust us with the installation and integration with the existing alarm system.

Optik tolali aloqa liniyalarini professional montaj qilish maxsus asboblarsiz mumkin emas. SAT Solutions katalogidagi "Asboblar" toifasi ВОЛС (optik tolali aloqa liniyalari) ni yotqizish, payvandlash, sinash va texnik xizmat ko'rsatishning to'liq arsenalini qamrab oladi: payvandlash apparatlari va tola kesuvchilaridan tortib reflektometrlar, montajchi to'plamlari va sarf materiallarigacha. Bu uskunaning barchasi telekommunikatsiya, qo'riqlash va strukturalangan kabel tizimlarida professional qo'llash uchun mo'ljallangan.

Bugungi kunda Toshkentda optik aloqa liniyalari uchun asboblarni ham yakka loyiha uchun, ham muntazam ishlar uchun montaj brigadasini jihozlash uchun sotib olish mumkin. Katalogdagi pozitsiyalar diapazoni yetarlicha keng: 78 nomdagi mahsulot ВОЛС montajining barcha bosqichlarini qamrab oladi — tolani tayyorlash, payvandlash, o'lchash, markalash va tozalash. Bu O'zbekistonga xorijiy servis markazlariga bog'liq bo'lmaslik imkonini beradi: to'g'ri asbob bilan qurollangan malakali brigada joyida istalgan optik tarmoqni mustaqil yig'ish va unga xizmat ko'rsatishga qodir.

Asbobni to'g'ri tanlash montaj sifati va tezligiga bevosita ta'sir qiladi. Tolaning noto'g'ri kesilishi yoki razyomning yomon tozalanishi ulanishda yo'qotishlar beradi, ularni keyinchalik reflektometrsiz aniqlash qiyin. Aynan shu sababli asbobni kompleks tanlash kerak: payvandlash apparati, kesuvchi va reflektometr bo'linmas ishchi to'plamni tashkil etadi, sarf materiallar va markalash esa inshootning uzoq muddatli sifatini ta'minlaydi.

## Qanday tanlash kerak

- Ishlar turi. Magistral ВОЛС ni muntazam montaj qilish uchun o'zak bo'yicha avtomatik yustirovka (core alignment) qiladigan unumdor payvandlash apparati kerak. Patch-kordlar va abonent kirishlari uchun qobiq bo'yicha tekislaydigan (clad alignment) ancha arzon apparatlar yetarli.

- Kesuvchi aniqligi. Tola kesim burchagi payvand chok sifatini belgilaydi. Professional kesuvchilar bir modali tola uchun muhim bo'lgan 0,5 gradusdan kam burchak og'ishini ta'minlaydi; ko'p modali uchun dopusklar yumshoqroq.

- OTDR dinamik diapazoni. Reflektometr trassa uzunligiga qarab tanlanadi. Uzunligi 3 km gacha bo'lgan abonent kirishlari uchun 20 dB yetarli, shaharlararo magistrallar uchun 35-40 dB va undan yuqori diapazonli apparatlar kerak.

- O'lchash to'lqin uzunligi. Bir modali ВОЛС 1310 nm va 1550 nm to'lqin uzunliklarida sinaladi. Bir reflektometrda ikkala diapazon mavjudligi (va ixtiyoriy ravishda trafikni uzmasdan monitoring uchun 1625 nm) ancha qulay.

- Kesuvchi resursi. Pichoqni almashtirishgacha bo'lgan kesim soni turli modellarda bir tartibga farq qiladi: byudjetlilar 10-16 ming operatsiyaga, professional — 30-48 mingga mo'ljallangan.

- Komplektlilik va keys. FOKIT tipidagi to'plam bir keysda kesuvchi, stripper, tozalash asbobi va sarf materiallarni darrov olish imkonini beradi — bu sayyor brigadalar uchun to'plamni alohida yig'ishdan qulayroq.

- Sarf materiallar va markalash. Torts tozalash uchun osch izopropil spirti, razyomlarni tozalash uchun bokslar, kabel birkalari va o'ziyopishqoq markerlar — bularning barchasi ko'ringandan tezroq tugaydigan kichik sarf materiali. Obyektga zaxirani oldindan hisoblab qo'yish kerak.

## Qo'llanilish sohalari

- Telekommunikatsiya va korporativ tarmoqlar. Korxonalar, ofis markazlari va savdo majmualarida СКС (strukturalangan kabel tizimi) ning gorizontal va magistral segmentlarini qurish va texnik xizmat ko'rsatish.

- Uzun obyektlardagi videokuzatuv tizimlari. Perimetrlar, yo'llar bo'ylab, aeroportlar va sanoat zonalarida — mis kabel kerakli masofani ta'minlamaydigan joylarda optika bo'yicha videosignal va ma'lumotlarni uzatish.

- Provayder va operator tarmoqlari. Butun O'zbekiston bo'ylab internet-provayderlar tomonidan GPON, FTTH va magistral aloqa kanallarini qurish — Toshkentdan hududiy tugunlargacha.

- Xavfsizlik obyektlari va past kuchlanishli tizimlar. Galvanik ajratish yoki elektromagnit shovqinlarga chidamlilik talab qilinadigan joylarda optikani kirishni nazorat qilish, qo'riqlash signalizatsiyasi va ovozli aloqa tizimlariga integratsiya qilish.

- Amaldagi ВОЛС ni ta'mirlash va diagnostika. OTDR yordamida uzilishlar va degradatsiyaga uchragan payvand ulanishlarini qidirish, ekspluatatsiya qiluvchi tashkilotlar obyektlarida tiklovchi payvandlash.

## Katalogdagi brendlar va modellar

- Pixietech — katalogdagi asosiy asbob va sarf materiallar liniyasi. Turli pichoq resursli PXT-FC-S09 va PXT-FC-6S kesuvchilari, PXT-OTDR-01 reflektometri (1310/1550 nm diapazonlari, maksimal diapazon 30/28 dB, o'rnatilgan vizual lokator VFL bilan), PXT-FOKIT-1 montajchi to'plamlari, PXT-FCP-BOX optik razyom tozalagichi, ОСЧ izopropil spirti, turli formatdagi kabel birkalari va markerlar taqdim etilgan. Liniya kabelni tayyorlashdan tortib yakuniy markalashgacha montaj brigadasi ehtiyojlarini qamrab oladi.

- Fujikura va Ilsintech (Pixietech yetkazib berishlari tarkibida) — payvandlash apparatlari. Katalogda Fujikura 36S+ KIT A va Ilsintech SWIFT K33 taqdim etilgan: har ikkala apparat avtomatik payvandlash va yo'qotishlarni baholash bilan professional yechimlar sinfiga tegishli, mas'uliyatli obyektlar uchun qo'llaniladi.

- УЗК (kabel tayyorlash qurilmalari). Diametri 6 mm bo'lgan shisha tayoqchalar 5 m uzunlikdagi buxtalarda — yashirin yotqizishda kabelni kanallar va trubalarga tortish uchun standart asbob.

## FAQ

Q: Montaj biznesini boshlash uchun qaysi payvandlash apparatini tanlash kerak?
A: Boshlash uchun qobiq bo'yicha tekislaydigan apparat yetarli — u arzonroq va abonent kirishlari hamda qisqa magistrallar bo'yicha aksariyat vazifalarni qamrab oladi. Agar so'nishga 0,05 dB/splays dan kam talab bilan bir modali magistral ВОЛС da ishlashni rejalashtirayotgan bo'lsangiz, Fujikura 36S+ kabi o'zak bo'yicha tekislaydigan apparatlarga darrov qarash kerak.

Q: Optik quvvat o'lchagichi bo'lsa, reflektometr majburiymi?
A: Bu turli vazifalarga ega turli asboblar. Quvvat o'lchagichi trassadagi umumiy yo'qotishlarni ko'rsatadi, OTDR esa muayyan nuqsonni — uzilish, sifatsiz splays yoki yomon razyomni — metrgacha aniqlik bilan lokalizatsiya qilish imkonini beradi. Jiddiy montaj va obyektni buyurtmachiga topshirish uchun OTDR zarur.

Q: Kesuvchi pichog'ini qanchalik tez-tez almashtirish kerak?
A: Foydalanish intensivligi va modelga bog'liq. Professional kesuvchilar 30-48 ming kesim operatsiyasiga mo'ljallangan, shundan so'ng kesim sifati yomonlashadi va payvand ulanishlaridagi yo'qotishlar o'sa boshlaydi. Muntazam ishlar davomida payvandlash apparati ko'rsatkichlari bo'yicha kesim burchagini vaqti-vaqti bilan nazorat qilish tavsiya etiladi.

Q: Optik razyomlarni tozalash uchun maxsus spirt kerakmi yoki dorixona spirti mos keladimi?
A: Optik razyomlar uchun suv va aralashmalarsiz yuqori tozalik darajasidagi izopropil spirti (ОСЧ yoki ХЧ) talab qilinadi. Dorixona etil spirti razyom tortsida iz qoldiradigan va kiritiladigan yo'qotishlarni yomonlashtiradigan suv va denaturat saqlaydi. To'g'ri spirtdan tozalagich-boks bilan birga foydalanish — sifatli montajning majburiy sharti.

Q: Zarur hujjatlar bilan tender ostida asbob yetkazib berish mumkinmi?
A: Ha. SAT Solutions yuridik shaxslar bilan ishlaydi va hujjatlarning to'liq paketini ta'minlaydi: hisob-faktura, nakladnaya, sertifikatlar va uskuna texnik pasportlari. Zarur bo'lganda kompaniya mutaxassislari tender hujjatlari uchun spetsifikatsiya shakllantirishda yordam beradi.
pxt-tools.en:
Professional installation of fiber-optic communication lines is impossible without specialized tools. The "Tools" category in the SAT Solutions catalog covers the full arsenal of equipment for laying, splicing, testing, and servicing FOCL: from splicers and fiber cleavers to reflectometers, installer kits, and consumables. All of this equipment is designed for professional use in telecommunication, security, and structured cabling systems.

Buying tools for optical communication lines in Tashkent today is possible both for a single project and for equipping an installation crew for regular work. The range of items in the catalog is quite wide: 78 items cover all stages of FOCL installation — fiber preparation, splicing, measurements, marking, and cleaning. This allows Uzbekistan not to depend on foreign service centers: a qualified crew armed with the right tools is able to independently deploy and service any optical network on site.

Proper tool selection directly affects the quality and speed of installation. An incorrect fiber cleave or poor connector cleaning results in splice losses that are then difficult to localize without a reflectometer. That is why tools should be selected comprehensively: a splicer, a cleaver, and a reflectometer form an inseparable working kit, while consumables and marking ensure the long-term quality of the installation.

## How to choose

- Type of work. For regular installation of trunk FOCL, you need a high-performance splicer with automatic core alignment. For patch cords and subscriber inputs, more affordable splicers with clad alignment are sufficient.

- Cleaver precision. The fiber cleave angle determines the quality of the splice. Professional cleavers ensure an angle deviation of less than 0.5 degrees, which is critical for single-mode fiber; for multimode, the tolerances are softer.

- OTDR dynamic range. A reflectometer is chosen according to the length of the route. For subscriber inputs up to 3 km long, 20 dB is sufficient; for intercity trunk lines, devices with a range of 35-40 dB and above are needed.

- Measurement wavelength. Single-mode FOCL are tested at wavelengths of 1310 nm and 1550 nm. Having both ranges in a single reflectometer (and optionally 1625 nm for monitoring without interrupting traffic) is much more convenient.

- Cleaver service life. The number of cleaves before blade replacement differs by an order of magnitude between models: budget ones are rated for 10-16 thousand operations, professional ones for 30-48 thousand.

- Completeness and case. A kit such as FOKIT allows you to immediately get a cleaver, stripper, stripping tool, and consumables in a single case — this is more convenient for field crews than assembling a set separately.

- Consumables and marking. High-purity isopropyl alcohol for cleaning end faces, boxes for cleaning connectors, cable tags, and self-adhesive markers — all of this is small consumable material that runs out faster than it seems. A reserve for the site should be planned in advance.

## Applications

- Telecommunication and corporate networks. Construction and maintenance of horizontal and trunk segments of structured cabling systems at enterprises, office centers, and shopping complexes.

- Video surveillance systems at extended sites. Transmission of video signal and data over optics along perimeters, roads, at airports, and in industrial zones where copper cable does not provide the required range.

- Provider and operator networks. Construction of GPON, FTTH, and trunk communication channels by internet providers across Uzbekistan — from Tashkent to regional nodes.

- Security facilities and low-current systems. Integration of optics into access control, security alarm, and voice communication systems where galvanic isolation or resistance to electromagnetic interference is required.

- Repair and diagnostics of existing FOCL. Searching for breaks and degraded splices using an OTDR, restorative splicing at the sites of operating organizations.

## Brands and models in the catalog

- Pixietech — the main line of tools and consumables in the catalog. It includes the PXT-FC-S09 and PXT-FC-6S cleavers with different blade lifespans, the PXT-OTDR-01 reflectometer (1310/1550 nm ranges, maximum range 30/28 dB, with a built-in visual VFL locator), the PXT-FOKIT-1 installer kits, the PXT-FCP-BOX optical connector cleaner, high-purity isopropyl alcohol, cable tags of various formats, and markers. The line covers the needs of an installation crew from cable preparation to final marking.

- Fujikura and Ilsintech (as part of Pixietech supplies) — splicers. The catalog features the Fujikura 36S+ KIT A and the Ilsintech SWIFT K33: both devices belong to the class of professional solutions with automatic splicing and loss estimation, used for critical sites.

- Cable pulling devices. Fiberglass rods with a diameter of 6 mm in coils 5 m long are a standard tool for pulling cable into ducts and pipes during concealed installation.

## FAQ

Q: Which splicer should I choose to start an installation business?
A: To start, a splicer with clad alignment is sufficient — it is cheaper and covers most tasks for subscriber inputs and short trunk lines. If you plan to work on single-mode trunk FOCL with a requirement for attenuation of less than 0.05 dB/splice, it is worth looking right away at splicers with core alignment, such as the Fujikura 36S+.

Q: Is a reflectometer mandatory if I have an optical power meter?
A: These are different tools with different tasks. A power meter shows the total losses on the route, while an OTDR allows you to localize a specific defect — a break, a poor-quality splice, or a bad connector — with meter precision. For serious installation and handing over a site to the customer, an OTDR is necessary.

Q: How often does the cleaver blade need to be replaced?
A: It depends on the intensity of use and the model. Professional cleavers are rated for 30-48 thousand cleaving operations, after which the cleave quality deteriorates and splice losses begin to increase. With regular work, it is recommended to periodically monitor the cleave angle by the splicer's readings.

Q: Is special alcohol needed for cleaning optical connectors, or will pharmacy alcohol do?
A: Optical connectors require high-purity isopropyl alcohol (analytical or chemically pure grade) without water or impurities. Pharmacy ethyl alcohol contains water and denaturant, which leave streaks on the connector end face and worsen insertion losses. Using the correct alcohol together with a cleaner box is a mandatory condition for quality installation.

Q: Is it possible to supply tools for a tender with the necessary documents?
A: Yes. SAT Solutions works with legal entities and provides a full package of documents: invoice, delivery note, certificates, and technical passports for the equipment. If necessary, the company's specialists will help draw up a specification for the tender documentation.

Karta o'quvchilar — bu foydalanuvchi identifikatorini (kontaktsiz karta, brelok, metka, zamonaviy modellarda esa smartfonni) tanib oladigan va o'tish to'g'risida qaror qabul qilish uchun ma'lumotlarni kontrollerga uzatadigan kirishni nazorat va boshqarish tizimining (СКУД) oxirgi qurilmalaridir. Aynan o'quvchiga xodim yoki tashrif buyuruvchi kirish nuqtasidan qanchalik tez va xatosiz o'tishi bog'liq, shu sababli bu qurilmalarni tanlashga kontrollerlar va qulflarni tanlashdan kam bo'lmagan jiddiylik bilan yondashiladi. Toshkentda muayyan vazifa uchun — ofisdagi bitta eshikdan tortib o'nlab nuqtali zavod nazorat-o'tkazish punktigacha — karta o'quvchilarni sotib olish SAT Solutions katalogi orqali qulay: biz modellarni karta standarti, interfeys turi va montaj sharoitlari bo'yicha tanlaymiz.

O'quvchisiz СКУД fizik jihatdan ishlamaydi: kontroller kirish huquqlari va jurnallarni saqlaydi, qulf buyruqni bajaradi, o'quvchi esa odam va tizim o'rtasidagi bog'lovchi bo'g'in bo'lib xizmat qiladi. Uning parametrlariga o'qish masofasi, qo'llab-quvvatlanadigan karta formatlari (EM-Marine, Mifare, HID va boshqalar), identifikatorlarni nusxalashga chidamlilik va ko'cha sharoitlarida ishlash ishonchliligi bevosita bog'liq. O'zbekiston obyektlari uchun harorat diapazoni va korpus himoyasi alohida muhim: kirish guruhidagi o'quvchi yozda to'g'ridan-to'g'ri quyosh ostida qiziydi, qishda va faslar oralig'ida esa harorat farqlari va yog'ingarchilikka duch keladi.

Bu toifa o'tishni cheklash va qayd etish kerak bo'lgan har bir joyda talabga ega: biznes-markazlar va ofislar, savdo obyektlari, ishlab chiqarish va ombor majmualari, turar-joy majmualari va avtoturargohlar, davlat muassasalari va rejimli zonalar. To'g'ri tanlangan o'quvchi obyekt xavfsizligini oshiradi, ish vaqtini hisobga olishni soddalashtiradi va turniketlar, shlagbaumlar hamda videokuzatuv bilan integratsiyalashadi. Alohida rol karta enkoderlariga ajratiladi: ular identifikatorlarni to'g'ridan-to'g'ri obyektda, uchinchi tomon pudratchilariga murojaat qilmasdan chiqarish va dasturlash imkonini beradi. SAT Solutions allaqachon o'rnatilgan yoki loyihalanayotgan uskuna bilan bog'liqlikda to'g'ri ishlaydigan, undan alohida mavjud bo'lmagan qurilmani tanlashda yordam beradi.

## Qanday tanlash kerak

- **Karta standarti va formatlari:** tizim qaysi identifikatorlar bilan ishlashini aniqlang — EM-Marine, Mifare Classic/DESFire, HID. O'quvchi siz foydalanadigan yoki joriy qilishni rejalashtirgan formatni qo'llab-quvvatlashi kerak, aks holda butun karta parkini almashtirishga to'g'ri keladi.
- **Ulanish interfeysi:** Wiegand kontrollerlar bilan bog'lash uchun eng keng tarqalgan bo'lib qolmoqda, biroq zamonaviy modellar RS-485 va OSDP ni qo'llab-quvvatlaydi — oxirgisi kanal shifrlanishi va teskari aloqani beradi. Interfeysni kontrolleringiz imkoniyatlariga qarab tanlang.
- **Masofa va o'qish usuli:** eshiklar uchun kartani yaqindan tegizish yetarli, o'tishlar va avtoturargohlar uchun kattaroq masofa kerak. O'quvchi faqat kirishga yoki kirish va chiqishga kerakligini hisobga oling.
- **Nusxalashdan himoya:** EM-Marine kartalari oson klonlanadi, shifrlangan Mifare esa ancha xavfsiz. Xavfsizlikka yuqori talablarga ega obyektlar uchun himoyalangan formatlarni tanlang.
- **Himoya klassi va harorat diapazoni:** ko'chada o'rnatish va kirish guruhlari uchun chang va namlikdan himoyaga ega hamda o'zbek iqlimini — qishki minuslardan yozgi to'g'ridan-to'g'ri quyosh ostidagi issiqqacha qoplaydigan ish diapazoniga ega korpus kerak.
- **Autentifikatsiya usuli:** faqat karta, karta plyus PIN-kod (klaviaturali modellar) yoki smartfon qo'llab-quvvatlashiga ega multiformatli qurilmalar. Zona xavfsizligiga talablar qanchalik yuqori bo'lsa, tasdiqlash omillari shunchalik ko'p.
- **Montaj sharoitlari va quvvatlanish:** o'rnatish joyini (devorga, turniket ustuniga, o'tishga), kontrollergacha bo'lgan liniya uzunligini va ruxsat etilgan kuchlanish pasayishini hisobga oling. Bunga interfeys tanlovi, kabel kesimi va qo'shimcha quvvat bloki zarurati bog'liq.

## Qo'llanilish sohalari

- **Ofislar va biznes-markazlar:** kirish guruhlari, muzokara va server xonalarini nazorat qilish, xodimlar ish vaqtini hisobga olish.

- **Ishlab chiqarish va omborlar:** katta oqimli nazorat-o'tkazish punktlari, turli ruxsat darajalariga ega sexlar va saqlash zonalariga kirish.
- **Turar-joy majmualari va avtoturargohlar:** aholining podyezdlarga, hududga va avtoturargohga kirishi, jumladan o'tishlar uchun kattaroq masofa bilan.
- **Davlat muassasalari:** kabinetlar, arxivlar va xizmat zonalariga nazorat qilinadigan va jurnal yuritiladigan o'tish.
- **Rejimli va maxsus obyektlar:** xavfsizlikka yuqori talablarga ega zonalar uchun ko'p omilli autentifikatsiya va himoyalangan karta formatlari.

## Katalogdagi brendlar va modellar

- **Dahua DHI-ASR2100H** — Dahua СКУД tarkibida ishlashga mo'ljallangan, kengaytirilgan talablarga ega vazifalar uchun model.
- **Dahua DHI-ASM100** — administrator ish joyida identifikatorlarni chiqarish va dasturlash uchun stol usti karta enkoderi.
- **Yagona Dahua ekotizimi:** bir ishlab chiqaruvchining o'quvchilari, enkoderlari, kontrollerlari va dasturiy ta'minoti moslik, oddiy sozlash va kirishni markazlashtirilgan boshqarishni ta'minlaydi.

## FAQ

Q: Yangi obyekt uchun qaysi karta standartini tanlash yaxshiroq?
A: Oddiy vazifalar uchun eng byudjetli variant sifatida EM-Marine mos keladi, biroq nusxalashdan yuqori himoya uchun biz shifrlangan Mifare ni tavsiya etamiz. SAT Solutions loyihalash bosqichida aniqlashda yordam beradi, keyinchalik butun karta parkini qayta ishlamaslik uchun.

Q: Karta o'quvchisi Toshkent sharoitida ko'chada o'rnatishga mos keladimi?

Q: O'quvchini allaqachon o'rnatilgan kontrollerga ulash mumkinmi?

Q: Karta enkoderi, masalan Dahua DHI-ASM100, nima uchun kerak?

Q: SAT Solutions faqat Toshkentda emas, hududlarda ham montaj bajaradimi?

card-readers.en:
Card readers are the terminal devices of an access control system (ACS) that recognize a user's identifier (a contactless card, key fob, tag, and in modern models even a smartphone) and transmit the data to the controller for a decision on passage. It is the reader that determines how quickly and error-free an employee or visitor passes through an access point, so these devices are chosen no less seriously than controllers and locks. Buying card readers in Tashkent for a specific task — from a single door in an office to a factory checkpoint with dozens of points — is convenient through the SAT Solutions catalog: we select models by card standard, interface type, and installation conditions.

Without a reader, an ACS physically does not work: the controller stores access rights and logs, the lock executes the command, and the reader serves as the link between the person and the system. Its parameters directly determine the read range, supported card formats (EM-Marine, Mifare, HID, etc.), resistance to identifier copying, and reliability of operation in outdoor conditions. For sites in Uzbekistan, the temperature range and housing protection are separately important: a reader at an entrance group heats up in the summer under direct sun, and in winter and between seasons it faces temperature fluctuations and precipitation.

This category is in demand wherever passage needs to be restricted and recorded: business centers and offices, retail sites, industrial and warehouse complexes, residential complexes and parking areas, government institutions and restricted zones. A properly selected reader increases the security of the site, simplifies working-time tracking, and integrates with turnstiles, barriers, and video surveillance. A special role is assigned to card encoders: they allow issuing and programming identifiers directly on site, without involving third-party contractors. SAT Solutions helps choose a device that works correctly in tandem with already installed or planned equipment, rather than existing separately from it.

## How to choose

- **Card standard and formats:** determine which identifiers the system will work with — EM-Marine, Mifare Classic/DESFire, HID. The reader must support the format you use or plan to implement, otherwise you will have to replace the entire card fleet.
- **Connection interface:** Wiegand remains the most common for pairing with controllers, but modern models support RS-485 and OSDP — the latter provides channel encryption and feedback. Choose the interface according to your controller's capabilities.
- **Range and reading method:** for doors, holding the card up close is sufficient, while driveways and parking areas require increased range. Consider whether the reader is needed only for entry or for both entry and exit.
- **Copy protection:** EM-Marine cards are easily cloned, whereas Mifare with encryption is significantly more secure. For sites with heightened security requirements, choose protected formats.
- **Protection rating and temperature range:** for outdoor installation and entrance groups, you need a housing with protection against dust and moisture and an operating range covering the Uzbek climate — from winter lows to summer heat under direct sun.
- **Authentication method:** card only, card plus PIN code (models with a keypad), or multi-format devices with smartphone support. The higher the zone's security requirements, the more confirmation factors.
- **Installation conditions and power:** consider the installation location (on a wall, on a turnstile stand, on a driveway), the line length to the controller, and the acceptable voltage drop. This determines the choice of interface, the cable cross-section, and the need for an additional power supply.
- **Ecosystem compatibility:** the reader should belong to the same line as the controllers and software (for example, the unified Dahua ecosystem), which simplifies configuration, updating, and service.

## Applications

- **Offices and business centers:** monitoring entrance groups, meeting rooms, and server rooms, and tracking employees' working time.
- **Retail sites:** restricting access to warehouse and utility rooms, checkout and cash-collection areas.
- **Production and warehouses:** checkpoints with heavy traffic, access to workshops and storage areas with different access levels.
- **Residential complexes and parking:** residents' access to entrances, the territory, and parking, including increased range for driveways.
- **Government institutions:** controlled and logged passage into offices, archives, and service areas.
- **Restricted and special sites:** multi-factor authentication and protected card formats for zones with heightened security requirements.

## Brands and models in the catalog

- **Dahua DHI-ASR1200E** — a basic contactless card reader for typical access points in offices and commercial sites.
- **Dahua DHI-ASR2100H** — a model for tasks with advanced requirements, designed to operate as part of a Dahua ACS.
- **Dahua DHI-ASM100** — a desktop card encoder for issuing and programming identifiers at the administrator's workstation.
- **Unified Dahua ecosystem:** readers, encoders, controllers, and software from a single manufacturer ensure compatibility, easy configuration, and centralized access management.

## FAQ

Q: Which card standard is best to choose for a new site?
A: For typical tasks, EM-Marine is suitable as the most budget-friendly option, but for increased copy protection we recommend Mifare with encryption. SAT Solutions will help you decide at the design stage so you don't have to redo the entire card fleet later.

Q: Is a card reader suitable for outdoor installation in Tashkent conditions?
A: Yes, provided a suitable housing protection rating and a temperature range covering the summer heat and winter lows. We select models specifically for outdoor entrance groups and driveway zones in Uzbekistan.

Q: Can a reader be connected to an already installed controller?
A: In most cases, yes, if the interface (Wiegand, RS-485, OSDP) and supported card formats match. SAT Solutions specialists will verify compatibility with your equipment before purchase.

Q: Why is a card encoder needed, for example the Dahua DHI-ASM100?
A: An encoder allows issuing and programming cards directly at the administrator's workstation — writing identifiers and linking them to users. This is convenient for sites where new employees or visitors are regularly added.

Q: Does SAT Solutions perform installation in the regions, and not only in Tashkent?
A: Yes, we work across Uzbekistan — we travel to sites in the regions for installation, commissioning, and service of ACS. Check the terms of travel with the managers.
