Toshkentda UPS va tegishli elektr ta'minoti uskunasini professional tanlash va montaj bilan sotib olishni SAT Solutions kompaniyasi taklif qiladi.

O'zbekistonda elektr tarmog'i sifati bir xil bo'lmayapti: kuchlanish sakrashlari, qisqa muddatli pasayishlar va to'liq o'chishlar qimmatbaho uskunani ishdan chiqarishi yoki xavfsizlik tizimlari ishini muhim lahzada uzishi mumkin. To'g'ri tanlangan UPS uskunani ortiqcha kuchlanishdan himoya qiladi, xalaqitlarni silliqlaydi va zaxira manbaga o'tish vaqtiga avtonom ishlashni yoki bir necha soat davomida to'laqonli ishlashni ta'minlaydi. Uzluksizlikka yuqori talablar qo'yiladigan obyektlar uchun — banklar, ma'lumot markazlari, ishlab chiqarish korxonalari — katta quvvatli uch fazali onlayn-UPS lardan foydalaniladi. Ofis va savdo obyektlari uchun ko'pincha 1-10 kVA bir fazali yechimlar yetarli.

Elektr ta'minoti sohasidagi yechimni tanlash tizim topologiyasiga, umumiy yuklamaga, avtonomiyaga bo'lgan talablarga va server tokchalarining mavjudligiga bog'liq. SAT Solutions katalogida 73 dan ortiq pozitsiya taqdim etilgan — ixcham PoE-injektorlar va kuchlanish datchiklaridan tortib uch fazali kirish va chiqishga ega 20 kVA li kuchli tokchali UPS lar, SNMP-monitoring platalari va intellektual PDU rozetka bloklarigacha.

## Qanday tanlash kerak

- UPS topologiya turi: onlayn (double conversion) eng yuqori himoya darajasini ta'minlaydi — yuklama har doim invertordan quvvatlanadi; chiziqli-interaktiv UPS lar kamroq muhim vazifalar uchun mos keladi. Server xonalari va videokuzatuv tizimlari uchun onlayn-topologiya tavsiya etiladi.

- kVA va kVt dagi quvvat: ulanadigan barcha uskunaning iste'molini yig'ing va 20-30% zaxira qo'shing. Kameralarga ega kichik NVR lar uchun 1-3 kVA yetarli; server tokchalari va yirik MMB lar uchun 10 kVA va undan yuqori yechimlar kerak.

- Fazalik: bir fazali (1:1) UPS lar ofis va savdo uskunasi uchun qo'llaniladi; uch fazali (3:3 yoki 3:1) — sanoat yuklamasi, kuchli server tizimlari va uch fazali kirishga ega obyektlar uchun.

- Form-faktor: server tokchalari bo'lmaganda pol usti UPS lar qulay; tokchali (rack) modellar joyni tejaydi va telekommunikatsiya shkaflarida boshqarishni soddalashtiradi.

- Avtonomiya vaqti: akkumulyatorlar sig'imi bilan belgilanadi. Xavfsizlik tizimlari uchun odatda ishni to'g'ri yakunlash yoki generatorga o'tish uchun 15-30 daqiqa yetarli; sutkalik avtonomiya uchun tashqi batareya modullari kerak.

- Monitoring va boshqaruv: SNMP platalari va tarmoq kartalari UPS holatini masofadan nazorat qilish, avariyalar haqida bildirishnomalar olish va yuklamani veb-interfeys yoki monitoring tizimi orqali boshqarish imkonini beradi. Yirik obyektlar uchun bu majburiy element.

- PoE-ta'minot: IP-videokuzatuv yoki IP-telefoniya qurishda PoE-injektorlar yoki boshqariladigan PoE-kommutatorlar kerakligini aniqlang — ular kameralar va kirish nuqtalari uchun alohida quvvat bloklarini istisno qilib, montajni soddalashtiradi.

## Qo'llanilish sohalari

- Videokuzatuv va xavfsizlik tizimlari: UPS elektr o'chganda NVR, DVR, IP-kameralar va videoyozuvlar saqlash serverlarining uzluksiz ishlashini ta'minlaydi, videoarxiv yo'qolishini istisno qiladi.

- Server xonalari va ma'lumot markazlari: katta quvvatli uch fazali onlayn-UPS lar, intellektual PDU va SNMP-monitoring platalari banklar, telekommunikatsiya operatorlari va korporativ buyurtmachilar IT-infratuzilmasining ishonchli elektr ta'minoti asosini tashkil etadi.

- Kirishni nazorat qilish va qo'riqlash signalizatsiyasi tizimlari: kirish kontrollerlari, o'quvchilar, signalizatsiya panellari uzluksiz quvvatni talab qiladi — har qanday nosozlik eshiklarni ochishi yoki obyektni qo'riqlovsiz qoldirishi mumkin.

- Savdo va biznes-markazlar: kassa uskunasi, POS-terminallar, tarmoq uskunasi va yong'in signalizatsiyasi tizimlari uchun UPS lar tarmoq beqaror bo'lganda moliyaviy yo'qotishlar va to'xtashlarning oldini oladi.

- Sanoat obyektlari va ishlab chiqarish: texnologik jarayonni to'xtatish mumkin bo'lmagan korxonalarning avtomatlashtirilgan boshqaruv tizimlari, sanoat kontrollerlari va telekommunikatsiya uskunasi uchun UPS lar.

- Telekommunikatsiya tugunlari va aloqa tugunlari: O'zbekiston bo'ylab marshrutizatorlar, kommutatorlar, mediakonvertorlar va aloqa operatorlari uskunasining uzluksiz quvvati.

## Katalogdagi brendlar va modellar

- Pixietech: SAT Solutions katalogining ushbu kategoriyasidagi asosiy brend. Liniya bir fazali va uch fazali ijroda kichikdan 20 kVA gacha quvvatli onlayn-UPS larni, tokchali va pol usti form-faktorlarni qamrab oladi. Alohida yo'nalish — 32A tokka mo'ljallangan IEC C13, IEC C19 va Schuko rozetkalariga ega intellektual PDU (quvvat taqsimlash bloklari).

- Pixietech monitoring platalari va modullari: GXT5 va boshqa seriyali UPS larni masofadan nazorat qilish uchun SNMP tarmoq kartalari, 1-3 kVt yuklamaga monitoring platalari, RPCM 63A masofadan quvvat boshqaruvi modullari energiya ta'minotining markazlashtirilgan monitoring tizimlarini qurish imkonini beradi.

- Pixietech PoE-uskunasi: IP-kameralar va kirish nuqtalarini o'ralgan juftlik orqali quvvatlash uchun 802.3af standartidagi boshqarilmaydigan PoE-injektorlar (masalan, PI-154-1A) — PoE-kommutatorlarsiz obyektlar uchun oddiy yechim.

- Nazorat va hisobga olish qurilmalari: uch fazali tarmoqni nazorat qilish uchun Phase Detector kuchlanish datchiklari, iste'molni masofadan hisobga olish uchun Wi-Fi bilan Tuya Smart elektr energiyasi hisoblagichlari — energiya samaradorligiga talablar qo'yiladigan obyektlar uchun dolzarb.

- Aksessuarlar va montaj to'plamlari: UPS ni server tokchasiga o'rnatish uchun montaj to'plamlari, quvvat kabellari va o'tkazgichlar — inshoot uchun butun to'plam bir joyda mavjud.

## FAQ

Q: 8-16 kameraga ega videokuzatuv tizimi uchun qaysi UPS ni tanlash kerak?
A: IP-kameralar va NVR ga ega tipik tizim uchun 1-3 kVA quvvatli bir fazali onlayn-UPS yetarli. Aniq hisob kameralar, registrator va tarmoq uskunasining iste'moliga bog'liq — mutaxassislarimiz hisobni bepul bajaradi.

Q: Onlayn-UPS va chiziqli-interaktiv o'rtasida qanday farq bor?
A: Onlayn-UPS (double conversion) yuklamani doimo invertordan quvvatlaydi, uni tarmoq xalaqitlari va sakrashlaridan to'liq izolyatsiya qiladi — bu eng yuqori himoya darajasi. Chiziqli-interaktiv UPS batareyaga faqat kuchlanish ruxsat etilgan chegaralardan chiqib ketganda o'tadi, bu esa bir necha millisekund tartibida qisqa muddatli quvvat uzilishini hosil qiladi.

Q: UPS dagi akkumulyatorlarni mustaqil ravishda almashtirish mumkinmi?
A: Ko'pchilik modellarda akkumulyatorlar foydalanuvchi tomonidan almashtiriladigan (hot-swap), biroq to'g'ri ishlash uchun almashtirishni servis mutaxassisiga ishonib topshirish tavsiya etiladi — u yacheykalar holatini tekshiradi, zaryad parametrlarini yangilaydi va yuklama ostidagi ishni sinovdan o'tkazadi. SAT Solutions UPS larning servis xizmatini Toshkent va O'zbekiston bo'ylab bajaradi.

Q: Obyektda dizel generatori bo'lsa, UPS kerakmi?
A: Ha, generator va UPS turli vazifalarni hal qiladi. Generator 10-30 soniyada ishga tushadi — bu vaqt ichida uskuna allaqachon toksiz qoladi. UPS bir zumda o'tishni ta'minlaydi va generator ishga tushishining butun vaqti davomida yuklamani quvvatlaydi, uskunaning nosozliklari va qayta yuklanishlarini istisno qiladi.

Q: UPS ning masofaviy monitoringini qanday tashkil etish mumkin?
A: Masofaviy monitoring uchun lokal tarmoqqa ulanadigan va UPS holati, batareyalar zaryad darajasi va yuklama parametrlari haqidagi ma'lumotlarni monitoring tizimi yoki e-mailga uzatadigan SNMP platalari yoki tarmoq kartalari qo'llaniladi. SAT Solutions katalogida mos UPS seriyalari uchun tegishli monitoring platalari va kartalari taqdim etilgan.
pxt-ups.en:
UPS and power supply are the foundation of the reliable operation of any security infrastructure and low-current systems. Uninterruptible power supplies, power distribution units, PoE injectors, power monitoring and management modules ensure the continuous operation of video surveillance, access control, server equipment and telecommunications nodes even during grid failures. Buying a UPS and related power supply equipment in Tashkent with professional selection and installation is offered by SAT Solutions.

The quality of the power grid in Uzbekistan remains uneven: voltage surges, brief dips and complete outages can disable expensive equipment or interrupt the operation of security systems at a critical moment. A properly selected UPS protects equipment from overvoltage, smooths out interference and provides autonomous operation for the duration of switching to a backup source or full operation for several hours. For facilities with high continuity requirements — banks, data centers, industrial enterprises — high-power three-phase online UPSs are used. For office and retail facilities, single-phase solutions of 1-10 kVA are more often sufficient.

The choice of a power supply solution depends on the system topology, the total load, the autonomy requirements and the presence of server racks. The SAT Solutions catalog features more than 73 items — from compact PoE injectors and voltage sensors to powerful 20 kVA rack UPSs with three-phase input and output, SNMP monitoring cards and intelligent PDU power outlet units.

## How to choose

- UPS topology type: online (double conversion) provides the highest level of protection — the load is always powered from the inverter; line-interactive UPSs are suitable for less critical tasks. For server rooms and video surveillance systems, an online topology is recommended.

- Power in kVA and kW: sum up the consumption of all connected equipment and add a 20-30% margin. For small NVRs with cameras, 1-3 kVA is sufficient; for server racks and large data centers, solutions from 10 kVA and above are necessary.

- Number of phases: single-phase (1:1) UPSs are used for office and retail equipment; three-phase (3:3 or 3:1) — for industrial load, powerful server systems and facilities with a three-phase input.

- Form factor: floor-standing UPSs are convenient in the absence of server racks; rack models save space and simplify management in telecommunications cabinets.

- Autonomy time: determined by battery capacity. For security systems, 15-30 minutes is usually sufficient for a correct shutdown or switch to a generator; for round-the-clock autonomy, external battery modules are needed.

- Monitoring and management: SNMP cards and network cards make it possible to monitor the UPS status remotely, receive fault notifications and manage the load via a web interface or a monitoring system. For large facilities, this is a mandatory element.

- PoE power: when building IP video surveillance or IP telephony, clarify whether PoE injectors or managed PoE switches are needed — they simplify installation by eliminating separate power supplies for cameras and access points.

## Applications

- Video surveillance and security systems: the UPS ensures the continuous operation of NVRs, DVRs, IP cameras and video storage servers during a power outage, eliminating the loss of the video archive.

- Server rooms and data centers: high-power three-phase online UPSs, intelligent PDUs and SNMP monitoring cards form the basis of reliable power supply for the IT infrastructure of banks, telecommunications operators and corporate customers.

- Access control and security alarm systems: access controllers, readers and alarm panels require uninterruptible power — any failure can open doors or leave a facility without security.

- Retail and business centers: a UPS for cash equipment, POS terminals, network equipment and fire alarm systems prevents financial losses and downtime during grid instability.

- Industrial facilities and manufacturing: a UPS for automated control systems, industrial controllers and telecommunications equipment of enterprises, where stopping the technological process is unacceptable.

- Telecommunications and communication nodes: uninterruptible power for routers, switches, media converters and communication operators' equipment throughout Uzbekistan.

## Brands and models in the catalog

- Pixietech: the main brand in this category of the SAT Solutions catalog. The lineup covers online UPSs with power from small ones up to 20 kVA in single-phase and three-phase versions, rack and floor-standing form factors. A separate direction is intelligent PDUs (power distribution units) with IEC C13, IEC C19 and Schuko outlets, rated for a current of 32A.

- Pixietech monitoring cards and modules: SNMP network cards for remote monitoring of GXT5 series UPSs and others, monitoring cards for a load of 1-3 kW, RPCM 63A remote power management modules make it possible to build centralized power supply monitoring systems.

- Pixietech PoE equipment: unmanaged 802.3af PoE injectors (for example, PI-154-1A) for powering IP cameras and access points over twisted pair — a simple solution for facilities without PoE switches.

- Control and metering devices: Phase Detector voltage sensors for monitoring a three-phase grid, Tuya Smart electricity meters with Wi-Fi for remote consumption metering — relevant for facilities with energy efficiency requirements.

- Accessories and mounting kits: mounting kits for installing a UPS in a server rack, power cables and adapters — the entire kit for installation is available in one place.

## FAQ

Q: Which UPS should I choose for a video surveillance system of 8-16 cameras?
A: For a typical system with IP cameras and an NVR, a single-phase online UPS with a power of 1-3 kVA is sufficient. The exact calculation depends on the consumption of the cameras, the recorder and the network equipment — our specialists will do the calculation for free.

Q: What is the difference between an online UPS and a line-interactive one?
A: An online UPS (double conversion) constantly powers the load from the inverter, fully isolating it from grid interference and surges — this is the highest level of protection. A line-interactive UPS switches to the battery only when the voltage goes beyond the permissible limits, which creates a brief power break of the order of a few milliseconds.

Q: Can I replace the batteries in a UPS myself?
A: In most models the batteries are user-replaceable (hot-swap), however for correct operation it is recommended to entrust the replacement to a service specialist — they will check the condition of the cells, update the charge parameters and test operation under load. SAT Solutions performs UPS service throughout Tashkent and Uzbekistan.

Q: Is a UPS needed if the facility has a diesel generator?
A: Yes, a generator and a UPS solve different tasks. A generator starts in 10-30 seconds — during this time the equipment is already de-energized. The UPS provides instant switching and powers the load for the entire generator startup time, eliminating equipment failures and reboots.

Q: How do I organize remote monitoring of a UPS?
A: For remote monitoring, SNMP cards or network cards are used, which connect to the local network and transmit data about the UPS status, battery charge level and load parameters to a monitoring system or to e-mail. The SAT Solutions catalog features the corresponding monitoring cards for compatible UPS series.

Aksessuarlar — bu xavfsizlik va tarmoq tizimlari loyihasining eng oxirida esga olinadigan qismi, garchi ko'pincha obyektning nizom bo'yicha ishga tushishi va nosozliksiz qancha xizmat qilishi aynan unga bog'liq bo'lsa-da. Ushbu kategoriyada hech bir montaj usiz o'tmaydigan sarf va yordamchi komponentlar to'plangan: kabel mahsulotlari, kommutatsiya elementlari, mahkamlagichlar va tegishli materiallar. Toshkentda muayyan videokuzatuv yoki SKT loyihasi uchun aksessuarlarni sotib olishni SAT Solutions katalogi orqali amalga oshirish mumkin — biz pozitsiyalarni obyektda o'rnatiladigan kameralar, registratorlar va tarmoq uskunasiga mos keladigan qilib tanlaymiz.

Aksessuarlarning asosiy roli — uskunaning ishonchli jismoniy ulanishi va quvvatini ta'minlash. O'ralgan juftlik, ulagichlar va mahkamlagichlar sifatiga signal uzatish masofasi, kameralar PoE-ta'minotining barqarorligi va liniyaning xalaqitlarga chidamliligi bevosita bog'liq. Bu moddada tejash deyarli har doim tasvir pasayishi, kadrlar yo'qolishi va qurilmalarning yolg'on «uzilishlari» bilan yakunlanadi, ular keyinchalik uzoq va qimmat diagnostika qilinadi. Shuning uchun malakali integrator aksessuarlarga kameralar va kommutatorlarning o'ziga qanchalik jiddiy qarasa, shunchalik jiddiy qaraydi.

O'zbekiston sharoitida aksessuarlarni tanlashga iqlim talablari qo'shiladi. +45 °C gacha yozgi issiq, kunduzi va kechasi o'rtasidagi harorat o'zgarishlari, chang va quruq havo kabel trassalari va izolyatsiyani, ayniqsa tashqi uchastkalar va isitilmaydigan xonalarda yuklaydi. Ofislar, savdo markazlari, ishlab chiqarishlar, turar-joy majmualari va viloyatlardagi obyektlar uchun mos kategoriya, qobiq va kesimga ega, «laboratoriya» sharoitlariga emas, haqiqiy yuklamalarga mo'ljallangan materiallar kerak. SAT Solutions aksessuarlarni ekspluatatsiya muhiti va tizimning boshqa uskunasi bilan moslikni hisobga olib tanlaydi.

## Qanday tanlash kerak

- **Kabel kategoriyasi:** zamonaviy videokuzatuv va tarmoqlar uchun bazaviy vazifalar uchun CAT5e ni, gigabitli tezlik va polosa bo'yicha zaxira kerak bo'lgan joylarda esa CAT6 ni tanlang. Katalogda ikkala variant ham taqdim etilgan — Dahua PFM920I-5EUN (CAT5e) va PFM920I-6UN-CN (CAT6).
- **O'tkazgich turi:** mis barqaror PoE va e'lon qilingan masofani beradi, misli o'tkazgichlar (CCA) esa kuchlanish tushishiga va uzun trassalarda kameralarning beqaror ishlashiga olib keladi. Xavfsizlik tizimlari uchun sof mis afzalroq.
- **Kesim va trassa uzunligi:** Ethernet uchun 100 metrli liniya byudjetini hisobga oling va uzoqdagi kameralarda PoE-pasayishga zaxira qo'ying; muhim uchastkalarda masofani qisqartiring yoki oraliq uskuna o'rnating.
- **Qobiq turi va montaj muhiti:** ichki tortish uchun standart qobiq yetarli, ko'cha va isitilmaydigan zonalar uchun o'zbek iqlimiga dolzarb ultrabinafsha, chang va harorat o'zgarishlariga chidamli materiallar kerak.
- **Ekranlash:** kuchli elektromagnit xalaqitlarga ega obyektlarda (kuchli kabellar yonida, ishlab chiqarishda) ekranlangan yechimlarni ko'rib chiqing, xotirjam ofis muhitida ekranlanmagan o'ralgan juftlik yetarli.
- **Uskuna bilan moslik:** aksessuarlar kameralar, registratorlar va kommutatorlarga ulagichlar, quvvat va kategoriya bo'yicha mos kelishi kerak — shuning uchun kabel va komponentlarni asosiy uskuna bilan bitta brenddan olish qulayroq, masalan Dahua liniyasi.
- **Zaxira va ta'mirlanuvchanlik:** takomillashtirish va xizmat ko'rsatish uchun kabel va sarf materiallarining kichik zaxirasini qo'ying, shunda bir necha metr yetishmasligi tufayli montajni to'xtatmang.

## Qo'llanilish sohalari

- **Ofislar va biznes-markazlar:** strukturalangan kabel tizimlari, IP-kameralar, kirish nuqtalari va ish joylarini ulash.
- **Savdo va riteyl:** videokuzatuv va tarmoq savdo zallari, omborlar va kassa zonalarini qamrab olgan do'konlar, supermarketlar va savdo markazlari.
- **Ishlab chiqarish va omborlar:** uzun trassalar, xalaqitga chidamlilik va liniyalarning mexanik mustahkamligiga yuqori talablar.
- **Turar-joy majmualari va xususiy uylar:** domofoniya, hovlilar, kiraverishlar va parkinglarda videokuzatuv, internet-infratuzilmaga ulanish.
- **Davlat muassasalari va ta'lim:** maktablar, poliklinikalar, ma'muriy binolar, bu yerda ishonchlilik va loyiha hujjatlariga muvofiqlik muhim.
- **Maxsus obyektlar va perimetr:** tashqi kameralar, nazorat-o'tkazish punktlari, to'siqlar va uzoq nuqtalar, bu yerda kabel va aksessuarlar qattiq ko'cha sharoitlarida ishlaydi.

## Katalogdagi brendlar va modellar

- **Dahua** — kategoriyaning asosiy brendi: xuddi shu ishlab chiqaruvchining kameralari va registratorlari bilan birgalikda ishlashga mo'ljallangan firma kabel mahsulotlari.
- **Dahua PFM920I-5EUN** — videokuzatuv va tarmoqlarning bazaviy vazifalari uchun UTP CAT5e kabeli, tipik trassalarda narx va ishonchlilik nisbati bo'yicha optimal tanlov.
- **Dahua PFM920I-6UN-CN** — o'tkazuvchanlik bo'yicha zaxiraga ega gigabitli liniyalar va loyihalar uchun UTP CAT6 kabeli, bu yerda modernizatsiya istiqboli muhim.
- **Yagona Dahua ekotizimi** — bitta ishlab chiqaruvchining kameralari, NVR va kommutatorlariga aksessuarlarni tanlash montaj, kafolat va keyingi xizmat ko'rsatishni soddalashtiradi.

## FAQ

Q: CAT5e CAT6 dan nimasi bilan farq qiladi va videokuzatuv uchun nimani tanlash kerak?
A: CAT5e qisqa trassalarda gigabitgacha bo'lgan IP-videokuzatuv va tarmoqlarning ko'pchilik vazifalarini ishonchli bajaradi, CAT6 esa polosa va xalaqitga chidamlilik bo'yicha kattaroq zaxira beradi. Toshkentdagi tipik obyektlar uchun Dahua PFM920I-5EUN mos keladi, agar modernizatsiya istiqbolini nazarda tutsangiz — CAT6 PFM920I-6UN-CN ni oling. SAT Solutions menejerlari loyihangiz uchun optimal variantni aniqlashga yordam beradi.

Q: Dahua kabeli kameralarni PoE-ta'minlash uchun mos keladimi?
A: Ha, Dahua ning firma mis o'ralgan juftligi standart 100 metr chegarasida ma'lumotlar va PoE-ta'minotni barqaror uzatishga mo'ljallangan. Kuchlanish pasayishlarini oldini olish uchun aynan mis o'tkazgichdan foydalanish muhim, misli emas. SAT Solutions original mahsulotlarni yetkazadi va montajdan keyin liniyalarni tekshiradi.

Q: Kabel +45 °C gacha issiq sharoitida ko'chaga tortishga chidaydimi?
A: Tashqi trassalar uchun ultrabinafsha, chang va harorat o'zgarishlariga chidamli mos qobiqli kabelni tanlash kerak. Biz materiallarni tanlashda O'zbekiston iqlimini va muayyan uchastka sharoitlarini hisobga olamiz. Ayniqsa yuklangan tashqi liniyalarda qo'shimcha himoya choralari va trassani malakali tashkil etishni tavsiya qilamiz.

Q: Aksessuarlarni asosiy uskunasiz alohida sotib olish mumkinmi?
A: Ha, aksessuarlar va kabel mahsulotlarini SAT Solutions katalogi orqali alohida pozitsiya sifatida sotib olish mumkin. Bunda biz nomuvofiqlikni oldini olish uchun tanlovni kameralaringiz va kommutatorlaringiz xarakteristikalari bilan kelishishni maslahat beramiz. Toshkentdagi mutaxassislarimiz mavjud tizimga kerakli komponentlarni tanlab beradi.

Q: SAT Solutions faqat yetkazib berishni emas, kabel trassalari montajini ham bajaradimi?
A: Ha, biz to'liq sikl bilan ishlaymiz — aksessuarlarni tanlash va yetkazishdan tortib trassalarni tortish, ulash, sinash va ishga tushirish-sozlashgacha. Ishlar Toshkentda ham, O'zbekiston viloyatlarida ham bajariladi. Ishga tushirilgandan keyin biz tizim servis xizmatini davom ettiramiz.
dahua-accessories.en:
Accessories are the part of a security and network systems project that is remembered last, although it is often this part that determines whether the facility will operate as intended and how long it will serve without failures. This category brings together consumable and auxiliary components without which no installation is complete: cable products, switching elements, mounting hardware and related materials. Buying accessories in Tashkent for a specific video surveillance or structured cabling system project is possible through the SAT Solutions catalog — we select items so that they match the cameras, recorders and network equipment installed at the facility.

The main role of accessories is to ensure a reliable physical connection and power supply for the equipment. The signal transmission range, the stability of PoE power for cameras and the line's resistance to interference directly depend on the quality of the twisted pair, connectors and mounting hardware. Saving on this line item almost always results in image degradation, frame loss and false device "dropouts" that are then long and expensive to diagnose. That is why a competent integrator treats accessories as seriously as the cameras and switches themselves.

In the conditions of Uzbekistan, climatic requirements are added to the choice of accessories. Summer heat up to +45 °C, temperature swings between day and night, dust and dry air load cable routes and insulation, especially on outdoor sections and in unheated premises. For offices, shopping centers, factories, residential complexes and facilities in the regions, materials with a suitable category, sheath and cross-section are needed, designed for real loads rather than "laboratory" conditions. SAT Solutions selects accessories taking into account the operating environment and compatibility with the rest of the system equipment.

## How to choose

- **Cable category:** for modern video surveillance and networks, choose CAT5e for basic tasks and CAT6 where gigabit speed and bandwidth headroom are needed. The catalog features both options — Dahua PFM920I-5EUN (CAT5e) and PFM920I-6UN-CN (CAT6).
- **Conductor type:** copper provides stable PoE and the declared range, whereas copper-clad conductors (CCA) lead to voltage drops and unstable camera operation on long routes. For security systems, solid copper is preferable.
- **Cross-section and route length:** consider the 100-meter line budget for Ethernet and allow a margin for PoE drop with remote cameras; on critical sections, reduce the distance or install intermediate equipment.
- **Sheath type and installation environment:** for indoor routing a standard sheath is sufficient; for outdoors and unheated zones, materials resistant to ultraviolet, dust and temperature swings relevant to the Uzbek climate are needed.
- **Shielding:** at facilities with strong electromagnetic interference (near power cables, at a production site), consider shielded solutions; in a quiet office environment, unshielded twisted pair is enough.
- **Compatibility with equipment:** accessories must match the cameras, recorders and switches in terms of connectors, power and category — so it is more convenient to take cable and components of the same brand as the main equipment, for example the Dahua lineup.
- **Reserve and maintainability:** allow a small reserve of cable and consumables for refinements and maintenance, so as not to halt installation due to a shortage of a few meters.

## Applications

- **Offices and business centers:** structured cabling systems, connection of IP cameras, access points and workstations.
- **Retail:** stores, supermarkets and shopping centers, where video surveillance and the network cover sales floors, warehouses and cash zones.
- **Manufacturing and warehouses:** long routes, heightened requirements for interference immunity and mechanical strength of lines.
- **Residential complexes and private houses:** intercom systems, video surveillance in yards, entrances and parking lots, connection to internet infrastructure.
- **Government institutions and education:** schools, clinics, administrative buildings, where reliability and compliance with project documentation are important.
- **Special facilities and perimeter:** outdoor cameras, checkpoints, fences and remote points, where cable and accessories operate in harsh outdoor conditions.

## Brands and models in the catalog

- **Dahua** — the main brand of the category: branded cable products designed to work together with cameras and recorders of the same manufacturer.
- **Dahua PFM920I-5EUN** — a UTP CAT5e cable for basic video surveillance and network tasks, the optimal choice in terms of price-reliability ratio on standard routes.
- **Dahua PFM920I-6UN-CN** — a UTP CAT6 cable for gigabit lines and projects with bandwidth headroom, where the prospect of modernization is important.
- **Unified Dahua ecosystem** — selecting accessories for cameras, NVRs and switches of a single manufacturer simplifies installation, warranty and further service.

## FAQ

Q: How does CAT5e differ from CAT6 and what should I choose for video surveillance?
A: CAT5e confidently handles most IP video surveillance and network tasks up to a gigabit on short routes, while CAT6 provides greater bandwidth headroom and interference immunity. For typical facilities in Tashkent, Dahua PFM920I-5EUN is suitable, and if you are planning for modernization — take CAT6 PFM920I-6UN-CN. SAT Solutions managers will help determine the optimal option for your project.

Q: Is Dahua cable suitable for PoE powering of cameras?
A: Yes, the branded copper twisted pair from Dahua is designed for stable data transmission and PoE power within the standard 100 meters. It is important to use a copper conductor specifically, not a copper-clad one, to avoid voltage drops. SAT Solutions supplies original products and checks the lines after installation.

Q: Will the cable withstand outdoor routing in heat up to +45 °C?
A: For outdoor routes, it is necessary to select cable with a suitable sheath resistant to ultraviolet, dust and temperature swings. We take into account the climate of Uzbekistan and the conditions of the specific section when choosing materials. On especially loaded outdoor lines, we recommend additional protection measures and competent route organization.

Q: Can accessories be bought separately, without the main equipment?
A: Yes, accessories and cable products can be purchased as a separate item through the SAT Solutions catalog. At the same time, we advise coordinating the choice with the specifications of your cameras and switches to avoid incompatibility. Our specialists in Tashkent will select the necessary components for an already existing system.

Q: Does SAT Solutions perform installation of cable routes, and not only supply?
A: Yes, we work on a full cycle — from selecting and supplying accessories to laying routes, termination, testing and commissioning. Work is performed both in Tashkent and in the regions of Uzbekistan. After launch, we continue system service.

Master-stansiyalar — bu videodomofoniya tizimlari va ular bilan bog'liq videokuzatuv infratuzilmasidagi markaziy boshqaruv qurilmalari. Ular chaqiruv panellari, abonent monitorlari, IP-kameralar va tegishli uskuna ulanadigan yadro rolini bajaradi, chaqiruvlar kommutatsiyasi, hodisalarni yozib olish va kirishni nazorat qilishning yagona mantiqini ta'minlaydi. Toshkentda muayyan obyekt arxitekturasi uchun master-stansiyalarni sotib olishni SAT Solutions katalogi orqali amalga oshirish mumkin — biz qurilmani abonentlar soni, video oqimlar bo'yicha yuklama va integratsiya stsenariylari bo'yicha tanlaymiz, shunchaki quti sotmaymiz.

Bir kvartiraga mo'ljallangan maishiy domofondan farqli o'laroq, master-stansiya miqyosga mo'ljallangan: o'nlab kiraverishga ega turar-joy majmuasi, ko'p darajali o'tkazish tizimiga ega biznes-markaz, taqsimlangan kirish nuqtalariga ega sanoat maydonchasi. Bunday qurilma bir vaqtning o'zida panellar va monitorlar o'rtasidagi chaqiruvlarni boshqaradi, video arxivni yuritadi, kirish huquqlarini ishlab chiqadi va ko'pincha yaqin kameralar uchun videokuzatuv serveri vazifasini bajaradi. Aynan shuning uchun master-stansiyani tanlashga abonent emas, server uskunasini tanlashday yondashiladi.

O'zbekiston bozori uchun ushbu kategoriya ayniqsa faol qurilish va modernizatsiya ketayotgan joylarda dolzarb: Toshkent va viloyat markazlaridagi yangi TJM lar, ma'muriy binolarni rekonstruksiya qilish, ishlab chiqarish va logistika majmualarini jihozlash. Yozda +45 °C gacha haroratli iqlim, kuchlanish o'zgarishlari va bir vaqtning o'zida ko'p sonli foydalanuvchilar markaziy tugun ishonchliligiga yuqori talablar qo'yadi. Obyekt o'sishi bilan yangi kiraverishlar, o'tkazgichlar va kameralar qo'shiladi, va aynan master-stansiya tizim qanchalik og'riqsiz masshtablanishini belgilaydi. Tanlashdagi xato shunchaki bitta yashovchining noqulayligini emas, obyektdagi butun aloqa va kirish tizimining nosozligini anglatadi, shuning uchun bu yerda malakali loyihalash muhim.

Alohida ta'kidlash kerakki, master-stansiya kamdan-kam holatda izolyatsiyalangan ishlaydi. Zamonaviy obyektlarda u bir necha quyi tizimlar — videodomofoniya, videokuzatuv, kirishni nazorat qilish va trevoga signalizatsiyasi — kesishuv nuqtasiga aylanadi, va ularni boshqariladigan yaxlitlikka birlashtirishga erishilishi uning dasturiy platformasiga bog'liq. Shuning uchun tanlashda nafaqat qurilmaning texnik xarakteristikalariga, balki ishlab chiqaruvchi ekotizimiga, yangilanishlar mavjudligiga va ekspluatatsiya mamlakatida malakali qo'llab-quvvatlash borligiga ham qarash muhim.

## Qanday tanlash kerak

- **Abonentlar va panellarning maksimal soni:** bugun va obyekt rivojlanishi uchun zaxira bilan stansiyaga qancha chaqiruv paneli, monitor va kirish nuqtasi haqiqatda ulanishini baholang.
- **Video oqimlar bo'yicha unumdorlik:** Dahua DSS-OneBox kabi videokuzatuv serveri darajasidagi qurilmalar uchun bir vaqtdagi yozib olish va ko'rish kanallari soni, shuningdek umumiy bitreyt muhim.
- **Xotira hajmi va turi:** arxiv chuqurligini kunlarda aniqlang va tegishli disklar hajmini qo'ying; mas'ul obyektlarda nosozlikka chidamlilik uchun RAID qo'llab-quvvatlashini hisobga oling.
- **Ekotizim mosligi:** master-stansiya va chaqiruv panellari, monitorlar, kameralar bitta dasturiy platformada ishlashi kerak — tekshirilgan integratsiyasiz brendlarni aralashtirish funksiyalar yo'qotilishiga olib keladi.
- **Tarmoq arxitekturasi:** PoE qo'llab-quvvatlashini, tarmoq portlari sonini, obyektning taqsimlangan tarmog'ida ishlash va bir necha VLAN orqali ulanish imkoniyatini aniqlang.
- **SKUD va trevoga bilan integratsiya:** kirishni nazorat qilish, trevoga kirishlariga reaksiya va binoning boshqa xavfsizlik quyi tizimlari bilan aloqa qo'llab-quvvatlashini tekshiring.
- **Ekspluatatsiya sharoitlari va quvvat:** O'zbekiston uchun yuqori haroratlarda barqarorlik, quvvat bo'yicha himoya va uzluksiz quvvat manbalari bilan moslik muhim.

## Qo'llanilish sohalari

- Turar-joy majmualari va ko'p kvartirali uylar — barcha kiraverishlar bo'ylab chaqiruvlar va kirishni markazlashtirilgan boshqarish.
- Biznes-markazlar va ofis binolari — resepshen, qorovul postlari va ijarachilar aloqasining yagona tizimi.
- Ishlab chiqarish va ombor majmualari — taqsimlangan o'tkazgichlarni nazorat qilish va sexlar o'rtasidagi aloqa.
- Davlat va ma'muriy muassasalar — rejim kiraverishlarida boshqariladigan kirish va hodisalarni qayd etish.
- Savdo obyektlari va servis markazlari — xizmat va mijoz zonalarining markaziy post bilan aloqasi.
- Xavfsizlikka yuqori talablar qo'yiladigan maxsus obyektlar — domofoniya, videokuzatuv va SKUD ni bitta yadroga integratsiya qilish.

## Katalogdagi brendlar va modellar

- **Dahua** — kategoriyaning asosiy brendi; domofoniya va videokuzatuvni markazlashtirilgan boshqarish uchun quyi tizimlarning tekshirilgan integratsiyasiga ega korporativ darajadagi yechimlar.
- **Dahua DSS-OneBox-H1/128** — master-stansiya vazifasini bajaruvchi videokuzatuv va boshqaruv serveri: video kanallari, domofoniya hodisalari va kirish mantiqini korxona darajasidagi yagona qurilmada birlashtiradi.
- Dahua DSS-OneBox seriyasi tayyor joylashtirishga yo'naltirilgan: oldindan o'rnatilgan boshqaruv DT va apparat qismi yagona majmua sifatida yetkaziladi, bu esa obyektni ishga tushirish muddatlarini qisqartiradi.
- Dahua DSS platformasi obyekt o'sishi bilan tizim yadrosini almashtirmasdan ulangan panellar, monitorlar va kameralar sonini oshirish imkonini beradi.

## FAQ

Q: Master-stansiya oddiy videodomofondan nimasi bilan farq qiladi?
A: Oddiy domofon bitta kvartira yoki kiraverishga xizmat qiladi, master-stansiya esa — ko'plab panellar, monitorlar va kirish nuqtalarini bir vaqtning o'zida boshqaradigan markaziy tugun. U arxiv yuritadi, kirish huquqlarini qayta ishlaydi va ko'pincha videokuzatuv serveri sifatida ishlaydi. O'zbekistondagi yirik obyektlar uchun bunday yadrosiz boshqariladigan tizim qurish deyarli mumkin emas.

Q: Dahua DSS-OneBox turar-joy majmuasi uchun mos keladimi?
A: Ha, bu yechim aynan ko'p sonli abonentlar va video kanallariga ega yirik obyektlarga yo'naltirilgan. U domofoniya, videokuzatuv va kirishni nazorat qilishni yagona qurilmada birlashtiradi. Muayyan model va konfiguratsiyani SAT Solutions kiraverishlar soni va talab qilinadigan arxiv chuqurligiga qarab tanlaydi.

Q: Master-stansiyaga allaqachon o'rnatilgan kameralarni ulash mumkinmi?
A: Ko'pchilik holatlarda ha, agar kameralar mos protokollarni qo'llab-quvvatlasa va bitta platformada ishlasa. Tekshirish bosqichida biz mavjud uskunani tekshiramiz va nima to'g'ridan-to'g'ri integratsiyalanishini, nima almashtirishni talab qilishini aniqlaymiz. Bu buyurtmachi sarmoyalarining bir qismini saqlab qolish imkonini beradi.

Q: Toshkentdagi yuqori yozgi haroratlar stansiya ishiga qanday ta'sir qiladi?
A: Markaziy uskuna odatda iqlim nazoratiga ega server yoki apparat xonasida joylashtiriladi, bu esa xatarlarning katta qismini bartaraf etadi. Loyihalashda SAT Solutions O'zbekiston sharoitlariga mo'ljallangan sovutish, quvvat bo'yicha himoya va zaxiralashni qo'yadi. Bu ko'chada +45 °C gacha haroratlarda barqaror ishlashni ta'minlaydi.

Q: SAT Solutions faqat Toshkentda emas, viloyatlarda ham montaj bajaradimi?
A: Ha, biz O'zbekiston bo'ylab, jumladan viloyat markazlari va uzoq maydonchalarda loyihalarni amalga oshiramiz. Ishlar hajmiga tarmoqlarni tortish, master-stansiyani o'rnatish va sozlash, ishga tushirish-sozlash va xodimlarni o'qitish kiradi. Muayyan viloyat bo'yicha muddatlar va logistikani aniqlashtirish uchun menejerlar bilan bog'lanish yetarli.
master-stations.en:
Master stations are the central control devices in video intercom systems and the related video surveillance infrastructure. They act as the core to which call panels, subscriber monitors, IP cameras and related equipment are connected, providing a unified logic for call switching, event recording and access control. Buying master stations in Tashkent for a specific facility architecture is possible through the SAT Solutions catalog — we select the device by the number of subscribers, the load in video streams and integration scenarios, rather than just selling a box.

Unlike a household intercom for a single apartment, a master station is designed for scale: a residential complex with dozens of entrances, a business center with a multi-level pass system, an industrial site with distributed entry points. Such a device simultaneously manages calls between panels and monitors, maintains a video archive, processes access rights and often acts as a video surveillance server for adjacent cameras. That is precisely why the choice of a master station is approached like the choice of server, rather than subscriber, equipment.

For the Uzbek market, this category is especially relevant where active construction and modernization are underway: new residential complexes in Tashkent and regional centers, reconstruction of administrative buildings, equipping industrial and logistics complexes. A climate with summer temperatures up to +45 °C, voltage swings and a large number of simultaneous users place heightened requirements on the reliability of the central node. As the facility grows, new entrances, checkpoints and cameras are added, and it is precisely the master station that determines how painlessly the system scales. An error in selection means not just the inconvenience of one resident, but a failure of the entire communication and access system at the facility, so competent design is critical here.

Separately, it is worth considering that a master station rarely works in isolation. At modern facilities, it becomes the convergence point of several subsystems — video intercom, video surveillance, access control and alarm signaling — and it is its software platform that determines whether they can be combined into a manageable whole. Therefore, when choosing, it is important to look not only at the technical characteristics of the device itself, but also at the manufacturer's ecosystem, the availability of updates and the presence of qualified support in the country of operation.

## How to choose

- **Maximum number of subscribers and panels:** assess how many call panels, monitors and access points will actually connect to the station today and with a margin for facility development.
- **Video stream performance:** for devices at the level of a video surveillance server, such as the Dahua DSS-OneBox, the number of simultaneous recording and viewing channels, as well as the total bitrate, is important.
- **Storage volume and type:** determine the archive depth in days and allocate the corresponding disk volume; consider RAID support for fault tolerance at critical facilities.
- **Ecosystem compatibility:** the master station and call panels, monitors, cameras must work in a single software platform — mixing brands without proven integration leads to loss of functions.
- **Network architecture:** clarify PoE support, the number of network ports, the ability to operate in a distributed facility network and connect over several VLANs.
- **Integration with ACS and alarms:** check support for access control, response to alarm inputs and communication with other building security subsystems.
- **Operating conditions and power:** for Uzbekistan, stability at high temperatures, power protection and compatibility with uninterruptible power supplies are important.

## Applications

- Residential complexes and apartment buildings — centralized management of calls and access across all entrances.
- Business centers and office buildings — a unified communication system for reception, security posts and tenants.
- Manufacturing and warehouse complexes — control of distributed checkpoints and communication between workshops.
- Government and administrative institutions — managed access and event logging at restricted-access entrances.
- Retail facilities and service centers — communication of service and client zones with a central post.
- Special facilities with heightened security requirements — integration of intercom, video surveillance and ACS in a single core.

## Brands and models in the catalog

- **Dahua** — the key brand of the category; enterprise-level solutions for centralized management of intercom and video surveillance with proven subsystem integration.
- **Dahua DSS-OneBox-H1/128** — a video surveillance and management server acting as a master station: it combines video channels, intercom events and access logic in a single enterprise-level device.
- The Dahua DSS-OneBox series is oriented toward ready-made deployment: the preinstalled management software and hardware part are supplied as a single complex, which shortens the facility launch time.
- The Dahua DSS platform makes it possible to increase the number of connected panels, monitors and cameras as the facility grows without changing the system core.

## FAQ

Q: How does a master station differ from an ordinary video intercom?
A: An ordinary intercom serves one apartment or entrance, whereas a master station is a central node managing many panels, monitors and access points simultaneously. It maintains an archive, processes access rights and often works as a video surveillance server. For large facilities in Uzbekistan, building a manageable system without such a core is practically impossible.

Q: Is the Dahua DSS-OneBox suitable for a residential complex?
A: Yes, this solution is oriented precisely toward large-scale facilities with a large number of subscribers and video channels. It combines intercom, video surveillance and access control in a single device. SAT Solutions selects the specific model and configuration for the number of entrances and the required archive depth.

Q: Can already installed cameras be connected to the master station?
A: In most cases yes, if the cameras support compatible protocols and work in a single platform. At the survey stage, we check the existing equipment and determine what integrates directly and what will require replacement. This allows part of the customer's investment to be preserved.

Q: How do high summer temperatures in Tashkent affect the station's operation?
A: Central equipment is usually placed in a server or hardware room with climate control, which removes most of the risks. During design, SAT Solutions provides for cooling, power protection and redundancy designed for the conditions of Uzbekistan. This ensures stable operation at temperatures up to +45 °C outdoors.

Q: Does SAT Solutions perform installation in the regions, and not only in Tashkent?
A: Yes, we implement projects throughout Uzbekistan, including regional centers and remote sites. The scope of work includes laying networks, installing and configuring the master station, commissioning and staff training. To clarify timelines and logistics for a specific region, it is enough to contact the managers.

Tarmoq uskunasi uchun aksessuarlar — bu yordamchi komponentlar bo'lib, ularsiz hech bir xavfsizlik va aloqa tizimlari inshooti yagona yaxlit sifatida ishlamaydi. Ushbu kategoriyaga PoE-injektorlar, quvvat elementlari, montaj va kommutatsiya aksessuarlari kiradi, ular elektr energiyasi va ma'lumotlarni bitta kabel orqali yetkazishni, uskunaning to'g'ri ulanishini va butun infratuzilmaning barqaror ishlashini ta'minlaydi. Toshkentda va O'zbekistonning boshqa viloyatlarida tarmoq uskunasi uchun aksessuarlarni sotib olishni SAT Solutions katalogi orqali amalga oshirish mumkin — biz montaj bosqichida xatolarning oldini olish uchun mos komponentlarni muayyan kamera, kirish nuqtasi yoki kommutator modeliga tanlaymiz.

Ushbu kategoriyada asosiy rolni PoE-injektorlar o'ynaydi — kommutator Power over Ethernet texnologiyasini qo'llab-quvvatlamaydigan joyda oddiy tarmoq liniyasiga quvvat qo'shadigan qurilmalar. Bu keng tarqalgan holat: obyektga allaqachon PoE siz boshqarilmaydigan svich yoki router olib kelingan, IP-kamera, Wi-Fi-nuqta yoki IP-telefonni alohida kuchli liniya tortmasdan ulash kerak. Injektor vazifani bitta qurilma bilan hal qiladi, elektromontaj vaqti va xarajatlarini tejaydi va uskunani o'ralgan juftlik orqali 100 metrgacha masofada quvvatlash imkonini beradi.

O'zbekiston sharoitida aksessuarlarni to'g'ri tanlash ayniqsa muhim. Tarmoqdagi kuchlanish o'zgarishlari, +45 °C gacha yuqori yozgi haroratlar, viloyatlardagi obyektlardagi changlanish — bularning barchasi quvvat komponentlariga yuqori yuklama hosil qiladi. Quvvat bo'yicha zaxiraga va ortiqcha yuklamadan himoyaga ega sifatli PoE-injektor ulangan uskunaning xizmat muddatini uzaytiradi va servisga chiqishlar sonini kamaytiradi. Malakali tanlangan aksessuarlar — bu mayda-chuyda emas, balki butun videokuzatuv tizimi yoki korxonaning korporativ tarmog'i ishonchliligining poydevoridir.

Alohida ta'kidlash kerakki, aksessuarlar ko'pincha aynan xarid paytida tejash tufayli zaif bo'g'inga aylanadi. Standart bo'yicha nomos injektor qurilmani ishga tushirmasligi yoki uni ishdan chiqarishi mumkin, quvvat yetishmasligi esa yuklama ostidagi kameralar va kirish nuqtalarining beqaror ishlashiga olib keladi. Shuning uchun ushbu kategoriyani tanlashga asosiy uskunani tanlashday jiddiy yondashish kerak — va minimal narxga emas, hisobga tayanish kerak.

## Qanday tanlash kerak

- **PoE standarti:** uskunangiz qaysi standartni qo'llab-quvvatlashini aniqlang — IEEE 802.3af (15,4 Vt gacha), 802.3at/PoE+ (30 Vt gacha) yoki kuchliroq qurilmalar uchun PoE++. Injektor yuklama talablariga mos kelishi yoki ulardan ustun bo'lishi kerak.
- **Port quvvati:** ulanadigan qurilmaning energiya iste'molini zaxira bilan yig'ing. Masalan, aylanuvchi kamera yoki kuchli kirish nuqtasi 30 Vt va undan ko'proq talab qiladi, o'rnatilgan kameraga esa 15 Vt yetarli.
- **Port tezligi:** zamonaviy tarmoqlar uchun gigabitli modellarni (GE) tanlang — ular yuqori aniqlikdagi IP-kameralar va tezkor kirish nuqtalari trafigi uchun «tor bo'g'in» bo'lib qolmaydi.
- **Ortiqcha yuklama va QT dan himoya:** O'zbekiston viloyatlaridagi beqaror elektr tarmoqlari uchun ortiqcha yuklama, qisqa tutashuv va kuchlanish sakrashlaridan o'rnatilgan himoya mavjudligi muhim.
- **Passiv/aktiv PoE bilan moslik:** injektor kuchlanishni to'g'ri kelishishi va uskunani shikastlamasligi uchun qurilmangizning PoE turini aniqlang.
- **Uzatish masofasi:** qurilma kerakli kabel uzunligida quvvat va ma'lumotlarni barqaror ushlab turishiga ishonch hosil qiling (odatda, 5e kategoriyali va undan yuqori o'ralgan juftlik orqali 100 m gacha).
- **Ekspluatatsiya sharoitlari:** issiq xonalar va shamollatishsiz shchitlar uchun issiqlik ajratish bo'yicha zaxiraga va sifatli korpusga ega modellarni tanlang.

## Qo'llanilish sohalari

- **Ofislar va biznes-markazlar:** kommutator PoE ni qo'llab-quvvatlamaydigan joylarda IP-telefonlar, Wi-Fi kirish nuqtalari va kameralarni ulash.
- **Savdo obyektlari:** videokuzatuv allaqachon mavjud tarmoq ustiga kengaytiriladigan do'konlar, supermarketlar va SDM lar.
- **Ishlab chiqarish va ombor xonalari:** kuchli liniyalarni tortmasdan uzoqdagi kameralar va kirish nuqtalariga quvvat berish.
- **Turar-joy majmualari va xususiy uylar:** domofoniya, kiraverishlar va kirishlardagi kameralar, maishiy kirish nuqtalari.
- **Davlat muassasalari:** mavjud tarmoq infratuzilmasini to'liq almashtirmasdan qo'shimcha jihozlash.
- **Maxsus obyektlar va uzoq maydonchalar:** O'zbekiston viloyatlaridagi obyektlar, bu yerda ulanishning avtonomligi va quvvat o'zgarishlariga chidamlilik muhim.

## Katalogdagi brendlar va modellar

- **Ruijie RG-E-130(GE)** — o'tkazuvchanlikni yo'qotmasdan to'liq tezlikdagi 1 Gbit/s kanal talab qilinadigan tarmoqlarda kameralar va kirish nuqtalarini ulash uchun gigabitli PoE-injektor.
- **Ruijie RG-POE-50-60W-MG** — energiya talab qiluvchi qurilmalar uchun 60 Vt gacha kuchaytirilgan quvvatli injektor: aylanuvchi kameralar, ko'p diapazonli kirish nuqtalari va yuqori iste'molli uskuna.
- **Ruijie RG-POE-AT30** — 30 Vt gacha quvvatli PoE+ (802.3at) standartidagi injektor, ko'pchilik IP-kameralar va o'rta sinf kirish nuqtalari uchun mos.
- **Ruijie** — SAT Solutions katalogida ushbu brendning Ruijie kommutatorlari va kirish nuqtalari ekotizimi bilan mos quvvat aksessuarlari taqdim etilgan, bu esa yagona boshqariladigan tarmoqni qurishni soddalashtiradi.

## FAQ

Q: PoE-injektor PoE-kommutatordan nimasi bilan farq qiladi?
A: Injektor asosiy kommutator PoE ni qo'llab-quvvatlamaganda bitta liniyaga quvvat qo'shadi, PoE-kommutator esa bir necha portni bir vaqtda quvvatlaydi. Injektor mavjud uskunani almashtirmasdan bir-ikkita qurilmani quvvatlash kerak bo'lganda foydali. SAT Solutions mutaxassislari Toshkentdagi obyektingiz uchun optimal yechimni tanlashga yordam beradi.

Q: IP-kamera uchun qanday quvvatli injektor kerak?
A: O'rnatilgan kamera uchun odatda 15,4 Vt (802.3af) yetarli, isitgichli yoki IK-yoritishli aylanuvchi kamera uchun — 30 Vt va undan ko'proq. Zaxiraga ega modelni olish yaxshiroq, masalan 30 Vt li Ruijie RG-POE-AT30 yoki 60 Vt li RG-POE-50-60W-MG. Aniq hisobni biz muayyan uskuna modeli uchun bajaramiz.

Q: PoE-injektor qancha masofada ishlaydi?
A: 5e kategoriyali va undan yuqori kabeldan foydalanganda o'ralgan juftlik orqali quvvat va ma'lumotlar uzatishning standart masofasi 100 metrgacha tashkil etadi. Kattaroq masofalarda qo'shimcha yechimlar qo'llaniladi — PoE uzaytirgichlari yoki oraliq uskuna. Biz ulanish sxemasini obyektingizdagi trassalar uzunligini hisobga olib tanlaymiz.

Q: Ruijie injektori boshqa brendlar kameralariga mos keladimi?
A: Ruijie PoE-injektorlari IEEE standartlari bo'yicha ishlaydi, shuning uchun ishlab chiqaruvchidan qat'i nazar standart PoE ni qo'llab-quvvatlaydigan ko'pchilik qurilmalar bilan mos keladi. Standart mosligi va yetarli quvvat muhim. SAT Solutions montajdagi xatarlarni istisno qilish uchun mosligini yetkazib berishdan oldin tekshiradi.

Q: Uskuna O'zbekistonning issiq iqlimiga chidaydimi?
A: Ruijie aksessuarlari keng harorat diapazonida ekspluatatsiyaga mo'ljallangan, ammo +45 °C gacha sharoitlarda to'g'ri montaj va shchitlarni shamollatish muhim. Biz quvvatlovchi uskunani issiqlik chiqarish va qizib ketishdan himoyani hisobga olib o'rnatamiz. Bu nosozliklar sonini kamaytiradi va xizmat muddatini uzaytiradi.
ruijie-accessories.en:
Accessories for network equipment are auxiliary components without which no installation of security and communication systems works as a single whole. This category includes PoE injectors, power elements, mounting and switching accessories that provide the delivery of electricity and data over a single cable, the correct connection of equipment and the stable operation of the entire infrastructure. Buying accessories for network equipment in Tashkent and other regions of Uzbekistan is possible through the SAT Solutions catalog — we select compatible components for a specific camera, access point or switch model to avoid errors at the installation stage.

The key role in this category is played by PoE injectors — devices that add power to an ordinary network line where the switch does not support Power over Ethernet technology. This is a common situation: an unmanaged switch or router without PoE is already brought to the facility, but it is necessary to connect an IP camera, Wi-Fi point or IP phone without running a separate power line. The injector solves the task with a single device, saving time and costs on electrical installation, and makes it possible to power equipment at a distance of up to 100 meters over twisted pair.

For the conditions of Uzbekistan, the correct choice of accessories is especially important. Voltage swings in the grid, high summer temperatures up to +45 °C, dust at facilities in the regions — all this creates an increased load on power components. A quality PoE injector with a power margin and overload protection extends the service life of connected equipment and reduces the number of service visits. Properly selected accessories are not a trifle but the foundation of the reliability of the entire video surveillance system or corporate enterprise network.

Separately, it is worth noting that accessories often become a weak link precisely because of saving during procurement. An injector incompatible in standard may fail to start the device or disable it, and a lack of power leads to unstable operation of cameras and access points under load. Therefore, the choice of this category should be approached just as seriously as the choice of the main equipment — and rely on calculation, not the minimum price.

## How to choose

- **PoE standard:** determine which standard your equipment supports — IEEE 802.3af (up to 15.4 W), 802.3at/PoE+ (up to 30 W) or PoE++ for more powerful devices. The injector must match or exceed the load requirements.
- **Power per port:** sum up the power consumption of the connected device with a margin. For example, a PTZ camera or a powerful access point requires 30 W and more, whereas 15 W is enough for a fixed camera.
- **Port speed:** for modern networks, choose gigabit models (GE) — they will not become a "bottleneck" for the traffic of high-resolution IP cameras and fast access points.
- **Overload and short-circuit protection:** the presence of built-in protection against overload, short circuit and voltage surges is critical for unstable power grids in the regions of Uzbekistan.
- **Compatibility with passive/active PoE:** clarify the PoE type of your device so that the injector correctly negotiates the voltage and does not damage the equipment.
- **Transmission range:** make sure the device stably maintains power and data over the required cable length (as a rule, up to 100 m over category 5e and above twisted pair).
- **Operating conditions:** for hot rooms and cabinets without ventilation, choose models with a margin in heat dissipation and a quality housing.

## Applications

- **Offices and business centers:** connection of IP phones, Wi-Fi access points and cameras in places where the switch does not support PoE.
- **Retail facilities:** stores, supermarkets and shopping malls, where video surveillance is expanded over an already existing network.
- **Manufacturing and warehouse premises:** supplying power to remote cameras and access points without running power lines.
- **Residential complexes and private houses:** intercom systems, cameras at entrances and in entryways, household access points.
- **Government institutions:** upgrading the existing network infrastructure without its complete replacement.
- **Special facilities and remote sites:** facilities in the regions of Uzbekistan, where connection autonomy and resistance to power swings are important.

## Brands and models in the catalog

- **Ruijie RG-E-130(GE)** — a gigabit PoE injector for connecting cameras and access points in networks where a full-speed 1 Gbit/s channel is required without loss of bandwidth.
- **Ruijie RG-POE-50-60W-MG** — a high-power injector up to 60 W for energy-intensive devices: PTZ cameras, multi-band access points and equipment with high consumption.
- **Ruijie RG-POE-AT30** — a PoE+ (802.3at) standard injector with power up to 30 W, suitable for most mid-range IP cameras and access points.
- **Ruijie** — the SAT Solutions catalog features power accessories of this brand, compatible with the ecosystem of Ruijie switches and access points, which simplifies building a unified managed network.

## FAQ

Q: How does a PoE injector differ from a PoE switch?
A: An injector adds power to a single line when the main switch does not support PoE, whereas a PoE switch powers several ports at once. An injector is advantageous when it is necessary to power one or two devices without replacing existing equipment. SAT Solutions specialists will help choose the optimal solution for your facility in Tashkent.

Q: What power injector is needed for an IP camera?
A: For a fixed camera, 15.4 W (802.3af) is usually sufficient; for a PTZ camera with heating or IR illumination — 30 W and more. It is better to take a model with a margin, for example the Ruijie RG-POE-AT30 at 30 W or the RG-POE-50-60W-MG at 60 W. We make the exact calculation for the specific equipment model.

Q: Over what distance does a PoE injector work?
A: The standard range of power and data transmission over twisted pair is up to 100 meters when using category 5e and above cable. At greater distances, additional solutions are used — PoE extenders or intermediate equipment. We select the connection scheme taking into account the route length at your facility.

Q: Is a Ruijie injector suitable for cameras of other brands?
A: Ruijie PoE injectors work according to IEEE standards, so they are compatible with most devices supporting standard PoE regardless of the manufacturer. Matching the standard and sufficient power is important. SAT Solutions checks compatibility before supply to eliminate risks during installation.

Q: Will the equipment withstand the hot climate of Uzbekistan?
A: Ruijie accessories are designed for operation in a wide temperature range, but in conditions up to +45 °C, proper installation and ventilation of cabinets are important. We install power equipment taking into account heat dissipation and protection from overheating. This reduces the number of failures and extends the service life.

- **Muhitdan himoya (ko'cha uchun):** ko'cha kamerasiga IP65 va undan yuqori sinfli korpus, viloyatlarning yozgi issig'i va qishki sovug'i uchun zaxiraga ega ish harorati diapazoni majburiy.

zkteco-cameras.en:
Wi-Fi cameras are network video cameras that transmit a video stream over a wireless network without running twisted pair to each device. They have become a practical solution where chiseling walls for cable is expensive, time-consuming or simply impossible: in rented offices, finished interiors, at dachas and remote sites. Buying Wi-Fi cameras in Tashkent for a specific task — from a compact indoor model to an outdoor rotating PTZ — is possible through the SAT Solutions catalog, which brings together devices proven on the local market with official support.

The main advantage of a wireless camera is the speed and flexibility of deployment. A monitoring point is moved in minutes, the system is scaled as the facility grows, and recording is carried out both to a memory card inside the camera and to the cloud or to a network recorder. For a small store, warehouse or private house, this means working video surveillance without a major renovation and without a crew of installers for a week.

At the same time, wireless transmission places its own requirements: a stable Wi-Fi signal, competent placement of access points, protection of the channel from unauthorized access and autonomy in case of a power outage. In the conditions of Uzbekistan, outdoor heat up to +45 °C, dusty air and voltage swings are added, so selecting a model and thinking through the infrastructure play no less a role than the characteristics of the camera itself. An error at the planning stage is usually more expensive than the price difference between models. Below we will examine what to look at when choosing and what tasks this category covers.

## How to choose

- **Camera type (fixed or PTZ):** for constant monitoring of one zone a fixed model is sufficient, while to survey a large territory a rotating PTZ camera with zoom and auto-tracking is taken — the catalog has rotating ZKTeco Wi-Fi cameras precisely for such scenarios.
- **Communication channel (Wi-Fi or 4G):** for a facility with wired internet, an ordinary Wi-Fi model is suitable, while for a remote site without a network a camera with a SIM card is chosen, for example the rotating 4G PTZ ZKTeco C4FS-EU 4G, operating in the mobile networks of Uzbekistan.
- **Resolution and sensor:** for face and plate recognition a camera with higher resolution and quality optics is needed; for a general overview a basic sensor is sufficient — assess the detail requirements in advance.
- **Night shooting:** check the IR illumination range and the presence of a color night mode — in parking lots, yards and on the perimeter this is critical.
- **Environmental protection (for outdoors):** an outdoor camera requires a housing of class IP65 and above, an operating temperature range with a margin for summer heat and the winter cold of the regions.
- **Power and autonomy:** consider the power supply method and behavior during grid failures — for continuous recording a UPS is needed, and a memory card in the camera safeguards the archive in case of a connection break.
- **Storage and access:** determine where the video will be stored (memory card, cloud, network recorder) and how many cameras your Wi-Fi access point can handle simultaneously without frame loss.

## Applications

- **Small and medium office:** monitoring the entrance, reception and work zones without running cable through a finished interior.
- **Retail:** stores, boutiques and points at markets and in shopping centers — monitoring the cash register, sales floor and display windows.
- **Warehouses and manufacturing:** overview of loading zones and aisles, where a rotating camera replaces several fixed ones.
- **Residential complexes and private houses:** yards, entrances, entryways and the surrounding area with night illumination.
- **Remote and seasonal facilities:** dachas, farms, construction sites and sites without wired internet — here 4G cameras come to the rescue.
- **Government institutions and small service businesses:** clinics, pharmacies, salons, cafes and service centers, where quick installation without renovation is important.

## Brands and models in the catalog

- **ZKTeco** — the main brand of the category: the company is known in Uzbekistan for access control and video surveillance systems, its Wi-Fi lineup is oriented toward simple integration and stable operation.
- **ZKTeco WIFI Wi-Fi camera** — a basic wireless model for an office, home or small room, quickly installed and connected to an existing network.
- **ZKTeco rotating Wi-Fi camera (PTZ)** — a rotating camera with remote control of the viewing direction for monitoring large areas from a single point.
- **ZKTeco WIFI rotating Wi-Fi camera** — another PTZ model of the wireless series for yards, warehouses and the perimeter.
- **ZKTeco C4FS-EU 4G rotating 4G camera (PTZ)** — an autonomous solution with mobile internet for facilities where there is no wired network and Wi-Fi.

## FAQ

Q: Is a Wi-Fi camera more reliable than a wired one?
A: A wired system is more stable in transmission, but Wi-Fi wins in installation speed and flexibility. For offices, homes and finished interiors, a wireless solution is fully justified — the main thing is to ensure a stable signal. SAT Solutions engineers will help assess what suits your facility in Tashkent better.

Q: What should I do if the facility has no wired internet?
A: Take a camera with 4G support, for example the rotating ZKTeco C4FS-EU 4G — it works via a SIM card in the mobile networks of Uzbekistan. This is convenient for dachas, farms, construction sites and remote sites. Recording in this case can be carried out to a memory card and to the cloud simultaneously.

Q: Will the camera work in summer at +45 °C?
A: Yes, if you choose an outdoor model with a suitable operating temperature range and housing protection from dust and moisture. SAT Solutions selects equipment with a margin for the local climate and installs it so as to avoid overheating. For indoor tasks, basic models are sufficient.

Q: How many Wi-Fi cameras can be connected to one network?
A: This depends on the bandwidth of the access point and router: the higher the camera resolution, the greater the load on the channel. For several cameras, one good access point is usually sufficient; for a large facility, a separate network is designed. We calculate the coverage in advance so that the video does not "freeze".

Q: Can I watch the video from a phone remotely?
A: Yes, ZKTeco Wi-Fi and 4G cameras support remote viewing through a mobile application from anywhere. We configure access during installation and show how to use it. SAT Solutions support remains available if help is needed.
