Qulflar uchun kronshteynlar — har qanday kirishni boshqarish tizimining yordamchi, ammo juda muhim elementi. To'g'ri tanlangan kronshteynsiz hatto eng ishonchli elektromagnit qulf ham talab qilingan ushlab turish kuchini va konstruksiyaning uzoq muddatliligini ta'minlay olmaydi. Agar siz Toshkentda yoki O'zbekistonning boshqa shahrida kirishni boshqarish tizimini sotib olib o'rnatmoqchi bo'lsangiz, mahkamlash aksessuarlarini savodli tanlash — loyihaning qulf yoki kontrollerni tanlash kabi muhim qismidir.

Kronshteynlar birinchi navbatda elektromagnit qulflar bilan qo'llaniladi: ular qulf va javob plastinasini turli konstruksiyadagi eshiklarda — metall, yog'och, shisha, shuningdek nostandart ramkalar va portallarda to'g'ri mahkamlash imkonini beradi. Kronshteyn konfiguratsiyasi o'rnatish burchagini, tekisliklar orasidagi zazorni va yakuniy yopishish kuchini belgilaydi. Noto'g'ri tanlangan yoki sifatsiz kronshteyn qiyshayishga, ushlab turish kuchining pasayishiga va qulfning vaqtidan oldin eskirishiga olib keladi. Aynan shuning uchun qulf ishlab chiqaruvchilari muayyan mahsulot seriyalari uchun mo'ljallangan firma mahkamlash to'plamlarini chiqaradilar.

Kronshteyn tanlashda eshik turi va uning ochilish yo'nalishi, eshik polotnasi va ramkaning qalinligi, shuningdek qulfning ushlab turish kuchini hisobga olish muhim. Shisha eshiklar uchun kronshteynlar konstruktiv jihatdan yog'och yoki metall eshiklar uchun modellardan farq qiladi: ular shishani teshmasdan qulfni ishonchli mahkamlash imkonini beruvchi maxsus qisuvchi plastinalar yoki adapterlarga ega. Kronshteynlarni to'g'ri montaj qilish qulfning e'lon qilingan xususiyatlariga bevosita ta'sir qiladi — buni tizimni loyihalashda ham, keyingi ekspluatatsiyasida ham hisobga olish zarur.

## Qanday tanlash kerak

- Eshik turi va polotna materiali. Yog'och va metall eshiklar uchun standart burchakli va Z-shaklidagi kronshteynlar, shisha eshiklar uchun esa U seriyali qisuvchi adapterlarga ega maxsus modellar (masalan, ML-180U, ML-280U) qo'llaniladi.
- Qulfning ushlab turish kuchi. Kronshteyn qulfning yuklama bo'yicha klassiga mos kelishi kerak: 180 kg, 280 kg yoki 500 kg qulflar uchun tegishli belgilarga ega turli modellar qo'llaniladi — kronshteynning ko'tarish qobiliyatini pasaytirish mumkin emas.
- Muayyan qulf modeli bilan moslik. Ishlab chiqaruvchilar, qoida tariqasida, u yoki bu kronshteyn qaysi qulflar bilan mos kelishini ko'rsatadilar. Original bo'lmagan yoki mos kelmaydigan kronshteynlardan foydalanish yopishish geometriyasini buzishi va ushlab turish kuchini pasaytirishi mumkin.
- Konfiguratsiya va montaj burchagi. Kronshteyn shaklini eshikning proyomdagi joylashuvidan kelib chiqib tanlang: to'g'ri, burchakli (L-shaklidagi) va Z-shaklidagi variantlar turli vaziyatlarda qo'llaniladi.
- Material va himoya qoplamasi. Zanglamaydigan po'latdan yasalgan yoki korroziyaga qarshi qoplamali kronshteynlar yuqori namlikli yoki agressiv muhitli obyektlar uchun afzalroqdir.
- To'liqlik. To'plamga barcha kerakli mahkamlash elementlari — boltlar, gaykalar, masofaviy vtulkalar, rezina prokladkalar kirishiga ishonch hosil qiling. Shtatli mahkamlagichning yo'qligi ko'pincha montajning kechikishiga sabab bo'ladi.
- Qo'shimcha aksessuarlarning mavjudligi. Shisha eshiklar uchun maxsus masofaviy va burchakli planka kerak bo'lishi mumkin — ularni xuddi shu liniyadan sotib olish mumkinligiga ishonch hosil qiling.

## Qo'llanilish sohalari

- Ofis va ma'muriy binolar. Kronshteynlar kirish guruhlarida, muzokara xonalarida, serverxonalarda va boshqa cheklangan kirish zonalarida qulflarni o'rnatishda qo'llaniladi.
- Savdo markazlari va riteyl. Do'kon va butiklarning shisha eshiklari fasad estetikasini buzmasdan shaffof polotnalar bilan ishlash uchun maxsus kronshteynlarni talab qiladi.
- Turar-joy komplekslari va apartamentlar. Podyezdlar, parkinglar va qavat maydonchalarida kirishni boshqarish tizimini tashkil qilishda kronshteynlar standart metall va yog'och eshiklarga moslab tanlanadi.
- Sanoat obyektlari va omborlar. Ishlab chiqarish va ombor xonalarida yuqori mas'uliyatli zonalarni himoya qilish uchun katta ushlab turish kuchli (380–500 kg) qulflar uchun kuchaytirilgan kronshteynlar qo'llaniladi.
- Tibbiyot va ta'lim muassasalari. Kasalxonalar, klinikalar va maktablardagi kirishni boshqarish tizimlari intensiv ekspluatatsiya va tez-tez ochilish sikllariga chidamli ishonchli mahkamlagichni talab qiladi.

## Katalogdagi brendlar va modellar

- KANIHAD — ushbu toifada taqdim etilgan yagona va asosiy brend. Kompaniya kirishni boshqarish tizimlari uchun uskunalarga ixtisoslashgan bo'lib, elektromagnit qulflarning o'zini ham, ularga firma mahkamlash aksessuarlarini ham ishlab chiqaradi.
- ML-ZL seriyali kronshteynlar (ML-180ZL, ML-280ZL, ML-380ZL, ML-500ZL) standart yog'och va metall eshiklarda elektromagnit qulflarni montaj qilish uchun mo'ljallangan; belgidagi raqam kilogrammda ushlab turish kuchiga mos keladi.
- ML-U seriyali kronshteynlar (ML-180U, ML-280U) — shisha eshiklar uchun maxsus modellar bo'lib, shishaga zarar yetkazmasdan qulfni ishonchli mahkamlashni ta'minlaydi.
- Qo'shimcha KANIHAD aksessuarlari (masalan, VI-HW10) nostandart eshik proyomlari konfiguratsiyalarida montaj imkoniyatlarini kengaytiradi.

## FAQ

Q: Bir ishlab chiqaruvchining kronshteynini boshqa brend qulfi bilan ishlatish mumkinmi?
A: Agar montaj o'lchamlari va yuklama xususiyatlari mos kelsa, texnik jihatdan bu mumkin. Biroq ishlab chiqaruvchilar firma to'plamlaridan foydalanishni tavsiya qiladi: ular o'z liniyasidagi qulflar bilan birgalikda loyihalanadi va sinovdan o'tkaziladi, bu e'lon qilingan ushlab turish kuchini kafolatlaydi.

Q: Shisha eshik uchun qaysi kronshteynni tanlash kerak?
A: Shisha eshiklar uchun qisuvchi adapterlarga ega U seriyali maxsus modellar (masalan, KANIHAD'dan ML-180U yoki ML-280U) qo'llaniladi. Ular shishani teshishni talab qilmaydi va estetikani saqlagan holda ishonchli mahkamlashni ta'minlaydi.

Q: Allaqachon o'rnatilgan qulfga qaysi kronshteyn mos kelishini qanday aniqlash mumkin?
A: Qulfning markasi va modelini, shuningdek eshik turini bilish zarur. SAT Solutions mutaxassislari mavjud qulfning fotosurati yoki texnik tavsifi bo'yicha mos keladigan kronshteynni tanlashga yordam beradi.

Q: Kronshteynlarni montaj qilish qulflarni o'rnatish narxiga kiradimi?
A: Qoida tariqasida, ha — mahkamlash aksessuarlarini montaj qilish kirishni boshqarish tizimini o'rnatish bo'yicha kompleks xizmatga kiritiladi. Ishlarning aniq tarkibi tijorat taklifini tayyorlashda aniqlashtiriladi.

Q: Kronshteynlarga kafolat bormi va u qancha muddatga?
A: Yetkazib beriladigan barcha KANIHAD aksessuarlariga ishlab chiqaruvchi kafolati tarqaladi. Kafolat muddatini buyurtma rasmiylashtirishda SAT Solutions menejerlaridan aniqlashtiring.
kanihad-brackets.en:
Brackets for locks are an auxiliary but critically important element of any access control system. Without a properly selected bracket, even the most reliable electromagnetic lock will not deliver the required holding force and structural durability. If you plan to buy and install an access control system in Tashkent or another city in Uzbekistan, the sound selection of mounting accessories is just as much a part of the project as the choice of the lock or controller itself.

Brackets are used primarily with electromagnetic locks: they allow the lock and armature plate to be correctly fixed on doors of various designs — metal, wooden, glass, as well as on non-standard frames and portals. The configuration of the bracket determines the installation angle, the gap between the surfaces and the resulting bonding force. An incorrectly selected or low-quality bracket leads to misalignment, reduced holding force and premature wear of the lock. This is exactly why lock manufacturers produce proprietary mounting kits designed for specific product series.

When choosing a bracket, it is important to take into account the type of door and its opening direction, the thickness of the leaf and the frame, as well as the holding force of the lock. Brackets for glass doors differ structurally from models for wooden or metal ones: they have special clamping plates or adapters that allow the lock to be securely fixed without drilling the glass. Correct installation of brackets directly affects the declared characteristics of the lock — this must be taken into account both when designing the system and during its subsequent operation.

## How to choose

- Type of door and leaf material. For wooden and metal doors, standard angular and Z-shaped brackets are used; for glass doors, specialized models with clamping adapters of the U series (for example, ML-180U, ML-280U).
- Holding force of the lock. The bracket must match the load class of the lock: different models with the corresponding marking are used for 180 kg, 280 kg or 500 kg locks — the load-bearing capacity of the bracket must not be understated.
- Compatibility with the specific lock model. Manufacturers, as a rule, indicate which locks a particular bracket is compatible with. Using non-original or incompatible brackets can disrupt the seating geometry and reduce holding force.
- Configuration and mounting angle. Choose the bracket shape based on the position of the door in the opening: straight, angular (L-shaped) and Z-shaped variants are used in different situations.
- Material and protective coating. Brackets made of stainless steel or with an anti-corrosion coating are preferable for facilities with high humidity or an aggressive environment.
- Completeness of the kit. Make sure that the kit includes all the necessary mounting elements — bolts, nuts, spacer sleeves, rubber gaskets. The absence of standard fasteners often becomes a reason for installation delays.
- Availability of additional accessories. Glass doors may require special spacer and angular plates — make sure they can be purchased separately within the same product line.

## Applications

- Office and administrative buildings. Brackets are used when installing locks on entrance groups, meeting rooms, server rooms and other restricted-access zones.
- Shopping centers and retail. Glass doors of shops and boutiques require specialized brackets for working with transparent leaves without spoiling the aesthetics of the facade.
- Residential complexes and apartments. When organizing an access control system in entrances, parking areas and floor landings, brackets are selected for standard metal and wooden doors.
- Industrial facilities and warehouses. In production and warehouse premises, reinforced brackets are used for locks with high holding force (380–500 kg) to protect high-responsibility zones.
- Medical and educational institutions. Access control systems in hospitals, clinics and schools require reliable fastenings resistant to intensive operation and frequent opening cycles.

## Brands and models in the catalog

- KANIHAD is the only and main brand represented in this category. The company specializes in equipment for access control systems, producing both the electromagnetic locks themselves and proprietary mounting accessories for them.
- Brackets of the ML-ZL series (ML-180ZL, ML-280ZL, ML-380ZL, ML-500ZL) are designed for mounting electromagnetic locks on standard wooden and metal doors; the number in the marking corresponds to the holding force in kilograms.
- Brackets of the ML-U series (ML-180U, ML-280U) are specialized models for glass doors, ensuring reliable lock fastening without damaging the glass.
- Additional KANIHAD accessories (for example, VI-HW10) expand the mounting capabilities for non-standard door opening configurations.

## FAQ

Q: Can a bracket from one manufacturer be used with a lock of another brand?
A: Technically this is possible if the mounting dimensions and load characteristics match. However, manufacturers recommend using proprietary kits: they are designed and tested together with the locks of their own product line, which guarantees the declared holding force.

Q: Which bracket should I choose for a glass door?
A: For glass doors, specialized models of the U series are used (for example, ML-180U or ML-280U from KANIHAD) with clamping adapters. They do not require drilling the glass and provide reliable fastening while preserving the aesthetics.

Q: How do I determine which bracket suits an already installed lock?
A: You need to know the make and model of the lock, as well as the type of door. SAT Solutions specialists will help select a compatible bracket based on a photo or technical description of the existing lock.

Q: Is bracket installation included in the cost of lock installation?
A: As a rule, yes — installation of mounting accessories is included in the comprehensive service for installing an access control system. The exact scope of work is clarified when preparing a commercial proposal.

Q: Is there a warranty on the brackets and how long is it?
A: All supplied KANIHAD accessories are covered by the manufacturer's warranty. Please clarify the warranty period with SAT Solutions managers when placing an order.

avigilon-panoramic.uz:
360° panoramali kameralar — bu keng burchakli yoki multisensorli optikaga ega videokuzatuv qurilmalari bo'lib, ular bitta qurilma bilan o'rnatish nuqtasi atrofidagi butun sahna qamrab oladi. Koridorlar chorrahasida, savdo zalida yoki ochiq maydonda bir nechta tor yo'naltirilgan kameralar o'rniga 360 yoki 180 gradusga ko'radigan va ko'r zonalar qoldirmaydigan bitta panoramali model yetarli. 360° panoramali kameralarni Toshkentda SAT Solutions katalogi orqali sotib olish mumkin: biz "quti"ni tavakkaliga sotmasdan, obyektning muayyan geometriyasi, shift balandligi va xavfsizlik xizmati vazifalariga moslab model tanlaymiz.

Texnik jihatdan bunday kameralar ikkita katta turga bo'linadi. Birinchisi — bitta matritsali sensor va o'ta keng burchakli "baliq ko'zi" obyektiviga ega fisheye-kameralar: dastlabki doiraviy tasvir dasturiy ravishda (dyuarping) bitta yoki bir nechta odatiy to'rtburchak proyeksiyalarga yoyiladi. Ikkinchi tur — bitta korpusda bir nechta alohida modul (ikki, uch, to'rt boshli) o'rnatilgan multisensorli kameralar bo'lib, har biri o'z optikasi va matritsasiga ega; ularni turli tomonlarga yo'naltirib, chetlarida buzilishlarsiz yuqori aniqlikdagi panorama yig'ish mumkin. Ikkala yondashuv ham bitta vazifani hal qiladi — minimal uskuna, kabel trassalari va videoregistratordagi portlar bilan maksimal qamrov.

O'zbekiston bozori uchun bu ayniqsa amaliy uskuna klassi. Yirik obyektlarda — logistika omborlari, parkinglar, ishlab chiqarish sexlari, savdo markazlari, bank zallarida — panoramali kamera o'rnatish nuqtalari sonini qisqartiradi, montajni soddalashtiradi va tarmoqqa hamda saqlash tizimiga yukni kamaytiradi. Shu bilan birga uskuna og'ir ekspluatatsiya sharoitlariga mo'ljallangan: ko'cha modellari keng harorat diapazonida ishlaydi va Toshkent hamda janubiy hududlarga xos +45°C gacha yozgi jaziramaga chidaydi, borddagi analitika esa katta ochiq sahnalarni operator doimiy e'tiborisiz qayta ishlashga yordam beradi.

## Qanday tanlash kerak

- **Optika turi (fisheye yoki multisensor):** fisheye xonani shiftdan bitta matritsa va past narxda kuzatish uchun qulay; multisensorli modellar butun panorama bo'ylab yuqoriroq umumiy aniqlik va o'tkirlik beradi — sahna o'lchami va detallashtirish talablariga qarab tanlang.
- **Uzoqlikdagi aniqlik va detallashtirish:** yuzlar va raqamlarni tanib olish uchun nafaqat umumiy megapiksellik, balki kerakli zonadagi metrga pikssellar zichligi ham muhim; katta ochiq maydonlarda multisensor yagona matritsadan afzalroq.
- **O'rnatish balandligi va joyi:** fisheye xona markazida shiftga montaj qilish uchun mo'ljallangan, multisensor esa moslashuvchanroq — boshlar binolar burchaklarida, xollarda va yo'l chorrahalarida alohida yo'naltiriladi.
- **Borddagi analitika:** harakatni aniqlash, obyektlarni tasniflash (odam/transport), tashrif buyuruvchilarni sanash va qiziqish zonalarining mavjudligi panorama qiymatiga bevosita ta'sir qiladi — analitikasiz operatorga 360° sahnani nazorat qilish qiyin.
- **Tungi rejim va dinamik diapazon:** kirish guruhlari, parkinglar va ko'chalar uchun WDR va IK to'g'ri ishlashi/qorong'ida sezgirlik muhim, aks holda yorqin faralar va qorong'i burchaklar detallarni "yutadi".
- **Muhitdan himoya (IP/IK) va harorat rejimi:** ko'cha va changli ishlab chiqarishlar uchun namlik va changdan himoyalangan korpus, antivandal ijro va +45°C jaziramada tasdiqlangan ishlash kerak.
- **Integratsiya va saqlash:** VMS/registratoringiz bilan moslikni, dyuarping usulini (kamerada yoki serverda) va yuqori aniqlikda ortib boruvchi arxiv hajmini hisobga oling — bu saqlash va kanalni tanlashga ta'sir qiladi.

## Qo'llanilish sohalari

- **Savdo va riteyl:** savdo zallari, kassa zonalari va kirish guruhlari — bitta kamera butun zalni nazorat qiladi va tashrif buyuruvchilarni sanash uchun ma'lumot beradi.
- **Logistika va ishlab chiqarish:** omborlar, sexlar, yuklash-tushirish zonalari, bu yerda ko'r zonalarsiz katta maydonni yaxlit kuzatish muhim.
- **Biznes-markazlar va ofislar:** xollar, resepsheyn, ochiq ish maydonlari va muzokara zonalari — butun qavatni bitta qurilma bilan kuzatish.
- **Transport va parkinglar:** yopiq va ochiq avtoturargohlar, o'tish yo'llari va kirish joylari, bu yerda panorama bir nechta yo'naltirilgan kamerani almashtiradi.
- **Davlat muassasalari va ijtimoiy obyektlar:** vestibyullar, koridorlar, muassasalardagi kutish zonalari, bu yerda katta umumiy maydonlarni nazorat qilish talab qilinadi.
- **Turar-joy komplekslari va maxsus obyektlar:** turar-joy majmualarining hovli hududlari, perimetrlar, kirish guruhlari va xavfsizlikka yuqori talablar qo'yiladigan obyektlar.

## Katalogdagi brendlar va modellar

- **Avigilon Alta A5 Quad** — keng ochiq sahnalarni yuqori aniqlikda qamrash uchun to'rtta optik modulli multisensorli panoramali kamera.
- **Avigilon H5A Multisensor** va **H5A Dual Head** — individual kuzatuv yo'nalishlariga moslashtiriladigan boshlarga ega H5A liniyasidagi multisensorli modellar.
- **Avigilon H5A Fisheye** — o'rnatilgan dyuarpingli xonalarni 360° shiftdan kuzatish uchun bir matritsali fisheye-kamera.
- **Avigilon H4 Multisensor** — kadr chetlarida buzilishlarsiz panorama talab qilinadigan yirik obyektlar uchun multisensorli yechim.
- SAT Solutions katalogida muayyan obyektga konfiguratsiyani moslash va yagona videokuzatuv tizimiga integratsiya qilish imkoniyati bilan Avigilon panoramali kameralari taqdim etilgan.

## FAQ

Q: 360° panoramali kamera bir nechta oddiy kameradan nimasi bilan yaxshi?
A: Bitta panoramali kamera butun sahnani ko'r zonalarsiz qamrab oladi, o'rnatish nuqtalari, kabel trassalari va registratordagi portlar sonini qisqartiradi. Bu ayniqsa katta ochiq maydonlarda montaj narxini pasaytiradi va ekspluatatsiyani soddalashtiradi. SAT Solutions mutaxassislari Toshkentdagi obyektingiz uchun ikkala variantni solishtirib berishga yordam beradi.

Q: Fisheye va multisensorli kamera o'rtasida qanday farq bor?
A: Fisheye bitta matritsa va o'ta keng burchakli obyektivdan foydalanadi, uning tasviri dasturiy ravishda yoyiladi; bu xonani kuzatish uchun ixcham va tejamli. Multisensorli kamera alohida optikaga ega bir nechta modulga ega bo'lib, bu butun panorama bo'ylab yuqoriroq umumiy aniqlik va o'tkirlik beradi. Tanlov sahna o'lchami va detallashtirish talablariga bog'liq.

Q: Bunday kameralar jaziramada ko'chaga o'rnatish uchun mos keladimi?
A: Ha, ko'cha panoramali modellari himoyalangan korpuslarda chiqariladi va keng harorat diapazonida, jumladan O'zbekistonning +45°C gacha yozgi jaziramasida ishlashga mo'ljallangan. Tanlashda biz changdan va namlikdan himoya klassini, antivandal ijroni va muayyan maydon sharoitlarini hisobga olamiz.

Q: Obyektga nechta kamera kerak va buni qanday hisoblash mumkin?
A: Miqdor maydon, xonalar geometriyasi, o'rnatish balandligi va detallashtirish vazifalariga bog'liq. Ko'pincha bitta panoramali kamera uch-to'rtta yo'naltirilgan kamerani almashtiradi, ammo aniq hisob obyekt rejasi bo'yicha amalga oshiriladi. SAT Solutions buyurtma berilganda qamrov zonalarini loyihalashni bepul bajaradi.

Q: Avigilon kameralarini mavjud tizimga integratsiya qilish mumkinmi?
A: Aksariyat hollarda ha — panoramali kameralar kerakli protokollarni va dyuarpingni qo'llab-quvvatlaydigan zamonaviy VMS va videoregistratorlar bilan integratsiya qilinadi. Biz uskunangiz bilan moslikni tekshiramiz va arxivni saqlashning maqbul sxemasini taklif qilamiz. Infratuzilmangizni baholash uchun SAT Solutions menejerlariga murojaat qiling.
avigilon-panoramic.en:
360° panoramic cameras are video surveillance devices with wide-angle or multisensor optics that cover the entire scene around the installation point with a single device. Instead of several narrowly directed cameras at a corridor intersection, in a retail hall or in an open area, a single panoramic model is enough — it sees 360 or 180 degrees and leaves no blind spots. You can buy 360° panoramic cameras in Tashkent through the SAT Solutions catalog: we select a model for the specific geometry of the facility, the ceiling height and the tasks of the security service, rather than selling a "box" at random.

Technically, such cameras are divided into two large types. The first is fisheye cameras with a single matrix sensor and an ultra-wide-angle "fisheye" lens: the original circular image is software-corrected (dewarping) into one or several familiar rectangular projections. The second type is multisensor cameras, where several separate modules (two, three, four heads) are installed in a single housing, each with its own optics and matrix; they can be aimed in different directions and assembled into a high-resolution panorama without distortion at the edges. Both approaches solve the same problem — maximum coverage with a minimum of equipment, cable runs and ports on the video recorder.

For the Uzbekistan market, this is an especially practical class of equipment. At large facilities — logistics warehouses, parking areas, production shops, shopping centers, banking halls — a panoramic camera reduces the number of installation points, simplifies mounting and lowers the load on the network and storage system. At the same time, the equipment is designed for harsh operating conditions: outdoor models operate over a wide temperature range and withstand summer heat up to +45°C, characteristic of Tashkent and the southern regions, while onboard analytics help process large open scenes without constant operator attention.

## How to choose

- **Type of optics (fisheye or multisensor):** fisheye is convenient for viewing a room from the ceiling with a single matrix and at a lower cost; multisensor models provide higher total resolution and sharpness across the entire panorama — choose based on the scene size and detail requirements.
- **Resolution and detail at distance:** for face and license plate recognition, not only the overall megapixel count matters but also the pixel density per meter in the required zone; on large open areas a multisensor is preferable to a single matrix.
- **Installation height and location:** fisheye is intended for ceiling mounting in the center of a room, while multisensor is more flexible — the heads are aimed individually at building corners, in halls and at driveway intersections.
- **Onboard analytics:** the presence of motion detection, object classification (person/vehicle), visitor counting and zones of interest directly affects the value of the panorama — without analytics it is hard for an operator to monitor a 360° scene.
- **Night mode and dynamic range:** for entrance groups, parking areas and streets, WDR and correct IR/low-light sensitivity are critical, otherwise bright headlights and dark corners "eat up" the details.
- **Environmental protection (IP/IK) and temperature range:** for outdoors and dusty production, a housing with protection against moisture and dust, a vandal-proof design and confirmed operation in heat up to +45°C is required.
- **Integration and storage:** consider compatibility with your VMS/recorder, the dewarping method (on the camera or on the server) and the growing archive volume at high resolution — this affects the choice of storage and channel.

## Applications

- **Trade and retail:** retail halls, checkout zones and entrance groups — a single camera monitors the entire hall and provides data for visitor counting.
- **Logistics and production:** warehouses, shops, loading and unloading zones, where continuous overview of a large area without blind spots is important.
- **Business centers and offices:** halls, reception areas, open workspaces and meeting zones — an overview of an entire floor with a single device.
- **Transport and parking:** covered and open parking lots, driveways and entrances, where a panorama replaces several directed cameras.
- **Government institutions and social facilities:** lobbies, corridors, waiting areas in institutions where control of large common spaces is required.
- **Residential complexes and special facilities:** courtyard areas of residential complexes, perimeters, entrance groups and facilities with heightened security requirements.

## Brands and models in the catalog

- **Avigilon Alta A5 Quad** — a multisensor panoramic camera with four optical modules for covering wide open scenes in high resolution.
- **Avigilon H5A Multisensor** and **H5A Dual Head** — multisensor models of the H5A line with adjustable heads for individual viewing directions.
- **Avigilon H5A Fisheye** — a single-matrix fisheye camera for 360° ceiling overview of rooms with built-in dewarping.
- **Avigilon H4 Multisensor** — a multisensor solution for large facilities where a panorama without distortion at the edges of the frame is required.
- The SAT Solutions catalog features Avigilon panoramic cameras with the ability to select a configuration for a specific facility and integrate them into a unified video surveillance system.

## FAQ

Q: Why is a 360° panoramic camera better than several ordinary ones?
A: A single panoramic camera covers the entire scene without blind spots, reduces the number of installation points, cable runs and ports on the recorder. This lowers installation costs and simplifies operation, especially on large open areas. SAT Solutions specialists will help compare both options for your facility in Tashkent.

Q: What is the difference between a fisheye and a multisensor camera?
A: A fisheye uses a single matrix and an ultra-wide-angle lens whose image is software-corrected; it is compact and economical for viewing a room. A multisensor camera has several modules with separate optics, which provides higher total resolution and sharpness across the entire panorama. The choice depends on the scene size and detail requirements.

Q: Are such cameras suitable for outdoor installation in the heat?
A: Yes, outdoor panoramic models are produced in protected housings and are designed to operate over a wide temperature range, including the Uzbekistan summer heat up to +45°C. When selecting, we take into account the dust and moisture protection class, vandal-proof design and the conditions of the specific site.

Q: How many cameras are needed for a facility and how is this calculated?
A: The quantity depends on the area, the geometry of the premises, the installation height and the detail tasks. Often a single panoramic camera replaces three or four directed ones, but an exact calculation is made based on the facility plan. SAT Solutions performs coverage-zone design free of charge when you place an order.

Q: Can Avigilon cameras be integrated into an existing system?
A: In most cases, yes — panoramic cameras integrate with modern VMS and video recorders that support the required protocols and dewarping. We will check compatibility with your equipment and propose an optimal archive storage scheme. Contact SAT Solutions managers to assess your infrastructure.

pxt-scs.uz:
Burama juftlik asosidagi strukturalangan kabel tizimi (SKS) — har qanday zamonaviy korporativ yoki sanoat tarmog'ining poydevori. U kompyuterlar, telefonlar, IP-kameralar, Wi-Fi kirish nuqtalari va boshqa faol uskunalarni yagona infratuzilmaga birlashtiradi. Savodli loyihalangan SKSsiz na lokal tarmoqning barqaror ishlashini, na videokuzatuv tizimlari videooqimlarining ishonchli uzatilishini, na kirishni boshqarish tizimlarining to'g'ri ishlashini ta'minlab bo'lmaydi. Aynan shuning uchun kabel mahsulotlari va passiv komponentlarni tanlash faol tarmoq uskunasini tanlash kabi e'tibor talab qiladi.

SKS butlovchi qismlarini Toshkentda SAT Solutions katalogi orqali sotib olish mumkin — bu yerda keng assortiment taqdim etilgan: 5e va 6-toifadagi UTP va F/UTP kabellari, turli uzunlik va rangdagi kommutatsion shnurlar, rozetkalar, RJ-45 konnektorlari, kabel bog'lagichlari va boshqa sarf materiallari. Bo'limda jami 150 dan ortiq pozitsiya mavjud bo'lib, bu istalgan miqyosdagi loyihani — kichik ofisdan tortib ko'p qavatli biznes-markaz yoki O'zbekistondagi sanoat obyektiga qadar — to'liq butlash imkonini beradi.

Buyurtma shakllantirishda faqat narxga emas, balki obyektning maqsadi, tarmoqqa yuklama, o'tkazuvchanlik qobiliyatiga bo'lgan talablar va o'rnatish sharoitlariga ham e'tibor qaratish muhim. To'g'ri tanlangan kabel toifasi va sifatli birikma komponentlari — passiv infratuzilmani almashtirmasdan tarmoqning 15-20 yil barqaror ishlashining garovi.

## Qanday tanlash kerak

- Kabel toifasi. Ma'lumot uzatish va IP-telefoniya vazifalari bilan ofis tarmoqlari uchun 1 Gbit/s gacha o'tkazuvchanlik qobiliyatiga ega Cat.5e yetarli. Yuqori yuklamali muhitlar, serverxonalar yoki tarmoqni kelajakda modernizatsiya qilish uchun darhol Cat.6 ni ko'zda tutgan ma'qul, u qisqa masofalarda 10 Gbit/s ni qo'llab-quvvatlaydi va yaxshiroq shovqinga chidamlilikni ta'minlaydi.

- Ekranlash turi. UTP kabeli (ekransiz) aksariyat ofis inshootlariga mos keladi. Foil ekranli F/UTP elektromagnit shovqin manbalari mavjud joylarda zarur: ishlab chiqarish sexlari, mashina zallari, kuchli elektr uskunalari bo'lgan xonalar.

- Kabel ijrosi. Ichki va tashqi o'rnatishni ajratadilar. Binolar ichidagi trassalar uchun standart PVX qobiqli kabel qo'llaniladi. Tashqi liniyalar yoki yuqori namlikli texnik xonalar uchun kuchaytirilgan himoyali kabel kerak.

- Patch-kordlarning uzunligi va rangi. Kommutatsion shnurlar 0,15 dan 10 m va undan ortiq uzunlikda chiqariladi. Uzunlikni to'g'ri tanlash kross shkaflaridagi ortiqcha halqalarni bartaraf etadi, administratsiyalashni soddalashtiradi va havo aylanishini yaxshilaydi. Rangli belgilash tarmoq segmentlarini vizual ravishda ajratishga yordam beradi.

- Konnektorlar sifati. RJ-45 konnektorlari — tizimning eng muhim elementlaridan biri. Ishonchsiz siquv yoki kontaktlarning sifatsiz metali beqaror ulanishga va o'tkazuvchanlik qobiliyatining pasayishiga olib keladi. Cat.6 uchun kattalashtirilgan o'tkazgich diametriga mos konnektorlardan foydalanish kerak.

- Komponentlarning mosligi. SKSning barcha elementlari — kabel, konnektorlar, rozetkalar, patch-panellar — bir toifada bo'lishi kerak. Bitta segmentda Cat.5e va Cat.6 komponentlarini aralashtirish xususiyatlarni eng past bo'g'inga qadar pasaytiradi.

- Sertifikatsiya va sinovdan o'tkazish. Montajdan so'ng SKSning har bir kanali kabel testeri bilan sinovdan o'tkazilishi kerak. Bu o'rnatilgan trassaning e'lon qilingan toifaga mosligini tasdiqlaydi va infratuzilmaga ishlab chiqaruvchi kafolatini olish uchun majburiy shartdir.

## Qo'llanilish sohalari

- Ofislar va biznes-markazlar. SKS ish joylarini, IP-telefonlarni, printerlarni, videokuzatuv va kirishni boshqarish tizimlarini yagona tarmoqqa birlashtiradi. Kabel tizimini savodli strukturalash keyingi masshtablashni soddalashtiradi.

- Savdo obyektlari. Savdo markazlari va do'konlarda burama juftlik kassalar, to'lov terminallari, videokuzatuv kameralari, Wi-Fi nuqtalari va raqamli axborot tizimlari uchun qo'llaniladi.

- Mehmonxonalar va mehmondo'stlik obyektlari. Rivojlangan SKS xonalardagi internetni, IP-ATSning ishlashini, xavfsizlik va binoni boshqarish tizimini ta'minlaydi.

- Sanoat korxonalari va omborlar. Bu yerda ekranlangan kabellar va yuqori mexanik mustahkamlikka ega komponentlar ayniqsa talabgir — tebranish, changlanish va elektromagnit shovqin sharoitida ishlash uchun.

- Ta'lim va davlat muassasalari. Maktablar, universitetlar, davlat organlari o'quv jarayoni, hujjat aylanishi va kirishni boshqarish tizimlarini ta'minlash uchun SKS asosida tarmoqlar quradilar.

- Turar-joy komplekslari va apartamentlar. Kvartiralar va kottejlarda burama juftlik bilan kuchsiz tok tarqatish internet, telefoniya va "aqlli uy" vazifalarini hal qiladi.

## Katalogdagi brendlar va modellar

- Pixietech. SAT Solutions katalogida Pixietech brendi mahsulotlari keng taqdim etilgan: ichki o'rnatish uchun UTP Cat.5e va Cat.6 kabellari, 0,15 dan 10 metrgacha uzunlikdagi bir nechta rangli ijrodagi (kulrang, ko'k, qora) UTP va F/UTP kommutatsion shnurlar, 2 portli ustki RJ-45 rozetkalari, Cat.6 uchun ekranlangan RJ-45 konnektorlari, shuningdek toza montaj uchun kabel bog'lagichlari.

- Pixietech patch-kordlari assortimenti kross shkaflari va ish joylarida qo'llaniladigan barcha tipik uzunliklarni qamrab oladi: patch-panellarni zich montaj qilish uchun o'ta qisqa 0,15-0,3 m shnurlar va nostandart trassalar uchun uzun 5-10 m.

- Cat.5e va Cat.6 kabel mahsulotlari binolar ichidagi kabel-kanallarda, qutilarda va devor oralig'idagi bo'shliqlarda o'rnatishga mo'ljallangan. 4 juft, mis o'tkazgichlar konstruksiyasi — O'zbekistondagi fuqarolik va sanoat qurilishining aksariyat obyektlari uchun standart.

## FAQ

Q: Ofis uchun qaysi kabel toifasi ko'proq mos keladi — Cat.5e yoki Cat.6?
A: Aksariyat ofislar uchun 1 Gbit/s gacha tezlikni qo'llab-quvvatlaydigan Cat.5e yetarli. Agar tarmoqni rivojlantirish, server uskunasini yoki 10 gigabitli kommutatorlarni ulash rejalashtirilsa, darhol Cat.6 dan foydalangan ma'qul — materiallar narxidagi farq qayta montaj qilish zaruratining yo'qligi bilan qoplanadi.

Q: Ekranlangan F/UTP kabeli kerakmi yoki oddiy UTP yetarlimi?
A: UTP aniq shovqin manbalarisiz standart ofis va turar-joy obyektlari uchun mos keladi. F/UTP ishlab chiqarish korxonalarida, serverxona va texnik xonalarda, shuningdek kabel trassalari kuch simlariga bevosita yaqinlikda o'tadigan joylarda tavsiya etiladi.

Q: RJ-45 konnektorlarini mustaqil ravishda siqish mumkinmi yoki mutaxassislarga ishonib topshirgan ma'qulmi?
A: Konnektorlarni siqish maxsus asbob va ko'nikmalarni talab qiladi. Noto'g'ri siqilgan konnektor — tarmoqning beqaror ishlashining eng tez-tez uchraydigan sababi. Mas'uliyatli obyektlar uchun har bir kanalni keyinchalik sinovdan o'tkazish bilan professional montaj qat'iy tavsiya etiladi.

Q: Burama juftlik asosidagi kabel infratuzilmasi qancha xizmat qiladi?
A: To'g'ri montaj va bukilish radiuslariga rioya qilinganda kabel tizimi 15-20 yil va undan ortiq xizmat qiladi. Sifatli komponentlar ishlab chiqaruvchilari sertifikatlangan materiallardan foydalanish va professional montaj sharti bilan tizimga umuman kafolat beradi.

Q: Toshkentda SKS montaji qancha turadi va hisobni qanday olish mumkin?
A: Narx obyekt maydoni, portlar soni, trassalar turi va uskuna toifasiga bog'liq. SAT Solutions obyektni ko'zdan kechirgach yoki xonalar rejalari asosida narxni bepul hisoblab beradi — saytda so'rov qoldirish yoki menejerga qo'ng'iroq qilish yetarli.
pxt-scs.en:
A structured cabling system (SCS) based on twisted pair is the foundation of any modern corporate or industrial network. It unites computers, telephones, IP cameras, Wi-Fi access points and other active equipment into a single infrastructure. Without a properly designed SCS, it is impossible to ensure either stable operation of the local network, or reliable transmission of video streams from surveillance systems, or correct operation of access control systems. This is exactly why the choice of cabling products and passive components requires as much attention as the choice of active network equipment.

You can buy SCS components in Tashkent through the SAT Solutions catalog — here a wide range is presented: UTP and F/UTP cables of categories 5e and 6, patch cords of various lengths and colors, sockets, RJ-45 connectors, cable ties and other consumables. In total, the section contains more than 150 items, which makes it possible to fully equip a project of any scale — from a small office to a multi-story business center or an industrial facility in Uzbekistan.

When placing an order, it is important to focus not only on price but also on the purpose of the facility, the network load, the throughput requirements and the installation conditions. A correctly chosen cable category and high-quality connection components are the key to stable network operation for 15-20 years without replacing the passive infrastructure.

## How to choose

- Cable category. For office networks with data transmission and IP telephony tasks, Cat.5e with throughput up to 1 Gbit/s is sufficient. For high-load environments, server rooms or future network upgrades, it is better to lay Cat.6 right away, which supports 10 Gbit/s over short distances and provides better noise immunity.

- Type of shielding. UTP cable (unshielded) is suitable for most office installations. F/UTP with foil shielding is necessary where there are sources of electromagnetic interference: production shops, machine rooms, premises with powerful electrical equipment.

- Cable design. A distinction is made between indoor and outdoor installation. For runs inside buildings, cable in a standard PVC sheath is used. For outdoor lines or technical premises with high humidity, cable with reinforced protection is needed.

- Length and color of patch cords. Patch cords are produced in lengths from 0.15 to 10 m and more. Correct length selection eliminates unnecessary loops in cross-connect cabinets, simplifies administration and improves air circulation. Color coding helps to visually delineate network segments.

- Quality of connectors. RJ-45 connectors are one of the most critical elements of the system. Unreliable crimping or low-quality contact metal leads to an unstable connection and degradation of throughput. For Cat.6, connectors compatible with the larger conductor diameter should be used.

- Compatibility of components. All SCS elements — cable, connectors, sockets, patch panels — must be of the same category. Mixing Cat.5e and Cat.6 components in one segment reduces the characteristics to the weakest link.

- Certification and testing. After installation, each SCS channel must be tested with a cable tester. This confirms that the laid run corresponds to the declared category and is a mandatory condition for obtaining the manufacturer's warranty on the infrastructure.

## Applications

- Offices and business centers. SCS forms a unified network of workstations, IP phones, printers, video surveillance and access control systems. Well-organized structuring of the cabling system simplifies subsequent scaling.

- Retail facilities. In shopping centers and stores, twisted pair is used for cash registers, payment terminals, surveillance cameras, Wi-Fi points and digital signage systems.

- Hotels and hospitality facilities. A developed SCS provides internet in rooms, operation of an IP PBX, security systems and building management.

- Industrial enterprises and warehouses. Here shielded cables and components with increased mechanical strength are especially in demand — for operation in conditions of vibration, dust and electromagnetic interference.

- Educational and government institutions. Schools, universities and government bodies build networks based on SCS to support the learning process, document flow and access control systems.

- Residential complexes and apartments. Low-current wiring with twisted pair in apartments and cottages solves the tasks of internet, telephony and "smart home".

## Brands and models in the catalog

- Pixietech. The SAT Solutions catalog widely features Pixietech brand products: UTP Cat.5e and Cat.6 cables for indoor installation, UTP and F/UTP patch cords from 0.15 to 10 meters long in several color options (gray, blue, black), 2-port surface-mounted RJ-45 sockets, shielded RJ-45 connectors for Cat.6, as well as cable ties for tidy installation.

- The Pixietech patch cord range covers all standard lengths used in cross-connect cabinets and at workstations: ultra-short cords of 0.15-0.3 m for dense patch panel mounting and long 5-10 m ones for non-standard runs.

- Cat.5e and Cat.6 cabling products are designed for installation in cable channels, trunking and inter-wall cavities inside buildings. The 4-pair, copper-conductor design is the standard for most civil and industrial construction facilities in Uzbekistan.

## FAQ

Q: Which cable category is better suited for an office — Cat.5e or Cat.6?
A: For most offices, Cat.5e is sufficient, supporting speeds up to 1 Gbit/s. If network expansion, connection of server equipment or 10-gigabit switches is planned, it is better to use Cat.6 right away — the difference in material cost pays off by eliminating the need for reinstallation.

Q: Do I need shielded F/UTP cable, or is ordinary UTP enough?
A: UTP is suitable for standard office and residential facilities without pronounced sources of interference. F/UTP is recommended at industrial enterprises, in server and technical premises, as well as where cable runs pass in close proximity to power wiring.

Q: Can I crimp RJ-45 connectors myself, or is it better to entrust this to specialists?
A: Crimping connectors requires a special tool and skills. An incorrectly crimped connector is the most common cause of unstable network operation. For high-responsibility facilities, professional installation with subsequent testing of each channel is strongly recommended.

Q: How long will a twisted-pair cabling infrastructure last?
A: With proper installation and observance of bend radii, a cabling system lasts 15-20 years and more. Manufacturers of high-quality components provide a warranty on the system as a whole, provided that certified materials and professional installation are used.

Q: How much does SCS installation cost in Tashkent and how do I get a quote?
A: The cost depends on the facility area, the number of ports, the type of runs and the equipment category. SAT Solutions performs a free cost calculation after inspecting the facility or based on the premises plans — just leave a request on the website or call a manager.

SAT Solutions mutaxassislari tizim arxitekturasini qurish va uskunaning maqbul to'plamini tanlashga yordam beradi.

## Qanday tanlash kerak

- Abonentlar va kanallar soni. IP-ATS sig'imi bir vaqtning o'zidagi maksimal suhbatlar va ro'yxatdan o'tgan akkauntlar sonini belgilaydi. Masalan, 200 SIP-akkauntli platforma o'rta korxonaga mos keladi, kichik ofisga esa 20-50 foydalanuvchili yechim yetarli.
- IP-telefon klassi. Boshlang'ich klass — oddiy xodimlar uchun 2-4 liniyali bazaviy apparatlar. O'rta va yuqori klass rangli displey, ko'proq dasturlanadigan tugmalar, PoE qo'llab-quvvatlashni nazarda tutadi. Rahbarlar va operatorlar uchun kengaytirilgan tugmali panel modullariga ega modellar mos keladi.
- PoE qo'llab-quvvatlash. Ethernet kabeli orqali quvvatlantirish har bir telefonga alohida 220 V kabel tortish zaruratidan xalos qiladi, montajni soddalashtiradi va inshoot narxini pasaytiradi.
- Protokollar va moslik. Telefonlar va ATS SIP — turli ishlab chiqaruvchilar uskunasining mosligini ta'minlovchi ochiq standartni qo'llab-quvvatlashiga ishonch hosil qiling. TLS va SRTP qo'llab-quvvatlash mavjudligi muzokaralarni shifrlashni kafolatlaydi.
- Analog liniyalar uchun VoIP-shlyuzlar. Agar binoda allaqachon analog liniyalar tortilgan bo'lsa yoki faks-apparatlarni ulash zarur bo'lsa, analog signalni IP ga aylantiradigan FXS/FXO-shlyuz kerak bo'ladi. 72 va undan ortiq portli shlyuzlar yirik obyektlar ehtiyojlarini qoplaydi.
- Videoaloqa. Bir qator modellar o'rnatilgan kamera bilan jihozlangan yoki tashqi kamerani ulashni qo'llab-quvvatlaydi, bu qo'shimcha uskunasiz videokonferensiyalar tashkil qilish imkonini beradi.
- Zaxiralash va uzilishlarga chidamlilik. Muhim obyektlar uchun zaxira aloqa kanalini, shuningdek tarmoqda ovozli trafikni prioritetlash uchun VLAN va QoS qo'llab-quvvatlashni ko'zda tutish muhim.

## Qo'llanilish sohalari

- Korporativ ofislar va holdinglar. Ichki raqamlash, qayta yo'naltirish va konferens-aloqa bilan barcha bo'linmalar uchun yagona telefon tizimi.
- Call-markazlar va qo'llab-quvvatlash xizmatlari. Ko'p sonli bir vaqtdagi liniyalarni qo'llab-quvvatlaydigan, CRM bilan integratsiya va suhbatlarni yozib olishga ega IP-ATS.
- Mehmonxonalar va mehmondo'stlik obyektlari. Har bir xonada telefonli, yagona konserj-xizmatidan boshqariladigan va mehmonxonani boshqarish tizimi bilan integratsiyalangan tizim.
- Sanoat korxonalari va ishlab chiqarish komplekslari. Himoyalangan apparatlardan foydalangan holda sexlar, omborlar va ma'muriy bino o'rtasidagi ishonchli aloqa.
- Tibbiyot muassasalari va klinikalar. Bo'limlar, ro'yxatga olish va xodimlar o'rtasidagi tez ichki aloqa, muhim muzokaralarni yozib olish imkoniyati bilan.
- O'quv muassasalari va davlat tashkilotlari. O'zbekistonning maktablari, universitetlari va idoralari uchun minimal ekspluatatsiya xarajatlari bilan markazlashtirilgan ovozli infratuzilma.

## Katalogdagi brendlar va modellar

- Cisco. Korporativ IP-telefoniyaning jahon yetakchilaridan biri. Katalogda UC Phone 7821 seriyali apparatlar va 8800 seriyasi uchun kengaytirish modullari taqdim etilgan — ishonchlilikka yuqori talablar qo'yiladigan o'rta va yirik korporativ inshootlar uchun uskuna.
- Fanvil. Ofis IP-telefonlari segmentida kuchli mavqega ega xitoy ishlab chiqaruvchisi. V va X seriyali modellar keng diapazonni qamrab oladi: bazaviy apparatlardan tortib CM60 kamerali Fanvil X7A kabi kamerali videotelefonlargacha.
- Pixietech. Katalogda ofis qo'llanishi uchun PXT seriyali IP-telefonlar bilan taqdim etilgan brend — kichik va o'rta kompaniyalar uchun arzon yechimlar.
- TAU VoIP-shlyuzlari. TAU seriyali ko'p portli FXS-shlyuzlar (jumladan 72 portli modellar) analog abonentlarni IP-infratuzilmaga ulash uchun mo'ljallangan, bu mavjud telefon tarmoqlarini modernizatsiya qilishda dolzarb.
- AIO seriyali IP-ATS. FXS/FXO-interfeyslarini qo'llab-quvvatlaydigan 200 va undan ortiq SIP-akkauntli dasturiy-apparat platformalari — korporativ markaziy ofis uchun tayyor yechim.

## FAQ

Q: IP-telefoniyani mavjud analog liniyalarga ulash mumkinmi?
A: Ha, buning uchun analog signalni SIP ga va aksincha aylantiradigan FXO-interfeysli VoIP-shlyuzlar qo'llaniladi. Shu tariqa amaldagi shahar raqamlarini saqlab qolish va tizimni bosqichma-bosqich IP-infratuzilmaga o'tkazish mumkin.

Q: Toshkentda ofis uchun IP-telefoniya qancha turadi?

Kichik ofis uchun bazaviy to'plam an'anaviy ATSdan sezilarli darajada arzonroq, o'zini oqlash esa aloqa xarajatlarining kamayishi hisobiga erishiladi. Aniq hisobni SAT Solutions obyekt talablarini tahlil qilgach tayyorlaydi.

Q: IP-ATS uchun ajratilgan server kerakmi?
A: Zamonaviy dasturiy-apparat IP-ATSlar alohida serverni talab qilmaydigan tayyor qurilmalar ko'rinishida yetkazib beriladi. Yirik inshootlar uchun dasturiy ATSni virtual mashinaga yoki buyurtmachining fizik serveriga o'rnatish ham mumkin.

Q: Internet o'chirilganda IP-telefonlar ishlaydimi?
A: Lokal tarmoq abonentlari o'rtasidagi ichki qo'ng'iroqlar obyekt ichida IP-ATS mavjud bo'lganda ishlashda davom etadi. Tashqi aloqa kanallarini zaxiralash uchun zaxira internet-kanal yoki GSM-shlyuzni ko'zda tutish tavsiya etiladi.

Q: IP-telefoniya uskunasiga qanday kafolat beriladi?
A: SAT Solutions yetkazib beradigan uskunaga rasmiy ishlab chiqaruvchi kafolati tarqaladi. Kafolat muddati brend va modelga bog'liq bo'lib, qoida tariqasida bir yildan uch yilgacha. Kompaniya shuningdek muhim obyektlar uchun kengaytirilgan servis shartnomalarini taklif qiladi.
pxt-voip.en:
IP telephony is a technology for transmitting voice over IP networks that has replaced traditional analog PBXs and today forms the basis of corporate communications in companies of any scale. Unlike classic telephony, IP solutions make it possible to unite voice, video and data in a single infrastructure, significantly reduce the costs of internal and international calls, and flexibly scale the system as the organization grows. SAT Solutions offers to buy IP telephony equipment in Tashkent with professional selection and installation.

The catalog includes 57 items: IP phones for rank-and-file employees and managers, software and hardware IP PBXs, VoIP gateways for connecting analog lines and subscribers, expansion modules and auxiliary equipment. Such a range covers the needs of both a small office of 10-20 subscribers and a large call center or a multi-branch company in Uzbekistan.

A sound choice of IP telephony begins with an analysis of tasks: whether integration with CRM, video communication, call recording or remote employees are needed. This determines the choice of the PBX platform, the class of telephone sets and the type of gateways. SAT Solutions specialists will help build the system architecture and select the optimal set of equipment.

## How to choose

- Number of subscribers and channels. The capacity of an IP PBX determines the maximum number of simultaneous calls and registered accounts. For example, a platform for 200 SIP accounts is suitable for a medium enterprise, whereas a small office is served by a solution for 20-50 users.
- IP phone class. The entry class comprises basic sets with 2-4 lines for rank-and-file employees. The mid and senior class implies a color display, more programmable keys, PoE support. For managers and operators, models with extended button-panel modules are suitable.
- PoE support. Power over the Ethernet cable eliminates the need to run a separate 220 V cable to each phone, simplifies installation and reduces the cost of the installation.
- Protocols and compatibility. Make sure that the phones and the PBX support SIP — an open standard ensuring compatibility of equipment from different manufacturers. The presence of TLS and SRTP support guarantees encryption of calls.
- VoIP gateways for analog lines. If analog lines are already laid in the building or fax machines need to be connected, an FXS/FXO gateway is required, converting the analog signal into IP. Gateways with 72 or more ports cover the needs of large facilities.
- Video communication. A number of models are equipped with a built-in camera or support connection of an external camera, which makes it possible to organize video conferences without additional equipment.
- Redundancy and fault tolerance. For critical facilities, it is important to provide a backup communication channel, as well as support for VLAN and QoS to prioritize voice traffic on the network.

## Applications

- Corporate offices and holdings. A unified telephone system for all divisions with internal numbering, call forwarding and conference calling.
- Call centers and support services. IP PBXs with support for a large number of simultaneous lines, integration with CRM and call recording.
- Hotels and hospitality facilities. A system with phones in every room, management from a single concierge service and integration with the hotel management system.
- Industrial enterprises and production complexes. Reliable communication between shops, warehouses and the administrative building using protected devices.
- Medical institutions and clinics. Fast internal communication between departments, the reception desk and staff with the ability to record important calls.
- Educational institutions and government organizations. A centralized voice infrastructure for schools, universities and agencies of Uzbekistan with minimal operating costs.

## Brands and models in the catalog

- Cisco. One of the world leaders in corporate IP telephony. The catalog features the UC Phone 7821 series sets and expansion modules for the 8800 series — equipment for medium and large corporate installations with high reliability requirements.
- Fanvil. A Chinese manufacturer holding strong positions in the office IP phone segment. The V and X series models cover a wide range: from basic sets to video phones with a camera, such as the Fanvil X7A with the CM60 camera.
- Pixietech. A brand represented in the catalog by PXT series IP phones for office use — affordable solutions for small and medium companies.
- TAU VoIP gateways. Multiport FXS gateways of the TAU series (including 72-port models) are designed for connecting analog subscribers to the IP infrastructure, which is relevant when upgrading existing telephone networks.
- AIO series IP PBXs. Software-hardware platforms for 200 or more SIP accounts with support for FXS/FXO interfaces — a ready-made solution for a corporate central office.

## FAQ

Q: Can IP telephony be connected to existing analog lines?
A: Yes, for this VoIP gateways with FXO interfaces are used, which convert the analog signal into SIP and back. This makes it possible to keep the existing city numbers and gradually transfer the system to an IP infrastructure.

Q: How much does IP telephony cost for an office in Tashkent?
A: The cost depends on the number of subscribers, the equipment class and the required functionality. A basic kit for a small office costs significantly less than a traditional PBX, and the payback is achieved through reduced communication costs. SAT Solutions will prepare an exact calculation after analyzing the facility's requirements.

Q: Is a dedicated server needed for an IP PBX?
A: Modern software-hardware IP PBXs are supplied as ready-made devices that do not require a separate server. For large installations, it is also possible to install a software PBX on a virtual machine or the customer's physical server.

Q: Do IP phones work when the internet is down?
A: Internal calls between subscribers of the local network continue to work if there is an IP PBX inside the facility. To back up external communication channels, it is recommended to provide a backup internet channel or a GSM gateway.

Q: What warranty applies to IP telephony equipment?
A: The equipment supplied by SAT Solutions is covered by the official manufacturer's warranty. The warranty period depends on the brand and model and, as a rule, ranges from one to three years. The company also offers extended service contracts for mission-critical facilities.

Videodevorlar dekoderlari va kontrollerlari — bu IP-kameralar va videoregistratorlardan tarmoq oqimlarini qabul qiluvchi, ularni dekodlaydigan va tasvirni monitorlarga, televizorlarga yoki tarkibli videodevorga chiqaradigan uskuna. Mohiyatan bu video manbalari va tasvirlash vositalari o'rtasidagi bog'lovchi bo'g'in: dekoder ko'plab H.264/H.265 oqimlarini qayta ishlashning resurs talab qiluvchi vazifasini o'z zimmasiga oladi va operator uchun tayyor tasvirni shakllantiradi, shu bilan serverlar va ish stansiyalarini yuklamadan xalos qiladi. Muayyan chiqarish sxemasi va kerakli kanallar soniga mos videodevorlar dekoderlari va kontrollerlarini Toshkentda SAT Solutions katalogi orqali sotib olish mumkin, bu yerda uskuna mavjud videokuzatuv tizimi arxitekturasiga moslab tanlanadi.

Bunday qurilmalarga ehtiyoj kameralar va nazorat nuqtalari soni bitta ekran doirasidan chiqib ketgan joyda paydo bo'ladi. Dispetcherga bir vaqtning o'zida o'nlab yoki yuzlab oqimlarni ko'rish kerak bo'lganda, ish stansiyasining oddiy monitori yetarli emas — bir nechta paneldan iborat yirik formatli devorga markazlashtirilgan chiqarish talab qilinadi. Dekoder oqimlarni ekranlar bo'ylab moslashuvchan tarzda joylashtirish, joylashuvlarni almashtirish, alohida kameralarni butun devorga masshtablash va alohida shaxsiy kompyuter ishtirokisiz tasvirni panellar o'rtasida ko'chirish imkonini beradi, bu sutkalik navbatchilik xizmatlari uchun muhim.

O'zbekistondagi obyektlar uchun — vaziyat markazlaridan va sanoat korxonalarining dispetcherxonalaridan tortib savdo komplekslarining monitoring zallari va qo'riqlash pultlarigacha — bu uskuna videooqimlarni 24/7 rejimida ishonchli va barqaror tasvirlashni ta'minlaydi. Apparat dekodlash dasturiy chiqarishga xos "qotib qolish" va kadr tushishlarini bartaraf etadi, ixcham ijro va past issiqlik ajratish esa qurilmalarni qo'shimcha sovutishsiz stellajlarga joylashtirish imkonini beradi, hatto yozgi haroratlar +45 °C ga yetadigan mintaqaning issiq iqlimida ham. Savodli tanlangan dekoder butun tasvirlash tizimining markaziy elementiga aylanadi va operatorning oqimlar bilan qanchalik qulay va operativ ishlashini belgilaydi.

Videodevorlar dekoderlari va kontrollerlari — bu izolyatsiyalangan holda emas, balki kameralar, registratorlar, tarmoq va tasvirlash panellarining o'zi bilan bog'liq holda tanlanadigan infratuzilma yechimi ekanligini tushunish muhim. Xarid bosqichida kanallar soni yoki chiqarish aniqligini hisoblashdagi xato yo ortiqcha imkoniyatlar uchun ortiqcha to'lovga, yo tizimni kengaytirishda resurslar yetishmasligiga aylanadi. Shuning uchun bunday qurilmalarni tanlashga alohida komponent xaridi sifatida emas, balki yagona loyihaning qismi sifatida yondashish kerak.

## Qanday tanlash kerak

- **Kirish kanallari soni va formati:** bir vaqtning o'zida qancha IP-oqim va qanday aniqlikda dekodlanishi kerakligini aniqlang. Modellar turli miqdordagi kanallarga va 4K gacha oqimlarni qo'llab-quvvatlashga mo'ljallangan — tizim o'sishi uchun zaxira qo'yish muhim.
- **Chiqarish aniqligi va 4K qo'llab-quvvatlash:** agar videodevor yoki monitorlarda yuqori aniqlikda tasvirlash rejalashtirilsa, dekoder 4K (Ultra HD) chiqarishni qo'llab-quvvatlashi kerak. Bu ayniqsa detallashtirilgan sahnalarni chiqarishda va alohida kamerani butun devorga masshtablashda dolzarb.
- **Videochiqishlar soni va turi:** fizik chiqishlar sonini (HDMI va h.k.) va yagona devorga birlashtirish mumkin bo'lgan panellar maksimal sonini tekshiring. Joylashuvning yakuniy geometriyasi shunga bog'liq.
- **Qo'llab-quvvatlanadigan kodeklar:** H.265/H.264 bilan moslikka ishonch hosil qiling — zamonaviy H.265 kodeki bir xil sifatda tarmoqqa yukni sezilarli darajada kamaytiradi, bu ko'p sonli kameralarda muhim.
- **Kameralar va NVR bilan moslik:** dekoder allaqachon o'rnatilgan uskuna bilan to'g'ri ishlashi kerak. Dahua yechimlari uchun bitta ekotizim doirasidagi va ONVIF bo'yicha moslik oldindan aytib beriladi va sozlashni soddalashtiradi.
- **Joylashuvlar va boshqaruv moslashuvchanligi:** sahnalarni almashtirish, ko'p ekranli joylashuvlar, bitta kamerani bir nechta panelga "tortish" va chiqarishni masofadan boshqarish imkoniyatlarini baholang.
- **Ekspluatatsiya sharoitlari va stellaj:** stellajga montaj qilish, issiqlik ajratish va 24/7 rejimida ishlashning barqarorligini hisobga oling — navbatchilik markazlari uchun bu hal qiluvchi omil.

## Qo'llanilish sohalari

- **Davlat va munitsipal xizmatlarning vaziyat va dispetcher markazlari**, bu yerda ko'plab oqimlarni videodevorga markazlashtirilgan chiqarish talab qilinadi.
- **Sanoat korxonalari va ishlab chiqarishlar** — texnologik uchastkalar, perimetr va ombor zonalarini yagona nazorat zalidan monitoring qilish.
- **Savdo markazlari va yirik do'konlar** — savdo zallari, kassalar va avtoturargohlar kameralarini chiqaradigan qo'riqlash pultlari.
- **Transport va infratuzilma obyektlari** — vokzallar, logistika xablari, ko'p sonli kuzatuv nuqtalariga ega avtoturargoh komplekslari.
- **Turar-joy komplekslari va biznes-markazlar** — kirish joylari, hovlilar va kirish guruhlarini nazorat qiluvchi konserj-xizmatlar va qo'riqlash postlari.
- **Maxsus obyektlar va qo'riqlash pultlari** — banklar, energetika, uzluksiz videonazoratga yuqori talablar qo'yiladigan obyektlar.

## Katalogdagi brendlar va modellar

- **Dahua** — toifaning asosiy brendi, ekotizim ichida oldindan aytib beriladigan moslik va ONVIF qo'llab-quvvatlash bilan videokuzatuv uskunalarini ishlab chiqarishning jahon yetakchilaridan biri.
- **Dahua DHI-NVD1205DH-4I-4K** — 4K aniqlikda chiqarishni qo'llab-quvvatlaydigan tarmoq dekoderi; videodevorlar qurish va IP-oqimlarni markazlashtirilgan chiqarish uchun yechim.
- **Dahua DHI-NVD1505DH-4I-4K** — 4K ni qo'llab-quvvatlaydigan NVD seriyali tarmoq dekoderi, ko'p sonli kanallar bilan ishlashga va bir nechta panelda moslashuvchan joylashuvlarga mo'ljallangan.
- **Dahua NVD seriyasi** — tasvirlash tizimlari uchun tarmoq dekoderlari liniyasi: H.265/H.264 apparat dekodlash, monitorlar va videodevorlarga chiqarish, joylashuvlarni boshqarish.

## FAQ

Q: Dekoder videoregistratordan (NVR) nimasi bilan farq qiladi?
A: NVR birinchi navbatda videooqimlarni yozib oladi va saqlaydi, dekoder esa ularni real vaqt rejimida monitorlarga va videodevorga chiqarish uchun mo'ljallangan. Yirik tizimlarda bu qurilmalar bir-birini to'ldiradi: NVR arxiv yuritadi, dekoder esa operator pultida markazlashtirilgan tasvirlashni ta'minlaydi.

Q: Bitta dekoderda bir nechta paneldan videodevor qurish mumkinmi?
A: Ha, Dahua NVD seriyali tarmoq dekoderlari bir nechta chiqishni moslashuvchan joylashuvlar bilan yagona videodevorga birlashtirishga mo'ljallangan. Panellarning aniq soni model va chiqarish formatiga bog'liq — SAT Solutions mutaxassislari sxemangizga mos konfiguratsiyani tanlab beradi.

Q: Dahua dekoderi boshqa ishlab chiqaruvchi kameralariga mos keladimi?
A: Qoida tariqasida ha, agar kameralar ONVIF standartini va mos H.265/H.264 kodeklarni qo'llab-quvvatlasa. Maksimal oldindan aytib beriladigan moslik Dahua yagona ekotizimi doirasida erishiladi, muayyan uskuna bo'yicha tekshirishni esa biz loyihalash bosqichida bajaramiz.

Q: Devorga video chiqarish uchun alohida kompyuter kerakmi?
A: Yo'q, apparat dekoderining mohiyati aynan shunda: u mustaqil ravishda tarmoq oqimlarini qabul qiladi va ajratilgan shaxsiy kompyutersiz tasvir shakllantiradi. Bu 24/7 uzluksiz ishlashning ishonchliligini oshiradi va egalik qilishning umumiy narxini pasaytiradi.

Q: Siz bunday uskunani O'zbekiston mintaqalarida yetkazib berasiz va montaj qilasizmi?
A: Ha, SAT Solutions ham Toshkentda, ham mamlakatning boshqa mintaqalarida yetkazib berish, montaj va ishga tushirishni bajaradi. Biz yetkazib berishni, stellajga o'rnatishni, joylashuvlarni sozlashni va amaldagi videokuzatuv tizimi bilan integratsiyani tashkil qilamiz.
decoders.en:
Decoders and video wall controllers are equipment that receives network streams from IP cameras and video recorders, decodes them and outputs the image to monitors, TVs or a composite video wall. In essence, this is the link between video sources and display facilities: the decoder takes on the resource-intensive task of processing multiple H.264/H.265 streams and forms a ready image for the operator, while offloading servers and workstations. You can buy decoders and wall controllers in Tashkent for a specific output scheme and the required number of channels through the SAT Solutions catalog, where equipment is selected for the architecture of the existing video surveillance system.

The need for such devices arises where the number of cameras and control points exceeds the scope of a single screen. When a dispatcher needs to see dozens or hundreds of streams simultaneously, an ordinary workstation monitor is not enough — centralized output to a large-format wall of several panels is required. The decoder makes it possible to flexibly lay out streams across screens, switch layouts, scale individual cameras to the entire wall and move the image between panels without a separate PC, which is critical for round-the-clock duty services.

For facilities in Uzbekistan — from situation centers and dispatch rooms of industrial enterprises to monitoring rooms of shopping complexes and security posts — this equipment ensures reliable and stable display of video streams in 24/7 mode. Hardware decoding eliminates the "freezes" and frame drops characteristic of software output, and the compact design and low heat dissipation make it possible to place the devices in racks without additional cooling even in the hot climate of the region, where summer temperatures reach +45 °C. A well-chosen decoder becomes the central element of the entire display system and determines how comfortably and promptly the operator works with the streams.

It is important to understand that decoders and video wall controllers are an infrastructure solution that is selected not in isolation but in conjunction with cameras, recorders, the network and the display panels themselves. An error in calculating the number of channels or the output resolution at the procurement stage results either in overpaying for excessive capabilities or in a shortage of resources when expanding the system. Therefore, the choice of such devices should be approached as part of a unified project, not as the purchase of a separate component.

## How to choose

- **Number and format of input channels:** determine how many IP streams should be decoded simultaneously and at what resolution. Models are designed for different numbers of channels and support streams up to 4K — it is important to allow for a reserve for system growth.
- **Output resolution and 4K support:** if display in high resolution is planned on the video wall or monitors, the decoder must support 4K (Ultra HD) output. This is especially relevant when outputting detailed scenes and scaling an individual camera to the entire wall.
- **Number and type of video outputs:** check the number of physical outputs (HDMI, etc.) and the maximum number of panels that can be combined into a single wall. The final layout geometry depends on this.
- **Supported codecs:** make sure of compatibility with H.265/H.264 — the modern H.265 codec noticeably reduces the network load at the same quality, which is important with a large number of cameras.
- **Compatibility with cameras and NVR:** the decoder must work correctly with already installed equipment. For Dahua solutions, compatibility within a single ecosystem and via ONVIF is predictable and simplifies setup.
- **Flexibility of layouts and control:** assess the capabilities of scene switching, multi-screen layouts, "pulling out" one camera onto several panels and remote output control.
- **Operating conditions and rack:** take into account rack mounting, heat dissipation and stability of 24/7 operation — for duty centers this is a decisive factor.

## Applications

- **Situation and dispatch centers** of state and municipal services, where centralized output of multiple streams to a video wall is required.
- **Industrial enterprises and production** — monitoring of technological areas, the perimeter and warehouse zones from a single control room.
- **Shopping centers and large stores** — security desks with the output of cameras from retail halls, checkouts and parking lots.
- **Transport and infrastructure facilities** — stations, logistics hubs, parking complexes with a large number of surveillance points.
- **Residential complexes and business centers** — concierge services and security posts controlling entrances, courtyards and entrance groups.
- **Special facilities and security desks** — banks, energy, facilities with heightened requirements for continuous video monitoring.

## Brands and models in the catalog

- **Dahua** — the main brand of the category, one of the world leaders in the production of video surveillance equipment with predictable compatibility within the ecosystem and ONVIF support.
- **Dahua DHI-NVD1205DH-4I-4K** — a network decoder with support for 4K output; a solution for building video walls and centralized output of IP streams.
- **Dahua DHI-NVD1505DH-4I-4K** — a network decoder of the NVD series with 4K support, designed to work with a large number of channels and flexible layouts across several panels.
- **Dahua NVD series** — a line of network decoders for display systems: hardware decoding of H.265/H.264, output to monitors and video walls, layout management.

## FAQ

Q: How does a decoder differ from a video recorder (NVR)?
A: An NVR primarily records and stores video streams, whereas a decoder is intended for their output to monitors and a video wall in real time. In large systems, these devices complement each other: the NVR maintains the archive, and the decoder provides centralized display at the operator's desk.

Q: Can a video wall of several panels be built on a single decoder?
A: Yes, network decoders of the Dahua NVD series are designed to combine several outputs into a single video wall with flexible layouts. The exact number of panels depends on the model and the output format — SAT Solutions specialists will select a configuration for your scheme.

Q: Will a Dahua decoder work with cameras from another manufacturer?
A: As a rule, yes, if the cameras support the ONVIF standard and compatible H.265/H.264 codecs. The most predictable compatibility is achieved within a single Dahua ecosystem, and we perform verification for specific equipment at the design stage.

Q: Is a separate computer needed to output video to the wall?
A: No, that is exactly the point of a hardware decoder: it independently receives network streams and forms the image without a dedicated PC. This increases the reliability of continuous 24/7 operation and reduces the total cost of ownership.

Q: Do you supply and install such equipment in the regions of Uzbekistan?
A: Yes, SAT Solutions performs supply, installation and commissioning both in Tashkent and in other regions of the country. We arrange delivery, rack installation, layout configuration and integration with the existing video surveillance system.
