Wi-Fi signal kuchaytirgichlari (repiterlar, takrorlagichlar) — bu router mavjud simsiz signalini qabul qilib, uni yana uzoqroqqa qayta uzatuvchi, kvartira, uy yoki ofisning asosiy marshrutizatordan to'lqin allaqachon yetib bormaydigan yoki kuchsizlanib yetib boradigan zonalariga qamrov maydonini kengaytiruvchi qurilmalardir. Ular qalin devorlar, uzun koridorlar, ko'p xonali planirovkalar va ikkinchi qavatning tipik muammosini hal qiladi, bu yerda tezlik pasayadi, ulanish esa doimiy uziladi. Muayyan planirovkaga va allaqachon o'rnatilgan routerga mos Wi-Fi signal kuchaytirgichlarini Toshkentda SAT Solutions katalogi orqali sotib olish qulay: biz "quti"ni tavakkaliga sotmasdan, maydon, diapazon va kerakli tezlik bo'yicha model tanlaymiz.

To'liq mesh-tizim yoki yangi kabel tortishdan farqli o'laroq, kuchaytirgich — bu daqiqalarda o'rnatiladigan tez va arzon yechim: qurilma rozetkaga ulanadi, WPS tugmasi orqali router bilan sinxronlanadi va darhol muammoli zonada tarmoq tarqata boshlaydi. Aksariyat maishiy va kichik tijorat vazifalari uchun bu yetarli: signalni uzoq yotoqxonaga, devor ortidagi omborga, koridor oxiridagi muzokara xonasiga yoki xususiy uyning hovlisidagi dam olish zonasiga yetkazish. Ushbu toifadagi qurilmalarning bir qismi burama juftlik olib kelinsa, mustaqil kirish nuqtasi sifatida ham ishlashi mumkin.

O'zbekiston sharoitida, bu yerda kapital g'isht va beton devorli ko'plab xususiy uylar, ko'p qavatli ofislar va vitrina hamda stellajlarga ega savdo xonalari mavjud, to'g'ri tanlangan kuchaytirgich infratuzilmani qimmat qayta ishlashsiz tarmoq barqarorligini sezilarli darajada oshiradi. Texnologiya cheklovini tushunish muhim: repiter aynan o'zi qabul qiladigan signalni qayta uzatadi, shuning uchun uni internet deyarli yo'q joyda emas, balki ishonchli qabul nuqtasida qo'yish kerak. Quyida — tanlash mezonlari, qo'llash stsenariylari va katalogimizdagi modellar.

## Qanday tanlash kerak

- **Diapazon (Single-band / Dual-band):** Mercusys MW300RE va ME30 kabi modellar 2,4 GHz diapazonida ishlaydi — u uzoqroqqa yetadi va devorlar orqali yaxshiroq o'tadi, maishiy vazifalar va katta maydon uchun mos keladi. Ikki diapazonli ME50G va ME80X qisqa masofalarda yuqori tezlik uchun 5 GHz qo'shadi — bu striming, videoqo'ng'iroqlar va zich trafik uchun tanlov.
- **Tezlik va Wi-Fi standarti:** real ehtiyojni baholang. MW300RE/ME30 N300 ga (300 Mbit/s gacha) mo'ljallangan — bu veb-serfing va video uchun yetarli. ME50G va ayniqsa Wi-Fi 6 (AX) qo'llab-quvvatlaydigan ME80X tezlik va bir vaqtdagi ulanishlar soni bo'yicha sezilarli darajada katta zaxira beradi.
- **Ethernet-portning mavjudligi:** gigabitli portli modellar (masalan, ME50G, ME80X) televizor, pristavka, shaxsiy kompyuter yoki IP-kamerani kabel bilan ulash imkonini beradi va bir vaqtning o'zida simli "ko'prik" vazifasini bajaradi — bu qurilmaning o'z Wi-Fi'si yo'q joyda yoki barqarorlik kerak bo'lganda muhim.
- **Ish rejimi (repiter / kirish nuqtasi):** ME80X va bir qator qurilmalar nafaqat takrorlagich, balki kabeldan kirish nuqtasi sifatida ham ishlashni biladi. Agar tarmoqni rivojlantirish rejalashtirilsa — keyinchalik uskunani almashtirmaslik uchun AP rejimli modelni oling.
- **Maydon va devor materiali:** beton va g'isht ostiga quvvat bo'yicha zaxira va o'tuvchanlik qobiliyati uchun 2,4 GHz diapazonini qo'ying. Ochiq ofislar va gipsokarton devorli kvartiralar uchun ixchamroq modellar yetarli.
- **Router bilan moslik:** kuchaytirgichlar deyarli har qanday ishlab chiqaruvchi marshrutizatori bilan ishlaydi, lekin router va repiter bir brenddan bo'lganda qulayroq (yagona sozlash mantig'i, Mercusys/TP-Link'da OneMesh uzluksiz rouming).
- **Quvvat va shakl-omil:** toifaning barcha qurilmalari — devorli, to'g'ridan-to'g'ri rozetkaga ulanadi. Rozetkaning ishonchli signal qabul nuqtasidagi joylashuvini va to'g'ri o'rnatish uchun signal darajasi indikatorining mavjudligini hisobga oling.

## Qo'llanilish sohalari

- **Kvartiralar va xususiy uylar:** signalni uzoq xonalarga, ikkinchi qavatga, mansardaga, yerto'laga yoki hovliga yetkazish — turar-joy sektorida eng ommaviy stsenariy.
- **Kichik ofislar va kovorkinglar:** qo'shimcha kabel tortmasdan muzokara xonalari, uzoq kabinetlar va koridor oxiridagi zonalarni qamrash.
- **Savdo (do'konlar, shourumlar):** metall stellajlar va vitrinalar signalni bo'g'adigan savdo zaliga, omborga va yordamchi xonalarga tarmoqni kengaytirish.
- **Kafe, restoranlar, mehmon zonalari:** yozgi maydonchalarda, terrasalarda va bankett zallarida barqaror mehmon Wi-Fi'si.
- **Turar-joy komplekslari va apartamentlar:** murakkab planirovka va kapital to'siqlarga ega katta kvartiralarda tarmoqni kuchaytirish.
- **Ombor va yordamchi xonalar:** asosiy router fizik jihatdan yetib bormaydigan uchastkalar uchun kirish nuqtasi rejimida kabel orqali ulash.

## Katalogdagi brendlar va modellar

- **Mercusys ME80X** — toifaning flagmani: Wi-Fi 6 (AX) qo'llab-quvvatlaydigan, gigabitli portli va kirish nuqtasi rejimli ikki diapazonli kuchaytirgich. Zamonaviy vazifalar uchun maksimal tezlik va ulanishlar bo'yicha zaxira.
- **Mercusys ME50G** — gigabitli Ethernet-portli ikki diapazonli model (2,4 + 5 GHz). O'rta o'lchamli kvartiralar va ofislar uchun tezlik va barqarorlik muvozanati.
- **Mercusys ME30** — maishiy stsenariylarda qamrov zonasini bazaviy kengaytirish uchun ixcham kuchaytirgich, WPS orqali oddiy sozlash.
- **Mercusys MW300RE** — uy va kichik ofisning uzoqqa qamrovi uchun 2,4 GHz diapazonidagi byudjetli N300-repiter.

Barcha pozitsiyalar — original Mercusys mahsuloti (TP-Link guruhi brendi), bu ekotizim bilan moslikni va xuddi shu oiladagi routerlar bilan oldindan aytib beriladigan ishlashni ta'minlaydi.

## FAQ

Q: Wi-Fi kuchaytirgich internet tezligini kesadimi?
A: Klassik repiter resursni qabul va uzatish o'rtasida bo'lishadi, shuning uchun 2,4 GHz'da tezlikning pasayishi mumkin. Mercusys ME50G va ME80X kabi ikki diapazonli modellar 5 GHz va Wi-Fi 6'da ishlash hisobiga bu effektni minimallashtiradi. SAT Solutions mutaxassislari muammoli zonadagi real tezlik sizni qanoatlantiradigan tarzda model tanlab beradi.

Q: Kuchaytirgich mesh-tizimdan nimasi bilan farq qiladi?
A: Kuchaytirgich mavjud router signalini qayta uzatadi va arzonroq turadi, lekin tarmoqlar o'rtasidagi almashinuv ideal uzluksiz bo'lmasligi mumkin. Mesh silliq rouming bilan yagona tarmoq quradi, lekin qimmatroq. Bir-ikki muammoli zona uchun kuchaytirgich maqbul; katta uy uchun biz SAT Solutions'da mesh yoki gibrid yechim taklif qilamiz.

Q: Kuchaytirgich mening routerim bilan ishlaydimi?
A: Ha, kuchaytirgichlar deyarli har qanday brend marshrutizatorlari bilan mos keladi. Router va repiter bir ishlab chiqaruvchidan bo'lganda qulayroq (masalan, OneMesh qo'llab-quvvatlaydigan Mercusys + TP-Link birikmasi) — sozlash va rouming osonroq. Routeringiz modelini menejerga ayting, biz moslikni tasdiqlaymiz.

Q: Kuchaytirgichni qayerga to'g'ri qo'yish kerak?
A: Asosiy router signali hali ishonchli bo'lgan nuqtaga — taxminan router va muammoli zona o'rtasidagi yo'lning yarmiga. Agar uni internet deyarli yo'q joyda qo'ysangiz, qurilma xuddi shunday kuchsiz signal tarqatadi. Ko'plab Mercusys modellari joyni tanlashga yordam beradigan signal darajasi indikatoriga ega; Toshkentda montaj qilishda muhandislarimiz nuqtani amaliy tanlaydi.

Q: Kuchaytirgichga qurilmani kabel orqali ulash mumkinmi?
A: Ha, Mercusys ME50G va ME80X kabi Ethernet-portli modellar TV, pristavka, shaxsiy kompyuter yoki kamerani sim orqali ulash va hatto kabeldan kirish nuqtasi rejimida ishlash imkonini beradi. Bu ulanishning maksimal barqarorligi muhim bo'lgan zonalar uchun qulay.
mercusys-extenders.en:
Wi-Fi signal boosters (repeaters, extenders) are devices that receive the existing wireless signal of a router and retransmit it further, expanding the coverage area into those zones of an apartment, house or office that the wave from the main router already does not reach or reaches weakened. They solve the typical problem of thick walls, long corridors, multi-room layouts and a second floor, where the speed drops and the connection constantly breaks off. It is convenient to buy Wi-Fi signal boosters in Tashkent for a specific layout and for an already installed router through the SAT Solutions catalog: we select a model by area, band and required speed, rather than selling a "box at random".

Unlike a full-fledged mesh system or laying new cable, a booster is a fast and inexpensive solution that is set up in minutes: the device plugs into a socket, synchronizes with the router via the WPS button and immediately starts distributing the network in the problem zone. For most household and small commercial tasks this is enough: to extend the signal to a distant bedroom, to a warehouse behind a wall, to a meeting room at the end of a corridor or to a lounge area in the yard of a private house. Some devices in this category can also work as a standalone access point if twisted pair is brought to them.

In the conditions of Uzbekistan, where there are many private houses with solid brick and concrete walls, multi-story offices and retail premises with display windows and shelving, a correctly selected booster noticeably raises network stability without a costly infrastructure rebuild. It is important to understand the limitation of the technology: a repeater retransmits exactly the signal it receives itself, so it must be placed at a point of confident reception, not where there is almost no internet left. Below are the selection criteria, usage scenarios and models from our catalog.

## How to choose

- **Band (Single-band / Dual-band):** models like the Mercusys MW300RE and ME30 operate in the 2.4 GHz band — it has a longer range and passes through walls better, suitable for household tasks and a large area. The dual-band ME50G and ME80X add 5 GHz for high speed over short distances — this is the choice for streaming, video calls and dense traffic.
- **Speed and Wi-Fi standard:** assess the actual need. The MW300RE/ME30 are rated for N300 (up to 300 Mbit/s) — this is enough for web surfing and video. The ME50G and especially the ME80X with Wi-Fi 6 (AX) support provide a substantially greater reserve in speed and the number of simultaneous connections.
- **Presence of an Ethernet port:** models with a gigabit port (for example, ME50G, ME80X) allow you to connect a TV, set-top box, PC or IP camera by cable and simultaneously serve as a wired "bridge" — this is critical where the device has no Wi-Fi of its own or where stability is needed.
- **Operating mode (repeater / access point):** the ME80X and a number of devices can work not only as a repeater but also as an access point from a cable. If network expansion is planned — take a model with AP mode so as not to change equipment later.
- **Area and wall material:** for concrete and brick, allow a reserve of power and the 2.4 GHz band for penetration capability. For open offices and apartments with plasterboard walls, more compact models are sufficient.
- **Compatibility with the router:** boosters work with a router of practically any manufacturer, but it is more convenient when the router and repeater are of the same brand (unified setup logic, seamless OneMesh roaming with Mercusys/TP-Link).
- **Power and form factor:** all devices in the category are wall-mounted, plugging directly into a socket. Take into account the location of the socket at the point of confident signal reception and the presence of a signal-level indicator for correct installation.

## Applications

- **Apartments and private houses:** extending the signal to distant rooms, the second floor, the attic, the basement or the yard — the most common scenario in the residential sector.
- **Small offices and coworking spaces:** covering meeting rooms, distant offices and zones at the end of a corridor without laying additional cable.
- **Retail (shops, showrooms):** expanding the network into the retail hall, the warehouse and back rooms, where metal shelving and display windows muffle the signal.
- **Cafes, restaurants, guest areas:** stable guest Wi-Fi on summer terraces, patios and in banquet halls.
- **Residential complexes and apartments:** boosting the network in large apartments with a complex layout and solid partitions.
- **Warehouse and utility premises:** connection by cable in access-point mode for areas that the main router physically does not reach.

## Brands and models in the catalog

- **Mercusys ME80X** — the flagship of the category: a dual-band booster with Wi-Fi 6 (AX) support, a gigabit port and access-point mode. Maximum speed and a reserve in connections for modern tasks.
- **Mercusys ME50G** — a dual-band model (2.4 + 5 GHz) with a gigabit Ethernet port. A balance of speed and stability for apartments and medium-sized offices.
- **Mercusys ME30** — a compact booster for basic coverage expansion in household scenarios, simple WPS setup.
- **Mercusys MW300RE** — a budget N300 repeater of the 2.4 GHz band for long-range coverage of a house and a small office.

All items are original Mercusys products (a brand of the TP-Link group), which ensures compatibility with the ecosystem and predictable operation with routers of the same family.

## FAQ

Q: Does a Wi-Fi booster cut internet speed?
A: A classic repeater divides the resource between reception and transmission, so on 2.4 GHz a speed reduction is possible. Dual-band models like the Mercusys ME50G and ME80X minimize this effect by operating in 5 GHz and Wi-Fi 6. SAT Solutions specialists will select a model so that the real speed in the problem zone suits you.

Q: How does a booster differ from a mesh system?
A: A booster retransmits the signal of the existing router and is cheaper, but switching between networks may not be perfectly seamless. Mesh builds a unified network with smooth roaming but is more expensive. For one or two problem zones a booster is optimal; for a large house we at SAT Solutions will propose a mesh or hybrid solution.

Q: Will a booster work with my router?
A: Yes, boosters are compatible with routers of practically any brand. It is more convenient when the router and repeater are from the same manufacturer (for example, the Mercusys + TP-Link pairing with OneMesh support) — setup and roaming are simpler. Tell the manager the model of your router, and we will confirm compatibility.

Q: Where should a booster be placed correctly?
A: At a point where the signal of the main router is still confident — roughly halfway between the router and the problem zone. If you place it where there is almost no internet, the device will distribute the same weak signal. Many Mercusys models have a signal-level indicator that helps choose the location; during installation in Tashkent our engineers select the point on the spot.

Q: Can a device be connected to the booster by cable?
A: Yes, models with an Ethernet port, such as the Mercusys ME50G and ME80X, allow you to connect a TV, set-top box, PC or camera by wire and even work in access-point mode from a cable. This is convenient for zones where maximum connection stability is important.

Radioko'prik — bu kabel yoki optika tortish imkonsiz, qimmat yoki maqsadga muvofiq bo'lmagan joyda ikkita nuqtani radiokanal orqali ulaydigan bir juft simsiz qurilma. Ular yordamida ikkita bino lokal tarmoqlarini birlashtiradilar, internetni uzoq obyektga chiqaradilar, kirish yoki perimetrdagi videokuzatuv kameralarini ulaydilar, ombor va ofis o'rtasida yo'l yoki sanoat zonasi orqali aloqa tashkil qiladilar. Muayyan vazifa va masofaga mos radioko'priklarni Toshkentda SAT Solutions katalogi orqali sotib olish mumkin — biz "ro'yxat bo'yicha" emas, balki uzoqlik, tezlik va ekspluatatsiya sharoitlariga qarab model tanlaymiz.

Radioko'prikning an'anaviy simli liniyaga nisbatan asosiy afzalligi — joylashtirish tezligi va begona infratuzilmadan mustaqillik. Xandaqlarni kelishish, aloqa kanalizatsiyasini ijaraga olish yoki uchinchi shaxslar hududi orqali optika tortish shart emas. To'g'ridan-to'g'ri ko'rinishda ikkita antennani o'rnatish, ularni bir-biriga yo'naltirish va kanalni sozlash yetarli. Bu ayniqsa vaqtinchalik obyektlarda, tarmoqni tez kengaytirishda va simli ulanish fizik yoki ma'muriy cheklovlarga duch keladigan joylarda qadrlanadi.

O'zbekiston sharoitida radioko'priklar taqsimlangan obyektlarda talabgir: Toshkent chekkalaridagi ishlab chiqarish maydonchalari va omborlar, mintaqalardagi fermer va agroobyektlar, qurilish maydonchalari, qo'riqlanadigan perimetrlar, bir tuman doirasidagi filiallarga ega obyektlar. Uskuna butun yil davomida ochiq havoda ishlaydi, shuning uchun +45 °C gacha jaziramaga, changga va yog'inlarga chidamlilik, shuningdek relyef va diapazondagi shovqinlarni hisobga olgan holda trassani savodli hisoblash muhim. Loyihalash bosqichidagi xato — noto'g'ri tanlangan diapazon, baholanmagan masofa yoki trassadagi to'siq — beqaror kanalga aylanadi, shuning uchun tanlashni faqat narx bo'yicha model tanlash emas, balki mutaxassislarga ishonib topshirgan ma'qul.

## Qanday tanlash kerak

- **Uzoqlik va to'g'ridan-to'g'ri ko'rinish:** asosiy parametr. Nuqtalar o'rtasida optik ko'rinish (LOS) bo'lishi kerak; to'siqlar, daraxtlar va binolar kanal sifatini keskin pasaytiradi. Obyektlar orasidagi haqiqiy masofaga nisbatan uzoqlik bo'yicha zaxirali modelni tanlang.
- **O'tkazuvchanlik qobiliyati:** real yuklamani baholang — bir juft IP-kamera uchun kamtarin kanal yetarli, ofis tarmoqlarini birlashtirish yoki yuqori aniqlikdagi videooqimlarni uzatish uchun yuqoriroq unumdorlikka ega model kerak.
- **Chastota diapazoni:** diapazondan uzoqlik, shovqinga chidamlilik va efir yuklanganligi bog'liq. Toshkentning zich shahar qurilishida efir shovqinli, shuning uchun diapazon va kanallarni tanlash barqarorlikka "pasport" tezligidan kuchliroq ta'sir qiladi.
- **To'plam turi:** ba'zi modellar tayyor "nuqta-nuqta" (PtP) juftligi ko'rinishida yetkazib beriladi, boshqalari esa bitta bazaviy nuqtadan bir nechta abonent quvvatlanadigan "nuqta-ko'p nuqta" (PtMP) sxemalarini qurish imkonini beradi. Bu tarmog'ingiz topologiyasini belgilaydi.
- **PoE quvvati va montaj:** aksariyat ko'cha ko'priklari PoE orqali quvvatlanadi — bu machtaga yoki kronshteynga bitta kabelni tortishni soddalashtiradi. Quvvat nuqtasiga qadar kabel trassasi uzunligini va momaqaldiroqdan himoya mavjudligini hisobga oling.
- **Muhitdan himoya:** O'zbekiston iqlimida ko'chaga o'rnatish uchun chang va namlikdan himoyali korpus va yozgi jaziramani hamda qishki sovuqni qoplaydigan e'lon qilingan ish harorati diapazoni kerak.
- **Kanal xavfsizligi:** agar ko'prik orqali korporativ trafik yoki videokuzatuv ma'lumotlari o'tsa, simsiz ulanishni shifrlash mavjudligi majburiy. Simsiz liniya sukut bo'yicha ushlab olish uchun ochiq, shuning uchun kanalni himoya qilish — bu opsiya emas, balki bazaviy talab.
- **O'sish va shovqinlar uchun zaxira:** o'tkazuvchanlik qobiliyati bo'yicha zaxira qo'ying va vaqt o'tishi bilan efir zichlashishini, ayniqsa shahar qurilishida, hisobga oling. Zaxirali model almashtirish va tezlik pasayishlarisiz uzoqroq ishlaydi.

## Qo'llanilish sohalari

- **Ishlab chiqarish va omborlar:** kabel tortish qiyin bo'lgan hududda sexlar, ombor korpuslari va ma'muriy bino o'rtasidagi aloqa.
- **Savdo va logistika:** uzoq pavilonlar, bozorlardagi savdo nuqtalari va taqsimlash markazlarini yagona tarmoq va videokuzatuv tizimiga ulash.
- **Turar-joy komplekslari va kottejlar posyolkalari:** turar-joy majmualari korpuslarini birlashtirish, internet va videokuzatuvni KPP, kirish guruhlari va uzoq korpuslarga chiqarish.
- **Davlat muassasalari va ta'lim:** aloqa liniyalarini kapital qurishsiz bir hudud doirasidagi muassasalar korpuslari, maktab va oliy o'quv yurti binolari o'rtasidagi aloqa.
- **Qurilish maydonchalari:** uskunani ko'chirish imkoniyati bilan vaqtinchalik obyektlarda aloqa va internetni tez joylashtirish.
- **Maxsus obyektlar va perimetral xavfsizlik:** simli infratuzilma yo'q kirish joylari, perimetrlar va qo'riqlanadigan uchastkalardagi uzoq kameralardan videooqimni uzatish.

## Katalogdagi brendlar va modellar

- **Ruijie RG-AirMetro460G** — obyektlar o'rtasida "nuqta-nuqta" magistral simsiz kanallarini qurish uchun radioko'prik.
- **Ruijie RG-EST100-E** — qisqa va o'rta masofalarda tarmoqlarni birlashtirishning tipik vazifalari uchun EST seriyasining bazaviy darajadagi modeli.
- **Ruijie RG-EST310-V2 va RG-EST350-V2** — yuqoriroq unumdor kanallar va kengaytirilgan qo'llash stsenariylari uchun EST seriyali ko'priklar.
- **Ruijie RG-EST330F-P** — ko'chaga o'rnatish uchun PoE-quvvatni qo'llab-quvvatlaydigan EST seriyali model.
- SAT Solutions katalogida Ruijie'ning EST va AirMetro seriyali uskunasi taqdim etilgan — ekspluatatsiyada qulay va ushbu ishlab chiqaruvchining qolgan tarmoq infratuzilmasi bilan mos yagona ekotizim.

## FAQ

Q: Radioko'prikni qanday masofaga qurish mumkin?
A: Uzoqlik muayyan modelga, tanlangan diapazonga va trassa sharoitlariga bog'liq. Asosiy shart — nuqtalar o'rtasida jiddiy to'siqlarsiz to'g'ridan-to'g'ri ko'rinish. SAT Solutions mutaxassislari obyektlaringiz juftligi uchun real uzoqlikni hisoblab, kerakli zaxirali Ruijie modelini tanlab beradi.

Q: Nuqtalar o'rtasida to'g'ridan-to'g'ri ko'rinish kerakmi?
A: Ha, radioko'prikning barqaror ishlashi uchun antennalar o'rtasida optik ko'rinish (LOS) zarur. Binolar, daraxtlar va relyef signalni kuchsizlantiradi va tezlikni pasaytiradi. Toshkent yoki mintaqadagi obyektni tekshirish bosqichida biz trassani tekshiramiz va zarur bo'lganda o'rnatish nuqtalarini ko'tarishni taklif qilamiz.

Q: Ko'prik +45 °C gacha jaziramada barqaror ishlaydimi?
A: Ruijie ko'cha modellari O'zbekistonning yozgi jaziramasini qoplaydigan keng harorat diapazonida ekspluatatsiya qilishga mo'ljallangan. Montajda biz kanal butun yil davomida barqaror ishlashi uchun qizishni, namlikdan himoyani va momaqaldiroqdan himoyani hisobga olamiz.

Q: Radioko'prik optika tortishdan nimasi bilan yaxshi?
A: Radioko'prik soatlarda joylashtiriladi, xandaqlar, kelishuvlar va kabel kanalizatsiyasini ijaraga olishni talab qilmaydi, uskunani esa boshqa obyektga ko'chirish mumkin. Bu simli liniya masofaga, begona hududga yoki obyektning vaqtinchalik xarakteriga duch keladigan joyda foydaliroq va tezroq. SAT Solutions vazifangiz uchun variantlarni solishtirishga yordam beradi.

Q: Bir nechta obyektni bitta nuqtaga ulash mumkinmi?
A: Ha, "nuqta-ko'p nuqta" (PtMP) sxemasidan foydalanganda bitta bazaviy nuqtadan bir nechta abonentni quvvatlantirish mumkin. Bu filiallar, turar-joy majmualari korpuslari yoki taqsimlangan kameralar uchun qulay. Biz topologiyani loyihalaymiz va katalogdan mos modellarni tanlaymiz.
ruijie-wireless.en:
A radio bridge is a pair of wireless devices that connect two points over a radio channel where laying cable or fiber is impossible, expensive or impractical. With their help, the local networks of two buildings are united, internet is brought to a remote facility, video surveillance cameras are connected at an entrance or perimeter, and communication is organized between a warehouse and an office across a road or industrial zone. You can buy radio bridges in Tashkent for a specific task and distance through the SAT Solutions catalog — we select a model by range, speed and operating conditions, rather than "from a list".

The main advantage of a radio bridge over a traditional wired line is the speed of deployment and independence from someone else's infrastructure. There is no need to coordinate trenches, rent communication conduits or run fiber across third-party territory. It is enough to install two antennas in line of sight, aim them at each other and configure the channel. This is especially valuable at temporary facilities, during rapid network expansion and where a wired connection runs into physical or administrative limitations.

In the conditions of Uzbekistan, radio bridges are in demand at distributed facilities: production sites and warehouses on the outskirts of Tashkent, farming and agricultural facilities in the regions, construction sites, guarded perimeters, facilities with branches within a single district. The equipment operates outdoors all year round, so resistance to heat up to +45 °C, dust and precipitation is important, as well as a sound calculation of the route taking into account terrain and interference in the band. An error at the design stage — an incorrectly chosen band, an underestimated distance or an obstacle on the route — results in an unstable channel, so the selection should be entrusted to specialists rather than choosing a model by price alone.

## How to choose

- **Range and line of sight:** the key parameter. There must be optical visibility (LOS) between the points; obstacles, trees and buildings sharply reduce channel quality. Choose a model with a range reserve relative to the actual distance between the facilities.
- **Throughput:** assess the real load — for a pair of IP cameras a modest channel is enough, while for uniting office networks or transmitting high-resolution video streams a model with higher performance is needed.
- **Frequency band:** the range, noise immunity and airwave congestion depend on the band. In the dense urban development of Tashkent, the airwaves are noisy, so the choice of band and channels affects stability more than the "paper" speed.
- **Kit type:** some models are supplied as a ready "point-to-point" (PtP) pair, while others allow building "point-to-multipoint" (PtMP) schemes, when several subscriber points are fed from a single base point. This determines the topology of your network.
- **PoE power and installation:** most outdoor bridges are powered via PoE — this simplifies the laying of a single cable to a mast or bracket. Take into account the length of the cable run to the power point and the presence of lightning protection.
- **Environmental protection:** for outdoor installation in the climate of Uzbekistan, a housing with dust and moisture protection and a declared operating temperature range covering the summer heat and winter cold is needed.
- **Channel security:** the presence of wireless connection encryption is mandatory if corporate traffic or video surveillance data goes over the bridge. A wireless line is by default available for interception, so channel protection is not an option but a basic requirement.
- **Reserve for growth and interference:** allow a throughput reserve and take into account that the airwaves become denser over time, especially in urban development. A model with a reserve will work longer without replacement and speed drops.

## Applications

- **Production and warehouses:** communication between shops, warehouse buildings and the administrative building on a territory where cable laying is difficult.
- **Trade and logistics:** connecting remote pavilions, retail points at markets and distribution centers to a unified network and video surveillance system.
- **Residential complexes and cottage settlements:** uniting the buildings of a residential complex, extending internet and video surveillance to a checkpoint, entrance groups and remote buildings.
- **Government institutions and education:** communication between the buildings of institutions, school and university buildings within a single territory without capital construction of communication lines.
- **Construction sites:** rapid deployment of communication and internet at temporary facilities with the ability to relocate the equipment.
- **Special facilities and perimeter security:** transmission of video streams from remote cameras at entrances, perimeters and guarded areas where there is no wired infrastructure.

## Brands and models in the catalog

- **Ruijie RG-AirMetro460G** — a radio bridge for building backbone wireless "point-to-point" channels between facilities.
- **Ruijie RG-EST100-E** — an entry-level model of the EST series for typical tasks of uniting networks over short and medium distances.
- **Ruijie RG-EST310-V2 and RG-EST350-V2** — bridges of the EST series for more productive channels and extended usage scenarios.
- **Ruijie RG-EST330F-P** — a model of the EST series with PoE power support for outdoor installation.
- The SAT Solutions catalog features Ruijie equipment of the EST and AirMetro series — a unified ecosystem, convenient to operate and compatible with the rest of this manufacturer's network infrastructure.

## FAQ

Q: Over what distance can a radio bridge be built?
A: The range depends on the specific model, the chosen band and the route conditions. The main condition is line of sight between the points without serious obstacles. SAT Solutions specialists will calculate the real range for your pair of facilities and select a Ruijie model with the necessary reserve.

Q: Is line of sight between the points required?
A: Yes, for stable operation of a radio bridge, optical visibility (LOS) between the antennas is necessary. Buildings, trees and terrain weaken the signal and reduce speed. At the facility survey stage in Tashkent or the region, we check the route and, if necessary, propose raising the installation points.

Q: Will the bridge work stably in heat up to +45 °C?
A: Ruijie outdoor models are designed for operation over a wide temperature range covering the summer heat of Uzbekistan. During installation, we take into account heating, moisture protection and lightning protection so that the channel works stably all year round.

Q: Why is a radio bridge better than laying fiber?
A: A radio bridge is deployed in hours, requires no trenches, approvals or renting of cable conduits, and the equipment can be relocated to another facility. This is more advantageous and faster where a wired line runs into distance, someone else's territory or the temporary nature of the facility. SAT Solutions will help compare the options for your task.

Q: Can several facilities be connected to a single point?
A: Yes, when using a "point-to-multipoint" (PtMP) scheme, several subscriber points can be fed from a single base point. This is convenient for branches, residential complex buildings or distributed cameras. We will design the topology and select suitable models from the catalog.

Elektron va biometrik qulflar — bu an'anaviy mexanik kalitni identifikatsiyalashning elektron usullari bilan: barmoq izi, kod, karta, smartfon yoki bu usullar kombinatsiyasi bilan almashtiradigan yoki to'ldiradigan kirishni boshqarish qurilmalari. Ular bir vaqtning o'zida ikkita vazifani hal qiladi: kundalik foydalanish qulayligini oshiradi va kirish guruhi xavfsizligini kuchaytiradi, chunki yo'qolgan yoki nusxalangan kalitning inson omilini bartaraf etadi. Alohida vazifalar klassi — qulfni obyektning umumiy xavfsizlik tizimiga integratsiya qilish. Zamonaviy modellar izolyatsiyalangan holda emas, balki SKUDning qismi sifatida ishlaydi: ochilish hodisalari qayd etiladi, kirishni vaqt bo'yicha cheklash mumkin, boshqaruvni esa masofadan olib borish mumkin. ## Qanday tanlash kerak

- **Identifikatsiya usuli:** nima kerakligini aniqlang — barmoq izi (biometriya), PIN-kod, RFID-karta, mobil ilova yoki ularning birikmasi. ZKTeco HBL400 kabi biometrik modellar o'tish tezligi va kalitlardan voz kechish muhim bo'lgan joyda qulay, kodli modellar esa kirish vaqtinchalik beriladigan joyda.
- **Eshik turi:** qulf polotna materiali va konstruksiyasiga moslab tanlanadi. Metall va yog'och eshiklar uchun ichki (vreznoy) mexanizmlar kerak, shisha to'siqlar va eshiklar uchun — polotnani teshmasdan maxsus shisha qulflar.
- **Avtonomlik va quvvat:** qurilma o'rnatilgan akkumulyator yoki batareyalardan ishlaydimi, zaryadni qancha ushlab turadi va zaryadsizlanganda zaxira ochish bormi, aniqlang. Beqaror elektr tarmog'iga ega obyektlar uchun avtonomlik muhim.
- **Foydalanuvchilar xotirasi va hodisalar jurnali:** qulf qancha barmoq izi, karta va kod saqlashini va ochilishlar logini yuritishini baholang. O'nlab xodimli ofis uchun kvartiradan ko'ra kattaroq xotira hajmi kerak.
- **Aloqa va boshqaruv:** simsiz ZKTeco modellari kirishni boshqarish va hodisalarni masofadan olish imkonini beradi. Sizga smartfon va bulut bilan integratsiya kerakmi yoki lokal boshqaruv yetarlimi, hal qiling.
- **Himoya va ishonchlilik:** antivandal himoya klassiga, buzishga urinishdagi xatti-harakatga, mexanik favqulodda ochishning mavjudligiga va changga hamda harorat o'zgarishlariga chidamlilikka e'tibor bering.
- **SKUD bilan moslik:** agar obyekt allaqachon kirishni boshqarish tizimi bilan jihozlangan bo'lsa, qulf unga to'g'ri o'rnatilishi, alohida ishlamasligi kerak.

## Qo'llanilish sohalari

- **Turar-joy ko'chmas mulki:** xususiy uylar, kvartiralar, apartamentlar — kalitsiz kirish qulayligi va oila a'zolari hamda xizmat ko'rsatuvchi xodimlar kirishini nazorat qilish.
- **Ofislar va biznes-markazlar:** xodimlar, kabinetlar va muzokara xonalari o'rtasida kirishni ajratish, o'tishlar jurnalini yuritish, ishdan bo'shatilgan xodimni tez o'chirish.
- **Savdo va xizmat ko'rsatish sohasi:** do'konlar, salonlar, savdo nuqtalaridagi omborlar — yordamchi va kassa zonalarini himoya qilish, ish vaqtidan tashqarida kirishni nazorat qilish.
- **Mehmonxonalar va ijara uy-joyi:** mehmonlar uchun vaqtinchalik kodlar va kartalar, fizik kalitlardan va ularni yo'qotganda almashtirish xarajatlaridan voz kechish.
- **Davlat muassasalari va ta'lim:** kabinetlar, arxivlar, serverxonalar va cheklangan kirishli xonalar, bu yerda barcha ochilish hodisalarini qayd etish muhim.
- **Maxsus obyektlar:** serverxonalar, omborxonalar, moddiy qadriyatlar va cheklangan doiradagi ruxsat etilgan shaxslarga ega xonalar.

## Katalogdagi brendlar va modellar

- **Simsiz ZKTeco qulfi** — simli infratuzilmasiz foydalanuvchilarni moslashuvchan boshqarish talab qilinadigan obyektlar uchun mos, kirishni masofadan boshqaradigan model.
- **Shisha ZKTeco qulfi** — polotna yaxlitligini buzmasdan ofis va savdo xonalarining shisha eshiklari va to'siqlari uchun yechim.
- **Elektron ZKTeco qulfi** — turar-joy va tijorat obyektlarida kodli va kartali kirish uchun bazaviy elektron yechim.

## FAQ

Q: Biometrik qulf oddiysidan nimasi bilan ishonchliroq?
A: U kalitni zaif bo'g'in sifatida bartaraf etadi: barmoq izini mexanik kalit kabi oson yo'qotib, nusxalab yoki uzatib bo'lmaydi. Aksariyat modellar ochilishlar jurnalini yuritadi, shuning uchun kim va qachon kirgani doimo ko'rinadi. Xodim ishdan bo'shatilganda uning barmoq izini xotiradan o'chirish yetarli, qulfni almashtirmasdan.

Q: Elektron qulf shisha eshik uchun mos keladimi?
A: Ha, buning uchun SAT Solutions katalogida shisha eshiklar va to'siqlarga mo'ljallangan alohida ZKTeco shisha qulfi mavjud. U polotnani teshmasdan montaj qilinadi va shaffof kirish guruhli ofis va savdo xonalari uchun mos keladi. Muayyan modelni tanlash shishaning qalinligi va mahkamlanishiga bog'liq.

Q: Qulf akkumulyatori o'tirib qolsa nima bo'ladi?
A: Aksariyat elektron qulflarda favqulodda ochish — mexanik kalit yoki zaxira razyom orqali tashqi quvvat bilan ko'zda tutilgan. Zaryadsizlanishdan oldin qurilma odatda foydalanuvchini ogohlantiradi. SAT Solutions mutaxassislari montajda sizning ekspluatatsiya stsenariyingizga avtonomlikni hisobga olib model tanlaydi.

Q: Qulfni masofadan boshqarish mumkinmi?

Bu ijara uy-joyi va vaqtinchalik kirish berish kerak bo'lgan obyektlar uchun qulay. Aniq imkoniyatlar tanlangan modelga bog'liq — biz Toshkentda vazifalaringizga mos keladiganini tavsiya qilamiz.

Q: SAT Solutions qulflarni faqat Toshkentda emas, mintaqalarda ham o'rnatadimi?
A: Ha, biz butun O'zbekiston bo'ylab, jumladan uzoq obyektlarda montaj va ishga tushirishni bajaramiz. O'rnatishdan tashqari foydalanuvchilarni sozlaymiz, qulfni mavjud kirishni boshqarish tizimiga integratsiya qilamiz va xodimlarni u bilan ishlashga o'rgatamiz. Obyekt topshirilgach servis uchun aloqada qolamiz.
zkteco-locks.en:
Electronic and biometric locks are access control devices that replace or supplement the traditional mechanical key with electronic identification methods: a fingerprint, a code, a card, a smartphone or a combination of these methods. They cover two tasks at once: they increase the convenience of daily use and strengthen the security of the entrance group, since they remove the human factor of a lost or copied key. You can buy locks in Tashkent for a residential, office or commercial facility through the SAT Solutions catalog — we select a model for the specific type of door and operating scenario, rather than selling a "box".

In the conditions of the Uzbek market, electronic locks are in demand both in private houses and in apartments, and in commercial premises, where an event log of "who opened the door and when" is important. A biometric lock removes dependence on a physical key: the owner does not need to carry a bunch, issue duplicates to staff or change the lock cylinder when an employee is dismissed — it is enough to delete the fingerprint or code from the device's memory. This is especially valuable for facilities with a changing set of users: rental housing, offices, cabinets and utility rooms.

A separate class of tasks is the integration of the lock into the overall security system of the facility. Modern models work not in isolation but as part of an ACS: opening events are recorded, access can be restricted by time, and management can be conducted remotely. For facilities in Tashkent and the regions, it is important to take into account local specifics — temperature swings, dust, power grid instability — and select devices that remain operable in real, not laboratory, conditions.

## How to choose

- **Identification method:** determine what is needed — a fingerprint (biometrics), a PIN code, an RFID card, a mobile app or their combination. Biometric models like the ZKTeco HBL400 are convenient where the speed of passage and the abandonment of keys are important, while code-based ones — where access is granted temporarily.
- **Type of door:** the lock is selected for the material and design of the leaf. Metal and wooden doors require mortise mechanisms, while glass partitions and doors require specialized glass locks without drilling the leaf.
- **Autonomy and power:** clarify whether the device runs on a built-in accumulator or batteries, how long it holds a charge and whether there is backup opening when discharged. For facilities with an unstable power grid, autonomy is critical.
- **User memory and event log:** assess how many fingerprints, cards and codes the lock stores and whether it keeps a log of openings. For an office with dozens of employees, a larger memory volume is needed than for an apartment.
- **Communication and management:** wireless ZKTeco models allow managing access and receiving events remotely. Decide whether you need integration with a smartphone and the cloud, or local management is sufficient.
- **Protection and reliability:** pay attention to the vandal-protection class, behavior during a break-in attempt, the presence of mechanical emergency opening and resistance to dust and temperature swings.
- **Compatibility with ACS:** if the facility is already equipped with an access control system, the lock must integrate into it correctly rather than work in isolation.

## Applications

- **Residential real estate:** private houses, apartments, flats — convenient keyless entry and access control of family members and service staff.
- **Offices and business centers:** differentiation of access between employees, cabinets and meeting rooms, keeping a log of passages, quick disabling of dismissed staff.
- **Trade and services:** shops, salons, warehouses at retail points — protection of utility and checkout zones, access control during non-working hours.
- **Hotels and rental housing:** temporary codes and cards for guests, abandonment of physical keys and the costs of their replacement when lost.
- **Government institutions and education:** cabinets, archives, server rooms and restricted-access premises where recording all opening events is important.
- **Special facilities:** server rooms, storerooms, premises with material assets and a limited circle of authorized persons.

## Brands and models in the catalog

- **ZKTeco** — the main brand in this category, specializing in biometrics and access control; models for different types of doors and operating scenarios.
- **ZKTeco HBL400** — a biometric lock for entrance doors with fingerprint identification; there is a demonstration variant HBL400+DEMO for getting acquainted with the functionality.
- **ZKTeco wireless lock** — a model with remote access management, suitable for facilities where flexible user management without wired infrastructure is required.
- **ZKTeco glass lock** — a solution for glass doors and partitions of offices and retail premises without compromising the integrity of the leaf.
- **ZKTeco electronic lock** — a basic electronic solution for code and card access at residential and commercial facilities.

## FAQ

Q: Why is a biometric lock more reliable than an ordinary one?
A: It eliminates the key as a vulnerable link: a fingerprint cannot be lost, copied or handed over as easily as a mechanical key. Most models keep a log of openings, so it is always visible who entered and when. When an employee is dismissed, it is enough to delete their fingerprint from the memory without changing the lock.

Q: Is an electronic lock suitable for a glass door?
A: Yes, for this the SAT Solutions catalog has a separate ZKTeco glass lock designed for glass doors and partitions. It is mounted without drilling the leaf and is suitable for offices and retail premises with transparent entrance groups. The choice of a specific model depends on the thickness and mounting of the glass.

Q: What happens if the lock's accumulator runs down?
A: Most electronic locks provide for emergency opening — with a mechanical key or external power via a backup connector. Before discharging, the device usually warns the user. SAT Solutions specialists select a model during installation taking into account autonomy for your operating scenario.

Q: Can the lock be managed remotely?
A: Yes, wireless ZKTeco models allow managing access and receiving opening events remotely, including from a smartphone. This is convenient for rental housing and facilities where temporary access needs to be granted. The specific capabilities depend on the chosen model — we will suggest one suitable for your tasks in Tashkent.

Q: Does SAT Solutions install locks in the regions, not only in Tashkent?
A: Yes, we perform installation and commissioning throughout Uzbekistan, including remote facilities. In addition to installation, we configure users, integrate the lock into the existing access control system and train staff to work with it. After handing over the facility, we remain in touch for service.

kanihad-cabinets.en:
Server and telecommunication cabinets are the backbone of any structured cabling system and server infrastructure. These are specialized 19-inch metal enclosures designed for mounting active and passive network equipment, storage systems, patch panels, switches and other hardware. A properly selected cabinet keeps the mounting space organized, protects equipment from mechanical damage and unauthorized access, and maintains a normal thermal operating regime. You can buy a server cabinet in Tashkent with a quality guarantee and professional installation from the SAT Solutions catalog.

The choice of cabinet is determined by the type of site, the quantity and nature of the equipment to be housed, and the available space. Wall-mounted models with 6, 9, 12 or 15 units are suitable for small offices and technical rooms — they take up minimal space and are easily mounted on the wall. For server rooms, communication nodes, data centers and large sites, floor-standing cabinets from 24 to 42 units and more are used. In Uzbekistan, demand for quality cabinets is growing due to the active construction of business centers, industrial and retail facilities, and the development of corporate networks — and SAT Solutions is ready to meet this need comprehensively: from supply to installation and commissioning.

In addition to the enclosure itself, proper cabinet configuration includes a power distribution unit (PDU strip) with the required number of outlets, cooling fan modules, shelves for non-unit equipment, brush cable entries and mounting kits. Each of these accessories affects the convenience of maintenance, reliability and durability of the entire system.

## How to choose

- Cabinet type: wall-mounted or floor-standing. Wall-mounted cabinets are suitable for a small amount of equipment and limited space. Floor-standing models are used in server rooms and technical spaces where access from several sides and the placement of a large number of devices are required.
- Height in units (U). Determined by the total number of units occupied by all planned equipment plus a 20-30% reserve for future expansion. Popular formats: 12U and 15U for wall-mounted, 32U and 42U for floor-standing cabinets.
- Enclosure depth and width. The standard width is 600 mm, the depth varies from 450 to 1000 mm. The depth is selected to fit the longest devices in the rack, usually servers or UPS units.
- Ventilation and cooling. Under high heat-dissipation loads, fan modules with forced cooling are required. For cabinets with passive ventilation, it is important to provide perforated doors and side panels.
- Cable management system. Brush panels, cable organizers and blanking plates ensure neat cable routing, simplify maintenance and reduce the risk of accidental disconnection.
- Power distribution unit (PDU). The number of outlets in the strip should cover all connected devices with a reserve. For critical sites, PDUs with power consumption monitoring are recommended.
- Quality of metal and hardware. The thickness of the enclosure steel, the quality of the locks and rails determine the durability of the cabinet and the level of equipment protection.

## Applications

- Corporate offices and business centers: housing switches, routers, servers, telephone exchanges, patch panels and storage systems.
- Manufacturing plants and warehouses: mounting industrial controllers, video surveillance systems, and data transmission equipment in limited technical spaces.
- Educational institutions, hospitals, government agencies: organizing communication nodes, housing database servers and network equipment.
- Shopping centers and hotels: mounting structured cabling equipment, IP telephony, and security systems.
- Telecommunication facilities and data centers: installing 42U and higher server racks fully equipped with cooling and power management accessories.
- Small offices and provider points of presence: compact wall-mounted cabinets of 6-15U for housing the minimum necessary set of active equipment.

## Brands and models in the catalog

- KANIHAD is the main brand in this catalog category. Both wall-mounted models (12U 600x600, 15U 600x600) and floor-standing cabinets of various formats (32U 600x900, 42U 800x800) are available, as well as a compact 4U 600x450 server cabinet. The product line covers a wide range of needs — from small office installations to server rooms.
- KANIHAD accessories: the catalog offers a complete set of components — 8-outlet PDUs, fan modules (2x and 4x coolers), shelves for floor-standing cabinets 600 and 800 mm deep, brush cable entries, and M6 mounting kits. This allows a cabinet to be configured for a specific task without searching for compatible accessories from third-party manufacturers.
- Unified 19-inch standard: all cabinets presented comply with the EIA-310 standard, which ensures compatibility with equipment from any manufacturer — Cisco, MikroTik, Huawei, D-Link, Dahua and others.

## FAQ

Q: Which cabinet should I choose for a small office of 20-30 people?
A: For a typical office of this size, a wall-mounted cabinet of 12-15 units with a depth of 600 mm is usually sufficient. It houses a switch, patch panel, router and, if necessary, a mini-PBX. The exact calculation depends on the list of equipment — our specialists will help you select the optimal option.

Q: Do I need a special fan if the cabinet is in a cool room?
A: Even at a low room temperature, heat can accumulate inside the cabinet when equipment is densely installed. Fan modules are recommended when the total equipment power is 500 W and above, or when there are devices with high heat dissipation — servers, UPS units, powerful switches.

Q: Can I buy a cabinet without installation, supply only?
A: Yes, SAT Solutions supplies cabinets and accessories without installation. However, we recommend using the installation and cable routing service — this guarantees correct assembly, compliance with cooling requirements, and neat wiring.

Q: What warranty is provided for the cabinets?
A: KANIHAD cabinets and accessories from our catalog come with a manufacturer's warranty. The warranty period is specified when placing the order. SAT Solutions also provides warranty support and replacement in case of a factory defect.

Q: Are the cabinets compatible with equipment from other manufacturers?
A: All cabinets in the catalog are made to the 19-inch standard (EIA-310), which ensures full compatibility with equipment of any brand — servers, switches, routers, patch panels and other devices of this format.

Machtaga to'g'ri o'rnatilgan bitta PTZ perimetr bo'ylab bir necha statsionar kamerani almashtirishga qodir, analitika bilan bog'langanda esa — harakatlanayotgan ob'ektni avtomatik kuzatib, uni kadrda ushlab turadi. Bu toifani keng ko'rinish ham, o'nlab va yuzlab metrga uzoqlashganda detallashtirish ham muhim bo'lgan joylarda ajralmas qiladi.

O'zbekiston sharoitida aylanuvchi kameralarga yuqori talablar qo'yiladi. +45°C gacha yozgi jazirama, chang, havodagi qumli muallaq zarralar va qish/yoz o'rtasidagi keskin harorat farqlari aylanuvchi uzelning mexanikasini va optikani yuklaydi, shuning uchun ko'chada o'rnatish uchun oynani isitish, puflab tozalash va germetik yuritmalarga ega himoyalangan bajarilishdagi modellar tanlanadi. Sanoat maydonlari, logistika terminallari, aeroportlar, qo'riqlanadigan perimetrlar va yirik turar-joy majmualari kabi ob'ektlarda PTZ-kameralar videokuzatuv tizimining yadrosiga aylanadi, modelni to'g'ri tanlash esa butun xavfsizlik konturining ishonchliligini bevosita belgilaydi.

## Qanday tanlash kerak

- **Optik zoom:** PTZ ning asosiy parametri. Optik transfokatorning karrali darajasi qancha yuqori bo'lsa, kamera raqamli interpolyatsiyasiz shuncha uzoq masofadagi detallarni (raqamlar, yuzlar) o'qiydi. Perimetr va katta masofalar uchun yuqori karrali modellar, hovli yoki maydon uchun — o'rtacha karrali modellar olinadi.
- **Ruxsat va matritsa:** ruxsat kadr detallashuvini belgilaydi, matritsaning o'lchami va yorug'likka sezgirligi esa — kuchsiz yoritishda tasvir sifatini. Mas'uliyatli ob'ektlar uchun yaxshi dinamik diapazonga (WDR) ega sensorlar tanlanadi, qarshi yorug'likda detallarni yo'qotmaslik uchun.
- **IR-yoritish va tungi rejim:** kechayu kunduz nazorat uchun zoom bilan muvofiqlashtirilgan infraqizil yoritishning masofasi muhim — masalan, H5A IR PTZ seriyasida. Yoritish optika yo'nala oladigan masofaga yetib borishi kerak.
- **Himoya va iqlimiy bajarilish:** O'zbekistonda ko'cha uchun changdan va namlikdan himoya sinfi (IP66/IP67), vandalizmga qarshi himoya, shuningdek isitish va puflash muhim — Rugged seriyasi og'ir ekspluatatsiya sharoitlari va keng harorat diapazoniga mo'ljallangan.
- **Pozitsiyalash tezligi va aniqligi:** aylanish tezligi, oldindan o'rnatilgan pozitsiyalar (presetlar) soni, patrul marshrutlari va nuqtaga qaytish aniqligi. Bu kamera trevoga hodisasini qanchalik tezkor bajarishini belgilaydi.
- **Bortdagi videoanalitika:** avtotreking (ob'ektni avtokuzatish), harakatni aniqlash, odamlar va transportni tasniflash. Avigilon kameralari operator va arxivga yukni kamaytiruvchi o'rnatilgan analitikasi bilan mashhur.
- **Infratuzilma bilan moslik:** kerakli protokollar va VMS ni qo'llab-quvvatlash, quvvat turi (PoE/PoE+), tarmoqning o'tkazuvchanlik qobiliyati va registratorga qo'yiladigan talablar. Bu integratsiyaning yakuniy narxiga ta'sir qiladi.

## Qo'llanilish sohalari

- **Sanoat va ishlab chiqarish maydonlari:** sexlar, ombor hovlilari, ortish zonalari va hudud bo'ylab transport harakatini nazorat qilish.
- **Logistika va transport uzellari:** terminallar, konteyner maydonlari, avtoturargohlar, kirish guruhlari — katta ochiq maydonlarni bitta qurilma bilan ko'rish.
- **Davlat idoralari va rejimli ob'ektlar:** ma'muriy binolar, idoraviy hududlar, xavfsizlik va hodisalarni kuzatishga yuqori talablar qo'yiladigan ob'ektlar.
- **Turar-joy majmualari va yopiq hududlar:** Toshkent va viloyatlarning yirik turar-joy majmualarida hovlilar, bolalar va sport maydonchalari, o'tish yo'llari va perimetrni ko'rish.
- **Savdo va jamoat ob'ektlari:** savdo-ko'ngilochar markazlar, bozorlar, avtoturargohlar va yondosh maydonlar, u yerda keng ko'rinish ham, aniq nuqtaga yaqinlashish imkoniyati ham kerak.
- **Perimetr himoyasi va maxsus ob'ektlar:** energetika, neft-gaz, suv olish inshootlari, kameralarni machtaga o'rnatish va marshrutlar bo'ylab patrul qilish bilan qo'riqlanadigan perimetrlar.

## Katalogdagi brendlar va modellar

- **Avigilon** — toifaning asosiy brendi, o'rnatilgan videoanalitikaga va mas'uliyatli ob'ektlar uchun optika sifatiga urg'u bergan professional PTZ-kameralar bilan taqdim etilgan.
- **Avigilon H5A IR PTZ** — uzoq va yoritilmagan uchastkalarda kechayu kunduz kuzatuv uchun o'rnatilgan infraqizil yoritishga ega H5A liniyasidagi aylanuvchi kamera.
- **Avigilon H5A Rugged PTZ** — og'ir ekspluatatsiya sharoitlari uchun kuchaytirilgan himoyalangan bajarilishdagi model: chang, harorat farqlari, perimetrda ko'chada o'rnatish.
- **Bazaviy konfiguratsiyadagi Avigilon PTZ-kameralari** — hududni ko'rish va ob'ektlarni kuzatishning tipik vazifalari uchun aylanuvchi yechimlar; aniq modifikatsiya ob'ektning masofalari va senariysi ostida tanlanadi.

## FAQ

Q: Bitta PTZ nechta statsionar kamerani almashtiradi?
A: Bu hudud geometriyasiga bog'liq, lekin to'g'ri o'rnatilgan bitta PTZ bir necha qat'iy kamera kerak bo'ladigan perimetr yoki maydonni qoplashga qodir. Amaliyotda PTZ statsionar kameralarni to'ldiradi: qat'iy kameralar doimiy ko'rinish beradi, aylanuvchisi esa hodisaga tezkor yo'naltiriladi. SAT Solutions muhandislari sizning ob'ektingiz uchun optimal nisbatni hisoblab beradi.

Q: PTZ-kamera Toshkentdagi yozgi jazirama bardosh beradimi?
A: Ha, modelni to'g'ri tanlaganda. O'zbekistonda ko'chada o'rnatish uchun biz kengaytirilgan harorat diapazoni va oynani puflashga ega himoyalangan bajarilishdagi kameralarni tanlaymiz — masalan, Avigilon H5A Rugged PTZ seriyasini. Bunday qurilmalar +45°C gacha jazirama, chang va keskin harorat farqlari sharoitida ishlashga mo'ljallangan.

Q: Avtotreking nima va u menga kerakmi?
A: Avtotreking — bu harakatlanayotgan ob'ektni avtomatik kuzatish: kamera odam yoki transportni kadrda ushlab, uning ortidan aylanadi. Funksiya perimetrlar va katta ochiq maydonlarda foydali, u yerda operator jismonan hamma narsani kuzata olmaydi. Avigilon kameralari o'rnatilgan analitikani qo'llab-quvvatlaydi, SAT Solutions esa uni sizning ob'ektingiz senariylariga sozlaydi.

Q: Avigilon PTZ-kameralarini allaqachon ishlayotgan videokuzatuv tizimiga ulash mumkinmi?
A: Aksariyat hollarda ha — protokollar va tarmoqning o'tkazuvchanlik qobiliyati bo'yicha moslik sharti bilan. Biz joriy infratuzilma, registrator va VMS ni tekshiramiz, so'ngra aylanuvchi kameralarni amaldagi konturga integratsiyalaymiz. Zarur bo'lsa, SAT Solutions tarmoq uzellari yoki saqlash tizimini modernizatsiya qilishni taklif qiladi.

Q: PTZ-kamera qanday aniqlash masofasini ta'minlaydi?
A: Masofa optik zoomning karrali darajasiga, matritsa ruxsatiga va tungi rejimda IR-yoritish masofasiga bog'liq. Bu parametrlar qancha yuqori bo'lsa, kamera yo'naltirilganda detallarni shuncha uzoq o'qiydi. Sizning ob'ektingizda raqamlar yoki yuzlarni o'qish uchun aniq masofani SAT Solutions muhandislari loyihalash bosqichida hisoblab beradi.
avigilon-ptz.en:
PTZ cameras are motorized cameras with control over horizontal movement (Pan), vertical movement (Tilt) and an optical zoom lens (Zoom). Unlike fixed cameras, such a camera physically moves the lens, covering a full 360° circle and zooming in on distant objects without loss of detail. You can buy PTZ pan-tilt-zoom cameras in Tashkent for a specific perimeter security or wide open area monitoring task through the SAT Solutions catalog, which brings together proven Avigilon models with full support from selection to commissioning.

Pan-tilt-zoom cameras solve a problem that an array of fixed devices cannot: monitoring a vast territory with a single device while being able to quickly aim at a point of interest and examine it in full detail. A single well-installed PTZ on a mast can replace several fixed cameras along the perimeter, and combined with analytics it can automatically track a moving object, keeping it in frame. This makes the category indispensable where both a wide field of view and detail at distances of tens and hundreds of meters matter.

In Uzbekistan, pan-tilt-zoom cameras are subject to increased requirements. Summer heat up to +45°C, dust, airborne sand suspension and sharp winter/summer temperature swings load the mechanics of the pan-tilt unit and the optics, so for outdoor installation models are chosen in a protective enclosure with heating, glass blowing and sealed drives. At sites such as industrial areas, logistics terminals, airports, guarded perimeters and large residential complexes, PTZ cameras become the core of the video surveillance system, and the correct model selection directly determines the reliability of the entire security loop.

## How to choose

- **Optical zoom:** the key PTZ parameter. The higher the optical zoom ratio, the farther the camera reads details (license plates, faces) without digital interpolation. High-ratio models are chosen for the perimeter and long distances, moderate ones for a yard or square.
- **Resolution and sensor:** resolution determines frame detail, while the size and light sensitivity of the sensor determine picture quality in low light. For critical sites, sensors with a good dynamic range (WDR) are chosen so as not to lose details in backlight.
- **IR illumination and night mode:** for round-the-clock monitoring, the range of the infrared illumination matched to the zoom is important — for example, in the H5A IR PTZ series. The illumination must reach the same distance the optics can aim at.
- **Protection and climate rating:** for outdoor use in Uzbekistan, the class of protection against dust and moisture (IP66/IP67), vandal resistance, as well as heating and blowing are critical — the Rugged series is designed for harsh operating conditions and a wide temperature range.
- **Positioning speed and accuracy:** rotation speed, the number of preset positions (presets), patrol routes and return-to-point accuracy. This determines how quickly the camera responds to an alarm event.
- **Onboard video analytics:** auto-tracking (automatic object tracking), motion detection, classification of people and vehicles. Avigilon cameras are known for their built-in analytics, which reduces the load on the operator and the archive.
- **Compatibility with infrastructure:** support for the required protocols and VMS, type of power (PoE/PoE+), network bandwidth and recorder requirements. This affects the final cost of integration.

## Applications

- **Industrial and manufacturing sites:** monitoring workshops, warehouse yards, shipping zones and vehicle movement across the territory.
- **Logistics and transport hubs:** terminals, container yards, parking lots, entrance groups — overview of large open spaces with a single device.
- **Government agencies and restricted-access facilities:** administrative buildings, departmental territories, sites with heightened requirements for security and event tracking.
- **Residential complexes and gated areas:** overview of yards, children's and sports grounds, driveways and the perimeter in large residential complexes of Tashkent and the regions.
- **Retail and public facilities:** shopping and entertainment centers, markets, parking lots and adjacent squares, where both a wide overview and the ability to zoom in on a specific point are needed.
- **Perimeter security and special facilities:** energy, oil and gas, water intakes, guarded perimeters with mast-mounted cameras and route patrolling.

## Brands and models in the catalog

- **Avigilon** is the main brand of the category, represented by professional PTZ cameras with an emphasis on built-in video analytics and optical quality for critical sites.
- **Avigilon H5A IR PTZ** is a pan-tilt-zoom camera from the H5A line with built-in infrared illumination for round-the-clock surveillance in remote and unlit areas.
- **Avigilon H5A Rugged PTZ** is a model in a reinforced protective enclosure for harsh operating conditions: dust, temperature swings, outdoor perimeter installation.
- **Avigilon PTZ cameras in basic configurations** are pan-tilt-zoom solutions for typical tasks of territory overview and object tracking; the specific modification is selected for the distances and scenario of the site.

## FAQ

Q: How many fixed cameras does one PTZ replace?
A: This depends on the geometry of the territory, but one well-installed PTZ can cover a perimeter or area that would otherwise require several fixed cameras. In practice, a PTZ complements fixed cameras: fixed ones provide a constant overview, while the pan-tilt one quickly aims at an event. SAT Solutions engineers will calculate the optimal ratio for your site.

Q: Will a PTZ camera withstand the summer heat in Tashkent?
A: Yes, with the right model choice. For outdoor installation in Uzbekistan, we select cameras in a protective enclosure with an extended temperature range and glass blowing — for example, the Avigilon H5A Rugged PTZ series. Such devices are designed to operate in heat up to +45°C, dust and sharp temperature swings.

Q: What is auto-tracking and do I need it?
A: Auto-tracking is the automatic following of a moving object: the camera itself keeps a person or vehicle in frame, turning to follow it. The function is useful on perimeters and large open areas where an operator physically cannot watch everything. Avigilon cameras support built-in analytics, and SAT Solutions will configure it for the scenarios of your site.

Q: Can Avigilon PTZ cameras be connected to an already operating video surveillance system?
A: In most cases yes — provided there is compatibility in terms of protocols and network bandwidth. We check the current infrastructure, recorder and VMS, after which we integrate the pan-tilt-zoom cameras into the existing loop. If required, SAT Solutions will propose an upgrade of network nodes or the storage system.

Q: What recognition range does a PTZ camera provide?
A: The range depends on the optical zoom ratio, sensor resolution and IR illumination range in night mode. The higher these parameters, the farther the camera reads details when aiming. SAT Solutions engineers will calculate the exact distance for reading license plates or faces at your site during the design stage.

pxt-server.en:
Server equipment is the foundation of any corporate IT infrastructure. It is servers that provide centralized data storage, request processing, and the operation of video analytics, access control systems and other security solutions. You can buy server equipment in Tashkent today for the most diverse tasks: from a small file server in an office to a high-load computing node at a large industrial site. SAT Solutions offers a wide selection of servers, drives, memory modules and related components, adapted to real operating conditions in Uzbekistan.

The catalog features Supermicro server platforms with Intel Xeon Silver processors, Toshiba Enterprise enterprise hard drives with capacities up to 20 TB, Intel D3 and S4 series SSDs with a SATA 6 Gbit/s interface, Micron DDR5 ECC RAM, as well as LR-Link network adapters and specialized interface cables for SAS/NVMe configurations. Each component is selected with regard to the requirements for reliability and durability under round-the-clock operation. Properly selected server equipment reduces the risks of downtime, speeds up data processing and ensures system scalability as the load grows.

Choosing a server and its components is a responsible process that requires an analysis of the load, the network architecture and the fault-tolerance requirements. An error at this stage results either in excessive costs or in performance bottlenecks. SAT Solutions specialists will help you form the optimal configuration for your project and budget — from design to commissioning.

## How to choose

- Load type: for file storage and a video archive, a single-processor platform with a large volume of HDDs is sufficient, while databases, virtualization or video analytics require multi-core Xeon processors and fast low-latency SSDs.
- Volume and type of RAM: server systems require ECC memory (with error correction); DDR5 provides greater bandwidth compared to DDR4 — relevant when working with large data arrays.
- Data storage: SSDs are suitable for operating systems and hot data, enterprise-class HDDs (for example, Toshiba Enterprise 7.2k SATA) — for long-term video surveillance archives and backups.
- Form factor and placement: 1U/2U servers are rack-mounted and save space, while tower solutions are more convenient for small offices without a server room.
- Network infrastructure: multi-port network cards (for example, LR-Link 4×GbE) allow separating management, storage and video-stream traffic, reducing the risk of channel overload.
- Fault tolerance: data backup modules for RAID controllers (for example, Broadcom CVPM05) protect the cache during a sudden power outage — a mandatory element for mission-critical systems.
- Scalability: during design, it is worth providing free PCIe slots in advance, along with the ability to add disks and expand RAM — this will reduce the cost of future upgrades.

## Applications

- Video surveillance systems: servers act as central storage for IP cameras, providing long-term archive retention and real-time video analytics.
- Corporate networks and data centers: management of users, file resources, applications and databases at enterprises of any scale.
- Access control and security systems: the server stores pass databases, event logs and ensures the operation of ACS software even without an internet connection.
- Industrial and manufacturing sites: data collection from equipment, monitoring of technological processes, integration with SCADA systems.
- Medical institutions and education: storage of electronic documents, operation of medical information systems, organization of learning environments and remote access.
- Government and commercial sites in Uzbekistan: data localization, compliance with regulator requirements, uninterrupted operation of critical services.

## Brands and models in the catalog

- Supermicro (Pixietech platforms): dual-processor servers of the SYS-121C and SYS-221H series based on the Intel Xeon Silver 4514Y with DDR5 memory and SATA drives — reliable solutions for corporate tasks and virtualization.
- Intel (Pixietech drives): SSDs of the D3-S4520 and S4510 series with 3D TLC NAND and a SATA 6 Gbit/s interface with a capacity from 480 GB to 1.92 TB — proven drives for server loads with a long write endurance.
- Toshiba Enterprise (Pixietech): 3.5" hard drives with a capacity of 14 TB and 20 TB with a spindle speed of 7200 rpm and a SATA 6 Gbit/s interface — the optimal choice for video archives and backup storage.
- Micron: DDR5 ECC UDIMM 32 GB server RAM with a frequency of 5600 MHz — a modern standard for platforms with DDR5 support, providing reliability and high bandwidth.
- LR-Link and Broadcom: network adapters with four GbE ports and backup power modules for RAID controllers — components that increase the flexibility and fault tolerance of the server.

## FAQ

Q: Which server is suitable for storing a video surveillance archive?
A: For a video archive, the key parameter is the total capacity of the disk subsystem and the sequential write speed. The optimal solution will be servers with a large number of bays for enterprise-class HDDs (for example, Toshiba Enterprise 14–20 TB) in a RAID configuration. The number of disks depends on the number of cameras, the recording resolution and the archive depth.

Q: Do I need ECC memory for a server, or can I get by with ordinary memory?
A: For servers that store mission-critical data — a video archive, databases, ACS logs — ECC memory is mandatory. It automatically detects and corrects single errors in data, preventing file corruption and unexpected system failures.

Q: Can the server be upgraded after purchase?
A: Most Supermicro server platforms allow for expansion: adding RAM modules, replacing or adding drives, installing additional network cards in free PCIe slots. That is exactly why it is important when purchasing to consider not only the current but also the prospective load.

Q: How much does server equipment cost and how do I get an accurate quote?
A: The cost depends on the configuration: processor performance, the amount of memory and disk space, and the type of drives. To get an accurate price for your tasks, contact SAT Solutions specialists — they will prepare a commercial offer taking into account the budget and project requirements.

Q: Does SAT Solutions perform server installation and setup outside Tashkent?
A: Yes, the company works throughout Uzbekistan. Dispatching specialists for installation, commissioning and technical maintenance is possible in any region of the country — details are specified when coordinating the project.
